Its geographic segments include Australia and New Zealand. The Company offers consumer-ready products, including fresh, value-added, and further processed items. Its Ingham’s brand offers a range of products including Ingham's Chicken Breast Nuggets Cheesy, Ingham's Turkey Mince, Ingham's Classic Turkey Breast Oven Roasted, Ingham's Frozen Turkey Buffe, Ingham's Fresh Turkey Necks, Turkey Tenders Lettuce Wraps, Ingham's Turkey Thigh Roast, Ingham’s Family Chicken Nuggets Original, among others.

name: LYCOPODIUM LTD
businessSummary: Lycopodium Limited is an Australia-based company, which provides integrated engineering, construction and asset management solutions. The Company's segments include Resources, Rail Infrastructure, Industrial Processes and Other. The Resources segment consists of engineering and related services provided to the extractive mining industry. The clients, including junior exploration companies and multinational producers, are developing projects for a range of commodities. The Rail Infrastructure segment consists of asset management, engineering, architectural and project delivery services to a range of public and private clients across Australia. The Industrial Processes segment consists of engineering and related services provided to manufacturing and renewable energy facilities throughout Australia and Southeast Asia. The Company has a presence in Australia, Canada, the United States, Argentina, Brazil, Peru, South Africa, Namibia, Botswana, Ghana and the Philippines.

name: CENTURIA CAPITAL GROUP
businessSummary: Centuria Capital Group is an Australia-based specialist investment manager. The Company delivers a range of products and services to investors, advisers and security holders. The Company offers a range of investment opportunities, including listed and unlisted real estate funds as well as tax-effective investment bonds. Its principal activities are the marketing and management of investment products including property investment funds and friendly society investment bonds, as well as co-investments in property investment funds. Its segments include Property funds management, Co-investments, Developments, Property and development finance, Investment bonds management and Corporate. Property Funds Management segment is engaged in the management of listed and unlisted property funds. Developments segment manages development projects and completion of structured property developments, which span sectors ranging from commercial office, industrial, health through to residential mixed use.

name: JUMBO INTERACTIVE LTD
businessSummary: Jumbo Interactive Limited is a digital lottery specialist. The Company provides its lottery software platforms and lottery management expertise to the charity and government lottery sectors in Australia and globally. Its segments include Lottery Retailing, which services business-to-consumer (B2C), Software-as-a-Service (SaaS), which services business-to-business (B2B) and business-to-government (B2G), Managed Services, which services B2B, and Dream Giveaways, which services B2C. Lottery Retailing is engaged in the sale of Australian national lottery and charity lottery tickets online and on mobile devices to customers in Australia and eligible overseas jurisdictions. SaaS is focused on development, supply and maintenance of SaaS for authorized businesses, charities and governments in the lottery market in Australia and the United Kingdom. The Managed Services is engaged in provision of lottery-related services for authorized businesses and charities in the lottery market.

name: SMARTGROUP CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Smartgroup Corporation Ltd is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in providing outsourced administration, fleet management, and software, distribution, and group services. The Company operates through three segments: Outsourced administration (OA), Vehicle services (VS), and Software, distribution, and group services (SDGS). The OA segment provides outsourced salary packaging services, novated leasing and associated products, and outsourced payroll services. The VS segment provides end-to-end fleet management services. The SDGS segment provides salary packaging software solutions, the marketing of salary packaging debit cards, distribution of vehicle insurance and workforce management software to the healthcare industry. The Company operates through a portfolio of brands including Smartsalary, Smartleasing, Smartfleet, Smartsalary Payroll Solutions, Autopia, Advantage Salary Packaging, AccessPay, PBI Solutions and Health-e Workforce Solutions.

name: DYNO NOBEL LTD
businessSummary: Dyno Nobel Limited is a technology supplier to the resources and agricultural sectors committed to helping create a sustainable and decarbonized world. The Company's segments include Dyno Nobel and Fertilisers. The Dyno Nobel segment includes Dyno Nobel Asia Pacific (DNAP), Dyno Nobel Americas (DNA), and Dyno Nobel EMEA & LATAM (DNEL). DNAP manufactures and sells industrial explosives and related products and services to the mining industry mainly in the Asia Pacific region. DNA manufactures and sells industrial explosives and related products and services to the mining, quarrying and construction industries in North America and initiating systems to businesses in Australia, Turkey and South Africa. It also manufactures and sells industrial chemicals. DNEL manufactures and sells industrial explosives and related products and services to the mining, quarrying and construction industries in the EMEA and LATAM regions. The Fertilisers segment represents the Phosphate Hill facility.

name: PREMIER INVESTMENTS LTD
businessSummary: Premier Investments Limited is an Australia-based company, which operates a number of specialty retail fashion chains within the specialty retail fashion markets in Australia, New Zealand, Asia and Europe. It also has investments in listed securities and money market deposits. It operates through two business segments: investments and retail. The retail segment represents the financial performance of a number of specialty retail fashion chains. The investment segment represents investments in securities for both long- and short-term gains, dividend income and interest. It owns Australian retail brands, such as Peter Alexander and Smiggle. Smiggle is a children’s stationery brand. Smiggle operates over 300 standalone stores across Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Malaysia, the United Kingdom and the Republic of Ireland. It also provides electrical consumer products. Its subsidiaries include Kimtara Investments Pty Ltd, Premfin Pty Ltd, Springdeep Investments Pty Ltd and others.

name: ORORA LTD
businessSummary: Orora Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the design, manufacture and decoration of glass bottles and aluminum cans. The Company operates through two segments: Global Glass and Orora Cans. The Global Glass segment, with operations spanning across Australasia, Europe, North America and the UAE, manufactures and provides glass packaging solutions. This segment produces a spectrum of glass packaging ranging from the manufacture, customization and decoration of glass bottles for the premium and ultra-premium spirit and wine markets to standard bottles. The Orora Cans segment, with manufacturing sites located across Australia and New Zealand, provides customers across the Asia-Pacific region with aluminum can solutions across the beverage sector. This segment offers a varied range of aluminum can styles and sizes as well as custom printing and decoration. It produces cans of all shapes and sizes for customers across carbonated soft drinks, beer, cider and others.

name: EBOS GROUP LTD
businessSummary: EBOS Group Limited is a marketer, wholesaler and distributor of healthcare, medical and pharmaceutical products. The Company is also the owner, product marketer and distributor of animal care brands. Its segments include Healthcare, Animal Care, and Corporate. The Healthcare segment includes sales of healthcare products in a range of sectors, through its own brands, retail healthcare, pharmacy, hospital and logistic services, and wholesale activities. The Animal Care segment includes sales of animal care products in a range of sectors, own manufactured and contract manufactured brands, retail, and wholesale activities. Its Community Pharmacy business includes Symbion, ProPharma, Pharmacy Wholesalers Russells, TerryWhite Chemmart, Good Price Pharmacy Warehouse, healthSAVE, Ventura Health, Minfos, DoseAid, Intellipharm, Endeavour Consumer Health, and Red Seal. Its contract logistics include Healthcare Logistics, Healthcare Logistics Clinical Trials and Clinect.

name: HANSEN TECHNOLOGIES LTD
businessSummary: Hansen Technologies Limited is a global provider of software and services to the energy, water and communications industries. The Company is engaged in the development, integration and support of software and services for the energy and utilities and communications and media sectors. Its segments include Energy & Utilities and Communications & Media. The Energy & Utilities segment encompasses the sale of software and the provision of consulting services for Energy & Utilities customers that primarily operate in electricity, gas and water. The Communications & Media segment encompasses the sale of software and the provision of consulting services for Communications & Media customers that primarily operate in telecommunications and pay-tv. Its services include software product services, cloud & hosting, managed services, and data protection and disaster recovery. Its software product services include architecture consulting, solution delivery, and systems integration.

name: BWP TRUST
businessSummary: BWP Trust (the Trust) is an Australia-based real estate investment trust, which is engaged in investing in and managing commercial properties throughout Australia. The Trust’s objective is to provide unitholders with a secure and growing income stream and long-term capital growth. The Trust’s properties are large format retailing properties, in particular, Bunnings Warehouses, leased to Bunnings Group Limited (Bunnings). Bunnings is a retailer of home improvement and outdoor living products in Australia and New Zealand, and a supplier to project builders, commercial trades people, and the housing industry. The Trust is an owner of Bunnings Warehouse sites in Australia, with a portfolio of 61 stores. Seven of the properties have adjacent retail showrooms that the Trust owns and are leased to other tenants. The Trust also owns six large format retail showroom properties, three industrial properties and has three vacant properties.

name: VEEM LTD
businessSummary: VEEM Limited (VEEM) is an Australia-based company, which is a designer and manufacturer of high-technology marine propulsion and stabilization systems for the global luxury motor yacht, fast ferry, commercial workboat, and defense industries. The Company is also engaged in manufacturing engineered products and services for the marine, defense, and mining industries. It operates various businesses, including VEEM Marine Propellers, VEEM Marine Gyrostabilizers, VEEM 24-7 Engineering, Defense, Timcast Hollowbar, Conquest Propellers, and SHARROW by VEEM. VEEM is a producer of high-performance propellers for inboard powered vessels. It is a manufacturer of specialized fin systems and components for defense, including the US Navy's LCS ride control foils and submarine valves and mufflers. VEEM is a manufacturing demonstrator propeller blades for the BAE type-26 Hunter Class frigate program. VEEM was also involved in the Large Hadron Collider and the Atlas Detector's Radiation Shield Doors.

name: SHAPE AUSTRALIA CORP LTD
businessSummary: SHAPE Australia Corporation Limited is an Australia-based national fitout and construction services specialist. The Company’s principal activities are construction, fitout, and refurbishment of commercial properties. Its capabilities include fitout and refurbishment, design and build, facade remediation, new build, modular construction, and aftercare and facilities maintenance. It offers across a range of industries, including commercial, government, defense, education, retail, healthcare, aged care, and hotels & hospitality. The Company provides fitout and refurbishment services, including high-end office fitout and a boutique hotel. It specializes in new build projects that include both traditional new construction and extensions to existing buildings. The Company also provides national facilities maintenance to clients with a property portfolio, large or small, to ensure the safe and operation of buildings, equipment, and systems.

name: RELIANCE WORLDWIDE CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Reliance Worldwide Corporation Limited is an Australia-based company, which designs, manufactures, and supplies water flow control and monitoring products and solutions for the plumbing and heating industry. Its principal product categories include plumbing solutions, appliance installation solutions, and Other products. Its plumbing solutions include brass and plastic push-to-connect plumbing fittings, other fittings, pipes, valves and integrated installation solutions. Its appliance installation solutions include fluid tech and appliance installation and repair. The Company's brands include JG Speedfit, HoldRite, and SharkBite. Its geographical segments include the Americas, Asia Pacific, and EMEA. The Asia Pacific segment includes Australia, New Zealand, Korea, and China. The EMEA segment includes the United Kingdom, Germany, Spain, Italy, Poland, France, and the Czech Republic. The Americas segment includes the United States of America and Canada.

name: DICKER DATA LTD
businessSummary: Dicker Data Limited is an Australia-based company, which is locally owned and operated distributor of information and communications technology (ICT) hardware, software, cloud and Internet of things (IoT) solutions. It also distributes information technology (IT) hardware, software, cloud, access control, surveillance and emerging technology solutions for the corporate and commercial market. It provides a range of solutions, which include access and surveillance, accessories, backup and recovery, business applications, business monitors, cloud, components, data center, data management, desktops, gaming, Internet of Things (IoT), networking, notebooks, peripherals, printers, pro AV and displays, power solutions, remote working, scanners and mobility, security surveillance, uninterruptible power supply (UPS), workstations, storage, servers, and video conferencing. Its subsidiaries include Express Data Holdings Pty Ltd, Dicker Data Financial Services Pty Ltd, and Dicker Data GP Pty Ltd.

name: IRESS LTD
businessSummary: Iress Limited is a technology company providing software to the financial services industry. The Company provides software and services for wealth management, financial advice, trading and market data, life and pensions and data intelligence in Asia-Pacific, North America, Africa, the United Kingdom (UK) and Europe. Its Trading & Global Market Data segment provides comprehensive solutions to financial market participants, encompassing market data, trading, compliance, order management, portfolio, and related tools designed to enhance business efficiencies. Its APAC Wealth Management provides financial advice software and related tools to the advice industry in the Asia Pacific region. Its UK segment includes UK Wealth Management and Sourcing, which provides insurance and mortgage comparison tools to UK financial advisers. Its South Africa, Canada & Other segment includes Financial Markets businesses, and Wealth Management.

name: BREVILLE GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Breville Group Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in designing, developing and marketing small electrical kitchen appliances across the globe. The Company operates through two segments: Global Product segment and Distribution segment. The Global Product segment sells products designed and developed by the Company that may be sold directly or through third parties or by other group-owned brands. The Distribution segment sells products that are designed and developed by a third party and are distributed pursuant to a license or distribution agreement or are sourced directly from manufacturers. Products in this business unit may be sold under Breville and Kambrook brands or through third-party brands, such as Nespresso. Its products include espresso machines, Nespresso machines, drip coffee machines, coffee grinders, juicers, blenders, ovens and air fryers, pizza ovens, microwaves, bread makers, toasters, grills and sandwich makers, and waffle makers.

name: GLOBE INTERNATIONAL LTD
businessSummary: Globe International Limited is an Australia-based company, which is a global producer and distributor specializing in purpose-built apparel, footwear and skateboard hardgoods (decks, wheels, trucks, etc.) for the board sports, street fashion, outdoor and workwear markets with products sold in more than 65 countries worldwide. The Company's segments include Australasia, North America, and Europe. Its proprietary brands include Globe, Salty Crew, FXD, Impala Skate, and X/DMG. It maintains diverse licensing and distribution businesses of third party owned brands for the Australian and New Zealand market, operating under its Hardcore Distribution and 4Front divisions. Its third-party brands include XLarge, S/DOUBLE, Stance, szade, Ritual Vision, Pro-Tec, and hardcore. Impala Skate offers roller skates, inline skates, and skateboards. It has offices, distribution hubs, and manufacturing centers in Melbourne, Los Angeles, Newport Beach, San Diego, Hossegor and Shenzhen.

name: ANZ GROUP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: ANZ Group Holdings Limited is a non-operating holding company. Its divisions include Australia Retail, Australia Commercial, Institutional, New Zealand, Suncorp Bank, Pacific, and Group Center. The Australia Retail division provides a full range of banking services to Australian consumers. This includes Home Loans, Deposits, Credit Cards and Personal Loans. The Australia Commercial division offers a range of banking products and financial services. The Institutional division services institutional and corporate customers, and governments across Australia, New Zealand and International, including Papua New Guinea, via the business units, such as Transaction Banking, Corporate Finance, and Markets. New Zealand division comprises of business unit, such as Personal and Business & Agri. The Suncorp Bank division provides banking and related services to retail, commercial, small and medium enterprises and agribusiness customers in Australia.

name: XRF SCIENTIFIC LTD
businessSummary: XRF Scientific Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company manufactures equipment and chemicals, which are distributed to production mines, construction material companies and commercial analytical laboratories, in Australia and overseas, and used in the preparation of samples for analysis. The Company's segments include Capital Equipment, Precious Metals and Consumables. The Capital Equipment segment manufactures sample preparation products and analytical instruments. The Precious Metals segment manufactures products for the laboratory and industrial platinum alloy markets. The Consumables segment manufactures chemicals and other supplies for analytical laboratories. Its subsidiaries include XRF Chemicals Pty Ltd, XRF Labware Pty Ltd, XRF Technology (WA) Pty Ltd, XRF Technology (VIC) Pty Ltd, XRF Scientific Americas Inc, XRF Scientific UK Ltd, Precious Metals Engineering (WA) Pty Ltd, among others.

name: PRO MEDICUS LTD
businessSummary: Pro Medicus Limited is an Australia-based healthcare informatics company. It provides a full range of medical imaging software and services to hospitals, imaging centers and health care groups in Australia, North America and Europe. Its products include Visage RIS, Visage RIS/PACS, Visage 7, Visage Ease Pro and Visage Ease. Visage RIS is a radiology information systems (RIS) medical software for practicing of management, training, installation and professional services. Visage RIS capabilities include patient registration, billing, scheduling, typing, HL7 integration, financial reporting, digital dictation and voice recognition integration. Visage 7.0 is a healthcare imaging software that provides clinicians with visualization capability for rapidly viewing two-Dimensional (2-D), 3-D and 4-D medical images and picture archive and communication system (PACS)/digital imaging software that is sold directly and to original equipment manufacturers, training, installation and others.

name: SOUTHERN CROSS ELECTRICAL ENGINEERING LT
businessSummary: Southern Cross Electrical Engineering Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is a provider and manufacturer of specialized electrical, instrumentation, communications, security, fire, and maintenance services and products and are diversified across three broad sectors of infrastructure, commercial and resources. Its segments include SCEE Electrical, Heyday, Trivantage and Force Fire. Its SCEE Electrical segment is engaged in provision of electrical, instrumentation, communications and maintenance services. Its Heyday segment is engaged in provision of electrical, instrumentation and communications services. Its Trivantage segment is engaged in provision of electrical, instrumentation, communications, security and maintenance services. Its Force Fire segment is engaged in designing, installation, inspection, testing and maintenance of fire protection systems. It serves commercial, resources, and infrastructure sectors.

name: HUB24 LTD
businessSummary: HUB24 Limited is an Australia-based provider of integrated platform, technology, and data solutions. The Company operates HUB24 Platform, HUBconnect, the Xplore Wealth platform, Class and myprosperity. The HUB24 Platform offers advisers and their clients a comprehensive range of investment options, including managed portfolio solutions, and enhanced transaction and reporting functionality. HUBconnect focuses on leveraging data and technology to provide solutions to common challenges for stockbrokers, licensees and advisers. Class is a cloud-based wealth accounting software that delivers self-managed superannuation fund (SMSF) administration, trust accounting, portfolio management, legal documentation and corporate compliance solutions to financial professionals. myprosperity is a provider of client portals for accountants and financial advisers, enabling streamlined service delivery, increased productivity and enhanced customer experience for finance professionals and their clients.

name: LOVISA HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Lovisa Holdings Limited is an Australia-based specialist fast fashion jewelry retailer. The Company and its subsidiaries are primarily involved in the retail sale of fashion jewelry and accessories. The Company is also focused on designing, developing, sourcing, and merchandising all its branded products. The Company develops, designs, sources and merchandises 100% of its Lovisa branded products. It offers a range of products, including earrings, necklaces, rings, body jewelry, and others. It offers a range of accessories, including hair clips, watches, jewelry boxes, belts, headbands, and others. The Company has over 1031 stores across over 50 markets globally, including Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Malaysia, Hong Kong, Namibia, South Africa, France, Austria, Belgium, Germany, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Poland, Italy, Hungary, Romania, Switzerland, Canada, Mexico, the United States, the United Kingdom, and franchised stores in the Middle East and South America.

name: ENERGY ONE LTD
businessSummary: Energy One Limited is an Australia-based supplier of software products, outsourced operations and advisory services to wholesale energy, environmental and carbon trading markets. The Company’s principal activity is the development and supply of software and services as well as energy trading and associated advisory services to energy companies and utilities. The Company’s segments include Energy Software and Energy Trading Industry. Its geographical segments include Australasia, CQ Energy and the United Kingdom /Europe. The Company’s software and services include advisory services, demand-linked risk management solutions, egssPort, EnergyOffer, enFlow, enPrice, enTrader, enVoy, EOT, eZ-Ops, generation services, NemSight, managed services, pypIT, SimEnergy, plant outage insurance, weather-linked risk management solutions, and global 24/7 outsourced operations services. It serves a range of customers across the globe, including energy retailers, generators, users, customers.

name: REA GROUP LTD
businessSummary: REA Group Ltd is a multinational digital advertising business specializing in property. The Company provides property and property-related services on Websites and mobile apps. It also provides digital tools, information, and data for people interested in property. Its segments include Australia, India, and International. Its Australia segment includes property and online advertising across Australia and the equity investments in Empirical CRE Pte. Ltd and financial services across Australia and equity investment of Simpology Pty Limited and Athena Financial Pty Ltd. Its India segment includes REA India Pte. Ltd. and its subsidiaries and the equity investment in Easiloan Techno Solutions Private Limited. Its International segment includes equity investments in Move, Inc. It operates residential and commercial property websites realestate.com.au and realcommercial.com.au, and a Website dedicated to share property, Flatmates.com.au, and a property research Website, property.com.au.

name: CAR GROUP LTD
businessSummary: CAR Group Limited is an Australia-based global digital marketplace business in the world. The Company delivers technology and advertising solutions designed to make buying and selling an experience, with digital marketplace businesses in Australia (carsales), South Korea (Encar), North America (Trader Interactive), Brazil (webmotors) and Chile (chileautos). The Company’s segments include Australia-Online Advertising Services; Australia-Data, Research and Services; Investments, North America, Latin America, and Asia. The Australia-Online Advertising segment includes online automotive classifieds, display advertising services and finance commission. The Australia-Data, Research and Services segment includes automotive data services, including software, analysis, research and reporting, valuation services, Website development, hosting and photography services. The Investments segment consists of online retail and wholesale tire sales and inspection services.

name: DATA#3 LTD
businessSummary: Data#3 Limited is an information technology (IT) services and solutions provider. It is focused on helping customers solve complex business challenges using technology solutions. The Company’s three reportable segments include: Software Solutions, Infrastructure Solutions and Services. Software Solutions segment provides software licensing, consumption sales along with consulting services. Infrastructure Solutions segment provides hardware and accompanying software licensing, vendor-branded maintenance services and other services. Services segment provides consulting services, project services, maintenance services, managed services, contracting services, software licensing and vendor-branded maintenance services. Its data and artificial intelligence (AI) include business analytics, customer management, internet of things (IoT) location-based analytics, and technology intelligence. Its connectivity includes IT-OT networking, software-defined networks, wireless networks, and SD-WAN.

name: DURATEC LTD
businessSummary: Duratec Limited is an Australia-based contractor providing assessment, protection, remediation, and refurbishment services to a range of assets and infrastructure. The Company’s multidisciplined capabilities combine engineering experience with project delivery expertise and use a range of in-house assessment technologies, including 3D capture and modelling technology with predictive analysis tools. Its segments include Defence, Mining & Industrial, Building & Facade and Energy. The Defense segment is engaged in the delivery of capital facilities, infrastructure and estate works program projects. The Mining & Industrial segment is engaged in the provision of tailored preventative maintenance programs. The Buildings & Facades segment is engaged in the completion of facade condition assessments and facade restorations. The Energy segment offers non-defense capital facilities, remediation and refurbishment of critical assets. Its Other segments relate to ports, transport, marine and water.

name: VYSARN LTD
businessSummary: Vysarn Limited is a vertically integrated water service provider. The Company is engaged in hydrogeological drilling, test pumping, reinjection water services and water consultancy businesses predominately in Western Australia. Its segments include Industrial, Technologies, and Advisory. Its Industrial segment consisting of Pentium Hydro (PH) and Pentium Test Pumping (PTP). The Advisory segment consisting of Pentium Water (PW). The Technology segment consisting of Project Engineering (ProEng). The Company, through Waste Water Services Pty Ltd., is engaged in the design, manufacture, installation, and maintenance of waste water treatment plants, potable water treatment plants, and pumping stations. The Company’s subsidiaries include Pentium Hydro Pty Ltd, Pentium Test Pumping Pty Ltd, Pentium Water Pty Ltd, Project Engineering (WA) Pty Ltd, Vysarn Asset Management Pty Ltd, and CMP Consulting Group Pty Ltd.

name: ORICA LTD
businessSummary: Orica Limited is an Australia-based mining and infrastructure solutions provider. The Company is engaged in the production and supply of explosives, blasting systems, mining chemicals and geotechnical monitoring to its digital solutions. Its segments include Blasting Solutions, Specialty Mining Chemicals and Digital Solutions. Its products and services include Bulk Systems, Packaged explosives, Initiating Systems, Boosters, Digital Solutions, Blasting Services, Automation, Training, Fertilizer, Resources, Slope Stability, among others. The Company serves various markets, such as surface coal, surface metal, iron ore, quarrying, underground mining, underground construction, construction, civil infrastructure, oil and gas, and agriculture. Its Blasting Solutions includes core production and supply of explosives and blasting systems to the mining, quarry and construction industries across Australia Pacific and Asia, North America, Latin America, and Europe, Middle East and Africa.

name: ALS LTD
businessSummary: ALS Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in the provision of professional technical services, primarily in the areas of testing, measurement and inspection. The Company provides comprehensive testing solutions to clients in a range of industries around the world. The Company operates through two segments: Commodities and Life Sciences. Its Commodities segment provides assaying and analytical testing services and metallurgical services for mining and mineral exploration companies and provides specialist services to the coal industry, such as coal sampling, analysis and certification, formation evaluation services, tribology testing services and related analytical testing. The Life Sciences segment provides analytical testing data to assist consulting and engineering firms, industry, and governments around the world in making informed decisions about environmental, food and pharmaceutical, electronics, consumer products, and animal health.

name: MONADELPHOUS GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Monadelphous Group Limited is a diversified services company operating in the resources, energy and infrastructure industry sector. The Company provides a range of services, including fabrication, modularization, offsite pre-assembly, procurement and installation of structural steel, tankage, mechanical and process equipment, piping, demolition and remediation works; multidisciplined construction services; plant commissioning; electrical and instrumentation services and engineering, procurement and construction services. It also offers process and non-process maintenance services; front-end scoping, shutdown planning, management and execution; water and wastewater asset construction and maintenance; construction of transmission pipelines and facilities; heavy lift and specialist transport; access solutions; dewatering services; corrosion management services; specialist coatings; rail maintenance services, and structural concrete and associated works.

name: BRAMBLES LTD
businessSummary: Brambles Limited is an Australia-based supply-chain logistics company. The Company is engaged in the provision of supply-chain logistics solutions, focused on the provision of reusable pallets and containers. Its segments include CHEP North America and Latin America (CHEP Americas); CHEP Europe, Middle East, Turkiye, and Africa, including the North American automotive business (CHEP EMEA); CHEP Australia, New Zealand and Asia, excluding India (CHEP Asia-Pacific); and Corporate center (Corporate). CHEP Americas segment is engaged in the pallet and container pooling business in the Americas. CHEP EMEA segment is engaged in the pallet and container pooling business in EMEA (including the global CHEP Automotive container business) and the CHEP-branded reusable plastic crates (RPC) business in South Africa. CHEP Asia-Pacific segment is engaged in the pallet and container pooling business in Asia-Pacific and the CHEP-branded RPC business in Australia and New Zealand.

name: WESFARMERS LTD
businessSummary: Wesfarmers Ltd is engaged in various business operations, such as home improvement, outdoor living products and supply of building materials. Its Kmart segment is a retailer of apparel and general merchandise, including toys, leisure, entertainment, home and consumables. Its Energy and Fertilizers (WesCEF) segment is a manufacturer and marketer of chemicals for industry, mining and mineral processing. Its Officeworks segment is a retailer and supplier of office products and solutions for households and small-to-medium-sized businesses. Its Industrial and Safety segment is a supplier and distributor of maintenance, repair and operating products. Its Wesfarmers Health (Health) segment is a wholesaler and retailer of pharmaceutical goods, health, wellness and beauty products. Its Catch segment is an online retailer offering branded products on a first-party basis and a third-party online marketplace. Its Other segments include OneDigital, Forest products, and Property.

name: ADR ON TELSTRA GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Telstra Group Limited is an Australia-based telecommunications company, offering a full range of communications services. The Company's Telstra Consumer segment provides telecommunication and technology products and services to consumer customers in Australia using mobile and fixed network technologies. Its Telstra Business segment provides telecommunication and technology products and services to small and medium businesses. Its Telstra Enterprise Australia segment provides telecommunication services, advanced technology solutions and others. Its Telstra International segment provides telecommunication, media and technology products and services to consumer, business and government customers in the South Pacific through its Digicel Pacific business. Its Networks, IT and Product segment's operations include Global Networks and Technology, and Product and Technology. Its Telstra InfraCo segment provides telecommunication products and services delivered over its networks.

name: PRAEMIUM LTD
businessSummary: Praemium Limited is an Australia-based company that helps financial advisers with investment, administration, and retirement solutions. The Company is focused on artificial intelligence (AI)-driven financial services. The Company's solutions provide access to global markets, alternative assets, and over 350 integrated SMAs. With technology and reporting, the Company enables advisers to manage, report, and administer complex wealth portfolios, with a digitized view of total wealth. From outsourced administration of non-custody assets to superannuation solutions, it delivers a complete wealth management platform. The Company's product categories include Administration, Investment and Retirement. Its Administration products include Scope and Scope+. The Company's Investment products include Spectrum and SMA. Its Retirement product is Super. Its platform includes reporting, digital experience, data integration, customizations, tax optimization, and alternative assets.

name: VAULT MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Vault Minerals Limited is an intermediate gold producer. The Company has three gold operations in Western Australia, plus an advanced gold production restart project in Ontario, Canada. The Leonora Operations are located approximately 900 kilometers (km) north-east of Perth and 25 km north of Leonora, within the Goldfields Region of Western Australia. The Leonora Operations comprise the King of the Hills (KOTH) open pit and underground mines, the Darlot satellite underground mine, and the KOTH processing facility. The Mount Monger Gold Operations are located approximately 580 km north-east of Perth and 50 km south-east of Kalgoorlie, within the Goldfields Region of Western Australia. The Deflector Gold-Copper Operations are located approximately 450 km north of Perth and 160 km east of Geraldton, within the Midwest Region of Western Australia. The Sugar Zone Gold Project is located in Ontario, Canada, over 30km north of White River and midway between Thunder Bay and Sault St. Marie.

name: OFX GROUP LTD
businessSummary: OFX Group Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the provision of international payments and foreign exchange services. It helps businesses and individuals to securely send and receive money, without bank fees. Its segments include APAC, North America and EMEA. Each region serves consumers, corporates, online sellers, and enterprise clients. It provides simple payments to over 180+ countries online, in app, or over the phone with one of its OFXperts. Its Global Currency Account can make running clients' international or eCommerce business easier. Its eCommerce and business clients, the OFX Global Currency Account, allows clients to have up to seven foreign currency accounts, so they can pay invoices, receive payments, and easily reconcile transfers in euros, dollars or yen. An OFXpert will support and tailor solutions to clients' business needs. It operates through various offices in London, Dublin, Sydney, Auckland, Hong Kong, Singapore, Toronto, and San Francisco.

name: NANOSONICS LTD
businessSummary: Nanosonics Limited is an Australia-based infection prevention company. The Company's principal activities include the manufacturing and distribution of the trophon ultrasound probe disinfector and its associated consumables and accessories. It is focused on the research, development, and commercialization of infection control and decontamination products and related technologies. Trophon technology includes high-frequency ultrasonic vibrations that generate a sonically activated hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) mist that kills bacteria, fungi, and viruses. Its products include trophon2, Nanosonics Auditpro, and trophon EPR. Its trophon2 includes AcuTrace radio frequency identification (RFID) technology, which enables digital record keeping and captures disinfection data. Nanosonics AuditPro is an automated digital system that combines clinician infection prevention decision making, with the Trophon 2 device infection control workflow data, and patient procedure information.

name: ATTURRA LTD
businessSummary: Atturra Limited is an Australia-based advisory and technology solutions provider. The Company is engaged in the technology business, providing a range of enterprise advisory, consulting, information technology (IT) services and solutions with a focus on local government, utilities, education, defense, federal government, financial services, and manufacturing industries. Its advisory and consulting capabilities across three areas include strategy and preparation, design and implementation, and realization and improvement. Its business applications capabilities include enterprise resource planning, process optimization for local government, professional services, safety solutions, and others. Its data and integration capabilities include intelligent integration and automation, enterprise data management, advanced analytics, middleware modernization, and others. Its managed services include cloud, modern workplace, among others.

name: ARB CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: ARB Corporation Limited is an Australia-based company, which designs, manufactures, distributes and sells motor vehicle accessories and light metal engineering works. Its product range includes a host of different accessories, from vehicle specific applications to a range of accessories, which are suitable for vehicles. Its products include earth camper; bull bars; side rails and side steps; rear protection, towing and wheel carriers; canopies; UTE lids and tub accessories; roof racks, cross bars and carriers; Old Man Emu 4X4 Suspension; Linx; driving lights; air compressors and tire accessories; air lockers; winches; recovery equipment; recovery points; under vehicle protection; fuel tanks and fuel storage; drawers and cargo solutions; slide kitchen; portable fridge freezers; tents, swags and awnings; camping and touring accessories; UHF radios, GPS and reverse cameras; safari snorkels; dual battery and solar systems; general accessories; interior protection, and merchandise.

name: CSL LTD
businessSummary: CSL Limited is an Australia-based biotechnology company. The Company’s areas of focus include rare and serious diseases, influenza vaccines and iron deficiency and nephrology. The Company’s segments include CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor. The CSL Behring segment manufactures, markets and distributes plasma products, gene therapies and recombinants. The CSL Seqirus segment manufactures, markets and distributes predominantly influenza related products and provides pandemic services to governments. The CSL Vifor segment manufactures, markets and distributes products in the therapeutic areas of iron deficiency and nephrology. Its CSL Plasma operates plasma collection networks, with approximately 325 plasma collection centers in the United States, Europe and China. The Company operates in Australia, the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, Switzerland and China (including Hong Kong). Its products include Respreeza, Zemaira, HAEGARDA, KCENTRA, Hepatitis B, Evogam, and others.

name: ASX LTD
businessSummary: ASX Limited (ASX) is a vertically integrated multi-asset exchange company. The Company is engaged in offering listings, trading, clearing, settlement, technical and information services, technology, data and other post-trade services. It acts as a market operator, clearing house and payments system facilitator. The ASX operates markets for a range of asset classes including equities, fixed income, commodities, and energy. Its activities span primary and secondary market services, including the raising, allocation and hedging of capital flows; trading and price discovery; central counterparty risk transfer, and securities settlement for both the equities and fixed income markets. ASX operates through four divisions: listings, markets, technology and data, and securities and payments. It also provides data and technology services to intermediaries, banks, information vendors and software developers to help them make decisions, offer services to their clients and connect with one another.

name: DUSK GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Dusk Group Limited is an Australia-based specialty retailer of home fragrance products. The principal activities of the Company comprise retailing of scented and unscented candles, home decor, home fragrance and gift solutions. Its product offering consists of candles & melts, diffusers and oils, bath & body, and home & living. Its candle products include novelty candles, pillar candles, scented candles, wax melts, tealight candles, and LED candles. The Company’s essential oils include essential oil blends, pure essential oils, and essential oil body care. Its diffuser products include glass diffusers, resin diffusers, ceramic diffusers, and mini diffusers. Its reed diffusers come in fruity, gourmand, fresh, woody, floral, or unscented options. Its bath & body collection includes bath bombs, perfumes, body care, and soaps & scrubs. Its home & living offers home cleaning products, room spray, lighting, plates, and glass and mug.

name: IGNITE LTD
businessSummary: Ignite Limited is an Australia-based company that is engaged in the provision of contingent labor and permanent recruitment services (Specialist Recruitment), and on demand information technology services (On Demand IT Services). Its segments include Specialist Recruitment and On Demand IT Services. The Specialist Recruitment segment is engaged in providing temporary, contract, and permanent recruitment services at all levels of seniority for businesses in both the public and private sectors. Its expertise spans various industries, including IT and digital, government, business support, engineering, information management, and professional services recruitment. Its On Demand IT Services segment comprises the delivery of specified information technology skills.

name: SHINE JUSTICE LTD
businessSummary: Shine Justice Ltd is the holding company of a stable of firms which provide legal services. These firms include Shine Lawyers, Sciaccas Lawyers, Stephen Browne Personal Injury Lawyers, Bradley Bayly Lawyers and Carr & Co Divorce and Family Lawyers. It specializes in plaintiff litigation services focused on damage-based claims, on personal injury matters, and class actions. It also offers national practice areas, which include superannuation and disability, dust disease litigation and medical negligence. The PI segment specializes in damage-based plaintiff litigation legal services, and consists of motor vehicle accidents, abuse law, workers' compensation, public liability, head trauma, disability insurance and superannuation claims, asbestos and dust disease, medical law and catastrophic injuries. The Class Actions segment includes work types that are not considered core personal injury, such as class actions, international mass torts, commercial disputes (in wind-down) and family law.

name: AMBERTECH LTD
businessSummary: Ambertech Limited is an Australia-based distributor of audio-visual solutions for all types of installation projects in Australia and New Zealand, including professional broadcast, media and communications; live sound and production; music instruments and sound recording; residential and commercial installation, and home entertainment markets. The Company operates through three segments: Retail, Integrated Solutions and Professional. The Retail segment is engaged in the distribution of home entertainment solutions to dealers. The Integrated Solutions segment is focused on distribution and supply of custom installation components for home theatre and commercial installations to dealers and consumers, and the distribution of projection and display products with business and domestic applications. The Professional segment is engaged in the distribution of high technology equipment to the professional broadcast, film, recording and sound reinforcement industries.

name: CASH CONVERTERS INTERNATIONAL LTD
businessSummary: Cash Converters International Limited is an Australia-based consumer lender and second-hand goods retailer operating globally. The principal activity of Company and its subsidiaries is that of a franchisor and financial services; a provider of secured and unsecured loans and the operator of corporate stores in Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom, all of which trade under the Cash Converters name. Its segments include Personal Finance, Vehicle Financing, Store Operations, New Zealand, and United Kingdom. Personal Finance segment comprises the Cash Converters Personal Finance personal loans business. Vehicle Finance segment comprises Green Light Auto Group Pty Ltd. Store Operations segment involves the retail sale of new and second-hand goods and personal lending including cash advance and pawnbroking operations at corporate-owned stores in Australia. It also has retail presence in repurposed luxury goods.

name: ASHLEY SERVICES GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Ashley Services Group Limited is an Australia-based labor hire company. The Company is engaged in the provision of labor hire (including recruitment) and training services. It operates through two segments: Labour Hire and Training. Labour Hire segment provides supply chain and warehousing labor hire, transport and logistics labor hire, e-commerce labor hire, defense labor hire, merchandising, layout services, rail labor hire, construction labor hire, manufacturing labor hire and horticulture labor hire. Training segment provides training services in civil construction; supply chain operations; telecommunications technology; data and voice technology; business; disability; individual support; and rail industry qualifications, including protection officers, safe working, track workers and track vehicle operators. The Company offers white-collar recruitment services, such as permanent, temporary and contract placements through multi-specialist provider, Concept Recruitment Specialists.

name: STEP ONE CLOTHING LTD
businessSummary: Step One Clothing Limited is an Australia-based direct-to-consumer online retailer company that offers a range of organically grown and certified, sustainable, and manufactured innerwear. The Company offers a range of underwear that suits a range of body types. It owns the designs for its innerwear and contracts the manufacturing of its products in Asia for export to warehouses in Australia, the United Kingdom and the United States. The Company's product range also includes women's underwear. The Company's sales channels include Amazon and other retailers. The Company also conceives and produces its own advertising content. Its subsidiaries include Step One Clothing Australia Pty Ltd, Step One Production Pty Ltd, Step One Clothing UK Limited, and Step One Clothing USA Inc.

name: KAROON ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Karoon Energy Ltd. is an Australia-based international oil and gas exploration and production company with assets in Brazil, the United States and Australia. The Company has two key producing assets: the Bauna Project in the Santos Basin, Brazil and the Who Dat assets in the Gulf of Mexico, United States. Its 100% owned and operated Bauna Project (which comprises the Bauna, Piracaba and Patola oil fields) is located in the BM-S-40 production license in the southern Santos Basin, offshore Brazil. It also holds a 100% interest in the Neon oil field, located approximately 75 kilometers (km) northeast of Bauna. It also holds a 100% interest in the Goia field, located approximately 18 km southwest of Neon. It also has 100% interests in six blocks (S-M-974, S-M-1038, S-M-1484, S-M-1605, S-M-1358, S-M-1603) in the Santos Basin, offshore Brazil. The Who Dat producing assets comprise the Who Dat, Dome Patrol and Abilene oil and gas fields and associated infrastructure.

name: ALLIANCE AVIATION SERVICES LTD
businessSummary: Alliance Aviation Services Limited is an Australia-based company, which provides contract, charter and allied aviation and maintenance services. It provides specialized aviation services to airlines and clients, including aircraft dry leasing, airport management, aircraft trading, part sales, engine leasing and engineering services. It offers an ad-hoc air charter service, regular public transport services and several allied aviation services, including engine and part sales, aircraft, engine and parts leasing, aerodrome management services and other engineering services. It has a growing aircraft, engine and spare parts trading business allied to the two aircraft types it operates. Its fleet is composed of three different Fokker aircraft (Fokker 70 LR jet and Fokker 100 jet) and Embraer 190. Fokker 100 is a modern and reliable jet aircraft with an aerodynamic design and operational performance. It serves mining, energy, government sectors and wet lease services for other airlines.

name: FLEETWOOD LTD
businessSummary: Fleetwood Limited is an Australia-based provider of modular and accommodation solutions as well as recreational vehicle (RV) parts and accessories. The Company's segments include RV Solutions, Building Solutions and Community Solutions. The RV Solutions segment is engaged in manufacturing, installation and distribution of recreational vehicle parts and accessories. The RV Solutions segment is comprised of two RV brands operating in Australia and New Zealand: Camec and Northern RV. The Building Solutions segment is engaged in designing, manufacturing and sale of accommodation. The Building Solutions segment serves various sectors, including aged care, education, amenities, commercial, health, custodial and defense. The Community Solutions segment includes the operation of communities. The Community Solutions segment include Searipple Village, Osprey Village and Glyde Digital. Glyde Digital is an Internet of Things technology developed by the Company that makes accommodation smarter.

name: MICHAEL HILL INTERNATIONAL LTD
businessSummary: Michael Hill International Limited is an Australia-based jewelry retailer, with a portfolio of brands, operating a network of over 287 stores across Australia, New Zealand, and Canada, with international digital platforms. The Company operates predominately in the retail sale of jewelry and related services sector in Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. The Company offers various products and services in various categories, including engagement and weddings, jewelry, gifts, and collections. Its engagement and wedding categories include engagement rings, promise rings, bridal sets, women's wedding rings and men's wedding rings. Its jewelry includes rings, earrings, bracelets and bangles, anklets, necklaces and pendants, chains, men's jewelry, watches, sterling silver, yellow gold, white gold, rose gold, as well as diamond jewelry and gemstone jewelry. The Company also offers a range of watches for men and women in gold tone, rose tone, and silver tone.

name: RECKON LTD
businessSummary: Reckon Limited is an Australia-based software company. The Company provides software for startups, sole traders, small and medium enterprises (SMEs), accountants, bookkeepers, and lawyers. The Company operates two divisions: Business Group and Legal Group. The Business Group provides accounting and payroll software for small to medium sized businesses and personal wealth management software branded as Reckon One, Reckon Mobile and Reckon Accounts Hosted, Reckon Accounts Business, Reckon Accounts Personal and Cashflow Manager. The Business Group operates in Australia and New Zealand. The Legal Group operates under the nQ Zebraworks brand. nQ Zebraworks is a document and billing workflow company that leverages the power of its Zebraworks cloud-based integration platform to deliver digitalization, billing and collections automation, cost recovery and analytics solutions for law firms and government and corporate legal departments. nQ Zebraworks is based in the United States.

name: CREDIT CORP GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Credit Corp Group Limited is an Australia-based provider of responsible financial services to the credit-impaired consumer segment. The Company's segments include debt ledger purchasing (Australia and New Zealand), debt ledger purchasing (United States) and consumer lending (Australia, New Zealand and the United States). The debt ledger purchasing (Australia and New Zealand) segment purchases consumer debts at a discount to their face value from credit providers in Australia and New Zealand. This segment includes the contingent collection services business in Australia and New Zealand. The debt ledger purchasing (United States) segment purchases consumer debts at a discount to their face value from credit providers in the United States. The consumer lending (Australia, New Zealand and the United States) segment offers various consumer loan products focused on credit-impaired consumers. Its loan products are delivered under a portfolio of brands, including CarStart and Wallet Wizard.

name: ALFABS AUSTRALIA LTD
businessSummary: Alfabs Australia Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company provides fabrication, construction and maintenance services, mining equipment and services, protective coatings, transport and logistics, and consumables. Its segments include Mining, Engineering, and Other. The Mining segment manufactures, repairs, overhaul servicing and hire of underground mining and ancillary equipment together with sales of mining related consumables and spare parts. The Engineering segment is engaged in heavy steel fabrication, site installation works and site-based maintenance. Its Other activities include ancillary businesses including protective coatings and transport. Its products include Structure Pod, Mesh Pod, Auger, Belt Splicing Pod, Bucket 2.1 Eject, Bucket 3.1 Eject, Bucket MH40 - The Hungry Hippo, CABA Quick Fill Pod, CABA Storage Pod, Cable Boat, Clan Clamp, Chain Locker, Concrete Kibble, and others.

name: AUSTRALIAN CLINICAL LABS LTD
businessSummary: Australian Clinical Labs Limited is a private provider of pathology services. Its laboratories perform a range of pathology tests each year for a range of clients, including doctors, specialists, patients, hospitals, and corporate clients. It performs a range of services for doctors, patients and corporate clients, including chemical pathology, hematology, histopathology & cytopathology, serology & microbiology, allergy & immunology, molecular cancer testing, genetic carrier screening & other antenatal testing, cardiac testing services, veterinary pathology, functional pathology, and pathology services for clinical trials, among others. Its specialist services include molecular cancer services, obstetrics and gynecology, pharmacogenetic testing, gastroenterology, and hospital services. It has operations in Victoria, New South Wales, Western Australia, South Australia, Queensland, and the Northern Territory. Its SunDoctors brand provides skin cancer care services.

name: EMECO HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Emeco Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company providing open cut and underground mining equipment, maintenance and project support solutions and services. The Company is engaged in the provision of surface and underground mining equipment, rental and complementary equipment and workshop and field services, including maintenance, asset and component rebuild, fleet optimization technology, and technical and engineering services. It operates through two segments: Rental and Workshops. The Rental segment provides a range of surface and underground earthmoving equipment solutions to customers in Australia and includes additional technology platforms to enable customers to improve earthmoving efficiencies of their rental machines. The Workshops segment provides maintenance, equipment and component rebuild services to customers in Australia. Its services include rentals, maintenance, fabrication, surface treatment and labor hire, among others.

name: HELLOWORLD TRAVEL LTD
businessSummary: Helloworld Travel Limited is a travel-distribution company. It is engaged in selling of international and domestic travel products and services, the operation of retail distribution networks of travel agents and specialized freight operations. Its segments include Travel Operations and Transport, Logistics, and Warehousing. The Company offers retail leisure travel and business travel networks, travel broker networks, destination management services (inbound), air ticket consolidation, tourism transport operations, wholesale travel services, online operations and event-based freight operations, all supported by proprietary and non-proprietary distribution systems. Its brands include Helloworld Travel, Helloworld Business Travel, Magellan Travel, Mobile Travel Agent, My Travel Group, and Travel Brokers. Its wholesale travel businesses in Australia include Viva Holidays, Ultimate Journeys, ReadyRooms, and in New Zealand includes Go Holidays and Williment Travel.

name: SAFEROADS HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Saferoads Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company specializing in the provision of innovative road safety solutions throughout Australia, New Zealand and North America. The Company provides state government departments, local councils, road construction companies and equipment to hire companies with a broad range of products and services designed to direct, protect, inform and illuminate for the public’s safety. Its products and services offering include solar lighting, electronic signs, temporary barriers, security bollards, traffic calming, guideposts, and vehicle mitigation. Its solar lighting products include permanent, which includes Roadway Solar V-LED Light and Blade Solar Light - Galvanised Pole, and portable, including Blade Solar Light-Telescopic Pole and Blade Solar Light - Hinged Pole. Its electronic signs include Zone VMS Essential and Zone VMS Classic. Its temporary barriers include BIG Blockout Barrier, HV2 Barrier, Ironman Hybrid Barrier, and others.

name: MASTERMYNE GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Mastermyne Group Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company provides mine operations, contracting, training and related services in mining and supporting industries across Australia. Its mining provides a full range of services and equipment to the coal mining industry, including new mine development, mine operation, roadway development, conveyors, outbye services, ventilation, secondary support, longwall relocations, polymeric emergency strata consolidation, production and ancillary equipment, and mining consumables. In addition, its Registered Training Organization delivers training and compliance solutions that improve efficiency and reduce costs to mine operators. Its portfolio of work encompasses outcomes for clients including Anglo American, Centennial Coal, Fitzroy Mining Operations, Glencore, GM3, Peabody Energy, Whitehaven Coal and Yancoal.

name: BEACH ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Beach Energy Limited is an Australia-based oil and gas exploration and production company. The Company has operations in South Australia, Victoria, Western Australia and New Zealand. In South Australia, it operates Cooper/Eromanga Basin, Moomba Carbon Capture & Storage (CCS), and Otway Basin South Australia. It operates Otway Basin Victoria Bass Basin, and Enterprise Project in Victoria. It operates Perth Basin in Western Australia. It operates Taranaki Basin in New Zealand. The Otway Basin Victoria is an onshore and offshore basin which extends approximately 500 kilometers from Cape Jaffa in South Australia to north-west Tasmania. The Company has around 33% ownership interest in the Moomba CCS Project, operated by its joint venture partner Santos. Its Perth Basin operations consist of the Waitsia project (operated by Mitsui E&P Australia) and Beharra Springs (operated by Beach Energy) projects. The Taranaki Basin is located along the west coast of the North Island in New Zealand.

name: INTEGRATED RESEARCH LTD
businessSummary: Integrated Research Limited is an Australia-based provider of user experience and performance management solutions for payment transactions and collaborative systems. The Company offers three key solution suites: Collaborate, Transact and Infrastructure - powered by the Prognosis platform. Its Collaborate solution offers enterprise grade performance management, testing solutions and analytics across voice, Web, video and collaboration ecosystems. Its Transact solution includes analyzing transaction data, deploying new technology and ensuring a seamless payments experience to keep its client card, high value and real-time payments business flowing. The Company's infrastructure solution includes access to real-time insight into HPE Non-Stop environments to help manage information technology (IT) performance, spot patterns in data and proactively prevent problems. Its solutions are used by various organizations, such as stock exchanges, banks and telecommunication companies.

name: GALE PACIFIC LTD
businessSummary: GALE Pacific Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is engaged in the marketing, sales, manufacture and distribution of branded screening, architectural shading, commercial agricultural / horticultural fabric products to domestic and global markets. The Company's segments include Americas (AMR), Australia/New Zealand (ANZ) and Developing Markets (DEV). Its brands include Coolaroo and GALE Commercial. Coolaroo provides shade sails over backyards and playgrounds to pet beds and awnings. Coolaroo product categories include Umbrellas, Roller Shades, Shade Sails, Shade Fabric, Pergolas and Gazebos, Grow and Utility Bags, and Pet Beds. GALE Commercial delivers architectural and industrial-grade fabrics. GALE Commercial product categories include Architectural Shade Fabric, Horticultural Knitted Fabric, Commercial Netting, Agricultural Shade and Protection, All-Weather Advertising Banners, Coated Polyfabrics, and Food-Grade Coated Non-Wovens.

name: WAM CAPITAL LTD
businessSummary: WAM Capital Limited (WAM) is an Australia-based investment company. WAM’s investment objectives are to deliver investors a stream of fully franked dividends, provide capital growth and preserve capital. It provides investors with exposure to an actively managed diversified portfolio of undervalued growth companies listed on the Australian Securities Exchange, with a focus on small-to-medium sized businesses. It also provides exposure to relative value arbitrage and market mispricing opportunities. Wilson Asset Management is the Company's investment manager.

name: MGX RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Mount Gibson Iron Limited is an Australia-based company that is engaged in producing and exporting iron ore products. The Company operates through two segments: Mid-West and Koolan Island. The Mid-West segment includes the mining, crushing, transportation and sale of iron ore from the Shine iron ore deposits and the port facilities at Geraldton Port. The Koolan Island segment includes the mining, crushing and sale of iron ore direct from the Koolan Island iron ore operation. The Shine Iron Ore Project (SIOP) is located approximately 85 kilometers (kms) north of the Company’s Extension Hill operation and approximately 375 kms northeast of Perth in the Mid-West region of Western Australia. Its Koolan Island operation is located in the Buccaneer Archipelago approximately 140 km north of Derby, in the Kimberley region of Western Australia. The Company’s subsidiaries include Mount Gibson Mining Limited, Geraldton Bulk Handling Pty Ltd, Gibson Minerals Ltd and Aztec Resources Limited.

name: KINGSTON RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Kingston Resources Limited is an Australia-based gold and copper company, operating the Mineral Hill mine in Cobar, New South Wales (NSW). The Mineral Hill Mine is an established gold-copper mine in the highly prospective Cobar Basin in NSW. Mineral Hill boasts an extensive gold, copper, zinc, lead and silver resource, alongside existing gold production and exploration upside. The site consists of a number of exploration and development opportunities, including several historic small open pit and underground operations and a number of exploration targets. Mineral exploration licenses EL1999 and EL8334 represent an exploration footprint in the Cobar Basin, which hosts a number of gold, copper-gold and polymetallic occurrences and operating mines.

name: NTAW HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: NTAW Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in distribution and marketing of motor vehicle tires, wheels, tubes and related products throughout Australia, New Zealand and South Africa. The Company is engaged in managing 11 business units, each operating separately. As part of its commercial retail businesses, its subsidiaries, Black Rubber Pty Ltd in Australia and Carters Tyre Service Limited, C.O. Tire & Retreading Co Limited and Tyre Distributors New Zealand Limited (collectively Carter’s) in New Zealand specializes in supplying truck and bus tires to commercial fleet owners and managing the performance of the tires through in-house technology, providing the required services (e.g. fitting) through company owned and affiliated tire stores. It owns Solid Plus, a business specializing in supplying industrial tires (mainly forklift tires) and fitting the tires at the premises of the customers. It operates approximately 23 distribution centers.

name: MITCHELL SERVICES LTD
businessSummary: Mitchell Services Limited is an Australia-based diverse drilling company. The principal activities of the Company and its subsidiaries are exploration and mine site drilling services to the exploration, mining, and energy industries, primarily in Australia. It offers drilling solutions at all stages of the mining lifecycle, across a diverse range of commodities and geographies. Its operations include surface and underground. It conducts multi-rig contracts utilizing both surface and underground drilling services on one project or on one site. Its surface services include diamond coring, directional, mud rotary, mine services, mineral performance drilling, reverse circulation, water bores, and geotechnical. It conducts conventional and wireline diamond coring throughout Australia. It performs underground in-seam (UIS) drilling in underground mining for the purposes of gas seam extraction, water drainage, coal seam delineation, cross-measure drilling and exploration.

name: AVA RISK GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Ava Risk Group Ltd is an Australia-based company, which provides technologies and services to protect critical and high value assets and infrastructure. The Company is engaged in the provision of security technology products for perimeter intrusion detection solutions. The Company operates through three segments: Detect, Access, and Illuminate. The Detect segment manufactures and markets smart fiber optic sensing systems for security and condition monitoring for a range of applications including perimeters, pipelines, conveyors, power cables and data networks. The Access segment specializes in the development, manufacture and supply of high security biometric readers, security access control and electronic locking products. Illuminate segment specializes in the development and manufacture of illuminators, automatic number plate recognition (ANPR) cameras and perimeter detectors. Its subsidiaries include FFT MENA Pty Ltd, Future Fibre Technologies (US) Inc., and MaxSec Group Pty Ltd.

name: WOODSIDE ENERGY GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Woodside Energy Group Ltd is a global energy company. Its segments include Australia, International and Marketing. The Australia segment is engaged in the exploration, evaluation, development, production and sale of liquefied natural gas, pipeline gas, crude oil and condensate and natural gas liquids in Australia. International segment is engaged in the exploration, evaluation, development, production and sale of pipeline gas, crude oil and condensate and natural gas liquids in international jurisdictions outside of Australia. Marketing segment is engaged in the marketing, shipping and trading of its oil and gas portfolio. Its projects include Pluto LNG, the North West Shelf Project, Macedon, Sangomar, the lower carbon ammonia project in Texas, and others. It holds an interest in Woodside Louisiana LNG, which is an under-construction LNG production and export terminal in Calcasieu Parish, Louisiana. The Sangomar, containing both oil and gas, is located 100 kilometers south of Dakar.

name: PEOPLEIN LTD
businessSummary: PeopleIN Limited is an Australian workforce solutions company. The Company's principal activities are the provision of staffing, business services and operational services. The Company's services include workforce management, recruiting, onboarding, contracting, rostering, timesheet management, payroll, and workplace health and safety management. It serves various sectors including education, trades and labor, agriculture and food, finance, tech and IT, and defence. Its specialist early education staffing and recruitment includes Expect a Star, which is an Australian owned provider of early childhood staffing and recruitment for childhood educators and childcare services. AWX is its brand in Trades and Labour, including construction, mining, manufacturing, transport and logistics, hospitality and more across Australia and New Zealand. Regional Workforce Management is the brand in the agriculture and food processing industries, offering recruitment, staffing, and managed services.

name: ADR ON WOODSIDE ENERGY GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Woodside Energy Group Ltd is a global energy company. Its segments include Australia, International and Marketing. The Australia segment is engaged in the exploration, evaluation, development, production and sale of liquefied natural gas, pipeline gas, crude oil and condensate and natural gas liquids in Australia. International segment is engaged in the exploration, evaluation, development, production and sale of pipeline gas, crude oil and condensate and natural gas liquids in international jurisdictions outside of Australia. Marketing segment is engaged in the marketing, shipping and trading of its oil and gas portfolio. Its projects include Pluto LNG, the North West Shelf Project, Macedon, Sangomar, the lower carbon ammonia project in Texas, and others. It holds an interest in Woodside Louisiana LNG, which is an under-construction LNG production and export terminal in Calcasieu Parish, Louisiana. The Sangomar, containing both oil and gas, is located 100 kilometers south of Dakar.

name: K&S CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: K&S Corporation Limited is an Australia-based provider of transport and logistics solutions within its target markets in Australia and New Zealand. The Company's principal activities include transport and logistics, warehousing and fuel distribution. The Company operates through three segments: Australian Transport, Fuels and New Zealand Transport. The Australian Transport segment includes provision of logistics services to customers within Australia. The Fuels segment is engaged in the distribution of fuel to fishing, farming and retail customers within the Southeast of South Australia. The New Zealand Transport segment is engaged in the provision of logistics services to customers within New Zealand. Its businesses include K&S freighters, K&S energy, chemtrans, K&S bulk, K&S New Zealand, DTM business logistics, K&S heavy haulage, and others.

name: METRO MINING LTD
businessSummary: Metro Mining Limited is an Australia-based mining and exploration company. The Company is an independent bauxite producer and explorer. The Company’s principal activities include the exploration, mining and sale of bauxite, and the brownfield expansion of the Bauxite Hills Mine. The Company’s flagship project is the Bauxite Hills Mine, which is a single operating mine located 95 kilometers (km) north of Weipa in Western Cape York in Far North Queensland, with a total tenement package covering approximately 1,900 square kilometers (km2). The Bauxite Hills Mine has an estimated ore reserve of 101.5 metric tons (Mt) and total resources of 131.2 Mt. The Company produces a high alumina bauxite and ships directly to customers in large ore carriers.

name: EDU HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: EDU Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company, which owns and operates tertiary education businesses, with a focus on education and human services fields of study. It serves both domestic and international students through its national campus network and online learning platforms. It operates through two segments: Australian Learning Group (ALG) and Ikon Institute of Australia (Ikon). ALG provides vocational education services to international students. Ikon provides higher education services to both domestic and international students. Ikon offers undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in fields such as counselling, community services, and early childhood education across campuses in Adelaide, Brisbane, Melbourne and Sydney, as well as online. ALG offers specialized courses designed to meet the needs of Australia’s skills-in-demand industries, including aged care, community services, and early childhood education, with campuses located in Adelaide, Brisbane, Melbourne and Sydney.

name: RAND MINING LTD
businessSummary: Rand Mining Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in exploration, development and production activities at the Company’s East Kundana Joint Venture tenements. The Company’s East Kundana Joint Venture (EKJV) is an operational underground gold mining project located in the Kundana area 25 kilometers (km) west northwest of Kalgoorlie and 47 km northeast of Coolgardie. The project comprises two producing underground mines Raleigh and Rubicon/Hornet /Pegasus (RHP). The Hornet orebody is located 600 meters (m) to the south of the Rubicon orebody. The Pegasus deposit is located approximately 480 m to the north of Rubicon and also accessed from the Rubicon decline.

name: METCASH LTD
businessSummary: Metcash Limited is an Australia-based wholesale distribution and marketing company. The Company provides merchandising, operational and marketing support across its food, liquor and hardware pillars. Its segments include Food, Liquor, and Hardware. The Food segment distributes a range of products and services to independent supermarkets, convenience retail outlets and food service customers. The Hardware segment distributes hardware products to independent retail outlets and the operation of Company-owned and joint venture retail stores. The Liquor segment distributes liquor products to independent retail outlets and hotels. It provides various brands including Cellarbrations, The Bottle-O, Porters Liquor and IGA Liquor. Its hardware brands include Mitre 10, Home Hardware, Total Tools and Hardings Hardware. The Company provides service to Independent Retailers in various corners of Australia, including Cape York and Cooktown in the Northeast, Dampier and Broome in the Northwest.

name: SYMAL GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Symal Group Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is in public and private infrastructure and offers a comprehensive range of services, including contracting, plant and equipment hire, material sales, recycling, and remediation services. Its services provide an end-to-end civil construction solution with touchpoints across the entire construction project lifecycle under four main brands - Symal, Sycle, Unyte and Wamarra (49% owned).
