Its segments are Contracting Services segment delivers construction projects in a variety of sectors, including public infrastructure, building and construction, roads and bridges, inland and marine ports, airports, energy and defense; Plant & Equipment segment provides internal and external construction crews, including supervision and project management support, as well as wet or dry plant hire, in a variety of sectors, and other segment provides recycling and remediation service includes materials transport and skip bin hire and collection.

name: STANMORE RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Stanmore Resources Limited is a resources company with operations and exploration projects in the Bowen and Surat basins. The Company controls and operates the South Walker Creek, Poitrel and Isaac Plains Complex metallurgical coal mines as well as the undeveloped Isaac Downs Extension, Eagle Downs, Lancewood and Isaac Plains underground projects, in Queensland’s prime Bowen Basin region. It holds several additional prospective coal tenements located in Queensland’s Bowen and Surat basins. South Walker Creek is an open-cut mine located approximately 35 kilometers (km) west of Nebo in Queensland's Bowen Basin. Poitrel is an open-cut mine located approximately 35 km east of Moranbah. Isaac Plains Complex is located approximately seven km east of Moranbah. Isaac Downs Extension is an undeveloped open-cut project situated immediately south of the Isaac Downs mine, across the Isaac River. Eagle Downs is a hard-coking coal development project located approximately 20 km from Moranbah.

name: LITTLE GREEN PHARMA LTD
businessSummary: Little Green Pharma Ltd is a global, vertically integrated and geographically diverse medicinal cannabis business with operations from cultivation and production through to manufacturing and distribution. Its principal activities include the cultivation of medicinal cannabis, procurement of raw materials and production of medicinal cannabis medicines; the supply of medicinal cannabis products into Australia and Europe; the supply of medicinal cannabis products for observational and clinical studies and research and development of new medicinal cannabis products, and the development of a psychedelics business including sponsoring a clinical trial into the treatment of refractory depression with psilocybin assisted therapy, construction of a psilocybin mushroom cultivation facility, and establishment of a psychedelic treatment clinic. It has a diverse and growing portfolio of cannabis-based medicines, distributed across Australia and over 12 export markets.

name: DONACO INTERNATIONAL LTD
businessSummary: Donaco International Limited is an Australia-based company, which operates leisure and hospitality businesses across the Asia Pacific region. The Company’s segments include Casino Operations-Vietnam, Casino Operations-Cambodia, and Corporate Operations. The Casino Operations-Vietnam segment is comprised of the Aristo International Hotel operating in Vietnam. These operations include hotel accommodation, and gaming and leisure facilities. The Casino Operations-Cambodia segment comprises the Star Vegas Resort and Club, operating in Cambodia. Its operations include hotel accommodation and gaming and leisure facilities. The Corporate Operations segment consists of development and implementation of corporate strategy, commercial negotiations, corporate finance, treasury, management accounting, corporate governance, and investor relations functions. Its Star Vegas Resort and Club is a casino resort in Poipet. The Aristo International Hotel is located on the border between China and Vietnam.

name: TRIBUNE RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Tribune Resources Limited is an Australia-based company that is engaged in exploration, development and production activities at the Company’s East Kundana Joint Venture tenements (EKJV). EKJV is an operational underground gold mining project located in the Kundana area approximately 25 kilometers (km) west-northwest of Kalgoorlie and approximately 47 km northeast of Coolgardie, in the Eastern Goldfields of Western Australia. The project comprises two producing underground mines, Raleigh and Rubicon/Hornet /Pegasus (RHP). Its exploration projects include Diwalwal Gold Project, Philippines and Japa Gold Project, Ghana. The Diwalwal Gold Project is located approximately 120 km northeast of Davao City on Mindanao Island in the Philippines. The Japa Gold Project is located in the Western Region of Ghana, approximately 110 km southwest of Kumasi and 50 km north of Tarkwa, centered in the village of Gyapa in the Wassa Amenfi East District.

name: GWA GROUP LTD
businessSummary: GWA Group Limited is an Australia-based supplier of building fixtures and fittings to households and commercial premises. The principal activities of the Company include research, design, import and marketing of building fixtures and fittings to residential and commercial premises, and the distribution and installation of various products through a range of distribution and customer channels in Australia, New Zealand and selected international markets. Its water solutions segment includes sale of vitreous China toilet suites, basins, plastic cisterns, taps and showers, baths, kitchen sinks, laundry tubs, domestic water control valves, smart products and bathroom accessories. The Company's brands include Caroma, Methven, Dorf and Clark. Its subsidiaries include Caroma Holdings Limited, Caroma Industries Limited, Caroma International Pty Ltd, Caroma Singapore Pte Ltd, Deva Tap Company Ltd, GWA Finance Pty Limited, GWA Group Holdings Limited, and GWA Group Holdings (NZ) Limited.

name: NUFARM LTD
businessSummary: Nufarm Limited is an Australia-based crop protection and seed technology company, which is engaged in the manufacture and sale of crop protection products and its proprietary seed technologies business. It operates two business lines: Crop Protection and Seed Technologies. The Crop Protection business deals in the manufacturing and selling of crop protection products used by farmers to protect crops from damage caused by weeds, pests and disease. It is managed by geographic segments: APAC (Australia, New Zealand and certain parts of Asia), Europe (United Kingdom, European Union, and certain other countries in Europe, Middle East and Africa) and North America (United States, Canada and Mexico). Seed Technologies business comprises the base seeds, bioenergy, omega-3 and seed treatment. platforms. Its omega-3 canola - the plant-based source of omega-3 for human nutrition and animal feed. Its carinata and energy cane are supplying sustainable biomass feed stocks for the biofuels industry.

name: AUSTIN ENGINEERING LTD
businessSummary: Austin Engineering Limited is an Australia-based global engineering company. The Company is engaged in designing and manufacturing loading and hauling solutions, including off-highway dump truck bodies, buckets, water tanks and related attachments, supporting both open-cut and underground operations. Complementing its proprietary product range are repair and maintenance services performed in its workshops and on clients' mine sites, and spare parts. Through its own design and engineering IP and range of tailored products, it delivers solutions for all commodity applications and drives efficiencies in productivity and safety in both open cut and underground mining operations. It has partnered with mining companies, contractors and original equipment manufacturers to create engineering solutions. It has operations around the world in Australia, the United States, Chile and Indonesia, serving many of the major mining sites in the world both directly and through local partners.

name: QANTAS AIRWAYS LTD
businessSummary: Qantas Airways Limited is a domestic and international airline. Qantas Domestic segment consists of Qantas Domestic and QantasLink. Qantas Domestic is a full-service airline which serves all Australian capital cities, large metropolitan areas as well as many regional hubs under the Qantas brand. QantasLink services metropolitan and regional transport destinations. Qantas International segment consists of Qantas International and Qantas Freight. Qantas International is a full-service international airline providing transportation between Australia and New Zealand, Asia, North and South America, Africa and Europe under the Qantas brand. Qantas Freight provides air freight services. Jetstar Group segment consists of Jetstar Domestic, Jetstar International (including New Zealand-based domestic operations), Jetstar Asia and an investment in Jetstar Japan. Qantas Loyalty segment consists of a portfolio of distinct brands and businesses, focusing on customer loyalty recognition programs.

name: GWR GROUP LTD
businessSummary: GWR Group Limited is an Australia-based resource company. The Company is focused on the development of mineral exploration and development projects. It is primarily focused on the exploration and development of its Prospect Ridge Project. It holds a 70% interest in the advanced Prospect Ridge Magnesite project located in northwest Tasmania. The Prospect Ridge Magnesite project area is in northwest Tasmania, 40 kilometers (km) southwest of the Port of Burnie. It sits upon a granted exploration license (EL5/2016), and is 11 km long and covers approximately 51 square kilometers (km2) in area and contains two magnesite deposits, the Arthur River and Lyons River deposits containing the magnesite inventory in Australia. The Company has a portfolio of mineral commodity projects that includes projects held in its own right, in joint ventures and indirectly through investment in other listed entities.

name: AF LEGAL GROUP LTD
businessSummary: AF Legal Group Limited is an Australia-based tech enabled law firm specializing in family and relationship law. The Company provides advice to clients in respect of divorce, separation, property, and children's matters together with related and ancillary services such as litigation. It is engaged in contested wills and estates practice, which includes all aspects of wills and estates disputes including contesting challenging and defending wills. Its subsidiaries include AF Legal Pty Ltd, Watts McCray (NSW) Pty Ltd, Withnall Cavanagh & Co Pty Ltd, AF Legal (Wollongong) Pty Ltd and AF Legal (Gold Coast) Pty Ltd. Watts McCray (NSW) Pty Ltd provides various legal services, including legal services, family law, dispute resolution, international law & expat services, Divorce.com.au and other legal services.

name: FORTESCUE LTD
businessSummary: Fortescue Ltd is an Australia-based global green technology, energy and metals company. The Company's segments include Metals and Energy. Metals segment includes exploration, development, production, processing, sale and transportation of iron ore, and the exploration for other minerals. Its metals business comprises its iron ore operations in the Pilbara as well as a pipeline of exploration projects globally including in Gabon in Africa, Latin America and Australia. The Company's metals business includes Hedland operations, Chichester Hub, Western Hub, Iron Bridge, Green Metal Project, integrated operations, Belinga Project, Blacksmith Project and Pilbara Energy Connect (PEC) project. Energy segment undertakes activities in the global development of green electricity, green hydrogen, green ammonia projects, as well as green technology development and manufacturing. Its energy business includes Arizona Hydrogen project, Holmaneset project, Pecem project and Gladstone PEM50 Project.

name: BHAGWAN MARINE LTD
businessSummary: Bhagwan Marine Limited is an Australia-based marine services company. The Company provides a diverse range of marine solutions within ports, nearshore, offshore and subsea locations to industries including oil and gas, subsea, port, civil construction, renewables and defense. Its offshore services include dive support, ROV support, crew change operations, metocean equipment deployment, geophysical surveys, geotechnical surveys, offshore accommodation services, decommissioning support, pilot transfers, FPSO offtake assist, oil field support services, coastal towage, coastal freight and others. Its port services include wharf & jetty construction support, crew change/transfers, harbor towage, line boats, inshore survey and ship supply runs. It has a fleet of approximately 95+ vessels comprising various vessel types, including dive support vessels, tugboats, multi-cats, utility vessels, barges and crew transfer boats, as well as other specialist vessels.

name: GRANGE RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Grange Resources Limited is an Australia-based company, which owns and operates an integrated iron ore mining and pellet production business located in the northwest region of Tasmania. The Company’s principal activities consist of the mining, processing and sale of iron ore from its operations in Tasmania, and the ongoing exploration and evaluation of mineral resources. Its projects include Savage River, Port Latta, and Southdown. The Savage River magnetite iron ore mine, is over 100 kilometers (km) southwest of the city of Burnie. The Port Latta project is located over 70 km northwest of Burnie, and its 100%-owned pellet plant and port facility at Port Latta produces over 2.5 million tons (Mt) of iron ore products annually. The Southdown Magnetite Project is located over 90 km east-northeast of Albany, and 10 km south-west of Wellstead in the Great Southern region of Western Australia. It contains over 1.2 billion tons of mineral resources, including 412 Mt of ore reserves.

name: RIVCO AUSTRALIA LTD
businessSummary: Rivco Australia Limited, formerly Duxton Water Limited, is an Australia-based company. The Company owns and manages a portfolio of water entitlements, providing the irrigation community with a broad range of water supply solutions. The primary investment objective of the Company is to build a portfolio of permanent water entitlements and utilize this portfolio to provide flexible water supply solutions to its Australian farming partners. It provides investors with direct exposure to the Australian water market. The Company owns and actively manages a diverse portfolio of water assets, primarily located in the Southern Murray Darling Basin (SMDB) region of Australia. The Company is engaged in providing irrigators with a range of water supply solutions and resource risk management tools. The Company holds approximately 91.5 gigalitres (GL) of permanent water entitlements. Duxton Capital (Australia) Pty Ltd. is the investment manager of the Company.

name: ENERO GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Enero Group Limited is an Australia-based global marketing and technology agency. The Company’s businesses include creative agency BMF, PR and integrated communications agencies, the Hotwire Group (Hotwire and ROI DNA), digital and experiential agency Orchard. Its specialist agencies provide progressive and integrated marketing services for global brands in technology, healthcare, and consumer verticals. Its integrated marketing and communication services include strategy, market research and insights, advertising, public relations, communications planning, design, events management, direct marketing, and programmatic media.

name: STRIKE ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Strike Energy Limited is an Australia-based energy company. The Company is an independent gas producer, developer and explorer focused on its quality conventional gas resources in the Perth Basin. Its projects in the Perth Basin include the producing Walyering gas facility, South Erregulla peaking gas power project, West Erregulla and Ocean Hill. The Walyering gas field sits in production license L23. The field is situated approximately 150 km north of Perth near the town of Cataby in the Mid-West. The South Erregulla field sits within L 24 and EP 503. It is situated approximately 350 km north of Perth near the town of Dongara in the Mid-West. The West Erregulla field sits within EP 469 which is operated and owned 50% by the Company. The Ocean Hill sits within EP495, situated approximately 350km north of Perth near the town of Eneabba. The Company also owns 100% of the geothermal rights in the Perth Basin, covering approximately 3,500 square kilometers (km2), namely The Precinct.

name: PRAIRIE LITHIUM LTD
businessSummary: Prairie Lithium Limited, formerly Arizona Lithium Limited, is an Australia-based company, which is focused on the sustainable development of the Prairie Lithium Project. The project is located in the Willson Basin of Saskatchewan, Canada. The project is comprised of over 345,000 acres of subsurface permits. It utilizes direct lithium extraction (DLE) technology to separate lithium from the brine. The extracted lithium concentrate is then converted onsite to an upgraded high-purity material. The remaining lithium-depleted brine shall be disposed of back underground into a different aquifer. The DLE process uses less land and fresh water while also generating less waste in comparison to hard rock and evaporation mining.

name: BAPCOR LTD
businessSummary: Bapcor Limited is a provider of vehicle parts, accessories, equipment, service and solutions. The Company’s segments include Trade, Specialist Wholesale, Retail and New Zealand. The Trade segment represents the trade-focused automotive aftermarket parts distribution to independent and chain mechanic workshops. It also includes the operations of Burson Auto Parts, Precision Automotive Equipment, Blacktown Auto and the Thailand-based operation. The Specialist Wholesale segment includes specialized wholesale distribution and network channel areas that focus on a specific automotive area, such as AAD, Baxters, Bearing Wholesalers, Roadsafe, Diesel Distributors, Federal Batteries, JAS, Premier Auto Trade, Truckline and WANO. The Retail segment includes operations of Autobarn, Autopro, Midas, ABS and Opposite Lock. The Retail segment is a full-offer retailer and service center. The New Zealand includes operations of Brake & Transmission (BNT), Autolign and HCB Technologies.

name: DETERRA ROYALTIES LTD
businessSummary: Deterra Royalties Limited is an Australia-based diversified resource royalty company. The Company's key investment activities involve the acquisition of resource royalties from third parties and providing finance to resource companies through royalty funding. The Company's two flagship royalties are Mining Area C and Thacker Pass lithium project. The Mining Area C (MAC) iron ore mine is located in Pilbara, Western Australia. The Thacker Pass lithium project is located in Nevada, United States. The Company's assets cover bulk, base, battery and precious metals at various stages of the mine lifecycle. Its bulk assets include Mining Area C, Koolyanobbing, Kwale, Yoongarillup/Yalyalup, Wonnerup, and Yandanooka. The Company's base and battery assets include Mimbula, Thacker Pass, Sonora, Paradox, Antler, Pukaqaqa, and Big Kidd. The Company's Lincoln asset is located in United States. The Company offers opportunities for ASX investors to invest in the global resources sector.

name: HORIZON OIL LTD
businessSummary: Horizon Oil Limited is an upstream oil and gas company. The principal activities of the Company is petroleum production, development, and exploration. It operates in three segments, which are China development, New Zealand development, and Australia development. The China development segment is involved in developing and producing crude oil from the Block 22/12 – WZ6-12, WZ12-8W and WZ12-8E oil field developments and in the exploration and evaluation of hydrocarbons within Block 22/12. The New Zealand development segment is involved in developing and producing crude oil from the Maari/Manaia oil field development. The Australia development segment is involved in developing and producing oil and gas from the Mereenie OL4 and OL5 oil and gas fields. The Block 22/12 oil development comprises nine hydrocarbon pools across three different Production Licenses. It lies 35 kilometers (kms) southwest of Weizhou Island, China, in 30m water depth. The Maari oil field is a producing oil field.

name: HELIA GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Helia Group Limited is a provider of Lenders Mortgage Insurance (LMI). It also provides tailored risk and capital management solutions. Its LMI proposition protects lenders if a homeowner defaults on a home loan and the lender is unable to recover the outstanding loan amount from the sale of the secured property. Lender's purchase LMI for risk transfer and capital management purposes. LMI provides protection to a lender to help borrowers purchase a property with a smaller deposit. LMI protects the lender against the risk of potential losses, in case they are unable to make home loan repayments, and the lender is unable to recover the outstanding loan amount from the sale of the security property. This makes loans more accessible to people who are looking to buy a home with less than 20% deposit. Home buyers have a range of flexible options for paying the LMI cost to their lender. It also offers flexible solutions to support home ownership and provide options for covering the LMI cost.

name: HMC CAPITAL LTD
businessSummary: HMC Capital Limited is an Australia-based diversified alternative asset manager focused on real estate, private equity, energy transition, healthscope, and digital infrastructure. Its segments include Real Estate, Private Credit, Private Equity, digital, and Corporate. Its Real Estate segment includes its HMC Capital managed HomeCo Daily Needs REIT, HealthCo Healthcare and Wellness REIT, HMC Wholesale Healthcare Fund and the Last Mile Logistics Fund. Its Private Equity segment comprises the HMC Capital Partners Fund I. Its Private Credit segment comprises commercial real estate and corporate credit fund management strategies. Its Digital Infrastructure segment comprises its digital infrastructure strategies, including HMC Capital managed fund, DigiCo Infrastructure REIT and StratCap. Corporate segment comprises capital solutions activities. It operates a private credit asset management platform over the medium-term spanning real estate, corporate, mezzanine, and infrastructure loans.

name: ADR ON SIMS LTD
businessSummary: Sims Limited is engaged in metal recycling and the provision of circular solutions for technology. Its activities include the buying, processing, and selling of ferrous and non-ferrous recycled metals, and the provision of environmentally responsible solutions for the recycling and repurposing of post-consumer electronic products and IT assets. The NAM segment comprises subsidiaries and joint ventures in the United States of America and Canada which perform ferrous and non-ferrous secondary recycling functions. The ANZ segment comprises subsidiaries in Australia, New Zealand and Papua New Guinea which perform ferrous and non-ferrous secondary recycling functions. The SAR comprises its investment in the SA Recycling joint venture in the United States of America. The SLS segment comprises subsidiaries which provide IT asset and cloud infrastructure reuse, redeployment and recycling in various countries. The GTO segment comprises its ferrous and non-ferrous marketing subsidiaries.

name: MCMILLAN SHAKESPEARE LTD
businessSummary: McMillan Shakespeare Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the provision of salary packaging, novated leasing, disability plan management and support co-ordination, asset management and related financial products and services. Its segments include Group Remuneration Services, Asset Management Services and Plan and Support Services. Group Remuneration Services segment provides administrative services in respect of salary packaging and facilitating motor vehicle novated leases for customers and ancillary services associated with motor vehicle novated lease products, including the provision of novated lease finance. Asset Management Services segment provides financing and ancillary management services associated with motor vehicles, commercial vehicles and equipment with operations in Australia and New Zealand. Plan and Support Services segment provides plan management and support coordination services to participants in the National Disability Insurance Scheme.

name: ARGOSY MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Argosy Minerals Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the development of the Rincon Lithium Project and exploration of the Tonopah Lithium Project. The Company has approximately 77.5% interest in the Rincon Lithium Project in Salta Province, Argentina and a 100% interest in the Tonopah Lithium Project in Nevada, United States. The Rincon Lithium Project comprises up to 8,606 hectares of Mining Titles and mining easement landholdings at the Salar del Rincon in Salta Province, Argentina. The Project is located in the elevated and arid Puna region of Argentina and forms part of a number of highly mineralized salars in production and development. The Company’s Tonopah Lithium Project is located within the Big Smokey Valley region in Nevada, United States, and comprises 425 claims covering an area of approximately 34.25 square kilometers (km2). The Tonopah Lithium Project is strategically located at the neighboring Silver Peak Lithium Mine deposit.

name: SOLVAR LTD
businessSummary: Solvar Limited is an Australia-based consumer and commercial finance company, which is engaged in the delivery of secured automotive loans as well as secured and unsecured personal loans. The Company operates through two segments: Australia and New Zealand. The Australia segment provides lending facilities in Australia generally based on the provision of an underlying asset as security, generally referred through a broker or distributed directly through digital channels. The New Zealand segment provides lending facilities in New Zealand generally based on the provision of an underlying asset as security, generally referred through a dealer. The Company operates through three business units in Australia - Money3, Automotive Financial Services (AFS) and Bennji; and one business unit in New Zealand - Go Car Finance. Money3, AFS and Bennji business units operate in Australia with broker networks and direct as primary distribution channels.

name: AGL ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: AGL Energy Limited is an Australia-based company, which operates an electricity generation portfolio within the National Electricity Market and is a private investor in renewable energy. The Company also owns an electric vehicle (EV) software platform. The Company's segments include Customer Markets, Integrated Energy and Investments. The Customer Markets segment comprises the consumer and large business customer portfolios responsible for the retailing of electricity, gas, broadband/mobile/voice, solar and energy efficiency products and services to residential, small and large business customers. The Integrated Energy segment operates its power generation portfolio and other key assets, including coal, gas, wind and hydro generation facilities, grid-scale batteries, natural gas storage and production facilities, and development projects. The Investments segment comprises its interests in the ActewAGL Retail Partnership, Tilt Renewables, Ovo Energy Australia and other investments.

name: TYRO PAYMENTS LTD
businessSummary: Tyro Payments Limited is an Australia-based technology-focused and values-driven company. The Company is focused on providing Australian businesses with payment solutions and complementary business banking products. Its segments include Payments and Banking. The Company provides credit, debit and electronic funds transfer at point of sale (EFTPOS) card acquiring, Medicare and private health fund claiming and rebating services to Australian businesses. It takes money on deposit and offers unsecured cash-flow based lending to Australian EFTPOS merchants. The Company is focused on in-store payments through e-Commerce solutions. It also provides solutions, such as its loans in the form of merchant cash advances and its fee-free, interest-bearing merchant transaction accounts and term-deposit accounts. It offers Tyro Connect, which is an integration hub for applications and point of sale (POS) systems, a plug and play platform software solution.

name: KALINA POWER LTD
businessSummary: KALiNA Power Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in delivering cost-effective power projects that incorporate technologies that generate constant baseload electricity with a low carbon footprint. Its 100% owned Canadian subsidiary, KALiNA Distributed Power (KDP) is developing a portfolio of multiple, 170 megawatts of natural gas-fired combined cycle power plants incorporating Carbon Capture and Sequestration (Power-CCS) in Alberta, Canada. The Sites are strategically located near ample interconnection infrastructure, including proposed carbon-di-oxide geological sequestration hubs, electrical grid connections, natural gas (NG) pipelines, and transportation infrastructure. Its KALiNA Cycle technology offers significant enhancements for power cycle applications involving geothermal as well as industrial waste heat to power (WHP). The KALiNA Cycle generates zero-emissions power from heat produced by energy-intensive industrial processes and geothermal resources.

name: WEST AFRICAN RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: West African Resources Limited is an Australia-based gold mining company. The Company is engaged in mining, mineral processing, exploration, project development, community and social sustainability, and rehabilitation within the West African country of Burkina Faso. It operates through two segments: the Mining Operations, which comprises the Sanbrado Gold Project operations located in Burkina Faso, and Construction and Exploration & Evaluation (E&E) segment comprises mines under construction and exploration and evaluation projects in locations other than Sanbrado. Its Sanbrado Gold Project is located approximately 90 kilometers (kms) east-southeast of Ouagadougou, the capital of Burkina Faso. Its Kiaka Gold Project is approximately 45 km south of Sanbrado Gold Mine in Burkina Faso. Its Toega Gold Project is located 14 km southwest of the Company’s Sanbrado gold operation. Its tenement portfolio comprises over 1,334 km2 over the Markoye fault region in central and southern Burkina Faso.

name: GULLEWA LTD
businessSummary: Gullewa Limited is engaged in exploration and mining, investments in equities and property. The Company’s activities cover Gold in Western Australia, base metals, mineral royalties and land subdivision in New South Wales (NSW). The Company’s wholly owned subsidiary Central Iron Ore Limited (CIO) is an exploration and development company engaged in the search for gold in Australia. Its main focus of exploration is in the Darlot Region of Western Australia, within 10 kilometers from the Red 5 Darlot Mine. The two main projects are: Red 5 Joint Venture and British King Gold Mine. It has a 1% royalty in several ATW Venture (Australia) Pty Ltd Mining Tenement, which include the Deflector Gold-Copper Project, located in the Gullewa Project area. The Company’s Gullewa Project is located 450 kilometers (km) north of Perth, 160 km east of Geraldton. The Company, through its fully owned subsidiary Gullpro Pty Ltd holds a 69% interest in a land subdivision at Aberglassyn.

name: QPM ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: QPM Energy Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company operates an integrated energy business comprising gas production and electricity generation. It owns 100% of the Moranbah Gas Project (MGP) and manages a portfolio of gas supply sourced from the MGP and mine waste gas produced by co-located coal mining operations. The Company also owns the Townsville Energy Chemicals Hub (TECH) Project which aims to develop a modern and sustainable refinery to produce nickel, cobalt and High Purity Alumina (HPA). The Company has operating control of two gas-fired power stations: 242MW Townsville Power Station, and 12.8MW Moranbah Power Station. Its subsidiaries include Pure Manganese Pty Ltd, QPM Tech Project Pty Ltd, Anroca Pty Ltd, Mineral Developments Pty Ltd, Ozark Mineral Resources INC, QPME Pty Ltd, QPM Energy (MGP Upstream) Pty Ltd, QPM Energy (Midstream) Pty Ltd, QPM Energy Markets Pty Ltd, QPM Energy (Merchant Services) Pty Ltd, and others.

name: RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Resource Development Group Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the provision of the contracting services to the mining sector within Australia, and the development of the Company’s Lucky Bay Garnet Project. The Company's segments include Construction, Mining and Other. It provides diversified mining services to the resources, infrastructure, and energy sectors within Australia, and owns two mining projects. It has manganese and garnet mining tenements in the Northwest of Western Australia. The Company, through its subsidiary, Central Systems Pty Ltd, provides multi-discipline construction and plant modification services to the resources, energy, and infrastructure sectors in Australia. Its subsidiaries include Comcen Pty Ltd, Australian Garnet Pty Ltd (AGPL) and others. Comcen Pty Ltd is the holder of the Ant Hill and Sunday Hill manganese project. AGPL is the holder of the Lucky Bay Garnet project and associated power infrastructure, including wind turbines.

name: EMBARK EARLY EDUCATION LTD
businessSummary: Embark Early Education Limited is an Australia-based provider of early childhood education and care. The Company owns and operates approximately 38 childcare centers with 3,476 licensed places. The Company operates over 23 centers in Queensland, 11 in Victoria, Two in New South Wales, One in Tasmania and One South Australia. It operates under brands such as Roseberry House, Brighthouse, Cubby care, Haven Early Learning, Kitiwah Place, Little Zebra, Carltron House, Moreton Drive Early Learning Centre, Youngstars Early Learning Centre, Kidsplay & learning centre, Edens Landing Childrens Centre, Imagination Garden, AppleBerries, Little Peanuts, and Peanut Kids.

name: BLUESCOPE STEEL LTD
businessSummary: BlueScope Steel Limited is a steel production company. The Company is focused on providing steel materials, products, systems and technologies across North America, Australia, New Zealand, Pacific Islands and throughout Asia. It is engaged in manufacturing of coil coating and coated steel products. Its segments include Australian Steel Products (ASP), North Star BlueScope Steel, Coated Products Asia, Buildings and Coated Products North America, and New Zealand & Pacific Islands. ASP segment produces and markets coated and painted flat steel products for Australian building and construction customers as well as offering commodity flat steel products. Coated Products Asia segment offers building products for China, consisting of metal coating, painting, Lysaght operations and engineered building solutions. It manufactures and markets a range of branded products that include pre-painted COLORBOND steel, zinc/aluminum alloy coated ZINCALUME steel and the LYSAGHT range of building products.

name: G8 EDUCATION LTD
businessSummary: G8 Education Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the operation of early childhood education and care centers. The Company has around 399 total centers with more than 36,000 children attending it. Its brands include Bambinos, Buggles, Casa Bambini, Community Kids, Creative Garden, Early Learning Services, First Grammar, Great Beginnings, Greenwood, Headstart Early Learning Centre, Jellybeans Childcare, Kinder Haven, Kindy Patch Kids, Kool Kids, NurtureOne, Pelicans, Pelican Childcare, Penguin Childcare, Sandcastles Childcare, The Learning Sanctuary and World of Learning. The Company’s childcare locations include Sydney, Newcastle, Melbourne, Brisbane, Gold Coast, Adelaide and Perth. Its subsidiaries include Grasshoppers Early Learning Centres Pty Ltd, Togalog Pty Ltd, Bourne Learning Pty Ltd, Ramsay Bourne Licences Pty Ltd, World of Learning Licences Pty Ltd, Shemlex Investment Unit Trust, and others.

name: TAMAWOOD LTD
businessSummary: Tamawood Limited is an Australia-based systems company. The Company's principal activities consist of contract home construction, home design and other associated activities in Australia; franchising and licensing operations, and consumer durables. The Company's subsidiaries include AstiVita Limited, AstiVita Bathrooms and Kitchens Pty Ltd, Dixonbuild Pty Ltd, DixonConstruct Pty Ltd, DixonRes Pty Ltd, Dixon Systems Pty Ltd, Edesia Asti Pty Ltd, Indent Manufacturers Pty Ltd, Solarpower Pty Ltd, Rosieres Appliances Pty Ltd, SolarRex Pty Ltd and TamawoodL Pty Ltd.

name: SCIDEV LTD
businessSummary: SciDev Limited is an Australia-based environmental solutions company, which is focused on water problems. The Company is a provider of specialty chemistry and water treatment technologies to heavy industry across the mining and mineral processing, water and wastewater, construction and infrastructure, oil and gas, remediation, and defense sectors. It segments include chemical services, water technologies, and corporate. Its chemical services segment is engaged in developing, manufacturing and supplying a range of chemistries and performance solutions that improve operational efficiencies, reduce waste and minimize water consumption across industry. The water technologies segment is focused on specialized water treatment and remediation technologies that remove harmful contaminants from groundwater, surface water and industrial liquid waste allowing water to be recycled or safely discharged to the environment.

name: PERPETUAL LTD
businessSummary: Perpetual Limited is a global financial services organization operating a multi-boutique asset management business, as well as wealth management and trustee services businesses. Its segments include Asset Management, Wealth Management, and Corporate Trust. The Asset Management business is a global multi-boutique asset management business offering an extensive range of specialist and differentiated investment capabilities through six boutique and seven brands in key regions globally. The Wealth Management business consists of perpetual private and three other distinct specialist businesses (Fordham, Jacaranda and Priority Life), offering a mix of wealth management, advice and trustee services to individuals, families, businesses, not-for-profit organizations and Indigenous communities throughout Australia. The Corporate Trust business is a provider of fiduciary and digital solutions to the banking and financial services industry in Australia and Singapore.

name: OMNI BRIDGEWAY LTD
businessSummary: Omni Bridgeway Limited is an Australia-based company involved in legal finance and risk management, including dispute and litigation finance, from case inception to post-judgment enforcement and recovery. The Company provides solutions, including arbitration financing, judgment enforcement, dispute funding, distressed asset recovery, bankruptcy, commercial, intellectual property, investor recoveries, class/group actions, appeals, and whistleblower. Arbitration financing analyzes factors impacting claims and advises on navigating the various arbitral institutions. Judgment enforcement advises clients on how to safeguard collectability and enforcement of judgments. The bankruptcy financing solutions include pre-litigation and pre-confirmation investigations, working capital, fees and credit funding and monetizing appeals. It assesses investment and enforcement opportunities in Africa, Asia, Australia, Canada, Europe, Latin America, the Middle East, the United Kingdom, and others.

name: FENIX RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Fenix Resources Limited is an Australia-based integrated mining, logistics and port services company with assets in the Mid-West region of Western Australia. The Company’s flagship Iron Ridge Iron Ore Mine is a high-grade direct shipping iron ore operation located approximately 360 km northeast of Geraldton. Its segments include Mining, Haulage and Port Services. Its iron ore products are transported by road to Geraldton using its Fenix-Newhaul haulage and logistics business. Its Newhaul Port Logistics business operates its own loading and storage facilities at the Geraldton Port. Its diversified mid-west iron ore, port and rail asset base includes Iron Ridge mine, the Beebyn W11 Deposit, the Shine Iron Ore Mine, the Newhaul Road Logistics haulage business, which owns and operates a road haulage fleet, two rail sidings at Ruvidini and Perenjori, as well as the Newhaul Port Services business that owns and operates three on-wharf bulk material storage sheds at Geraldton Port.

name: RIDLEY CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Ridley Corporation Limited is an Australia-based animal feed manufacturer. The Company operates through three segments: Bulk Stockfeeds, Packaged Feeds and Ingredients and Fertilizer. The Bulk Stockfeeds segment includes animal nutrition stockfeed solutions delivered in bulk. The Packaged Feeds and Ingredients segment comprises animal nutrition feed and ingredient solutions delivered in packaged form, ranging from one ton down to three-kilogram bags. Its Fertilizer segment sells fertilizers in Eastern Australia and to the export market. Its specialist areas include Bulk Ruminant Stockfeeds, Bulk Monogastric Stockfeeds, Animal Proteins & Oils, Commodities, NovaqPro, Specialty Product Distribution and Primo Aquaculture. Its product range includes Beef, Sheep, Dairy, other Ruminants, supplements & concentrates and partial mixed ration (PMR) & total mixed ration (TMR) smart blends. It is also a provider of dairy feed, cattle feed, and sheep feed.

name: INTELLIGENT MONITORING GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Intelligent Monitoring Group Limited is an Australia-based security company. The Company is engaged in providing provision of security, monitoring and risk management services in Australia. The Company operates through three segments: Monitoring, Installations, Maintenance, and Service. Its Monitoring segment provides security and video systems for commercial and residential customers. Its Installations segment provides security and video systems designed to meet individual customer requirements, both commercial and residential. Its Maintenance segment provides alarm and video installation and maintenance ser security and video systems for existing customers. Its Services segment includes guarding, patrolling and security officer training. The Company’s business includes ADT Security, Intelligent Monitoring Solutions, Signature Security Group, and Threat Protect Training.

name: QBE INSURANCE GROUP LTD
businessSummary: QBE Insurance Group Limited is an Australia-based insurance and reinsurance company. The principal activities of the Company include underwriting general insurance and reinsurance risks, management of Lloyd's syndicates and investment management. The Company's segments are North America, International, and Australia Pacific. The North America segment writes general insurance, reinsurance, and crop business in the United States. The International segment writes general insurance business in the United Kingdom, Europe, and Canada. This segment also writes general insurance and reinsurance business through Lloyd's; worldwide reinsurance business through offices in the United Kingdom, the United States, Ireland, Bermuda, Dubai, and mainland Europe; and provides personal and commercial insurance covers in Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, and Vietnam. The Company's Australia Pacific segment primarily underwrites general insurance risks throughout Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific region.

name: ACROW LTD
businessSummary: Acrow Limited is a provider of smart integrated construction systems across formwork, industrial services and commercial scaffolding in Australia. The Company's portfolio is falsework and shoring, screen solutions, Jacking Systems (Jumpform), and internal engineering capabilities. The Company operates 13 locations with over 60,000 tons of equipment. Its products include Slim-Lite and Slim-Max Soldiers, Acrowall-60, Acrowall-80, Single sided A-Frames, Acrow Flex Deck, Acrow Prop, Acrow GASS, V-shore, Powershore 30, Powershore 150, Acrow Screens, Jacking Systems, Universal Soldier System (USS), Quickstage, SuperCuplok, Ringlock, Timber and Ply, Props, Containment, and Accessories and other. The Company, through Benchmark Scaffolding, provides scaffolding solutions for complex applications in the industrial, mining and infrastructure sectors.

name: NEW HOPE CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: New Hope Corporation Limited is a coal producer with associated port, oil and gas, and agricultural operations. The Company operates the Bengalla Mine in New South Wales and the New Acland Mine in southeast Queensland, with coal primarily exported to customers in Asia. Its agricultural enterprises are located near its coal mines. Its Coal Mining in Queensland segment includes mining-related production, processing, transportation, port operations and marketing. Its Coal Mining in New South Wales segment includes mining-related production, processing, transportation, marketing, exploration. Its Other segments include coal exploration outside existing operational areas, oil and gas-related exploration, development and production, pastoral operations, treasury and administration. The Bengalla Mine is located four kilometers south-west of Muswellbrook in New South Wales. New Acland Mine is an open-cut thermal coal mine located 27 kilometers north-west of Oakey in southeast Queensland.

name: VICINITY CENTRES
businessSummary: Vicinity Centres is an Australia-based retail property company with a fully integrated asset management platform, and $24 billion in retail assets under management. The Company’s principal activities include investment in a portfolio of retail investment properties. It owns and manages retail destinations across Australia and offers a range of retail, residential, and office spaces. It has a direct portfolio with interests in approximately 51 shopping centers (including the DFO Brisbane business) and manages 26 assets on behalf of Strategic Partners. Its properties include Bankstown Central, Bayside, Buranda Village, Chadstone, DFO Perth, Emporium Melbourne, Queen Victoria Building, QueensPlaza, and The Glen. Its development properties include One Middle Road, Chadstone, Bankstown Central, Victoria Gardens, Box Hill Central, and Chatswood Chase Sydney. Its retail solutions include advertising, brand activations, leasing, and pop-up retail.

name: SOUTHERN CROSS MEDIA GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Southern Cross Media Group Limited is an Australia-based media company. The Company has a presence across broadcast television, audio, publishing, and digital. The Company is engaged in the creation of audio content for distribution on broadcast (AM, FM and DAB radio) and digital networks. The Company owns various media brands, including the Seven Network and its channels 7two, 7mate, 7flix and 7Bravo; as well as 7plus, 7NEWS.com.au, LiSTNR, the Hit and Triple M audio networks, The West Australian, The Sunday Times, PerthNow, The Nightly and Roam. The Company also owns approximately 104 radio Hit and Triple M stations across FM, AM and DAB+ and provides national sales representation for a further 56 regional radio stations. LiSTNR is a free, personalized audio app offering the radio, podcasts, music, and sport. LiSTNR delivers a daily feed of curated content, making it easier than ever to discover new audio experiences designed just for you.

name: COUNT LTD
businessSummary: Count Limited is an Australia-based integrated accounting and wealth services provider. The Company operates through three segments: Equity Partnerships, Wealth and Services. The Equity Partnerships segment includes investments in firms that provide accounting, audit and assurance, taxation, financial planning services and business and corporate advisory services. The Wealth segment includes financial services and investment products provided by Australian Financial Services Licence (AFSL) holders. The Services segment includes services that support the activities of accounting and financial planning firms both internal and external to the Group’s network. It also provides specialty accounting services, including asset acquisitions and disposal, forensic accounting, xero implementations, and cashflow forecasting and dashboard reporting, among others. It provides specialty sector expertise services, including for not-for-profit organizations and retirement villages, among others.

name: PIONEER CREDIT LTD
businessSummary: Pioneer Credit Limited is an Australia-based financial services provider. The Company is focused on acquiring and servicing Purchased Debt Portfolios (PDPs). The Company is also focused on providing customer service along with a range of products and solutions to help them achieve their financial goals. The Company specializes in acquiring and servicing retail debt portfolios. These portfolios consist of individuals with financial obligations to the Company and are the cornerstone of its customer relationships. It works with Australia’s banks, non-bank lenders, and financial institutions. Its key focus is on providing commercial solutions to its financial sector partners. The Company has approximately 219,000 customers throughout Australia and New Zealand. The Company's subsidiaries include Pioneer Credit Solutions Pty Limited, Sphere Legal Pty Limited, Pioneer Credit (Philippines) Pty Limited, Pioneer Credit Connect Pty Limited, Pioneer Credit Broking Services Pty Limited and others.

name: COVENTRY GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Coventry Group Limited is a distributor of industrial products and services operating throughout Australia and New Zealand. The Company operates in two segments: Trade Distribution and Fluid Systems. The Trade Distribution segment includes the importation, distribution and marketing of industrial fasteners, industrial hardware supplies and associated products, temporary fencing, and cabinet-making hardware. Trade Distribution supplies a range of fastening systems, cabinet hardware systems, industrial and construction products to customers in the industrial, manufacturing, infrastructure, building and construction, roofing and cladding, mining and mining services, resources/oil and gas and agriculture and aquaculture sectors. The Fluid Systems segment includes the design, manufacture, distribution, installation and maintenance of lubrication and hydraulic fluid systems and hoses. It also offers rock hammer service and repair and installation of fire suppression systems.

name: MAGELLAN FINANCIAL GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Magellan Financial Group Limited is an Australia-based specialist asset manager. The Company’s segments include Funds Management, Fund Investments and Associate Investments. The Funds Management segment provides investment fund management services to high net worth and retail investors in Australia and New Zealand, and to institutional investors globally. Its Funds Management activities include providing investment research and administrative services to certain clients; providing investment management and sub-advisory services under client mandates, and acting as responsible entity/trustee (RE) and/or investment manager (IM) for the funds (collectively the Magellan Funds). The Fund Investments segment comprises its direct investment in certain Magellan Funds and a select portfolio of listed Australian and international equities. The Associate Investments segment comprises a portfolio of selective investments in businesses in which it has a strategic interest.

name: CROMWELL PROPERTY GROUP
businessSummary: Cromwell Property Group is an Australia-based real estate investor and fund manager. The Company's segments include Funds and asset management, and Investment portfolio. Its Fund management segment represents activities in relation to the establishment and management of external funds for institutional and retail investors. Asset management includes property and facility management, leasing and project management, and development related activities. The Investment portfolio segment involves the ownership of investment properties located in Australia. These properties are held for long-term investment purposes. The Company’s properties include HQ North Tower, Brisbane, Queensland; 475 Victoria Avenue, Chatswood, New South Wales (NSW); Qantas HQ, Sydney; 207 Kent Street, Sydney; McKell Building, Sydney, NSW, and others.

name: METALS X LTD
businessSummary: Metals X Limited is a tin producer and holds a portfolio of assets from exploration to development. The Company’s principal activities include investment in a joint venture company operating a tin mine in Australia and investments in companies undertaking exploration and development of tin, gold and base metals projects in Australia and Europe. The Company owns a 50% equity interest in the Renison Tin Operation (Renison) through its 50% stake in the Bluestone Mines Tasmania Joint Venture Pty Ltd. The tailings dams have a Probable Ore Reserve containing approximately 99,000 tons of tin and 51,000 tons of copper. It also holds rights to over 45 square kilometers of prospective tenure surrounding Renison. Its base metals portfolio is leveraged both to global Gross domestic product (GDP) growth and to the burgeoning technological advancement in batteries, in particular their application in the electric vehicle market.

name: MYER HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Myer Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company which is engaged in the department store business. Its segments include Myer Retail and Myer Apparel Brands. Myer Retail segment includes store and online sales made under the brands: Myer, sass & bide, Marcs and David Lawrence. Myer Apparel Brands include stores and online sales made under the brands: Just Jeans, Dotti, Jacqui E, Portmans and Jay Jays. Its merchandise offer includes core product categories: Womenswear; Menswear; Childrenswear; Beauty; Homewares; Electrical Goods; Toys and General Merchandise. The Company operates approximately 56 department stores across Australia, as well as its online business: myer.com.au. Its subsidiaries include NB Elizabeth Pty Ltd, NB Russell Pty Ltd, NB Lonsdale Pty Ltd, NB Collins Pty Ltd, Warehouse Solutions Pty Ltd, Myer Group Pty Ltd, Myer Pty Ltd, Myer Group Finance Limited, The Myer Emporium Pty Ltd and others.

name: NRW HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: NRW Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in providing engineering, construction, manufacturing, technology, operations and maintenance services. The Company operates through four segments: Civil, Mining, Minerals Energy & Technologies (MET) and Electrical, Mechanical, Infrastructure & Technology (EMIT). Its Civil segment specializes in the delivery of private and public civil infrastructure projects, mine development, bulk earthworks and commercial and residential subdivisions. Its Mining segment specializes in mine management, contract mining, load and haul, drill and blast, coal handling preparation plants, maintenance services and the fabrication of water and service vehicles. Its Minerals, Energy & Technologies segment specializes in the design, construction, operation and maintenance of global resource projects across the mineral processing, energy and non-process infrastructure market segments.

name: ASTRON LTD
businessSummary: Astron Limited is engaged in the exploration and development of mineral sands projects, the upgrading of mineral sand products into higher value products and the development and application of technologies for the production of advanced materials and chemicals from mineral sands products. Its principal activities include work to advance its interest in the Donald Rare Earths and Mineral Sands Project (Donald Project) in regional Victoria to operations; exploration activities through Jackson Mineral Sands Pty Ltd, to delineate and advance its Jackson Rare Earths and Mineral Sands Project, which is located in close proximity to the Donald Project, and the operation of titanium and zirconium minerals processing activities, using a mineral separation plant at Yingkou, China; the evaluation and advancement of downstream applications for zircon and titanium, and titanium and zirconium minerals procurement and trading activities through its subsidiary Astron Titanium (Yingkou) Co. Limited.

name: CHAMPION IRON LTD
businessSummary: Champion Iron Limited is an Australia-based iron ore exploration and development company. The Company through its wholly owned subsidiary, Quebec Iron Ore Inc., owns and operates the Bloom Lake Mining Complex, located on the south end of the Labrador Trough, approximately 13 kilometers (km) north of Fermont, Quebec. Bloom Lake is an open-pit operation with two concentration plants that primarily source energy from renewable hydroelectric power. It ships iron ore concentrate from Bloom Lake by rail, to a ship loading port in Sept-lles, Quebec, and has sold its iron ore concentrate to customers globally, including in China, Japan, the Middle East, Europe, South Korea, India and Canada. In addition to Bloom Lake, it owns a portfolio of exploration and development projects in the Labrador Trough, including the Kamistiatusset Project, located over 21 km south-east of Bloom Lake, and the Cluster II portfolio of properties. Its other projects are Cluster I, Powderhorn and Gullbridge projects.

name: TREASURY WINE ESTATES LTD
businessSummary: Treasury Wine Estates Limited is an Australia-based wine company. The Company is involved in the production, marketing and sale of wine. The Company’s segments include Treasury Premium Brands, Penfolds, and Treasury Americas. The Treasury Premium Brands segment is responsible for the manufacture, sale and marketing of wine within Australia, Asia, Europe, Canada, the Middle East and Africa. The Penfolds segment is responsible for the manufacture, sale and marketing of Penfolds wine globally. The Treasury Americas segment is responsible for the manufacture, sale and marketing of wine within North American and Latin America regions. In Australia, it owns and operates six wineries and one packaging facility with wines primarily produced in South Australia and Victoria. In New Zealand, it owns one winery located in Marlborough. Its brands include Penfolds, DAOU Vineyards, 19 Crimes, Drop of Sunshine, Frank Family Vineyards, Etude, Beaulieu Vineyard, and Seppelt.

name: BULLETIN RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Bulletin Resources Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. Its projects include the Lake Rebecca Gold Project, Ravensthorpe Lithium Project, Chifley Gold Project, Mt Cue Gold Project, Farmer Project and Powder Sill Project. The Lake Rebecca Gold Project comprises approximately 1,100 square kilometers (km2) of gold prospective exploration tenements in the southern Laverton Tectonic Zone, 150 kilometers (km) east north-east of Kalgoorlie, Western Australia. Its 100% owned Ravensthorpe Lithium Project contains outcropping spodumene and lepidolite lithium bearing pegmatites. The 130km2 tenement package is 12km southwest and along the strike of Rio Tinto’s Mt Cattlin lithium mine. The Chifley project is a 79km2 exploration tenement that is prospective for gold. It is approximately 50km to the south of Lake Rebecca and on a northwest trending splay of the Claypan Fault. Mt Cue Gold Project is 25km2 in area and is located approximately 33km west of Cue, Western Australia.

name: 5G NETWORKS LTD
businessSummary: 5G Networks Limited is a digital services company. The Company's principal activities include the supply of cloud-based solutions, managed services, and network services, the operation of fiber and wireless infrastructure and management of cloud computing environment, and the operation of data center facilities. Its segments include Enterprise and Wholesale. The Enterprise segment include cloud hosting, domain names, data center, networks, and voice, information technology (IT) managed services, hardware and software and digital marketing products and services provided to enterprise and government customers. The Wholesale segment include cloud hosting, data center, networks and voice products and services provided to wholesale telecommunications and Segment information is provided below in relation to these segments.

name: VMOTO LTD
businessSummary: Vmoto Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the development and manufacture, marketing and distribution of electric two-wheel vehicles (electric motorcycles and electric mopeds). It operates in four geographical segments: Australia, China, Europe and Singapore. Its E-Mobility Solutions (EMS) is an integrated electric mobility solution focused on electric two-wheel mobility, which encompasses range of two-wheel vehicles, dual battery models for extended range, electric charging infrastructure in the form of fast charging and battery swapping technology, and pre-installed Internet of Things (IoT) devices with fleet management software. Its e-motorcycle vehicles include STASH, TC MAX, TS STREET HUNTER PRO, OFF-R, and others. Its Smart Connectivity and IoT include services such as smart platform, sharing solutions, and others. Its 4G APP prepares scooters for integration with third-party IT ecosystems. The Company has approximately 76 distributors in over 90 countries.

name: SWOOP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Swoop Holdings Limited is an Australia-based Internet service provider with mobile and national broadband network (NBN) products. It also services the residential and small and medium-sized enterprises (SME) broadband markets through its fixed wireless and fiber infrastructure as a fixed wireless network provider. It designs, builds and services its own residential infrastructure, including towers, and with mobile and NBN as flagship products. Its principal activities include the provision of services over the NBN fixed line and fixed wireless networks; fiber network management and construction, and fixed wireless access as well as wholesale transit services to other Internet service providers (ISPs) and telecommunications companies. Through its subsidiary, Telco Pay Pty Ltd (Moose Mobile), the Company provides mobile services. It also operates a fixed wireless, fiber and wholesale network infrastructure carrier with the national network.

name: FAR LTD
businessSummary: FAR Limited is an Australia-based independent, Africa focused, oil and gas exploration company. The principal activities of the Company are identifying and developing strategies to realize value from the consideration receivable for the sale of its interest in the RSSD Project in Senegal to Woodside Energy (Senegal) BV (Woodside Energy). The Company has rights to a contingent payment, as consideration for the sale of its interest in the RSSD Project. The contingent payment comprises 45% of entitlement barrels (being the share of oil relating to its previously held 13.67% of the RSSD Project comprising the Sangomar Field exploitation area of interest), multiplied by the excess of the crude oil price per barrel and US$58 per barrel (capped at US$70 per barrel).

name: REGIS RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Regis Resources Limited is an Australia-based gold producer and explorer company. It operates in three segments: Duketon North (DNO), Duketon South (DSO) and Tropicana. DNO and DSO collectively comprise the Duketon Gold Project. The DNO segment consists of Moolart Well, Gloster, Anchor, Dogbolter-Coopers and Petra. The DSO segment consists of Garden Well, Rosemont, Rosemont Underground, Erlistoun, Tooheys Well and Baneygo. The Tropicana segment is operated by joint venture partner AngloGold Ashanti Australia Limited. Its Duketon Gold Project is in the northeastern Goldfields of Western Australia approximately 130 kilometers (km) north of Laverton. It focuses on high-grade gold mining opportunities in the mining region of Central Western New South Wales (NSW). Its Tropicana Gold Project is located approximately 330 km east-northeast (ENE) of Kalgoorlie in Western Australia. Its McPhillamys Gold Project is located about 250 km west of Sydney in the mining region of Central Western NSW.

name: ITECH MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: iTech Minerals is a mineral exploration company exploring for and developing battery materials and critical minerals within its 100% owned Australian projects. The Company is exploring for graphite and developing the Lacroma and Campoona Graphite Deposits in South Australia and copper-gold-antimony and lithium in the Reynolds Range Project. It is focused on developing the advanced Eyre Peninsula Graphite Project in South Australia and exploring the early-stage Reynolds Range Copper-GoldProject in the Northern Territory. The Reynolds Range project consists of three exploration licenses and covers a total of over 375 square kilometers (km2) of the Aileron Province, part of the Paleoproterozoic North Australian Craton. It owns 100% of the Eyre Peninsula Graphite Project (formerly the Campoona Project). It is an emerging graphite district, and close to established energy infrastructure, transportation routes, facilities and shipping options.

name: HIGHCOM LTD
businessSummary: HighCom Limited is an Australia-based international defense industry company. The Company operates through two divisions: HighCom Armor (the United States Operation) and HighCom Technology (Australian Operations). HighCom Armor division designs, manufactures, and supplies global military, law enforcement, and first responder customers with advanced personal protection ballistic products and solutions for body armor, ballistic helmets, and composite armor panels and platform structures. HighCom Technology division supplies Australian Defense and Security Agencies with small uncrewed arial systems and sensor payloads, and provides local program, project and engineering management, systems integration, maintenance, composite repairs, and logistics support services. Its HighCom Armor also designs, develops, tests, manufactures, and distributes dozens of National Institute of Justice compliant hard and soft armor products, as well as other composite armor panels and complex curved items.

name: BABY BUNTING GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Baby Bunting Group Limited is an Australia-based specialty maternity and baby goods retailer. The Company primarily caters to parents with children from newborn to three years of age and parents-to-be. It also provides services to new and expectant parents. The Company operates through two segments: Australia and New Zealand. Its principal product categories include prams, cots and nursery furniture, car safety, toys, babywear, feeding, nappies, manchester and associated accessories. It also provides services that are complementary to the products it sells, including car seat installation and hire services for certain nursery products. It offers various brands, including 4Baby, Bilbi, Britax, Bugaboo, Jengo, Camelbak, Charli Chair, Cherub Baby, Chicco, Dentons, Disney, and others. It operates retail stores in Australia and New Zealand and related online stores. Its subsidiaries include Baby Bunting Pty Ltd, Baby Bunting EST Pty Ltd, and Baby Bunting NZ Limited.

name: STOCKLAND CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Stockland Corporation Ltd is an Australia-based creator and curator of connected communities. The Company is a diversified property group in Australia. It owns, funds, develops and manages portfolios of residential and land lease communities, retail town centers, and workplace and logistics assets. The Company’s segments include Development, Investment Management, and Other. The Development segment develops a range of assets including residential properties, commercial properties and mixed-use assets. Investment Management segment invests in and manages commercial properties and residential investment properties, manages capital investments, and earns management income for services performed. It also creates communities and whole-of-life housing solutions across its master planned and land lease communities. Its focus is on leveraging its specialist end-to-end, multi-sector capability to create value at each stage of the real estate life cycle.

name: IONEER LTD
businessSummary: Ioneer Ltd is an Australia-based lithium-boron producer. The Company is principally engaged in the development of the Rhyolite Ridge lithium-boron deposit in the state of Nevada, United States of America. The Company’s Rhyolite Ridge Lithium-Boron Project is located in Esmeralda County, Nevada, situated in the Silver Peak Range, part of the larger geo-physiographic Basin and Range Province of western Nevada. Rhyolite Ridge is approximately 14 miles northeast of Dyer, Nevada. It is 65 miles southwest of Tonopah, Nevada, 215 miles from Reno, and 255 miles from Las Vegas. The Company operates through two segments: North America and Australia.

name: EXCELSIOR CAPITAL LTD
businessSummary: Excelsior Capital Limited is an Australia-based listed investment company (LIC) and manages an investment portfolio. The Company's primary investment strategy focuses on achieving long-term growth and capital appreciation while effectively managing risk through a diversified portfolio approach. The fund portfolio construction is primarily a non-market correlated strategy for investments that seeks to generate positive absolute return at low volatility with negligible correlation to both the other investments within the portfolio and that of the broader risk assets such as listed equities and sovereign bonds. Capital may be allocated to direct and indirect investments in managed investment schemes and trusts, as well as in both listed and unlisted companies, through equity, derivative instruments, debt, or a combination. The Company may also invest in a broad range of businesses, providing both capital and strategic guidance to generate sustainable long-term returns and capital growth.

name: RECTIFIER TECHNOLOGIES LTD
businessSummary: Rectifier Technologies Limited is an Australia-based company, which designs and manufactures high-efficiency power rectifiers and produces electronic and specialized magnetic components. The Company's segments include Electronic Components, Industrial Power Supplies (Electricity generation/distribution and Defence) (E&D), Industrial Power Supplies (Transport and Telecommunication) (T&T) and Industrial Power Supplies (Electric vehicles) (EV). Electronic Components segment is engaged in manufacturing electronic components. Industrial Power Supplies (E&D) segment manufactures and distributes rectifiers, controllers, accessories and complete systems for the power generation, distribution industries and defense. Industrial Power Supplies (T&T) segment manufactures and distributes power supplies for the transport industries and telecommunications. Industrial Power Supplies (EV) segment manufactures and distributes electric vehicle charges, battery charges and power supplies.

name: GPT GROUP
businessSummary: The GPT Group is an Australia-based vertically integrated diversified property company that owns and actively manages a portfolio of Australian retail, office and logistics assets, with assets under management of approximately $32.2 billion. The Company utilizes its real estate management platform to enhance returns through property development and funds management. Its office portfolio includes 32 Smith, 4 Murray Rose Avenue, 580 George Street, 2 Park Street, Darling Park 1 & 2 And Cockle Bay Wharf, Darling Park 3, Eclipse Tower, Liberty Place, 150 Collins Street, and others. Its logistics portfolio includes 128 Andrews Road, 1 Huntingwood Drive, 10 Interchange Drive, 104 Vanessa Street, 16-34 Templar Road, 18-24 Abbott Road, 1B Huntingwood Drive and others. Its retail portfolio includes Charlestown Square, Macarthur Square, Rouse Hill Town Centre, Westfield Penrith, and Chirnside Park, among others. Its Funds Management platform is focused on the Australian retail and office sectors.

name: INFINITY METALS LTD
businessSummary: Infinity Metals Limited, formerly Infinity Lithium Corporation Limited, is an Australia-based minerals company. The Company is principally engaged in the exploration and evaluation of lithium assets and progression of the integrated lithium chemicals conversion plant. The Company, through its subsidiary, Extremadura New Energies, maintains a 75% ownership interest in the San Jose Lithium Project. The Project is located approximately three hours from Madrid, and three and a half hours from Lisbon, accessible by dual-lane highway. The proposed fully integrated industrial project is focused on the production of battery-grade lithium chemicals from a mica feedstock. The Company, through Highland Resources Limited, owns 100% of four granted, advanced high-grade gold exploration assets in the Lachlan Fold Belt, Victoria. The Comstock Gold-Silver Prospect lies two kilometers along strike to the southeast from Forsyth Prospect. Its other projects include Mitta, Goodhope-Union and Bindi.

name: KINGSGATE CONSOLIDATED LTD
businessSummary: Kingsgate Consolidated Limited is a gold and silver producer and owner and operator of the Chatree Gold Mine in central Thailand and the Nueva Esperanza Gold-Silver Project, located in the highly endowed Maricunga Belt in northern Chile. The Chatree Gold Mine is located in central Thailand, approximately 280 kilometers (km) north of the capital of Bangkok and straddles the Phichit, Phetchabun and Phitsanulok provinces. Chatree is a large, low-grade, low sulphidation epithermal deposit, located in the highly prospective Loei-Phetchabun volcanic belt. Nueva Esperanza Gold-Silver is a prospective pre-feasibility stage gold and silver project comprising several deposits (Arqueros, Chimberos and Teterita) located in a high sulphidation epithermal system, and a number of prospective exploration targets. Nueva Esperanza is located in the prolific Maricunga Belt in the Atacama Region of Northern Chile, 140 km North-East of the city of Copiapo, a regional mining center.

name: SIMS LTD
businessSummary: Sims Limited is engaged in metal recycling and the provision of circular solutions for technology. Its activities include the buying, processing, and selling of ferrous and non-ferrous recycled metals, and the provision of environmentally responsible solutions for the recycling and repurposing of post-consumer electronic products and IT assets. The NAM segment comprises subsidiaries and joint ventures in the United States of America and Canada which perform ferrous and non-ferrous secondary recycling functions. The ANZ segment comprises subsidiaries in Australia, New Zealand and Papua New Guinea which perform ferrous and non-ferrous secondary recycling functions. The SAR comprises its investment in the SA Recycling joint venture in the United States of America. The SLS segment comprises subsidiaries which provide IT asset and cloud infrastructure reuse, redeployment and recycling in various countries. The GTO segment comprises its ferrous and non-ferrous marketing subsidiaries.

name: OOH!MEDIA LTD
businessSummary: oOh!media Limited is an Australia-based out-of-home (OOH) media company. The Company is engaged in offering advertisers the ability to create deep engagement between people and brands across diverse OOH location-based portfolios in Australia and New Zealand. It also invests in technology. Its portfolio includes large format digital and classic roadside screens; large and small format digital and classic signs located in retail precincts such as shopping centers; large and small format digital and classic signs in airport terminals, lounges and in-flight; digital and classic street furniture signs; digital and classic format advertising in public transport corridors, including rail, and digital and classic signs in high dwell time environments, such as universities and office buildings. It also provides advertising creative and printing services. It has a network of over 35,000 digital and static asset locations that include roadsides, airports, train stations, bus stops, and others.

name: SCENTRE GROUP
businessSummary: Scentre Group is an Australia-based company, which owns and operates a portfolio of 42 Westfield destinations with 37 located in Australia and five in New Zealand encompassing. The Company's Westfield destinations are located across Australia and New Zealand. Its retail service includes marketing services, gift cards, center services and a marketing hub. Its BrandSpace gives businesses access to over 1,800 full motion SuperScreens and SmartScreens and various retail pop-up and promotional touchpoints, located to optimize customer connections. The Company operates through two segments: property investment, and property management and construction segments. The Property investments segment owns and operates shopping centers. The Company’s Property management and construction segment includes external fee from third parties, primarily property management and development fees, and associated business expenses.

name: AMA GROUP LTD
businessSummary: AMA Group Limited is an Australia-based company. The principal activity of the Company is the operation and development of collision repair businesses in Australia and New Zealand. Its segments consist of AMA Collision, Capital SMART, Wales, and Specialist Businesses. The AMA Collision segment provides larger, more complex repairs to cars that have sustained high-severity collision damage and may be undriveable. The Capital SMART segment specializes in performing rapid repairs on cars that have sustained low-to-medium collision damage and are still drivable. The Wales segment provides specialized facilities for all commercial vehicle repairs, from light commercial to prime movers, B-doubles, buses, and earthmoving equipment. Its Specialist Businesses include AMA Prestige, which offers sites servicing prestige vehicle marques; TechRight, an Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) calibration service; and Track Right, a mechanical repair service.

name: EML PAYMENTS LTD
businessSummary: EML Payments Limited is an Australia-based company, which provides a global payment solutions platform. The Company offers program management and payments to create customizable solutions for businesses, brands and their customers. Its segments include North America, Europe, and Asia Pac. The North America segment provides provision of prepaid payment services, predominantly with single-load card solutions, to its customers in the United States and Canada. The Europe segment provides provision of reloadable and non-reloadable prepaid payment solutions to customers in Europe and the United Kingdom. The Asia Pac segment provides the provision of prepaid payment services to customers in Australia and New Zealand. It offers a range of products and payment options, including banking, credit, and disbursements services, earned wage access, gifts, incentives and rewards and FX solutions. Its products include Card Payments, Open Banking, Digital Account Payments and Seamless.

name: ADORE BEAUTY GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Adore Beauty Group Limited is an Australia-based beauty focused e-commerce Website. The Company provides an integrated content, marketing and e-commerce retail platform that partners with a portfolio of over 300 brands and 14,000 products.
