It sells beauty and personal care products to Australian and New Zealand consumers. It fulfils orders from its customer fulfilment center in Victoria. The Company's product categories include skin care, makeup, hair, body, fragrance, teen, men, Korean beauty, clean beauty, wellness, travel size, trending, gifts, subscribe and save, refills, specials, and bundles. It offers various brands, which include Aceology, Adore Beauty, AERIN Beauty, Aesop, Aesthetics Rx, Baebrow, Calvin Klein, Davines, Davroe, Denman Brushes, Embryolisse, Espoir, others. The Company's skin care products include cosmeceuticals, serums & treatments, moisturizers, cleansers & scrubs, and masks. Its hair products include hair bond repair, hair fall & thinning, and conditioners.

name: CANN GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Cann Group Limited is an Australia-based company, which is focused on developing, producing, and supplying innovative cannabis medicines. The principal activities of the Company include the cultivation of medicinal cannabis for both medicinal and research purposes pursuant to the licenses and permits issued to the Company, the development and manufacture (via third party arrangements) of finished product formulations, and the pursuit and execution of various supply agreements with third parties. It operates through cultivation of the medicinal cannabis segment. The Company supplies a range of dried flower and oil products, as well as active pharmaceutical ingredients and extracts, to customers in Australia and around the world. It also owns Satipharm and its patent-protected capsule technology. The Company's research and good manufacturing practices (GMP) manufacturing facilities are near Mildura, Victoria.

name: KELSIAN GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Kelsian Group Limited is an integrated multi-modal transport provider and tourism operator. Its segments include Marine and Tourism, Australian Bus and International Bus. Marine and Tourism segment operates vehicle and passenger ferry services, barging, coach tours and package holidays, lunch, dinner and charter cruises and accommodation facilities throughout Australia. Australian Bus segment operates metropolitan public bus services on behalf of governments in Sydney, Melbourne, Perth, Adelaide, and Stradbroke Island, as well as regional and remote bus services supporting the resources sector in Western Australia. It also operates charter bus services in the Northern Territory. International Bus segment operates or participates in the operation of metropolitan public bus services on behalf of governments in the United Kingdom, Channel Islands and Singapore. It also operates charter motorcoaches for corporates, local and federal government and educational sectors in the United States.

name: MEDICAL DEVELOPMENTS INTERNATIONAL LTD
businessSummary: Medical Developments International Limited is an Australia-based company that delivers emergency medical solutions dedicated to improving patient outcomes in both domestic and international markets. The Company operates in two segments: Pain Management and Respiratory. The Pain Management segment is engaged in the supply of analgesia for acute and procedural pain. The Company manufactures an inhaled analgesic, Penthrox (the Green Whistle), at manufacturing facilities at Scoresby and Springvale in Victoria, Australia. Penthrox is sold into domestic and international markets through distribution partnerships and direct in-market capability. The Respiratory segment is a supplier of respiratory products including asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) space chambers, peak flow meters, portable nebulizers and silicone face masks. The respiratory supplies into Australia, the United States of America, Europe, and Asia through partnerships with distributors.

name: SERVICE STREAM LTD
businessSummary: Service Stream Limited is a provider of essential network services to the telecommunications, utility and transport sectors. It designs, constructs, operates and maintains critical infrastructure networks. Its segments include Telecommunications, Utilities, and Transport. The Telecommunications segment offers a range of operations, maintenance, installation, design and construction services to the owners of fixed-line and wireless telecommunication networks in Australia. The Utilities segment offers a range of operations, maintenance, design and construction services to gas, water and electricity network owners, industrial asset owners and other customers in Australia. Service capabilities include asset maintenance, engineering, design and construction of network assets. The Transport segment offers long-term operational support and maintenance services to public and private road and tunnel asset owners. Service capabilities include road network maintenance and control room operations.

name: STEADFAST GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Steadfast Group Limited operates insurance broker and agency networks in Australia, New Zealand, Singapore and the United States of America. The Company includes the provision of services to Steadfast Network brokers, the distribution of insurance policies via insurance brokerages and underwriting agencies, and related services. Its segments include Broking, Underwriting Agencies, International, Technology, Complementary and Head Office. Its Complementary businesses comprise IQumulate Premium Funding, Steadfast Business Solutions, Steadfast Risk Group, Goldseal and Meridian Lawyer. It owns a portfolio of approximately 30 underwriting agencies providing specialist insurance products in niche market segments to the open market. It also owns Lloyds broking house, HWS Specialty, offering wholesale placement for brokers and agents around the world as well as direct insurance solutions. Its portfolio includes personal insurance, strata insurance, commercial property, liability and others.

name: PO VALLEY ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Po Valley Energy Limited is an Australia-based gas and condensate development company. The Company is an explorer and developer of natural gas for domestic consumption in Italy. The Company is focused on developing two of its fields, Podere Maiar (Selva) and the Teodorico project. Selva is an onshore natural gas field in the eastern part of the Po Plan, among the Ferarra and Bologna provinces, in the Emilia Romagna region. The exploration permit measures approximately 506 square kilometers (km2) and within this permit, the Selva Malvezzi production concession is 80.68 km2. The Company's 100%-owned Teodorico (AR94PY) license is located off the east coast of Italy, approximately 30 km southeast of Venice and 40 km northeast of Ravenna, in the shallow waters of the Adriatic Sea. The Company is active in Italy’s main onshore gas production fields of Po Valley in the north of Italy and offshore gas fields in the Adriatic Sea. Its subsidiary is Po Valley Operations Pty Limited (PVO).

name: DOWNER EDI LTD
businessSummary: Downer EDI Limited is an Australia-based company that provides integrated services in Australia and New Zealand. The Company’s segments include Transport, Energy and Utilities, and Facilities. Its Transport segment consists of road services businesses across Australia and New Zealand, rail businesses in Australia and projects businesses in New Zealand. Utilities segment consists of power, gas, water, telecommunications, industrial, resources, and energy businesses. This includes planning, designing, constructing, operating, maintaining, managing, and decommissioning power and gas network assets, and others. Its Facilities segment provides outsourced facility services to customers across a diverse range of industry sectors including education, health, government, and defense. Facilities provide asset management services to facilities and estates that cover maintenance, expansion and frontline services for strategic assets across a range of sectors.

name: IMMURON LTD
businessSummary: Immuron Limited is an Australia-based biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing orally delivered targeted polyclonal antibodies for the treatment of infectious diseases. It operates through two segments: Research and development (R&D), and Hyperimmune products. The R&D segment is focused on R&D projects performed in Australia and the United States. Hyperimmune products segment is engaged in Travelan and Protectyn activities which occur predominantly in Australia, the United States and Canada. Its flagship products consist of Travelan and Protectyn. Travelan is an orally administered passive immunotherapy that prophylactically reduces the likelihood of contracting traveler’s diarrhea and is sold in pharmacies throughout Australia. Protectyn is sold online and in health practitioner clinics and is marketed as an immune supplement to help maintain a healthy digestive function and liver. Its clinical programs include Travelan (IMM-124E), and IMM-529.

name: JUPITER MINES LTD
businessSummary: Jupiter Mines Limited is an Australia-based pure-play manganese company. The Company's core asset is a 49.9% stake in Tshipi e Ntle Manganese Mining, an independently operated and managed, black-empowered company that operates the Tshipi manganese mine in South Africa’s Kalahari region. Tshipi operates as an open pit mine, producing on average 3.4 million tons of manganese ore annually, with the flexibility to scale production in line with market demand. The mine produces both lumpy and fines manganese ore, with average grades of approximately 36.5% and 35.5%, respectively. The mine employs a combination of rail and road transport to deliver processed manganese ore to eight commercial ports across South Africa. These ports include Port Elizabeth, Saldanha, Cape Town, East London, Durban, Richards Bay, Mossel Bay, and Ngqura, as well as Luderitz in Namibia. The Company is exploring the potential to supply high purity manganese sulphate monohydrate to the electric vehicle battery market.

name: MIRVAC GROUP
businessSummary: Mirvac Group is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in property investment for the purpose of deriving rental income and investments in unlisted funds. It owns and manages assets across the residential, office and industrial, retail and build to rent sectors. The Company’s residential properties include apartments, town homes, houses, and land. It has residential apartment projects and communities across New South Wales, Queensland, Victoria & Western Australia. Its portfolio of office properties includes 101-103 Miller Street, North Sydney; 410 Ann Street, Brisbane; Locomotive Workshop, South Eveleigh; 380 St Kilda Road, Melbourne; 31 Market Street, Sydney; Olderfleet, 477 Collins Street, Melbourne; 55 Pitt Street, Sydney, and others. Its portfolio of industrial properties includes 36 Gow Street, Padstow and 39 Herbert Street, St Leonards. Its Birkenhead Point Brand Outlet is situated five kilometers from Sydney CBD on a prime 3.7-hectare waterfront site.

name: DEXUS
businessSummary: Dexus is an Australia-based real estate company. The Company’s segments include Office, Industrial, Co-investments, Property management, Funds Management, and Development and Trading. The Office segment consists of domestic office space with any associated retail space, as well as car parks and office developments. The Industrial segment includes domestic industrial properties, industrial estates and industrial developments. The Co-investments segment includes distribution income earned from investments in pooled property and real estate security funds. The Property management segment includes property management services for third-party clients and owned assets. The Funds Management segment consists of funds management of third-party client assets. The Development and trading segment includes revenue earned and costs incurred by the Company on development services and inventory.

name: CETTIRE LTD
businessSummary: Cettire Limited is an Australia-based global online retailer. The Company is engaged in offering a selection of in demand personal luxury goods via its Website, cettire.com. It has access to an extensive catalogue of more than 2,500 luxury brands and 500,000 products of clothing, shoes, bags, and accessories. It sells a range of products from over 500 designers, which include a range of women's and men's wear from brands, such as Prada, Gucci, Saint Laurent, Balenciaga, and Valentino, among others. The Company's product categories include clothing, shoes, bags, and accessories. Its clothing category offers activewear, coats, jackets, jeans, knitwear, pants, and various others. Its shoes category offers boots, espadrilles, lace-up shoes, loafers, and various others. The Company’s bags category offers bag accessories, belt bags, clutch bags, crossbody bags and various others. The Company also offers accessories, such as belts, glasses, gloves, hats, and various others.

name: WEBJET GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Webjet Group Limited is an Australia-based digital consumer travel company. The principal activities of the Company are online sales and distribution of travel products including flights, hotels, holiday packages, car and motorhome rentals, and travel insurance. The Company operates through three segments: Webjet OTA, Cars & Motorhomes, and Trip Ninja. Its Webjet OTA segment is an online travel agency that operates in Australia and New Zealand. Webjet OTA enables customers to compare, combine and book the domestic and international travel flight deals, hotel accommodation, holiday package deals, travel insurance and car hire worldwide. Its Cars & Motorhomes segment operates a global e-commerce platform specializing in motorhome and car rentals, servicing customers across multiple international markets. Its Trip Ninja segment is a travel technology business that develops solutions to optimize complex travel itineraries.

name: AUSTRALIS OIL & GAS LTD
businessSummary: Australis Oil & Gas Limited is an Australia-based oil and gas company. The Company's principal activity is oil and gas exploration, development, and production. Its segment includes Oil & Gas Production and Other. The Company's Oil & Gas Production segment is engaged in the development and production of oil and gas assets in the United States (USA). The Company operates one area of interest onshore being leases, wells and facilities in the Tuscaloosa Marine Shale (TMS) in the states of Louisiana and Mississippi in the USA. It holds approximately 47,400 net acres within the production delineated core of the oil producing TMS. The Company is engaged in operating approximately 30 producing wells and 18 non-operated wells all within the TMS. Its subsidiaries include Australis Services Inc, Australis TMS Inc, Australis USA 1 Pty Limited, and Australis Europe Pty Limited.

name: AUSTRALIAN AGRICULTURAL COMPANY LTD
businessSummary: Australian Agricultural Company Limited is an Australia-based integrated cattle and beef producer. The Company’s principal activities include distribution of branded beef into global markets; production of beef including breeding, backgrounding and feedlotting, and ownership, operation, and development of pastoral properties. It owns and operates properties, feedlots and farms comprising approximately 6.5 million hectares of land in Queensland and the Northern Territory. It manages a cattle herd of over 456,000 head across properties, feedlots and farms throughout Queensland and the Northern Territory. Its Livingstone Beef processing facility is situated in Livingstone Valley, over 50 kilometers south of Darwin in the Northern Territory. Its brands include Westholme and Darling Downs. Its subsidiaries include A. A. Company Pty Ltd, Austcattle Holdings Pty Ltd, A. A. & P. Joint Holdings Pty Ltd, Shillong Pty Ltd, James McLeish Estates Pty Limited, and others.

name: 3P LEARNING LTD
businessSummary: 3P Learning Limited is an Australia-based company, which operates within the education technology sector. It is engaged in the development, sales and marketing of educational software and ebooks to schools and to parents of school-aged students, delivered via a software-as-a-service subscription model. Its segments include Business-to-School (B2B) and Business-to-Consumer (B2C). Its solutions include Mathletics, Reading Eggs, Mathseeds, Writing Legends, LiteracyPlanet and Brightpath Progress. Mathletics is a mathematics program that provides instant access to thousands of digital and physical activities for practice, fluency and critical thinking in one place. Mathseeds develop early numeracy skills with captivating activities covering number sense, addition, subtraction and multiplication. Reading Eggs makes learning essential reading and phonics skills easy and fun. The program uses a sequence of online reading lessons, activities and books that keep students engaged and on tasks.

name: BOSS ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Boss Energy Limited is an Australia-based uranium company focused on the Honeymoon Uranium Project in South Australia. The Honeymoon Uranium Project is located in South Australia, 80 kilometer (km) northwest of the town of Broken Hill. Its Project consists of two main exploration areas (the Eastern and Western tenement regions) with one granted Mining Lease 6109 (ML6109), totaling a 2,595 square kilometer (km2) tenement package, which covers approximately 980 km2 of pastoral leases. The project also consists of five Exploration Leases (EL) covering prospects at Honeymoon and Gould's Dam, 70 km northwest of Honeymoon. It operates through two segments: Australian uranium operations and Alta Mesa operations. It also operates 30%-owned Alta Mesa Project in South Texas is a high-grade uranium In-Situ Recovery (ISR) project in South Texas, a prolific United States district for sandstone-hosted ISR production, having produced approximately 80 million pounds (Mlb) historically.

name: COLES GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Coles Group Limited is an Australia-based company that is engaged in the retail industry. The Company operates through two Supermarkets and Liquor. The Supermarkets segment includes fresh food, groceries, and general merchandise retailing, which includes Coles Online and Coles Financial Services. The Liquor segment includes liquor retailing, including online service. The Company’s businesses include Coles Supermarkets, Coles Online, Coles Liquor, flybuys, and Coles Financial Services. Coles Supermarkets is a national full-service supermarket retailer operating more than 851 supermarkets. Coles Liquor business includes three trading banners: Liquorland, First Choice Liquor Market and Vintage Cellars. Coles Online provides its customers with a choice of home delivery, including same-day and overnight drop and go services, or pick up from click and collect locations. Coles Liquor offers a range of wines, spirits, beers, and Ready-to-Drink products.

name: AJ LUCAS GROUP LTD
businessSummary: AJ Lucas Group Limited is a provider of drilling services primarily to the coal industry in Australia, and an operator, through its United Kingdom subsidiary Cuadrilla Resources Holdings Limited, of exploration and appraisal of conventional and unconventional oil and gas prospects in the United Kingdom. The Company's segments include Australian Operations and UK Oil & Gas. The Australian Operations segment encompasses the Australian Drilling business and the Company's head office and corporate costs. The Australian Drilling business provides integrated professional drilling services, predominantly for exploration and degasification of coal mines, but may also include the recovery and commercialization of coal seam gas, and associated services. The UK Oil & Gas segment is engaged in the exploration and development of unconventional and conventional hydrocarbons in the United Kingdom. Its license holdings include Bowland, Elswick, Balcombe, Weald, and Weaverthorpe.

name: L1 GROUP LTD
businessSummary: L1 Group Ltd, formerly Platinum Asset Management Limited, is an Australia-based global independent investment manager. The Company is a provider of listed equities and alternative investment strategies. It seeks to deliver this through breed investment strategies and remaining fully aligned with its clients.

name: 29METALS LTD
businessSummary: 29Metals Limited is a copper-focused base and precious metals mining company with producing and exploration assets in Australia and Chile. The principal activities of the Company are mining and mineral production, mineral concentrate sales, mineral exploration and development, and ancillary services. Its Golden Grove mine is a volcanic-hosted massive sulfide (VHMS) geological system. Its exploration activities include the Redhill exploration project located in Chile. The Redhill comprises historic mine site with significant known high grade copper, gold and silver mineralization and is a regional tenement position in Chile. The Company holds 100% of the Redhill exploration project. Its Cutters Cove project at Redhill includes the mineralized veins of Cristina, Gorda, Angelica, Cutters, and Franceses, and the Ingleses target area, as well as a regional tenement package within the surrounding province.

name: WESTSTAR INDUSTRIAL LTD
businessSummary: WestStar Industrial Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the provision of an industrial services company providing engineering, construction and mining services to the resources, energy and infrastructure sectors. Its segments include SIMPEC Pty Ltd and Alltype Engineering Pty Ltd. SIMPEC Pty Ltd is a construction contractor with specialist experience in both Structural Mechanical and Piping and Electrical and Instrumentation works. Alltype Engineering Pty Ltd provides workshop, site installation, construction and maintenance services to the oil and gas, water, power generation, infrastructure, mining, resources, utility, petrochemical and defense industries. Its services include multidiscipline construction contracting, structural mechanical piping (SMP), electrical and instrumentation, fabrication of pipe, plate and structural steel, rotating equipment installation, fluid systems solutions, equipment and services, and asset management services.

name: INCANNEX HEALTHCARE INC
businessSummary: Incannex Healthcare Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company. The Company is engaged in developing combination medicines that target the underlying biological pathways associated with chronic conditions, including obstructive sleep apnoea, rheumatoid arthritis, and generalized anxiety disorder. Its lead clinical program, IHL-42X, is an oral fixed-dose combination of dronabinol and acetazolamide designed to target underlying mechanisms and act synergistically in the treatment of obstructive sleep apnoea. IHL-42X has completed a Phase II clinical trial. PSX-001 is a synthetic psilocybin treatment for the treatment of generalized anxiety disorder. PSX-001 has completed a Phase II clinical trial. IHL-675A is an oral fixed-dose combination of cannabidiol and hydroxychloroquine sulfate designed to act synergistically to alleviate inflammatory conditions, such as rheumatoid arthritis. IHL-675A is in a Phase II clinical development program.

name: NUCOAL RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: NuCoal Resources Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is developing unrealized coal and mineral assets. The Company operates in the coal industry in New South Wales, Australia. The Company has an exploration license located in Bayswater Power Station through its subsidiary Dellworth Pty Ltd. The Company holds exploration license EL 6812 (Savoy Hill tenement) adjacent to mining operations owned and operated by Glencore, Coal & Allied and Anglo Coal. Its EL 6812, Savoy Hill, is located approximately 30 kilometers to the north-west of Singleton, close to the Great Northern Railway line, in the upper Hunter Valley of New South Wales. The mining operations near Savoy Hill include Drayton Mine, Drayton South Project, Hunter Valley Operations and Mount Arthur, which are located to the north, west, south east and north-west of the study area, respectively. The Company's subsidiaries include Doyles Creek Mining Pty Limited, NuCoal Share Plan 1 Pty Ltd and Dellworth Pty Ltd.

name: CARNARVON ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Carnarvon Energy Limited is an Australia-based independent oil and gas explorer. The Company’s principal activities are oil and gas exploration, development and production. The Company secured its interests in the Bedout Sub-Basin permits, WA-435-P, WA-436-P, WA-437-P and WA-438-P. The offshore permits cover an area of 21,652 square kilometers (km2), which is located approximately 110 kilometers (km) from the coast, offshore of Port Hedland in Western Australia. The Pavo North oil discovery was made with the Pavo-1 well intersecting reservoirs and confirming net oil pay across a zone of 46 meters. Pavo lies in offshore permit WA-438-P, where Carnarvon holds a 20% interest. The Company’s core exploration portfolio offshore Western Australia contains more than 100 prospects, providing plenty of running room in the emerging Bedout sub-basin. It holds a 10% interest in WA-435-p and WA-437-P.

name: LENDLEASE GROUP
businessSummary: LendLease Group is an integrated real estate business, with an international investment management capability. The Company's Investments segment includes owning and/or managing investments in Australia, Singapore, United Kingdom, Italy, the United States, Malaysia, and Japan. The segment includes an investment management platform and its ownership interests in residential, office, retail, industrial, and infrastructure investment assets. Its Development segment represents development projects in Australia only. Its products and services include the development of inner city mixed use developments, apartments, retail, commercial assets and social and economic infrastructure. Its Construction segment represents the Construction business in Australia only. Its products and services include the provision of project management, design, and construction services. Its Capital Release Unit segment includes overseas construction operations, overseas development projects, and others.

name: BENDIGO AND ADELAIDE BANK LTD
businessSummary: Bendigo and Adelaide Bank Limited is an Australia-based banking and financial services company. It is engaged in the provision of a range of banking and other financial services, including consumer, residential, business, rural and commercial lending, deposit taking, payments services, wealth management, margin lending, treasury and foreign exchange services. Its Consumer division focuses on engaging with and servicing its consumer customers and includes the branch network, Up digital bank, mobile relationship managers, third party banking channels, wealth services, cards and payments, home safe and customer support functions. Its Business and Agribusiness segments focus on servicing business customers and includes Business Banking, Portfolio Funding, and Agribusiness, which includes all banking services provided to its agribusiness and farming customers. Corporate includes the results of its support functions including treasury, technology, property services, finance, risk and others.

name: CITY CHIC COLLECTIVE LTD
businessSummary: City Chic Collective Limited is a global omnichannel retailer specializing in dressing plus-size women’s apparel, footwear and accessories. Its omnichannel model comprises a network of approximately 76 stores across Australia and New Zealand (ANZ) and Websites operating in ANZ, the United States of America, and third-party marketplaces and wholesale partners in Australia, New Zealand, United States of America, and Canada. Its brand, City Chic clothing and lingerie, is centered on beautiful design and its experience in the plus-size fashion industry. City Chic plus-size fashion includes plus-size dresses, plus-size denim, plus-size lingerie, plus-size tops, and plus-size clothing. City Chic brands shoe categories include boots, heels, flats, and wedges. Its geographical segments include ANZ and the Americas.

name: ADVANCE ZINCTEK LTD
businessSummary: Advance ZincTek Limited is an Australia-based company, which manufactures aluminum oxide powder (Alusion), zinc oxide dispersions and zinc oxide powder (ZinClear) for the Personal Care Sector. The Company’s Personal Care segment produces and distributes dispersions of mineral-only ultraviolet (UV) filters in cosmetic emollients used for sunscreen, skincare and pharmaceutical formulations, as well as alumina plate-like powders used for cosmetic applications. It supplies cosmetic and pharmaceutical grade zinc oxide powder used in sunscreens and personal care products. Its products offer vegan natural zinc oxide powders, bulk sunscreens and dispersions. The Company’s Dispersions include ZinClear IM 50 CCT, ZinClear XP60 CCT, ZinClear XP65-70 CCT, ZinClear XP65-70 CCT + LCT, ZinClear XP35 CCT + SGa, ZinClear XP47 CCT + TES, ZinClear XP52 CCT + SGlu, ZinClear XP60 CCT + LCT, and others. Its subsidiaries include Antaria Pty Ltd, Sunscreen Safety Testing Laboratory Pty Ltd and others.

name: JCURVE SOLUTIONS LTD
businessSummary: Jcurve Solutions Limited is an Australia-based business transformation technology company. The Company is engaged in the sale, implementation and support of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) solutions, which consist of the exclusively licensed small business edition of Oracle NetSuite, JCurve ERP (in Australia and New Zealand), and the Oracle NetSuite mid-market and enterprise editions. Its segments include ANZ ERP, Asia ERP, TEMS and Quicta. ANZ ERP segment includes ERP cloud-based Business Management solutions and associated consulting services that are sold to Australian and New Zealand customers. Asia ERP segment includes ERP cloud-based Business Management solutions and associated consulting services, which are sold to Southeast Asian customers. TEMS segment develops and markets Telecommunications Expense Management Solutions (JTEL, Full Circle and Phoneware) that are sold to Australian customers. Quicta segment develops and sells service management and scheduling software.

name: AMOTIV LTD
businessSummary: Amotiv Limited owns a portfolio of companies specializing in providing automotive products and solutions that meet the needs of its customers worldwide. The Company’s divisions include 4WD Accessories and Trailering; Lighting, Power and Electrical; and Powertrain and Undercar. Its 4WD Accessories and Trailering division encompasses various brands, including AutoPacific Group (APG), Hayman Reese, CruiseMaster, ECB, Rola, Parkside, Trojan, Trail Boss, Kaymar, TriMotive, BestBars, Fully Equipped, Crown Canopy, X-Bar, and Christine Products. Its Lighting, Power and Electrical division is engaged in delivering advanced lighting, power, and electrical solutions. The division includes various brands, including Brown & Watson International (BWI), Projecta, Big Red Gear, Twisted Throttle, and Caravan Electrical Solutions. Its Powertrain and Undercar division encompasses various brands, including Ryco Filters, AA Gaskets, Infinitev, and Australian Clutch Services (ACS).

name: ENDEAVOUR GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Endeavour Group Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the retail drinks and hotels business. The Company’s segments include Retail, Hotels, and Other. The Retail segment is engaged in procurement and manufacturing of drinks for sale to customers in Australia. Its Hotels segment is engaged in provision of hotels-related goods and services, including food and drinks, accommodation, entertainment, and gaming in Australia. Its Other segment consists of various Company support functions, including corporate costs. Its brands include ALH, BWS, Dan Murphy's, endeavourX, Jimmy Brings, LANGTONS, MixIn, Paragon Wine Estates, and Pinnacle Drinks. It operates over 1,726 stores under the Dan Murphy’s and BWS brands, as well as Pinnacle Drinks, which creates and manages the Company’s portfolio of exclusive brands. It operates over 354 hotels, including food and drinks, accommodation, entertainment and gaming operations.

name: LIFESTYLE COMMUNITIES LTD
businessSummary: Lifestyle Communities Limited is an Australia-based company, which develops, owns and manages affordable independent living residential land-lease communities. It monitors all settings, including local house prices, national economic indicators, demographics, design trends, environmental advances and customer expectations. The Company’s land lease model allows working, semi-retired, and retired people to downsize their family home to free up equity in retirement, whilst enjoying resort-style living including pools, gyms, clubhouse, cinema, lawn bowls, tennis, and others. It has over 29 residential land lease communities under contract, in planning, in development, or under management. Its communities include Bayside and Peninsula communities, Bellarine communities, South-East communities, North Victoria communities, and West Victoria communities. Its subsidiaries include Lifestyle Investments 1 Pty Ltd, Lifestyle Developments 1 Pty Ltd, Lifestyle Management 1 Pty Ltd, among others.

name: IDT AUSTRALIA LTD
businessSummary: IDT Australia Limited is a pharmaceutical manufacturing company. The Company is engaged in the supply of products and provision of research and development and other technical services within the pharmaceutical and allied industries. Its business includes research and development, active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) and finished dosage form manufacture (FDF), clinical and commercial, project management, chemical services, analytical chemistry, pharmacy services, pharmaceutical development in all dosage forms, clinical packaging and regulatory affairs services. Its Current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) manufacturing facilities produces both API and FDF across the medicinal cannabis manufacturing space. It also provides a full-scale service for new drug development and scale-up, commercial active drug manufacture as well as a variety of oral and injectable finished drug dose forms. Its analytical laboratories offer medicinal cannabis cGMP testing.

name: CHALLENGER LTD
businessSummary: Challenger Limited is an Australia-based investment management company. The Company operates through two segments: Life and Funds Management. The Life segment principally includes the annuity and life insurance business carried out by Challenger Life Company (CLC). CLC offers fixed-rate and other retirement and superannuation products that are designed for Australian investors who are seeking a low-risk, fixed-term, or lifetime investment and reliable income. CLC also offers fixed-term and lifetime investments to investors in Japan through its reinsurance arrangement with Mitsui Sumitomo Primary Life Insurance Company Limited (MS Primary). CLC invests in assets that provide long-term income streams for customers. Its Funds Management segment is engaged in providing an end-to-end fund management business. The Funds Management segment also offers a range of managed investments across fixed income and property.

name: CLOVER CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Clover Corporation Limited focused on technology, new product development, and commercialization. The principal activities of the Company are the refining and sale of natural oils, the production of encapsulated powders and the research and product development of functional food and infant nutrition ingredients. Its microencapsulation technology enables nutritional oils, such as tuna, fish, algal and fungal oils, to be added to infant formulas, foods, and beverages. Its technologies protect those sensitive oils from oxidation, allowing them to be incorporated into a range of applications. The Company, through its subsidiary, Nu-Mega Ingredients Pty Limited (Nu-Mega), supplies refined Omega-3 oils and a range of other encapsulated ingredients for use in infant formula, nutraceuticals, pharmaceuticals, and sports nutrition markets. Nu-Mega’s Driphorm range of microencapsulated powders enables the addition of Hi-DHA tuna and/or algal oils to a broad spectrum of products.

name: GREATLAND RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Greatland Resources Limited is an Australia-based gold and copper producer. The Company operates two segments: Telfer-Havieron and Exploration. Telfer-Havieron is engaged in the mining and processing of gold and copper, mine development. Exploration is engaged in exploration and evaluation of gold and copper mineralization. Telfer gold mine is an operating gold-copper mine located in the Paterson Province of the East Pilbara region in Western Australia, approximately 1,300 kilometers (km) northeast of Perth and 485 km east-southeast of Port Hedland. Telfer gold mine is engaged in mining from the West Dome Open Pit and Main Dome underground using contractors Macmahon for surface mining and Byrnecut for underground mining. The Havieron gold-copper project is a brownfield, underground gold-copper deposit located in the Paterson province in the East Pilbara region of Western Australia, approximately 45km east of the Telfer gold-copper mine.

name: INFOTRUST LTD
businessSummary: Infotrust Ltd, formerly Spirit Technology Solutions Limited, is an Australia-based technology and cyber security services provider. The Company helps organizations to stay secure, compliant and connected through integrated cyber security, secure managed technology, and cloud communication services. The Company delivers end-to-end cyber security, managed IT, and advisory services for public and private sectors. Its Australia-based security operations center operates 24/7, ensuring real-time threat detection and rapid response. Its services include offensive, defensive, compliance, managed security operations center (SOC), secure modern workplace, network security, managed IT support, and business automation & Internet-of-Things (IoT). Its solutions include secure email ecosystem, secure endpoint, secure cloud access and secure network. Its offensive services include Penetration Testing and SMB1001. Its defensive services include continuous threat exposure management and data security.

name: SRG GLOBAL LTD
businessSummary: SRG Global Limited is an Australia-based diversified infrastructure services company. The Company’s segment includes Maintenance and Industrial Services, and Engineering and Construction. The Maintenance and Industrial Services segment provides integrated asset program management, asset monitoring, inspection and testing, asset maintenance and remediation, specialist drill and blast and geotech, engineered products and access services that sustain and extend critical industries and infrastructure. These span multiple sectors, including oil and gas, energy, major infrastructure, offshore, mining, power generation, water treatment plants, commissioning, decommissioning, shutdowns, specialist testing, inspection, monitoring, and civil works. The Engineering and Construction segment provides specialist engineering and construction of critical infrastructure across a diverse range of sectors, including water, transport, defense, resources, energy, health and education.

name: CATALYST METALS LTD
businessSummary: Catalyst Metals Limited is an Australia-based gold producer with landholdings in two Australian gold belts. The Plutonic Gold Mine is located approximately 300 kilometers (Km) northeast of Meekatharra in the mid-west region of Western Australia. The Project sits on over 45 granted mining leases of approximately 40 km in length along the Plutonic-Marymia Gold Belt, which extends from the Plutonic Gold Mine in the southwest to the Trident deposit in the northeast. The Four Eagles Gold Project is situated along the Whitelaw Gold Corridor, 70 kilometers north of the historic Bendigo Goldfield. It has interests in over 13 exploration licenses and two retention licenses along the Whitelaw and Tandarra Faults north of Bendigo and in other areas north of the Fosterville and Inglewood gold fields. It has also signed binding documentation to acquire the Old Highway Gold Deposit, located 40km south of Plutonic along the Great Northern Highway.

name: REGIONAL EXPRESS HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Regional Express Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in the provision of air services, including the transportation of passengers and freight, along with pilot training. The Company's segments include regular public transport, charter and other, and training. The Company has a regional and domestic airline, Rex, operating a fleet of approximately 57 Saab 340 and nine Boeing 737-800 NG aircraft to 56 destinations throughout all states in Australia. In addition to the airline Rex, the Company comprises wholly owned subsidiaries, including two pilot academies, Australian Airline Pilot Academy with campuses in Wagga Wagga and Ballarat, and a propeller maintenance organization, Australian Aerospace Propeller Maintenance.

name: ENVIRONMENTAL GROUP LTD
businessSummary: The Environmental Group Limited is engaged in the design, application and servicing of gas vapor and dust emission control systems, inlet and exhaust systems for gas turbines, engineering services, developing water treatment and service install provider for heat transfer plant and equipment primarily related to boilers, including 24/7 customer service for mechanical, electrical and automation support to a variety of industries. Its five business units include EGL Clean Air-Total Air Pollution Control and Airtight Solutions; Baltec IES; EGL Clean Energy-Tomlinson Energy Service and Ignite Services; EGL Water, and EGL Waste Services. Its Baltec IES produces inlet and exhaust systems for gas turbines, which are used to complement and augment solar and wind energy production. The EGL Water division continues to develop its patented technologies in conjunction with Victoria University. EGL Waste Services provides the sales and services platform for the Turmec Agency agreement in Australia.

name: ORIGIN ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Origin Energy Limited is an Australia-based integrated energy company. The principal activity of the Company is the operation of energy businesses, including exploration and production of natural gas, electricity generation, wholesale and retail sale of electricity and gas, and sale of liquefied natural gas. The Company’s segments include Energy Markets, Share of Octopus Energy, Integrated Gas, and Corporate. The Energy Markets segment is engaged in energy retailing and wholesaling, power generation, and liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) operations predominantly in Australia. The Share of Octopus Energy segment includes the Company's investment in Octopus Energy Group Limited. The Integrated Gas segment is focused on the investment in Australia Pacific Liquified Natural Gas (APLNG) and also includes commodity hedging and trading. The Corporate segment provides various business development and support activities.

name: WINCHESTER ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Winchester Energy Limited is an Australia-based oil and gas exploration and production company with operations in West Texas, USA. It controls over 2,600 acres in the Permian Basin, producing predominantly from the Strawn Formation but also from the Ellenburger and Cisco Formations. It operates 26 wells and has interests in another 10 non-operating wells. Its projects include Nolan County and Jocelyn - Varn. The East Permian Basin contains a number of stacked oil and gas reservoirs and its leased acreage in Nolan County has significant oil resource potential across a host of historically productive formations, such as the Fry/Strawn Sands as well as the thick Penn Carbonate, Wolfcamp 'D' organic shales, Crystal Falls (Canyon), and Cisco formations. The Company has a 70% working interest in the Jocelyn - Varn waterflood project in Taylor County, Texas. The project is located 18 miles to the east of its Nolan County acreage.

name: IDP EDUCATION LTD
businessSummary: IDP Education Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in international education services. The Company specializes in matching universities, colleges, and schools with the right students worldwide. Its segments include Asia, Australasia, and Rest of World. The principal activities of each segment are provision of student placement services, International English Language Testing (IELTS) and English language teaching services. It offers placement of international students into education institutions in Australia, the United Kingdom, the United States, Canada, New Zealand, and Ireland. The placement services include counselling, application processing and pre-departure guidance. It is engaged in the distribution and administration of IELTS tests. It is also a co-owner of IELTS with the British Council and Cambridge Assessment. It is also engaged in the operation of English language schools in Taiwan, Vietnam and Cambodia and the operation of digital marketing and event services.

name: ATLAS ARTERIA GROUP
businessSummary: Atlas Arteria Group is an Australia-based global owner, operator, and developer of toll roads. The Company has a portfolio of five toll roads in France, Germany, and the United States. The Company owns a 31.14% interest in the Autoroutes Paris-Rhin-Rhone (APRR) toll road group in France. In addition to the APRR business is the smaller Autoroute des deux lacs (ADELAC) business, which connects to APRR in southeast France. Together APRR and ADELAC comprise approximately 2,424 kilometers of motorway network located in the East and Southeast of France. In the United States, it owns a 66.67% interest in the Chicago Skyway, a 12.5 kilometers toll road in Chicago and has 100% of the economic interest in the Dulles Greenway, a 22 kilometers toll road in the Commonwealth of Virginia. In Germany, it owns 100% of the Warnow Tunnel in the northeast city of Rostock.

name: MYSTATE LTD
businessSummary: MyState Limited provides banking, trustee, equipment finance and managed fund products and services through its subsidiaries MyState Bank Limited (MyState Bank), Auswide Bank Ltd (comprising Auswide Bank and Selfco) and TPT Wealth Limited (TPT Wealth). Its segments include MyState Bank, Auswide Bank (including Selfco), and Wealth Management. MyState Bank’s product offerings include lending, encompassing home loans, personal, overdraft, line of credit and commercial products, transactional savings accounts and fixed-term deposits and insurance products. Auswide Bank’s (including Selfco) product offerings include lending, encompassing home loans, personal, overdraft, line of credit and commercial products, transactional savings accounts, fixed-term deposits, insurance products, leasing and commercial hire purchases. The Wealth Management division is a provider of funds management and trustee services. It operates predominantly within Tasmania.

name: SIREN GOLD LTD
businessSummary: Siren Gold Limited is an Australia-based gold and antimony exploration company with three key projects in the upper South Island of New Zealand: Sams Creek gold project in Upper Takaka, Langdons antimony-gold project near Reefton and the Queen Charlotte antimony-gold project. The Company has seen high-grade gold and stibnite mineralization throughout tenements due to its position on the Lachlan Fold Belt. The Reefton Project is a significant gold exploration and mining venture in the South Island of New Zealand. The Langdons project prospecting permit (PP 60893) is located in the Paparoa goldfield, approximately 50 kilometers (km) SW of Reefton. The Queen Charlotte gold-antimony mineralization that contains the historic Endeavour antimony mine is 120kms to the east of Sams Creek. The Sams Creek Gold Project is located 140kms NE of Reefton and 100kms NE of Lyell. The mineralization is contained within a hydrothermally altered peralkaline granite porphyry dyke.

name: ELDERS LTD
businessSummary: Elders Limited is an Australia-based agribusiness company. The Company's business includes rural services, real estate, insurance and others. Its segments include Branch Network, Wholesale Products, Feed and Processing Services and Corporate Services and Other Costs. The Branch Network segment includes the provision of a range of products and services through a common distribution channel, including agricultural retail products, agency services, real estate services and financial services. The Wholesale Products segment includes the Australian Independent Rural Retailers (AIRR) business based in Shepparton, Victoria, supported by a network of eight warehouses to supply independent retail stores throughout Australia. The Feed and Processing Services segment includes Killara feedlot, a diversified business incorporating grain-fed beef distribution, grass-fattening operations, cow manure processing and irrigated feed crop production in Quirindi, New South Wales.

name: CLOSE THE LOOP LTD
businessSummary: Close the Loop Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in creating products and packaging that include recyclable and made-from recycled content. The Company collects, sorts, reclaims and reuses resources that would otherwise go to landfills. The Company is primarily involved in collection and recycling of electronic equipment, imaging consumables, plastics, paper and cartons and any other activity incidental thereto as well as providing premium and innovative flexible and carton packaging, flexographic print packaging, seafood packaging, storage solutions and the supply of thermal paper and associated paper products. Its products include RFlex and TonerPlas. It offers end-to-end solutions across packaging and consumables to a variety of markets, with advanced innovation in product development, as well as end-of-life take-back and recovery systems for complex commodities to reduce waste to landfills. It also offers battery collection and recycling services.

name: SANTOS LTD
businessSummary: Santos Limited is focused on three regional business unit, including Cooper Basin, Queensland and New South Wales (NSW) and (PNG), now form the Eastern Australia and PNG Business Unit, Northern Australia and Timor-Leste, and Western Australia now form the Western Australia, Northern Australia and Timor-Leste Business Unit and Alaska is the third regional Business Unit. Supporting these three business units are two functional divisions: Santos Energy Solutions and Upstream Gas and Liquids. The Cooper Basin produces natural gas, gas liquids and crude oil. Gas is sold primarily to domestic retailers, industry and for the production of liquefied natural gas, while gas liquids and crude oil are sold in domestic and export markets. Its GLNG project in Queensland produces liquefied natural gas (LNG) for export to global markets from the LNG plant at Gladstone and is also sold to the domestic market. Northern Australia and Timor-Leste is centered on the Bayu-Undan/Darwin LNG (DLNG) project.

name: BELLEVUE GOLD LTD
businessSummary: Bellevue Gold Limited is engaged in the exploration and evaluation of minerals and mining and processing of gold at its Bellevue Gold Project in Australia. The Bellevue Gold Project is located in the northern part of the Norseman Wiluna Greenstone belt in the Yilgarn Craton, Western Australia. The project is approximately 40 kilometers (km) north (by sealed highway) from the regional center of Leinster and covers approximately 1,930 square kilometers (km2) of mining and exploration licenses. The project represents one of Australia's highest-grade gold mines, with a Mineral Resource of approximately 3.1 million ounces (Moz) at 9.9 grams per ton (g/t) global grade resource.

name: CREDIT CLEAR LTD
businessSummary: Credit Clear Limited is a technology company. It has developed a digital billing and communication platform that helps organizations drive smarter, faster, and more efficient financial outcomes by changing the way customers manage their re-payments through a user experience that the market demands in a digital age. It manages customer accounts across a range of industries, including transport, financial services, government, and utilities. Its segments include Receivable Collections and Legal Services. Receivable Collections segment represents the provision of receivable collection services using a combination of technology solutions and traditional collection methods. Legal Services offers specialized credit legal services, which when combined with the Receivables Collections business, allows the Company to offer a full-service end to end offering for its clients. Its RepayTech technology allows customers to make re-payments through a variety of channels and with re-payment option.

name: VIVA ENERGY GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Viva Energy Group Limited is an Australia-based convenience retailer, commercial services and energy infrastructure company. The Company’s segments include Convenience & Mobility (C&M), Commercial & Industrial (C&I) and Energy & Infrastructure (E&I). The Company operates a retail convenience and fuel network of approximately 900 stores across Australia and supplies fuels and lubricants to a total network of over 1,500 service stations. It owns and operates the Geelong Refinery located in Victoria, and operates bulk fuels, aviation, bitumen, marine, chemicals, polymers and lubricants businesses supported by more than 20 terminals and 79 airports and airfields across the country. The Company, through OTR Group, operates a fuel and convenience network of approximately 200 stores and 107 quick service restaurants, including Hungry Jacks, Guzman Y Gomez, Subway, Oporto, Wok in a Box, and Krispy Kreme SA. It operates in Australia, Singapore and Papua New Guinea.

name: PRO-PAC PACKAGING LTD
businessSummary: Pro-Pac Packaging Limited is an Australia-based flexibles and industrial specialty packaging company with a diversified distribution and manufacturing network throughout Australia and New Zealand. The Company's segments include Flexibles and Specialty packaging. The Flexibles packaging segment primarily manufactures flexible packaging materials incorporating products such as stretch and shrink wrap, agricultural silage packaging, fresh produce bags, barrier and lidding films and industrial protective films. The Specialty packaging segment sources and distributes packaging materials and related consumer products. The Company delivers bespoke packaging solutions for a broad group of blue-chip and small and medium enterprise clients in the industrial, food and beverage, health, agriculture and manufacturing sectors. Its industrial and protective packaging products include hand stretch film, machine stretch wrap, shrink films, packaging tape, masking tape and steel strapping.

name: ORA BANDA MINING LTD
businessSummary: Ora Banda Mining Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in mining operations and the sale of gold, mine development and exploration in Western Australia. The Company is the 100% owner of the Davyhurst Gold Project, which is located approximately 120 kilometers (kms) north-west of Kalgoorlie, within the Tier one gold mining province of the Eastern Goldfields. The Davyhurst Gold Project includes approximately 67 granted tenements that cover an area of 1,135 square kilometers (km2). The Company's projects include Central Davyhurst, Riverina-Mulline, Siberia, Callion and Walhalla. Its Central Davyhurst project area is located within a five kms radius of the Davyhurst Processing Plant. The Company's Riverina Underground gold deposits are hosted within three separate shear/mylonite zones, namely Reggie’s, Murchison, and Main Lode, all trending approximately north-south. The Company's Sand King (Siberia) is an underground mine at the Davyhurst Gold Project.

name: AUSSIE BROADBAND LTD
businessSummary: Aussie Broadband Limited is an Australia-based operating as a national carrier of telecommunications and technology services in Australia, servicing residential, business, wholesale and enterprise and government customers. The Company provides a suite of data, voice, and managed solutions. The Company’s segments include Residential, Business, Wholesale, Enterprise and Government, and Symbio. The Residential segment provides telecommunications services to residential users. The Business segment provides telecommunications services to business users. The Wholesale segment provides telecommunication services to third-party resellers. The Enterprise and Government segment provides telecommunication services to large enterprises including those in the public sector. The Symbio segment provides telecommunication services to software companies, telecom providers and enterprise customers.

name: SELECT HARVESTS LTD
businessSummary: Select Harvests Limited is an Australia-based vertically integrated almond food company. The Company manufactures, processes and markets almond products for the Australian retail and industrial markets, in addition to exporting almonds globally. It is engaged in growing, processing, packaging and sale of almonds and its by-products from Company-owned and leased almond orchards. It supplies a full range of value-added almond products (blanched, roasted, sliced, diced, meal and paste) in multiple customer categories, including beverage, bakery, confectionery, cereal, snacking, health, dairy (ice cream), re-packers and wholesalers. It supplies both branded and private label products to key retailers, distributors and industrial users. Its brands are Renshaw and Allinga Farms. Its geographically diverse almond orchards are located in Victoria, South Australia and New South Wales. Its portfolio includes over 9,262 hectares of Company-owned, leased and joint venture almond orchards.

name: RAIDEN RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Raiden Resources Limited is a lithium-based metal gold exploration company. The Company is focused on the Andover North-South, Mt Sholl, and Arrow lithium projects. Its Mt Sholl Lithium project is located approximately 22 kilometers (km) southeast of Karratha in the Pilbara region of Western Australia. The property comprises two exploration licenses covering an area of 9.6 square kilometers (km2). It also has a portfolio of gold projects in Western Australia, including the Arrow project, which is located approximately 110 km southwest of Port Hedland in the Pilbara region of Western Australia. Its other projects include Boodaylerrie, Yandicoogina, Tolisnica-Stanca, Donje Nevlje, Pirot, Zupa, Majdanpek West, Vuzel, Zlatusha, Kalabak, BG1 and others. The Boodalyerrie is located 78 kilometers northeast of Nullagine and 113 kilometers southeast of Marble Bar in the Pilbara region of Western Australia. The Boodalyerrie exploration license (E45/3586), which covers an area of 50 km2.

name: STONEHORSE ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Stonehorse Energy Limited is an Australia-based exploration and production (E&P) company. The Company focused on onshore oil and gas in Canada and the United States. The Company holds working interests in a number of producing oil and gas assets located in Texas and Oklahoma in the USA and Alberta in Canada. It also holds a 25% working interest in the Myall Creek property located in the Surat Basin, Queensland. The Company’s Jewell well in Oklahoma, USA is delivering seasoned production of approximately 2,869 BOE per month. The Well Names include Burgess, Sutton, Bullard, Henry Federal, Randolph, Jewell, Newberry, Mitchell, Thelma, Caroline, and Wapiti.

name: FITELL CORP CLASS A
businessSummary: Fitell Corporation, through GD Wellness Pty Ltd, its wholly owned subsidiary, is an online retailer of gym and fitness equipment both under its brands and other brand names in Australia. The Company’s brand portfolio is categorized into three brands under its Gym Direct brand: Muscle Motion, Rapid Motion, and FleetX, in over 2,000 stock-keeping units (SKUs). The Company’s products and services include fitness equipment and licensing business. It markets and sells fitness equipment and related products as well as a shop for business setup from personal training studios to commercial gyms. Its fitness equipment products are sold directly to customers through online or offline platforms. Its licensing business offers turnkey solution for personal training studios and commercial gym chains. Its artificial intelligence (AI)-powered interactive platform, 1FinalRound, provides online training content along with various other services.

name: ADR ON IMMURON LTD
businessSummary: Immuron Limited is an Australia-based biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing orally delivered targeted polyclonal antibodies for the treatment of infectious diseases. It operates through two segments: Research and development (R&D), and Hyperimmune products. The R&D segment is focused on R&D projects performed in Australia and the United States. Hyperimmune products segment is engaged in Travelan and Protectyn activities which occur predominantly in Australia, the United States and Canada. Its flagship products consist of Travelan and Protectyn. Travelan is an orally administered passive immunotherapy that prophylactically reduces the likelihood of contracting traveler’s diarrhea and is sold in pharmacies throughout Australia. Protectyn is sold online and in health practitioner clinics and is marketed as an immune supplement to help maintain a healthy digestive function and liver. Its clinical programs include Travelan (IMM-124E), and IMM-529.

name: BIRDDOG TECHNOLOGY LTD
businessSummary: BirdDog Technology Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the development and manufacturing of hardware and software video technology solutions industry. The principal activities of the Company consist of development and manufacturing of global video technology that enhances the quality, speed and flexibility of video through a range of solutions, augmented with network device interface (NDI). These solutions are then sold through a network of distributors and resellers and direct, to individuals and organizations within professional video, corporate audio-visual (AV) and digital signage markets who demand broadcast quality video content. The Company’s product portfolio includes converters, camera lines, AV section, software, and accessories. The Company’s NDI Bridge transports complete NDI streams over local area network (LAN), wide area network (WAN) or public Internet. Its NDI Audio Direct makes audio-over-IP available for software-based audio applications.

name: GENETIC SIGNATURES LTD
businessSummary: Genetic Signatures Limited is an Australia-based specialist molecular diagnostics (MDx) company. The Company's principal activities include research and commercialization of identifying individual genetic signatures to identify diseases and the sale of associated products into the diagnostic and research marketplaces. The Company is focused on the development and commercialization of its platform technology, 3base. Its MDx 3base platform technology provides high-volume hospitals and pathology laboratories with the ability to screen for an array of infectious pathogens, with a high degree of specificity, in a rapid throughput (time-to-result) environment. It designs and manufactures a suite of real-time Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) based products for the routine detection of infectious diseases under the EasyScreen brand. Its products include EasyScreen Pan-Enteric Detection Kit, EasyScreen STI Genital Pathogen Detection, EasyScreen Viral Meningitis Detection Kit, and others.

name: AUMEGA METALS LTD
businessSummary: AuMEGA Metals Limited is an Australia-based gold exploration company. The Company is focused on exploring its two properties, Cape Ray Shear Zone and Hermitage. It is focused on exploration to explore on its district scale land package that spans over 110 kilometers (Km) along the Cape Ray Shear Zone. This zone hosts EquinoxGold's Valentine Gold Project, a gold deposit with significant mineral resources. The Hermitage Project is highly prospective for gold exploration following a review of targets in Newfoundland that have exploration potential. The Blue Cove Copper Project is in southeastern Newfoundland, over 175 km to the east of its Hermitage Project and 260 km by road west of St. John’s. The Blue Cove option agreement covers over 78 non-contiguous claims covering 19.5 square kilometers (km2). In addition to the option agreement, it has staked 113 mineral claims covering an additional 28.25 km2 adjacent to the Blue Cove mineral claims.

name: STREAMPLAY STUDIO LTD
businessSummary: Streamplay Studio Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in the development and operation of online eSport gaming platforms. The Company’s activities include development, publishing, and distribution of interactive digital entertainment across both Tier one gaming storefronts and telco value-added services. The Company is also a provider of competitive gaming and cloud streaming technologies. Its platforms support telco-integrated services such as mGames in the Pacific Islands, PlayStream in the UAE and MTN Arena and Arena Plus in South Africa. It owns North America based Noodlecake Studios, a game developer and publisher. Its broader operations include development and publishing, esports, streaming, and telco-aligned gaming services across North America, Australia, the Middle East, Africa, and the Pacific Islands.

name: AUSTIN METALS LTD
businessSummary: Austin Metals Limited is an Australia-based base and precious metals explorer focused on the prolific mining districts of Broken Hill, the Cobar Basin and the Lachlan Fold Belt of New South Wales, Australia. Its flagship Austin Gold Project is located in the highly prospective Murchison greenstone province of Western Australia, directly adjacent to the Cue Gold Project owned by Musgrave Minerals Limited, which includes the high-grade Break of Day Deposit and Starlight discovery. The Company has also secured a significant ground holding of the Tallering Greenstone belt in the prolific Murchison gold mining region of Western Australia located approximately 150 kilometers (km) south of the Golden Grove deposit. Its Ashburton Project comprises around eight granted exploration tenements and one granted prospecting license covering 510 square kilometers (km2) and is located on Ashburton Downs Station, approximately 75 km SW of Paraburdoo in the Pilbara Region of Western Australia.

name: MEEKA METALS LTD
businessSummary: Meeka Metals Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in mineral exploration and resource project development in Western Australia. The Company is focused on the exploration and evaluation of its mineral assets at the Murchison Gold Project and Circle Valley Project. Its flagship Murchison Gold Project hosts a 1.2-million-ounce (Moz) mineral resource. The Murchison Gold Project covers the northern extent of the highly prospective Mount Magnet and Youanmi Shear Zones in the prolific Murchison Gold Fields of Western Australia. In addition, the Company owns the Circle Valley Project, which is located 85 km south of Norseman in Western Australia. The project tenure covers the southwestern Albany-Fraser Mobile Belt.

name: IRIS METALS LTD
businessSummary: IRIS Metals Limited is an Australia-based exploration company. The Company has a suite of assets which are highly prospective for hard rock lithium located in South Dakota, United States. Its segments include Australia and the USA. The Australia segment focused on mining exploration and evaluation in Australia and the USA segment focuses on mining exploration and evaluation in the United States. Its projects include The Beecher Project, Tin Mountain and Leonora Project, Dewy mine, Helen Beryl mine and Edison mine. The Beecher Project is located seven km from the township of Custer in the Black Hills of South Dakota. The project spans approximately 50.88 hectares of private patented claims and surrounding federal claims. The Beecher Project includes the Longview, Beecher and Black Diamond mines. The Tin Mountain Mine includes crystals of lithium spodumene visible in the underground drives. The Edison Mine focuses on lithium spodumene, beryllium, feldspar, mica, and tantalum.

name: GLOBAL LITHIUM RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Global Lithium Resources Limited is a diversified West Australian focused mining exploration company. The Company has multiple assets in key lithium branded jurisdictions with a primary focus on the 100%-owned Manna Lithium Project in the Goldfields and the Marble Bar Lithium Project (MBLP) in the Pilbara region, Western Australia. The Manna Lithium Project is an outcropping pegmatite exploration project located approximately 100 kilometers (km) east of Kalgoorlie in the Goldfields region of Western Australia. The tenements in Manna Lithium Project include E28/2551, E28/2522, M28/414, E28/3357, E28/3359,and others. The MBLP is located approximately 150 km south-east of Port Hedland and over 15 km north-east of Marble Bar in the Pilbara region of Western Australia. The tenements in MBLP include E45/4309, E45/4328, E45/4361, E45/4724, E45/4669, E45/5812, E45/5843, E45/5871, E56/5873, and E45/5869.

name: TEMPEST MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Tempest Minerals Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company with a diversified portfolio of projects in Western Australia prospective for precious, base and energy metals. The Company’s projects include Yalgoo, Mount Magnet, Five Wheels and Elephant Project. Its flagship project is its holding in the Yalgoo region of Western Australia totaling over 1,000 square kilometers (km2). The Remorse Deposit sits on the eastern side of the Yalgoo Project, near a number of historical gold, iron and base metal occurrences. The Sanity Target sits in the eastern portion of the Yalgoo project area. Mount Magnet project is a prolific multi-million-ounce gold mining center with numerous large-scale, long-life open pit and underground mines. The Five Wheels project is over 266 km2 of granted tenure in the Earaheedy region of Western Australia proximal to the high-profile Rumble Resources Ltd discoveries. The Elephant project comprises over 194 km2 of highly prospective exploration leases.

name: LARK DISTILLING CO LTD
businessSummary: Lark Distilling Co. Ltd is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the production, marketing, selling and distribution of Australian craft spirits. The Company has three segments: whisky, gin, and other. It offers various Whisky products, such as Dark Lark Single Malt Whisky, Classic Cask, Boilermaker House Whisky Bar Limited Release, and Para 1992 Cask Finish with 100ml Tawny Liqueur, among others. It offers a range of Gin products, which include Forty Spotted Citrus & Pepperberry + Pinot Noir Gin, Forty Spotted Classic Gin & Raspberry + Rose, Forty Spotted Classic, Forty Spotted Tassie Bush Honey, Forty Spotted Wild Rose, Forty Spotted Citrus & Pepperberry, Forty Spotted Raspberry & Rose, and Forty Spotted Pinot Noir. It operates in Tasmania and Australia. It markets its products via traditional off-premise retailers and on-premises bars, and via its direct-to-consumer business, which is hospitality and online e-commerce. Its primary focus is Whisky and the Lark brand.

name: LCL RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: LCL Resources Limited is an Australia-based exploration and mining company. The Company is a gold/copper/nickel explorer with multiple assets in Papua New Guinea (PNG) and the mid-Cauca Gold Belt of Colombia. The Company’s segments include Mineral Exploration Colombia and Mineral Exploration Papua New Guinea. It holds approximately 3890 square kilometers (Km2) of exploration titles in five regions of Papua New Guinea prospective for copper, gold, and nickel. The Company also holds position within the Quinchia region of the Mid-Cauca Gold Belt of Colombia. The Company is actively exploring in PNG while the 100% owned, 10,500 hectares (ha) Quinchia Gold Project in Colombia progresses through early-stage feasibility related studies. Its Quinchia Gold Project is located in central west Colombia, 100 kilometers (km) south of Medellin, in the department of Risaralda. Its Ono project consists of Kusi Target, which is prospective for high-grade gold skarn and copper/gold porphyry.

name: MANDRAKE RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Mandrake Resources Limited is an Australia-based explorer focused on advancing its lithium project in the Paradox Basin in south-eastern Utah, United States. The Company’s segments include Utah Lithium Project, Jimperding Ni-Cu-PGE Project and Berinka Pine Creek Gold Project. The Utah Lithium Project is located in the Paradox Basin in south-eastern Utah and covers approximately 93,755 acres. The Utah Lithium Project also incorporates the Lisbon Valley uranium mining district. The Jimperding Project lies approximately 30 kilometers (km) east of Chalice Gold Mines Limited’s (Chalice) Julimar Ni-Cu-PGE discovery in the Jimperding Metamorphic Belt located 70 km northeast of Perth. Berinka Pine Creek Gold Project covers an approximately 289km2 exploration license in the under-explored western limb of the Pine Creek Orogen, Northern Territory, 180 km south of Darwin.

name: NORWEST MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Norwest Minerals Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company is focused on exploration of highly prospective assets, including rare earth elements (REE), copper, gold and base metals. Its projects include Bulgera, Marymia East, Bali, Arunta West and Marriott. The Bulgera Gold Project is located approximately 200 kilometers (km) north of Meekatharra in the seven million ounces (moz) gold Plutonic Well greenstone belt. The Bali Copper Project is located 75 km west of Paraburdoo in Western Australia. The Bali Project includes an eight km long shear being a faulted zone proven to host copper, lead, zinc and silver mineralization. The Arunta West Rare Earth project is located in Western Australia, over 600 km west of Alice Springs. The tenements cover a ground holding of 1600 square kilometers (km2) along the Arunta belt. The Marriott Project is located 70 km southeast of the nickel mining and processing center of Leinster, and 80 km from Leonora.

name: INVICTUS ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Invictus Energy Limited is an Australia-based independent upstream oil and gas company. The Company is focused on energy resources in sub-Saharan Africa. Its asset portfolio consists of 360,000 hectares within the Cabora Bassa Basin in Zimbabwe, SG 4571 and EPOs 1848/49 contain the Mukuyu and multiple Basin Margin prospects. The Cabora Bassa Basin project is located in northern Zimbabwe near the border of Mozambique. The Mukuyu Gas Field has multiple hydrocarbon-bearing reservoirs containing gas in the Upper and Lower Angwa Formations. The Mukuyu structure has an areal closure of more than 200 square kilometers (km2) and vertical relief of approximately 1,400 meters. Basin Margin Play has a total of eight targets: Kigelia, Baobab, Munondo, Acacia, Marula, Mukamba, Mimosa and Mukwa, identified stretching east-west through the southern reaches of the EPO 1848 licence area. Its subsidiaries include HIS Texas LLC, Invictus Energy Resources Pty Limited, Geo Associates (Pvt) Ltd, and others.

name: TRITON MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Triton Minerals Limited is an Australia-based mining exploration and development company. The Company is focused on graphite projects. It holds a 100% economic interest in Grafex Limitada (Grafex). Its flagship Ancuabe Project is located adjacent to the producing AMG Graphit Kropfmuhl (GK) graphite mine. The project is approximately 80 kilometers (km) by sealed road from an operating container port in Pemba. Grafex comprises over four exploration licenses, EL5305, EL5380, EL5365 and EL5304. The Company has also granted a mining concession for the Cobra Plains Graphite Project located in northern Mozambique, within Neoproterozoic rocks of the Xixano Complex. The Company holds a 100% beneficial interest in Cobra Plains miming concession (MC11548 C). The Company holds a 100% economic interest in the Ancuabe Project mining concession (MC913 2C). Its Aucu Project is located in the resource-rich Tete region of Mozambique.

name: SUNSTONE METALS LTD
businessSummary: Sunstone Metals Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company with gold and copper assets in Ecuador. The Company’s assets are the Bramaderos Gold-Copper Project and El Palmar Copper-Gold Project. The Bramaderos Gold-Copper Project is located in Loja province, 130 kilometers (km) from the provincial capital city Loja and west of Catacocha. The Bramaderos property covers approximately 4,959 hectares (ha). The sealed Pan American Highway, which crosses the western part of the concession. The concession is approximately 900 meters above sea level. The El Palmar Copper-Gold Project is located in northern Ecuador, 60 km north-west of Ecuador’s capital Quito. The El Palmar Copper-Gold Project is located in a highly prospective mineralised district related to the Toachi Faults Zone.

name: SHEFFIELD RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Sheffield Resources Ltd is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in mineral sands evaluation and development in Australia and mineral sands evaluation in Brazil. The Company’s operating segments include South Atlantic project, Thunderbird project, and Other. The South Atlantic project consists of mineral sands tenements located in Southeast Brazil. The Thunderbird project consists of mineral sands tenements located in the Canning Basin that form part of the Thunderbird mineral sand mining operation held by Thunderbird Operations Pty Ltd, a subsidiary of Kimberley Mineral Sands Pty Ltd (KMS). The South Atlantic Project is located within the Rio Grande do Sul Coastal Plain, a region located in the southernmost state of Brazil, Rio Grande do Sul, along the coast of the Atlantic Ocean. The Thunderbird Mineral Sand Project lies 70 kilometers (km) west of Derby and 30 km north of the sealed Great Northern Highway (GNH) joining Derby and Broome.

name: ORTHOCELL LTD
businessSummary: Orthocell Limited is an Australia-based regenerative medicine company. The Company is focused on regenerating mobility for patients by developing products for the repair of a variety of bone and soft tissue injuries. Its portfolio of products includes Striate+, Remplir, and OrthoACI. Striate+ is an acellular resorbable collagen membrane used for guided bone and tissue regeneration in dental applications. Remplir is a collagen-based nerve wrap designed to support nerve repair surgery in peripheral nerve repair. OrthoACI, or Autologous Chondrocyte Implantation, offers treatment for symptomatic defects of the articulating cartilage of the joints. OrthoACI uses the patient’s own healthy cartilage cells called chondrocytes to assist the regeneration of damaged cartilage. The Company is engaged in the development of its tendon cell therapy in the United States. Its autologous tendon therapy is an advanced injectable cellular therapy for the treatment of chronic tendon injuries.

name: MINBOS RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Minbos Resources Limited is an Australia-based exploration and development company. The Company is engaged in the nutrient supply and distribution business. The Company is focused on the development of a primary phosphate and nitrogen-based fertilizer business that stimulates agricultural production and promotes food security in Angola and the broader Congo Basin.
