It is primarily focused on the development of the Cabinda Phosphate Project and the Capanda Green Ammonia Project. Its phosphate fertilizer brand is Prosper Primeiro. The Capanda Green Ammonia Project produces nitrogen for the Primeiro+ products. It also provides education to commercial and family farmers through extension services.

name: LEGEND MINING LTD
businessSummary: Legend Mining Limited is an Australia-based exploration company. The Company is engaged in the exploration of nickel and copper deposits in Australia. The Company’s exploration focus is on its nickel-copper Rockford Project in the Fraser Range, Western Australia. The Rockford Project is located within the highly prospective Fraser Range district of Western Australia, with tenure covering a total area of approximately 2,532 square kilometers (km2). The Company's exploration is primarily focused on magmatic nickel-copper-cobalt (Nova-Bollinger/Voisey’s Bay style), along with volcanogenic massive sulfide (VMS) style zinc-copper-silver and Tropicana style structurally controlled gold mineralization. The Rockford Project comprises over 11 granted exploration licenses. The Rockford Project’s tenements include E28/1716, E28/1717, E28/1727, E28/2188, E28/2189, E28/2190 and others. The Company's wholly owned subsidiary is Legend Cameroon Pty Ltd.

name: FOCUS MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Focus Minerals Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in gold exploration and production in Western Australia. The Company's Coolgardie Gold Project (Coolgardie) covers approximately 116.6 square kilometers (km2) of highly prospective tenements on the outskirts of the Coolgardie township in the Goldfields region. The Company is also engaged in the development of the Bonnie Vale Underground Mine.

name: FREEHILL MINING LTD
businessSummary: Freehill Mining Limited is a mining and exploration company. It is focused on the development of its 100%-owned, 478-hectare Yerbas Buenas magnetite and associated materials project in Chile. It also holds copper and gold exploration projects in Chile and is assessing other related investment opportunities. The Company, through its Chilean companies Yerbas Buenas SpA and San Patricio Mineria SpA, hold several concessions in an area just north of the city of Coquimbo-La Serena, Chile. These concessions are all located in one area in Region IV of Chile on the coast about 500 kilometers north of the capital Santiago. The concessions comprise a large JORC magnetite resource within the Yerbas Buenas and Arenas concession blocks and a magnetite-copper-gold exploration area on the northern boundary of Yerbas Buenas with eight blocks collectively known as the El Dorado project. The El Dorado project is located in the El Tofo fault and within the Atacama IOCG belt (Iron Oxide Copper Gold).

name: ENERGY METALS LTD
businessSummary: Energy Metals Limited is an Australia-based uranium exploration company. The Company has eight exploration projects located in the Northern Territory (NT) and Western Australia covering around 2,400 square kilometers (km2). Its projects include Bigrlyi, Ngalia Regional, Macallan, Anketell, Mopoke Well, Lakeside, Manyingee, and Lake Mason. The Bigrlyi deposit is a sandstone hosted uranium-vanadium deposit located on the northern margin of the Ngalia Basin, approximately 350 km northwest of Alice Springs. The Ngalia Regional Project is located in the Ngalia Basin, between 180 and 350 km northwest of Alice Springs in the Northern Territory. The Macallan project comprises a single exploration licence application (ELA27333), located 460 km northwest of Alice Springs and 140 km from Bigrlyi. The Anketell project is located 100 km east of Mt. Magnet and comprises retention licence R58/2. The Manyingee project (E08/1480 and R08/3) is located 85 km south of the port of Onslow.

name: DIGITALX LTD
businessSummary: DigitalX Limited is an Australia-based digital investment manager and crypto fund manager. The Company’s segments include Product Development, Asset Management (AM) and Other. Its Sell My Shares (SMS) provides share brokerage services via its Sell My Shares platform. The Asset Management division offers high net worth and institutional investors access to a portfolio of digital assets. It operates two funds focused on digital assets: the DigitalX BTC Fund and the DigitalX spot Bitcoin ETF. Its other segments include governance, finance, legal, risk management, company secretarial and management of corporate entities. Its subsidiaries include DigitalX Bitcoin Fund, DigitalX Asset Management Pty Ltd and Sell My Shares Pty Ltd.

name: CORAZON MINING LTD
businessSummary: Corazon Mining Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration and development company. The Company’s focus is on nickel, gold, copper and cobalt. The Company's primary focus is the exploration and advancement of its West Australian gold portfolio, located in the highly prospective Gascoyne Region. This portfolio consists of two key projects: Feather Cap Gold Project and Two Pools Gold Project. Its other projects include Mt Gilmore Copper-Gold-Cobalt Project and Lynn Lake Nickel-Copper-Cobalt-Project (Lynn Lake). The Two Pools Gold Project is located within the proven Plutonic-Marymia Greenstone Belt. The Feather Cap gold Project is a potential asset located within the Bryah-Padbury Basin, part of the Capricorn Orogen in Western Australia. The Project is situated in a proven mineral province that hosts significant gold and base metal deposits. The Lynn Lake Project in Manitoba, Canada, is a significant Class-1 nickel resource.

name: CADENCE CAPITAL LTD
businessSummary: Cadence Capital Limited is an Australia-based investment company. The Company is engaged in investing primarily in securities listed both in Australia and internationally. The Company may take short positions and may also deal in derivatives. The Company has only one segment. It operates predominately in Australia and in one industry being the securities industry. It invests in various sectors, including basic materials, energy, communications, financial, insurance, industrial, utilities, technology, and consumer, non-cyclical. The Company is managed by Cadence Asset Management Pty Limited.

name: BOA RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: BOA Resources Limited, formerly Boadicea Resources Ltd, is an Australia-based exploration company with tenements in exploration located in the Fraser Range, Paterson Province, Eastern Goldfields of Western Australia. The Company is focused on its key lithium and nickel assets in Western Australia. In the Fraser Range, the Company holds 11 exploration licenses north and south of IGO’s Nova Ni-Co-Cu mine covering an area of approximately 919 square kilometers (km2). Its Fraser Range licenses include Symons Hill, Transline, White Knight, Giles, Fraser South, Southern Hills and South Plumridge. In Paterson Province, the Company’s Koongulla Project consists of three grant tenements, which cover a total area of approximately 670.7km2. The tenements are Koongulla EL45/5392, Koongulla East EL45/5866 and Koongulla South EL45/5959. It holds various tenements in the Eastern Goldfields region, such as Bald Hill East, Kookaburra Well, Ant Hill, Two Tanks and Cat Camp.

name: AUSTRALIAN MINES LTD
businessSummary: Australian Mines Limited is an Australia-based producer and supplier of technology metal materials to the electric vehicle and energy storage industries. The principal activity of the Company is exploration and evaluation of mineral projects prospective for critical and battery metals, including rare earth elements, lithium, niobium, cobalt, nickel, and scandium. Exploration was advanced across the Company’s portfolio in Australia and Brazil. The Company’s 100%-owned Sconi Battery Minerals Project is located in North Queensland, Australia and approximately 220 kilometers (km) northwest of Townsville, focusing on delivering nickel and cobalt. It has two other early stage, green metals, exploration, and development projects, including the Flemington Project (cobalt-scandium-nickel-copper-gold) in New South Wales and the Lennard Project (nickel sulfide) in Western Australia. It also operates Jequie Rare Earth Project (Bahia State) and the Resende Lithium Project (Minas Gerais State).

name: ANDROMEDA METALS LTD
businessSummary: Andromeda Metals Limited is an Australia-based industrial minerals company. The Company is engaged in the sustainable supply of industrial minerals and the advancement of nanotechnologies. The Company's Great White Project (GWP) contains several deposits containing a naturally occurring blend of halloysite tubes and kaolinite plates. The Great White Project is located within the District Council of Streaky Bay, near the community of Poochera on the Eyre Peninsula in South Australia. Its Mount Hope Kaolin Project is located 80 kilometers (km) northwest of Port Lincoln on the Eyre Peninsula in South Australia. The Company’s Eyre Kaolin Project is composed of four exploration tenements totaling 2,799 square kilometers on the Western Eyre Peninsula, South Australia. It is also advancing a High Purity Alumina (HPA) Project in South Australia, leveraging its proprietary low-carbon processing technology and using premium refined Great White kaolin product as a feedstock.

name: 88 ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: 88 Energy Limited is an Australia-based oil and gas exploration and production company with a North American focus. The Company’s segments include Alaska Exploration, Namibia Exploration, and Other. The Project Phoenix is located on the Dalton Highway with the Trans-Alaskan Pipeline System (TAPS) bisecting the acreage. Its Project Leonis is located adjacent to TAPS and the Dalton Highway. It has 45% non-operated working interest (WI) in the onshore Petroleum Exploration License (PEL 93). This license covers 18,500 square kilometers of underexplored acreage within the Owambo Basin in Namibia.

name: GALILEO MINING LTD
businessSummary: Galileo Mining Ltd is an Australia-based exploration company. The Company is focused on the exploration and development of palladium, nickel, copper, and cobalt resources in Western Australia. It has two prospective West Australian resource and exploration projects: the Norseman Project and the Fraser Range Project. The Norseman Project contains the Callisto Discovery and adjacent regional prospects Jimberlana and Mission Sill with potential for palladium, platinum, nickel, copper, cobalt, and rhodium mineralization. The Company’s tenure at Norseman project comprises exploration and prospecting licenses covering a total area of over 278 square kilometers (km2). The Fraser Range project covers exploration licenses totaling 602 square kilometers in the Albany-Fraser Orogen. The Fraser Range Project with exploration tenements prospective for nickel-copper-cobalt deposits. The Fraser Range tenure is located across two areas: the North Fraser Range and the South Fraser Range projects.

name: ARTICORE GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Articore Group Limited is an Australia-based company, which owns and operates the global online marketplaces, Redbubble.com, TeePublic.com and Dashery.com. These marketplaces facilitate artists’ design and sale of a range of products printed with the creators’ artwork to their customers worldwide. The products are produced and shipped by third party service providers, such as product manufacturers, printers and shipping companies referred to as fulfillers. The Company sells uncommon designs, everyday products, such as apparel, stationery, housewares, bags, and wall arts. Its segments include Redbubble and TeePublic. Redbubble and TeePublic segments are online marketplaces for print on demand products. The Redbubble product range includes clothing, stickers, phone cases, wall art, home & living, kids and babies, accessories, stationery and office, and gifts. Republic is a marketplace for independent creators to sell the merchandise bearing their art.

name: AUSTRAL RESOURCES AUSTRALIA LTD
businessSummary: Austral Resources Australia Ltd is an Australia-based copper cathode producer, developer and explorer located in the Mt Isa District of northwest Queensland. The Company’s projects include Anthill Project, Lady Annie Project, Cameron River Project, and Miranda Project. The Anthill Project area lies within the Lady Annie Project, and it is located 45 kilometers (km) from the Mt Kelly processing facility. The Lady Annie Project tenements are in the Western Fold Belt of the Mount Isa Inlier. The Cameron River Project tenements lie within the Eastern Fold Belt of the Mount Isa Inlier with the northern most tenement close to the boundary with the Central Kalkadoon-Leichardt Belt. The tenements are prospective for copper, gold and rare earths. The Miranda Project tenements lie predominantly within the Central Kalkadoon-Leichardt Belt of the Mount Isa Inlier. The Company has entered into an agreement to acquire the Rocklands Copper Mine located in North-West Queensland.

name: HARRIS TECHNOLOGY GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Harris Technology Group Limited is an Australia-based online retailing company. The Company is focused on providing information technology/consumer electronics (IT/CE) products for small and medium businesses in Australia. The Company’s main business is the eCommerce business of Harris Technology (HT). The Company’s business is conducted online both on www.ht.com.au and through the online platforms, such as Amazon, Kogan, Catch and eBay.

name: GROWTHPOINT PROPERTIES AUSTRALIA LTD
businessSummary: Growthpoint Properties Australia Limited is an Australia-based real estate investment trust (REIT). The Company invests in industrial and office properties across Australia. The Company operates through three segments: Industrial property investments, Office property investments and Funds management. The Company directly owns a portfolio of high-quality, modern office and industrial properties, and manages a portfolio of office, industrial, and retail assets for third-party wholesale syndicates and institutional investors through its fund management business. Its total property portfolio by value consists of approximately 27 high-quality office properties with a total lettable area of 347,763 square meters (sqm). Its industrial portfolio comprises 23 modern industrial properties. Its office properties include Building 3, 570 Swan Street, 2-6 Bowes Street, 100 Skyring Terrace, 1 Charles Street, 75 Dorcas Street, 109 Burwood Road, Building 2, 572-576 Swan Street, and others.

name: BOWEN COKING COAL LTD
businessSummary: Bowen Coking Coal Limited is an Australia-based coking coal company. The Company is engaged in the development, production and sale of coal in Queensland, Australia, with a primary focus on metallurgical coal. The Company’s flagship Burton Mine Complex near Moranbah encompasses multiple operations with the Ellensfield South Mine and the Plumtree North development serving a centralized Coal Handling and Preparation Plant (CHPP) and train load out facility connected by a haul road. In addition, the Company owns the Bluff PCI Mine near Blackwater (in care and maintenance) and holds the Isaac River (100%), Hillalong (80%) Cooroorah (100%), Carborough (100%) and Comet Ridge (100%) coking coal development projects and is a joint venture partner in Lilyvale (15%) and Mackenzie (5%) with Stanmore Resources Limited. Its subsidiaries include Bowen PCI Pty Ltd, Coking Coal One Pty Ltd, New Lenton Coal Pty Ltd, and Lenton Management and Marketing Pty Ltd.

name: MMG LTD
businessSummary: MMG Limited is an Australia-based mining company. The principal activities of the Company include exploration, development and mining of copper, zinc, cobalt, gold, silver, molybdenum and lead deposits around the world. Its segments include Las Bambas, Kinsevere, Khoemacau, Dugald River, Rosebery, and Other. Las Bambas is an open-pit, scalable, long-life copper and molybdenum mining operation, which is located in the Cotabambas, Apurimac region of Peru. Kinsevere is an open-pit copper mining operation located in the Haut-Katanga Province of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The Dugald River mine is an underground zinc mining operation located near Cloncurry in Northwest Queensland. Rosebery is an underground polymetallic base metal mining operation located on Tasmania’s west coast. Khoemacau mine is an underground copper and silver mining operation located in north-west of Botswana, in the Kalahari Copperbelt with mining rights covering an area of over 4,040 square kilometers.

name: STRUCTURAL MONITORING SYSTEMS PLC CPI
businessSummary: Structural Monitoring Systems Plc is an Australia-based company engaged in the design and manufacture of electronic products and the provision of manufacturing services to the aviation industry. The Company, through its wholly owned subsidiary, Anodyne Electronics Manufacturing Corp. (AEM), operates three business segments: Avionics, Contract Manufacturing and CVM. The Avionics segment provides customer-driven solutions designed to meet the requirements of the special mission aviation industry. The Contract manufacturing segment provides contract electronics manufacturing to a select group of aerospace customers. The CVM segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sales, and support of the Comparative Vacuum Monitoring (CVM) sensor technology and equipment for meeting crack detection and inspection requirements for certain metal structures of commercial airframes. The Company has operations in North America, Europe/ United Kingdom and others.

name: COCHLEAR LTD
businessSummary: Cochlear Limited provides implantable hearing solutions and a range of implants and sound processor upgrades. Its segments include Cochlear Implants, Services, and Acoustics. The Cochlear Implants segment offers Cochlear implant systems. The Services segment offers sound processor upgrades, accessories and other. The Acoustics segment offers bone conduction systems and sound processor upgrades. Its products and services portfolio includes Cochlear implant portfolio, Acoustic solutions portfolio, Recipient support tools, and Cochlear Connected Care solutions. Its Cochlear Connected Care solutions include Cochlear Nucleus SmartNav System, Cochlear Custom Sound Pro Fitting Software, Cochlear Link, Cochlear Remote Assist, and Cochlear Remote Check. Its Cochlear implant portfolio includes Cochlear Nucleus System. Acoustic solutions portfolio includes Cochlear Osia System, and Cochlear Baha System. Its Recipient support tools include Cochlear Nucleus, and Baha and Osia Smart Apps.

name: MITHRIL SILVER AND GOLD LTD
businessSummary: Mithril Silver and Gold Ltd is a precious metals exploration company. The Company is focused on developing its flagship Copalquin Project. The Copalquin mining district Project is located in Durango State, Mexico and covers an entire mining district of 70 square kilometers (km2) containing several dozen historic gold and silver mines. Its Copalquin Mining District, covered by approximately five contiguous mining concessions, is a large epithermal gold-silver system, located in Mexico’s Sierra Madre Gold-Silver Trend. It also holds free carried interest in the Limestone Well vanadium tenements located in Western Australia.

name: TRUE NORTH COPPER LTD
businessSummary: True North Copper Limited is an Australia-based copper-focused exploration company. The Company’s projects include Cloncurry Project, Mt Oxide Project, and Bundarra Project. The Cloncurry Project is centered around the Great Australia Mine Complex located at Cloncurry in north-west Queensland. The Cloncurry Project’s mineral resources contain 101.25 kt copper, 76.62 koz gold, and 1.86 kt Cobalt. The Mt Oxide Project has established infrastructure, including an exploration camp and proximity to a processing plant and power grid. The Mt Oxide Project offers development and exploration potential. The Mt Oxide Project holds substantial resources, including 220 kt Copper, 5.13 Moz silver, and 21.2 kt cobalt. Its Bundarra Project is strategically situated approximately 130 kilometers (km) southwest of Mackay and 50 km east of Moranbah in the central Queensland coal fields.

name: RENASCOR RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Renascor Resources Limited is an Australia-based company, which is focused on the development of economically viable mineral deposits, including its Siviour BAM project in South Australia. The Company holds interests in various tenements, such as Carnding, Marree, Dutton Bay, Malbrom, Lipson Cove, Verran, Malbrom West, Cleve, Hincks, Outalpa, Cutana, Old Wartaka, Witchelina, Flat Hill, Malbooma Railway, Carnding, Iron Baron and Gregory Creek. The Siviour BAM Project comprises the Siviour Graphite Deposit, located near Arno Bay on the Eyre Peninsula in South Australia. Siviour BAM Project has a battery anode material production facility, located in Bolivar, where Siviour graphite concentrate is converted into purified spherical graphite (PSG). The Carnding Project contains several near-surface, high-grade gold prospects in South Australia's Central Gawler Craton. The Marree Project is a copper-prospective ground position within South Australia's Adelaide Fold Belt.

name: RICHMOND VANADIUM TECHNOLOGY LTD
businessSummary: Richmond Vanadium Technology Limited is an Australia-based minerals exploration company. The principal activity of the Company includes mineral exploration and development with a particular focus on vanadium resources. The Company is focused on its 100% owned Richmond-Julia Creek Vanadium Project in north Queensland. The Richmond-Julia Creek Vanadium Project is a non-titanomagnetite vanadium deposit. The Richmond-Julia Creek Vanadium Project is located in the mining friendly jurisdiction of north Queensland approximately 500 kilometers (km) west of Townsville and 400 km east of Mt Isa on the main east-west Flinders Highway and close to existing infrastructure including a gas pipeline, proposed Copper String 2.0 HV network line and Great Northern rail line linked to Townsville Port. The project consists of five tenements (EPMs 25163, 25164, 25258, 26425, 26426) totaling over 1,403 square kilometers and comprises three main prospects - Lilyvale, Manfred and Rothbury.

name: TABCORP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Tabcorp Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the provision of gambling, entertainment and integrity services. Its segments include Wagering and Media and Integrity Services. The Wagering and Media segment is engaged in the provision of totalizator and fixed odds betting and retail wagering networks, and the global racing media business. Its portfolio of operations includes TAB, Sky Racing, Sky Racing World (SRW) and Premier Gateway International (PGI). TAB is an omnichannel provider of wagering experiences. PGI operates an international wagering and tote pooling hub licensed and operating out of the Isle of Man. SRW manages the international marketing and distribution of international racing content. The Integrity Services segment is focused on gaming machine monitoring operations in New South Wales, Queensland, Tasmania and the Northern Territory and venue services. It operates the MAX business such as MAX Regulatory Services (MRS) and others.

name: HUMM GROUP LTD
businessSummary: humm Group Limited is an Australia-based diversified financial services company that provides instalment plans which enable businesses and consumers to make large purchases. The Company operates in Australia, New Zealand, Ireland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Its principal activities include the provision of Commercial Lending in Australia and New Zealand; Point of Sale Payment Plans (PosPP); Australia Cards (humm 90, and Lombard); and New Zealand Cards (including Farmers Finance Card, Farmers Mastercard, Q Card, Q Mastercard and Flight Centre Mastercard). The Company operates through four segments: Commercial and Leasing, New Zealand Cards, Australia Cards, and PosPP. Its Commercial segment consists of Australia and New Zealand Commercial Lending. Its Australia Cards segment includes humm90, and Legacy Lombard. Its PosPP segment includes a consolidation of humm Australia, humm Canada, humm Ireland and humm UK.

name: WINSOME RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Winsome Resources Limited is an Australia-based lithium focused exploration and development company with four project areas in Quebec, Canada. Its 100% owned projects include Cancet Lithium Project, Adina Lithium Project, Sirmac-Clappier Project, and Tilly Project. Its advanced projects - Cancet and Adina, provide shallow, high-grade lithium deposits. The Cancet Lithium Project comprises a substantial landholding of over 200 square kilometers (km2). The Sirmac-Clapier Project is located 30 kilometers (km) from the provincial road infrastructure between the regional centers of Chibougamau and Chapais. The Tilly Projects is 100% owned hard rock lithium project that covers 47 km2. It also owns 100% of the offtake rights for lithium, cesium and tantalum from Power Metals Corp's Case Lake Project in Eastern Ontari and also owns around a 19.6% interest in Power Metals Corp. The Company has an option over the 29 claims of the Jackpot Property, immediately north of Adina.

name: NICKEL INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: Nickel Industries Limited is a nickel pig iron (NPI) producer, which is a key input in the production of stainless steel. It is engaged in the production of nickel matte. The Company owns a portfolio of mining and low-cost downstream nickel processing assets in Indonesia. It holds interest in high pressure acid leach (HPAL) projects, producing mixed hydroxide precipitate (MHP) for use in the electric vehicle (EV) supply chain. Its segments include Nickel ore mining in Indonesia, Ranger Nickel rotary kiln electric furnace (RKEF) project in Indonesia and Singapore and the HPAL projects in Indonesia. Its principal operations, located in Indonesia, are the Hengjaya Nickel, Oracle Nickel and RKEF projects located within the Indonesia Morowali Industrial Park (IMIP), the Angel Nickel RKEF Project within the Indonesia Weda Bay Industrial Park (IWIP) and the Hengjaya Mine, a large tonnage, high grade nickel laterite deposit in close proximity to the IMIP.

name: PIVOTAL METALS LTD
businessSummary: Pivotal Metals Limited is an Australia-based company, which is an explorer and developer of mineral deposits. The principal activity of the Company is exploration for and development of copper, nickel, and platinum group metals (PGM) deposits. The Company holds the flagship Horden Lake property, which contains a joint ore reserves committee (JORC) compliant Indicated and Inferred Mineral Resource Estimate of over 27.8Mt at 1.49% copper equivalent (CuEq), comprising copper, nickel, palladium, and gold. The property is located approximately 140km north of Matagami in northwest Quebec. Horden Lake is complemented by a battery metals exploration portfolio in Canada located within the Belleterre-Angliers Greenstone Belt (BAGB) comprised of the Midrim, Laforce, Alotta and Lorraine high-grade nickel copper PGM sulfide projects in Quebec. The BAGB Project covers approximately 157 square kilometers (km2) landholding in the prospective BAGB.

name: AUSTAL LTD
businessSummary: Austal Limited is an Australia-based global shipbuilder and defense prime contractor designing, constructing and sustaining advanced commercial and defense vessels. The principal activities of the Company include the design, manufacture and support of high-performance vessels for commercial and defense customers. The Company operates through four segments: USA Shipbuilding, USA Support, Australasia Shipbuilding and Australasia Support. The USA Shipbuilding segment includes the USA manufactures high-performance defense vessels primarily for the US Navy and Coast Guard. The USA Support segment provides ongoing support and maintenance of Austal and non-Austal vessels to the US Navy, principally in the United States (USA) and other international jurisdictions. The Australasia Shipbuilding segment comprises Australia, Philippines and Vietnam shipbuilding operations. The Australasia Support segment comprises Australia and Trinidad and Tobago operations.

name: PEEL MINING LTD
businessSummary: Peel Mining Limited is an Australia-based base and precious metals exploration company with a primary focus on copper. The Company is focused on exploration and development of its projects in the Cobar Region of New South Wales, Australia. The Company's projects include the Mallee Bull Project, Wirlong Project, May Day Project and Southern Nights / Wagga Tank. The Mallee Bull Copper Project is located approximately 100 kilometers (km) south of Cobar in western New South Wales (NSW) and is situated on a 20,000-acre pastoral lease owned by Peel Mining. The Wirlong Project is located over 75 km south of Cobar and 30 km southwest of Nymagee, NSW. The May Day Pit is located approximately 105km south-southeast of Cobar in western NSW. The Southern Nights / Wagga Tank project can be divided into two prospects: Wagga Tank to the North and Southern Nights over one km to the South. They are located over 130 km south of Cobar and 30 km northwest of Mount Hope in central NSW.

name: SEEING MACHINES LTD
businessSummary: Seeing Machines Limited is engaged in providing operator monitoring and intervention sensing technologies and services for the automotive, mining, transport and aviation industries. The Company’s principal activities include developing, selling and licensing products, services and technology to detect and manage driver fatigue and distraction, entering commercial agreements with partners for the design, development and sale of products into key target markets, and research and development of its core vision processing technologies to support the development and refinement of its products. Its OEM segment includes both the automotive and aviation business units. Its Aftermarket segment includes Fleet and Off-Road business units. It also develops machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) capability. Its technology portfolio of AI algorithms, embedded processing and optics, power products that need to deliver reliable real-time understanding of vehicle operators.

name: HARTSHEAD RESOURCES NL
businessSummary: Hartshead Resources NL is an oil and gas exploration and development company. The Company has an interest in the Seaward Production License P2607 (60% owned RockRose Energy/40% Hartshead), comprising of five contiguous blocks (48/15c, 49/6c, 49/11c, 49/12d and 49/17b) which contain four existing gas fields in the United Kingdom Southern Gas Basin totaling approximately 440.5 billion cubic feet (Bcf) of 2C Contingent Resources. Its license area covers approximately 729.5 square kilometers. The license contains multiple gas fields and prospects, which are divided into three phases for workstreams and operations. Its Phase I consists of the Somerville and Anning Gas Fields. Its Phase II includes the Hodgkin and Lovelace Gas Fields. Its Phase III includes an exploration portfolio of new prospect inventory totaling approximately 14 prospects and leads with unrisked 2U Prospective Resources of 344 Bcf.

name: PARAGON CARE LTD
businessSummary: Paragon Care Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the healthcare sector. The Company is a provider of medical equipment, devices, consumables, pharmaceuticals, complementary medicines, nutritional supplies, and manufacturer of Blood Bank diagnostic reagents to the healthcare markets in Australia, New Zealand and Asia. The Company’s geographical segments comprise Australia & New Zealand and Asia. It also offers equipment repair, maintenance and total equipment management through ParagonCare Service & Technology. Its CH2 brand distributes pharmaceutical, medical consumables, nutritional and over the counter products medical equipment and medical supplies. Its product portfolio includes critical care, dental, diagnostic & scientific, medical products & consumables, neonatal, orthopedics, service, surgical, technology & connectivity, urology, veterinary and aesthetics. Its brands include ParagonCare Immulab, ParagonCare Veterinary, Medtek, and Western Biomedical.

name: CYPRIUM METALS LTD
businessSummary: Cyprium Metals Limited is an Australia-based copper company. The Company’s flagship property is the Nifty Copper Complex in Western Australia, which produces copper from both oxide and sulfide resources. The Nifty Copper Mine is located on the western edge of the Great Sandy Desert in the north-eastern Pilbara region of Western Australia, approximately 350 kilometers (km) southeast of Port Hedland. Nifty has a mineral resource estimate of 1,038,000 tons of copper and a mineral inventory of 91,000 tons of copper in existing leach pads. The Company’s other assets include copper-focused properties in the Paterson Province, including multiple defined resources. The Paterson Exploration Project is located in the north-eastern Pilbara region of Western Australia. The 2,400-square kilometer (km2) land package is contiguous with much of the Nifty Copper Mine and Maroochydore Copper Project tenement boundaries. The Maroochydore deposit is located over 85 km southeast of Nifty.

name: KELLY PARTNERS GROUP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Kelly Partners Group Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in the provision of chartered accounting and other professional services, predominantly to private businesses and high net worth individuals. The Company’s segments include Accounting and Other services. The Accounting segment includes Accounting and taxation services, corporate secretarial, outsourced chief financial officer (CFO), audits, business structuring, bookkeeping, and all other accounting related services. The Other services segment includes financial broking services, wealth management, investment office and all other non-accounting services. It consists of approximately 37 operating businesses across 35 locations in Australia, Hong Kong and the United States.

name: ASPIRE MINING LTD
businessSummary: Aspire Mining Limited is an Australia-based coking coal development company. The Company 100% owns the Ovoot Coking Coal Project, and 90% owns the Nuurstei Coking Coal Project, both located in Khuvsgul aimag of north-western Mongolia. The Company is primarily focused on developing the Ovoot Coking Coal Project to mine coking coal via open pit methods, beneficiate it onsite, transport it by truck to a Company-owned coal unloading and loading facility near Erdenet, and delivering it onward via rail to customers in China, Russia and beyond utilizing the existing trans-Mongolian rail network. The Ovoot Project area is located in north-western Mongolia and comprises mining license MV017098. The Nuurstei project comprises mining license MV-020941 and is capable of producing washed hard coking coal. The project is located approximately 10 kilometers (km) from Khuvsgul provincial capital of Moron and is approximately 160 km northeast of the Ovoot project.

name: NUIX LTD
businessSummary: Nuix Limited is a provider of investigative analytics and intelligence software, which enables organizations to find insights from large amounts of unstructured data. The Company helps customers collect, process, and review large amounts of structured and unstructured data. It offers a software platform (Nuix platform) comprising a proprietary data processing engine (Nuix Engine) and several software applications. The Nuix platform operates at a forensic level, providing users with a detailed, contextualized and legally defensible way of viewing and interacting with data. Its solutions include Nuix Neo Data privacy, Nuix Neo Discover, Nuix Neo Investigations, and Nuix Neo Legal. Its products include Nuix NEO Platform and Nuix Components. Nuix Components include Nuix Discover, Nuix Workstation, Nuix Investigate, Nuix Enterprise Collection Center, Nuix Adaptive Security, and Nuix Rampiva. Nuix Adaptive Security offers visibility, adaptability, and control over data right at its source.

name: ALCHEMY RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Alchemy Resources Limited is an exploration company. The Company is focused on the discovery and development of gold, base metal and battery metals within Australia. Its projects include Karonie Gold Project, Cobar Basin/Lachlan Fold Belt Projects, West Lynn Project, Lake Rebecca Gold Project, Bryah Basin Iron Ore and Bryah Joint Venture. The Karonie Project covers highly prospective mineralized structures within Kurnalpi Terrain greenstones over 100 Kilometers (km) east of Kalgoorlie. The Lachlan Projects cover highly prospective terrain in the Central Lachlan Orogen and comprise three project areas prospective for Cobar-style epithermal gold and base metals and copper-gold porphyry mineralization. The Lachlan/Cobar Basin Projects consist of the Overflow Gold-Base Metal Project, the Yellow Mountain Copper-Gold Project, the West Lynn Nickel-Cobalt-Alumina Project and the Eurow Copper-Gold Project, each containing multiple drill ready gold and/or base metal and/or nickel-cobalt targets.

name: IMEXHS LTD
businessSummary: IMEXHS Limited is an Australia-based provider of medical imaging software and radiology services in 18 countries, including Colombia, the United States and Australia. The Company develops software-as-a-service imaging solutions that includes a Picture Archiving and Communications System (PACS), a Radiology Information System (RIS), a Cardiology Information System (CIS) and an Anatomical Pathology Laboratory Information System (APLIS). Its solutions are cloud-based, vendor neutral and zero footprint, with no need for installed software. Its radiology services provide radiological diagnostic services to hospitals and medical facilities in Colombia and Spain using IMEXHS medical imaging software. The Company's services business also provides it with medical images and radiologists interpretation and reports to develop artificial intelligence (AI) tools. Its solutions include AQUILA - Radiology, ALULA - Pathology, ANTEROS - cardiology, artificial intelligence and advanced visualization.

name: KINGSROSE MINING LTD
businessSummary: Kingsrose Mining Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. It is focused on the acquisition and exploration of critical mineral deposits. Its projects include Penikat, Rana, Finnmark, Central Finland, and Jakon. The Penikat Project is a high-grade PGE-nickel-copper deposit located in North-West Finland. The Rana Project is a brownfield nickel-copper-cobalt project that is prospective for the discovery of massive sulfide mineralization and is located in Nordland County, Norway. It owns 291 new exploration licenses in Finnmark County, northern Norway, totaling 2,736 square kilometers (km2) of early-stage nickel-copper-cobalt-PGE prospective ground across two mineral belts. The Central Finland project is located in the Kotalahti Nickel Belt, a 400-km long greenstone belt, which hosts the past-producing Hitura, Kotalahti and Enonkoski nickel mines. The Jakon project comprises two exploration permits and six exploration reservations totaling 205 km2 in Central Finland.

name: ZINC OF IRELAND NL
businessSummary: Zinc of Ireland NL is an Australia-based mineral exploration and development company focused on its zinc/lead projects in the Republic of Ireland as well as at its Earaheedy zinc/lead/silver and Cascade rare earth element (REE) exploration projects in Western Australia (WA). Its 100%-owned Kildare Project is located approximately 40 kilometers (km) southwest of Dublin and comprises approximately 240 square kilometers (km2) of contiguous prospecting licenses. The Earaheedy license is located approximately 200 km east of Wiluna and 220 km southeast of the RTR Chinook and Magazine Pb-Zn discoveries. The Earaheedy license contains approximately 23 km of strike of the target unconformity between the Frere and Yelma formations. The Company also covers approximately 1380 km2 lithium exploration project in the Superior Province, Manitoba, Canada. Through its subsidiary Avignon Resources Pty Ltd, it has six mineral exploration licenses and seven mining claims in Manitoba.

name: BEGA CHEESE LTD
businessSummary: Bega Cheese Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in receiving, processing, manufacturing, and distributing dairy and other food-related products. The Company operates in two segments: Branded, and Bulk. The Branded segment is engaged in the manufacture of value-added consumer products for owned and externally owned brands. The Bulk segment is engaged in the manufacturing of bulk dairy ingredients, nutritional and bio-nutrient products. The Company's products include cheese, spreads, groceries, and bio nutrients. The Cheese products include Bega Junior, Bega Cheddar Cheese Flavor Stringers, Bega Swiss Cheese Stringers, Bega Original Stringers, Bega Strong & Bitey, Bega Extra Tasty and Bega Super Slices. Its Spreads products include Bega Simply Nuts, B honey, Bega Peanut Butter and Vegemite. Its grocery products include ZoOSh Dips, ZoOSh Mayonnaise and ZoOSh Dressings.

name: HILLGROVE RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Hillgrove Resources Limited is an Australia-based mining company and also focused on copper production from the Kanmantoo Underground Copper Mine in South Australia. The Company's flagship project, The Kanmantoo Underground project, is located approximately 55km from Adelaide. The Kanmantoo Copper Mine, located in the mining jurisdiction of South Australia, has quickly ramped up to an annual copper production rate of approximately 12,000 tons and is well-capitalized with a 3.6 million tons per annum processing plant. The Company holds 100 % of a series of Exploration Licenses covering over 4,187 square kilometers in south-east South Australia alongside 311 square kilometres surrounding the Kanmantoo Mine and the northern Mount Lofty Ranges in the Cambrian-Ordovician Kanmantoo Province.

name: ST BARBARA LTD
businessSummary: St Barbara Limited is an Australia-based gold mining company with operations in Canada and Papua New Guinea. The Company's operations include the Atlantic Operations and the Simberi Operations. Its Atlantic Operations in Nova Scotia, Canada consists of its open pit Touquoy mine, along with three additional planned projects nearby at Fifteen Mile Stream, Cochrane Hill and Beaver Dam. Its Atlantic Operations are located approximately 80 kilometers (km) north-east of Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada. The Company is also exploring the Moose River Corridor and elsewhere in Nova Scotia. Its Simberi Operations consists of an open cut mine on the northernmost island in the Tabar group of islands in the province of New Ireland in Papua New Guinea. Its Simberi Operations is located approximately 900 km away from the capital of Papua New Guinea, Port Moresby.

name: BEACON MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Beacon Minerals Limited is a gold producer based in the Eastern Goldfields of Western Australia. The principal activity of the Company is mineral development and production in Western Australia. Its projects include Lady Ida Project, Jaurdi Gold Project, Mount Dimer Project and MacPhersons Project. The Lady Ida Project is situated approximately 29 kilometers from Beacon’s Jaurdi Gold Processing Plant, which is itself located around 50 kilometers west of Kalgoorlie. The Jaurdi Gold Project consists of The Black Cat, Wealth of Nations, Panther and Lost Dog deposits, in addition to the Jaurdi Gold Processing Plant. The Mount Dimer Project is positioned approximately 120 kilometers northeast of Southern Cross and 113 kilometers northwest of Beacon’s Jaurdi processing plant. The MacPhersons Project (MRP) tenements encompass the Hampton ultramafic sequence on the southern limb of the Tindals anticline.

name: IGO LTD
businessSummary: IGO Limited is a resources company that discovers, develops and produces products critical to the clean energy transition. Its segments include Nova Operation, Forrestania Operation, Cosmos Project, Lithium Business, and Growth. The Nova Operation comprises the Nova underground nickel mine and processing operation which produces nickel and copper concentrates. Forrestania Operation is located 400 kilometers east of Perth in Western Australia. Cosmos Project comprises the development of the Odysseus underground mine focused on the production of nickel concentrate, containing nickel and cobalt metal. The project is in care and maintenance. The Lithium Business represents its 49% share in the lithium joint venture, Tianqi Lithium Energy Australia Pty Ltd (TLEA), with Tianqi Lithium Corporation. The existing assets of TLEA include the Greenbushes Lithium Mine and the Kwinana Lithium Hydroxide Refinery. The Growth segment comprises exploration, business development and project evaluation.

name: GR ENGINEERING SERVICES LTD
businessSummary: GR Engineering Services Ltd is an Australia-based process engineering consulting and contracting company. The Company specializes in providing engineering design and construction services to the mining and mineral processing industries. Its segment includes Mineral Processing and Oil & Gas. The Mineral Processing segment includes engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) contracts and engineering, procurement and construction management (EPCM) contracts. Its Oil and Gas contracts comprise the delivery of operations and maintenance, well sites, engineering and production assurance services to the customer base. The Company’s services include feasibility studies, design and construction, project management, consulting, and asset management. Its projects include Abra Base Metals Project, Andy Well Gold Project, Bellevue Gold Project, Carosue Dam Expansion Project, Carosue Dam Paste Backfill Project, Cosmos Restart Project, Cosmic Boy Concentrator, Edna May Project, and others.

name: NUCHEV LTD
businessSummary: Nuchev Limited is an Australia-based nutritional and wellness business solutions company. The Company is engaged in the development, sales, and marketing of vitamins and dietary supplements. The Company’s products include those branded under Oli6, Bio Practica, and Medicine Tree and a number of globally recognized European brands sold under exclusive license in Australia and New Zealand by bWellness. The Company's primary products include its Oli6 branded goat infant formula and nutritional range, which are sold across Australian Pharmacy and Grocery channels, China and other overseas markets, online through the China Cross-Border e-commerce (CBEC), and general trade retail channels.

name: EAGERS AUTOMOTIVE LTD
businessSummary: Eagers Automotive Limited is an Australia-based automotive retail company representing a diversified portfolio of automotive brands across Australia and New Zealand. The Company operates through two segments: Car Retailing and Property. Within the Car Retailing segment, the Company offers a diversified range of automotive products and services, including new vehicles, used vehicles, vehicle maintenance and repair services, vehicle parts, service contracts, vehicle brokerage, vehicle protection products and other aftermarket products. The Company also facilitates financing for vehicle purchases through third-party sources. New vehicles, vehicle parts and maintenance services are predominantly supplied in accordance with franchise agreements with manufacturers. The Car Retailing segment includes a motor auction business and forklift rental business. Within the Property segment, it acquires commercial properties principally for use as facility premises for its motor dealership operations.

name: ILUKA RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Iluka Resources Limited is a global critical minerals company with specialization in exploration, project development, mining, processing, marketing and rehabilitation. It sells a range of titanium dioxide feedstocks, zircon products and rare earth minerals. Its segments include Mineral Sands, Rare Earths (RE), and Idle. Mineral Sands segment includes mining operations at Jacinth-Ambrosia in South Australia, Cataby in Western Australia, and activities at Balranald in New South Wales. It also includes associated processing operations at the Narngulu mineral separation plant in mid-west Western Australia, and the processing of ilmenite at Synthetic Rutile Kilns, also located in Western Australia. RE segment comprises the Eneabba Rare Earths Refinery being constructed in Western Australia alongside Phase I and II of the Eneabba development, and the Group's investment in Northern Minerals Limited. Idle comprises rehabilitation obligations in the United States (Florida and Virginia).

name: INFOMEDIA LTD
businessSummary: Infomedia Ltd is an Australia-based company. The Company is a provider of data as a service (DaaS) and software as a service (SaaS) solution for the data-driven automotive ecosystem. Its segments include Asia Pacific; Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA), and Americas, representing the combined North, Central and South America. Its parts include Microcat EPC, Microcat Partsbridge, Microcat Market, and Microcat CRM. Its services include Superservice Menus, Superservice Triage, Superservice Platform, and Superservice Connect. Superservice Connect is the online service booking solution powered by VIN-specific original equipment manufacturer (OEM) data, ensuring customers see the precise service schedule for their vehicle. Its SimplePart is a data-driven e-commerce platform designed to help dealers and OEMs sell more parts and accessories. For dealers, SimplePart offers a turnkey solution that simplifies launching and managing an online store.

name: HAMMER METALS LTD
businessSummary: Hammer Metals Limited is an Australia-based company, which is involved in mineral exploration in Western Australia and Queensland. The Company’s projects include Bronzewing South Au/Li/Ni Project and Mount Isa Projects. The Company holds a 100% interest in the Bronzewing South Gold Project located adjacent to the 2.3 million-ounce Bronzewing gold deposit in the highly prospective Yandal Belt of Western Australia. It also has a 51% interest in the Jubilee (Cu-Au) deposit. It also holds a strategic tenement position covering approximately 2,800 square kilometers (km2) within the Mount Isa mining district, with 100% interest in the Kalman (Cu-Au-Mo-Re) deposit, the Overlander North and Overlander South (Cu-Co) deposits, the Lakeview (Cu-Au) deposit and the Elaine (Cu-Au) deposit. It is an active mineral explorer, focused on discovering large copper-gold deposits of Ernest Henry style and has a range of prospective targets at various stages of testing.

name: LAWFINANCE LTD
businessSummary: LawFinance Limited is an Australia-based provider of finance solutions for the legal industry in the United States. The Company, through its subsidiary, National Health Finance HoldCo, LLC (NHF), operates a medical lien funding business in the United States. NHF purchases medical liens generally related to the provision of medical services to individuals involved in motor vehicle accidents where the services are required due to an injury sustained in the accident and where those individuals were the not-at-fault party (except in Michigan, which is a not-at-fault state). NHF's funding solution enables medical providers to maintain liquidity and reduce the administrative burden by managing medical claims through the litigation process. NHF's funding solution is also of benefit to the lawyers acting on behalf of the injured party as it ensures there is no gap in medical care and the claim can be maximized. Its subsidiaries include JustKapital STL Pty and JustKapital NHF USA Holdings.

name: AMPOL LTD
businessSummary: Ampol Limited is an Australia-based transport energy provider. The Company supplies petrol and a convenience network, as well as refining, importing and marketing fuels and lubricants. It also launched its electric vehicle charging and home electricity solutions. The Company supplies fuel to approximately 80,000 customers in diverse markets across the Australian economy, including defense, mining, transport, marine, agriculture, aviation and other commercial sectors. Across its retail network, the Company serves approximately three million customers every week with fuel and convenience products, as well as electric vehicle charging at selected locations. Its customer base is supported by its robust supply chain and strategic infrastructure positions across the country, which includes 16 terminals, six pipelines, 55 wet depots, over 1,800 branded sites and one refinery located in Lytton, Queensland. This network is supported by over 8,300 people across Australia and overseas.

name: FREELANCER LTD
businessSummary: Freelancer Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in the provision of an online outsourcing marketplace and escrow payment services. The Company is involved in the freelancing and crowdsourcing marketplace. The Company operates through two segments: Online Marketplace and Online Payment. The Company owns Escrow.com, a provider of secure online payments and online transaction management for consumers and businesses on the Internet. It safeguards both the buyer and seller with all funds kept in trust that are transacted in escrow. The Company also owns Loadshift, a heavy haulage freight marketplace with over 750 million kilometers of freight posted. The Company has more than 80 million registered users and have posted over 25 million projects and contests in over 3,000 areas, as diverse as Website development, logo design, marketing, copywriting, astrophysics, aerospace engineering and manufacturing.

name: TALONX RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Talonx Resources Limited, formerly Mount Burgess Mining N.L., is an Australia-based company engaged in the discovery and developing commercial deposits of mineral resources. Its projects include Viking Project, Blair North Project, and Kihabe Project. The Viking Gold Project is located 30 kilometers (km) east of Norseman. The project comprises 66 square kilometers (km2) of granted tenure situated within the Albany-Fraser Province. The Blair North Project is located 25 km east of Kalgoorlie, surrounded by established operations and gold deposits. The Blair North project offers drill-ready targets along strike and at depth at the Commodore prospects. The Blair North Project sits approximately 20km southeast of Kalgoorlie in the Eastern Goldfields of Western Australia, within a prolific gold and nickel district rich in existing infrastructure. The Kihabe Project (PL43/2016) is situated in West Ngamiland, within the Republic of Botswana. The Kihabe project covers an area of 1,000 km2.

name: PARKWAY CORPORATE LTD
businessSummary: Parkway Corporate Limited is an Australia-based cleantech company focused on developing and implementing industrial-scale water treatment solutions. Its Industrial Technology related activities are performed through Parkway Process Technologies (PPT) and are predominantly focused on innovative process technology related R&D, including process development, evaluation, optimization and piloting, as well as a range of technology scale-up and commercialization related activities. Its Industrial Operations are performed through Parkway Process Solutions (PPS) and are predominantly focused on the provision of conventional water and wastewater treatment related products and services, including specialty project execution related services. In addition, PPS is involved in integrated project delivery related services including engineering, specialized fabrication and installation services for a diverse range of commercial, indusKaringa Lakes Potash Project in the Northern Territory of Australia.

name: PLATINA RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Platina Resources Limited is an Australia-based company focused on advancing early-stage metals projects through exploration, feasibility, and permitting towards development. The Company controls a 100% interest in a portfolio of gold projects in the Yilgarn Craton in Western Australia. It operates a range of projects consisting of Mt McKenna, Beete, Brimstone, Binti Binti, Mt Narryer, and Jubilee. The Beete Gold Project covers 134 kilometers (km) and is located in a historical high-grade mining district near Norseman, and 10 km south of 1 Moz Scotia Mining center. The Brimstone Gold Project covers 65.62 km2 and is located 40 km north-east of Kalgoorlie within a proven gold district in close proximity to the Penny's Find gold deposit. The Challa project includes two exploration licenses covering 293 km2 located approximately 500km north-east of Perth in Western Australia. The Binti Binti Project comprises two exploration licenses located approximately 50km north-east of Kalgoorlie.

name: KALI METALS LTD
businessSummary: Kali Metals Limited is an Australia-based lithium focused exploration company. The Company is engaged in minerals exploration with a focus on lithium, gold, tin and critical minerals. Its portfolio of assets includes Pilbara Projects: include DOM’s Hill Project, Marble Bar Project, and Pear Creek Project; Southern Lachlan Fold Belt Projects; include Jingellic Project and Tallangatta Project, and Higginsville Lithium District. Its DOM’s Hill Project comprises 125 square kilometers (km2) is located in the East Pilbara region of Western Australia and is 110 kilometers (km) southeast of Port Hedland and 52 km northwest of Marble Bar. The 100% owned Pear Creek Project consists of three exploration licences and is located between the DOM’s Hill Project and the Marble Bar Project in the East Pilbara region of Western Australia, approximately 140 km southeast of Port Hedland and 60 km northwest of Marble Bar. Its Jingellic Project is situated in southern New South Wales.

name: CAZALY RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Cazaly Resources Limited is an Australia-based resource exploration company that operates internationally, holding a diverse portfolio of mineral projects in Australia, Canada and Namibia. The Company’s projects include the Halls Creek Copper, Zinc and Silver Project, Carb Nb/REE Project, Kaoko Lithium Project and Abenab North REE & Base Metals Project. Its joint venture projects include Sundown Lithium JV Project, McKenzie Springs JV Project and Mount Venn JV Project. It also has an agreement to earn approximately 80% interest in the Goongarrie Gold Project. The Halls Creek Copper, Zinc and Silver Project is situated 25 kilometers (kms) southwest of Halls Creek and covers part of the Halls Creek Mobile Zone, which is prospective for a range of commodities including copper, gold, and nickel. The Carb niobium (Nb) and rare earth elements (REE) Project is located in northwest Ontario, Canda in the Red Lake District, comprising over 93 mineral claims.

name: PANTORO GOLD LTD
businessSummary: Pantoro Gold Limited, formerly Pantoro Limited, is an Australia-based gold producer. The Company is focused on its 100%-owned Norseman Gold Project in Australia. The Norseman Gold Project is located in the Eastern Goldfields of Western Australia, at the southern end of the highly productive Norseman-Wiluna greenstone belt. The project lies approximately 725 kilometers (km) east of Perth, 200 km south of Kalgoorlie, and 200 km north of Esperance. The project tenure of approximately 1,000 square kilometers (km2) covers nearly all the historic Norseman Gold province. The project has measured, indicated and inferred mineral resources of 4.87 million ounces. The Norseman Gold Project lies immediately adjacent to the Norseman township and is infrastructure-rich with office and workshop complexes, camp accommodation, site laboratory, 10MW power station, bore fields and a road network servicing all existing mineral resource areas already in place.

name: PWR HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: PWR Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company and its subsidiaries are involved in the design, prototyping, production, testing, validation and sales of advanced cooling products and solutions to the motorsports, automotive and industrial original equipment manufacturing (OEM), aerospace and defense, and automotive aftermarket sectors for domestic and international markets. It operates through two segments: PWR Performance Products and PWR C&R. The PWR Performance Products segment is engaged in designing and manufacturing high-end motorsports, OEM, aerospace and defense, and automotive aftermarket products for non-United States markets. The PWR C&R segment offers its products primarily for the United States market. Its products include tube and fin heat exchangers, bar and plate heat exchangers, liquid cold plates, micro matric heat exchangers, and others. Its performance aftermarket products include radiators, intercoolers, transmission oil coolers, and others.

name: BUBS AUSTRALIA LTD
businessSummary: Bubs Australia Limited is an Australia-based producer of infant and adult chilled and powdered, goat dairy products. It offers families around the world a comprehensive range of Australian premium infant nutrition products under the Bubs brand, including goat milk infant formula, organic grass-fed cow milk infant formula, organic baby food, cereals, toddler snacks, as well as a range of adult nutritional powders and chilled goat milk under the Caprilac brand. Bubs A2 Beta-Casein Protein, Bubs Organic Grass-fed, and Easy-Digest Goat Milk Infant Formula, along with Bubs Organic baby food range, cater for all feeding occasions and stages of a child’s development during their first 1,000 days of life. Its organic food range includes organic plant burst pouches, organic snack range and organic baby cereal. Its products are sold in supermarkets and pharmacies throughout Australia, as well as exported to around 10 markets across China, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and United States.

name: DIATREME RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Diatreme Resources Ltd is a producer of mineral and silica sands. The Company’s key projects comprise the Northern Silica Project and Galalar Silica Sand Project in Far North Queensland, located next to the silica sand mine at Cape Flattery. Its other projects include Cyclone Zircon Project and Cape Flattery Silica Project. Its Northern Silica Project is located approximately 35 kilometers (km) north of Hope Vale and 14 km west of the Port of Cape Flattery in Far North Queensland. The Galalar Silica Sands Project is situated near Cape Bedford, over 20 km from Hope Vale, which is engaged in producing silica for the solar panel market. Its Cyclone Zircon Project located in the Barton shoreline within the Wanna Lakes area of the northern Eucla Basin, over 25 kilometers from Western Australia’s state border. The Cyclone deposit occurs within tenements M69/141 (Cyclone), held by the Company’s subsidiary, Lost Sands Pty Ltd, and R69/1, (Cyclone Extended), held directly by the Company.

name: TITANIUM SANDS LTD
businessSummary: Titanium Sands Limited is a mineral exploration company. The Company, through its local partners, Orion Minerals (Private) Limited, Sanur Minerals (pvt) Ltd and Kilsythe Investments (Private) Limited, are developing a high grade mineable heavy mineral sands project at Mannar Island, Sri Lanka. The Mannar Island Heavy Mineral Sands Project is located in Northwest Sri Lanka and is an ilmenite feedstock project with minor credits from other mineral components. It holds five heavy mineral sands exploration licenses located in North West Sri Lanka on Mannar Island and the adjacent mainland coast. The exploration licenses include EL 370, EL 351, EL 425, EL 423, and EL 424. It also has four renewal pending licenses including EL 180/R/3, EL 182/R/3, EL 371, and EL 372. It is focused around Mannar Island, an island approximately 26 kilometers (km) long and six km wide, and 140 square kilometers in area, joined to the mainland shore by road and rail connections over a short causeway.

name: YOWIE GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Yowie Group Limited is a global brand licensing company. The Company specializes in the development of consumer products designed to promote learning, understanding and engagement with the natural world through the adventures of over six endearing Yowie characters. It owns and manages a portfolio of intellectual property underpinning the Yowie surprise-inside chocolate brand and associated digital and licensed products. The Company's core markets are North America and Australia/New Zealand. It operates through two geographical segments: the United States and Australia. Its collections include Baby Animals, Animals with Super Powers, Blast from the Past, Wild Water, WCS, Rescue, All Americas collection, Ranger series, Premier collection, and others. In addition to its core Yowie chocolate line, the Company is also engaged in brand licensing with iconic names such as the NBA (National Basketball Association), Bluey, NRL, and AFL. It also owns the Ernest Hillier brand and factory.

name: GOLDARC RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: GoldArc Resources Limited, formerly Asra Minerals Limited, is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. Its flagship projects are located in the prolific Leonora and Kookynie districts of the Eastern Goldfields. Leonora South Gold project consists of over 8 semi-contiguous granted mining licenses, including 313 square kilometers (km2) across its eastern tenements and an additional 236 km2 in the western area. The project consists of two JORC compliant resources at their Orion and Sapphire deposits totaling over 48,000 ounces. Leonora South Gold project is located 60km south of Leonora along the Goldfields Highway in the historic Kookynie Goldfields. The Leonora North Gold Project is located 40km northeast of Leonora. It is located within the Archaean Eastern Goldfield Superterrane, the eastern division of the Achean Yilgarn Craton, and it is located around 250km north of Kalgoorlie, covers an area 100km long and 80km wide and contains an abundance of orogenic gold deposits.

name: GOLDEN MILE RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Golden Mile Resources Limited is an Australia-based project development company and mineral exploration company. The primary focus is on growing the Company with a multi asset and multi commodity strategy through advancement of core projects, acquisition of high-quality assets and tactical alliances with joint venture partners. Its projects include Pearl Copper Project, Quicksilver Nickel-Cobalt Project, Leonora Gold Joint Venture (JV) Project, Gidgee JV Project, Yuinmery Project, Yarrambee Project, Marble Bar Lithium-Gold Project, and Murchison Project. The Pearl Copper Project is situated in the San Manuel mining district, Pinal County, Arizona, over 40 kilometers (km) north-east of Tucson, near the town of Mammoth. The Quicksilver Project, located near the town of Lake Grace, is over 300 km south-east of Perth, Western Australia. The Quicksilver Project is centered over a narrow greenstone belt, the Project is prospective for nickel-cobalt, and gold.

name: CHRYSOS CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Chrysos Corporation Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is a provider of novel assay services to the global mining industry through its proprietary PhotonAssay technology. Assaying involves the analysis of ore or other materials to determine the presence and quantity of valuable metals or other constituents. The PhotonAssay technology causes excitation of atomic nuclei allowing enhanced analysis of gold, silver, copper and other elements in approximately two minutes. PhotonAssay units are deployed to mine sites and independent laboratories which provide assay services. The Company's segments include Asia Pacific (APAC), Europe, Middle East, and Americas. Its subsidiaries include Chrysos AU Operations Pty Ltd, Chrysos UK Services Ltd, PhotonAssay Mexico S.A. DE C.V, PhotonAssay Operations, and PhotonAssay New Zealand Pty Ltd, among others.

name: HOT CHILI LTD
businessSummary: Hot Chili Limited is an Australia-based copper company. The principal activity of the Company is engaged in mineral exploration. The Company is focused on copper exploration and development in Chile’s Atacama Region. The Company’s Costa Fuego Project is a copper mining hub in Region III on the Chilean coastal range. Its Chilean coastal range Costa Fuego Copper-Gold Project comprises the Cortadera, Productora and San Antonio deposits. The Cortadera deposit is focused on copper-gold discoveries in Chile. Productora is an advanced-stage copper-gold project. Its El Fuego copper Project encompasses two historic underground mines, which include San Antonio and Valentina. The Company’s wholly owned subsidiaries include Sociedad Minera El Corazon Limitada, Sociedad Minera Los Mantos SpA, Sociedad Minera Frontera SpA, and Sociedad Minera Bandera SpA.

name: GOLD HYDROGEN LTD
businessSummary: Gold Hydrogen Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is engaged in discovery and development of natural hydrogen and helium gases in a potentially extensive province in South Australia. The Company holds one granted Petroleum Exploration License (PEL) in South Australia (PEL 687) that covers approximately 75,000- square kilometers (km2) of permitted tenement on the Yorke Peninsula and Kangaroo Island in South Australia. The Company through its subsidiary hold an additional seven applications for Natural Hydrogen and Helium exploration within South Australia. The Company is also the applicant for four gas storage exploration licenses applications (GSELA) covering an area of approximately 8,000 km2 within the Yorke Peninsula portion of PEL 687 in South Australia.

name: RIO TINTO LTD
businessSummary: Rio Tinto Limited is a mining and materials company. It operates in 35 countries and produces iron ore, copper, aluminum, critical minerals and other materials needed for the global energy transition. Its segments include Iron Ore, Aluminum, Copper, and Minerals. The iron ore segment includes iron ore mining and salt and gypsum production in Western Australia. Its iron ore operations in the Pilbara comprise an integrated network of 18 iron ore mines and four independent port terminals. The aluminum segment includes bauxite mining, alumina refining, and aluminum smelting and recycling. The copper segment includes mining and refining of copper, gold, silver, molybdenum, other by-products and licensing of extraction technologies. The minerals segment includes mining and processing of borates, diamonds, iron concentrate and pellets from the Iron Ore Company of Canada, lithium and titanium dioxide feedstock.

name: PEXA GROUP LTD
businessSummary: PEXA Group Limited operates a digital property settlements platform company. The Company operates through three segments: PEXA Exchange, PEXA Digital Growth, and PEXA International. PEXA Exchange segment includes Australian Electronic Lodgement Network (ELN) and financial settlement platform which operates in the Australian electronic conveyancing market. The PEXA Exchange facilitates the collaboration between customers across the property ecosystem to enable the transfer and settlement of transactions in real property. PEXA Digital Growth segment is engaged in the provision of property-related analytics and digital solutions to financial institutions, governments, property developers and related professionals, and PR actioners in Australia. PEXA International segment is engaged in the provision of digitalized property registration and settlement, and related services, in overseas Torrens Title jurisdictions, initially in the United Kingdom (UK).

name: GCM CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: GCM Corporation Limited is an Australia-based manufacturer and producer of high-performing thermal management and cooling products for the technology, electronics, and industrials sectors. The Company's advanced cooling product leverages proprietary VHD technology to deliver superior thermal management for high-performance, energy-intensive applications, including heat sinks, heat spreaders, and cold plates. VHD Technology represents advanced technology which produces commercial very high density (VHD) blocks. Its products serve critical sectors such as data centers, high performance computing, high performance electronics, advanced industrial manufacturing, renewable energy, aerospace and defense, and energy systems. Its projects include McIntosh Graphite Project, Torrington Topaz and Tungsten Project, Greenfields Projects, and Single-Crystal Mullite Fibers. It is initiating a work program to advance and commercialize single crystal mullite fiber technology (utilizing Topaz).

name: FORTE ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Forte Energy Limited, formerly IPB Petroleum Limited, is an Australia-based oil and gas exploration company. The Company has a 100% interest in the petroleum exploration permits located in the Browse Basin: WA-424-P. The Browse Basin is located north of Broome, offshore, Western Australia, and covers an area of approximately 140,000 square kilometers (km2). The WA-424-P permit contains three wells, including Gwydion-1, Caspar-1A, and Pryderi-1. The Company's subsidiaries include IPB WA 424P Pty Ltd and IPB Exploration Pty Ltd.

name: WISR LTD
businessSummary: Wisr Limited is an Australia-based neo-lender company. The Company provides a collection of financial products and services. The Company is engaged in writing personal loans and secured vehicle loans for three, five and seven-year maturities to Australian consumers, and funding these loans through the warehouse funding structures. It provides a Financial Wellness Platform underpinned by consumer finance products, the Wisr App. The Wisr App helps Australians pay down debt, multiple credit score comparison services and Australia’s first money-coaching app Wisr Today. Combined with content and other products that use technology to provide better outcomes for borrowers, investors, and everyday Australians. The Company’s products include loans, credit scores and round up. Its credit score is a summary of financial habits, and helps lenders get to know its customers. Its loan products include debt consolidation loans, car loans, medical loans and others.

name: SANDFIRE RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Sandfire Resources Limited is a mining and exploration company with a focus on copper exploration. The Company’s segments include DeGrussa Copper Operations, Minas De Aguas Tenidas (MATSA) Copper Operations, Black Butte Project, Motheo Copper Project and Exploration and Other. DeGrussa Copper Operations segment consists of both the DeGrussa and Monty Copper-Gold Mines located in the Bryah Basin mineral province of Western Australia. MATSA Copper Operations consists of the Minas De Aguas Tenidas (MATSA) polymetallic mining complex in Spain, comprising three underground mines. Black Butte Project consists of the evaluation activities for the Black Butte Copper Project located in central Montana in the United States of America. Motheo Copper Project segment consists of development of the Motheo Copper Mine, exploration and evaluation activities in Botswana and Namibia within the Kalahari Copper Belt. The Exploration and Other segment include its exploration and evaluation activities.

name: MORELLA CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Morella Corporation Limited is an Australia-based critical minerals company. The Company is engaged in exploration and resource development activities, advancing projects in lithium, rubidium, titanium and vanadium across Australia and United States. These critical minerals underpin the global transition to clean energy, electrification and advanced technologies. Its projects span the Mt Edon Rubidium-Lithium and Dixon Well Titanium-Vanadium prospects in Western Australia, the Mallina, Tabba Tabba and West Wodgina Lithium Projects in the Pilbara, and the Fish Lake Valley and North Big Smoky Lithium Projects in Nevada, United States. The Company's Mt Edon Project is located approximately five kilometers southwest of Paynes Find in Western Australia’s Mid-West region. Its Lake Valley Project is located in western Nevada, within the Esmeralda lithium brine province that also hosts the nearby Silver Peak operation - North America’s only producing lithium brine mine.

name: PACIFIC SMILES GROUP LIMITED
businessSummary: Pacific Smiles Group Limited is an Australia-based dental company. The Company operates dental centers at which independent dentists practice and provide clinical treatments and services to patients. It owns and operates the Pacific Smiles Dental and Nib Dental Care centers across the East Coast of Australia and manages the operation of HBF Dental Centers in Western Australia. The Company provides dentists with fully serviced and equipped facilities, including support staff, materials, marketing, and administrative services. The Company operates approximately 120+ dental centers nationally. The Company's Dental Center Networks are located in Belconnen, Manuka, Gungahlin and Tuggeranong in Australian Capital Territory (ACT); Ashfield, Belmont and Balgowlah in New South Wales; Caroline Springs and Chirnside Park in Victoria, and Birtinya, Bribie Island and Capalaba in Queensland.

name: LOTUS RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Lotus Resources Limited is an advanced uranium company. The principal activities of the Company include the exploration and development of its Kayelekera Uranium Project in Malawi and Letlhakane Uranium Project in Botswana. The Company operates through four business segments and two geographical locations, being the exploration, evaluation and development of Uranium assets in Africa (comprising the geographical locations Malawi and Botswana), nickel-cobalt exploration, evaluation and development in Australia, and corporate activities in Australia. The Kayelekera Uranium Project is located in northern Malawi, Southern Africa, 52 kilometers (km) west by road from the town of Karonga. It owns a 100% interest in Letlhakane Uranium Project in Botswana. The asset is located within 50 kilometers of Francistown, a population center in Botswana.

name: MARQUEE RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Marquee Resources Limited is an Australia-based critical metals explorer. The Company’s projects include Mount Clement antimony, gold, lead, copper and silver Project, Rare Earth Elements (REE) Project, West Spargoville Project, Lone Star Copper-Gold Project, Clayton Valley Lithium Project, Kibby Basin Lithium Project, Sa Pedra Bianca Gold and Silver Project, and Yindi Gold and Lithium Project. Its 100% owned Mount Clement antimony, gold, lead, copper and silver Project is located 30 kilometers (km) southwest of Black Cat Syndicate’s Paulsens gold mine, at the western end of the Ashburton Basin in the northern Capricorn Orogen. The Yindi Gold and Lithium Project is situated within over 106 square kilometers of highly prospective gold tenure and is strategically positioned over the greenstone belt and the structurally significant Yilgani Fault, a gold-bearing corridor. The 100% owned Redlings REE project is located over 40 km west of Leonora, and 77 km north of Menzies.

name: STEALTH GROUP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Stealth Group Holdings Ltd is an Australia-based multi-sector distribution company. The Company is engaged in providing a range of industrial, safety, automotive, workplace and consumer products and solutions to businesses, trade-professionals and retail consumers through an omnichannel model incorporating a large sales force, contact centers, physical stores and online.
