businessSummary: Elevra Lithium Limited, formerly Sayona Mining Limited, is a North American lithium producer, with projects in Quebec, Canada and Western Australia. Its projects include Abitibi-Temiscamingue Hub, Eeyou Istchee James Bay Hub and Western Australia. Its Abitibi-Temiscamingue Hub includes North American Lithium, Authier Lithium Project, Tansim Lithium Project and Vallee Lithium Project. Its Eeyou Istchee James Bay Hub includes Moblan Lithium Project, Lac Albert Lithium Project and Troilus Claims. In Western Australia, it has lithium and gold projects. Its projects also include Ewoyaa Lithium Project and Carolina Lithium Project. Authier Lithium Project in Quebec, Canada is a hard rock spodumene lithium deposit. Tansim Lithium Project is situated 82 kilometers south-west of the Authier Lithium Project. Moblan Lithium Project is located in the Eeyou-Istchee James Bay region of northern Quebec, a proven lithium mining province which hosts lithium resources including the Whabouchi mine.

name: JANISON EDUCATION GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Janison Education Group Limited operates within the education technology sector globally. Its principal activities include the provision of a digital assessment platform and assessment services (invigilation, marking, test development and exam management) as well as the sale of assessment products, such as International Competitions and Assessments for Schools (ICAS), Academic Assessment Services (AAS)/Allwell and Quality Assessment Tasks (QATs). The Company operates two business units: Product and Platform. The Product segment provides exam products, exam items and associated exam services which are sold to schools, parents and teachers. The Platform segment operates exam enterprise-grade assessment platform technology and event management services for large organizations, national education authorities and accreditation bodies. The Company’s core customer segment is the Schools market (K-12) in Australia, Singapore and the United Kingdom.

name: HAWTHORN RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Hawthorn Resources Limited is an Australia-based diversified critical minerals and gold explorer with tenement holdings throughout Western Australia. The Company’s projects include Mount Bevan Magnetite Project, Mount Bevan Critical Minerals Project and Anglo Saxon Gold Mine. The Company has a joint venture with Hancock Magnetite Holdings Pty Ltd and Legacy Iron Ore Limited on the Mount Bevan Magnetite and Critical Minerals Project, which is located in South Yilgarn, southwest of Leonora. The Anglo-Saxon gold project is a joint venture between the Company (70%) and Gel Resources Pty Ltd (30%) located at Pinjin, approximately 140 kilometers northeast of Kalgoorlie. The Anglo-Saxon gold mine is located in the South Laverton Tectonic zone (SLTZ), 140 kilometers north-east of Kalgoorlie and 35 kilometers east of the Carosue Dam mill. The project is part of the Trouser Legs Joint Venture (TLJV) with Gel Resources Pty Ltd.

name: MONEYME LTD
businessSummary: MoneyMe Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is engaged in providing consumer and commercial finance. The Company uses smart technology to redefine the borrowing experience with easy and seamless credit products, from digital loans and credit cards to financial wellness tools. The Company’s proprietary technology platform, Horizon and its artificial intelligence (AI) engine, AIDEN with generative and agentic AI, driving improved customer experience, operational efficiency and credit decisioning. It targets customers with above average credit profiles through a range of fast, flexible, and competitively priced products, including car loans, personal loans, and credit cards. The Company’s products and services include personal loans, refinance loans, medical loans, autopay, renovation loans, wedding loans, travel loans, Freestyle credit card, debt consolidation, and credit scores.

name: CORE LITHIUM LTD
businessSummary: Core Lithium Ltd is an Australia-based lithium mining company. It owns and operates Finniss Lithium project, which is located south of Darwin Port in the Northern Territory. The project lies within a prospective area for lithium in the NT, the Bynoe Pegmatite Field, and covers approximately 500 square kilometers (km2) of granted tenements. The project is approximately 88 kilometers (km) by sealed road from Darwin Port, Northern Territory. Its other projects include Shoobridge Lithium, Anningie and Barrow Creek Lithium, Yerelina and Mt Freeling, and Blueys-Inkheart. The Shoobridge Lithium Project is located approximately 160 km south-southeast of Finniss near Darwin in the Northern Territory. The Anningie and Barrow Creek encompass eight exploration licenses over approximately 2,000 km2 in and around the Anningie and Barrow Creek tin-tantalum pegmatite fields in the Northern Territory. The Yerelina and Mt Freeling Projects, located in South Australia.

name: DREADNOUGHT RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Dreadnought Resources Limited is an exploration and development company focusing on acquiring and exploring quality projects within the state of Western Australia (WA). The Company's projects include Kimberley Project, Mangaroon Project, and Bresnahan Project. It controls approximately 420 square kilometers (km) in the highly prospective West Kimberley region of WA. The Tarraji-Yampi Copper-Silver-Gold-Cobalt Project is located only 85 km from the port of Derby. Its Mangaroon Project covers approximately 5,000 km2, located 250 km south-east of Exmouth in the underexplored Gascoyne Region of WA. Mangaroon has three focus areas, the Mangaroon Critical Metals, Mangaroon Gold and Base Metals. Bresnahan is located over 125km southwest of Newman in the Ashburton Basin. The project comprises over 3,700 km2 covering over 200kms strike along the Bresnahan Basin / Wyloo Group unconformity. Bresnahan is prospective for unconformity related heavy rare earth (HREE) deposits.

name: LAKE RESOURCES NL
businessSummary: Lake Resources NL is an Australia-based lithium developer utilising ion exchange extraction technology for production of sustainable, high purity lithium from the Company's flagship Kachi Project in Catamarca Province within the Lithium Triangle in Argentina. The Company also has an additional early-stage project in this region, the Ancasti or Catamarca Pegmatite Lithium Project.

name: CANTERBURY RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Canterbury Resources Limited is an Australia-based resource company. The Company is focused on exploring potential Tier-1 copper-gold projects in the Southwest Pacific. The Company has a portfolio of projects in Australia and Papua New Guinea that are prospective for porphyry copper-gold, epithermal gold-silver and intrusion-related Ni-Cu-PGM deposits. Its portfolio includes multiple projects that are at the advanced exploration phase. Each project provides potential for the discovery and/or delineation of large-scale copper, gold, and molybdenum resources. Its tenements in Australia include Briggs, Mannersley, Fig Tree Hill, Don River, Rocky Point, Ulam Range, and Peenam. Its tenements in Papua New Guinea include Bismarck, Ekuti Range, Wamum, Waits Creek, Waffa River, and Legusulum. It also has an agreement to acquire EPM 29106 (Jack Shay) in central Queensland, Australia. Briggs is located approximately 60 kilometers west of the deep-water port of Gladstone.

name: GENESIS MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Genesis Minerals Limited is an Australia-based gold company, 100% focused on the prolific Leonora District in Western Australia. The Company's principal activities are gold mining, project development and exploration activities in Western Australia. Its operations include Leonora Operations and Laverton Operations. The Company's Leonora Operations include Admiral Operations, Gwalia Operations, Harbour Lights Project, Tower Hill Project and Ulysses Operations. The Gwalia Gold Mine is located at Gwalia, a few kilometers south of Leonora, Western Australia. Its Laverton Operations include Bruno-Lewis Project, Jupiter Project, Laverton Gold Project and Redcliffe Project. The Bruno-Lewis project is located within the northeastern goldfields in the Archaean Yilgarn Block. The Redcliffe Project includes the Redcliffe, Hub, GTS, Nambi, Kelly, Bindy and Mesa Westlode deposits. Genesis Mining Services is the inhouse mining services provider for the Company, providing Open Pit mining services.

name: NT MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: NT Minerals Limited is an Australia-based exploration and minerals development company with projects in the Northern Territory and Western Australia. The Company is focusing on copper, bulk commodities and strategic minerals. Its projects include Redbank Project, Millers Creek Project, Wollogorang Project, Finniss River Critical Minerals Project and Twin Peaks Project. The Redbank Project is located in the east McArthur Basin and spans an area from the Northern Territory/Queensland border west towards Glencore’s McArthur Mine. The Millers Creek Project is located approximately 700 kilometers (kms) northwest of Adelaide and consists of real estate situated between mining companies OZ Minerals to the north and FMG to the east. The Wollogorang Project is located in the southeast McArthur Basin. The Finniss River Critical Minerals Project is located 70 kms southwest of Darwin. The Twin Peaks Project is 520 kilometers north of Perth and approximately 200 kms northeast of Geraldton.

name: REDSTONE RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Redstone Resources Ltd is a base, precious metals and a lithium company. The principal activity of is mineral exploration in Australia and Canada. It focuses on exploring its 100% owned prospective West Musgrave Project, which includes the Tollu Copper deposit, in Western Australia. The West Musgrave Project is located between BHP’s Nebo Babel Deposit and Nico Resources’ Wingellina Ni-Co project. The Tollu Project is located in the south-east portion of the West Musgrave region of Western Australia. The Tollu Project consists of hydrothermal copper quartz veins in a mineralized system covering an area at least five square kilometers (km2). Its other projects include Atlas Project, Babylon Project, Herculaneum Project, Pergamon Project, and Pompeii Project. The Atlas Project lies to the immediate north of the Tollu Project and is proximal to the Tollu Fault Zone. The Babylon Project is located east of the Tollu fault zone. The Herculaneum Project is located west of the Tollu Project.

name: WASHINGTON H. SOUL PATTINSON AND COMPANY
businessSummary: Washington H. Soul Pattinson and Company Ltd., formerly First Services Company Ltd, is an Australia-based holding company. The Company’s subsidiaries include Brickworks Limited and WHSP Holdings Ltd. Brickworks Limited is a manufacturer and distributor of building products in Australia and North America, with operations spanning bricks, roofing, masonry, and property investments. Its operations are categorized into four segments: Building Products Australia, Building Products North America, Property, and Investments. WHSP Holdings Ltd is a diversified investment company with investments across a range of industries and asset classes. Its investment portfolios include Strategic Investments Portfolio, Large Caps Portfolio, Private Equity Portfolio, Credit Portfolio, Emerging Companies Portfolio, and Property Portfolio. It invests in multiple industries, including building materials, telecommunications, natural resources, pharmaceuticals, agriculture, property and financial services.

name: AUSTRALIAN VANADIUM LTD
businessSummary: Australian Vanadium Limited is a resource company focused on vanadium. The Company is advancing the development of the Australian Vanadium Project at Gabanintha. Its segments include Upstream: Australian Vanadium Project - evaluation and feasibility of the Australian Vanadium Project; Midstream: Electrolyte Plant - manufacturing of vanadium electrolyte, and Downstream: Energy Storage - sale, development and deployment of utility-scale vanadium flow battery energy storage solutions by VSUN Energy. The Australian Vanadium Project is located in the Murchison Province over 43 kilometers (km) south of the mining town of Meekatharra in Western Australia. The Nowthanna Hill deposit is located over 50 km south of Meekatharra in Western Australia and is hosted in carnotite within silicified calcrete layers and carbonate-rich sandy clays. The Coates Project is situated over 60 km east of the Perth metropolitan area in the Shire of Wundowie.

name: WOOLWORTHS GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Woolworths Group Limited is an Australia-based retailer. The Company's segments include Australian Food, Australian B2B, New Zealand Food, W Living, and Other. The Australian Food segment is engaged in procurement of food, drinks and related products for resale and provision of services (including eCommerce) to retail and business customers in Australia. The Australian B2B segment includes procurement and distribution of food and related products for resale to other businesses and provision of supply chain services to business customers in Australia. The New Zealand Food segment includes procurement of food, drinks and related products for resale and provision of services (including eCommerce) to retail and wholesale customers in New Zealand. The W Living segment includes procurement of discount general merchandise and pet products for resale to retail customers in Australia and New Zealand. The Other segment comprises Quantium and various support functions.

name: DEVELOP GLOBAL LTD
businessSummary: Develop Global Ltd is engaged in exploration and development of base metals and mining services. The Company is also involved in operations of its underground mining services division Develop Mining Services Its segments include mining services and mining and exploration. The Company’s projects include Sulphur Springs Project, Whim Creek Joint Venture, Woodlawn Project, Pioneer Dome, and Kangan Gold Project. The Sulphur Springs project is located 144 kilometers (km) to the southeast of Port Hedland and includes the Sulphur Springs and Kangaroo Caves deposits together with tenements along the 27 km Panorama Trend that contains six advanced targets that have returned intersections of commercial grade copper and zinc. The Whim Creek Joint Venture Project is located 115 km to the southwest of Port Hedland. The Woodlawn Project is a zinc-copper-lead-gold-silver project located in the Lachlan Fold belt in New South Wales, 250 km south-west of Sydney and 40 km south of Goulburn.

name: SUPERLOOP LTD
businessSummary: Superloop Limited is an Australia-based telecommunications company. The Company operates through three segments: Wholesale, Business and Consumer. The Wholesale segment is defined by large scale telecommunications, data and technology customers who purchase various connectivity services to support their core business services, as well as retail Internet service providers who do not have access to a connectivity network of their own. The Business segment is defined by small, medium and large corporate customers who purchase connectivity services to facilitate their core business. The Consumer segment is defined by customers who purchase basic Internet and mobile phone products for domestic residential use. Its products include national broadband network (NBN) access, NBN TC2, NBN Enterprise Ethernet, dark fiber, fixed wireless access, third party access, security, managed Wi-Fi, VoIP, international ethernet, wavelength and international (including Indigo) subsea cable capacity.

name: GREAT SOUTHERN MINING LTD
businessSummary: Great Southern Mining Limited is an Australia-based gold exploration company. The Company's projects are located within approximately 40 kilometers (km) of operating mills and major operations. It holds exploration licenses totaling 421 square kilometers (km2) in the Duketon Greenstone Belt located to the north of the town of Laverton in Western Australia. The Company is exploring primarily for gold with advanced exploration areas including Amy Clarke and Golden Boulder. The East Laverton Nickel Project comprises four granted exploration licenses covering an area of 405 km2, located approximately 35 km from the town of Laverton. The Mon Ami Project comprises five licenses centered on a permitted mining license, all located in Western Australia. The Edinburgh Park project is located approximately 100 km southeast of Townsville in Queensland and encompasses an area of approximately 1,750 km2 surrounding the high sulphuration epithermal Mt Carlton gold-silver-copper mine.

name: WESTGOLD RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Westgold Resources Limited is a gold producer located in the Murchison and Southern Goldfields regions of Western Australia. Murchison Operations incorporates three processing hubs at Cue, Meekatharra and Fortnum. Its Southern Goldfields operations encompass the Beta Hunt and Two Boys underground mines and smaller open pit operations, all of which are serviced by the 1.6Mtpa Higginsville processing plant. Its operations at Fortnum are located in the Proterozoic age Bryah Basin stratigraphy approximately 150 km northwest of Meekatharra. Its operations around the regional town of Meekatharra encompass Westgold’s central group of assets, including the historic gold mining centres of Meekatharra North, Paddy’s Flat, Yaloginda, Nannine and Reedy’s. Its operations around the regional town of Cue encompass the historic mining centres of Big Bell, Cuddingwarra, Day Dawn and Tuckabianna. The underground Beta Hunt Mine located 600 km from Perth in Kambalda, Western Australia.

name: WESTPAC BANKING CORP
businessSummary: Westpac Banking Corporation is an Australia-based company that provides banking and selected financial services, operating under multiple brands, and predominantly in Australia and New Zealand, with a small presence in Europe, North America, Asia and the Pacific. Its segments include Consumer, Business & Wealth, Westpac Institutional Bank (WIB), Westpac New Zealand and Group Businesses. The Consumer segment provides a full range of banking products and services to customers in Australia through three lines of business consisting of mortgages, consumer finance and cash and transactional banking. The Business & Wealth segment comprises business banking, wealth management, private wealth, and Westpac Pacific. The WIB segment delivers a range of financial products and services to corporate, institutional and government customers. The Westpac New Zealand segment provides banking, and wealth products and services for consumer, business and institutional customers in New Zealand.

name: MOHO RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Moho Resources Ltd is an Australia-based natural resources company advancing early-stage gold and other metals projects in Western Australia through exploration towards development. The Company operates the Silver Swan North Project, located approximately 40 kilometers (km) northeast of Kalgoorlie-Boulder in Western Australia, which lies on the eastern flank of the Kanowna-Scotia Dome within the Boorara Domain. The Weld Range North Project is located in the highly prospective Youanmi Terrane of the Yilgarn Craton in Western Australia. Its Bush Chook Gold Project expanded around 386 square kilometers (km2) in the Mosquito Creek Basin of the Pilbara Craton, Western Australia.

name: TESORO GOLD LTD
businessSummary: Tesoro Gold Limited is an Australia-based gold exploration company. The Company is focused on the acquisition, exploration and development of commercially significant resource projects in Chile, with a focus on gold. It is focused on the exploration and development of the El Zorro Gold Project in the Coastal Cordillera region of Chile. The Ternera Gold Deposit is situated within the El Zorro Gold Project, located 900km north of Santigo in Chile’s Atacama Region. The Ternera Gold Deposit occurs within the El Zorro Gold Project, which covers a total concession holding area of approximately 570 square kilometers, located 130 kilometers (km) north of Copiapo City, in Region III (Atacama) in northern Chile. The Ternera Deposit is over 13 km inland from the Pacific Ocean, 57 km by road from the port town of Caldera. Its subsidiaries include Tesoro Mining Chile SPA, El Zorro S.C.M, Tesoro Australia Pty Ltd, among others.

name: SILVER MINES LTD
businessSummary: Silver Mines Limited is an Australia-based silver exploration company. The Company’s projects include Bowdens Silver Project, Barabolar Project, Tuena Gold Project and Calico North Project. The Bowdens Silver Project is an undeveloped silver deposit in Australia and lies within Exploration License 5920, which is 100% held by the Company. The Bowdens Silver and Barabolar Projects are located in central New South Wales, approximately 26 kilometers east of Mudgee. The consolidated project area comprises 2,115 square kilometers (km2) of titles covering approximately 80 kilometers of strike of the highly mineralized Rylstone Volcanics and underlying sediments, intrusions and volcanics of the Macquarie Arc. The Tuena Gold Project is located 80 kilometers south of the city of Orange in New South Wales. It also holds a significant land position in the Orange/Blayney district covering 747 square kilometers. It also has the right to earn up to 80% interest in the Kramer Hills Project.

name: EQUATORIAL RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Equatorial Resources Limited is an Australia-based company primarily focusing on Africa. The Company is advancing its mineral assets, including the notable Nimba Alliance Iron Ore Project. Its projects also include Badondo Iron Project (Badondo) and Mayoko-Moussondji Iron Project. The Nimba Project covers a large landholding in Guinea's prolific Nimba Iron Ore Corridor and comprises majority ownership of two permits: 100% of the Nimba West permit covering approximately 198 square kilometers (km2), and 56% of the Nimba North permit covering around 107 km2. The Nimba Project is located within a cluster of major iron ore projects where the development of large-scale transport infrastructure to enable efficient economic production is ongoing. Badondo is a potentially large-scale iron project in the northwest of the Republic of Congo, situated within a cluster of world-class iron ore exploration projects. It has retained a 2% royalty on production from the Mayoko-Moussondji Iron Project.

name: AUDINATE GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Audinate Group Limited is a developer of Dante audio over IP networking solutions. Its principal activity is the development and sale of digital Audio Visual (AV) networking solutions. Dante is its technology platform that distributes digital audio and video signals over computer networks. Dante comprises software and chips, cards and modules that are sold to and integrated inside the AV products of its original equipment manufacturer customers. It also provides a series of products and services to AV professionals, including AVIO adapters and management and control software. Its Dante IP networking solution is used in the professional live sound, commercial installation, broadcast, public address, and recording industries. Dante replaces traditional analogue audio cables by transmitting perfectly synchronized audio signals across large distances, to multiple locations at once, using nothing more than an Ethernet cable. It also offers AI-powered, cloud-based camera control technology.

name: VRX SILICA LTD
businessSummary: VRX Silica Limited is an Australia-based silica sand company. The Company is focused on developing its 100% owned silica sand projects at Arrowsmith (North, Brand and Central), Muchea and Boyatup in Western Australia. The Arrowsmith project includes Arrowsmith North, Brand Silica and Central Silica Sand projects, all located approximately 270 kilometers (km) north of Perth, Western Australia. Its 100%-owned Muchea Mining Lease is located approximately 50 km north of Perth, Western Australia. Muchea comprises one granted exploration license, two exploration license applications, one granted mining lease, three granted miscellaneous licenses and one miscellaneous license application for an area of 74.4 km2. The Company’s 100%-owned Boyatup Silica Sand Project is located about 125km east of Esperance in Western Australia and is connected by sealed road to the Esperance Port. Boyatup includes two tenements, E69/3560 and E69/3668, for a total project area of 124 km2.

name: WIDE OPEN AGRICULTURE LTD
businessSummary: Wide Open Agriculture Ltd is an Australia-based ingredient company focusing on the next generation of plant protein ingredients for food and drink manufacturers globally. The Company focused on commercializing its lupin protein isolate products, along with research and product development activities. The Company’s flagship product, Buntine Protein, is a novel plant-based protein derived from lupins. Manufactured under a globally protected patent, Buntine Protein is a versatile ingredient that creates products across multiple categories, including plant-based dairy, meats, baked goods, and health foods. Its subsidiaries include Wide Open Land Pty Ltd, Wide Open Plant Protein Pty Ltd, and Wide Open Agriculture Germany GmbH.

name: KINATICO LTD
businessSummary: Kinatico Limited is an Australia-based provider of know-your-people solutions. The Company’s solutions comprise pre-employment screening, verification services and workforce compliance management internationally. It provides real-time workforce compliance management via its core software-as-a-service RegTech solution. By combining certifications and compliance data with business policy and legislative requirements, the Company enables scalable compliance monitoring spanning preemployment to real-time requirements related to geolocation, roles and tasks applicable across a range of industries. The Company also provides a range of pre-employment checks via its CVCheck solution. This is delivered via its proprietary technology platform, which includes an employment screening and verification offering. Its geographical segments include Australia and New Zealand. It serves various industries, including education, financial services, energy and resources, and insurance.

name: CARNABY RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Carnaby Resources Limited is an exploration and development company. The Company is focused on copper and gold projects in the Mount Isa Inlier of Queensland and the Pilbara’s Mallina Basin and Yilgarn Margin of Western Australia. Its flagship Greater Duchess Copper Gold Project is located approximately 70km southeast of Mount Isa in Queensland and centered around the historical Duchess copper mining district. The Greater Duchess Copper Gold project encompasses 1,921 square kilometers (km2) of Iron Oxide Copper-Gold (IOCG) prospective tenure, including its Mount Hope, Nil Desperandum and Lady Fanny deposits. The Company’s Pilbara Gold and Lithium Projects comprise the Strelley, Mt Grant and Goldsworthy Gold Projects and the Big Hill Lithium Project. Each of these projects are located in the prospective Mallina Basin of Western Australia, northeast of the Hemi gold deposit of De Grey Mining Ltd. Its Yilgarn Margin Projects comprise the Malmac and Throssel Projects.

name: RETAIL FOOD GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Retail Food Group Limited is a food and beverage company. The Company is a multi-brand retail food franchise manager and is the owner of brands, including Gloria Jean’s, Donut King, Brumby’s Bakery, Crust Gourmet Pizza, CIBO Espresso, and Beefy’s Pies, among others. The Company is also a roaster and supplier of coffee products. Its principal activities include intellectual property ownership of the Donut King, Brumby’s Bakery, Crust Gourmet Pizza Bar, Rack ‘em Bones BBQ Ribs, Beefy’s Pies, CIBO Espresso and Gloria Jean’s Coffees Brand Systems; development and or management of the Donut King, Brumby’s Bakery, Crust Gourmet Pizza Bar, Rack ‘em Bones BBQ Ribs, Beefy’s Pies, CIBO Espresso, and Gloria Jean’s Coffees Brand Systems throughout the world, whether directly managed and/or as licensor for all Brand Systems; development and management of the Firehouse Subs Brand System. Its segments include Cafe, Coffee & Bakery Division and Quick Service Restaurant Division (QSR).

name: NEOMETALS LTD
businessSummary: Neometals Ltd is an Australia-based battery materials producer. The Company has developed and is commercializing three environmentally friendly processing technologies. The Company operates through three segments: lithium, titanium/vanadium and other. It is commercializing Lithium-ion Battery (LiB) Recycling technology via Primobius GmbH JV. It is providing recycling service as principal in Germany and commenced plant supply and licensing activities as technology partner to Mercedes-Benz. The Company is involved in commercializing patented ELi electrolysis process to produce battery quality lithium hydroxide from brine and/or hard-rock feedstocks. It also enables sustainable production of high-purity vanadium pentoxide from processing of steelmaking by-product (Slag). Its Barrambie Titanium and Vanadium Project is a highest-grade hard-rock titanium-vanadium deposits. The other segment comprises other minor exploration projects and mineral process technology businesses.

name: HASTINGS TECHNOLOGY METALS LTD
businessSummary: Hastings Technology Metals Limited is an Australia-based rare earths and gold company. The Company is focused on the development of its flagship Yangibana Rare Earths and Niobium Project and Whiteheads Gold Project in the Goldfields Region of Western Australia. Yangibana is located in the Gascoyne region of Western Australia and contains one of the highly valued deposits of NdPr in the world with an NdPr to Total Rare Earth Oxide ratio of up to 52% in some areas of the orebody. The Yangibana Project occupies 650 square kilometers and is located approximately 250 kilometers (km) northeast of Carnarvon in Western Australia. The projected is located on Gifford Creek Station, which covers Thiin-Mah, Warriyangka, Tharrkari and Jiwarli country. The Whiteheads Gold Project is strategically located approximately 80 km northeast of Kalgoorlie, offering access to existing infrastructure, operating mines and gold processing facilities. Its projects also include Brockman and Ark Gold.

name: ZENITH MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Zenith Minerals Limited is an Australia-based mining exploration company. The Company is focused on minerals containing lithium and related metals required for rechargeable lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles and renewable energy storage. It also has a portfolio of gold and base metal deposits located in Western Australia and Queensland. Its projects are Split Rocks Lithium-Tantalum Project, Waratah Well Lithium-Tantalum Project, Hayes Hill Lithium - Nickel Project, Split Rocks Gold Project, Red Mountain Gold-Silver Project and Earaheedy Zinc Project. The Split Rocks Project is located approximately 40 km south of the regional town of Marvel Loch in the Goldfields Region of Western Australia. The Waratah Well project is located over 20 km northwest of the regional town of Yalgoo in the Murchison Region of Western Australia. The Hayes Hill project consists of four granted exploration licenses in a highly mineral prospective corridor north of Norseman in Western Australia.

name: NOVA MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Nova Minerals Limited is an Australia-based gold, antimony and critical minerals exploration and development company. The Company is focused on advancing the Estelle Project, comprising 514 square kilometers (km2) of State of Alaska mining claims, which includes multiple mining complexes across a 35-kilometer-long mineralized corridor of over 20 advanced gold and antimony prospects, including two multi-million-ounce resources, and several drill ready antimony prospects. The 85%-owned project is located 150 kilometers northwest of Anchorage, Alaska, United States of America, in the prolific Tintina Gold Belt, a province which hosts a 220 million-ounce (Moz) documented gold endowment and some of the gold mines and discoveries, including Barrick's Donlin Creek Gold Project and Kinross Gold Corporation's Fort Knox Gold Mine. The Company has two primary gold deposits at Estelle: RPM High-Grade Gold in the South, and Korbel Bulk Tonnage Gold in the North.

name: COUNTY INTERNATIONAL LTD
businessSummary: County International Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company's Polymet Tenement Portfolio includes exploration licenses, such as Mayfield (EL8983) and Shoalhaven (EL9343). Its Copper/Gold Group Tenement Portfolio-Sector-1-Gold consists of exploration licenses, such as Yambulla (EL7547), Nerrigundah (ELA5727), Whipstick (EL8508), Imlay (EL8679) and Wangarabell (EL006612). Its Copper/Gold Group Tenement Portfolio-Sector 2-Copper consists of exploration licenses, such as Dunedoo (EL9173), Koorawatha (EL8740), Murringo (EL8757) and Narrallen (EL8758). EL8983 is about 50 kilometers (km) east north-east of Queanbeyan. EL9343 is located about 30 km north of Braidwood in the Lachlan Fold Belt to the east of the Mayfield tenement. EL7547 covers about 53 square kilometers is located contiguous with the Imlay tenement. EL9173 is located about 10 km northeast of Dunedoo. The Company holds two coal projects located in the Powder River Basin in Wyoming, United States.

name: SIV CAPITAL LTD
businessSummary: SIV Capital Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in renting commercial equipment to businesses. The Company’s subsidiaries include SIV Finance Company Pty Ltd, and GoGetta Equipment Funding Pty Ltd.

name: RTG MINING INC
businessSummary: RTG Mining Inc. is a mining and exploration company. The Company is focused primarily on progressing the Mabilo Project to start-up, with a view to moving quickly and safely to a producing gold and copper company. It also has a number of new opportunities, including the Panguna Project in Bougainville. The Company holds a 40% interest in Mt. Labo Exploration and Development Corporation (Mt. Labo), which owns the high-grade Copper and Gold Mabilo Project in the Philippines. It holds a 90% interest in the Chanach Project. The Chanach Project is located in the prolific southern Tien Shan metallogenic belt. Its Bunawan Project includes four project areas situated in the mineral province of the Pacific Cordillera volcanic arc in the South Philippines. Its Nalesbitan Project is only 15 kilometers (km) west of the Mabilo development project in the historic Paracale Gold District in Eastern Luzon. Its Panguna Copper-Gold Project is located in the Central Region of the island of Bougainville.

name: ADR ON NOVA MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Nova Minerals Limited is an Australia-based gold, antimony and critical minerals exploration and development company. The Company is focused on advancing the Estelle Project, comprising 514 square kilometers (km2) of State of Alaska mining claims, which includes multiple mining complexes across a 35-kilometer-long mineralized corridor of over 20 advanced gold and antimony prospects, including two multi-million-ounce resources, and several drill ready antimony prospects. The 85%-owned project is located 150 kilometers northwest of Anchorage, Alaska, United States of America, in the prolific Tintina Gold Belt, a province which hosts a 220 million-ounce (Moz) documented gold endowment and some of the gold mines and discoveries, including Barrick's Donlin Creek Gold Project and Kinross Gold Corporation's Fort Knox Gold Mine. The Company has two primary gold deposits at Estelle: RPM High-Grade Gold in the South, and Korbel Bulk Tonnage Gold in the North.

name: ADR ON IMMUTEP LTD
businessSummary: Immutep Limited is an Australia-based late-stage biotechnology company. The Company is focused on developing novel immunotherapies for cancer and autoimmune disease. It is focused on advancement of therapeutics related to Lymphocyte Activation Gene-3 (LAG-3), and its diversified product portfolio harnesses LAG-3’s ability to stimulate or suppress the immune response. Its lead clinical candidate is eftilagimod alfa (efti or IMP321) for the treatment of different types of cancers. Efti is the Company’s first-in-class novel immunotherapy that directly activates the immune system to fight cancer, which is under evaluation in TACTI-004 (KEYNOTE-F91), a registrational Phase III trial for the first-line therapy of advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer. Its second in-house product candidate (IMP761) which is in clinical development for the treatment of autoimmune disease, a third product candidate, IMP731, a depleting antibody that could remove T cells involved in autoimmunity.

name: AMERICAN RARE EARTHS LTD
businessSummary: American Rare Earths Limited is an Australia-based critical minerals company. Through its wholly owned subsidiary, Wyoming Rare (USA) Inc., the Company is advancing the Halleck Creek Project in Wyoming, a rare earth deposit. The Halleck Creek Project is located in the Central Laramie Mountains, approximately 70 kilometers (km) northeast of Laramie, and 30 km southwest of Wheatland, Wyoming and covers over 3304 hectares (ha). Through its wholly owned subsidiary Wyoming Rare (USA) Inc., it controls approximately 367 unpatented lode mining claims and four Wyoming State Mineral Leases. Its 100% owned La Paz Rare Earth Project, which is located in La Paz County, Arizona, approximately 170 kilometers northwest of Phoenix. The La Paz Project covers over 2779 ha. Its projects also include Beaver Creek and Searchlight properties. The Searchlight Heavy Rare Earths Project is an exploration project located in a precious metal mining district in the eastern Mojave Desert Region.

name: GELION PLC
businessSummary: Gelion plc is a renewable-energy storage innovator. It conducts research and development in battery system and associated industrial design and manufacturing. The Company is engaged in the development of two battery chemistries-Lithium-Sulfur (Li-S) and Zinc hybrid cell technologies. Its lithium-sulfur and zinc-based storage solutions are designed to be alternatives to lithium-ion and lead-acid battery technologies. The batteries provide energy storage solution (ESS) for applications including stand-alone power system, commercial and industrial, utility scale stationary ESS, and reserve power (uninterrupted power supply, telecom). The Company is also focused on sulfur technology with lithium metal anode for drone and unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV), electric vehicles (EV), e-heavy vehicles and stationary storage.

name: IRON BEAR RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Cyclone Metals Limited is an Australia-based mineral investment, exploration, and evaluation company. The Company is focused on developing its flagship Iron Bear Project, an iron ore project located in the Labrador Trough, Canada. The Iron Bear Project is an iron ore project consisting of around ten licenses totaling 11,025 hectares (ha) and 441 graticular mineral claims which are 100% owned by the Company. The Company’s other projects are Grand Port, Wee Macgregor and Nickol River Gold. Grand Port project holds 100% of six projects over a diversified portfolio of gold, copper, nickel and platinum group elements (PGE) assets in New Zealand. The Company holds a 20% interest in the Wee Macgregor project which comprises three granted mining licenses, ML 2504, ML 2773 and ML 90098. These licenses are located approximately 60 kilometers (km) southeast of Mt Isa. Nickol River Project tenements are located 10km east of Karratha in the West Pilbara of Western Australia.

name: AMERICAN TUNGSTEN & ANTIMONY LTD
businessSummary: American Tungsten & Antimony Ltd is an Australia-based company, which is advancing critical mineral development in Tier-1 United States jurisdictions. Its projects include Antimony Canyon, Tennessee Mountain, Central Idaho Antimony, Achilles Antimony and Nightingale Tungsten. The Company owns 20 patented mining claims covering around 375 acres of the core deposit area. These are surrounded by approximately 360 unpatented lode claims, offering potential for expansion. The Tennessee Mountain Project includes four patented lode claims covering the historic Garnet Mine in Elko County, Nevada: NV106359075 - Tennessee Mountain, NV106359076 - Tennessee Mountain 2, NV106359077 - Tennessee Mountain 3 and NV106359078 - Tennessee Mountain 4. The project, located in the Alder Mining District. The Nightingale Project is a district-scale tungsten exploration opportunity in the historic Nightingale Mining District, Pershing County, Nevada, USA.

name: ION VIDEO LTD
businessSummary: Ion Video Ltd is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in video, creating immersive, deeply personalized viewing experiences. The Company’s patented Video Virtualisation Engine (VVE) turns big, bulky video files into lightweight, searchable data that is enriched with artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML), making it easy and efficient for users to find and share what matters to them. Creators and owners of videos can drive greater viewing and monetization of their video assets.

name: AMERICAN URANIUM LTD
businessSummary: American Uranium Limited, formerly GTI Energy Limited, is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in exploring mineral tenements in the United States of America, including Utah and Wyoming. The Company's projects include Wyoming in situ recovery (ISR) and the Henry Mountains. The Wyoming in situ recovery (ISR) project includes Lo Herma, Great Divide Basin (GDB) and Green Mountain. The Lo Herma ISR Uranium Project is located in Converse County, Powder River Basin (PRB), Wyoming (WY). The Project lies approximately 15 miles north of the town of Glenrock and within 60 miles of five permitted ISR uranium production facilities. The Thor, Teebo, Odin, Loki and Wicket prospects (GDB Prospects) are located within Wyoming’s Great Divide Basin (GDB) Uranium District in Sweetwater County, Wy. The Company has land holdings in the Henry Mountains region of Utah, which include uranium and vanadium mineralization, generally shallow at 20-30 meters average depth.

name: VITASORA HEALTH LTD
businessSummary: Vitasora Health Limited, formerly Respiri Limited, is an Australia-based healthcare technology and services company that focuses on digital Connected Care in the United States healthcare market. The Company offers remote patient monitoring (RPM) and chronic care management (CCM) services. Its Care Management model enables healthcare organizations to extend care beyond their clinics, integrating multi-device remote monitoring, virtual clinical support, and artificial intelligence (AI)-powered decision-making.

name: AUREKA LTD
businessSummary: Aureka Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company holds a portfolio of advanced stage gold exploration projects across Victoria. Its projects include Stawell Corridor, St Arnaud Gold, and Jubilee Gold. The Stawell Corridor Project (which incorporates the Irvine and Langi Logan gold projects and five other prospective targets) captures 60 kilometers (km) of a multi-million-ounce gold zone. Jubilee Gold is a highly prospective exploration project consisting of a single tenement of 122 square kilometers located 25 km south-west of Ballarat, Victoria. Its tenements encompass the historical St Arnaud Goldfield and its associated mines, including the Comstock Open Pit. It owns a 49% contributing interest in the Tandarra Gold Project, which contains three main prospects: Tomorrow, Macnaughtan and Lawry located only 50km northwest of Agnico Eagle’s world-class Fosterville Gold Mine, and 40km north of the 22-million-ounce Bendigo Goldfield.

name: CLEVER CULTURE SYSTEMS LTD
businessSummary: Clever Culture Systems Limited, formerly LBT Innovations Limited, is an Australia-based company that provides intelligent automation solutions to microbiology laboratories. The Company has developed a technology, the Automated Plate Assessment System (APAS Independence), using artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning software to automate the imaging, analysis and interpretation of microbiology culture plates. The technology is a United States FDA-cleared AI technology for automated culture plate reading. The product is being sold to microbiology laboratories in the pharmaceutical manufacturing sector for the reading of environmental monitoring culture plates and to clinical laboratories as an in vitro diagnostic for infectious diseases. Thermo Fisher Scientific, Inc is the exclusive distributor of the APAS Independence to clinical customers in the United States and selected countries in Europe.

name: NEW MURCHISON GOLD LTD
businessSummary: New Murchison Gold Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration and development company. The Company holds a substantial package of tenements in the prolific Murchison goldfield near Meekatharra, Western Australia. Murchison Project comprises approximately 14 exploration licenses and three applications for exploration licenses, encompassing over 460 square kilometers (km2) in the Murchison region of Western Australia. The Company is focused on the Garden Gully Gold Project, which comprises an approximately 677 square kilometers (km2) tenure package covering the Abbots Greenstone Belt (AGB) and other key regional structures. The project has multiple gold prospects along the belt, with the most advanced being the Crown Prince Prospect. Crown Prince Prospect is located within a granted mining lease and is advancing towards development.

name: NEURIZON THERAPEUTICS LTD
businessSummary: Neurizon Therapeutics Limited is an Australia-based clinical-stage biotechnology company. The Company is engaged in advancing treatments for neurodegenerative diseases. It is developing its lead drug candidate, NUZ-001, for the treatment of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS), which is the common form of motor neurone disease. ALS treatments for patients while exploring the potential of NUZ-001 for broader neurodegenerative applications. ALS is a devastating neurodegenerative condition that primarily affects nerve cells that control voluntary muscles. Through international collaborations and rigorous clinical programs, it is focused on creating new horizons for patients and families impacted by complex neural disorders.

name: CRITICA LTD
businessSummary: Critica Limited is an Australia-based company. The principal activity of the Company is mineral exploration and development of the Jupiter Rare Earths Project in Western Australia. Its Brothers Clay-Hosted Rare Earth Project (Brothers) is a large strategic landholding totaling approximately 1,356 square kilometers (km2) of granted tenure, with an additional 435 km2 of licenses under application, all situated on pastoral leases in Western Australia. The Jupiter Project is a high-grade, clay-hosted rare earths deposit located within the broader Brothers landholding. Jupiter is strategically located within the Mt Magnet and Yalgoo mining district. In addition to its primary project, Jupiter and the Brothers Project, it holds exploration licenses in several regions, and those projects include Kulin, Mount Lindsay, and the Livingstone DSO Hematite.

name: ANDEAN SILVER LTD
businessSummary: Andean Silver Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration and development company. The Company is focused on advancing its 100% owned Cerro Bayo Silver-Gold project in the Aysen region of Southern Chile. The Cerro Bayo Silver-Gold project covers 285 square kilometers (km2) and comprises over 70 contiguous exploration concessions as well as surface properties that cover the areas of the Laguna Verde mining district and processing facilities. The Cerro Bayo Silver-Gold Project hosts indicated and inferred mineral resources of 9.8 million tons at a grade of 353 grams per ton for 111 million ounces of contained silver equivalent (AgEq). Its other projects include Hillside Project, Mt Alexander Project and Araluen Project. The Mt Alexander Project (E29/1167) is located on the western margin of the prospective Mt Alexander greenstone belt. The Araluen Project area covers 230 km2 and abuts and covers the southern extents of the Braidwood Granodiorite, host of the Dargues Gold mine.

name: SUN SILVER LTD
businessSummary: Sun Silver Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is engaged in the exploration and evaluation of silver resources in the Elko County and White Pine County regions of Nevada, United States of America. The Company’s Maverick Springs Project is located about 85 kilometers (km) from the fully serviced mining town of Elko in Nevada and is surrounded by several gold and silver mining operations, including Barrick’s Carlin Mine.

name: BLINKLAB LTD
businessSummary: BlinkLab Limited is an Australia-based digital healthcare company focused on Artificial intelligence (AI) powered diagnostics. The Company has fully developed a smartphone based diagnostic platform for autism, Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), schizophrenia, and other neurodevelopmental conditions. Its product is an autism diagnostic test that leverages the power of smartphones, AI and machine learning to deliver screening tests specifically designed for children as young as over 18 months old. Its pipeline includes BlinkLab Dx 1 and BlinkLab Dx N. Its BlinkLab Dx 1 is an autism diagnostic adjunct. Its BlinkLab Dx N is an ADHD diagnostic adjunct.

name: SYNTARA LTD
businessSummary: Syntara Limited is an Australia-based clinical-stage drug development company. The Company is targeting extracellular matrix dysfunction with its amine oxidase chemistry and other technologies to develop novel medicines for blood cancers and conditions linked to inflammation and fibrosis. The Company’s lead candidate SNT-5505 is for the bone marrow cancer myelofibrosis which causes a build-up of scar tissue that leads to loss of red and white blood cells and platelets. The Company is also advancing topical pan-LOX inhibitors in scar revision, keloid scarring and scar prevention post-surgery. Its product candidate, SNT-4728, is an inhibitor to treat sleep disorders and slow progression of neurodegenerative diseases like Parkinson’s by reducing neuroinflammation. The Company’s other drug candidates target fibrotic and inflammatory diseases such as kidney fibrosis, NASH, pulmonary fibrosis and cardiac fibrosis.

name: CADOUX LTD
businessSummary: Cadoux Limited is an Australia-based resources company, which is focused on the exploration and development of critical and strategic mineral projects. The Company’s segments include high purity alumina exploration and evaluation in Australia and potash exploration and evaluation in Asia. Its project includes High Purity Alumina (HPA) and Rare earths. HPA is a processed non-metallurgical alumina product characterized by its purity level. HPA is used for its properties and characteristics, such as corrosion and scratch resistance, high brightness, and its ability to withstand extreme temperatures. HPA is also used as a base material in the manufacture of sapphire substrates for applications, such as light emitting diodes (LEDs), in the manufacture of artificial sapphire glass and in certain battery and power storage components, artificial gemstones and special space, aeronautical and medical applications. Its Rare-Earths are a set of 17 metallic elements.

name: REDIVIUM LTD
businessSummary: Redivium Limited is an Australia-based company, which is a lithium-ion battery recycler. The principal activity of the Company is implementation of the European battery recycling strategy. The Company has rights (via licensing arrangements) to exploit lithium battery recycling technology in certain European jurisdictions such as Scandinavia, Italy, Southeastern Europe, the United Kingdom (UK), and Ireland. The technology has been developed by Neometals Ltd, and is 50% owned by German engineering firm SMS Group GmbH. The Company provides recycling solutions. Its access to this advanced recycling process with low CO2 emissions delivers high purity chemicals back to the battery manufacturing sector. Using a proprietary process, lithium, nickel, cobalt and other valuable materials are recovered from waste lithium-ion batteries (LiBs).

name: G11 RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: G11 Resources Limited is a gold and copper development and exploration company. Its projects include Koonenberry Project, Packsaddle, NW Cobar Project, and Sedgwick Bluff. Its Koonenberry Project is located approximately 80 kilometers (km) east of Broken Hill, New South Wales and covers an area of 3,300 square km, located within the Koonenberry Belt. The area is prospective for copper, gold, lead, silver, and other base metals. Koonenberry Project includes four distinct corridors: The Wilandra Corridor, The Cymbric Vale Corridor, The Wertago Corridor and The Bilpa Corridor. The Sedgwick Bluff Copper/Gold project is located along the strike of the Mount (Mt) Lyell copper-gold mine in the Mt Read Volcanic belt in Tasmania. The Packsaddle Gold/Copper (Au/Cu) project includes the untested Kings Hill anomaly in the Thomson Orogen of NW New South Wales targeting intrusive-related Cu/Au (IRCG) and Orogenic Au. The NW Cobar Copper project is targeting Cobar style base metal deposits.

name: MANY PEAKS MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Many Peaks Minerals Limited is an Australia-based gold and copper focused exploration company. The Company’s projects include Ferke Gold Project, Odienne Gold Project, Oume Gold Project, Baga Gold Project and Aska Lithium Project. The Ferke Gold Project is located in northern Cote d’Ivoire covering 300 square kilometers (km2) in a granted exploration permit license. The Odienne Project is located in northwest Cote D’Ivoire and comprises two granted exploration permits covering a combined area of 758 km2. The Baga Gold Project is a 644 km2 land holding comprised of two recently granted exploration permits located 150 kilometers (km) east of the city of Bouake, Cote d’Ivoire and situated 80 km west of the border with Ghana. The Oume Gold Project is located in south-central Cote D’Ivoire. The Aska Lithium Project is located proximal to Newfoundland’s southwest coast over 45 km east of Cape Ray.

name: BRAZILIAN RARE EARTHS LTD
businessSummary: Brazilian Rare Earths Limited is a mineral exploration company. The principal activity of the Company is exploring for rare earth elements and other critical minerals in the Rocha da Rocha province in the state of Bahia in Brazil. Its segments include Brazil exploration and Corporate. The Rocha da Rocha Project is located in the state of Bahia in Northeast Brazil and is located over 200 kilometers (km) from a port. The Rocha da Rocha Project is comprised over 267 granted exploration permits registered with Brazil’s National Mining Agency. The Rare earths and critical minerals province with multiple discoveries over one million acres of highly prospective exploration ground. The Amargosa Bauxite-Gallium Project is an advanced exploration stage asset, located in the Tier one mining jurisdiction of Bahia, Brazil. The Sulista Project area is located over 80 km southwest of the Monte Alto project.

name: IONDRIVE LTD
businessSummary: Iondrive Limited is an Australia-based battery recycling technology company. The Company primarily focuses on developing and commercializing solutions for lithium battery recycling. Its Hydrometallurgical Battery Recycling project employs a patented, environmentally safe solvent to gently separate critical components from used batteries, providing a safer and more efficient alternative to traditional methods. The Company holds licenses from the University of Adelaide for next-generation battery technologies, including an enhanced performance non-flammable lithium-ion based battery and a low-cost, high-cycle life water-based battery. The Company holds prospective Lithium, rare-earth elements (REE) and precious metals projects. Its lithium projects include Samguen Li Project and Seobyeok Li Project, which has two highly prospective REE projects, including the Jangnam REE Project comprising 10 exploration license applications covering 24.7 square kilo meters (km2).

name: ALGORAE PHARMACEUTICALS LTD
businessSummary: Algorae Pharmaceuticals Limited is an Australia-based artificial-intelligence (AI) enabled pharmaceutical development company. The Company’s proprietary AI platform, Algorae Operating System (AlgoraeOS), is an AI platform that leverages extensive medical and scientific databases from various disciplines within an advanced system at the intersection of AI and pharmaceutical research. Its other drug candidates include AI-116, AI-168, NTCELL. AI-116 is a combination drug candidate made up of cannabidiol (CBD) and an off-patent pharmaceutical ingredient. It is conceptualized to be a potential treatment for dementia, including Alzheimer’s disease. AI-168 is a novel combination drug candidate made up of a cannabinoid and an off-patent pharmaceutical ingredient, which is conceptualized to be a potential treatment for cardiovascular disease, including hypertension. NTCELL is an alginate coated capsule containing clusters of neonatal porcine choroid plexus cells.

name: UNICO SILVER LTD
businessSummary: Unico Silver Limited is an Australian exploration and development company focused on uncovering world-class silver and gold deposits in Argentina’s prolific Santa Cruz province. It holds 100% of the Cerro Leon, Cerro Puntudo, and Joaquin Projects, all are located in silver gold districts, Santa Cruz, Argentina. Its flagship Cerro Leon project is located within the mining friendly Santa Cruz province of Argentina, about 130 kilometers (km) northwest of the port town San Julian. The Cerro Leon Project is in the central Deseado Massif geological province, approximately 45 kilometers northwest of AngloGold Ashanti's Cerro Vanguardia mine. The Joaquin and Cerro Puntudo are located towards the central eastern margin of the Deseado Massif geological province that stretches across southern Argentina into the Chilean southern Andes. The Joaquin and Cerro Puntudo mining properties include over 16 titles, totaling approximately 35,946 hectares.

name: GREENHY2 LTD
businessSummary: GreenHy2 Limited is an Australia-based clean energy company. The Company delivers engineering solutions for renewable energy. The Company has specific expertise in solid state hydrogen storage for use in fuel cells and as hydrogen gas. Its activities include solid state hydrogen storage batteries supported by 100% renewable generation, and construction across the infrastructure, telecommunications, power, renewable energy, industrial and commercial sectors. Its products include GKN products and GKN HY2 Connect. Its GKN products include MINI with 425 kilowatt hours (kWhrs) of Storage, MEDI with two megawatt hours (MWhrs) of Storage and MEGA with four MWhrs of Storage or 250 kilograms (kg) of Hydrogen. The Company's tower systems can be stacked to achieve any size of storage required. GKN HY2 Connect, its digital platform, provides big data and artificial intelligence (AI) control and simulation creating the modelling and predictive capacity required by customers.

name: ENERGY TRANSITION MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Energy Transition Minerals Ltd is an Australia-based exploration and development company. The Company is focused on developing and financing supply chains for the metals and materials that are critical to the decarbonization of the world, with a focus on mineral projects globally. Its projects include Kvanefjeld Project and Villasrubias Project. The Kvanefjeld project is located in an area of southern Greenland, which has approximately one billion tons of mineral resources (JORC-compliant). The project includes various large-scale multi-element resources, including Kvanefjeld, Sorensen and Zone 3. The Kvanefjeld project remains subject to arbitration procedures in the Arbitration Tribunal in Copenhagen. The Villasrubias project is located in the southwest corner of the province of Salamanca close to the Portuguese border and 33 kilometers (km) away from Ciudad Rodrigo, the district capital. The Company is managing exploration projects in Western Europe, North America, and Greenland.

name: SOUTHERN PALLADIUM LTD
businessSummary: Southern Palladium Limited is an Australia-based platinum group metal (PGM) company. The main business activity of the Company is the advancement of Bengwenyama PGM project, located in South Africa. The Bengwenyama Project is a large shallow advanced exploration and pre-development PGM opportunity situated on the Eastern Limb of the Bushveld Complex and south of the Anglo Platinum Modikwa property. The Project lies approximately five km west of the village of Steelpoort, 20 kilometers (km) west-southwest of the larger town of Burgersfort, and 250 km east-northeast of Pretoria. The Project has a total areal extent of 5,279.74 hectares. Two economic reefs, the Merensky and UG2 reefs, occur on the Properties, which extend from surface to a depth of 1,100 meters over 10 km downdip. Both these reefs are primary economic deposits exploited by other platinum mining companies for PGMs and base metals in the region.

name: FINDER ENERGY HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Finder Energy Holdings Limited is an Australia-based oil and gas exploration company. The Company is involved in oil and gas exploration in the Northwest Shelf in Western Australia and the North Sea in the United Kingdom. Its portfolio comprises a mix of development, appraisal and exploration projects, namely North West Shelf - Australia, North Sea - the United Kingdom, and Timor-Leste - North West Shelf. Its Northwest Shelf in Western Australia permits include AC/P 61 and WA-547-P. The AC/P 61 exploration permit is located within the prolific Vulcan Sub-basin. It holds 100% equity in exploration permit WA-547-P comprising an area of around 7,260 square kilometers (km2). It has 76% interest in PSC 19-11, located within the prolific Laminaria High oil province in the Bonaparte Basin. Its North Sea permits include P2610, P2530, P2655 and P2656. The P2530 permit has an area of approximately 576 km2.

name: GREENX METALS LTD
businessSummary: GreenX Metals Limited is focused on the exploration of Tannenberg Copper Project and the Arctic Rift Copper (ARC) Project. The Tannenberg Copper Project is a copper brownfield exploration project which is highly prospective for sediment-hosted (Kupferschiefer type) copper deposits. It holds an over 90% interest in the Tannenberg exploration license, which covers over 1900 square kilometers in the state of Hesse in central Germany, encompassing the Richelsdorf copper-silver mines. The ARC project is the copper-silver bearing Discovery Zone, located at the northern end of Neergaard Dal. The Discovery Zone comprises three parallel breccia faults trending northwest-southeast. Mineralization is expressed in two main forms, within which there are two sub-forms: Breccia bound, and Stratiform. In Breccia bound, mineralization occurs in thin quartz. In Stratiform, mineralization occurs immediately adjacent to the faults. Its Eleonore North project in Greenland is located in Eastern Greenland.

name: CUFE LTD
businessSummary: CuFe Ltd is a mineral producer and explorer with holdings, or rights or interests in, various tenements prospective for copper, lithium, gold, rare earths and iron ore located in Western Australia and the Northern Territory. Its main focus is its mature iron ore assets in Western Australia (JWD Iron Ore Project) and the Northern Territory (Yarram Iron Ore Project) and copper asset (Tennant Creek Copper Project). The JWD Iron Ore Project is located in Western Australia, 700 kilometers from Geraldton Port. It holds a 50% interest in Gold Valley Iron and Manganese Pty Ltd, the owner of the iron ore rights over the Yarram project. It owns 55% interest in the Tennant Creek project. It owns West Arunta (niobium) and Tambourah (lithium) exploration tenure. It owns North Dam Lithium and Rare Earths Project- E 15/1495, M15/1893 (certain mineral rights), and M15/1495. Its other projects include Bryah Basin Joint Venture Projects, Morck Well Project, Peak Hill Project and Mt Ida Iron Ore Project.

name: WA1 RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: WA1 Resources Ltd is an Australia-based mineral company. The Company is primarily involved in the mineral exploration and project development in Western Australia. The Company owns 100% of two exploration projects in Western Australian. The West Arunta Project, which contains the Luni niobium deposit, is located in Western Australia, approximately 590 kilometers (km) west of Alice Springs. The Madura Project tenements are located approximately 540 km east of Kalgoorlie, with noncontiguous tenements extending to near the south coast of Western Australia. The exploration project comprises seven granted Exploration Licenses and two Exploration License applications in the Madura Province of southeastern Western Australia.

name: INOVIQ LTD
businessSummary: INOVIQ Ltd is an Australia-based biotechnology company developing diagnostics and therapeutics for cancer. The Company's commercialized products include EXO-NET exosome isolation technology for biomarker discovery and diagnostics development, and the hTERT test as an adjunct test for bladder cancer. The Company is also advancing clinical-stage diagnostics for the detection and monitoring of ovarian and breast cancers, and early-stage exosome therapeutics for solid tumors.

name: ECHOIQ LTD
businessSummary: EchoIQ Limited is an Australia-based artificial intelligence (AI) and medical technology company. The Company uses AI-driven technology and software to improve decision-making in cardiology. The principal activity of the Company is the development of AI software that aids in predicting Aortic Stenosis heart condition. The Company’s EchoSolv platform harnesses AI-driven analysis of echocardiographic data to assist clinicians in detecting aortic stenosis and other conditions. Its EchoSolv product allows users to assess echocardiographic studies against diagnostic guidelines for structural heart conditions. EchoSolv automatically identifies patients at risk of structural heart disease. EchoSolv improves the standard clinical workflow associated with diagnosis and treatment. The Company’s subsidiaries include HWH Software Pty Ltd, Echo IQ Global Pty Ltd and Echo IQ Incorporated.

name: FELIX GOLD LTD
businessSummary: Felix Gold Limited is an Australia-based gold discovery company operating in the Tintina Gold Province. The Company’s flagship asset is a substantial landholding in a Fairbanks Gold District, where historical gold production exceeds 16 million ounces. The Company holds an interest in gold projects within the Fairbanks District of the Tintina Gold Province. The Company's projects include Treasure Creek Project, Grant-Ester Project and NE Fairbanks Project. The Treasure Creek Project area consists of over 236 Alaska State Mining Claims that cover 11,573 hectares (ha). The Grant-Ester Project is comprised of over 154 Alaska State mining claims that total 3,397 ha. The NE Fairbanks Project is comprised of over 326 Alaska State mining claims that total 14,637 ha located approximately 25 kilometers (km) to the Northeast of the city of Fairbanks. The MHT Project comprises Alaskan State Mining claims of over 6,203 acres located only 20 km north of mining and logistics hub, Fairbanks City.

name: WIA GOLD LTD
businessSummary: Wia Gold Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the gold exploration business focused on the Kokoseb discovery in Namibia. The Company’s Kokoseb Gold Project is located in north-west Namibia approximately 320 kilometers by road from the capital city of Windhoek. The Kokoseb Gold Project lies within the Okombahe Exploration License, which is held under a joint venture by the Company (80%) and the Namibian state-owned mining company, Epangelo. The Okombahe EL is part of its broader Damaran Belt tenure in Namibia, which consists of approximately 12 tenements across a total area of over 2,700 square kilometers (km2).

name: FALCON METALS LTD
businessSummary: Falcon Metals Limited is a mineral exploration company. Its projects include the Pyramid Hill Gold Project, Mount Jackson Project, and Farrelly Mineral Sands Project. Its joint venture projects include Viking Project Joint Venture and Hawkstone Project Joint Venture. The Pyramid Hill Gold Project covers an area of more than 7,000 square kilometers predominately in the Bendigo region of Victoria. The Mt Jackson project area is located at the northern end of the Southern Cross Belt where it converges with the Koolyanobbing Shear Zone. The 100%-owned Farrelly Mineral Sands Project is located about 80 kilometers (km) northwest of Bendigo, near the town of Boort in Victoria. The Viking Project Joint Venture is located approximately 30 km east of the regional township of Norseman. The project consists of one granted exploration license (E63/1963) and one license application (E63/1994). The Hawkstone Project Joint Venture is located in the emerging West Kimberley magmatic nickel province.

name: LARVOTTO RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Larvotto Resources Limited is a resources company. The Company is advancing its portfolio of in-demand minerals projects, including the 1.7Moz AuEq high-grade Hillgrove Gold-Antimony Project in New South Wales (NSW), the Mt Isa copper, gold, and cobalt project adjacent to Mt Isa townsite in Queensland, the Eyre multi-metals and lithium project located 30 kilometers (km) east of Norseman in Western Australia and a gold exploration project at Ohakuri in New Zealand's North Island. The Hillgrove Gold-Antimony Project covers 254 square kilometers and comprises six key mining areas within 48 granted mining licenses. Mt Isa Project is located in northwest Queensland, Australia. The Eyre Project is located approximately 600 km east of Perth, Western Australia, and 200 km south of the major mining center of Kalgoorlie and covers an area of approximately 580 square kilometers. The Ohakuri Project is in the north island of New Zealand and consists of a partially explored epithermal gold system.

name: RADIOPHARM THERANOSTICS LTD
businessSummary: Radiopharm Theranostics Limited is an Australia-based clinical-stage radiotherapeutics company developing a platform of radiopharmaceutical products for diagnostic and therapeutic applications in areas of high unmet medical need. The Company has a pipeline of highly differentiated platform technologies spanning peptides, small molecules and monoclonal antibodies for use in cancer. The clinical program includes one Phase II and three Phase I trials in a variety of solid tumor cancers including lung, breast, and brain. Its technologies include Nano-mAbs, Pivalate, AVB6 Integrin, PSA-mAb, and PTPu. Nano-mAbs is a novel radiopharmaceutical platform made using genetic engineered camelid derived single domain antibodies (sdAb) labelled with a radioisotope of therapeutic radiation. Pivalate is an 18F-FPIA radiotracer, based on a short chain carbohydrate which utilizes the early steps of fatty acid oxidation.

name: GREEN TECHNOLOGY METALS LTD
businessSummary: Green Technology Metals Limited is focused on the lithium exploration and development business. The Company’s main 100% owned Ontario lithium projects comprise high-grade, hard rock spodumene assets (Seymour, Root, Junior and Wisa) and lithium exploration claims (Allison, Falcon, Gathering, Pennock and Superb) located on prospective Archean Greenstone tenure in north-west Ontario, Canada. The Seymour Project is located near the township of Armstrong and approximately 230 kilometers (km) north of the city and the port of Thunder Bay. Its Junior Lithium Project covers over 10,856 hectares and is situated within the Eastern Hub, close to the proposed Seymour mine and concentrator. The Company’s 100% owned Root Lithium Project has revealed multiple stacked LCT pegmatites, and a maiden Inferred Mineral Resource estimate of over 14.6Mt @ 1.21% lithium oxide from the McCombe and Root Bay pegmatites. Its subsidiaries include Lithium Triangle Pty Ltd and Green TM Resources (Canada) Ltd.

name: MINERALS 260 LTD
businessSummary: Minerals 260 Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration and development company. The Company's projects include the Moora Project, Aston Project, and Bullabulling Project. The 100%-owned Moora Project is located 140km north-east of Perth in the Wheatbelt Region of Western Australia. The Moora Project consists of three granted exploration licenses and one exploration license application registered in the name of the Company’s subsidiary, ERL (Aust) Pty Ltd, covering approximately 371 sq km. The Aston Project is located in the Gascoyne Region of Western Australia, approximately 850 km north of Perth and 100 km northeast of the township of Gascoyne Junction. The Aston Project consists of 15 granted exploration licenses and two exploration license applications. The Bullabulling Project is an undeveloped gold deposit, located 25km south-west of Coolgardie in the Western Australian Goldfields. Its subsidiaries include ERL (Aust) Pty Ltd and Minerals 260 Holdings Pty Ltd.

name: AURUM RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Aurum Resources Limited is an Australian gold exploration company focused on the discovery and development of gold projects in Cote d'Ivoire, West Africa. The Company's projects include Napie Gold Project and Boundiali Gold Project. The Napie Gold Project covers approximately 224 square kilometers (km2) and consists of the Tchaga and Gogbala deposits located on the Napie shear. The Napie Gold Project is a shallow, open pittable, high-grade resource with a maximum resource depth between 160 meters and 195 meters across the two deposits and has access to hydroelectricity, bitumen road and water. It has 100% ownership of the Korhogo Project (manganese discovery) and the Brobo Project (lithium/rare earths). The Boundiali Gold Project is comprised of four neighboring exploration tenements: Boundiali Minex Tenement PR0893, Boundiali DS tenement PR808, Boundiali South tenement PR414 and Boundiali North tenement PR283. The Company owns and runs approximately eight diamond drill rigs.

name: HAWSONS IRON LTD
businessSummary: Hawsons Iron Limited is an Australia-based company. The principal activity of the Company is mineral exploration and development of the Hawsons Iron Project. Its flagship Hawsons Iron Project is located approximately 70km from Broken Hill, New South Wales. The Company's tenements include Redan, Burta, Little Peak, Wonga and Hawsons Iron, which cover approximately 180 square kilometers (km2), 290 km2, 41 km2, and 287 km2 respectively. The Company is advancing green steel production through high-grade magnetite concentrate. Its dry processing technology produces high-grade magnetite concentrate (68.4% Fe).

name: LI-S ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Li-S Energy Limited is engaged in development and commercialization a new type of battery based on Lithium-Sulphur (Li-S) and using boron nitride nanotubes (BNNT) as both an integrated protective insulation layer and a component in composite anodes, which allows faster charging rates and increased battery cycle life. The Company produces batteries in pouch, cylinder and flexible battery formats to address the needs of partners and prospective customers who manufacture drones, electric cars, electric trucks, other electric vehicles, space and other applications. Its lithium sulfur batteries are lighter, cleaner and greener and deliver more than twice the energy density of lithium ion. BNNT is an advanced nanomaterial with physical properties. It takes advantage of its physical strength, thermal conductivity and electrical resistance as well as some electrochemical properties to enhance its lithium sulfur and lithium metal batteries.

name: MIDAS MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Midas Minerals Ltd is a junior mineral exploration company with a primary focus on copper and precious metals. Its projects include the Newington Project, Challa Gold, Nickel-Copper-PGE Project, Reid-Aylmer Project, Otavi Project, and Greenbush Lithium Project. The Reid-Aylmer Project has mineral claims totaling about 157 square kilometers (km2) located northeast of Yellowknife, in the Northwest Territories of Canada. The Greenbush lithium project covers over 102 km2 and is located 12 km east of Highway 599, about 95 km north of Savant Lake and 70 km south of Pickle Lake. The Newington Lithium-Gold Project has 212 km2 of tenements located at the north end of the Southern Cross greenstone belt. Its Challa Gold, Nickel-Copper-PGE encompasses over two exploration licenses and three license applications totaling 860 km2 and an option for a 47 km2 exploration license. It has the 1,776 km2 high-grade Otavi Copper Project and holds an option over the 194 km2 South Otavi Project in Namibia.

name: CLARITY PHARMACEUTICALS LTD
businessSummary: Clarity Pharmaceuticals Ltd is an Australia-based clinical-stage radiopharmaceutical company. The Company is focused on developing targeted copper theranostics based on its SAR Technology Platform. It is progressing clinical trials with its approximately three key products, SARTATE, SAR-bisPSMA, and SAR-Bombesin. Its lead product, SAR-bisPSMA, is progressing through over three clinical trials: one theranostic trial (SECuRE) and two Phase III diagnostic trials (CLARIFY and AMPLIFY). SARTATE is developed for diagnosing, staging, and treating cancers that express somatostatin receptor 2 (SSTR2). SAR-bisPSMA is developed for diagnosing, staging, and treating prostate cancer that expresses prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA). SAR-Bombesin is developed for identifying and selecting patients for subsequent treatment of cancers that express a specific receptor called the gastrin releasing peptide receptor (GRPr), including breast cancer and prostate cancer.

name: ELEVATE URANIUM LTD
businessSummary: Elevate Uranium Ltd is an Australia-based uranium exploration company. The Company is engaged in the exploration and evaluation of its mineral tenements in Namibia and Australia and enhancing the value through the potential application of the Company’s patented U-pgrade uranium beneficiation process to those mineral tenements. Its Namibia tenements include Koppies, Hirabeb, Namib IV, Marenica Uranium Project, and Capri. The Company holds around ten active tenements in the Erongo Region of Namibia, each at varying stages of exploration advancement. The Koppies tenement (EPL 6987) is located in the Namib Desert region of Namibia. The Capri tenement (EPL 7508) is located in the Erongo uranium province in Namibia. In Australia, the Company's tenements consist of the 100% owned Angela, Thatcher Soak, Oobagooma and Minerva Projects and holdings in the Bigrlyi, Malawiri, Walbiri and Areva Joint Ventures. The Angela tenement (EL25758) is a sandstone-hosted roll-front type uranium deposit.

name: METALLIUM LTD
businessSummary: Metallium Limited, formerly MTM Critical Metals Limited, is engaged in recovering critical and precious metals from mineral concentrates and high-grade waste streams. The Company is focused on deploying its patented Flash Joule Heating (FJH) technology for strategic metals recovery in the United States.
