The FJH process enables single-step extraction of critical, strategic, and precious metals, including antimony, gallium, germanium, indium, gold, and rare earths, from electronic waste and mineral concentrates, without smelting or acids. It also owns gold and rare-earth element projects in Canada and Australia, which include the Pomme Project, East Laverton Gold Project, Mt Monger Gold Project and West Arunta Project. The Pomme Project, located in Quebec, Canada, consists of over 43 mineral claims, covering approximately 2,400 hectares. The East Laverton Project covers over 1,900 square kilometers (km2) in the prolific Eastern Goldfields region of Western Australia.

name: CAMPLIFY HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Camplify Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company that operates peer-to-peer digital marketplace platforms connecting recreational vehicle (RV) owners to hirers. The Company’s platform delivers a seamless and transparent experience for consumers (potential RV hirers) to connect with RV owners and SMEs with a fleet of RVs. Its segments include Hire, Membership and Other. It has a global family of RV rental marketplace brands. The brands include Camplify, PaulCamper, and MyWay. The Company provides a range of caravans, motorhomes, camper trailers and campervans for hire via the respective platforms. MyWay provides insurance solutions to RV marketplace customers, and PaulCamper is a peer-to-peer van-sharing platform connecting van owners with travelers. It operates in seven key markets, such as Australia, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, Spain, Germany, the Netherlands, and Austria. Its subsidiaries include Camplify Co (Australia) Pty Ltd, Camplify Co (NZ) Limited, and others.

name: CLEAN TEQ WATER LTD
businessSummary: Clean TeQ Water Limited is an Australia-based water treatment company. It is a global technology company, specializing in providing economic and environmentally sustainable solutions to address critical issues related to freshwater scarcity, mine tailings, and metal recovery. Its technology solutions include desalination, nutrient removal, zero liquid discharge and hardness removal. Its core markets include water and wastewater recycling, lithium production, and the remining and rehabilitation of mine tailings. Its technologies include CIF (continuous ionic filtration), HIROX (ultra-high recovery RO), DESALX (membrane free desalination), BIOCLENS (lens encapsulated bacteria), BIONEX (complete nutrient removal), and EVAPX (low energy evaporation and crystallization), among others. Its solutions include ammonia removal, boron removal, hardness removal, sulphate removal, uranium removal, and others. It has a presence in locations, including Melbourne, Perth, Darwin, Beijing, and others.

name: BARTON GOLD HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Barton Gold Holdings Limited is an Australia-based gold developer. The Company is focused on the production of 150,000ozpa with 2.1Moz Au & 3.1Moz Ag JORC Mineral Resources (78.9Mt @ 0.85 g/t Au), brownfield mines, and 100% ownership of the single gold mill in the Gawler Craton of South Australia. Its projects include Challenger Gold Project, Tarcoola Gold Project, Tunkillia Gold Project and Wudinna Gold Project. The Challenger Project is located approximately 730 kilometers (km) northwest of Adelaide, South Australia and about 130 km northwest of the Tarcoola Project. It comprises the Challenger Mine, the Challenger Mill, a mine village and associated infrastructure. The Tunkillia Project is located about 70 km S/SE of the Tarcoola Project on a 1,360 square kilometer (km2) tenement package which hosts a 1.5Moz Au JORC Mineral Resource Estimate. The Tarcoola Project is located over 70km N/NW of the Tunkillia Project on about 1,640 km2 of tenements.

name: BESRA GOLD INC CPI
businessSummary: Besra Gold Inc. is an Australia-based gold mining company focused on exploration and development of the Bau Goldfield in East Malaysia. The Company controls, directly and indirectly, a 98.5% interest (93.8% on an equity-adjusted basis) in the Bau Gold Project located in Sarawak, East Malaysia. Its interests in mining tenements extend across four concessional areas, collectively covering around 1,340 square kilometers (km2) of Sarawak; the Bau Gold Project (consisting of Blocks A and B), Rawan and Serian (Block C) areas. Its development activities are focused on the Jugan Project located within the Bau Gold Project. Its Jugan Project is located approximately six kilometers (kms) northeast of the Bau township. Gold is associated with sulfide (refractory) mineralization within the shale dominated lithologies of the Pedawan Formation, locally outcropping as a topographic high at Jugan Hill. Its Bekajang Project lies along a prospective trend that includes two historical gold mines.

name: LUNNON METALS LTD
businessSummary: Lunnon Metals Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in mineral resource exploration and development, with a focus on nickel and gold. The Company's segments include Gold mineral exploration and Nickel mineral exploration in Western Australia. The Company’s principal activities include its Kambalda Gold & Nickel Project (KGNP), which consists of approximately 47 square kilometeres (km2) of tenements, located immediately south of Kambalda, Western Australia. The KGNP features approximately 47 km2 located approximately 570 kilometers (km) east of Perth and 50-70 km south-southeast of Kalgoorlie, in the Eastern Goldfields of Western Australia. KGNP comprises two project areas, the Foster and Baker Project (in which the Company holds the tenure and associated mineral rights, including nickel and the majority of gold rights) and the Silver Lake and Fisher Project (in which the Company holds only the nickel rights and minerals directly associated with nickel).

name: SUNRISE ENERGY METALS LTD
businessSummary: Sunrise Energy Metals Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in the development of its Sunrise Battery Materials Complex (Sunrise Project) in New South Wales (NSW). The Sunrise Project is a supplier of battery raw materials and aluminum-scandium alloys. It is utilizing its Clean-iX resin technology for extraction and purification of a range of metals and progressing exploration activities at its other mineral tenements. Its Clean-iX Continuous Resin-In-Column is a continuous counter-current process that extracts metals from clarified leach solutions. Its Clean-iX Continuous Resin-In-Pulp is a continuous countercurrent process that directly extracts metals from leached pulps. It is advancing activities across its range of exploration assets in NSW. Its limestone exploration includes Hunters (EL9627), EL8883 Meloola and EL8833 Boona Gap, Gleninga South (EL9598) and Gleninga (EL8882). It also focused on rare earth elements exploration, which includes Minore (EL9031 and EL8961).

name: FIREBIRD METALS LTD
businessSummary: Firebird Metals Limited is an Australia-based advanced manganese developer. The Company is focused on combining mining and downstream processing for the advancement of the electric vehicle (EV) battery sector. Its projects include Oakover Manganese Project, China Battery Grade Manganese Plant, Wandanya Project and Hill 616 Manganese Project. The Oakover Manganese Project is located approximately 85 kilometers (kms) east of Newman in the Eastern Pilbara region of Western Australia. The Hill 616 Manganese Project is located over 85 kms southeast of Newman within the Peak Hill Mineral Field. Wandanya Project consists of two exploration license applications, E46/1456 and E46/1457, which cover an area of 51 square kilometers (Km2) located in the Eastern Pilbara Region of Western Australia. Its other projects include Disraeli Manganese Project, and Midgengadge Manganese Project.

name: BOAB METALS LTD
businessSummary: Boab Metals Limited is an Australia-based exploration and development company with interests in Australia and South America. The Company’s projects include The Sorby Hills, The Manbarrum Project, and The Eight Mile Creek Project. The Company is focused on the development of its Sorby Hills Lead-Silver-Zinc Project (Sorby Hills), located within the Kimberley Region of Western Australia. The Project is located 50 kilometers (km) from Kununurra and 150km from Wyndham Port. Its Manbarrum Project is located within the Northern Territory, 25 km east of the Company’s flagship Sorby Hills Project. Its Eight Mile Creek exploration tenements cover around 206 square kilometers of relatively under-explored tenure immediately south of Sorby Hills. The Company's subsidiaries include Pacifico Holdings SAS, Pacifico Minerals Sucursal Colombia, Sorby Hills Pty Ltd, Sorby Management Pty Ltd, West Rock Resources Panama Corp., West Rock Resources Pty Ltd, and Manbarrum Pty Ltd.

name: SPARC TECHNOLOGIES LTD
businessSummary: Sparc Technologies Limited is engaged in developing new technologies to disrupt and transform industry while seeking to deliver a more sustainable world. It is focused on developing new technologies in graphene additive materials, photocatalytic green hydrogen and sodium-ion batteries, which have a positive impact on climate change and sustainability. It is developing a portfolio of sustainable technologies focused on the renewable energy sector. Its Graphene is a 2D material made of carbon atoms arranged in a hexagonal lattice which creates properties capable of transforming and disrupting global industries. Its renewable energy sector is pioneering a dynamic portfolio of sustainable technologies designed to reshape the future of energy production and storage. Its Graphene Based Additives are developed for targeted applications in the marine and protective coatings market. Its ecosparc products for anticorrosive epoxy coatings deliver a 40% improvement in anticorrosive performance.

name: CASPIN RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Caspin Resources Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company, which is engaged in early-stage exploration and development. Its projects include the Bygoo Project, Yarawindah Brook Project and the Mount Squires Project. The Bygoo Project is an advanced, high-grade tin project located in a prolific tin-producing region. The Bygoo Project is positioned within the Wagga Tin Granites, a mineralized belt with many occurrences of tin and associated metals, the project surrounds the Ardlethan Tin Mine. Its Yarawindah Brook Project is located in the West Yilgarn region, a new mineral province hosting the Gonneville PGE-Ni-Cu Deposit owned by Chalice Mining Limited, only 40km to the south. Mount Squires is a large-scale, greenfield gold, rare earths and base metal project located in the West Musgrave region of Western Australia. The project is located adjacent to the western border of the West Musgrave mine development, which hosts the Nebo-Babel Ni-Cu sulfide deposits.

name: MARVEL GOLD LTD
businessSummary: Marvel Gold Ltd is a resource company. The Company is a gold explorer with advanced exploration projects and substantial landholdings in the country’s key gold-bearing regions. Its projects include Hanang Gold Project, Yanfolila Gold Project, and Kolondieba Gold Project. The Hanang Gold Project is a regional gold project, located within a highly prospective, underexplored greenstone belt on the Eastern Margin of the +70Moz gold endowed Lake Victoria Gold Field. The Yanfolila Project is in southern Mali, 45 kilometers north of Endeavour Mining’s Kalana gold project and 35 km east of the hummingbird resources Yanfolila gold mine. The 200 square kilometer Kolondieba Project is prospective for gold mineralization in a similar structural setting to the Morila mine and the Tabakorole deposit. Kolondieba Project is located 70 km north-west of Resolute Mining’s Syama gold mine and 50km south of Barrick Gold’s Morila gold mine.

name: 4DMEDICAL LTD
businessSummary: 4DMedical Limited is an Australia-based medical technology company specializing in advanced diagnostic imaging solutions. Leveraging its proprietary XV Technology and Imbio Technology, the Company provides cutting-edge thoracic imaging that enhances physician diagnoses and management of respiratory conditions. XV technology delivers detailed insights to airflow, lung structure, and regional lung function through a patient’s complete breath cycle. It produces software and hardware products that enable new levels of non-invasive, quantitative analysis of lung function. Its products include CAC (Coronary Artery Calcification), CT-LVAS (Computed Tomography Lung Ventilation Analysis Software), IQ-UIP, LDAf (Functional Lung Density Analysis), LDAi (Lung Density Analysis-Inspiration), LTA (Lung Texture Analysis), PHA Analysis (Pulmonary Hypertension Assessment), XV LVAS (X-ray Velocimetry Lung Ventilation Analysis Software), and XV Scanner.

name: ATOMO DIAGNOSTICS LTD
businessSummary: Atomo Diagnostics Limited is an Australia-based medical device company. The Company supplies integrated rapid diagnostic test (RDT) devices to the global diagnostic market. The Company’s patented devices simplify testing procedures, enhance usability and improve reliability across rapid point-of-care (POC) and at-home testing applications. The Company has commercialized a number of products across international markets and has supply agreements in place for testing applications targeting infectious diseases, including COVID-19, HIV, viral vs bacterial differentiations as well as the early detection of pregnancy. Its products include Atomo HIV Self-Test, AtomoRapid Pascal and AtomoRapid Curie, among others. Its Atomo HIV Self-Test is an integrated, blood-based rapid diagnostic test (RDT) for HIV screening, which provides results in 15 minutes. The AtomoRapid Pascal platform offers improved performance and usability in point of care testing.

name: AML3D LTD
businessSummary: AML3D Limited is an Australia-based technology company. It is disrupting metal part supply chains using the Company’s patented wire additive manufacturing (WAM) process. WAM combines state-of-the-art welding science, robotics automation, materials engineering, and proprietary software to lead metal additive manufacturing globally. It is the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) of the ARCEMY industrial metal 3D printing systems. ARCEMY uses WAM to provide advanced, automated, point-of-need 3D manufacturing solutions that are efficient, cost-effective and have ESG outcomes compared to traditional casting, forging and billet machining processes. ARCEMY is the Internet of Things (IoT) and Industry 4.0 enabled to allow manufacturers across aerospace, defense, maritime, manufacturing, mining and oil & gas to become globally competitive. It also provides metal 3D printing design engineering services, software licensing, technical support, consumable sales and contract manufacturing services.

name: ECOGRAF LTD
businessSummary: EcoGraf Limited is an Australia-based integrated battery anode materials developer. The Company is engaged in building a diversified battery anode material business to produce high-purity graphite products for the lithium-ion battery and advanced manufacturing markets. In Tanzania, it is developing the TanzGraphite natural flake graphite business, commencing with the Epanko Graphite Project, to provide a scalable supply of feedstock for EcoGraf battery anode material processing facilities, together with quality flake graphite products for specialized industrial applications. Using its EcoGraf HFfree purification technology, the Company seeks to upgrade the flake graphite to produce 99.95%C high performance battery anode material to supply electric vehicle, battery and anode manufacturers in Asia, Europe and North America. The Company’s EcoGraf purification process recycles battery anode materials to support customers to reduce carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions and lower battery costs.

name: RAREX LIMITED
businessSummary: RareX Limited is a critical minerals company specializing in rare earths and niobium in hard rock carbonatites. It is engaged in curating a portfolio of carbonatite related prospects within which the Khaleesi Project represents the exploration flagship. The exploration focus of the business is on the Khaleesi Project in the East Yilgarn which is a district-scale, elevated-niobium, and alkaline intrusive complex. The Company's engineering and commercial focus is on offtake and approvals at the mid-study-level, Cummins Range Project, a carbonatite hosted rare earth and phosphate project, containing magnet grade rare earths and battery grade phosphates and undeveloped rare earths project. The new Khaleesi Project is located along strike from Ponton Dyke, the Cundeelee carbonatite, and the Tropicana Gold mine. The Khaleesi Project is located adjacent to the Mulga Rocks deposits on the transition of the Yilgarn Craton to the Albany-Fraser Belt, specifically in the Northern Foreland Unit.

name: SKY METALS LTD
businessSummary: Sky Metals Limited is focused on the exploration and development of mineral resources in Australia. The Company’s project portfolio offers exposure to tin, gold, copper, and other critical metals projects in the mining jurisdiction of New South Wales. Its tin projects include Tallebung Tin Project, Doradilla Project and Narriah Project. Its gold projects include Cullarin Project, Caledonian Project, and Kangiara project. Its gold-copper projects include the Iron Duke Project and Galwadgere project. Its 100% owned flagship project is Tallebung project is located over 70 kilometers (km) north-west of Condobolin in central-western New South Wales. The Doradilla Project is located approximately 45 km south-east of Bourke in western New South Wales and is considered prospective for polymetallic tin, copper, silver, bismuth, indium and zinc mineralization. The Narriah Project (EL9524) is located approximately 10 km south-southeast of Rankin Springs in southwest New South Wales.

name: AFRICAN GOLD LTD
businessSummary: African Gold Ltd is an Australia-based company. The principal activities of the Company consist of exploration and evaluation of mineral resources. It operates through two segments: Exploration and evaluation of Minerals in Cote d’Ivoire and Exploration and evaluation of Minerals in Mali. Its projects include Didievi Project, Agboville Project, Konahiri Project, Koyekro Project, Kedougou-Kenieba Project, and Syama Shear Zone Project. The Didievi Project located in central Cote d’Ivoire, approximately 35 kilometers (km) from the capital, Yamoussoukro, and 60km from operating low-grade mines. The Agboville Project covers an area of 1,400 square kilometer (km2) and is located in the southeast of the West African Craton. he Konahiri North (391 km2) and Konahiri South (354 km2) Applications are situated in the central portion of the NNW-trending Kotiola Marabadrassa Birimian Greenstone Belt, in central Cote d’Ivoire.

name: YANDAL RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Yandal Resources Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is focused on exploring its portfolio of highly prospective 100% owned gold projects located in the Yandal and Norseman-Wiluna Greenstone Belts in Western Australia. Its projects include Ironstone Well-Barwidgee and Mt McClure. The Ironstone Well-Barwidgee Project covers approximately 370 square kilometers (km2) of prospective and under-explored tenure located between the Jundee and Bronzewing mines in the northern Yandal Greenstone Belt. The Mt McClure Project is located approximately 15 kilometers (km) south-west of the historic Bronzewing gold mine and 10 km from Orelia gold mine both owned by Northern Star Resources Ltd in the southern Yandal Belt. The project covers a total strike length of over 17 km of prospective stratigraphy and includes several shallow historical open-cut pits.

name: HERAMED LTD
businessSummary: HeraMED Limited is an Australia-based medical data and technology company. The Company is engaged in the digital transformation of maternity care by transforming the prenatal and postpartum experience with its hybrid maternity care platform. The Company offers a proprietary platform that utilizes hardware and software to reshape the doctor/patient relationship using its clinically validated in-home fetal and maternal heart rate monitor, HeraBEAT, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and big data. The HeraBEAT medical device is used by pregnant women in Europe, the United States, Israel and Australia. The Company’s proprietary offering, HeraCARE, is engineered to offer a fully integrated maternal health ecosystem designed to deliver care to ensure expectant mothers are engaged, informed and well-supported, allowing healthcare professionals to provide quality care and enable early detection and prevention of potential risks.

name: ALDORO RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Aldoro Resources Limited is a mineral exploration and development company. The Company has a portfolio of critical mineral projects, including rare earth, niobium, lithium, rubidium and base metal projects. Its project is the Kameelburg REE/Niobium Carbonatite Project in Namibia. Its other projects are based in Western Australia, including the Wyemandoo lithium-rubidium project, the Niobe lithium-rubidium-tantalum Project and the Narndee Igneous Complex in Western Australia. The Wyemandoo critical metal pegmatite project comprises four exploration licenses (E57/1017, E58/571, E58/555 and E59/2431) that overlie part of the Windimurra Igneous Complex. The Niobe Rb-Li Project consists of 195-ha mining lease application over part of the Dalgaranga-Mount Farmer pegmatite swarm located approximately 70-kilometer northwest of Mount Magnet. The Narndee Project covers a large portion of the ultramafic zone of the Narndee Igneous Complex.

name: SULTAN RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Sultan Resources Limited is an Australia-based exploration company. The Company has a portfolio of mineral exploration projects in Australia that are prospective for gold, copper, nickel and cobalt. Its projects include Lachlan Fold Belt, East Tallering Gold, Dalwallinu Gold, Thadunu Gold/Copper/Minerals, and Lake Grace Nickel/Cobalt/Gold. The Lachlan Fold Belt projects comprise granted exploration licenses, EL8734, EL8704 and EL8735, which together cover a total area of approximately 330 square kilometers (km2). The East Tallering project is prospective for gold mineralization and comprises one granted tenement covering approximately 67 km2. The project is 450 kilometers (km) northeast of Perth and 180 km northeast of Geraldton, Western Australia (WA). The Dalwallinu Gold project has the potential for the discovery of high-grade gold deposits, which comprise tenements covering approximately 167 km2. The project is approximately 250 km northeast of Perth, WA.

name: NEUROSCIENTIFIC BIOPHARMACEUTICALS LTD
businessSummary: NeuroScientific Biopharmaceuticals Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in developing peptide-based pharmaceutical drugs that target a number of neurodegenerative conditions with high unmet medical demand. The Company's product portfolio includes EmtinB, a therapeutic peptide initially targeting glaucoma, as well as other Emtin peptides (EmtinAc, EmtinAn and EmtinBn). EmtinB is a peptide-based compound that binds to surface-based cell receptors from the LDLR family, activating intracellular signalling pathways that stimulate neuroprotection, neuroregeneration and modulate neuroinflammation. EmtinB is modelled on a specific active domain of the complex human protein called Metallothionein-IIA, which is produced as part of the human body's innate immune response to cell injury. Its StemSmart is a global patented technology engaged in manufacturing cell products. The use of its proprietary StemSmart technology in a special access program for fistulising Crohn’s disease.

name: CONSTELLATION RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Constellation Resources Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in exploration for minerals and other commodities. Its projects include Edmund Collier, Yerrida and Ashburton Projects (natural hydrogen projects); Ularring Copper Gold Project; and Orpheus Project. Its natural hydrogen projects expand over a total area of 87,602 square kilometers (km2) in Western Australia across the Edmund-Collier, Yerrida and Ashburton Basins, intersecting and/or in proximity to the Goldfields gas transmission. The Ularring Copper Gold Project consists of tenements E70/4686, E70/4901, E70/6671 covering 222 km2, and is located 100 kilometers (km) northeast of Perth. The Orpheus joint operation area consists of a 70% interest in three mineral exploration licenses, E28/2403, E63/1281, E63/1282, and a 100% interest in E28/2738 and E28/2957, and one exploration license under application, E63/1695 all located in Fraser Range province and targets nickel-copper sulphide mineralization.

name: ZOONO GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Zoono Group Limited is an Australia-based global biotech company that develops, manufactures and distributes a suite of antimicrobial solutions in multiple countries. The Company produces sprays, wipes and foams suited for skin care, surface sanitizers and mold remediation treatments. Its products are based on the ZOONO molecule, an antimicrobial molecule that bonds to any surface and kills pathogens including bacteria, viruses, algae, fungi and mold. The Company markets its products in various countries, including Australasia, Asia, United States, India, United Kingdom and Europe. Its subsidiaries include Zoono Group Limited (NZ), Zoono Limited, Zoono Holdings Limited (UK), Zoono EU Limited, Zoono (Shanghai) Biotech Co. Limited, Zoono Holdings USA LLC and Zoono South Africa (Pty) Ltd.

name: ZEUS RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Zeus Resources Limited is a mineral exploration company. The Company holds 12 granted tenements and applications. These tenements include five granted tenements: one at Wiluna, two at Kalabity and two at Wydgee. There are seven applications for new tenements, including three adding to the Mortimer Hills Project, one adding to the Wiluna Project, one adding to the Blue Hill Project and two adding to the Kalabity Project. The Wiluna Project consists of one granted exploration license (EL), E53/1603, and one EL application, E53/2197, located near the township of Wiluna, approximately 540 km north of Kalgoorlie. The Mortimer Hills Project comprises three EL applications (E09/2791, E09/2798 and E09/2874), located over five kilometers (km) east southeast along the strike from DLI’s Yinnietharra Lithium Prospect. It also owns six exploration licenses with an area of approximately 79 square kilometers (km2) comprising the Casablanca Antimony Project located in central Morocco.

name: YOJEE LTD
businessSummary: Yojee Limited is an Australia-based logistics technology company focused on simplifying freight operations through digital innovation. The Company is a developer and provider of software solutions to the Asian Pacific contracted road transportation industry. Its platform enables logistics providers to consolidate complex supply chain networks into a single, intuitive system. Its cloud-based software-as-a-service (SaaS) logistics platform facilitates the flow of freight movements into a single ecosystem. Its Transport Carrier Management System (TCMS) platform enables real-time collaboration, execution, and visibility across transport operations. The Company is also developing its MOSAIC platform, the freight forwarding software that simplifies complex logistics with an intuitive user-focused interface. The Company serves third-party logistics providers (3PLs), global freight forwarders, major shipping lines, and large-scale manufacturers.

name: WEST WITS MINING LTD
businessSummary: West Wits Mining Limited is an Australia-based company focused on the exploration, development, and production of precious and base metals. The Company’s projects include Witwatersrand Basin project (WBP) and Mt Cecelia project. The Witwatersrand Basin project is located in the gold region of Central Rand Goldfield of South Africa boasts, an approximately 5.025 million ounces (Moz) gold project. The Witwatersrand Basin is a largely underground geological formation which surfaces in the Witwatersrand. In Western Australia, the Company is exploring gold and copper at the Mt Cecilia Project in a district that supports several world-class projects such as Woodie Woodie manganese mine, Nifty copper and Telfer gold/copper/silver mines. The Mt Cecelia project is located on the border of the East Pilbara and Paterson Provinces of Western Australia and covers approximately 225 square kilometers (km2) of prospective ground, strategically located adjacent to tenements held by Rio Tinto Ltd.

name: WHITE CLIFF MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: White Cliff Minerals Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company, pioneering high grade copper discoveries in a Tier 1 Jurisdiction. The Company’s projects include RAE Copper-Silver Project and Great Bear Copper-Gold-Silver-Uranium Project. The RAE Copper-Silver Project, located in Nunavut, is prospective for a range of copper-silver mineralization styles. The RAE Copper-Silver Project is located on mainland Canada, 75 kilometers (km) from nearest town of Kugluktuk, providing support and a deep-water port. The RAE Copper-Silver Project covers an area of approximately 1,228 square kilometers (km2). The Great Bear Lake Project is located 240 km southwest of the Company’s RAE Copper-Silver Project and the settlement of Kugluktuk covers an area of approximately 2,900 km2 of the iron oxide copper gold prospective Great Bear Magmatic Zone (GBMZ). The GBMZ is an extensively hydrothermally altered and mineralized Proterozoic continental andesitic stratovolcano-plutonic complex.

name: WEEBIT NANO LTD
businessSummary: Weebit Nano Ltd is an Australia-based developer and licensor of advanced semiconductor memory technology. The Company’s Resistive RAM (ReRAM) addresses the growing need for higher performance and lower power non-volatile memory (NVM) solutions in a range of new electronic products, such as Internet of Things (IoT) devices, smartphones, robotics, autonomous vehicles, fifth generation (5G) communications and artificial intelligence. Its ReRAM technology is based on fab-friendly materials and can be easily integrated with existing flows and processes. It is creating ReRAM IP that customers can embed in their system-on-chip (SoC) designs. It is also developing discrete (stand-alone) memory technology, targeting storage class memory, persistent memory and NOR flash replacement. Weebit ReRAM is ideal for applications requiring high temperature and endurance levels, offering a power efficient NVM that is easy to integrate and tolerant to radiation and electromagnetic fields.

name: VIKING MINES LTD
businessSummary: Viking Mines Limited is an Australia-based company that is engaged in investing in mineral exploration projects. The Company’s projects include Canegrass Battery Minerals Project and Riverina East Project. The Canegrass Battery Minerals Project is located in the Murchison region, approximately 620 kilometers (km) north-east of Perth, Western Australia. Its Canegrass Battery Minerals Project has three deposits at Fold Nose, Kinks and Kinks South. The Riverina East Project is centered around the high-grade First Hit gold mine situated along the prospective Ida and Zuleika Shear zones in the Eastern Goldfields of Western Australia. The Riverina East Project is located over 50km west of the sealed Goldfields highway and the township of Menzies. The Company has acquired Linka Project, which is a tungsten project located in Nevada, United States. The Linka Project encompasses the approximately three historic mines of Linka, Hillside and Conquest.

name: TYRANNA RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Tyranna Resources Limited is an Australia-based mineral explorer primarily focused on lithium exploration in Angola, Africa. The Company's Muvero Lithium Project is located near the Port of Namibe (or Mocamedes), where drilling is targeting spodumene mineralization. The Muvero Lithium Project covers 207 square kilometers (km2) area targets the Giraul pegmatite field, in which at least-1000, pegmatites have been identified. The exposed pegmatites are up to 1,500m long and up to 100m wide, presenting as patches of outcrop surrounded by rubble and shallow soil derived from eroded rock. It also owns 72% the Namibe Lithium Project. The Namibe Lithium project is located in undeveloped land east of the city of Namibe, provincial capital of Namibe Province in southwest Angola. The Namibe Lithium Project is located approximately 25 kilometers (km) east of the Port of Namibe.

name: TTA HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: TTA Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company. The principal activity of the Company is trading via e-commerce and selling to retail customers through TEAC Store Website and various e-commerce platforms. The Company operates through a single segment, which is sale of electronic consumer goods via e-commerce in the Australian market.

name: TORO ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Toro Energy Limited is an Australia-based uranium development and exploration company with projects in Western Australia. The Company’s portfolio includes uranium deposits in the north-eastern goldfields region of Western Australia known as Centipede-Millipede, Lake Maitland, Lake Way, Dawson Hinkler and Nowthanna. The Centipede-Millipede, Lake Maitland and Lake Way deposits collectively form the Wiluna Uranium Project (Wiluna Uranium Project). The Dawson Hinkler and Nowthanna deposits are advanced exploration prospects. Wiluna Uranium Project is centered on its planned processing facility located 30 kilometers (km) south of the town of Wiluna in the northern goldfields of Western Australia. Its Theseus Uranium Project is located near Lake Mackay on the Western Australian/Northern Territory border; and has an interest in an incorporated joint venture with Deep Yellow Limited that owns prospective exploration tenure in Namibia.

name: TALISMAN MINING LTD
businessSummary: Talisman Mining Limited is an Australia-based mineral development and exploration company. The Company is engaged in the exploration, discovery and development of opportunities in base and precious metals. It has secured tenements in the Cobar/Mineral Hill region in Central New South Wales (NSW) through the grant of its own exploration licenses and through a joint venture agreement. Its projects include Lachlan NSW Project, Macquarie NSW Project, and Mabel Creek IOCG Project. The Lachlan NSW Project has a highly prospective base metals and copper-gold tenure, with a 6,000 square kilometers (km2) exploration portfolio in the Lachlan Fold Belt, NSW. The Yarindury Prospect is an undrilled anomaly in a lightly explored project within the Macquarie Arc Porphyry Cu-Au corridor of New South Wales. Yarindury is located over 30km north-east of Dubbo in NSW. The Mabel Creek Prospect is a lightly explored project within the Gawler Craton Iron Oxide Copper-Gold (IOCG) corridor of South Australia.

name: TALGA GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Talga Group Ltd is an Australia-based battery materials and technology company. The Company is engaged in the development of sustainable battery materials via technology and vertical integration of its 100% owned Swedish graphite resources. Its flagship product, Talnode-C, is a natural graphite anode material made using renewable energy for a low emissions footprint. Its battery materials under development include an advanced silicon anode product and conductive additives for cathodes. It is also advancing the commercialization of its silicon anode, Talnode-Si. Its product portfolio also includes recycled graphite anode product, Talnode-R. It owns 100% of multiple mineral assets of graphite, copper, cobalt and iron in northern Sweden. Its projects include the Vittangi Anode Project, Vittangi Graphite Project, Jalkunen Graphite Project, Kiskama Copper-Cobalt Project, Raitajarvi Graphite Project, Masugnsbyn Iron Project, and Other Battery Metals Project.

name: TUNGSTEN MINING NL
businessSummary: Tungsten Mining NL is a resources company, which is primarily focused on the discovery and development of tungsten deposits in Australia. The Company's key projects are Mt Mulgine in Western Australia & Watershed in northeast Queensland and Hatches Creek in the Northern Territory. Mt Mulgine is located in the Murchison Region of Western Australia, approximately 350 kilometers (km) north northeast of Perth. The Watershed Project is located 130 km north of Cairns in a mining-friendly jurisdiction. The Hatches Creek Project is located 375 km northeast of Alice Springs in the Northern Territory of Australia. The Project consists of two granted exploration licenses' covering 31.4 km2 (EL22912 and EL23462), which cover the entire historic Hatches Creek tungsten mining center.

name: TARUGA MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Taruga Minerals Limited is a mineral exploration company. The Company is focused on acquiring and developing gold, copper and precious metals exploration projects in Australia. Its projects include the Gascoyne Project, Mt Craig Copper Project, Flinders Iron-Oxide-Copper-Gold (IOCG) Project, Meekatharra Magmatic Ni-Cu Project and Torrens IOCG Project. The Company’s Gascoyne Project consists of four contiguous exploration licenses, E08/3245, E08/3733, E08/3734 and E08/3752, covering 416.5 square kilometers (km2) in the prospective Gascoyne province of Western Australia. The Mt Craig Copper Project includes exploration licenses EL 6541, EL 6695 and EL 6829, covering over 1,712km2 centered around a major structure, the Worumba Anticline. The Company holds an approximately 20% interest in the Meekatharra Project, which includes exploration license E51/1832, located 30km southeast of the regional center of Meekatharra in the Murchison region of Western Australia.

name: SOVEREIGN METALS LTD
businessSummary: Sovereign Metals Limited is an Australia-based company is focused on developing its Kasiya Rutile-Graphite Project (Kasiya) in Malawi. Kasiya is located in the Lilongwe District of the Southeastern African country of Malawi. Kasiya’s Mineral Resource Estimate (MRE) is 1.8Bt at 1.0% rutile resulting in over18 Mt tons of contained natural rutile. The MRE has broad zones of very high-grade rutile, which occur contiguously across a very large area of over 200 square kilometers. Kasiya’s graphite by-product Mineral Resource Estimate (MRE) is 1.8 Bt at 1.4% graphite, containing over 24.4 Mt tones of contained natural graphite. The Kasiya Rutile-Graphite deposit is in an area northwest of Malawi’s capital of Lilongwe called the Lilongwe Plain.

name: STRIKE RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Strike Resources Limited is an Australia-based resource company. The Company owns the high-grade Apurimac Iron Ore Project in Peru. Its principal activities include the development of a small-scale direct shipping Iron Ore (DSO) operation in relation to the Apurimac Iron Ore Project. The Apurimac Iron Ore project is located in the Southern Highlands of Peru, which has concessions totaling approximately 72,800 hectares. Apurimac Iron Ore project contains a JORC mineral resource of 269 metric tons of Iron ore at Opaban of 57.3% Iron. The Company's mineralization include Iron, Silica, Alumina, Phosphorus, and Sulphur.

name: STARPHARMA HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Starpharma Holdings Limited is an Australia-based biotechnology company specializing in advancing dendrimer technology. The Company's principal activities are focused on the research, development and commercialization of dendrimer technology for pharmaceutical and healthcare applications. The Company's portfolio of dendrimer-based products includes three clinical-stage dendrimer enhanced product (DEP) assets, preclinical radiopharmaceutical assets, research collaborations, and three commercially marketed over the counter (OTC) products. Its clinical-stage assets, DEP SN38, DEP cabazitaxel, and DEP docetaxel, are dendrimer-based chemotherapeutic drugs. Additionally, the Company has a preclinical pipeline of DEP radiopharmaceuticals in development. It also manufactures and sells SPL7013 (astodrimer sodium) proprietary products: VivaGel BV, Viraleze nasal spray, and VivaGel condom. The Company has applied its DEP technology to the innovative area of antibody-drug conjugates.

name: STRATEGIC ELEMENTS LTD
businessSummary: Strategic Elements Limited is an Australia-based pooled development fund (PDF). The Company’s segment includes Resources and Technology. The Company is managed primarily on the basis of its exploration projects (Resource segment) and research and development of the energy ink cell and robotics and AI solutions (technology segment). Its ventures include Australian Advanced Materials, Stealth Technologies and Other ventures. Energy Ink is a renewable energy technology that generates electrical energy from moisture in the air to power a device directly or provide energy for battery storage. Stealth Technologies is focused on developing autonomous security vehicles (ASV) for perimeter security. Stealth Technologies has also systematically advanced the application of key components of its ASV technology to develop a new product application.

name: SILEX SYSTEMS LTD
businessSummary: Silex Systems Limited is a technology commercialization company, the primary asset of which is the SILEX laser enrichment technology (SILEX technology). It is focused on the commercialization of its SILEX laser-based enrichment technology for application to key global markets: uranium production and enrichment (nuclear power), silicon enrichment (silicon quantum computing) and medical isotope enrichment (new cancer therapies). Its segments include Silex Systems, Translucent and Silex USA. Its technology includes SILEX Laser Isotope Separation Technology, SILEX Uranium Enrichment Technology, Global Laser Enrichment and SILEX Quantum Silicon Production for Quantum Computing. SILEX technology has been under development for uranium enrichment jointly with licensee, Global Laser Enrichment LLC. It is focused on the development of additional commercial applications of SILEX technology, including the production of Quantum Silicon for the emerging technology of silicon-based quantum computing.

name: RHYTHM BIOSCIENCES LTD
businessSummary: Rhythm Biosciences Ltd is an Australia-based medical diagnostics company. The Company is engaged in delivering simple, affordable blood tests for accurate and early detection of cancers. It is focused on improving patient outcomes through detection at the earliest possible stage, reducing the global burden of cancer and saving lives. The Company’s blood-based technology, a blood test for the detection of Colorectal Cancer (CRC). The ColoSTAT Test-Kit measures five specific protein biomarkers that indicate the likelihood of CRC. The test is an alternative for individuals who are unable or unwilling to participate in current screening programs. It is being updated to meet the IVDR (In vitro diagnostic medical devices regulation) regulatory standards. Its geneType platform personalized predictive test portfolio that uses a combination of genomic and clinical information to predict risk of chronic disease development.

name: RED METAL LTD
businessSummary: Red Metal Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The principal activities of the Company are acquisition and exploration of mineral prospects in Australia. The Company's projects include Pulkarrimarra Project Copper-Cobalt & Gold-Copper, Gulf copper-gold project and Lawn Hill Project. Its funded projects include Gidyea copper-gold project, Corkwood Copper-Gold project, Three Ways Project, Pardoo Nickel-Copper and Gold project, Punt Hill and Pernatty Lagoon Copper-Gold project, Nullarbor Project, and Callabonna Copper-Gold project. The Company's other projects are located in the regions, including Queensland, Western Australia and Northern Territory. The Corkwood project is situated about 100 kilometers northwest of Glencore’s Ernest Henry copper-gold mine and about 60 kilometers north of the Little Eva copper-gold deposit.

name: PYC THERAPEUTICS LTD
businessSummary: PYC Therapeutics Limited is an Australia-based clinical-stage biotechnology company creating a new generation of ribonucleic acid (RNA) therapies to change the lives of patients with genetic diseases. The Company utilizes its proprietary drug delivery platform to enhance the potency of precision medicines within the rapidly growing and commercially proven RNA therapeutic class. Its drug development programs target monogenic diseases - the indications with the highest likelihood of success in clinical development. Its first-in-class drug programs include Retinitis Pigmentosa type 11, (VP-001), Polycystic Kidney Disease, (PYC-003), Autosomal Dominant Optic Atrophy (ADOA) (PYC-001) and Phelan-McDermid Syndrome (PMS) (PYC-002). The Company's VP-001 program is a lead asset for a blinding eye disease of childhood progressed through multiple patient cohorts in the ongoing single ascending dose clinical trial. ADOA is a progressive and blinding eye disease.

name: PRESCIENT THERAPEUTICS LTD
businessSummary: Prescient Therapeutics Limited is a clinical-stage oncology company. It is engaged in developing personalized medicine approaches to cancer, including targeted and cellular therapies. Its product pipeline includes PTX-100, CellPryme-M, and OmniCAR. PTX-100 is a first-in-class targeted therapy which can disrupt the RAS family pathway by inhibiting the prenylation action of the enzyme GGT-1. PTX-100 is in a Phase 2a clinical study in refractory/relapsed Cutaneous T Cell Lymphoma with Fast Track Designation. CellPryme-M is a high-performance cell therapy enhancement platform that can improve CAR-T efficacy. The CellPryme platform consists of two distinct components which can be used separately but have significant synergies when used together. OmniCAR is a universal CAR platform that is controllable, with plug and play capabilities to enable a wider range of cancers to be targeted. OmniCAR enables controllable T-cell activity and multiantigen targeting with a single cell product.

name: PROSPECT RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Prospect Resources Limited is an Australia-based company, which is focused on the exploration and development of electrification and battery metals mining projects in the broader sub-Saharan African region. The Company’s projects include Omaruru Lithium Project, Step Aside Lithium Project and Mumbezhi Copper Project. The Mumbezhi Copper Project is situated in the world-class Central African Copperbelt region of north-western Zambia. It is located on two fully permitted Large Scale Mining Licenses (39445-HQ-LML; 39465-HQ-LML), covering an area of approximately 356 square kilometers. The area is prospective for large tonnage, low to medium grade copper deposits. The Omaruru Lithium Project, comprising the EPL 5533 tenement, is centered on the village of Wilhelmstal, east of Karibib in Namibia and covers approximately 132 square kilometers. The Step Aside Lithium Project is located approximately 35km from Harare and approximately 8 kilometers north of the Arcadia Lithium Mine Project.

name: POLYNOVO LTD
businessSummary: PolyNovo Limited is an Australia-based medical technology company. The Company’s business includes designing, manufacturing and selling biomedical devices. Its principal activity is the development of medical devices for medical applications, utilizing the patented bioabsorbable polymer technology NovoSorb. NovoSorb is a family of proprietary medical grade polymers that can be utilized to manufacture medical devices designed to support tissue repair. NovoSorb polymer devices can be expressed in a variety of physical formats including foam, coatings, fibers, plastic structures, films, and biologic carriers. Its products include NovoSorb Biodegradable Temporizing Matrix (BTM) and NovoSorb MTX. NovoSorb BTM is a bilayer dermal matrix for the regeneration of the dermis when lost through extensive surgery, trauma or burn. NovoSorb MTX has applicability for single stage grafting in burns, chronic, and surgical wounds.

name: PLS GROUP LTD
businessSummary: PLS Group Limited, formerly Pilbara Minerals Limited, is a global producer of lithium materials, with a diversified portfolio of assets and strategic partnerships in the rapidly growing battery materials sector. It owns 100% of the independent hard-rock lithium operation, the Pilgangoora Operation in Australia, and the Colina Lithium Project in Brazil. It is also integrated into the lithium value chain through its joint venture with POSCO Pilbara Lithium Solution Co Ltd in South Korea, which manufactures battery-grade lithium hydroxide. Pilgangoora Operation is located 140 kilometers (km) southeast of Port Hedland, in Western Australia’s resource-rich Pilbara region, in Nyamal and Kariyarra Country. The Colina Project is located 10 km from the town of Salinas in the mining jurisdiction of Minas Gerais, Brazil.

name: PROTEOMICS INTERNATIONAL LABORATORIES LT
businessSummary: Proteomics International Laboratories Ltd is an Australia-based medical technology company. The Company is engaged in predictive diagnostics and bioanalytical services. It specializes in the area of proteomics, the industrial scale study of the structure and function of proteins. It focuses on developing and commercializing diagnostic tests for chronic diseases. Its principal activities fall into three key areas: commercialization of PromarkerD, the predictive test for diabetic kidney disease (DKD) and future kidney function decline in patients with type 2 diabetes; precision diagnostic tests in development: the Promarker pipeline, and specialist accredited analytical services on a commercial basis. Its Promarker pipeline and analytical services include PromarkerEndo, PromarkerEso and OxiDx technology. PromarkerEndo is a prototype diagnostic test for endometriosis identifying up to 90% of patients with the disease. PromarkerEso is a prototype diagnostic test for esophageal cancer.

name: PENINSULA ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Peninsula Energy Limited is an Australia-based uranium mining company. The Company owns the Lance Project (Lance) and Dagger Project. The Lance Project is located in Wyoming, United States of America, operated through its 100% owned subsidiary, Strata Energy Inc (Strata). The Lance Projects comprise the Ross Production Project Area, Kendrick Development Project Area and Barber Exploration Area. The Lance Projects are located in Crook County, in northeastern Wyoming, approximately 31 miles east-northeast of the town of Gillette and extend over a strike length of 37 kilometers (kms) to the north, and over a strike width of eight km. It holds mineral rights and surface access rights over a non-contiguous north-south distance of about 50 km. In Wyoming, the Company has mineral rights of over 43,358 acres and surface access rights over land holdings of 11,982 acres. The Dagger Project in Crook County, Wyoming lies within the North Black Hills district in the northeast corner of the state.

name: PALADIN ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Paladin Energy Ltd is an Australia-based independent uranium producer with 75% ownership of the Langer Heinrich Mine (LHM) located in Namibia. The Company also owns a portfolio of uranium exploration and development assets in the mining jurisdictions of Canada and Australia. Its segments include Australia, Namibia and Canada. The LHM is located in central western Namibia, approximately 80 kilometers (km) east of Swakopmund and 85 km northeast of the Walvis Bay deepwater harbor. Its Patterson Lake South (PLS) Project hosts the Triple R deposit, a high-grade and near-surface uranium deposit. The property comprises over 49 claims covering approximately 57,622 hectares. It owns a number of greenfield exploration projects that are prospective for hosting high-grade uranium, including West Cluff, Larocque, Seahawk, Merlin, Corsair and Typhoon. Its projects also include Michelin (Labrador, Canada), Mount Isa and Manyingee projects in both Queensland and Western Australia.

name: PREDICTIVE DISCOVERY LTD
businessSummary: Predictive Discovery Limited is an Australia-based exploration and development company. The Company is engaged in identifying and developing gold deposits within the Siguiri Basin, Guinea. The Company’s key asset is the Tier-1 Bankan Gold Project. The Company is focused on its Bankan Gold Project, located in the North-East of Guinea. The Bankan Gold Project is located in the North-East of Guinea, which lies within the Siguiri Basin, which is part of the prolific West African Birimian/Archean gold belts that stretch from Mali, through Guinea, Cote d’Ivoire, Burkina Faso and into Ghana. The project is 550 kilometers (km) by road from Guinea’s capital Conakry within the region of Upper Guinea (Haute-Guinee) and is near the regional administrative center of Kouroussa. Its Bankan license area covers 356 square kilometers in four exploration permits: Kaninko, Saman, Bokoro and Argo. It also has exploration assets near the NEB and BC deposits. It is also focused on the Koundian Project.

name: PANCONTINENTAL ENERGY NL
businessSummary: Pancontinental Energy NL is an Australia-based petroleum (oil and gas) exploration company. The Company is focused on conventional oil and gas projects. It has key assets in Africa (Namibia) and Australia (Queensland). The Company’s portfolio includes resource potential, offshore oil projects. The project in Namibia includes Orange Basin PEL 87. The project in Australia includes Onshore Cooper Eromanga Basin, which includes ATP 920 and ATP 924. The Orange Basin PEL 87 is located approximately 10,947 square kilometers in Orange Basin, Offshore Namibia. The ATP 924 is located approximately 2,220 square kilometers in Cooper Eromanga Basin.

name: ODYSSEY GOLD LTD
businessSummary: Odyssey Gold Limited is an Australia-based gold explorer. The Company is focused on its high-grade gold projects in the Murchison Goldfields. The Company holds a land position of approximately 169 square kilometers (km2) in the prolific Murchison Goldfields. The Murchison Goldfields is host to a 35 million ounces (Moz) gold endowment. It holds an 80% interest in the Tuckanarra and Stakewell gold projects (Tuckanarra Project). The Tuckanarra Project is located between Meekatharra and Mount Magnet, proximal to multiple gold processing plants, along the Great Northern Highway. The Tuckanarra Project area has open pits, extensive minor gold workings, and prospecting pits principally associated with quartz veins and the mafic and banded iron formations (BIF) units. Its Stakewell Project area is located within the Meekatharra-Wydgee Greenstone belt within the north-eastern Murchison Domain. The Project area covers Archean basement rocks.

name: NEXUS MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Nexus Minerals Limited is an Australia-based resource company. The Company is engaged in mineral exploration in Australia. It has a portfolio of gold projects. Its projects include Wallbrook Gold Project, Pinnacles Joint Venture Gold Project, Jamieson Minerals New South Wales (NSW) Lithium-Caesium-Tantalum (LCT) Project, Pinnacles Regional Gold Project, and Bethanga Porphyry Copper-Gold Project. The Wallbrook Gold Project is located approximately 140 kilometers (km) northeast of Kalgoorlie in the Eastern Goldfields. The Pinnacles Joint Venture Gold Project covers over 125 square kilometers (km2) and is located approximately 100 km northeast of Kalgoorlie. The Pinnacles Regional Gold Project covers over 125 km2, located 100 km Northeast of Kalgoorlie. The Bethanga Porphyry Copper-Gold Project site is located over 300 km northeast of Melbourne and 30 km east of the regional center of Albury Wodonga.

name: NEUROTECH INTERNATIONAL LTD
businessSummary: Neurotech International Limited is an Australia-based clinical-stage biopharmaceutical development company. The Company focuses predominately on pediatric neurological disorders with a broad-spectrum oral cannabinoid drug therapy called NTI164. It has completed a Phase II/III randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial in autism spectrum disorder (ASD). In addition, it has completed and reported significant and clinically meaningful Phase I/II trials in ASD and pediatric autoimmune neuropsychiatric disorders associated with streptococcal infections (PANDAS) and pediatric acute-onset neuropsychiatric syndrome (PANS), collectively PANDAS/PANS along with Rett Syndrome. NTI164 is being developed as a therapeutic drug product for a range of neurological disorders in children where neuroinflammation is involved. The Company’s subsidiaries include AAT Research Ltd and AAT Medical Ltd.

name: MAGNUM MINING AND EXPLORATION LTD
businessSummary: Magnum Mining and Exploration Limited is an Australia-based company, which is focused on Buena Vista Magnetite and HIsmelt Green Pig Iron Project, located in Nevada in the United States. The Company is also developing the Appalachian Iron HIsmelt Green Pig Iron Project located in West Virginia, United States. It owns 100% interest in Monomatapa Mining Services Inc, which holds the Parker and Mormon Canyon Projects. The project assets include two packages of prospective copper-gold properties situated in Arizona and Idaho, United States. The Company owns 100% interest in EV Resources Inc, which holds the La Cienega Gold Project situated in Arizona, United States. It owns 100% interest in Palmares Estudos Geologicos LTDA, which owns a major portfolio of Rare Earth Element (REE) prospective mineral exploration licenses. Its Azimuth 125 and Palmares REE Projects are located across the states of Bahia, Minas Gerais and Goias states in south-central Brazil. Both projects cover 1,549 km2.

name: MARMOTA LTD
businessSummary: Marmota Limited is an Australia-based mining exploration company. The Company is focused on gold, titanium, and uranium. Gold exploration is centered on the Company's gold discovery at Aurora Tank that is yielding outstanding intersections in the highly prospective and significantly underexplored Gawler Craton in the Woomera Prohibited Defense Area. Its flagship uranium resource is at Junction Dam adjacent to the Honeymoon mine. Its Gawler Craton gold project comprises seven adjacent gold deposits, including Marmota’s flagship Aurora Tank gold discovery, Campfire Bore, Golf Bore, Greenewood and Mainwood. Aurora Tank is the Company's flagship gold project, located 100km SW of Coober Pedy. Its new Titanium discovery at Muckanippie features bonanza Heavy Mineral (HM) concentrations and intercept thicknesses, starting from the surface, hosted in mineral sands.

name: MAGNETIC RESOURCES NL
businessSummary: Magnetic Resources NL is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company is focused on gold exploration in a gold belt in Laverton. The Company owns a portfolio of 100% owned tenements, totaling 261 square kilometers (km2) in the gold mining province of Western Australia, Laverton. Its projects include Lady Julie Central, Lady Julie North, Hawks Nest and Homeward Bound South. Lady Julie Project consists of approximately 11.4 km2 of tenements. The area covering the Lady Julie and HN9 Projects is endowed with gold mineralization. The Lady Julie North 4 deposit is located approximately 2.5km North of the Lady Julie Central deposit. Homeward Bound South Project consists of approximately 14km2 tenements comprised of eight granted prospecting licenses covering a five kilometers (km) strike length of the Federation Shear Zone situated 40 km east of Leonora. The Julimar Lookalike assets are 90 km north-east of the Julimar high grade palladium-rich Ni-Cu-PGE sulphides at Julimar.

name: LYNAS RARE EARTHS LTD
businessSummary: Lynas Rare Earths Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in integrated mining of rare earth minerals in Australia and mineral processing in Australia and Malaysia, and development of rare earth deposits. The Company’s operations include Mt Weld, Lynas Malaysia, Kalgoorlie and Lynas USA. It focuses on developing the Mt Weld resource, which includes ongoing exploration, production of mixed rare earths concentrates, and an expansion project to increase concentrate feedstock production to support 12,000 tons per annum of finished NdPr oxide. The Lynas Malaysia advanced materials plant is located on a 100-hectare site in the Gebeng Industrial Estate, a purpose-built petrochemical industry zone near Kuantan, on the east coast of Malaysia. Its rare earths processing facility in Kalgoorlie undertakes value-added processing of rare earths and produces Mixed Rare Earths Carbonate (MREC) which is shipped to Lynas Malaysia for separation into individual rare earth products.

name: KRAKATOA RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Krakatoa Resources Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the mineral exploration and evaluation of acquisition opportunities. Its projects include Mt Clere Rare Earth Project, King Tamba Speciality Metals Project, Belgravia Porphyry Project, Turon Gold Project, Rand Gold Project and Mac Well Project. The Mt Clere Rare Earth Project is located approximately 200 kilometers (km) northwest of Meekatharra. Belgravia Porphyry Project is located in the central division of the Molong Volcanic Belt (MVB) and covers an area of over 80 square kilometers (km2) located in the tier 1 mining jurisdiction of the Lachlan Fold Belt, New South Wales, Australia. The Turon Project covers 120 km2 and is positioned approximately 50km east of the Company’s Belgravia Project and 60km northeast of Newcrest Mining’s Cadia Valley Mine in the central tableland region, NSW. The Rand Gold Project covers a substantial area of 580 km2 in the Central Lachlan Fold Belt, New South Wales.

name: INVESTIGATOR SILVER LTD
businessSummary: Investigator Silver Limited is a metal exploration company, which is primarily focused on the Gawler Craton of South Australia. Its projects include the Paris Silver Project, Uno Morgans, Curnamona and Paris Silver Corridor. Its flagship asset, the Paris Silver Project, hosts a JORC resource of over 57 million ounces (moz) silver and 99,000 tons (kt) of lead, and is located approximately 70 kilometers (km) north of the rural township of Kimba on South Australia’s Eyre Peninsula. Uno Morgans Project is located 85 km east of the Paris Silver Project. It holds over 700 square kilometers (km2) within the prospective Curnamona Province, which has gold and copper deposits. The Paris Silver Corridor consists of Peterlumbo tenement (EL6347-100% IVR) and the Black Hill tenement (EL6475).

name: HAZER GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Hazer Group Limited is an Australia-based technology company, driving global decarbonization efforts with the commercialization of its disruptive climate-tech. The principal activity of the Company is the research and development of hydrogen and graphitic carbon production technology. The Company’s advanced technology enables the production of clean and economically competitive hydrogen and graphite, using a natural gas (or biogas) feedstock and iron-ore as the process catalyst. The Company has intellectual property rights to a technology (the Hazer Process), which enables the production of hydrogen gas from the thermo-catalytic decomposition of methane (natural gas) with low carbon dioxide emissions and the co-production of a high-purity graphite product. The Company's markets include industrial hydrogen, hydrogen mobility and synthetic graphite. It has facilities, including a research and development lab and a fluid bed reactor pilot plant.

name: HELIOS ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Helios Energy Ltd is an Australia-based onshore oil and gas exploration company. The Company’s principal activity includes the exploration activities in Presidio Oil and Gas Project located in Presidio County, Texas, United States. The Company is organized into two segments, being oil and gas exploration in the USA and helium in China. The Presidio Oil & Gas Project is comprised of a large wet gas resource. The Company has a 70% working interest (WI) in a total of approximately 66,776 acres (46,743 net acres). It has drilled two vertical wildcat wells into the Presidio Oil Project: Quinn Creek 141 and Quinn Mesa 113 (two miles apart). The Company’s subsidiaries include Helios Energy USA, Ltd, Helios Operating, LLC, Helios Energy (China) Ltd and Helios Energy Holdings Ltd.

name: HAVILAH RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Havilah Resources Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the exploration for and evaluation of mineral resources (predominantly copper, gold, cobalt and iron ore) in South Australia. The Company’s projects are the Kalkaroo copper-gold project (Kalkaroo), Mutooroo copper-cobalt-gold project (Mutooroo, Grants Project, Maldorky Project and Prospect Hill Project. The Kalkaroo Project is an open pit copper-gold-cobalt project in northeastern South Australia. Mutooroo is a high-grade open pit and underground copper-cobalt-gold project located 40 minutes from Broken Hill. Grants Project is a iron ore deposit within a few kilometers of the railway line in northeastern South Australia. Maldorky Project is the highest grade Braemar Iron Formation hosted iron ore project in northeastern South Australia. The Prospect Hill tin project, located on the northern margins of the Flinders Ranges.

name: GALILEE ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Galilee Energy Limited is an integrated and diversified sustainable energy company and a key supplier of natural gas to the east coast market of Australia. The principal activity of the Company is oil and gas exploration and production. It has tenement interests and exploration and evaluation activities in Australia, the United States and Chile. The Company holds interests in a diversified exploration portfolio with coal seam gas and conventional oil and gas assets in three of Australia’s east coast basins. Its projects include Glenaras Gas Project, Kumbarilla Project, and Springsure Gas Project Denison. The Glenaras Gas Project is located in the western central Galilee Basin. The Galilee Basin is a sedimentary basin covering approximately 247,000 square kilometers (sq.km). The Kumbarilla Gas Project in ATP 2043 is located in southern Queensland. The Springsure Gas Project, which is located at ATP 2050 in central Queensland.

name: ENERGY WORLD CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Energy World Corporation Limited is an Australia-based independent energy company, primarily engaged in the production and sale of power, and development of liquefied natural gas (LNG) projects. The Company operates through four segments: Oil and Gas in Australia, Oil and Gas in Indonesia, Power in Indonesia, and Project Development. The Company’s operations are in three countries: Philippines, Indonesia, and Australia. Its Philippines operations is engaged in the development of the LNG Hub terminal in the Philippines and development of 650 megawatts (MW) combined cycle gas fired power plant. Its Indonesia operations include a 315 MW Senkang combined cycle gas fired power plant, development of a 2 million tons per annum (mtpa) LNG liquification plant and Sengkang gas field. Its Australia operations include ownership interests in various gas fields, development of a 56,000 tpa LNG Liquification plant, an 8 MW Alice Springs power plant, and Alice Springs LNG plant.

name: EVE HEALTH GROUP LTD
businessSummary: EVE Health Group Limited is an Australia-based vertically integrated producer of branded nutrition, health and wellness products. The Company’s Meluka business provides branded wellness consumer products. Its Meluka business is focused on supporting sales of its digestive health products, in particular the P3 Gut Builder. It provides probiotic supplement powder system for improved digestive health. The functional gut nutrition solution is in the form of a three-step supplement powder system, each of which contain pre, pro and postbiotics as well as selected functional superfood ingredients in an easy to consume and versatile offering. The Company also offers honey and essential oil products. Its honey products include organic raw honey and raw honey probiotic concentrate. The Company has global reach and application to various markets across Australia and New Zealand, Asia Pacific and North America.

name: EMMERSON RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Emmerson Resources Limited is engaged in mineral exploration in Australia. The Company's projects include Tennant Creek and New South Wales (NSW). It has a commanding land position and is exploring the Tennant Creek Mineral Field (TCMF), one of Australia's highest-grade gold and copper fields that has produced over 5.5 million ounces (Moz) of gold and 470,000t of copper from deposits including Warrego, White Devil, Orlando, Gecko, Chariot, and Golden Forty. The Company holds approximately 1,800 square kilometers in the TCMF. It is exploring two early-stage gold-copper projects in NSW, identified from the application of two-dimensional and three-dimensional predictive targeting models. The highly prospective Macquarie Arc in NSW hosts >80Moz gold and >13Mt copper with these resources heavily weighted to areas of outcrop or limited cover. Its exploration projects contain many attributes of the known deposits within the Macquarie Arc but remain underexplored due to historical impediments.

name: ECLIPSE METALS LTD
businessSummary: Eclipse Metals Limited is an Australia-based exploration company focused on exploring south-western Greenland, Northern Territory and Queensland for multicommodity mineralization. The Company has a portfolio of assets prospective for cryolite, fluorite, siderite, quartz, rare earth elements (REE), gold, platinum group metals, manganese, palladium, vanadium and uranium mineralization. Its Ivigtut Project within mineral exploration license MEL2007-45 in southwest Greenland hosts the Ivigtut cryolite mine and a range of undeveloped mineral deposits. The Company holds two granted exploration licenses and six exploration license applications in the Ngalia Basin, with a combined area of approximately 7,550 square kilometers (km2) situated within this uranium mineralized region. The Devil’s Elbow uranium-gold-palladium prospect in the Northern Territory is covered by EL27584. Its tenements also include the Amamoor Manganese Project, Cusack's Bore Uranium Project and Yuendi Copper Project.

name: ELECTRO OPTIC SYSTEMS HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Electro Optic Systems Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in designing, manufacturing, and exporting advanced technology systems. The Company operates in two segments: Defence Systems and Space Systems. The Defence Systems segment specializes in technology for weapon systems optimization and integration, as well as Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) and C4 systems for land warfare. The Company's key products include remote weapon systems, vehicle turrets, high-energy laser weapons (directed energy), as well as fully integrated and modular counter-UAS and C4 systems. The Space Systems segment specializes in applying EOS-developed optical sensors and effectors to detect, track and characterize objects in space. It includes capabilities in the domain of space control.

name: ENCOUNTER RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Encounter Resources Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company is focused on discovering major copper and niobium/ rare earth element (REE) deposits in Australia. It controls a portfolio of 100% owned projects in Australia's exciting mineral provinces that are prospective for copper and critical minerals. It has numerous large scale copper projects being advanced in partnership and funded through farm-in agreements with miners: South32 and IGO. Its projects include Aileron Critical Minerals Project, Sandover Copper Project, Beetaloo Basin Copper Projects, Junction Lithium Project, Irwin REE Projects, Lamil Copper-Gold Project, Jessica and Carrara Copper-Zinc Projects, Yeneena Copper Project and Elliott Copper Project. The 100% owned Aileron project covers around 1,765 square kilometers and is located in the West Arunta region of Western Australia. The Jessica and Carrara projects are being explored in partnership with South32 under farm-in agreements.

name: ELEMENTOS LTD
businessSummary: Elementos Limited is an Australia-based tin company with development assets in mining jurisdictions in Andalucia, Spain and Tasmania, Australia. The Company is focused on developing both the Oropesa Tin Project in Andalucia, Spain and the Cleveland Tin Project in Tasmania, Australia. The Oropesa Tin Project is located in the Guadiato Valley, in the Province of Cordoba, within the Andalucia autonomous region, Spain. The Oropesa Tin Project consists of approximately 13 square kilometers, located approximately 75 kilometers (km) north-west of city of Cordoba and 180km north-east of the capital of Seville in southern Spain. The Cleveland Tin Project is located approximately 80km southwest of Burnie in the mineral-rich northwest region of Tasmania, Australia. Its subsidiaries are Rockwell Minerals Pty Ltd, Rockwell Minerals (Tasmania) Pty Ltd, Elementos Minerales S.A., Elementos Spain Pty Ltd, and others.

name: DEEP YELLOW LTD
businessSummary: Deep Yellow Limited is an Australia-based uranium mining company. Its projects include the Namibian project portfolio comprises of Tumas Project, Omahola Projects, Nova joint venture (JV) Project, Yellow Dune JV Project, Mulga Rock Project, and Alligator River Project. The Tumas Project comprises a series of palaeochannel/calcrete-type uranium deposits. Omahola Project is located within the prospective Alaskite Alley corridor, within which uranium deposits, including Rossing, Husab, Etango and Valencia are located. The Nova joint venture (JV) Project includes two exclusive prospecting licenses (EPL) prospective for both basement and palaeochannel-type uranium mineralization. The Yellow Dune JV comprises one mineral deposit retention license (MDRL) covering a drilled-out uranium resource of the palaeochannel/calcrete-type at Aussinanis. The Mulga Rock consists of two separate mining areas over a total length of 30 kilometers.

name: DATELINE RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Dateline Resources Limited is an Australian company focused on mining and exploration in North America. The Company owns 100% of the Colosseum Gold-REE Project in California. Its Colosseum Gold and Rare Earths Project are situated in San Bernardino County, California, United States. The Colosseum Gold Mine is located in the Walker Lane Trend in East San Bernardino County, California. The Colosseum is located less than 10 kilometers (km) north of the Mountain Pass Rare Earth mine. Its other projects are the Argos Strontium Project (100%, San Bernardino County) and the Music Valley Heavy Rare Earths Project (100%, Riverside County). The Argos Project comprises four patented claims situated on the southern margin of the Cady Mountains. The Music Valley HREE Project (Music Valley), located in Riverside County, California, United States. Music Valley consists of 57 claims totaling 1,140 acres.

name: DRONESHIELD LTD
businessSummary: DroneShield Limited is an Australia-based company focusing on radio frequency (RF) sensing, artificial intelligence and machine learning, sensor fusion, electronic warfare, rapid prototyping, and MIL-SPEC manufacturing. It provides artificial intelligence-based platforms for protection against advanced threats, such as drones and autonomous systems. It offers customers bespoke counter-drone (or counter-UAS) and electronic warfare solutions and off-the-shelf products designed to suit a variety of terrestrial, maritime, or airborne platforms. Its products include DroneSentry-C2, DroneSentry-C2 Enterprise, DroneSentry-C2 Tactical, RfPatrol Mk2, DroneGun Mk4, Immediate Response Kit (IRK), DroneGun Tactical, and others. The RfPatrol Mk2 is a next-generation wearable solution providing airspace awareness for military, law enforcement, and executive security personnel. The DroneGun tactical neutralizes unauthorized drones with precision, ensuring mission success in complex environments.

name: CYNATA THERAPEUTICS LTD
businessSummary: Cynata Therapeutics Limited is an Australia-based clinical-stage stem cell and regenerative medicine company. The Company is focused on the development of therapies based on Cymerus, which is a therapeutic stem cell platform technology. Cymerus uses induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) to manufacture cell therapy products, including mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs), at commercial scale. Its product candidates include CYP-001, CYP-004 and CYP-006TK. CYP-001 is under Phase II clinical trials with a focus on treatment for steroid-resistant acute graft versus host disease (GvHD) and a Phase 1/II trial in patients undergoing kidney transplantation. CYP-006TK is a Cymerus iPSC-derived MSC topical wound dressing product candidate. This product is used in the Company’s Phase I clinical trial in diabetic foot ulcers (DFU). CYP-004, is an iPSC-derived MSC product for intra-articular injection (injection into a joint), is ongoing with a Phase III trial in patients with osteoarthritis of the knee.

name: CARAVEL MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Caravel Minerals Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the exploration of mineral tenements in Western Australia. The Company’s Caravel Copper Project is located 150 kilometers north-east of Perth in Western Australia’s Wheatbelt region. The Project has a Mineral Resource Estimate of 3.03 million tons of contained copper and an Ore Reserve of 1.4 million tons. The project is located in the Southwest Native Title Settlement Area of Western Australia where all residual Native Title rights and interests have been settled by agreement between the State of Western Australia and Noongar Groups. The Company’s other projects include Mt William, Dalwallinu, Brookton, Gillingarra, Caravel Copper, Mukinbudin, Burakin, and Cadoux.

name: CENTAURUS METALS LTD
businessSummary: Centaurus Metals Limited is an Australia-based exploration company. The Company is primarily involved in exploration for and evaluation of mineral resources. Its projects include Jaguar Nickel Sulfide Project, Boi Novo Copper Gold Project, Jambreiro Iron Ore Project and Rio Novo Copper-Gold Project. Its Jaguar Nickel Sulfide Project is located in the Carajas Mineral Province of northern Brazil. The Project is approximately 250 kilometers (km) from the regional city of Parauapebas in the Brazilian State of Para and sits within a 30 square kilometers (km2) tenement package in the Sao Felix do Xingu municipality. The Company’s Boi Novo Copper-Gold Project, secured as part of Centaurus’ Horizon II Business Development and Growth Strategy in NE Brazil, covers 35 km2 of highly prospective ground in the Carajas Mineral Province. The Company’s 100%-owned Jambreiro Project is located in south-east Brazil. Its Rio Novo Project (40 km2) lies immediately north of its Boi Novo Project.

name: CHALICE MINING LTD
businessSummary: Chalice Mining Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the exploration and evaluation of the Gonneville Palladium-Nickel-Copper Project and the exploration of projects located in the West Yilgarn region of Western Australia. The 100%-owned Gonneville Project is located on Chalice-owned farmland approximately 70 kilometers (km) north-east of Perth, Western Australia.
