It provides colocation services to local and international organizations. It is focused on sustainability and renewable energy and delivers its customers solutions and NABERS 5-star certification. Its partner ecosystem comprises a specialized ICT community of less than 750 clouds, networks and information technology (IT) service providers. The Company's network-rich ecosystem enables its customers to source and connect with cloud platforms, service providers, and vendors to build integrated hybrid cloud deployments and scale their IT infrastructure and services.

name: BRAVURA SOLUTIONS LTD
businessSummary: Bravura Solutions Limited is an Australia-based provider of software solutions for the wealth management, life insurance and funds administration industries. The Company is engaged in the development, licensing and maintenance of specialized administration and management software applications and the provision of professional consulting services for the Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) and Asia-Pacific (APAC) regions of the financial services industry. Its solutions include wealth management systems, life and protection systems, transfer agency systems, digital, financial messaging, workplace, legacy and heritage replacement, and umbrella funds. The Company's services include professional services, managed and cloud services, data migration, and training. Its professional services include consulting, data migration and data services, software development, digital, and project management. It delivers its software solutions through either an installed or hosted delivery model.

name: ANTEOTECH LTD
businessSummary: AnteoTech Ltd is an Australia-based supplier of advanced material solutions to the battery materials and life sciences markets. Its products and technologies include Anteo X, Ultranode, AnteoBind and AnteoBind NXT. Anteo X is a water-based, binder-compatible cross linker designed to improve the mechanical stability and performance of high silicon anodes in lithium-ion batteries. Anteo X enhances cohesion between active materials, binders, and conductive agents, enabling higher silicon loadings, greater energy density, and improved cycle life. Ultranode is its proprietary high silicon anode formulation technology, developed to boost energy density in lithium-ion batteries. AnteoBind is a patented surface chemistry platform that simplifies and enhances the immobilization (bioconjugation) of biomolecules on a variety of substrates. AnteoBind NXT builds on the core AnteoBind technology, delivering improved binding efficiency, and reducing reagent usage.

name: ATLANTIC LITHIUM LTD
businessSummary: Atlantic Lithium Limited is an Australia-based lithium-focused exploration and development company with assets in Ghana and Cote d'Ivoire, West Africa. The Company is advancing its Ewoyaa Lithium Project. In Ghana the Company holds approximately 509 square kilometers (km2) of granted and under application tenure. In Cote d'Ivoire, the Company holds approximately 771 km2 of granted and under application tenure. The Ewoyaa Lithium project is located within one kilometer (km) of the Takoradi Accra N1 highway, 110 km from the Takoradi deep-sea port and adjacent to grid power. In Cote d'Ivoire, the Company through its wholly owned subsidiary Khaleesi Resources SARL, holds exploration permits over the highly prospective Rubino and Agboville exploration licenses, which cover over 374.18 km2 and 396.89 km2, respectively.

name: UNITH LTD
businessSummary: Unith Ltd is an Australia-based technology company that specializes in artificial intelligence (AI)-driven digital human and conversation design solutions. It focuses on the design, development, and deployment of interactive, artificial intelligence (AI)-powered, conversational agents. Its segment includes Subscription, Digital Humans and Other Segments. Subscription segment consists of broad content offering of products such as mobile security, games and video portals via a mobile payments network and the underlying AI-driven technology platform. The Digital Humans B2B SaaS division creates license engaging, user-centric conversations in real time with AI-powered digital humans. The Company also operates a business-to-consumer subscription division, which leverages the value-add created by its digital human and conversation design solutions technology. Its subscriptions arm offers access to specific functionalities, tools, or content related to digital humans and AI technology.

name: FRONTIER ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Frontier Energy Limited is an Australia-based renewable energy company. The Company is developing the Waroona Renewable Energy Project, which is located strategically in the heart of the South-West of Western Australia. The Project is approximately 120 kilometers (km) south of the Perth, eight kilometers southwest of the Waroona townsite and five kilometers east of Forrest Highway, the traffic route linking Perth and Bunbury. The nearby 330kV Landwehr Electricity Terminal will allow the Company to sell electricity via the Southwest Interconnected System. The Company holds 830 hectares (ha) of freehold land located within 0.5 km of the Landwehr Terminal, a major connection point to WA’s electricity network, located on high voltage (330kV) transmission lines in the least constrained portion of the network.

name: LAKES BLUE ENERGY NL
businessSummary: Lakes Blue Energy NL (LKO) is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the exploration for oil and gas within Australia and Papua New Guinea. Its projects include Nangwarry Carbon Dioxide, Wombat Gas Field, Trifon/Gangell Gas Field, Baragwanath Gas Field, Roma Shelf Oil and Gas Project, Enterprise North, Otway-1, Portland Energy Project, and Buna. Through its subsidiary, Otway Energy Pty Ltd, the Company holds 50% of, and operates PRL 249. PRL 249 contains the Nangwarry Carbon Dioxide Project. Through Gippsland, it focuses on Petroleum Retention Lease 2 (PRL2), within which the Wombat (100% LKO) and Trifon/Gangell (57.2% LKO) gas fields are located. It holds 100% of ATP 1183, which is located in the Roma Shelf area of Queensland. ATP 1183 contains multiple oil and gas exploration targets, including Wellesley, Riverslea Updip, Major, Emu Apple, and Bendee, with significant conventional prospective resource potential.

name: ALARA RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Alara Resources Limited is an Australia-based mining and exploration company with operations focused on the Middle East. Its projects include Al Wash-hi Majaza Copper-Gold Project, Daris Copper-Gold Project, Awtad Copper-Gold Project, Mullaq Copper-Gold Project and Al Ajal Copper-Gold Project. Its Al Hadeetha Wash-hi Majaza Copper-Gold Project is located over 160 kilometers (km) south-west of the capital city Muscat, in the Sultanate of Oman. Its Daris Project consists of two high-grade copper mineralization within the 587 square kilometers (km2) Block 7 Exploration License. Its Awtad Project comprises an area of approximately 497 km2 (Block 8) and is located immediately adjacent to the Block 7 (Daris Copper-Gold Project). Its Mullaq Exploration License area is adjacent to the Wash-hi Exploration License. Its Al Ajal Prospect is located near the village of Al Ajal in the Taww area, near the northern coast of the Sultanate of Oman and about 65 km west of Muscat.

name: ADMIRALTY RESOURCES NL
businessSummary: Admiralty Resources NL is an Australia-based diversified mineral exploration company with mineral interests in Chile and Australia. The Company is engaged in advancing the production at its flagship Mariposa Iron Ore Project in Chile (Mariposa Project). It has approximately 32 mineral exploration and exploitation concessions covering approximately 6,600 hectares (ha) and is located within the Chilean iron belt in the Atacama Desert at an altitude of 380 meters above sea level and 10 kilometers south from the city of Vallenar in the Third Region of Chile. Its exploration projects in the Company’s Harper South district (2,498 ha) include La Chulula and Soberana, with the potential for further growth in iron ore resources. Other exploration areas in Chile include the Pampa Tololo district (3,455 ha) and El Cojin (600 ha). In Australia, the Company holds a 50% stake in the Pyke Hill Project, a cobalt and nickel project in Western Australia.

name: BRIGHTSTAR RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Brightstar Resources Limited is an Australia-based gold development company. The Company hosts a portfolio of assets hosted in Western Australia, with approximately 3.9 million ounces (Moz) of mineral resources across the Goldfields and Murchison regions. The Company owns and operates the underground Second Fortune and Fish Gold Mines south of Laverton. It has consolidated three project hubs-Laverton, Sandstone, and Menzies. The Laverton hub is the Company’s primary production center with main deposits Jasper Hills (Lord Byron and Fish), Cork Tree Well, Second Fortune, and Beta. The Sandstone Hub is located in the Sandstone Greenstone Belt, approximately 600 kilometers (km) northeast of Perth, Western Australia. It includes the Sandstone Gold Project and Montague East Gold Project. The Menzies Gold Project is centered on the town of Menzies, over 130 km north of Kalgoorlie, within the Norseman-Wiluna Greenstone Belt with key deposits of Lady Shenton.

name: ADR ON MESOBLAST LTD
businessSummary: Mesoblast Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is engaged in developing allogeneic (off-the-shelf) cellular medicines for the treatment of severe and life-threatening inflammatory conditions. The Company has developing a range of late-stage product candidates, derived from its first and second generation proprietary mesenchymal lineage cell therapy technology platforms therapies for distinct indications. The Company’s Ryoncil (remestemcel-L-rknd) is an allogeneic bone marrow-derived mesenchymal stromal cell (MSC) therapy. Its other product candidate is Revascor (rexlemestrocel-L). Rexlemestrocel-L is second generation mesenchymal lineage precursor cell product platform and is in late-stage development for treatment of: chronic heart failure (chf) and chronic low back pain (clbp) due to degenerative disc disease. The two products have been commercialized in Japan and Europe by the Company's licensees.

name: MESOBLAST LTD
businessSummary: Mesoblast Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is engaged in developing allogeneic (off-the-shelf) cellular medicines for the treatment of severe and life-threatening inflammatory conditions. The Company has developing a range of late-stage product candidates, derived from its first and second generation proprietary mesenchymal lineage cell therapy technology platforms therapies for distinct indications. The Company’s Ryoncil (remestemcel-L-rknd) is an allogeneic bone marrow-derived mesenchymal stromal cell (MSC) therapy. Its other product candidate is Revascor (rexlemestrocel-L). Rexlemestrocel-L is second generation mesenchymal lineage precursor cell product platform and is in late-stage development for treatment of: chronic heart failure (chf) and chronic low back pain (clbp) due to degenerative disc disease. The two products have been commercialized in Japan and Europe by the Company's licensees.

name: APOLLO MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Apollo Minerals Limited is an Australia-based exploration company. The Company is focused on the discovery and development of substantial near-surface gold mineralization at the Company’s Salanie Gold Project within its 100% owned Keri permit in Gabon. It also owns the near surface zinc-lead, Kroussou Project in Gabon. The Salanie Gold Project is located 16 kilometers (km) from the town of Lambarene and lies within the Company’s 100% owned Keri Permit (G4-456). The Kroussou project is located in south-west Gabon on the central west African coast. The project exploration permit is 100% owned by the Company, located approximately 220 km south of the capital Libreville within the Ngounie Province. The Project consists of two exploration permits (G4-569 and G4-456) which cover over 2,363 square kilometers (km2) and have 135 km of strike length along the prospective contact between the Cretaceous Cotier Basin to the west and Archean/Proterozoic basement to the east.

name: EDEN INNOVATIONS LTD
businessSummary: Eden Innovations Ltd produces and sells a high-performance concrete admixture, EdenCrete and retrofit dual fuel technology, OptiBlend developed for diesel generator sets. Its segments include Eden Innovations LLC and Eden Innovations (India) Pvt Ltd. Eden Innovations LLC segment includes EdenCrete sales and development and Optiblend sales, service, and manufacturing in the United States. The Eden Innovations (India) Pvt Ltd segment includes Optiblend sales, service, and manufacturing in India. The Company’s innovations include EdenCrete, OptiBlend, EdenPlast, and Other Technologies. Its EdenCrete is a carbon nanotube enriched admixture for concrete that improves tensile and flexural strength. Its OptiBlend technology allows a conventional diesel engine to run natural gas as its primary fuel without modifying the engine or the current diesel fuel system. Its EdenPlast is a CNT enriched polypropylene tape. Its other technologies are Pyrolysis Project and Hythane.

name: OBJECTIVE CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Objective Corporation Limited is an Australia-based company, which supplies information technology software and services. The Company's product categories include content solutions, planning & building, and regulatory solutions. Its content solutions include content and process management (Objective Nexus), federated information governance (Objective 3Sixty), secure external file collaboration (Objective Connect), and automated redaction (Objective Redact). The Company's planning & building product includes planning and development platform (Objective Build), building plan assessment tools (Objective Trapeze) and planning policy management (Objective Keyplan). Its regulatory solutions include data-driven regulation (Objective RegWorks) and regulated document production (Objective Keystone). The Company's solutions include local government; federal and state government; regulation; information governance, and wealth, banking and insurance. It provides consulting and managed services.

name: TORQUE METALS LTD
businessSummary: Torque Metals Limited is an Australia-based exploration company. The Company’s projects include Paris Gold Project, New Dawn Gold Project, Edleston Gold Project, and Penzance Gold Project. Its Paris Exploration Camp is the prime asset of the Company, which covers approximately 1,200 square kilometers (km2) of land, including 16 mining licenses, two prospecting licenses and 48 exploration licenses. The Paris Gold Project mineral resource estimate3 (MRE3) includes three deposits (Paris, HHH and Observation). The Edleston Gold Project is situated in the Abitibi Belt, approximately 60km via road to the south of Timmins, Ontario, Canada. Its over 310km2 land package is surrounded by numerous processing facilities including Alamos Gold, IAMGOLD and Newmont. New Dawn’s gold potential lies in the northernmost area of the project, also known as New Dawn North. The New Dawn Gold Project comprised of approximately four exploration licenses.

name: COMMONWEALTH BANK OF AUSTRALIA
businessSummary: Commonwealth Bank of Australia provides retail and commercial banking services in Australia, and in New Zealand through its subsidiary, ASB Bank Limited (ASB). Its segments include Retail Banking Services, Business Banking, Institutional Banking and Markets, New Zealand, and Corporate Center and Other. Retail Banking Services provides banking products and services to personal and private bank customers, helping them to manage their everyday banking needs, buy a home or invest in the future. Business Banking serves the banking needs of business, corporate and agribusiness customers across the full range of financial services solutions. It also provides equities trading and margin lending services through the CommSec business. Institutional Banking and Markets offers a full range of domestic and global financing and banking services to institutional and government clients. New Zealand includes the banking and funds management businesses operating in New Zealand under the ASB brand.

name: METEORIC RESOURCES NL
businessSummary: Meteoric Resources NL is an Australian company, developing the Caldeira Rare Earths Project in the state of Minas Gerais in Brazil. The Caldeira Rare Earths Project comprises approximately 77 mining and exploration licenses (with total landholdings over 18,292 hectares) located between the cities of Caldas, Pocos de Caldas, and Andrades in the southwest region of the state of Minas Gerais in Brazil. Caldeira is located 254 km from the city of Sao Paulo and approximately 350 km from the port of Santos. Rare earths mineralization at the Caldeira Project is enriched in magnet rare earths of dysprosium and terbium and neodymium and praseodymium. Its other projects include Warrego North IOCG Project and Webb JV. Located in the Northern Territory, the Warrego North Project is approximately 20 km northwest of the historical high-grade Warrego Copper-Gold Mine. The Webb JV is focused on the evaluation of a kimberlite field comprising 280 targets and covers an area of over 961 km2.

name: GENUSPLUS GROUP LTD
businessSummary: GenusPlus Group Ltd is an Australia-based specialist power and communications infrastructure and services provider. The Company and its subsidiaries' principal activities include the construction and maintenance of transmission and distribution power lines and substations servicing the Western Australian, Queensland, New South Wales and Tasmanian power networks, as well as providing specialist engineering, testing and commissioning services to the electrical and communications industries. Its segments include infrastructure, services, and energy & engineering. Its Infrastructure segment offers a range of services, including planning, designing, constructing, operating, testing, maintaining, managing and decommissioning. Its service segment constructs communication networks, provides asset management on utilities, and upgrades to existing power infrastructure. Its Energy and Engineering segment delivers end-to-end Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) solutions.

name: OLIVER'S REAL FOOD LTD
businessSummary: Oliver’s Real Food Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the provision of fast-food services. The Company runs two contract packing manufacturing facilities for the retail, catering, and hospitality industries. In addition, the Company has investments in property, listed and unlisted companies. It operates through the Quick Service Restaurants segment in Australia. Its menu includes Mango Passion Morning Mix, Berry Morning Mix, Moroccan Vegetable Bowl, Mexican Chicken Bowl, Peri Peri Chicken Burger, OLI Burger, Mexican Chicken Pocket, Moroccan Vegetable Pocket, Organic Chicken Nuggets, Kids Chicken Nuggets Meal, Junior Cheeseburger Meal, Kids Chicken Burger Meal, Crumpets with Butter and Honey, Breakfast Egg Wrap, Bacon and Egg Roll, Avocado on Sourdough, among others. Its products sold online are Date and Walnut Cookie, Oliver's Blueberry Protein Bar, Oliver's Cranberry and Almond Cookie, Oliver's Goji and Superfruit Protein Bar, among others.

name: SGH LTD
businessSummary: SGH Ltd is an Australia-based diversified operating company, with businesses across industrial services, energy and media. In industrial services, the Company owns WesTrac, Boral and Coates. WesTrac is an authorized Caterpillar dealer in Western Australia and New South Wales /Australian Capital Territory, providing heavy equipment sales and support to customers. Boral is an integrated construction materials business, producing and selling a broad range of materials, including quarry materials, cement, concrete, asphalt and recycled materials. Boral has operations in all the Australian States and Territories. Coates is an equipment hire business which provides a range of general and specialist equipment to a wide variety of markets including engineering, building construction and maintenance, mining and resources, manufacturing, government and events. It holds a 40.2% interest in Seven West Media, which is engaged in broadcast television, magazine and newspaper publishing and online.

name: LOTTERY CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: The Lottery Corporation Limited is a lottery and Keno operator with a portfolio of brands and games. It is engaged in the provision of gaming and entertainment services. The Lott is the brand that unites the Company’s licensed lottery operations in all states and Territories of Australia, except Western Australia, under license arrangements. Its game brands include Set for Life, Powerball, Oz Lotto, TattsLotto, Saturday lotto, Gold Lotto, X Lotto, Weekday Windfall, Lucky Lotteries, Lotto Strike, Super 66, Instant Scratch-Its and Keno. Its lotteries products can be purchased in news agencies, convenience stores and other retail outlets, online at thelott.com and via its mobile app. It is an interactive social game played predominantly in venues, such as pubs, clubs, hotels, casinos and TABs, with games typically running every three minutes. It operates a Keno distribution network of 3,260 venues across New South Wales, Victoria, Queensland and the Australian Capital Territory.

name: DGR GLOBAL LTD
businessSummary: DGR Global Limited is engaged in the generation of projects and the provision of services and support to sponsored listed companies, within the mineral resources industry. The Company’s business is the creation of resource exploration, development, and mining companies. It owns a portfolio of investments in companies, which include SolGold Plc, Atlantic Lithium Ltd, Clara Resources Australia Ltd, New Peak Metals Ltd, and Lakes Blue Energy NL. SolGold plc focuses on the copper and gold porphyry systems at Cascabel in Ecuador. Atlantic Lithium Ltd focuses on the Ewoyaa Lithium Project in Ghana. Clara Resources Australia Ltd is focusing on a diverse commodity base including cobalt, nickel, and metallurgical coal. New Peak Metals Ltd is focused on exploring for alternative gold deposits as well as other precious and base metals project opportunities. The Company’s pipeline projects include Coolgarra Minerals Pty Ltd, and Pinnacle Gold Pty Ltd.

name: QORIA LTD
businessSummary: Qoria Limited is an Australia-based technology company. The principal activities of the Company include sales and distribution, marketing, and customer support of its suite of cyber safety products and services. It has four operating segments, being the provision of educational technology services in Australia and New Zealand (ANZ), the United Kingdom (UK), the United States of America (USA), and Europe. It offers a suite of cyber safety products and services through its key distribution channels, as well as the provision of ongoing customer support services and continual improvement and upgrade of its services. Its comprehensive suite of child digital safety and wellbeing solutions, including real-time technologies, advanced reporting and education and training programs. Its solutions include classroom Internet management, granular reporting, proactive risk monitoring, real-time wellbeing, student education, staff engagement, parental empowerment, content filtering, and firewall.

name: COMPLII FINTECH SOLUTIONS LTD
businessSummary: Complii FinTech Solutions Limited provides end-to-end compliance and risk management software as a service (SaaS) platform for equity capital markets participants, from dealers / brokers, financial advisers, financial planners, wealth advisers, to listed and unlisted companies and investors. The Company has five segments: Complii segment, a financial technology platform sector; the PrimaryMarkets segment, a trading platform sector; the Advisor Solutions Group segment, an Australian Financial Service Licence (AFSL) sector; the Registry Direct segment, a share register sector, and the MIntegrity segment, a compliance consulting sector. Its products and services include registry services from inception of a corporation or trust, trading facilities whilst unlisted (pre-IPO), new capital raising (pre-IPO rounds + IPO listing + placements post listing), administration tools and shareholder services plus all the compliance controls required for those AFSL holders and their registered users.

name: VOLT GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Volt Group Limited, formerly Volt Power Group Limited, is an industrial technology company, which develops and commercializes ESG focused, zero emission power generation and hydrogen production technologies and mining equipment. Its products include EcoQuip, ATEN, HYTEN and Wescone. EcoQuip offers mobile solar light and communications towers incorporating United States military spec build quality, superior illumination performance and advanced OEM power management, data and remote-control telemetry. ATEN Technology or System is a waste heat recovery, zero emission electricity generation technology. An installed ATEN system recovers open cycle gas turbine and reciprocating engine driven power station exhaust heat or industrial waste heat to generate zero emission, baseload electricity. The HYTEN technology is a waste heat to hydrogen production system. Wescone supplies sample crushers and sample crushing solutions to the mining, mineral processing and assay laboratory industries.

name: POINTSBET HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Pointsbet Holdings Limited is an Australia-based corporate bookmaker with operations in Australia and Canada. The Company has developed a cloud-based wagering platform through which it offers its clients advanced sports and racing wagering products, and iGaming. The Company’s segments include Australian Trading, Canadian Trading, and Corporate. The Australian Trading segment provides online sports and online fixed odds racing betting services to Australian customers. The Canadian trading segment offers online sports betting and iGaming services provided to Canadian customers. The Company’s products include Fixed Odds Sports, Fixed Odds Racing, PointsBetting, and iGaming (online casino). Its subsidiaries include PointsBet Australia Pty Ltd, PointsBet Pty Ltd, PBH Softech Private Limited, PointsBet Canada Operations 1 Inc., and others.

name: HORIZON MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Horizon Minerals Limited is a mid-tier gold producer with projects located in the West Australian goldfields. It holds a 100% interest in gold projects in the Kalgoorlie and Coolgardie regions, including the 428,000 oz Boorara project and 1,372,000 oz in satellite projects in close proximity. Its Boorara project is located approximately 10 kilometers (km) east of the Kalgoorlie's Super Pit gold mine on the eastern edge of the city of Kalgoorlie-Boulder, Western Australia. Its Phillips Find Project is located approximately 45 km north-northwest of Coolgardie, Western Australia. It operates the Black Swan processing facility, which is a 2.2 million tons per annum (Mtpa) processing facility strategically located approximately 50 km northeast of Kalgoorlie. The Nimbus Project is located approximately 15 km east of Kalgoorlie-Boulder in Western Australia. It also owns Gordons Dam Project, which encompasses 34 mining licenses over approximately 77 km2 in the Western Australian goldfields.

name: BIOTRON LTD
businessSummary: Biotron Limited is a clinical-stage biotechnology company. The Company is engaged in developing and commercializing a novel small molecule approach that has the potential to treat several serious viral diseases. Its proprietary primary bacterial cell-based screening platform enables rapid screening for target viroporin proteins, including hepatitis C, HIV-1, Dengue, Zika, Influenza, and Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV). The Company has developed a library of over 350 compounds with potential activity against a range of viral diseases. Its lead compound, BIT225, is in Phase II development for the treatment of HIV-1. BIT225 appears to inhibit HIV-1 replication in macrophage reservoir cells offering the potential, when used in combination with other anti-retroviral compounds, to eradicate HIV-1. The Company also owns SedRx, which is a general anesthetic containing alfaxalone.

name: XREF LTD
businessSummary: Xref Limited is an Australia-based human resource (HR) and recruitment technology company that offers a range of reference and pre-employment checks, employee engagement and exit surveys. The Company operates through three segments: Xref Platform, Trust Marketplace and Xref Engage. The Xref Platform segment includes enterprise platform (pre-employment reference surveys, pulse and exit surveys) and recruiter platform (pre-employment reference surveys only). The Trust Marketplace segment includes ID verification, qualification checks and background checks. The Xref Engage segment includes engagement surveys. The Company's solutions by industry include not-for-profit, health and aged care, government, construction, retail, hospitality, and aged care QI surveys. Its platform's features include survey builder, people records, reporting and insights, integrations, security and compliance, and template builder. Its types of integration include background checks and applicant tracking system.

name: SUREFIRE RESOURCES NL
businessSummary: Surefire Resources NL is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company holds mineral exploration licenses over Vanadium, Magnetite and Gold projects located in Western Australia. It is focused on Victory Bore Vanadium critical and battery minerals project. The Victory Bore project is located in the Mid-West region of Western Australia. Its Perenjori Iron Ore Project is located within 15 kilometers (km) of both the Morawa-Peronjori trunk rail line and the Karara rail spur. Its Yidby Gold Project is situated within the southern portion of the Yalgoo-Singleton Greenstone Belt, 40 km from Paynes Find and 400 km northeast of Perth. The project is also surrounded by several significant gold projects. Its Kooline Lead-Silver Project tenements cover almost 50 km strike length of mineralized Ashburton Formation and are located 55 km south of the one Moz Paulsen’s gold mine and 190 km northwest of Paraburdoo in the Ashburton province of Western Australia.

name: DOMINO'S PIZZA ENTERPRISES LTD
businessSummary: Domino's Pizza Enterprises Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the operation of retail food outlets and the operation of franchise services. The Company operates through three segments: Australia/New Zealand (ANZ), Europe and Asia. The Company's menu consists of Domino's Pizzas, including Premium Pizzas, Traditional Pizzas, Value Max Range, Value Range, Value Range Pizzas, Vegan Range, Make Your Own, Meltzz, Loaded fries, Pizza Pasta, Sides, Chicken, drinks, and Desserts. Its Sides include Savoury Sides and Chicken Sides. Its Loaded Fries include BBQ Meatlovers Loaded Fries, Firebreather Loaded Fries, Bacon & Cheese Loaded Fries, And Cheesy Loaded Fries. Its Pizza Pasta include Smokehouse Pork Belly Pasta, The Lot Pasta, Buffalo Chicken & Bacon Pasta, Simply Mac & Cheese Pasta, Simply Bacon Mac & Cheese Pasta. The Company Drinks include Malted Vanilla Thickshake, Chocolate Malt Thickshake, and Chocolate Malt Thickshake With Cream.

name: RAMSAY HEALTH CARE LTD
businessSummary: Ramsay Health Care Limited is a provider of hospital and healthcare services in Australia, Europe and the United Kingdom. Its segments include Australia, the UK, France and the Nordics. Its businesses include Ramsay Australia, Ramsay Sante, Ramsay UK, and Elysium Healthcare. Ramsay Health Care is Australia’s private hospital operator, with more than 70 modern hospitals, clinics and surgical centers in cities and towns across the country. Ramsay Sante is a private care provider in Europe with hundreds of modern hospitals, clinics, primary care and imaging centers across France, Sweden, Norway, Denmark and Italy. Ramsay UK has a network of hospitals and day surgeries across the UK providing a range of clinical specialties to private and self-insured patients. Elysium Healthcare is an independent provider of specialist health and care services. Elysium's four core service streams are mental health and wellbeing, learning disabilities and autism, neurological, and children and education.

name: TELIX PHARMACEUTICALS LTD
businessSummary: Telix Pharmaceuticals Limited is an Australia-based biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of therapeutic and diagnostic radiopharmaceuticals and associated medical technologies. It is developing a portfolio of clinical and commercial stage products that aims to address significant unmet medical needs in oncology and rare diseases. Its segments include Therapeutics, Precision Medicine and Telix Manufacturing Solutions. Therapeutics segment develops targeted radionuclide therapies for urologic, neurologic, musculoskeletal and hematological cancers. Precision Medicine segment focuses on bringing diagnostic imaging solutions to market. Precision Medicine segment also includes MedTech and International businesses. Telix Manufacturing Solutions segment is its global network of facilities designed to deliver patient doses worldwide. Its pipeline products include TLX591, TLX250, TLX101, TLX66, TLX592, TLX252, TLX400, Illuccix (68Ga-PSMA-11) and TLX007-CDx.

name: RESOLUTION MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Resolution Minerals Ltd is an Australia-based mineral exploration company engaged in the acquisition, exploration and development of precious and battery metals, such as antimony, gold, copper, and uranium. Its Horse Heaven Antimony-Gold-Tungsten Project is well-situated in Valley County, Idaho United States. The Horse Heaven Project comprises 699 federal lode mining claims covering over 5,644 hectares. Its George Project covers a large area prospective for roll-front style uranium (2,839km2) in central South Australia. The Company’s Drake East Project hosts fourteen known antimony occurrences, including the well-documented Mosquito Creek Antimony-Gold Reef and Ball & Smiths Lode. These antimony occurrences cover a large area with a NW-SE strike length of over 15 kilometers (km). Its Neardie Project hosts three past producing antimony mines. Its Spur South Gold-Copper Project is located within the highly mineralized Macquarie Arc region in NSW.

name: BLACK CAT SYNDICATE LTD
businessSummary: Black Cat Syndicate Limited is an Australia-based gold producer with operating mines and processing facilities at two of its three 100% owned operations. The Company’s projects include Kal East Gold Operation (Kal East), Paulsens Gold Operation (Paulsens), Coyote Gold Project (Coyote), and Mt Clement Antimony Project. Kal East comprises approximately 650 square kilometers (km2) of highly prospective ground to the east of the mining center of Kalgoorlie, Western Australia. Paulsens comprises over 3,640 km2 of tenure located 180 kilometers (km) west of Paraburdoo in Western Australia. Coyote comprises over 630 km2 prospective tenements located in Northern Australia, 20 km on the Western Australia side of the WA /NT border, on the Tanami Highway. Mt Clement is located over 30 km from the Paulsens Gold Operation with highest-grade antimony deposit in Australia. The Company 100% owns and operates the Lakewood gold processing facility, located over 6km east of Kalgoorlie.

name: ZEOTECH LTD
businessSummary: Zeotech Limited is an Australia-based mineral processing technology company. The Company develops and commercializes zeolite mineral processing technology. The Company's projects include Toondoon Kaolin project (Toondoon) and Abercorn Kaolin project. The Toondoon Kaolin Project comprises an approved mining lease (ML80126) and two exploration permits for minerals (EPM 27395 & 27866), located approximately 20 kilometers south of Mundubbera, Queensland and spans over 28,000 hectares. The Abercorn Kaolin Project comprises four contiguous exploration permits for mineral (EPM) for a total of 50 sub-blocks, comprising EPM 26837 (33 sub-blocks), EPM 26903 (4 sub-blocks), EPM 19081 (1 sub-block) and EPM 27427 (12 sub-blocks), located 20 kilometers (km) north of Eidsvold and 70 km south of Monto in the North Burnett District of south-central Queensland, spanning circa 20,000 hectares. Its portfolio of zeolite synthesis technologies can produce a range of targeted grades and products.

name: AVENIRA LTD
businessSummary: Avenira Limited is an Australia-based fertilizer focused project developer. The Company is developing the Wonarah Phosphate Project located in the Barkly region, Northern Territory, and exploring the Jundee South Project located in the north-eastern part of the Norseman Wiluna belt of the Archaean Craton in Western Australia. Wonarah Phosphate Project focuses on the development of Yellow Phosphate and aims to mine and process high-grade phosphate ore from its Tier 1, 100% owned Wonarah Phosphate Mine. The project is designed as a simple open-cut mining operation. The Jundee South Project covers operating gold projects including Jundee, Bronzewing and Darlot and contains more than a 60-kilometer strike of prospective greenstone stratigraphy. The Project area contains regional structures interpreted to control gold mineralization throughout the Yandal Greenstone Belt and contains a number of historically defined gold occurrences.

name: WEB TRAVEL GROUP LTD
businessSummary: WEB Travel Group Limited is an Australia-based global business to business (B2B) travel distribution company. The Company connects travel sellers with travel buyers across all major global markets. WebBeds, its brand, is a global online marketplace for the travel trade, an intermediary connecting hotels and other travel service suppliers to a distribution network of travel buyers all over the world. WebBeds sources room inventory from worldwide hotels, then connects, aggregates and merchandises that inventory as bookable product in its platform, the WebBeds Global Marketplace, and distributes it to a global network of travel trade buyers, who sell to the traveling public. Global and regional hotel chains, resorts, transfer and sightseeing companies and more - can sell their products through WebBeds by connecting to a diversified global network of over 50,000 travel buyers across more than 39,000 locations. It also offers application programming interface connectivity.

name: LINDIAN RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Lindian Resources Limited is a mineral exploration company with rare earths and bauxite assets. It is engaged in exploration and development of the Kangankunde Rare Earths Project. The Company is advancing its portfolio of bauxite projects in Guinea and Tanzania. The Kangankunde Rare Earths Project in Malawi contains high grade rare earths deposits with low impurities and minimal radioactivity and is located approximately 90 kilometers (kms) north of the city of Blantyre in Malawi. Its Gaoual Bauxite Project is in northwestern Guinea within the Boke Bauxite Belt. It is situated south of the township of Gaoual in the northern portion of the Kogon-Tomine interfluve. The Lelouma Project is located 40km from its high grade Gaoual conglomerate bauxite project. The Woula Bauxite Project is located in Northwestern Guinea. It also has interests in the Lushoto and Pare Bauxite projects in eastern Tanzania’s Mozambique Belt, which includes over eight prospective tenements.

name: WISETECH GLOBAL LTD
businessSummary: WiseTech Global Limited is a developer and provider of software solutions to the logistics execution industry globally. The Company develops, sells, and implements software solutions which enable logistics service providers to facilitate the storage of goods and information, domestically and internationally. It provides its solutions to approximately 17,000 customers in over 174 countries. The Company's technology, CargoWise, is an integrated, global software platform for logistics service providers. Its software enables logistics service providers to execute logistics transactions and manage their operations on one global database across multiple users, functions, offices, corporations, currencies, countries, and languages. Its main data centers in Australia, Europe and the United States deliver its CargoWise platform principally through the cloud, which customers access as needed and pay for usage as they execute on its platform.

name: JINDALEE LITHIUM LTD
businessSummary: Jindalee Lithium Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration and development company. The Company is focused on lithium exploration and development. The Company’s projects include McDermitt Lithium, Sherlock and Clayton North. The Company’s flagship project is the McDermitt Lithium Project in south-east Oregon, United States. The McDermitt Lithium Project is 100% owned and located approximately 35 kilometers (km) west of the town of McDermitt, straddling the Oregon and Nevada border. The McDermitt Lithium Project is a sediment-hosted lithium deposit. The Clayton North project is located approximately 23km north of the only producing lithium operation in the United States at Silver Peak. The project is ideally located in close proximity to the only lithium producing operation in the United States of America. The Sherlock Project comprises one Exploration License (E47/4345) centered approximately 75km east of Karratha in Western Australia.

name: ADVERITAS LTD
businessSummary: Adveritas Limited is an Australia-based company, which creates software solutions that leverage big data to drive business performance. Its segments include Product and Engineering, Sales and marketing and Corporate. The Product and Engineering segment is engaged in the development and maintenance of the Company's proprietary software offerings. These activities are conducted in Australia and Croatia. The Sales and marketing segment is engaged in deploying its sales and marketing initiatives and in providing ongoing customer service. These activities are carried out by sales and marketing personnel and consultants located in the Australia Pacific region, Europe and South-east Asia. Its ad fraud prevention software, TrafficGuard, is available as a service. TrafficGuard is a full funnel measurement, verification and fraud prevention solution for digital advertising. TrafficGuard detects, mitigates and reports on ad fraud before it impacts digital advertising budgets.

name: SMART PARKING LTD
businessSummary: Smart Parking Limited is an Australia-based parking technology company. The Company operates in three divisions: Parking Management, Technology, and Research & Development. The Parking Management segment is engaged in the provision of parking management solutions, predominantly servicing the retail sector, managing agents and landowners in the United Kingdom, New Zealand, Australia, Germany, Denmark, and Switzerland. The Technology segment is engaged in the sale of technology, hardware, and software, predominantly for parking solutions around the world, and to support the parking management division. The Research & Development segment includes research, developing, and enhancing automatic number plate recognition (ANPR) software/hardware for both the Technology and Parking Management divisions. It serves various industries, such as Councils & Local Authorities, Hospitals & Medical Centers, Hotels & Hospitality, Leisure & Tourism, Residential, Restaurants & Eateries, and others.

name: PROVARIS ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Provaris Energy Ltd is an Australia-based company. The Company is advancing innovative Compressed Hydrogen (H2) and Carbon Dioxide (CO2) storage and transport solutions through proprietary tank designs for storage, maritime gas carriers and integrated supply chain development. The Company’s principle activities include supporting the development of hydrogen production and export projects in Europe, with a focus on local collaborations in Norway; the design, engineering and Maritime Class Approvals for its proprietary H2Neo Carrier and H2Leo Storage Barge for the marine storage and transportation of compressed hydrogen; and developing innovative liquid CO2 tank designs for marine transport and offshore storage and injection applications. Its proprietary H2Neo carrier is based on a conventional MR tanker with two integrated tanks to store (450-tonnes) hydrogen at 250 bar MAOP.

name: KALAMAZOO RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Kalamazoo Resources Limited is an Australia-based exploration company with a portfolio of gold and base metals projects in the Central Victorian Goldfields, the Pilbara and the Murchison, Western Australia. In the Pilbara, the Company is the 100% owner of Ashburton Gold Project. Also, in the Pilbara, the Company is engaged in exploring its Mallina West Project, which is located along strike of and within the same structural corridor as Northern Star's Hemi gold discovery. In the Central Victorian Goldfields, it is engaged in exploring its 100% owned Castlemaine Goldfield Project, the South Muckleford Gold Project south of the Maldon Goldfield, the Myrtle Gold Project, the Tarnagulla Gold Project and the Mt Piper Gold Project near the Fosterville gold mine in Victoria. It also operates the Xanadu Gold Project, which includes nine tenements (P52/1592-98, E52/3692 and E52/3711) covering 142.4 km2 that are contiguous with and along strike to the southeast of the Ashburton Gold Project.

name: GALAN LITHIUM LTD
businessSummary: Galan Lithium Limited is an Australia-based lithium exploration and development company. The Company is focused on its lithium brine projects, Hombre Muerto West (HMW) and Candelas, located on the Hombre Muerto Salar in Argentina. Its projects include HMW Lithium Project, Candelas Project, and Greenbushes South Project. Its flagship HMW Lithium Project is situated within the Hombre Muerto basin. The Project lies 90 kilometers (km) north of the town of Antofagasta de la Sierra, in the Province of Catamarca, Argentina, and is located to the southwest of the Salar del Hombre Muerto. The Candelas Project comprises 14 exploration permits covering over 24,000 hectares hosted within an approximately 15km long by three-four km wide structurally controlled basin. It also owns 100% of the Greenbushes South Project, which covers a total area of approximately 315 square kilometers (km2) located about 250 km south of Perth, Western Australia.

name: RMA GLOBAL LTD
businessSummary: RMA Global Limited is an Australia-based online digital marketing company. The Company operates RateMyAgent, a review platform for client-centered Real Estate professionals. It is engaged in providing data on real estate agents, their active residential property listings and sale results, as well as reviews from vendors and buyers of residential real estate. It operates sales, leasing and mortgage broking across the United States of America, Australia, and New Zealand. Its business offers a way for agents to efficiently collect and promote client reviews, helping them stay top of mind with past clients and earn trust with prospective new clients. The primary streams for the business consist of subscription and promoter fees. Promoter is a product that enables agents and agencies to digitally promote their digital profiles through various third-party platforms. Its subsidiaries include RateMyAgent.com Pty Ltd, RateMyAgent Services Pty Ltd, RAdmin (Aus) Pty Ltd, and RateMyAgent Inc.

name: HYDRIX LTD
businessSummary: Hydrix Limited is an Australia-based specialist product designing, engineering and medical device distribution company. The Company is engaged in the development of comprehensive products. Its segments include Hydrix Services, Hydrix Medical and Hydrix Ventures. Hydrix Services segment offers a comprehensive range of engineering, development and regulatory consulting services, including software, electronics, mechanical, industrial design and general product development services. Hydrix Medical distributes disruptive cardiovascular technologies that address unmet needs of patients and healthcare providers. Products include the Guardian real-time heart attack warning system from Avertix Medical, Implicity’s cloud-based artificial intelligence (AI)-driven remote cardiac patient monitoring and data management solution, and Echo IQ’s AI technology. Hydrix Services segment’s portfolio companies include Gyder Surgical Pty Ltd, Avertix Medical Inc., Memphasys Limited, and Cyban Pty Ltd.

name: BETR ENTERTAINMENT LTD
businessSummary: betr Entertainment Limited, formerly BlueBet Holdings Limited, is a pure-play digital wagering operator focusing solely on the Australian wagering market. The Company is engaged in offering sports and racing betting products and services to online and telephone clients through its advanced online wagering platform and mobile applications. The Company is powered by a highly scalable proprietary cloud-based technology platform that can also be delivered as a white-labelled technology solution for business to business (B2B) partners. The betr brand offers betting services for various sporting events, including American football, Australian rules, baseball, basketball, cricket, golf, ice hockey, motor racing, rugby league, rugby union, soccer, tennis, and others. Its product line includes horse racing, greyhound racing, and harness racing, among others.

name: BETMAKERS TECHNOLOGY GROUP LTD
businessSummary: BetMakers Technology Group Ltd is an international provider of advanced wagering technology, data, content, and service solutions with a footprint that spans the racing and betting markets. The Company is engaged in the development and provision of software, data, and analytic products for the business-to-business (B2B) wagering market and the production and distribution of racing content. Its segments include Global Betting Services and Global Tote. The Global Betting Services segment provides customers with a variety of racing software, data, and analytical tools. This includes basic race data, such as pricing, runners, and form, as well as analytical tools to consume and leverage the data, and wagering tools, such as platforms and managed trading services. It also assists racing bodies and rights holders in producing and distributing race content. The Global Tote segment includes the provision of tote software and integrations to facilitate tote liquidity and resulting.

name: MAYFIELD CHILDCARE LTD
businessSummary: Mayfield Childcare Limited is an Australia-based childcare services provider. The Company is primarily engaged in operating long day childcare (LDC) centers located in Victoria, Queensland and South Australia. The Company owns and operates approximately 45 long day care centers located in Victoria, Queensland and South Australia, providing education and care to over 3,600 families. It has over 4,000 registered childcare places. The Company’s childcare centers include Mayfield Early Education Oakbank, Clever Kids Early Learning, Precious Cargo Westbourne Park, Precious Cargo Woodville Park, Mayfield Early Education Bayswater, Mayfield Early Education Camberwell, Mayfield Early Education Cheltenham, Mayfield Early Education Clyde North, Mayfield Early Education Dandenong, Mayfield Early Education Allenstown, Mayfield Early Education Brinsmead, Mayfield Early Education Brose Street, Mayfield Early Education Clifton Beach, Mayfield Early Education Norman Gardens, among others.

name: BEAMTREE HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Beamtree Holdings Limited is an artificial intelligence decision support and data company. The Company provides automation technology and data analytics that support health care providers. The Company's segments include Diagnostic Technology, Clinical Decision Support, Coding Assistance and Data Quality, and Analytics and Knowledge Networks. The Diagnostic Technology which is engaged in Enabling the effective delivery of diagnostic services as they underpin the future of health and personalized medicine, and its product includes RippleDown. The Clinical Decision Support which is engaged in combining human and artificial expertise together to enhance decisions that improve care, value and experience and its product includes Ainsoff Deterioration Index. The Coding Assistance and Data Quality segment products are PICQ, RISQ, and Integrated Coding Platform. The Analytics and Knowledge Networks segment is engaged in combining data analytics solutions with peer-to-peer alliances.

name: ESTRELLA RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Estrella Resources Limited is an Australia-based company, which is focused on the exploration and development of nickel projects. The Company’s projects include the Carr Boyd Nickel Project and the Spargoville Project. The Carr Boyd Nickel Project covers the Carr Boyd Layered Complex, 75 square kilometers (km2) mafic igneous complex which hosts several nickel and copper sulfide occurrences. The Carr Boyd Layered Complex is in a Tier 1 jurisdiction approximately 80 kilometers (km) north-north-east of Kalgoorlie, Western Australia. Carr Boyd Nickel Project, north of Kalgoorlie in Western Australia, is a focus for the Company-where it has recently made a nickel and copper discovery while drilling into the T5 electromagnetic target. Its two-reverse circulation (RC) drill holes, CBP042 and CBP043, were completed to test the T5 EM conductor plate. The Spargoville Project is located approximately 20 km southwest of Kambalda, Western Australia.

name: ENVIROSUITE LTD
businessSummary: Envirosuite Limited is an environmental intelligence company. The principal activities of the Company include development and sale of environmental management technology solutions. The Company operates through three geographic operating segments: Asia Pacific (APAC), Americas and Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA). It combines science and technology to produce predictable and actionable insights, that allows customers to optimize their operations, remain compliant and manage their environmental impact. Its platforms include EVS Industrial, EVS Water, EVS Aviation, and EVS IoT. EVS Industrial is an integrated hardware and software emissions monitoring solutions to support data driven decisions at industrial and municipal operations. EVS Water is a suite of science-based design and asset management software for the water industry. EVS Aviation offers comprehensive airport environmental management software. It serves various industries, such as mining, airports, and waste treatment.

name: LITHIUM ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Lithium Energy Limited is an Australia-based battery minerals company. The Company is engaged in the exploration and development of sustainable minerals projects. The Company's projects include Capricorn Gold-Copper Belt Project, White Plains Lithium Brine Project, Solaroz Lithium Brine Project, Burke and Corella Graphite Projects, and Mt Dromedary Natural Graphite Project. Its Capricorn Gold-Copper Belt Project (Queensland) tenements cover an area of approximately 1,795 square kilometers (km2). The Company has staked 6,870 hectares of mineral claims in Utah, United States (White Plains Lithium Brine Project). Its Solaroz Lithium Brine Project comprises eight mineral concessions totaling approximately 12,000 hectares. It holds 100% of the Mt Dromedary Natural Graphite Project. Its Burke Graphite Project comprises EPM 25443, covering approximately 6.47 km2. Its Corella Graphite Project comprises EPM 25696, covering approximately 19.41 km2. It also holds Leichhardt Crossing Tenement.

name: GSTECHNOLOGIES LTD
businessSummary: GSTechnologies Limited is an Australia-based fintech company. The Company's principal activity comprises of fintech services through the use of blockchain technology, and the provision of data infrastructure, storage and technology services by its subsidiaries. The Company's subsidiaries include Golden Saint Technologies (Australia) Pty Ltd, GS Fintech Ltd, GS Fintech Pte Ltd, GS Fintech UAB, Angra Limited, Angra Global Limited and Semnet Pte Ltd. Angra Global operates under the AngraFX and Angra Global brand names and is an FCA approved Authorized Payment Institution (API), as well as holding a Canadian Money Services Business (MSB) license. The GS20 Exchange is offering spot trading and over-the-counter trading desk services for crypto assets, although it is not a pure cryptocurrency exchange. Its GS Money platform is a blockchain-driven neo banking platform. The Company's Bake Cryptocurrency platform includes the Bake.io Web application and Bake mobile app.

name: FBR LTD
businessSummary: FBR Limited is an Australia-based company, which designs, develops, and builds dynamically stabilized robots to address global needs in a safer, efficient, and sustainable way. These robots are designed to work outdoors using the Company’s core Dynamic Stabilization Technology (DST). The application of DST includes the Hadrian X and Mantis. Hadrian X is a bricklaying robot that builds structural walls faster, safer, more accurately and with less wastage than traditional manual methods. The Hadrian X provides Wall as a Service, its commercial offering, to builders on demand. The Shuttle Block Delivery System is designed to lay existing commercially available blocks as well as have the ability to lay blocks. Mantis is a high deposition welding robot for the large-scale metal fabrication industries such as mining, shipbuilding and defense manufacture.

name: WA KAOLIN LTD
businessSummary: WA Kaolin Limited is an Australia-based kaolin production company. The Company is engaged in mineral exploration, extraction and processing. The Company's principal activities are the exploration and development of an inferred mineral resource of high-grade premium kaolinized granite, proprietary production and value-adding processes. The Company holds the Wickepin Kaolin Project, approximately 220km south-east of Perth, Western Australia. The Wickepin Project produces high-quality kaolin for Tier one customers in Asia and around the world. The project comprises four retention licenses (R70/40, R70/42, R70/43 and R70/44) and a single mining lease (M70/1143). The Company has a two-stage ramp-up strategy at the Wickepin Kaolin Project. The stage one optimizes production to over 200,000 tons per annum (tpa) and Stage two will ramp up production to 400,000tpa.

name: WRKR LTD
businessSummary: Wrkr Ltd is an Australia-based regulatory technology company. The Company’s principal activities consist of operating Wrkr PLATFORM, Wrkr PAY, and Wrkr READY. The Wrkr PLATFORM is a cloud-based compliance platform for handling messaging with the Australian Taxation Office (ATO), SuperStream, Single Touch Payroll (STP) 2.0, Pan-European Public Procurement Online (PEPPOL), Standard Business Reporting (SBR) and State authorities, and orchestrating payment processing for worker pay and super contributions for fund administrators. Its Wrkr PAY is a superannuation gateway and clearing house and payment handling solution for processing of employee pay and super contributions for payrolls and superfunds. Its Wrkr READY is a white label employee onboarding solution to manage the compliant onboarding of full-time and casual workers.

name: RIMFIRE PACIFIC MINING LTD
businessSummary: Rimfire Pacific Mining Ltd is an Australia-based critical minerals exploration company, which is advancing a portfolio of projects within the highly prospective Lachlan Orogen and Broken Hill districts of New South Wales (NSW). The Company's 100% owned projects include Green View Cobalt Project, Valley Project and East Cowal Copper Gold Project. Its earn in projects include Avondale and Fifield. Green View Cobalt Project lies around 35 kilometers (km) west of Broken Hill, within the highly prospective Broken Hill geological district of NSW, and includes three high-grade cobalt targets: Bald Hill, Staurolite Ridge and Railway Extension. Valley Project is located five km west of Kincora Copper's Mordialloc porphyry copper gold discovery. East Cowal Copper Gold Project has around 500 square kilometers, which lies 60 km southwest of Parkes within the highly prospective Lachlan Orogen of NSW. Avondale and Fifield projects are being funded by its exploration partner, Golden Plains Resources.

name: JADE GAS HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Jade Gas Holdings Limited is an Australia-based gas exploration company. The Company is focused on the coal bed methane (CBM) potential of Mongolia. The Company’s flagship project is the Coal Bed Methane gas project over the Production Sharing Agreement (PSA) area of Tavantolgoi XXXIII unconventional oil basin, (TT CBM Project). It operates and manages the TT CBM Project through its subsidiary Methane Gas Resource LLC (MGR), a joint venture (JV) company partnering with Erdenes Methane LLC (EM). It also holds two prospective CBM permits: Shivee Gobi and Eastern Gobi. Together the permits cover an area of over 18,000 square kilometers (km2) and are located within existing coal basins and near coal deposits and mines. Its Shivee Gobi permit covers an area of over 8,317 km2 and is located approximately 300 km south of Ulaanbaatar. It also holds a prospecting agreement permit over the Baruun Naran coal field (BNG Project), which is located immediately adjacent and west of its TTCBM Project.

name: EPSILON HEALTHCARE LTD
businessSummary: Epsilon Healthcare Limited is an Australia-based global healthcare and pharmaceuticals company. The Company has a diversified and vertically integrated portfolio of assets, including healthcare, pharmaceutical contract development and manufacturing and pharmacy services. The Company’s segments include Telehealth Medical Practice and Contract Development and Manufacturing. The Company owns medicinal cannabis assets, including the GMP cannabis manufacturing facility in the Southern Hemisphere (the Southport Facility) in Southport, Australia, and the Tetra Health clinic group. Its subsidiaries include Epsilon Pharma Pty Ltd, Metra Holdings Pty Ltd, Epsilon Biotech Pty Ltd, among others.

name: NORTHERN MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Northern Minerals Limited is a mineral exploration company. It owns 100% of the Browns Range Project (Project) in northern Western Australia, tenements rich in the heavy rare earth elements dysprosium (Dy) and terbium (Tb). The Browns Range Project is located over160 kilometers (km) south-east of Halls Creek on the northern edge of the Tanami Desert in Western Australia. Its other projects include John Galt, Boulder Ridge, Coomarie Dome, Gardiner Tanami, and Rabbit Flats. The John Galt Project comprises granted tenements held 100% by the Company, which covers a combined area of 78 square kilometers (km2). John Galt is situated in East Kimberley, approximately 150km north of Browns Range. The John Galt Project comprises granted tenements, such as E80/4298, E80/4967, E80/5230, and E80/6079. Boulder Ridge Project is located 150 km south of the Browns Range Dome along the western margin of the Coomarie Dome. Rabbit Flats tenement group lies immediately east of the Tanami village in the NT.

name: MAD PAWS HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Mad Paws Holdings Limited (Mad Paws) is an Australia-based company engaged in the pet services and products business. It offers an online pet platform, making the process of owning and caring for a pet more accessible. The Company’s segments are Marketplace and e-Commerce & Subscription. The Marketplace segment offers a pet services marketplace that matches and connects pet owners seeking pet care services, such as walking, day care and grooming, with pet-sitters, walkers and other pet service providers, vetted and registered by Mad Paws. e-Commerce & Subscription segments offer various pet product verticals, including medication, over the counter pet related products, pet food and toys and treats. It offers brands such as Pet Chemist, Waggly, Dinner Bowl, Mad Paws Pet Insurance and Sash beds. Its services include Day care, Dog training, House visiting, Dog walking, Hosting, Dog grooming, Dog Boarding, and others. The Mad Paws pet ecosystem supports over 300,000 active pet owners.

name: VECTION TECHNOLOGIES LTD
businessSummary: Vection Technologies Limited is an Australia-based enterprise-focused company that helps businesses bridge the physical and digital worlds. The Company helps organizations leverage their three-dimensional (3D) data through extended reality (XR) interfaces that foster collaboration and learning, grow sales and more. It is engaged in developing and commercializing integrated digital transformation technology solutions and services as part of its INTEGRATEDXR suite, including ICT infrastructure, kiosks, mixed reality (MR), augmented reality (AR), virtual reality (VR), computer-aided design (CAD), 3D modeling and renderings, and artificial intelligence (AI). Its INTEGRATEDXR products include Mindesk, EnWorks, 3DFrame, Configurator, and XRKiosk. Mindesk is a solution to support design review and real-time rendering workflows. EnWorks is a solution that supports training, manufacturing and maintenance processes.

name: VINYL GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Vinyl Group Ltd is a music company, providing tech and media solutions that connect music creators, fans and brands. The Company’s diverse portfolio has touchpoints across all corners of the global music ecosystem, empowering everyone from creators to consumers. These include Vinyl.com, which offers an e-commerce experience, including over 50K titles for fans to support their favorite artists; Vampr, a social-professional networking platform and talent marketplace, allowing 1.4M creators to discover collaborators and monetize their work in over 180 countries; Jaxsta is a database of official music credits with over 380M verified credits, and Serenade, a Web3 pioneer in physical and digital collectible. The Company’s publishing arm, Vinyl Media, is home to a powerhouse of culture, premium content, and live experiences, operates Concrete Playground, a digital city guide, Mediaweek, Tone Deaf, and licenses the Rolling Stone, Refinery29, and Variety mastheads in Australia.

name: NUENERGY GAS LTD
businessSummary: NuEnergy Gas Limited is an Australia-based independent clean energy company. The Company is primarily involved in the exploration, appraisal, and development of hydrocarbons with a primary focus on unconventional gas on coal seam gas, also known as coal bed methane (CBM). The Company operates onshore coal bed methane (CBM) Production Sharing Contracts (PSCs), such as Tanjung Enim PSC, Muara Enim PSC, Muara Enim II PSC and Muralim PSC. The Tanjung Enim PS is located approximately 50 kilometers and 130 kilometers from the industrial cities of Prabumulih and Palembang, respectively. The Muara Enim PSC is located about 45-60 kilometers and 100-120 kilometers from the industrial cities of Prabumulih and Palembang. The Muralim PSC is Located about 70 kilometer and 140 kilometers from the industrial cities of Prabumulih and Palembang respectively. Its subsidiaries include Dart Energy (Tanjung Enim) Pte Ltd, PT Trisula CBM Energi, and Dart Energy (Muralim) Pte Ltd.

name: CLEANAWAY WASTE MANAGEMENT LTD
businessSummary: Cleanaway Waste Management Limited is an Australia-based total waste management, industrial and environmental services company. Its Solid Waste Services segment comprises the collection, recovery and disposal of solid waste. Its Environmental and Technical Solutions (ETS) segment- Oils and Technical Services, and Health Services - includes Oils and Technical Services, which comprises the collection, treatment, processing, refining and recycling and destruction of hazardous and non-hazardous liquids, hydrocarbons and chemical waste, specialized product destruction and hazardous waste. Its Health Services comprise the provision of services to the health sector for the safe treatment and disposal of health-related waste, which includes sharps management, medical waste, pharmaceutical waste, healthcare hazardous waste and quarantine waste. Its ETS- Industrial Services comprises services provided to the resources, oil and gas, infrastructure, and industrial markets.

name: QUANTUM GRAPHITE LTD
businessSummary: Quantum Graphite Limited is an Australia-based company which engaged in the manufacturing of high-grade flake graphite products and the mining of and exploration for graphite deposits in South Australia. The Company is the owner of the Mikkira Graphite Deposit located on the Eyre Peninsula, South Australia. The Company's Uley 2 Project is located on the Eyre Peninsula, South Australia, approximately 20 kilometers west-south-west of Port Lincoln. The Uley Graphite Project consists of a fully permitted mining operation with five contiguous mining tenements. Its Uley 2 processing plant produces a minimum of approximately 100,000 tons of high purity coarse flake. The Uley mine produces high purity coarse flake graphite with a product mix serving a number of thermal applications, including refractories and oil and gas drilling fluids.

name: COBRE LTD
businessSummary: Cobre Limited is a copper exploration and development company with a focus on the Kalahari Copper Belt (KCB) in Botswana. The Company is engaged in advanced exploration of 100%-owned assets in the Kalahari Copper Belt (KCB), Botswana which spans across an extensive licensed area of 5,393 square kilometers (km2), prospective for sedimentary hosted copper-silver mineralization. Its Botswana projects include Ngami Copper Project (NCP), Kitlanya West Copper Project, Okavango Copper Project and Kitlanya East Copper Silver Project. The NCP project covers an area of approximately 727 km2. Kitlanya West Copper Project straddles the northern margin of the KCB, including an estimated 500 km of prospective D’Kar / Ngwako Pan Formation contact. The Perrinvale Project covers over 306km2 of the Panhandle and Illaara Greenstone Belts in Western Australia. Its Sandiman Tenement is located in the Gascoyne Province, in Western Australia and spans across 202km2 on the eastern edge of the Carnarvon Basin.

name: TECHNOLOGYONE LTD
businessSummary: TechnologyOne Limited is an Australia-based enterprise software company. The Company is engaged in the development, marketing, sales, implementation, and support of fully integrated enterprise business software solutions. The Company's segments include Software and Consulting. The Software segment consists of sales and marketing, research and development, and a Software as a Service (SaaS) platform. The Consulting segment is responsible for services in relation to its software. The Company's enterprise business software solutions include Technology One Business Analytics, Technology One Corporate Performance Management, Technology One DXP Local Government, Technology One Enterprise Asset Management, Technology One Enterprise Budgeting, Technology One Enterprise Cash Receipting, Technology One Enterprise Content Management, Technology One Financials, Technology One Human Resource and Payroll, Technology One Performance Planning, and Technology One Property and Rating, among others.

name: CHANGE FINANCIAL LTD
businessSummary: Change Financial Limited is an Australia-based global fintech company. The Company leverages scalable technology to provide payment solutions, card issuing and testing to banks and fintechs. Its principal activity includes commercialization and ongoing development of its payments management platform and payment testing solution. Its core products include Vertexon Payments as a Service (PaaS) and PaySim. Vertexon (PaaS) integrates with the core systems of banks and fintechs, enabling the delivery of physical, digital, and virtual card solutions to their customers. It includes integrated features such as Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay and Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) services. PaySim is a payment testing solution, which enables banks and fintechs to complete end-to-end testing of their payment platforms and processes from a desktop. It also provides the default standard for payments testing for many Australian companies, including Australia’s domestic card payment service eftpos.

name: IDENTITII LTD
businessSummary: Identitii Limited is an Australia-based regulatory technology (RegTech) company. The Company helps financial services businesses and other regulated entities gain visibility into, and control over, the data needed to meet financial crime reporting obligations in Australia and around the world. It is engaged in developing and licensing software for regulated entities. It is focused on eliminating anti-money laundering (AML) and counter terrorist financing (CTF) compliance risk for financial services businesses. BNDRY is the Company’s flagship product that helps teams embed risk and compliance capability into their products and services. Its Payble's payment experience platform allows councils to customize their payment processes to improve cashflow, lift productivity, and optimize cost. The Company help organizations re-imagine how risk works by building connected ecosystems that provide a single, integrated view of customer risk and related activities.

name: BRAZILIAN CRITICAL MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Brazilian Critical Minerals Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company’s primary exploration focus is Brazil, in the Apui region. It is exploring for rare earth elements (REEs) and (PGE) projects via the exploration, development of projects in Northern Brazil. The Company’s flagship projects include EMA ionic REE and APUI ENE REE, which covers approximately 700 square kilometers (km2). The Ema ionic adsorbed clay (IAC) project is contained within the 781 km2 of exploration tenements within the Colider Group. The Apui project encompasses seven tenements spanning a total of over 510 km2. Its Tres Estados Project contains a total inferred resource of 725,230 ounces at 1,152g/t of 5E precious metals (platinum, palladium, iridium, rhodium, and gold).

name: ORION MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Orion Minerals Ltd is an Australia-based diversified metal exploration and development company. The Company is engaged in exploration, evaluation and development of base metal, gold, and platinum-group element projects in South Africa (Areachap Belt and Okiep Copper Complex, Northern Cape). Its projects include Prieska Copper-Zinc Mine Project, Okiep Copper Project, Fraser Range Project, Jacomynspan (JMP) Battery Metals Project, Walhalla Project, Stratega Metals Vapour Refining Project, and Areachap Exploration. The Prieska Project is located in the Northern Cape Province of South Africa, approximately 270 kilometers south-west of the regional capital Kimberley. The Okiep Copper Project (OCP) is located in the Northern Cape Province of South Africa, approximately 570 km north of Cape Town and 450 km west of the Company’s flagship Prieska Copper Zinc Project. The JMP Project is located 65 km north of Orion’s flagship Prieska Copper Zinc Mine in South Africa’s Northern Cape.

name: RESOURCE MINERALS INTERNATIONAL LTD
businessSummary: Resource Minerals International Ltd, formerly Resource Mining Corporation Limited, is an Australia-based company. In Tanzania, it has two exploration projects targeting Copper-Gold and six projects focused on nickel occurrences in sulphides within known and prolific mafic and ultramafic intrusions. In Finland, it has two projects, focusing on the exploration of lithium. Tanzanian Projects include Mpanda and Mbozi, Kabanga North Nickel, Kapalagulu, Kabulwanyele and Southern Projects (Liparamba, Kitai, Mbinga). Its Finnish Projects include Kola Lithium Project (Koyhajoki and Pikkukallio exploration permits) and Hirvikallio Lithium Project (Laitiainen permit application). The Mpanda and Mbozi projects are located within the Ubendian Orogenic Belt, a source of Ni, Cu and Au resources within Tanzania. Kabulwanyele Project is in the Mpanda District of Tanzania, covering over 20.5 square kilometers. The Kabanga North Nickel Project is situated along strike from the Kabanga Nickel Project.

name: ZIP CO LTD
businessSummary: Zip Co Limited is an Australia-based digital financial services company. The Company, operating in two core markets: Australia and New Zealand (ANZ) and the United States, offers access to point-of-sale credit and digital payment services, connecting millions of customers with its global network of tens of thousands of merchants. In ANZ market, it offers retail line of credit products and personal loans to consumers in Australia and retail installment products to consumers in New Zealand. In the United States market, the Company offers Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) instalment products to customers. In the United States market, its products include Zip Pay in 4 (shop online and instore and pay in four payments over six weeks) and Zip Pay in 8 (shop online and instore and pay in eight payments over 14 weeks). The Company offers various products in Australia including Zip Pay, Zip Plus, Zip Money, and Zip Personal Loan. In New Zealand market, it offers Zip Pay in 4 products.

name: GROUP 6 METALS LTD
businessSummary: Group 6 Metals Limited is an Australia-based resource exploration and development company. The Company is focused on producing high-grade tungsten concentrate from its 100%-owned Dolphin Mine located on King Island, Tasmania. The Dolphin Tungsten Mine is located near the town of Grassy on the south-east coast of King Island, the most western large island in the Bass Strait between Victoria and Tasmania. The hosts the highest-grade tungsten deposit of size in the western world. Scheelite (tungsten) within the Dolphin mining area occurs within carbonate-rich Mine Series rocks in close proximity to the Grassy Granite and against controlling faults. The Company holds the exploration license EL19/2001 at Grassy, King Island (63 square kilometers) and mining lease CML 2080P/M at Grassy, King Island.

name: ADR ON KAZIA THERAPEUTICS LTD
businessSummary: Kazia Therapeutics Limited is an Australia-based pharmaceutical drug development company. The Company operates in the pharmaceutical research and development business. The Company’s lead program is paxalisib, an investigational brain-penetrant inhibitor of the PI3K / Akt / mTOR pathway, which is being developed to treat multiple forms of brain cancer. It is also developing EVT801, a small-molecule inhibitor of VEGFR3, which is critical to the development of new blood vessels and lymphatic vessels in a growing tumor, as well as to the metastasis of tumors to distant sites in the body. It designed paxalisib to inhibit PI3K, a critical control mechanism in growth and cell division, which is activated in many forms of cancer. The Company’s drug candidates are designed to treat diseases, such as brain cancer, renal cancer, and liver cancer.

name: ATLASSIAN CORP CLASS A
businessSummary: Atlassian Corporation is a provider of team collaboration and productivity software. The Company specializes in software development, work management, and enterprise service management software, which enables enterprises to connect their business and technology teams with an artificial intelligence (AI)-powered system of work. Its interconnected portfolio of apps, AI agents, and Collections, each with discrete value propositions, delivers solutions for software teams, IT operations and support teams, leadership, and business teams.
