It has five fields of expertise: Head Protection, such as helmets and face masks; Hand Protection, such as latex and synthetic gloves; Body Protection, such as clothing to protect from hazardous environments; Foot Protection, such as safety shoes and boots, and Fall Protection, such as energy absorber fall arresters and connectors. All the Company's products are marketed under the DELTA PLUS brand. The Company operates worldwide through its subsidiaries, mainly in Europe, Asia, South America and Middle East. It operates through Deweer Security Sa, Delta Plus UK, Froment EURL, Octoplus Spain SL, DSS, FVL FV and Vertic-Alpic, among others.

name: VETOQUINOL SA
businessSummary: Vetoquinol SA is a France-based company that specializes in the research, development, manufacture, marketing and sale of veterinary drugs and products. The Company’s product portfolio is divided between livestock, such as cattle and pigs, and companion animals, including dogs and cats. Vetoquinol SA’s offering includes anti-infectives, such as Marbocyl; anti- pain inflammatories, which comprise Tolfedine, intended for dogs and cats, and Tolfine for livestock, and cardiovascular and nephrology treatment, such as Prilium, an oral daily administration formula for dogs, among others. The Company markets over 700 products, in such countries as France, Austria, Canada, Italy, Poland, Spain and the Netherlands, among others. It trades its products throughout Europe, North America, Africa, the Middle East and Pacific Asia. In April 2014, it acquired Bioniche's animal health business.

name: I2S SA
businessSummary: I2S SA is a France-based provider of image processing and optronics software and digital vision equipment. It operates through its divisions, including i2S Digibook, which designs, manufactures and markets a range of scanners and related software for the digitization of ancient books, bound documents and archives, i2S Vision, which offers digital vision solutions and remote transmission cameras and i2S OEM Devices, which takes care of the development from prototype to mass production of dedicated vision systems. The range of Company’s products includes smart cameras, digital scanners, specialized opto-electronics and image processing software and embedded analysis. The Company's clients are government organizations, libraries, archives, museums, service providers, scientific and university organizations, as well as equipment manufacturers, among others. I2S SA operates through its subsidiary, i2S Inc, located in the United States and other dependant companies.

name: BANIJAY GROUP NV
businessSummary: Banijay Group NV formerly known as FL Entertainment NV is France-based company. The Company provides online platform for digital entertainment content production and sports betting in Europe through its two business segments, Banijay and Betclic Everest Group. The Banijay Group creates, develops, sells, produces and distributes television formats and programs, and digital content for a wide range of customers. It produces both scripted and non-scripted content across all genres, including reality shows, entertainment and talk shows, game shows, factual entertainment, documentary, drama and comedy. Betclic Everest Group offers gaming and online sports betting. Its online gaming offering comprises casino, poker, games and virtual sports. The Company’s four main geographies are France, Portugal, Poland, Germany and Italy.

name: EUROFINS CEREP SA
businessSummary: Eurofins-Cerep SA, formerly Cerep SA is a France-based company that specializes in the pre-clinical research, discovery and development of new pharmaceutical drugs. The Company, using its BioPrint technology systems that analyzes pharmaceutical drugs on the market, those that have been withdrawn, and those that failed in the development stages, builds up predictive models of the potential of new drugs. These predictions are based on the drugs' chemical structure and their performance in vitro. The Company then offers solutions to the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sectors on reducing time and costs in the early stages of the drug development process. Clients can also gain access to some of the Company's technology by subscribing to BioPrint. The Company’s maximum revenue is generated through Exports accounts.

name: PEUGEOT INVEST SA
businessSummary: Peugeot Invest SA (formerly known as FFP SA) is a France-based investment holding company. The Company is engaged in investment activities such as diversified assets, made up of direct minority holdings, private equity vehicles, co-investments and real estate. It operates it's business through it's direct and indirect holdings to make progress in the areas of governance, social work and environmental protection. The Company operates it's business through it's subsidiaries.

name: ROBERTET SA
businessSummary: Robertet SA is a France-based holding company engaged in the production and distribution of flavor and perfume additives and ingredients. The Company's operations are conducted through three divisions: Raw Materials, which supplies ingredients to the cosmetics industry for products such as soaps, shampoos, and other beauty products, as well as air fresheners; Fragrance, providing ingredients that go into the creations of a number of perfumes and scents, and flavours, including products for food and beverage industries. The Company operates globally through a network of subsidiaries, including Bionov, Robertet GmbH, Robertet Argentina, Robertet Do Brasil, Robertet Hiyoki, Robertet Turkey, Robertet de Mexico, Robertet USA, Robertet Italia, Robertet Savoury, and Aroma Esencial Sl, among others.

name: ANTIN INFRASTRUCTURE PARTNERS SAS
businessSummary: Antin Infrastructure Partners SAS is a France-based private equity firm specializes in in the management of investment funds. The Firm focuses on infrastructure businesses operating in the energy and environment, telecommunications, transportation and social infrastructure sectors. It generates risk-adjusted returns for investors through a combination of capital appreciation and cash yield.

name: MANITOU BF SA
businessSummary: Manitou BF SA is a France-based holding company engaged in the marketing and manufacture of machinery for the construction, agricultural and industrial sectors. The Company specializes in the manufacturing and marketing of handling, lifting and earthmoving equipment for the construction, agriculture, and industry markets. The Company's activities are structured around two main segments: Handling and lifting equipment that includes rough-terrain handling equipment (fixed and rotating telehandlers, rough-terrain forklifts and on-board trucks), aerial work platforms, industrial and semi-industrial forklifts, truck-mounted forklifts, rough-terrain forklift trucks, warehousing equipment, skid-steers and track loaders, articulated loaders and backhoe loaders; Services : sale of spare parts and accessories, provision of financing solutions, fleet management, provision of connected machines, extended warranties and maintenance contracts, training services and sale of second-hand equipment.

name: GROUPE ENTREPRENDRE SA
businessSummary: Groupe Entreprendre SA is a France-based company engaged in the publishing industry. It offers various types of publications under different categories, including economics, cars, IT, football, home, cookery, health, lifestyle and culture. The Company publishes 60 titles, such as Entreprendre, l’Essentiel de l’Auto, le Foot, Maison revue, Cuisine revue, Feminin Psycho, le Magazine des Livres, Sante revue or Creation d’entreprise magazine. Entreprendre SA has an average distribution of 20 million copies annually. The Company is part of the Lafont presse group.

name: THALES SA
businessSummary: Thales SA is a France-based technology company. The Company provides a range of solutions divided into three segments: Aerospace systems, Defense and security systems, Digital identification and security solutions. The aerospace systems segment provides avionics equipment such as cockpit, cabin multimedia, and simulation equipment and space systems include satellites and payload technologies, among others. Its Defense and security systems segment includes control and monitoring, communication, protection, cybersecurity, and related technologies, radars and optronics. The company’s Cyber and Digital segment offers cybersecurity solutions such as data security, application security as well as digital identity and biometrics solutions to banks, mobile network operators and governments.

name: ESSILORLUXOTTICA SA
businessSummary: EssilorLuxottica SA is a France-based company specializing in the vision care and eye wear industry. Its operations include Ophthalmic Lenses & Optical Instruments, Eye wear such as Frames and Sunglasses, Retail and Distribution Networks, and Equipment Manufacturing. It designs and produces corrective lenses incorporating technologies for addressing myopia, hypermetropia, and astigmatism. It also manufactures and markets both prescription and non-prescription frames and sunglasses. In addition, EssilorLuxottica develops and supplies machines, tools, and consumables used by prescription laboratories and optical professionals. The Company further offers non-prescription reading glasses, fashion eye wear, and related consumer accessories, as well as selected apparel, footwear, and accessories through its associated brands.

name: HERMES INTERNATIONAL SCA
businessSummary: Hermes International SCA is a France-based company. The Company is predominantly specialized in the designing, manufacturing, and marketing of luxury products. Its products are divided among leather and saddlery goods, such as purses, luggage, small leather goods, planners, writing items, saddles, bridles, riding objects and clothing, among others; clothes, shoes, and accessories; silk and textile products; clocks and watchmaking articles; perfumes and beauty products; and other products mainly includes jewelry and home decoration products. The subsidiaries of the Company are Castille Investissements, Compagnie Hermes de Participations, Comptoir Nouveau de la Parfumerie, and Grafton Immobilier, among others. The Company operates through stores worldwide.

name: 74SOFTWARE SA
businessSummary: 74Software SA, formerly Axway Software, is a France-based Company. The Company is predominantly engaged in enterprise software development for enterprise marketplace, integration, open banking, API management, financial accounting hub, managed file transfer, and cloud services. It principally focuses on delivering enterprise applications and critical infrastructure software for a number of markets and geographies. The Group is a combination of Axway and SBS. SBS designs, builds and operates the software solutions for banks and lenders. Axway focuses on API management, managed file transfer, B2B integration and financial accounting hub software.

name: LEGRAND SA
businessSummary: Legrand SA, formerly Legrand SNC, is a France-based company that specializes in the design, manufacture and distribution of products and systems for electrical installations and information networks. Its activity is organized around four product families: products for monitoring and controlling electrical energy, including switches, electrical connectors, thermostats, dimmers, burglar alarms, smoke detectors, audio and video connectors; energy distribution products, including circuit breakers, electrical boxes, electrical cabinets; cable management systems, including channels, mouldings, conduits, floor boxes, and structured wiring systems (voice-data-image), including wall sockets for high-speed transmission, optical fiber and copper splitters and connection panels used in telephone and computer networks. It operates through Solarfective and OCL1, the specialist in architectural lighting solutions and Afco System. Legrand operates worldwide.

name: SCHNEIDER ELECTRIC SE
businessSummary: Schneider Electric SE is a France-based company that provides energy-related solutions globally. The Company specializes in the Digital Transformation of Energy Management and Automation in Homes, Buildings, Data Centers, Infrastructures, and Industries. It has a presence in across 115 countries, Schneider Electric SE provides products in power management - medium voltage, low voltage and secure energy, and automation systems. The Company provides integrated efficiency solutions that combine energy management, automation, and software. The ecosystem built by the Company allows it to collaborate on its open platform with a community of partners, integrators, and developers to offer its customers both control and operational efficiency in real time. Its sales are distributed geographically across France, Western Europe, the United States , North America, China, Asia or Pacific and other.

name: LES HOTELS BAVEREZ SA
businessSummary: Les Hotels Baverez SA (formerly known as Hotel Regina Paris SA) is a French-based company that operates a four-star hotel, Hotel Regina, located in Paris. The hotel comprises 120 suites and bedrooms, including apartments and deluxe rooms. It also offers additional services, such as English bar and Club Lounge, as well as conference space, equipped with phone and Internet capabilities, and accessed via a separate entrance. Hotel Regina Paris SA has two affiliated hotels in Paris: Hotel Raphael, which comprises 83 rooms, and Villa & Hotel Majestic, which provides 52 apartments and rooms.

name: L'OREAL SA
businessSummary: L'Oreal SA is a France-based cosmetic group company. The Company is predominantly engaged and offers skin care products, makeup products, hair care products, perfumes, colouring products and others. Its products are marketed through mass distribution and distance selling, selective distribution, hair salons and pharmacies. Its cosmetics division is organized into four divisions, consumer cosmetics: brands L'Oral paris, Garnier, Maybelline New York and NYX professional makeup, Stylenanda, Essie and Mixa, luxury cosmetics: Lancome, Kiehl's, Giorgio Armani Beauty, Yves Saint Laurent Beaute, Biotherm, Helena Rubinstein, Shu Uemura, IT Cosmetics, Urban Decay, Ralph Lauren, Mugler, Viktor&Rolf, Valentino, Azzaro, Prada, Takami and Aesop, active cosmetic products : La Roche-Posay, Vichy, CeraVe, SkinCeuticals and Skinbetter Science and professional products : L'Oreal Professionnel, Kerastase, Redken, Matrix and PureOlogy.

name: STREAMWIDE SA
businessSummary: Streamwide SA is a France-based company engaged in the production of software applications for telecommunication sector. Its offering consist of StreamWIDE Messaging, a voice video and fax messaging product line; StreamWIDE Charging, a real time charging product line for fixed and mobile operators and calling-card operators; StreamWIDE Reachability, which provides reachability and multiple identities management; StreamWIDE Multimedia, a software solution that delivers ring back tone services (RBT) and conferencing solutions; StreamWIDE Marketing, a product line for networks and mobile marketing solutions; StreamWIDE Interconnection, an application technology which provides connectivity solutions for NGN and IMS networks, among others. As of December 31, 2011, it operated through four subsidiaries: StreamWIDE Inc (United States), StreamWIDE Romania, StreamWIDE France and StreamWIDE Beijing.

name: AIR LIQUIDE
businessSummary: L'Air Liquide Societe Anonyme pour l'Etude et l'Exploitation des Procedes Georges Claude SA, formerly Air Liquide SA, is a France-based gas company, which provides gases-related technologies and services. It operates through two segments: Production of industrial and medical gases that include oxygen, nitrogen, hydrogen, synthesis gas. In addition, the group provides equipment and services for fluid system control, chemical gas and liquid management, home care and hospital hygiene services and operating room equipment. Turnover by market is broken down between industries, health, and electronics; And Other that include engineering and construction activities of gas production plants and manufacturing of advanced technology products. The Company assist across the world many industries, such as aeronautics, automotive, beverage, chemicals, construction, electronics manufacturing, food, and glass, among others.

name: DASSAULT SYSTEMES SE
businessSummary: Dassault Systemes SE is a France-based software company, which provides different kind of three-dimensional (3D) solutions. Its product, 3DEXPERIENCE, is a business experience platform structured in four quadrants encompassing twelve brands: Social and Collaborative applications (including ENOVIA, 3DEXCITE, CENTRIC PLM), 3D Modeling applications (including SOLIDWORKS, CATIA, GEOVIA, BIOVIA); Simulation applications (including 3DVIA, DELMIA, SIMULIA) and Information Intelligence applications (including NETVIBES, EXALEAD,MEDIADATA). The Company's structure is divided into three sectors: Manufacturing Industries (Transportation & Mobility; Aerospace & Defense; Marine & Offshore; Industrial Equipment; High-Tech; Home & Lifestyle; Consumer Packaged Goods & Retail) Life Sciences & Healthcare (Life Sciences) - (Life Sciences) Infrastructure & Cities (Energy & Materials; Construction, Cities and Territories; Business Services).

name: ADR ON DASSAULT SYSTEMES SE
businessSummary: Dassault Systemes SE is a France-based software company, which provides different kind of three-dimensional (3D) solutions. Its product, 3DEXPERIENCE, is a business experience platform structured in four quadrants encompassing twelve brands: Social and Collaborative applications (including ENOVIA, 3DEXCITE, CENTRIC PLM), 3D Modeling applications (including SOLIDWORKS, CATIA, GEOVIA, BIOVIA); Simulation applications (including 3DVIA, DELMIA, SIMULIA) and Information Intelligence applications (including NETVIBES, EXALEAD,MEDIADATA). The Company's structure is divided into three sectors: Manufacturing Industries (Transportation & Mobility; Aerospace & Defense; Marine & Offshore; Industrial Equipment; High-Tech; Home & Lifestyle; Consumer Packaged Goods & Retail) Life Sciences & Healthcare (Life Sciences) - (Life Sciences) Infrastructure & Cities (Energy & Materials; Construction, Cities and Territories; Business Services).

name: LVMH MOET HENNESSY LOUIS VUITTON SE
businessSummary: LVMH Moet Hennessy Louis Vuitton SE is a France-based company. The Company is predominantly engaged in offering luxury products. Its segments are divided among fashion and leather items: it offers brands such as Louis Vuitton, Kenzo, Celine, Fendi, Marc Jacobs, and Givenchy; watches and jewels offers brands like Bulgari, TAG Heuer, Zenith, Hublot, Chaumet, Fred brands, and Tiffany; perfumes and cosmetics includes brands of perfumes Christian Dior, Guerlain, Loewe, and Kenzo brands, among others, makeup products includes Make Up For Ever, Guerlain, and Acqua di Parma, among others; wines and spirits like champagnes (Moet & Chandon, Mercier, Veuve Clicquot Ponsardin, Dom Perignon brands, and among others), wines such as Cape Mentelle, Chateau D'Yquem, cognacs, and whiskey (mainly Glenmorangie), among others.

name: EQUASENS SA
businessSummary: Equasens SA is formerly known as Pharmagest Interactive SA is a France-based company. The Company is engaged in publishing and integration of software packages intended for pharmacies, hospitals, health establishments, laboratories, retirement homes and health professionals. Its activity is distributed in publishing and integration of software packages for pharmacies, publishing of IT solutions for health and medico-social establishments and development of solutions and infrastructure for e-Health. It provides software packages for managing databases, information, stocks, orders, electronic care sheets, etc. It offers publishing and integration of software packages for retirement homes, hospitals and care homes (software for managing admissions, invoicing, tracking collections and accounting, care monitoring, stewardship management, etc.);

name: RIBER SA
businessSummary: Riber SA is a France-based company engaged in the semiconductor industry. It manufactures and supplies front-end equipment for the semiconductors, oxides, novel devices, nitrides, solar cells and Organic Light-Emitting Diode (OLED) communities. It designs and develops the Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE) technology allowing for the creation of electronic and optoelectronic devices, such as monolithic microwave integrated circuits, pump lasers and Vertical Cavity Surface Emitting Laser (VCSEL). It also provides a range of MBE-related components, such as effusion cells, valved crackers, gas flow control systems and computerized process controllers, and Ultra-High Vacuum (UHV) hardware components, including substrate heaters, among others. It also offers installation, maintenance, engineering and upgrading services for machines and equipment, and process training courses for its products. The Company has such subsidiaries as MBE Control Solutions and Addon SAS, among others.

name: FINANCIERE MONCEY SA
businessSummary: Financiere Moncey SA is a France-based investment and holding company. The Company's portfolio of holdings includes Financiere de l'Odet, Financiere V, Omnium Bollore and Socphipard.

name: BASSAC SA
businessSummary: Bassac SA is a France-based company. The Company is predominantly engaged in the business offering development of new mid-range housing (apartments and individual houses), located mainly in European cities. It principally offers its services in segments such as development and promotion of real estate assets new housing and manufacture and sale of prefabricated garages. The segment development and promotion of real estate assets includes activities carried out in particular under the brands Les Nouveaux Constructeurs, Premier and Concept Bau) and commercial real estate (offices and tertiary premises) and manufacture and sale of prefabricated garages.

name: SIGNAUX GIROD SA
businessSummary: Signaux Girod SA is a France-based company engaged in the design, development, installation, maintenance and lease of signs and associated products. The Company operates in nine product families: traffic signage, directional signage, signage for streets and sites, local information, temporary signage, roadway equipment, urban development, vehicle safety and marking and supports and accessories. Signaux Girod SA has 36 decentralized sites in France, responsible for vertical highway signage, horizontal signage and road zoning and worksite signage services. It also has five specialized subsidiaries in France, responsible for electronic signage, urban furniture, furniture for visual communication, floral decoration, and adhesive visual identity materials. The Company also leases safety and security products, such as temporary signs for working sites.

name: KUMULUS VAPE SA
businessSummary: Kumulus Vape SA is a France-based company engaged in electronic shopping. The Company operates mainly as an online retailer specializing in the sale of electronic cigarettes and related products, including hardware, e-liquid and accessories.The Company partners with a number of brands, which includes Alliancetech Vapor, Aspire, Eleaf, GeekVape, Innokin, Joyetech, JUSTFOG, The French Box, Fan-tas-tic, Halo, Loaded, One Hit Wonder, Origa, Phillip Rocke, Psycho Bunny, as well as Swoke, The Milkman and Vincent in the Vapes, among others.

name: GROUPE GUILLIN SA
businessSummary: Groupe Guillin SA is a France-based company specializing in the development, manufacturing and marketing of plastic packaging products intended for various sectors of the food industry. It offers a range of products including trays, plates, but also sheets for thermoforming and various solutions for catering and meal distribution. Groupe Guillin SA includes seventeen subsidiaries including Alphaform, which manufactures plastic plates, bowls, boxes and trays intended for transport and distribution; Dynaplast, producer of rigid plastic sheets and plastic packaging for fruits and vegetables, Guillin Emballages, specialized in the design and manufacture of thermoformed plastic packaging, Socamel Technologies, focused on the collective catering market, producing trolleys multi-services and plastic trays and Rescaset Concept, also active in the catering market and offering, among other things, porcelain trays, plates and dishes.

name: CATANA GROUP SA
businessSummary: Catana Group SA, formerly Poncin Yachts SA is a France-based company specializes in the design, construction and marketing of luxury boats. The Company operates the concession of a harbor located in the department of Var (Port Pin Rolland). It provides activities such as sale of boats and services. It offers luxury catamarans (Catana, Bali and Catspace brands). The Company work carried out on boats (refitting, repairs, maintenance work, etc.), hire of boat-mooring places and security services (400 mooring spaces and 500 on-land storage spaces), boat hire, etc. Its shipyard activity offering all services to boaters, and on the other hand that of Marina which can accommodate up to 400 boats afloat and 300 dry, with infrastructure.

name: LEXIBOOK LINGUISTIC ELECTRONIC SYSTEM SA
businessSummary: Lexibook Linguistic Electronic System SA is a France-based company that designs and markets electronic leisure products. The Company has as its main activity in the manufacture and distribution of consumer electronic products primarily intended for children and adolescents. It offers a range of products such as toys, calculators, touch pads, audio CD player, electronic dictionaries, translators, computers, tablets, clocks, weather stations, and telephones. It also includes personal organizers, agendas, calculators, licensed electronic games, and pocket translation devices including imitation games for girls, chess games and naval battles. It sells the products directly through department stores, wholesalers, retailers, by mail order and by way of e-commerce over more than 25 million products in 40 countries, including France, the United Kingdom, Germany, Spain, Hong Kong, Portugal, and Italy.

name: AKWEL SA
businessSummary: Akwel SA, formerly known as MGI Coutier SA, is a France-based company specializing in design, manufacturing, and marketing of automotive equipment. The Company’s activities are based on two main production lines: Fluid Transfer and Mechanisms. Fluid Transfer sector provides services in storage, treatment and diffusion of fluids and products include manifolds, ducts, air filters, cam covers, blow-by heating connectors and pipes, ventilation of battery compartment, cooling systems, fuel vapor pipe, dosing pumps, protective casings for additive systems and heated pipes for selective catalytic reduction systems, among others. Mechanisms sector manufactures opening, closing and articulation products such as doorstops and hinges, pedal boxes and under-bonnet mechanisms, locks & strikers and door handles and fuel caps, among others. The Company also has other divisions: Ability, Research & Development, Environment and Aftermarket.

name: MGI DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY SA
businessSummary: Mgi Digital Technology SA, formerly MGI France SA, is a France-based company that specializes in the design, manufacture, marketing and distribution of digital printers and related products. The Company offers a digital direct-to-print technology that provides four-color process printing variable data, personalization, bar codes, personal identification numbers (PINs), magnetic stripes, photos, and auto numbering. The Company’s portfolio of products includes MeteorDP8700XL, plastic card dies cutting, JET cards, JETvarnish, UVarnish, Punchcard Pro, Presscard Pro and EnvelopExpress, among others. The Company’s clients belong to commercial printing, silk screeners, plastic cards printers, newspaper and book printers, graphic art professionals and government sectors.

name: NSC GROUPE SA
businessSummary: NSC Groupe SA is a France-based company specializes in the design and manufacture of equipment for the packaging industry. The Company provides equipment for combing and spinning long textile fibers. It offers cast iron parts in small and medium series that is intended for the machine building, refrigeration, street furniture, hydraulics, transport, printing, etc. sectors. Its equipment for winding and unwinding packaging materials. It design and integration of complete production lines and for the management of complex industrial projects.

name: PASSAT SA
businessSummary: Passat SA is a France-based holding company engaged in the video-assisted promotion and remote sale of various categories of products. The Company operates through its direct and indirect subsidiaries, such as Passat USA, Passat Espagne SA, Passat Italie SRL, Wind of Trade and Chimney Sweeping Log. It offers a portfolio of products, comprising fitness, beauty, health and leisure products, kitchen utensils and accessories; patented do-it-yourself products, home comfort and maintenance products, gardening products, toys and household products, among others. It operates under the brands, Stone Guard, Facil Home, Spirit of Beauty, Sprayza, Actiforme, Pleinair Jardin, Puissance Verte, among others. The Company has promotional in-store videos and it also distributes its products via teleshopping channels and mail-order catalogs. It has operations in France, Portugal, Spain, Italy, Canada and the United States.

name: VIVENDI SE
businessSummary: Vivendi SE is a France-based company. The Company is predominantly engaged in content, media, and entertainment, developing a portfolio of both listed and unlisted assets, in its market. It mainly consists of several companies in the content production, communication and media. Its portfolio includes minority stakes in publicly traded companies: Universal Music Group and Banijay Group in content and entertainment, MediaForEurope, Telecom Italia, Telefonica, and Prisa in media and telecommunications. It supports value-creating companies, offering sustainable prospects and a contribution to the evolution. It also offers magazine publishing (Prisma Media) and video games (Gameloft). It anticipates global dynamics and participates in the transformations of the sectors in which the group operates.

name: SPARTOO SA
businessSummary: Spartoo SAS SA is a France-based company. With 10,000 brands and more than 1 million references, the Company offers a selection of fashion items, such as footwear, ready-to-wear and bags. The Company specializes in the online distribution of footwear, clothing and leather goods for women, men and children. Its fashion offer is distinguished in particular by the promotion of more than 16 proprietary brands, including 10 created in-house, such as Betty London, Citrouille & Compagnie, Dream in Green, Fericelli, Casual Attitude, Carlington or So Size or via acquisitions, such as GBB, JB Martin, Christian Pellet, Un matin d'ete, Little Mary and Easy Peasy. The Company is present in more than 30 countries, including France, Germany, England, Italy and Spain.

name: FLEURY MICHON SA
businessSummary: Fleury Michon SA is a France-based company that is engaged in developing meal solutions in the self-service delicatessen and prepared meals segments in France. The Company has three segments: Pole GMS France, a fresh packed self-service of the radius catering and delicatessen - GMS branded Fleury, Michon a brand distributors, regulation, production and distribution in France; Pole International :a fresh packaged Self-Service - regulation of production and distribution outside France; and the Other Sectors segment: food and beverages services, excluding travel and home restoration, and are of business support and assistance to subsidiaries in logistics, human resources, and information system, finance. Fleury Michon SA delivers meals to businesses under the Fauchon and Flo Prestige brand names. It has various subsidiaries, including Fleury Michon Charcuterie and Fleury Michon Traiteur de la Mer; and it has presence in Canada, Poland, Switzerland, Italy, Spain and Norway, among others.

name: EXEL INDUSTRIES SA
businessSummary: Exel Industries SA is a France-based company engaged in the design, manufacture and sale of precision spraying equipment for three markets: agriculture, industry and gardening. The Company supplies the industrial market with spraying equipment for applying liquid paints, glues and other substances, sold mainly under the brands Kremlin Rexson and Sames Technologies. The Company offers to the agricultural market a range of spraying equipment for large-scale crops, vineyards, fruit trees and tropical crops, sold under such brands as Hardi and Ilemo. It also offer plant-care substances, including herbicides and insecticides, among others. The Company offers to individual customers a range of plant sprayers and accessories, sold under such brands as Tecnoma, Berthoud and Cooper-Pegler. The Company has various subsidiaries, including Kremlin Rexson SA, Tecnoma Technologies SAS, Caruelle-Nicolas SAS, Preciculture SAS, Moreau SAS and Herriau SAS, among others.

name: HERIGE SA
businessSummary: Herige SA, formerly VM Materiaux SA is a France-based company that is principally engaged in the manufacture, distribution, trading and installation of materials and equipment for the building and construction industries. The Company specializes in the trading of wholesale and finishing materials, and home furnishing products. It manufactures concrete and industrial joinery products. It provides activities such as materials trading, sale of industrial joinery, sale of concrete etc. It offers distribution of construction materials for building and public works. It provides exterior joinery (windows and doors in PVC, aluminum or wood), closures (roller shutters, gates and garage doors) and wooden structures (trusses, traditional frames and wooden panels). The Company offers ready-mixed, industrial and prefabricated concrete.

name: SOGECLAIR SA
businessSummary: Sogeclair SA is a French high-tech engineering company specialized in the design and development of industrial products and simulation solutions. The Company is established in three divisions: Aerospace division, providing services for aerostructure, systems installation, configuration and data product management and aerostructure subassemblies; Vehicle division providing engineering services for light industrial and military special vehicles; and Simulation division, which develops engineering and training simulators, as well as software for simulation purposes. Among the Company’s customers are Air France, Airbus, Thales, Aixam, Daimler, DGA, Technip, Renault, Technirail, SNCF and Neopost France, among others. Sogeclair SA offers solutions to three main market sectors: aeronautics and air traffic; automobile and rail, and defense and industry. It operates through subsidiaries, such as MSB Ressources Globales, among others.

name: MOULINVEST SA
businessSummary: Moulinvest SA is a France-based company that specializes in the wood industry. The Company provides wood cutting services and manufactures finished wood products aimed at the building industry, such as beams and timber frame structures for houses. The Company also uses the waste from its primary activity using biomass to produce electricity and heat, as well as manufacturing wood pellets to be used in heating systems. Moulinvest SA sources its wood from forests in the Auvergne and Rhone-Alpes regions of France. The Company has various direct subsidiaries, such as Scierie Moulin, which regroups the wood cutting activities of the Company, and Moulin Bois Energie, which focuses on the renewable energy activities of the Company. Moulinvest SA also has an indirect subsidiary, SCI de Ville, a real estate company which owns the building used by Scierie Moulin.

name: REWORLD MEDIA SA
businessSummary: Reworld Media SA is a France-based company engaged in the online information services sector. It specializes in publishing Internet sites for the general public dedicated to sustainable development. In addition, it develops and sells content and animations for Web portals and implements sensitization means and tools for companies and local administrations. The Company operates two Websites: Developpementdurable.com, which is engaged in the publishing of economic, social, environmental and political news, and GchangeTout.com, dedicated to products and services exchange between individuals. It has also developed a platform reworld.com, dedicated to sustainable development.

name: PRISMAFLEX INTERNATIONAL SA
businessSummary: Prismaflex International SA is a France-based company engaged in the design and manufacture of outdoor advertizing solutions and large format digital printing services. The Company provides outdoor signs, including trivision signs displaying three advertising campaigns, street furniture like bus shelters, display columns and city lights, scrolling signs, LED signs and traditional signs. It also offers indoor and outdoor point-of-purchase advertisings like printed carpets, light boxes, hanging systems, printed self-adhesives, parking billboards, movie frames and window solutions, among others used for trade fairs, exhibitions, festivals and other events. The Company also offers digital printing services designed for Prismaflex displays. It markets substrates, inks and other materials used in printing industry. It operates through subsidiaries based in Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, Spain, France, South Africa, Bahrain, Australia, Sweden and the Russian Federation.

name: STRADIM ESPACE FINANCE SA
businessSummary: Stradim Espace Finance SA is a France-based company, which specializes in the construction, development and sale of apartment buildings and individual houses. The Company is active domestically, mainly in Alsace, Champagne-Ardennes, Midi-Pyrenees and Pays de la Loire regions. The Company operates through its subsidiaries, including Espace Promotion SAS, Espace Foncier SARL, Habitat Services SARL, Espace Participations SARL and MC Bat SARL, among others.

name: HAULOTTE GROUP SA
businessSummary: Haulotte Group SA is a France-based company engaged in the manufacture of lifting and earth moving equipment. It operates through three business divisions: manufacture and sale of lifting equipment, rental of lifting equipment and providing services such as financing, spare parts, repairs, training and technical assistance. The Company offers two main product categories: People lifting equipment, such as telescopic, scissors, articulating, masts, push around, trailers and truck-mounted booms; and Material lifting equipment and earth moving, such as backhoe loaders and telehandlers. Haulotte Group has six production plants: three in France, one in Romania, one in China and one in United States. It operates through subsidiaries, including Haulotte France Sarl and Telescopelle SAS, among others. It is present in over 100 countries worldwide.

name: IMERYS SA
businessSummary: Imerys SA is a France-based specialty minerals company that provides a range of customizable solutions to many industries, such as construction materials, mobile energy, steelmaking, agri-food, automotive and cosmetics. The Company operates through two segments: Performance Minerals. Performance Minerals provides additives for paints and coatings, components for technical and conventional ceramics, additives for plastics and polymers, fillers and coatings for printing and writing paper, as well as board and packaging, filtration agents for liquid foodstuffs and blood plasma, specialty graphite for mobile energy and precision. The Company is active globally. It supports a diverse range of sectors, from construction and automotive to consumer goods. The Company provide renowned solutions based on processing and refining mineral resources, synthetic minerals and formulations.

name: TELEPERFORMANCE SE
businessSummary: Teleperformance SE, formerly Teleperformance SA is a France-based telemarketing and tele-services provider. The Company provides outsourced services and business consulting dedicated to customer relationship management. It specializes in the outsourcing of contact centers dedicated to customer relationship management. The Company offers customer experience management services, customer information services, technical assistance, customer acquisition, back-office services. It offers integrated business process management and digital transformation services and high value-added consulting services. The Company provides provision of specialized services, online interpreting, management of visa applications and debt collection.

name: ROUGIER SA
businessSummary: Rougier SA is a France-based producer of wood company. The Company sells logs, sawn timber and plywood produced in its forest and industrial units in Central Africa (Gabon and Congo, among others) throughout the world. In addition, the Company provides semi-finished products, such as decking and benches, among others. In France, Rougier has two import sales networks: Rougier Sylvaco, a specialist in various forms of tropical wood and Rougier Panneaux, a specialist in plywood panels. Rougier SA has several subsidiaries, including Mokabi, SPS International and Rougier Gabon, among others. The Company trades approximately 70 tropical wood species globally in more than 50 countries.

name: FOUNTAINE PAJOT SA
businessSummary: Fountaine Pajot SA is a France-based company that manufactures cruise catamarans and motor yachts. The Company involves in two divisions: sale of catamarans and services (primarily after sales services). It consists of a technological solution platform called Odsea Laboratory that transforms production processes in the field of renewable energy production, electricity storage and the electrification of propulsion and life. It also reduces the marine footprint of the boats through the concepts like Eco-Cruising and Smart Cruising. It has approximately 600 employees in its two production sites: the sail and core range units from La Rochelle in Aigrefeuille and the Flagships or large units from the Port Neuf factory in La Rochelle.

name: MERSEN SA
businessSummary: Mersen SA, formerly Le Carbone Lorraine SA, is a France-based company engaged in the production of carbon and graphite products and their application. The Company's activities are divided into two sectors: advanced materials and electrical power. The advanced materials sector includes graphite anticorrosion equipment, brushes and brush holders for industrial electric motors, and high-temperature applications of isostatic graphite. The electrical power sector includes solutions for energy management (namely power electronics; supplier of passive components for power electronics), electric protection and monitoring in industrial fuses manufacturing and current collection for the rail market. In July 2013, it sold its activities at the Gresy-sur-Aix site in the Savoie region of France. In December 2013, it sold activities specialized in stirrers and mixers and in metal plate heat exchangers.

name: BARBARA BUI SA
businessSummary: Barbara Bui SA, also known as Barbara Bui, is a France-based company that designs, manufactures and distributes women's fashion goods, ready-to-wear clothing and accessories, such as shoes and bags. The Company sells the products via boutiques in Paris, New York, Milan, Moscow, Ekaterinbourg and Seoul, and through a network of multi-brand shops and department stores in France, the USA, Canada, Africa and Asia, among others. It is also active in the perfume and cosmetics market with the fragrance named Barbara Bui Le Parfum. As of December 31, 2013, the Company operates through a subsidiary BBK Holding Etats-Unis, has 99.00% stake in Barbara Bui Srl Italie and 55.00% stake in Alain Tondowski Sarl France.

name: MG INTERNATIONAL SA
businessSummary: Mg International SA is a France-based company that specializes in swimming pool security and hygiene. The Company produces and sells a range of equipment for private and public swimming pools, such as Aquasensor and Aqualarm alarms that sound when people fall into swimming pools; Poseidon, computer assisted surveillance systems for the prevention against drownings and Aqualife, automatic coverings for swimming pools. MG International sells its products directly to swimming pool builders and distributors. MG International SA operates essentially in France, in Europe and in the United States through its subsidiaries including, MG Brazil, MG Iberica, Poseidon Technologies Inc and Safeblue. The Company is controlled by Maytronics Ltd.

name: HAVAS NV
businessSummary: Havas NV is a France-based company. The Company is predominantly engaged in providing a wide range of content production and management needs, including live-action editorial, audio, design, animation, digital production, and transaction. It is a provider of advertising and public relations services intended to create connections between people and brands through media. The Company is divided into two main segments: Havas Creative and Havas Media. The Havas Creative segment focuses on integrated marketing communications and solutions for its clients in industries such as sports, health, and financial services. The Havas Media segment focuses on media planning, buying, and digital activities via television, the Internet, and magazines.

name: ADUX SA
businessSummary: Adux SA, formerly Hi-Media SA, is a France-based multimedia company engaged in Internet publishing, online advertising and electronic payments. The Company operates through two business divisions: Publishers division and Advertisers Solutions. Publishers division specializes in the publishing of Websites, including Fotolog.com, Jeuxvideo.com, Blogorama.fr, Actustar.com, MagicRPM.com, GameOnly.com and Mujeractual.com. Advertisers division provides advertising sales and direct marketing services under the Hi-Media Network brand, and also offers electronic payment services under the brand names Allopass (micropayment platform), Hipay (electronic wallet) and Mobile Trend (mobile marketing and SMS center). It offers its services in France, Germany, Spain, Portugal, China and the United States, among others. The Company has subsidiaries as Admoove, a French location-based mobile advertising company, among others.

name: ICAPE HOLDING SA
businessSummary: Icape Holding SA is a France-based company that manufactures printed circuit boards and custom-made technical parts. The Company manufactures its products in Asia and more particularly in China. It owns more than 25 professional factories in the power circuit breaker (PCB) field and more than 50 factories in custom-made technical parts. Its portfolio of products includes single side and double side PCBs with polymer holes, double side PCBs with polymer, conductive holes, and special low-cost PCBs with polymer inks printing.

name: EKINOPS SA
businessSummary: Ekinops SA is a France-based company engaged in design, development, and marketing of open and interoperable telecommunications solutions for service providers (telecommunications operators and businesses) around the world. The Company develops optical aggregation and transportation sub-systems for metropolitan and long-distance networks. Its products include switching, routing and multi-protocol solutions, optical amplifiers, optical filters, as well as optical protection units, among others. Its system can be configured through a software download to manage the aggregation of multiprotocol services through integration of systems and functionalities, allowing systems to be used through a single protocol. The Company operates a network of business offices in Americas, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

name: SAMSE SA
businessSummary: Samse SA is a France-based company specialized in trading of construction material. The Company provides trading in construction materials, tiles, earthenware, joinery, floor coverings, parquet floors, sanitary ware, etc. aimed at professionals in the building, wood and public works sector. Its multi-specialist network represents a dense network which guarantees a close relationship with construction sites, craftsmen and construction companies. It provides storage capacities, logistics platforms and on-site delivery services provide customers with service and time savings.

name: JACQUET METALS SA
businessSummary: Jacquet Metals SA, formerly Jacquet Metal Service SA is a France-based company specialized in the distribution of special steels. The Company's main activity covers the purchase, storage and delivery of different families of products distributed to customers, essentially local, made up of small and medium industrial companies. The Company declines its offer through a portfolio of brands organized within three divisions, each targeting specific customers and markets. Jacquet distributes stainless-steel quarto sheets, Stapper distributes long stainless-steel products and IMS group distributes products for mechanical purposes. The Company operates globally.

name: KEYRUS SA
businessSummary: Keyrus SA is a France-based company engaged in management consulting as well as technology integration and management. It offers a portfolio of core business as well as industry-specific services. The Company operates under two main brands: Keyrus that addresses the segment of Key Accounts & Medium and enterprises, the provision of advice in the areas of management and business organization, as well as the provision of advice, integration and development of information system, and Absys Cyborg that is engaged in the development and integration of management solutions, such as Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Business Intelligence for small, medium and companies. It operates through Navigha, Creac'h Consulting and Qconsulting.

name: UV GERMI SA
businessSummary: UV Germi SA, formerly Bordas Uv Germi SA, is a France-based company engaged in the development of ultraviolet (UV) disinfection technology. It develops and manufactures a range of UV sterilizers for water treatment. Its sterilizers consist of low pressure mercury vapor lamps, which emit a monochromatic wavelength aimed at destruction of microorganisms. The lamps placed either in cylindrical tubes or canalization, with thin layers of water circulating around them and water components absorbing UV radiation. The applications of the Company's technology include dechloramination of swimming pools, treatment of drinking, rain and waste water, fountains and ponds disinfection, industrial water treatment, aquarium cleaning, and air treatment, purification and disinfection, among others.

name: SODEXO SA
businessSummary: Sodexo SA is a France-based service provider company. The Company operates through three main segments: On-site Services, Benefits & Rewards Services and Personal & Home Services. Its on-site Services delivers onsite customizable services, such as foodservices, design of workplaces, sterilization of medical devices, reception and cleaning services to Business & Administrations, Healthcare & Seniors, and Education industries. The Company benefits & rewards services provides customizable services to business customers for improve engagement, recognition, work-life balance, travel and expense management, health, and wellbeing. Its personal & Home Services covers three areas: childcare services, designed to take care of the youngest children; concierge services, to enhance the development and well-being of the clients’ employees in the workplace; home care services for seniors and adults who want to maintain their independence while enjoying the comfort of their home. It is active globally

name: BNP PARIBAS SA
businessSummary: BNP Paribas SA is a France-based international banking institution. The Company organizes its businesses into three main fields of activity: Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB), Commercial, Personal Banking and Services (CPBS) and Investment and Protection Services (IPS). CIB includes Global Banking, Global Markets, and Securities Services. CPBS covers commercial and personal banking in France, Belgium, Italy, Luxembourg, and in Europe-mediterranean, it also offers specialized businesses, with Arval and Leasing Solutions, BNP Paribas Personal Finance and new digital businesses and personal investors. IPS provides services such as wealth management, asset management, real estate and principal investments.

name: PLASTIQUES DU VAL DE LOIRE SA
businessSummary: Plastiques du Val de Loire SA is a France-based company that specializes in the manufacture of complex plastic parts. Using the injection process the Company processes thermoplastic petroleum granules into parts for use in such sectors as television and audio, automobile, telecommunications, electrical, construction and gardening. The Company’s portfolio of products includes vehicle interiors, front-end modules, under-bonnet parts, lighting and signaling, ovens, remote controls, household electrical switchers, among others. Plastiques du Val de Loire SA is operational through several subsidiaries, including Creutzwald Injection SAS, Cardonaplast, Tunisie Plastiques Systemes, Elbromplast, Karl Hess, Duna Injection Real Estate, Automotive Plastics Rochefort, as well as Banque Populaire du Val de France, among others.

name: PISCINES DESJOYAUX SA
businessSummary: Piscines Desjoyaux SA is a France-based company specializes in the manufacturing and marketing of swimming pools. Its activity is distributed as sale of swimming pools , property management. The Company provides private, collective and public swimming pools. It develops activities in the manufacturing of paving and coping and the production of associated equipment (roller shutters, robots, barriers, alarms, shelters, lighting, heat pumps, spas, saunas, water treatment systems, furniture). garden, etc.); It offers property management.

name: GUERBET SA
businessSummary: Guerbet SA is a France-based pharmaceutical group specialized in the manufacture and marketing of medical imaging contrast agents destined for diagnostic purposes. It produces medical imaging contrast products for x-ray imaging, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), ultrasound imaging and for nuclear medicine. The contrast agents are used in the diagnosis of cardio-vascular, inflammatory and neuro-degenerative disorders. The Company’s portfolio of products comprises brands, such as Xenetix, Hexabrix, Optiray, Oxilan, Telebrix, Lipiodol, Dotarem, Endorem, Artirem, Lumirem, and Lipiodol, among others. Guerbet SA is also active in the fine chemicals industry through its Simafex subsidiary. The Company operates through its subsidiaries, including Simafex, Medex, SCI KALB, Guerbet LLC, Guerbet Asie Pacifique and Guerbet GmbH, among others.

name: AQUILA SA
businessSummary: Aquila SA is a France-based company that provides 24-hour security services. The Company specializes in the prevention and assistance services for corporate clients and private individuals. It offers interventions in the response to security alerts, accompaniment services for workmen and maintenance technicians in the locations where there may be a security risk, as well as intervention services for elderly people. In addition, the Company develops and markets security devices, notably its Aquimobil portable global positioning system (GPS) security alert device. As of December 31, 2010 Aquila SA operated two subsidiaries: 95%-owned Aquiserv SAS, focused on services for professionals and 98.92%-owned Aquimedia SARL, operating as a 24/24 hour call center.

name: LACROIX GROUP SA
businessSummary: Lacroix Group SA, formerly knew as Lacroix SA, is a France-based industrial company primarily engaged in the design, manufacture and marketing of signaling and electronic control equipment. The Company has three divisions: LACROIX Electronics, which specializes in the provision of electronic subcontracting services, including the design, assembly and testing of electronic boards for the use in the industrial electronics, automobile, telecommunications, multimedia and electrical appliance sectors; LACROIX Sofrel, which is involved in the manufacture and sale of remote control and management products for technical installations and industrial sites through applications called Telemetry and SCADA, and LACROIX City, which designs smart road solutions for local governments and businesses. Lacroix SA is present in a number of European countries.

name: FERMIERE DU CASINO MUNICIPAL CANNES SA
businessSummary: Fermiere du Casino Municipal de Cannes SA (SFCMC) is a France-based company that operates casinos, hotels and other leisure facilities found within vacation resorts. The Company, which leases its facilities and equipment from Group Lucien Barriere, operates two casinos: Barriere de Cannes Croisette, and Barriere les Princes, and two hotels: a five-star Majestic, and a four-star Gray d'Albion. The Company also operates other leisure facilities, both on-site and in other locations, including restaurants, function and meeting rooms, swimming pools, tennis courts and a discotheque, and offers rental of shops. The SFCMC has five subsidiaries: Hotel Majestic (SIEHM), Hotel Gray d’Albion SA (HGAC), CASINO BARRIERE LES PRINCES (SCLC), SOCIETE D’EXPLOITATION DE LA PLAGE MAJESTIC (SEPM) and SCI 8 Cannes Croisette.

name: PLUXEE NV
businessSummary: PLUXEE N.V. is a France-based company. The Company is involved into benefits and reward services for the employees. It offers additional advantages such as restaurant meal, food, gift vouchers, mobility, training, and wellness. It includes other products as well, like rewards and recognition, public benefits, fuel, and fleet management. It also provides a wide range of proposals for food Services, Facilities Management Services, and worker benefit solutions. The Group's products are distributed through digital solutions that are used by the client employees on a daily or more occasional basis.

name: EUTELSAT COMMUNICATIONS SA
businessSummary: Eutelsat Communications SA is a France-based global satellite telecommunications operator, specializing in the provision of connectivity and video services across the globe. The Company provides fully integrated GEO-LEO satellite operator, with a fleet of 35 geostationary satellites and a low orbit (LEO) constellation composed of more than 600 satellites. It meets the needs of its customers present in four key market segments: Video, where it distributes more than 6,500 television channels, and the high-growth markets of Mobile Connectivity, Fixed Connectivity and Home Services. governments. The Company incomparable wealth of its in-orbit resources and ground infrastructure allows Eutelsat Communications to meet the needs of its customers around the world through integrated solutions.

name: BONDUELLE SA
businessSummary: Bonduelle SA is a France-based company primarily engaged in the processing and distribution of vegetables. It provides three types of products, such as canned, frozen and fresh processed vegetables, as well as ready-to-eat dishes. It offers its products under the Bonduelle, Cassegrain, Frudesa, Salto and Arctic Gardens brands, to the consumer markets in over 75 countries. The Company has its productions sites in several countries and has operations in more than 60 countries. The Company operates a number of subsidiaries.

name: DEVERNOIS SA
businessSummary: Devernois SA, also known as Devernois, is a France-based company specializing in design, production and marketing of women's apparel and accessories. The Company offers apparel and accessories for women, including suits, blouses, sweaters, skirts, pants, jackets, and dresses, among others. Its revenue is generated by the following segments: sales of company-owned magazines; sales to retailers: multi-brand stores, franchisees and department stores; sales to affiliates; The Company operates through subsidiaries: Sofrade SA, with its subsidiaries Italie 6 SARL and Devernois Belgique SARL; Devernois Espana SL, Socad SARL, Devernois Luxembourg SARL and Devernois Portugal LDA.

name: EMOVA GROUP SA
businessSummary: Emova Group SA, formerly Groupe Monceau Fleurs SA, is a France-based company primarily engaged in the retail of flowers and plants. It offers a range of cut flowers, blooming and green plants available in flower shops in nine countries, including France, Spain, Italy, Belgium, Germany, Japan and others. The Company's network comprises more than 450 flower shops, operating under Monceu Fleurs, Happy and Rapi'Flore brands. It also develops franchise agreements with flower sellers. The Company operates through its subsidiaries, including Happy Inc., La Generale des Vegetaux, Flore Distribution, KSV, Global Export, Gestflore, Floria Creation SAS, Hauraunize, Monceau Fleurs International and Monceau Fleurs, among others.

name: OPMOBILITY SE
businessSummary: Opmobility SE formerly Compagnie Plastic Omnium SE is a France-based plastic processing group with activities in the Automobile and Environment sectors. The Automotive Division comprises two businesses: Auto Exterior parts, offered by Plastic Omnium Auto Exterior, and Fuel Systems provided by Inergy Automotive Systems, among others. The Environment Division specializes in waste containerization, urban and road signage and urban planning, provided by Plastic Omnium Systemes Urbains, SULO and Compagnie Signature. Compagnie Plastic Omnium SA is present in Europe and in the North and South America, including such countries, as Germany, Belgium, Poland, Sweden, Romania, the United States, Canada, Argentina and Brazil. The Company operates a development center in Lozorno, Slovakia, for its exterior and structural components operations. It also has a number of plants and research and development centers across the world.

name: BURELLE SA
businessSummary: Burelle SA is a France-based holding company active in three areas: Industry and Services, through its subsidiary Compagnie Plastic Omnium SA, investment in other businesses through Burelle Participations and Real Estate, through Sofiparc. Compagnie Plastic Omnium SA, operates through two segments. It specializes in the manufacture of automobile plastic body parts, fuel and pollution control and produces waste containers (waste management systems) and urban/street furniture, as well waste management services. Sofiparc SAS, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, manages an office complex in Levallois, and land in Lyon and its Region. Burelle Participations SA, Burelle's wholly owned subsidiary, is an investment company focusing on investment in medium-sized companies through minority or majority interest holdings. The Company is present in Europe, North America, South America, South Africa and Asia.

name: SAINT JEAN GROUPE
businessSummary: Saint Jean Groupe, formerly known as Sabeton SA, is a France-based holding company, primarily active in the food processing industry. The Company through its subsidiaries produces and markets under the brands Saint Jean, Royans, Ravioles de Romans and Quenelles La Royale, different type of food, such as ravioli, fresh pasta, quenelles and ready meals, among others. It also manages an online shop and is active locally.

name: STEF SA
businessSummary: Stef SA, formerly known as STEF-TFE SA, is a France-based company primarily engaged in the transportation of refrigerated and frozen goods. The Company has three divisions: Transport unit, responsible for transportation of fresh and frozen products and seafood; Logistics unit, responsible for logistics of fresh and frozen goods for manufacturers, mass retailers, food service outlets and catering and IT Systems unit, which is responsible for STEF software and on customer-oriented software. STEF SA operates through subsidiaries, including STEF-TFE Transport, STEF-TFE International, Agrostar, among others. The Company is present in France, Italy, Switzerland, Spain, Portugal and Benelux, among others. It operates through Speksnijder Transport BV, Vers-Express Koel-Vries Logistiek BV and Transports Badosa, among others.

name: PROLOGUE SA
businessSummary: Prologue SA, (formerly Prologue Software), is a French company that delivers solutions in three key areas that can contribute to the optimization of information systems for companies. Its solutions include Cloud Computing with a brokering platform for tailoring solutions to the needs of each business, and tools for porting and administrating applications in the Cloud with optimized, controlled and cost-effective deployment and management; Unified communication including telephony and fax over IP systems that are fully integrated within the enterprise information system and Enterprise Content Management (ECM) and Exchange (EDI) incoming and outgoing flows, as well as documents circulating within the client's company. All the Company's products are based on a shared technological hub and allow for business-to-business exchanges, financial electronic exchange, and business-to-administration exchanges. Prologue SA also offers technical support and assistance.

name: ENENSYS TECHNOLOGIES SA
businessSummary: Enensys Technologies SA is a France-based company engaged in the design, manufacturing and marketing of the digital television transmission systems mainly for the mobile television, digital terrestrial television Internet protocol (IP) distribution, and test end monitoring solutions. The Company specializes in the broadcast of digital television via mobile telephones using digital video broadcasting, including handheld (DVB-H) and terrestrial digital multimedia broadcasting (T-DMB) technologies, among others. It also manufactures digital television/information technology interfacing solutions. The Company's core products include baseband converters, network adapters and Peripheral Component Interconnect (PCI) card adapters, among others.

name: AUREA SA
businessSummary: Aurea SA is a France-based company which operates in the environmental and sustainable development sector. The Company focuses on activities related to the recycling of motor oils, to the production of wheels with solid rubber tires at the base of used tires, and to the recycling of polyvinyl chloride (PVC). Aurea operates through its direct and indirect subsidiaries, including Compagnie Francaise Eco Huile SA, which is engaged in the recycling of oils used in vehicle motors; Rulo NV, which is involved in PVC recycling; Flaurea Chemicals SA, which provides hazardous waste treatment; DB Energies, which supplies petroleum products for heating, roads vehicles, agricultural tractors and public works machinery, and Roll Gom SAS that specializes in the treatment of used tires and Hipcricket, among others.

name: HITECHPROS SA
businessSummary: Hitechpros SA is a France-based company specialized in outsourcing services for IT sector. The Company operates a Website, www.hitechpros.com, which serves as a Web-based marketplace, intended for putting entities in the IT market in touch with each other, as well as providing assistance for chief information officers, by connecting them with the IT resources. Hitechpros SA’s clients include IT services companies, freelance consultants and training specialists, among others. As of December 31, 2011, the Company operates through its wholly owned subsidiary Hitechliberty SARL.

name: ARAMIS GROUP SA
businessSummary: Aramis Group SAS is a France-based company which provides an online platform services to purchase used cars in Europe. The Company allows anyone to switch vehicle where, when and how they want within 48 hours. It works with an array of Brands which include Aramisauto, Cardoen, Clicars, and CarSupermarket. The Company focuses on 4 strategic orientations which include Continue, Consolidate, Deploy, and Develop. It also works towards on reducing the impact on the environment.

name: ELIOR GROUP SA
businessSummary: Elior Group SA is a France-based company, which operates as an operator in the contracted food and support services industry. The Company caters to a number of sectors in the domains of business, education, as well as healthcare, among others. The Elior Group model relies on three main activities: contract catering, concession catering and support services. The activities are organized around two main commercial brands: Elior, which encompasses catering offers dedicated to business and industry, and Elior Services, which encompasses cleaning solutions aimed in particular at healthcare facilities and sensitive industrial environments, along with facility management services.

name: NEOLIFE SA
businessSummary: Neolife SA is a France-based company engaged in the manufacture of building components and solutions. The Company divides its offer in six product lines. The Outlife line provides exterior design solutions, such as cladding, insulated facade systems, outdoor joinery and covering systems. The Inlife division supplies interior design components, including partitions, linings and movable walls. The Sunlife’s offering includes terrace decking and systems, privacy screens, fencing and water walls. The Streetlife division manufactures street furniture, walkway sand and landscaping features. The Homelife line is engaged in the area of living spaces, and provides complete building solutions, garages, carports and summer houses. The Techlife line produces bio-sourced and recycled materials. The Company’s main product is VESTA, Vegetal, Ecological Stable Timber Advantage, an environmental material based on wood fibers.

name: BOGART SA
businessSummary: Bogart SA formerly known as Jacques Bogart SA, is a France-based engaged in the production and commercialization fragrances and cosmetics. The Company's portfolio of brands includes Bogart and licenses for Ted Lapidus, Carven, Chevignon and Naf Naf, among others. In addition, the Company sells ready-to-wear apparel under Balenciaga and Ted Lapidus brands. The Company distributes the products through a network of perfumeries in France and via local distributors or Company’s subsidiaries in Belgium, Germany, Austria, Italy, Spain, Portugal and China, among others. The Company operates through a number of subsidiaries, including Parfums Ted Lapidus SAS, Societe Francaise de Fabrication de Parfumerie SAS, Distribal SAS, Fairtrade SARL, Stendahl SAS, Aromalux SAS and Carven parfums SAS, among others.

name: METROPOLE TELEVISION SA
businessSummary: Metropole Television SA is a France-based audiovisual company that specializes in the production, distribution and marketing of television (TV) programs. The Company activity is distributed as operation of TV channel, operation of radio stations, production of programs and marketing of audiovisual rights. It provides 4 free channels (M6, W9, 6ter and Gulli), 9 pay channels (Paris Premiere, Tva, M6 Music, Serie Club, Tiji, Canal J, RFM TV, MCM and MCM Top) and 4 digital channels (6play, 6play Max, Gulli Max and Gulli Replay). The Company offers ownership of RTL, RTL2 and Fun Radio radio stations and broadcast of podcasts; It provides marketing of derivative products, publication of magazines, organization of events, publishing of websites, teleshopping, etc.

name: CATERING INTERNATIONAL & SERVICES SA
businessSummary: Catering International & Services SA is a France-based company engaged in the catering and support services for companies that carry out projects in extreme conditions. The Company is primarily active in such regions as Middle-East, Africa, South America, Asia and Eastern Europe. Catering International & Services SA has three divisions: Catering, which is responsible for the organization and preparation of meals; Engineering, which organizes engineering work, provision of equipment, design and preparation of site facilities; and Services Support, which provides transportation, maintenance and leisure services. The Company's main clients are companies in the oil and gas sector, the public buildings and works sector and the engineering and mining industries. Catering International & Services SA operates through several subsidiaries, including Arctic Catering Services, CIS Sierra Leone and CIS TCHAD, among others. In September 2014, the Company acquired 70% of Top Service.

name: NETGEM SA
businessSummary: Netgem SA is a France-based company involved in Internet Television (IPTV) solutions sector. The Group offers hardware and software technologies to telecommunication operators worldwide. Its hardware services include the end-to-end design, development and production of set-top boxes. Hardware products include Internet TV adaptor and Hybrid set top box. The Company's software services comprise a range of solutions, including personal video recorder (PVR), time-shifting applications and nCloud applications. Netgem SA’s principal clients are: TF1, TDF and Eutelsat. The Company operates through its subsidiaries and affiliated companies, including wholly owned NMS SA, Netgem Australie, Netgem Singapour, Netgem Iberia SL (Spain), among others. Netgem's decoders and software are used by customers in France and Australia, among others. As of December 31, 2012, it announced the merger of the entities NMS and PlugnSurf. On August 1, 2013 it merged with Videofutur Entertainment Group SA.

name: SEB SA
businessSummary: SEB SA is a France-based manufacturer of household equipment. The Company is present in three complementary sectors: Cookware, Kitchen Electrics and Home and Personal Care. The Cookware sector includes frying pans, oven dishes, pressure cookers, kitchen utensils, among others. The Kitchen Electrics is divided into two smaller groups: Electric cooking, which includes deep fryers, table-top ovens, rice cookers, induction hobs, barbecues, informal meal appliances and Preparation, which consists of food processors, beaters, mixers, blenders, juicers, coffee makers. The Home and Personal Care is divided into Linen care (including steam irons and steam generators), Home care (fans, portable heaters, and air-conditioners appliances, among others) and Personal care (hair care appliances, depilators, bathroom scales). SEB SA has six multi-regional brands: All-Clad, Rowenta, Moulinex, Tefal, Lagostina and Krups. It operates through SWIZZZ PROZZZ.

name: BENETEAU SA
businessSummary: Beneteau SA is a France-based holding company of the group engaged in the construction and sale of recreational boats and mobile leisure homes. The Group is organized into two divisions, including Boats, specialized in the design, production and marketing of recreational boats and luxury yachts, and Housing, engaged in the design, manufacture and marketing of mobile leisure homes. The leisure boats and ships are sold under such brand names as Beneteau, Jeanneau, Lagoon and Prestige, among others, and the mobile homes under O'Hara and IRM brand names. The Company operates worldwide through such subsidiaries as Beneteau Inc, Jeanneau America Inc, CNB (Construction Navale Bordeaux), Monte Carlo Yachts Spa, GBI Srl and Fonderie Vrignaud SA, among others. It is also active as a management software provider for the boat business.

name: ARCURE SA
businessSummary: Arcure SA is a France-based company specialized in the technology sector. The Company develops a range of solutions for enhancing the autonomy of industrial machinery. Arcure SA serves companies operating within construction, transport, tunnels or urban cleanup, logistics and the mining sector. Its portfolio includes two main products: Blaxtair and Omega. Blaxtair offers solutions for securing the perimeter around mobile industrial machinery and robots by preventing collision in working environments. Omega is an advanced stereoscopic camera calculating the disparity map by providing metadata to the user. Additionally, thanks to its two sensors, Omega provides the disparity map and raw images at 20 frames per seconds. Apart from France, the Company also operates in a number of countries, which includes Japan, Chile and England, among others.

name: PULLUP ENTERTAINMENT SA
businessSummary: Focus Entertainment SA, formerly known as Focus Home Interactive SA, is a France-based company principally engaged in the video games industry. The Company specializes in the developing and publishing of video games for PCs and consoles. It supports development studios in the production monitoring, the marketing, the sale and the financing of their projects. The Company has successful licenses such as The Surge, Vampyr, and A Plague Tale: Innocence. Its products are marketed by relying on the distribution networks of its partners, i.e. the wholesale and retail networks for the physical distribution channel and the download platforms for online distributions.

name: EIFFAGE SA
businessSummary: Eiffage SA is a France-based company which provides construction and concessions group services. It carries activities through five divisions such as Construction and maintenance of transport and civil engineering infrastructure: roads, highways, bridges, railways, etc. Furthermore, the group produces and markets aggregates, coatings, and binders; Design, construction, and maintenance of electrical, climate and mechanical engineering installations; Construction and renovation of buildings: homes, offices, shopping centers, car parks, stadiums, prisons, hospitals, etc. In addition, The Company is developing a real estate development activity; Construction and management under concession of infrastructure and structures; And Others.

name: DELFINGEN SA
businessSummary: Delfingen SA is a France-based company. The Company operates in the automotive sector and also in the building and electrical equipment industries. It provides solutions for electrical wiring and fluid networks in vehicles. It produces components for mobility markets in Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. Its products include wiring harness protection such as plastic tubing, textile sleeves, and shielding; hose and tube protection for various environments; and routing, fastening, and branching components. In automotive applications, it supplies systems for fuel tanks, engine compartments, washer systems, and interior trim fastening including seat retainers and felt stripes. It also offers tubing systems for conveying, filling, draining, and distributing low-pressure fluids in vehicles. Its services include product and packaging customization, delivery to production lines, multi-component assembly, and supply chain support.

name: GRAINES VOLTZ SA
businessSummary: Graines Voltz SA is a France-based company that is engaged in the distribution of seeds. The Company sells a range of flower and vegetable seeds varieties; flower seeds mixtures and vegetable seeds for the hobby market and professional horticulturalists, truck farmers, supermarkets and Do it Yourself (DIY) stores. Additionally, Graines Voltz offers also communication tools for retailers to highlight their products and develop their customer sales. On June 3, 2013, Company announced that on December 8, 2012 it acquired 100% of the share capital of Agreva, a Turkish company. The financial terms of the deal were not disclosed. On August 26, 2013, the Company announced the acquisition of all Plan SAS's Plan Ornemental shares.

name: SOCIETE MARSEILLAISE DU TUNNEL PRADO CAR
businessSummary: Societe Marseillaise du Tunnel Prado Carenage SA (SMTPC) is a France-based company that operates the Prado Carenage Tunnel and the Rege Tunnel.
