businessSummary: Paradise Entertainment Limited is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of casino management services. The Company operates through two business segments. The Casino Service segment is engaged in the provision of management services to casinos in Macau. The Gaming System segment is engaged in the development, provision and sales of electronic gaming systems. The Company is also involved in the market development and software development businesses through its subsidiaries.

name: ORIENT OVERSEAS (INTERNATIONAL) LTD
businessSummary: Orient Overseas (International) Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in container transport and logistics businesses. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Container Transport and Logistics segment is engaged in the provision of global containerized shipping services in major trade lanes, covering Trans-Pacific, Trans-Atlantic, Asia/Europe, Asia/Australia and Intra-Asia trades. In addition, this segment also provides integrated services over the management and control of effective storage and flow of goods. The Others segment is involved in the commercial properties.

name: LION ROCK GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Lion Rock Group Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the printing business. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Printing segment is mainly engaged in provision of printing services. The Publishing segment is mainly engaged in provision of publishing services.

name: EMPEROR WATCH & JEWELLERY LTD
businessSummary: Emperor Watch & Jewellery Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the sales of watches and jewelry. The Company is a retailer of European brand watches and self-designed jewellery products under its own brand Emperor Jewellery. The Company operates its stores across Hong Kong, Macau, mainland China, Singapore and Malaysia, as well as its online shopping platform. The Company’s watch products mainly include watches from different kinds of European brands, such as Rolex, Tudor, Tag Heuer, Zenith, Vacheron Constantin, among others. The Company’s Jewellery products include rings, necklaces, pendants, bangles, bracelets, earrings, brooches.

name: G & M HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: G & M Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of design and builds solution service for podium facade and curtain wall works. The Company is mainly engaged in the provision of one-stop design and build solutions in relation to podium facade and curtain wall works. The Company is also engaged in the provision of repair and maintenance services.

name: TASTE . GOURMET GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Taste . Gourmet Group Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the operation of restaurants. The Company principally provides Japanese, Chinese, Western, Vietnamese food. The Company also provides dessert and kiosks. The Company’s restaurant brands include Nabe Urawa, Dab-Pa, La’taste, Rakuraku Ramen, Yakiniku Guu, Parkview, Takano Ramen, Moments Together, Sankinn, Tirpse, Urawa, Wasyokuya Yamaichi, Say Cheese, Say Cheese Kiosk, Sweetology, Xianghui, Same Same.

name: PICO FAR EAST HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Pico Far East Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of exhibition, event and brand activation services. The Company operates its business through four main segments. The Exhibition, Event and Brand Activation segment provides exhibitions, events and brand activation services, including exhibition planning, promotional event design and video content production. The Museum and Themed Entertainment segment is mainly engaged in the design and decoration of museums and theme parks. The Visual Branding Activation segment is mainly engaged in providing digital experience and decoration services for retail stores in industries such as automobiles. The Meeting Architecture Activation segment is engaged in the management of conferences and exhibitions.

name: TIANJIN PORT DEVELOPMENT HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Tianjin Port Development Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of containerized and non-containerized cargo handling services. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Cargo Handling segment is engaged in the provision of container handling and non-containerized cargo handling. The Sales segment is engaged in the supply of fuel and sales of materials. The Other Port Ancillary Services segment is engaged in the provision of tugboat services, agency services, tallying and other services.

name: WATER OASIS GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Water Oasis Group Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the sale of skincare products. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Product segment is mainly engaged in the sale of skincare products under the brand names of h2o+, Erno Laszlo and Glycel. The Services segment is engaged in the provision of services in beauty centers, spas and medical beauty centers mainly under the brand names of Oasis Spa, Oasis Beauty, Aqua Beauty and Oasis Homme.

name: SHOUGANG FUSHAN RESOURCES GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Shougang Fushan Resources Group Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in coking coal mining, production and sales of coking coal products. The Company’s main business include coal mining business and coal processing business. The coal mining business include the mining and exploration of coal resources and the production of raw and clean coking coal in the People’s Republic of China (PRC). The Company owns Xingwu Coal Mine, Jinjiazhuang Coal Mine and Zhaiyadi Coal Mine in China. In addition, the Company engages in the coal processing business through its coal preparation plant.

name: COMPUTIME GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Computime Group Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the research and development, design, manufacture and trading of electronic control products. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Contract Manufacturing Services segment is engaged in the research and development, design, manufacture, trading and distribution of commercial and industrial control products. The Smart Solutions segment is engaged in the research and development, design, manufacture, trading and distribution of building and home control and appliance control products. The Company sells its products within domestic market and to overseas markets such as the America, Europe and Asia.

name: S A S DRAGON HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: S A S Dragon Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the distribution of electronic components and semiconductor products. The Company is mainly engaged in the distribution of electronic components and semiconductor products used in mobile phone products, consumer electronics products, computer and network products, and telecommunication products. In addition, the Company is also engaged in the sale of light-emitting diode (LED) lighting and display products, distribution of business equipment and provision of related ancillary services, contract works of LED lighting and display products and properties investment business.

name: DREAM INTERNATIONAL LTD
businessSummary: Dream International Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the plush stuffed toy business. The Company operates through three segments. The Plush Stuffed Toys segment is mainly engaged in the design, development, manufacture and sale of plush stuffed toys. The Plastic Figures segment is mainly engaged in the design, development, manufacture and sale of plastic figures. The Tarpaulin segment is mainly engaged in the design, development, manufacture and sale of tarpaulin.

name: MODERN DENTAL GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Modern Dental Group Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the production and distribution of prosthetic dental products. The Company operates its business through three segments. The fixed prosthetic devices segment is engaged in the supply of restorative dental products, including crowns, bridges and implants. The removable prosthetic devices segment is engaged in the production of full dentures and partial dentures. The others segment is engaged in the production of orthodontic devices, sport guards and anti-snoring devices, and the provision of educational events and seminar services.

name: JBM (HEALTHCARE) LTD
businessSummary: JBM (Healthcare) Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the development, manufacture and distribution of Chinese medicines. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Branded Medicines segment is engaged in the development, manufacture and distribution of branded medicines with chemical compounds as active ingredients. The Proprietary Chinese Medicines segment is engaged in the development, manufacture and distribution of registered Chinese medicines composed solely of any Chinese herbal medicines specified in the Chinese Medicine Ordinance, or any materials of herbal, animal or mineral origin customarily or widely used by the Chinese. The Health and Wellness Products segment is engaged in the distribution and sale of supplements, medical consumables and other nonpharmaceutical products for the general health and wellness of consumers.

name: ORIENTAL WATCH HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Oriental Watch Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the trading of watches and clocks. The Company operates through three regional segments: Hong Kong segment, Mainland China segment and Macau segment. Its brands include Roger Dubuis, Bulgari, Rolex, GUCCI and Calvin Klein.

name: JACOBSON PHARMA CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Jacobson Pharma Corporation Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacturing and sale of generic drugs. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Generic Drugs segment is engaged in the development, manufacture and distribution of a host of off-patent medicines for various therapeutic use. The Branded Healthcare segment is engaged in the development, manufactures and distributes branded medicines, proprietary Chinese medicines and health and wellness products. Currently the activities of two segments in this regard are primarily carried out in Hong Kong.

name: MS GROUP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: MS Group Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the production and sales of plastic bottles. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) Business Customer Product segment engages in the manufacturing and sales of plastic bottles and cups for infants and toddlers and plastic and stainless-steel sports bottles to OEM business customers. The Own Brand Product segment engages in design, manufacturing and sales of own brand infant products.

name: CRYSTAL INTERNATIONAL GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Crystal International Group Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacturing and sales of apparel. The Company operates through five segments: casual wear, denim, intimate apparel, sweaters, as well as sportswear and outdoor wear, it primarily provides one-stop manufacturing services for global apparel brands. In addition, the Company also owns production facilities, including garment and fabric factories, located in Vietnam, People’s Republic of China (PRC), Cambodia, Bangladesh, and Sri Lanka.

name: MEDIALINK GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Medialink Group Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the distribution of media content. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Media Content Distribution segment is engaged in the distribution of media content including animation series, variety shows, drama series, animated and live action feature films and other video content. The Brand Licensing segment is engaged in obtaining various rights to use third party owned brands, including certain merchandising rights, location based entertainment rights and promotion rights, and sub-licensing the use of these brands to customers and acting as an agent for brand licensors.

name: BUILD KING HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Build King Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the construction engineering business. The Company mainly operates its business in Hong Kong and Chinese markets. The Company’s business includes building construction, civil works, foundation works, railway and associated works, structural steel works, tunnels and maritime works. In addition, the Company operates a sewage treatment plant and steam supply plants.

name: STELLA INTERNATIONAL HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Stella International Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacturing and sales of footwear products. The Company operates business through two business segments. The Manufacturing segment engages in the sale and manufacturing of footwear and handbag. The Retailing and Wholesaling segment engages in the sale of products of self-developed brands.

name: WH GROUP LTD
businessSummary: WH Group Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the pork business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Packaged Meats segment is engaged in the production, wholesale and retail of low temperature and high temperature meat products. The Pork segment is engaged in the slaughtering, wholesale and retail of fresh and frozen pork and hog farming businesses. The Others segment is engaged in the slaughtering and sales of poultry. The Segment is also engaged in the sales of ancillary products and services such as provision of logistics services, manufacturing of flavouring ingredients and natural casings, manufacture and sales of packaging materials, operating finance companies, property development companies, a chain of retail food stores, sales of biological pharmaceutical materials, trading of meat related products and others.

name: CHINA STARCH HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: China Starch Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of starch products. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Upstream Products segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cornstarch and ancillary corn-refined products. The Fermented and Downstream Products segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of lysine, starch-based sweetener, modified starch and other products.

name: TEN PAO GROUP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Ten Pao Group Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the development, manufacturing, and sales of electronic charging products. The Company operates through six segments. The Smart Charger and Controller segment produces and sells smart chargers and controllers. The Telecommunications segment produces and sells switching power supplies for telecommunications equipment. The New Energy Business segment produces and sells energy storage products for electric vehicles. The Media and Entertainment segment produces and sells media and entertainment-related power supply products. The Lighting segment produces and sells power supply products related to lighting products. The Other segment produces and sells other power supply products.

name: MING FAI INTERNATIONAL HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Ming Fai International Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the hotel supplies business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Hotel Supply Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of hotel supply products. The Operational Supply and Equipment (OS&E) Business segment is engaged in the sale of operating supplies and equipment. The Health Care and Hygienic Product Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of health care and hygiene products.

name: DAWNRAYS PHARMACEUTICAL (HOLDINGS) LTD
businessSummary: Dawnrays Pharmaceutical (Holdings) Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of non-patented drugs. The Company operates its business through two segments. The finished drugs segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of finished drugs. The intermediates and bulk medicines segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of intermediates and bulk medicines.

name: QUEEN S ROAD CAPITAL INV.
businessSummary: Queen's Road Capital Investment Ltd is a financier to the global resource sector. The Company is a resource-focused investment company, making investments in privately held and publicly traded resource companies. The Company acquires and hold securities for both long-term capital appreciation and short-term gains, with a focus on convertible debt securities and resource projects in development or production located in safe jurisdictions.

name: CHINA FOODS LTD
businessSummary: China Foods Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in beverage business. The Company is mainly engaged in processing, bottling and distribution of sparkling beverage products, and distribution of still beverage products. The Company manufactures, distributes, markets and sells the Coca-Cola series products, offers products which include sparkling drink, juice, water, milk drink, energy drink, tea, coffee, functional nutrition drink, sports drink and plant-based protein drink.

name: CHOW SANG SANG HOLDINGS INTERNATIONAL LT
businessSummary: Chow Sang Sang Holdings International Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacture and retail of jewellery. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Manufacture and retail of jewellery segment engages in the manufacture and retail of jewellery and operates retail stores. The Wholesale of Precious Metals segment engages in the trade of precious metals. The Securities and Futures Broking segment provides brokering and dealing services for securities and futures. The Other Businesses segment engages in the investment in properties and other jewellery related businesses.

name: KUNLUN ENERGY COMPANY LTD
businessSummary: Kunlun Energy Company Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the natural Gas sales business. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Natural Gas Sales segment is mainly engaged in the retail sales, distribution and trading of natural gas products. The Sales of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) segment is mainly engaged in the wholesale and retail sales of LPG products. The Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) Processing and Terminal segment is mainly engaged in the processing, unloading, storing, gasification and entrucking of LNG. The Exploration and Production segment is mainly engaged in the exploration, development, production and sales of crude oil and natural gas.

name: UNITED LABORATORIES INTERNATIONAL HOLDIN
businessSummary: The United Laboratories International Holdings Limited is an investment holding company principally engaged in the sales of intermediate products, bulk medicine and finished products. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Intermediate Products segment is engaged in the sale of intermediate products. The Bulk Medicine segment is engaged in the sale of bulk medicine. The Finished Products segment is engaged in the sale of antibiotics finished products, non-antibiotics finished products and capsule casings. Through its subsidiaries, the Company is also engaged in the production and sale of organic fertilizer.

name: SINOFERT HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Sinofert Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the crop nutrition products business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Basic Business segment engages in the procurement and sales of potash fertilizers, phosphate fertilizers and sulfur. The Growth Business segment is engaged in the research, production and sales of bio-compound fertilizers and specialty fertilizers as well as the sales of plant protection products and seeds. The Production segment is engaged in the production and sales of crop nutrition products. Additionally, the Company provides technology research and development and services for crop nutrition-related businesses and products, engages in the mining and exploration of phosphate rock and produces feed calcium. The products include potash fertilizers, nitrogen fertilizers, compound fertilizers and phosphate fertilizers, among others.

name: Q P GROUP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Q P Group Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacture and sales of paper products. The Company operates its business through two segments. Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) segment is engaged in the manufacture and sales of greeting cards, tabletop games, educational items and premium packaging items. Web Sales segment is engaged in the manufacture and sales of playing cards, tabletop games and puzzles.

name: VSTECS HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: VSTECS Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the development of information technology product channel and the provision of technical solution integration services. The Company mainly operates through three segments. The Enterprise Systems segment provides enterprise system tools, including middleware, operating systems, Unix/NT servers, databases and storage for information technology (IT) infrastructure and IT infrastructure design and implementation, training, maintenance and support services. The Consumer Electronics segment provides finished IT products, including computer, mobile phone, drone, smart sports watch, three-dimensional (3D) printer, game console among others. The Cloud Computing segment provides cloud computing solutions and services. The Company has offices in People's Republic of China, Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines, Indonesia, Cambodia, Myanmar and Laos.

name: BOSIDENG INTERNATIONAL HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Bosideng International Holdings Ltd is a holding company mainly engaged in developing and managing the portfolio of its down apparel brands. The Company operates its business through four segments. The down related apparels segment carries on the business of sourcing and distributing branded down and related apparels and certain brand authorization. The original equipment manufacturing (OEM) management segment carries on the business of sourcing and distributing OEM products. The ladieswear apparels segment carries on the business of sourcing and distributing branded ladieswear apparels. The diversified apparels segment carries on the business of sourcing and distributing non-seasonal apparels, including school uniforms and children’s wear.

name: CHINA RESOURCES PHARMACEUTICAL GROUP LTD
businessSummary: China Resources Pharmaceutical Group Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the pharmaceutical business. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Pharmaceutical Business segment develops, manufactures and sells a range of pharmaceuticals and health products. The Pharmaceutical Distribution Business segment provides distribution, warehousing, logistics and other value-added pharmaceutical supply chain solutions and related services to pharmaceutical manufacturers, device manufacturer and dispensers, including hospitals, distributors and retail pharmacies. The Pharmaceutical Retail Business segment operates retail pharmacies. The Other Business Operations segment engages in property holding and other businesses.

name: FSE LIFESTYLE SERVICES LTD
businessSummary: FSE Lifestyle Services Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of comprehensive living services. The Company operates its business through three segments. The City Essential Services segment provides cleaning and waste disposal services, recycling and environmental protection disposal services, technical support and maintenance services, security guard services, environmental engineering services, landscaping services and other services. The Electrical & Mechanical(E&M) Services segment provides engineering and consultancy services on installation. The Property & Facility Management Services segment provides property and facility management services, property agency and related services for buildings, carparks management services and security services. The Company provides one-stop services to clients engaged in projects in property development, public infrastructure, education and transportation facilities and others.

name: GOLD PEAK TECHNOLOGY GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Gold Peak Technology Group Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the research and development (R&D), manufacturing, marketing and trading of batteries business. The Company, alien with its subsidiaries, operates its business through four segments. The Battery segment is engaged in R&D, manufacture and marketing of primary batteries, branded batteries and batteries related accessories. The Audio segment is engaged in the design, manufacture and selling of professional audio products, branded audio systems, branded loudspeakers and related electronics and acoustic products. The Rechargeable Battery segment is engaged in R&D and marketing of energy storage battery solutions and rechargeable batteries. The Other Industrial Investments segment is engaged in the investment holding business. The Company also engages in the business to business (B2B) battery business.

name: HYFUSIN GROUP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Hyfusin Group Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacturing and sale of candle products. The Company manufactures and distributes daily-use candles, scented candles and decorative candles. Daily-use candles include pillar candles, taper candles, tea light candles, and votive candles; Decorative candles involve silicon candles, botanical candles, and gel candles. The Company also produces and sells other products contain diffusers. The Company distributes its products in the United States of America (USA), United Kingdom (UK), Norway, Spain and other overseas markets.

name: SINO LAND CO LTD
businessSummary: Sino Land Co Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the rental of properties. The Company operates its business through six segments. The Property Sales segment is involved in the sale of residential units, including residential units in Corinthia By The Sea in Tseung Kwan O, Dragons Range in Kau To, the Palazzo in Chengdu, among others. The Property Rental segment is engaged in the rental of retail portfolio, office portfolio, and industrial portfolio. The Property Management and Other Services segment mainly provides property management services for finest residences, commercial buildings, shopping malls and exquisite clubhouses. The Hotel Operations segment operates hotels, including The Fullerton Hotel Singapore, The Fullerton Bay Hotel Singapore, Conrad Hong Kong, The Westin Sydney and The Olympian Hong Kong. The Investments in Securities segment is engaged in securities investment business. The Financial segment provides finance services.

name: WASION HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Wasion Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the advanced metering infrastructure business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Power Advanced Metering Infrastructure segment is mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of smart power meters and provision of respective system solutions. The Communication and Fluid Advanced Metering Infrastructure segment is mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of communication terminals and water, gas and heat metering products and provision of respective system solutions. The Advanced Distribution Operations segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of smart power distribution devices and providing smart power distribution solutions and energy efficiency solutions.

name: IMPRO PRECISION INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: Impro Precision Industries Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the development and production of various castings products and precision machining parts. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Investment Casting segment is involved in the metal forming process casting molten metal into a ceramic mold produced by surrounding a wax pattern. The Precision Machining and Others segment is engaged in the drilling or shaping on metal parts. The Sand Casting segment is engaged in the metal forming process forming molds from three-dimensional (3D) pattern of sand and pouring molten metal into the mold cavity for solidification. The Surface Treatment segment mainly provides surface treatment services including plating, anodizing, painting and coating. The Company's main products are engine parts, automotive parts, marine parts, aerospace parts, hydraulic equipment parts and construction equipment parts.

name: CHOW TAI FOOK JEWELLERY GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Chow Tai Fook Jewellery Group Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of jewellery products. The Company is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of gem-set, platinum and k-gold jewellery and gold jewellery and products. The Company is also engaged in the distribution of various watch brands. The Company operates its business through two segments: Business in the Mainland China segment and Business in Hong Kong & Macau of China and Other Markets segment.

name: PLOVER BAY TECHNOLOGIES LTD
businessSummary: Plover Bay Technologies Ltd is an investment holding company. The Company and its subsidiaries are principally engaged in the research, design, development and marketing of Software Defined WAN (SD-WAN) routers and the provision of software licenses and warranty and support services. The Company’s products and services are used by enterprise users, such as multinational companies, as well as industry users. The SD-WAN routers segment mainly offers wired and wireless routers bundled together with embedded software and firmware. The Company mainly operates its business in Hongkong, Taiwan, United States of America, Malaysia, Canada, Mexico, United Kingdom, Singapore, France, as well as Israel, among others.

name: DEEP SOURCE HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Deep Source Holdings Ltd, formerly Theme International Holdings Ltd, is an investment holding company principally engaged in the distribution, trading and processing of metal products. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Distribution, Trading and Processing Business segment is engaged in the distribution, trading and processing of bulk commodities such as silver and gold ingots, iron ores, steel products, nickel ore, chrome ore as well as related products. The Financial Services Business segment is engaged in the provision of securities and derivatives financial services, margin financing as well as fund management services.

name: CAFE DE CORAL HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Cafe De Coral Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in food and beverage businesses. The Company is principally engaged in operation of quick service restaurants, casual dining chains, institutional catering, as well as food processing and distribution. In addition, the Company is engaged in the development of ordering platforms, mobile ordering applications (Apps) and provision of quick response (QR) code ordering for takeaway and pre-orders services. The Company mainly operates its business in China.

name: LEVER STYLE CORP
businessSummary: Lever Style Corp is a Hong Kong-based investment holding company principally engaged in the trading of garments. The Company provides supply chain solutions in multiple apparel categories from shirt to bottoms, suits, outerwear, knitwear, suits, soft fabrics and sweaters. Its supply chain solutions encompass fashion design, prototype development, technical package including a blueprint consisting of production instructions and specifications to facilitate contract manufacturers to realize design visions, development, fabric and ancillary raw material procurement, production oversight, quality control, as well as delivery and distribution logistics subject to customers’ needs.

name: ORBUSNEICH MEDICAL GROUP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: OrbusNeich Medical Group Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the development, production and sales of medical equipment and machineries. The Company is engaged in the design, development, manufacture, distribution and sale of interventional medical devices for the treatment of coronary heart disease and peripheral vascular diseases. The Company's main products include percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) and percutaneous transluminal angioplasty (PTA) balloons. In addition, the Company's products also include semi-compliant balloons and scoring balloons for pre-dilatation and lesion preparation, coronary stents for implantation, non-compliant balloons for post-dilatation and specialty catheters. The Company mainly conducts its businesses in domestic and overseas markets.

name: KECK SENG INVESTMENTS HONG KONG LTD
businessSummary: Keck Seng Investments Hong Kong Ltd is a Hong Kong-based investment holding company principally engaged in property and hotel businesses. The Company operates its business through three segments. Hotel segment is engaged in the businesses of hotel room accommodation, provision of food and beverage at hotel restaurant outlets and the operation of slot machines. Property segment is engaged in the leasing of retail, commercial and office properties, as well as the development, sales and marketing of properties in Macau. Investment and Corporate segment is engaged in the management of its corporate assets and liabilities, available-for-sale and trading securities, financial instruments and other treasuries.

name: CHINA PIPE GROUP LTD
businessSummary: China Pipe Group Ltd, formerly SoftPower International Ltd, is an investment holding company principally engaged in the trading of pipes and fittings. The Company is mainly engaged in the wholesale, retail and logistics business of pipes and pipe fittings. The products sold by the Company include copper pipes and fittings, steel pipes and fittings, ductile iron pipes and fittings, epoxy cast iron (CI) pipes and fittings, stainless steel pipes and fittings, unplasticized polyvinyl chloride (UPVC) pipes and fittings, valve products, among others.

name: TECHTRONIC INDUSTRIES CO LTD
businessSummary: Techtronic Industries Co Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in power equipment products businesses. The Company mainly operates through two segments. The Power Equipment segment is mainly engaged in the sales of power tools, power tool accessories, outdoor products, and outdoor product accessories. Its power equipment products are sold under the MILWAUKEE, EMPIRE, AEG, RYOBI, HOMELITE, Imperial Blades, STILETTO and HART brands, or through original equipment manufacturer (OEM) customers. The Floorcare & Cleaning segment is primarily engaged in the sales of floorcare products and floorcare accessories. Its floorcare and cleaning products are sold under the HOOVER, DIRT DEVIL, VAX and ORECK brands, or through OEM customers.

name: PRINX CHENGSHAN HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Prinx Chengshan Holdings Ltd, formerly Prinx Chengshan (Cayman) Holding Ltd, is an investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of tire products. The Company develops, manufactures and sells tires and provides tire full-life-cycle services. The Company's tire products include all steel radial tires, semi-steel radial tires and bias tires, which are mainly used in intermediate and long distance transportation, buses, mixed road or off-road vehicles, light trucks, passenger cars, pickup trucks and sport utility vehicles (SUVs), vehicles for agricultural and industrial off-road conditions, among others.

name: PAX GLOBAL TECHNOLOGY LTD
businessSummary: Pax Global Technology Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the development and sales of e-payment terminals products. The Company is engaged in the provision of maintenance and installation and payment solution services as well. The Company is mainly engaged in the provision of android smart e-payment solutions, unattended solutions, classic e-payment solutions and commercial electronic point of sale (EPOS) solutions.

name: TOWN RAY HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Town Ray Holdings Ltd is a Hong Kong-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of electric heating household appliances. The Company is a product developer, industrial designer, manufacturer and supplier of various mid-range electric heating household appliances. The Company's electric home appliance products principally include clothing care appliances such as pump steam irons, garment irons and steam irons, as well as coffee machines, steamers and other cooking appliances. The Company's products are mainly sold to overseas markets, including Germany, France, the United Kingdom and the Netherlands.

name: GDH GUANGNAN (HOLDINGS) LTD
businessSummary: GDH Guangnan (Holdings) Ltd, formerly Guangnan Holdings Ltd, is an investment holding company principally engaged in the distribution and trading of fresh and live foodstuffs and provision of slaughtering services. The Company operates through three business segments. The Fresh and Live Foodstuffs segment is engaged in the distribution, purchasing and sales of fresh and live foodstuffs, operation of pig farming and the distribution of live pigs. The Tinplating segment is engaged in the production and sales of tinplate and related products, which are mainly used as packaging materials for food processing manufacturers. The Property Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing of office and industrial premises to generate rental income.

name: LEE & MAN CHEMICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Lee & Man Chemical Co Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacture and sales of chemical products. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Chemical segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemical products. The Company‘s products include polymers, basic chemicals, food and water additives, paper additives and lithium ion battery additives. The Property segment is mainly engaged in the development and sale of properties, properties rental and related properties services provision business.

name: CHINA OVERSEAS PROPERTY HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: China Overseas Property Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of property management services. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Property Management Service segment is mainly engaged in the provision of property management services such as security, repairs and maintenance, cleaning and garden landscape maintenance for residential communities, commercial properties, government properties and construction sites. The Value-added Service segment is mainly engaged in the engineering, review of building plans, equipment and facility selection advice to property developers and other property management companies. The segment is also engaged in the operation of community assets, home living services and commercial services. The Car Parking Space Trading Business segment is engaged in the sale and purchase of parking spaces.

name: ESSEX BIO-TECHNOLOGY LTD
businessSummary: Essex Bio-Technology Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the production and sale of biopharmaceuticals for the treatment of body surface trauma and eye injuries. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Surgical segment is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of Beifuji series products such as Beifuji spray, Beifuji lyophilized powder, Beifuxin gel and others. The Ophthalmology segment is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of Beifuji series products such as Beifushu eye drops, Beifushu eye gel, Beifushu single-dose eye drops and others. The Provision of Services segment is engaged in the provision of healthtech e-platform related medical services.

name: VALUETRONICS HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Valuetronics Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of electronics manufacturing services (EMS). Along with subsidiaries, the Company operates its business through two segments. The Industrial and Commercial Electronics (ICE) segment provides industrial and commercial electronics products. The Consumer Electronics (CE) segment provides consumer electronics products. The Company produces products covering smart lighting products, printers, temperature sensing devices, communication products, automotive products and medical equipment.

name: EDVANCE INTERNATIONAL HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Edvance International Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the provision of cybersecurity products and services. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Cybersecurity Services Business segment is mainly engaged in the provision of technical implementation and maintenance and support services. The Cybersecurity Products Business segment is mainly engaged in the procurement of network security products, system security products and application and data security products business. The Digital Assets Financial Services and Investment Business segment is mainly engaged in the provision of digital assets financial services. In addition, the Company is engaged in the venture investment and securities trading business.

name: SITC INTERNATIONAL HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: SITC International Holdings Co Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the provision of integrated transportation and logistics solutions. The Company is mainly engaged in the logistics services, including the provision of container transportation, freight forwarding, shipping agency, depot, warehousing services, container vessel leasing, land leasing and others. The Company operates trade routes and land logistics business networks covering multiple countries and regions.

name: ADR ON GEELY AUTOMOBILE HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Geely Automobile Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the production and sales of automobiles. The Company mainly develops, manufactures and sells automobiles, including cars, sport utility vehicles (SUVs), new energy and electrified vehicles. The Company's car types include home, travel and sports. The Company's new energy and electrified vehicles include electric vehicles, battery electric vehicles, hybrid electric vehicles, mild hybrid electric vehicles and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles. In addition, the Company produces and sells automobile parts, batteries and other automobile components. The Company also sells licenses for its intellectual property.

name: GEELY AUTOMOBILE HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Geely Automobile Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the production and sales of automobiles. The Company mainly develops, manufactures and sells automobiles, including cars, sport utility vehicles (SUVs), new energy and electrified vehicles. The Company's car types include home, travel and sports. The Company's new energy and electrified vehicles include electric vehicles, battery electric vehicles, hybrid electric vehicles, mild hybrid electric vehicles and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles. In addition, the Company produces and sells automobile parts, batteries and other automobile components. The Company also sells licenses for its intellectual property.

name: CLP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: CLP Holdings Limitedis an investment holding company mainly engaged in the generation and supply of electricity. The Company operates a portfolio of generating assets, harnessing a wide range of fuels including coal, gas, nuclear, wind, hydro and solar. Its business also includes transmission and distribution, and electricity and gas retail activities. Along with subsidiaries, the Company operates its business through five segments: the Hong Kong segment, the Mainland China segment, the India segment, the Southeast Asia and Taiwan segment, and the Australia segment. The Hong Kong segment operates a vertically-integrated regulated business. It is involved of generation, distribution and provision of electricity supply.

name: CHINA RESOURCES BEER HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: China Resources Beer Holdings Co Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in beer businesses. The Company's main businesses include the manufacture, sales and distribution of beer products. The Company sells its products within domestic market and to overseas markets. The Company's subsidiaries include CRE Beverage Trading Limited, China Resources Snow Breweries Limited and China Resources Snow Breweries (Sichuan) Co Ltd, among others.

name: CH DISPLAY OPT
businessSummary: China Display Optoelectronics Technology Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in flat panel display products-related businesses. The Company's main business include the manufacturing and sales of liquid crystal display (LCD) modules for computers and mobile phones, as well as flat panel display products, such as thin-film transistor (TFT)-LCDs. The Company mainly operates its businesses in China.

name: INTRON TECHNOLOGY HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Intron Technology Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company engaged in the provision of automotive electronics solutions. The Company provides solutions to the original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and their suppliers in the automotive industry, targeting critical automotive electronic components applied in new energy, body control, safety and power train systems. The Company’s services include designing, validating and fine-tuning solutions; developing customized design of the electronic components; sourcing and delivering appropriate semiconductor devices or electronic components.

name: BANK OF EAST ASIA LTD
businessSummary: Bank of East Asia Ltd is principally engaged in banking business. The Company operates through nine segments. Personal Banking covers branch operations internet banking consumer and property loans MPF and credit cards. Chinese Mainland Operations cover subsidiaries and associates in Mainland China and Hong Kong support. Wholesale Banking covers corporate lending syndicated loans asset financing commercial lending securities financing and trade services. Overseas Macau and Taiwan Operations cover overseas branches subsidiaries and associates and Hong Kong support. Treasury Markets cover treasury operations and securities trading. Wealth Management covers private banking investment products advisory and brokerage. Corporate Management covers regulatory capital costs and interest income from capital-funded activities. Inter-segment Elimination covers elimination of inter-segment transactions. Others cover trust services and Hong Kong back-office support.

name: CHINA EDUCATION GROUP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: China Education Group Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of private higher education services. The Company operates its business through three segments: the Higher Education segment, the Vocational Education segment, and the Global Education segment. The Company operates higher education and vocational education institutions in the People's Republic of China (the PRC) and provides education services in Australia and the United Kingdom (UK).

name: COSCO SHIPPING INTERNATIONAL (HONGKONG)
businessSummary: Cosco Shipping International (Hongkong) Co Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the ship-related business. The Company operates its business through six segments. The Marine Equipment and Spare Parts segment is mainly engaged in the trading and supply of marine equipment and spare parts. The Coatings segment is mainly engaged in the production and sale of coating. The General Trading segment is mainly engaged in the trading, storage, processing and supply of asphalt and other products. The Insurance Brokerage segment is mainly engaged in the provision of insurance brokerage services. The Ship Trading Agency segment is mainly engaged in the provision of agency services relating to shipbuilding, ship trading and bareboat charter. The Intelligent Shipping Services segment is mainly engaged in providing green, low-carbon and digital intelligent solutions for the shipping industry business.

name: AUTOMATED SYSTEMS HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Automated Systems Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in information technology (IT) related businesses. The Company operates its business through two segments. The IT Products segment is engaged in the provision of IT and related products. IT Services segment is engaged in the provision of systems integration, software and consulting services, engineering support for products and solutions, as well as management services. Its services and solutions include infrastructure, security, data intelligence, mobile and cloud categories. The Company operates businesses in Hong Kong, Mainland China, Taiwan, Macau, Thailand, Singapore and Malaysia, among others.

name: AIA GROUP LTD
businessSummary: AIA Group Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the life insurance and health insurance business. The Company provides individual and group life insurance, accident and health insurance, savings and retirement products, and offers related services including employee benefits, credit insurance and wealth management. The Company operates across multiple Asian markets through its subsidiaries and joint ventures.

name: KFM KINGDOM HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: KFM Kingdom Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of precision metal stamping products business. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of metal stamping, computer numerical control, sheet metal processing, product assembly and precision metal products. The Company sells its products in domestic and overseas markets.

name: CHINA TOBACCO INTERNATIONAL (HK) CO LTD
businessSummary: China Tobacco International (HK) Co Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the sales, import and export of cigarettes and tobacco leaf products. The Company operates its business through five segments. The Tobacco Leaf Products Import Business segment is mainly engaged in the import of tobacco leaf products in Chinese Mainland from origin countries or regions around the world. The Tobacco Leaf Products Export Business segment is mainly engaged in the export of tobacco leaf products. The Cigarettes Export Business segment exports cigarettes to duty-free outlets. The Brazil Operation Business segment is mainly engaged in the procurement, processing, sale of tobacco leaves and procurement of agricultural materials inherent to tobacco production in Brazil and from Brazil to regions around the world. The New Tobacco Products Export Business segment is mainly engaged in the export of new tobacco products to overseas market worldwide.

name: INTERNATIONAL HOUSEWARES RETAIL CO LTD
businessSummary: International Housewares Retail Co Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the retailing of housewares products. Its products are mainly sold under the brands of JHC, 123 by ELLA, City Life, Epo Gifts and Stationery, Happy Kitchen, Japan Home and JHCeshop. The Company is engaged in the sale of products such as home furnishing, fashion, personal care, food and household fast moving consumer goods. The Company operates its business through three business segments: The Retail segment, The Wholesale segment, The Franchise and Other segment.

name: TEXHONG INTERNATIONAL GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Texhong International Group Ltd, formerly Texhong Textile Group Ltd, is an investment holding company engaged in the manufacture of cotton textiles. The Company is principally engaged in the production and sales of yarn, gray cloth, fabrics and garments. The Company mainly operates its business in mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, Vietnam, Cambodia, the United States, Mexico, Nicaragua and other regions.

name: KLN LOGISTICS GROUP LTD
businessSummary: KLN Logistics Group Ltd, formerly Kerry Logistics Network Ltd, is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the provision of logistics and freight forwarding services. The Company operates its business through two segments. The International Freight Forwarding segment provides international freight forwarding services within Asia, between Asia and Europe, and between Asia and America, transporting goods by air, sea and cross-border land transport services. The Integrated Logistics segment provides integrated logistics services in Asia, including warehousing, inventory and other value-added services, land transportation and distribution, returns management and sales of goods.

name: EAGLE NICE (INTERNATIONAL) HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Eagle Nice (International) Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the sportswear business. The Company is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of down jackets, tracksuits, sweaters, sports pants and other sportswear.

name: YUE YUEN INDUSTRIAL (HOLDINGS) LTD
businessSummary: Yue Yuen Industrial Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of footwear products. The Company is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of athletic shoes, outdoor shoes, casual shoes, sports sandals, soles, components and other footwear products. The Company is also engaged in the retail and distribution of sportswear and footwear products. Retail operation also includes provision of commercial spaces to retailers and distributors.

name: CONVENIENCE RETAIL ASIA LTD
businessSummary: Convenience Retail Asia Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the operation of chain bakery stores. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Bakery segment is engaged in the manufacture and retail of bakery products. The Eyewear segment is engaged in the retail of eyewear products.

name: ANXIAN YUAN CHINA HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Anxian Yuan China Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in cemetery businesses. The Company's businesses include the construction and management of cemeteries, the sales of tombs and niches, the provision of burial services and the sales of funeral supplies. In addition, the Company mainly operates businesses in People's Republic of China (PRC).

name: TAK LEE MACHINERY HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Tak Lee Machinery Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the sale of heavy equipment and spare parts. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Sales of Heavy Equipment and Spare Parts segment is mainly engaged in the sale of heavy equipment and parts such as excavators, dump trucks, bulldozers, platforms, forklifts, vibratory rollers as well as others. The Heavy Equipment Leasing segment is mainly engaged in the leasing of heavy equipment and provision of lease-related operating services. The Repair, Logistics and Other Ancillary Services segment is mainly engaged in the provision of repair, logistics and other ancillary services.

name: CHEN HSONG HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Chen Hsong Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in plastic injection molding machines-related businesses. The Company mainly manufactures and sells plastic injection molding machines and related products, such as two-stage perform molding turnkey systems, shop-floor management systems and ductile iron castings, among others. The Company operates through three geographical markets, including Mainland China and Hong Kong market, Taiwan market and Other Overseas Countries market.

name: UMP HEALTHCARE HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: UMP Healthcare Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in healthcare businesses. Together with its subsidiaries, the Company operates business through its two operating segments. The Clinical Healthcare Services segment is engaged in the provision of medical and dental services, health check-up and other auxiliary services include imaging and laboratory services, physiotherapy services and vision care services. The Corporate Healthcare Solution Services segment is engaged in the provision of corporate healthcare solutions to contract customers. The Company is also engaged in the health check-up business and the provision of professional training to doctors and nurses under its GOLD training programme in Mainland China.

name: TEXWINCA HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Texwinca Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the textile and garment business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Production, Dyeing and Sale of Knitted Fabric, Yarn and Garments segment is mainly engaged in the production, dyeing and sale of knitted fabric, yarn and garments. The Retailing and Distribution of Casual Apparel and Accessories segment is mainly engaged in the retailing and distribution of casual apparel and accessories. The Others segment is mainly engaged in the provision of franchise services. The segment is also engaged in the property investment business.

name: MIRAMAR HOTEL AND INVESTMENT CO LTD
businessSummary: Miramar Hotel and Investment Co Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the office leasing business. The Company operates its business through five segments. The Property Rental segment is mainly engaged in the leasing of office and retail premises. The Travel Operation segment is mainly engaged in the operation of travel agency services. The Hotels and Serviced Apartments segment is mainly engaged in operating of hotels and serviced apartments and provision of hotel management services. The Food and Beverage Operation segment is mainly engaged in the operation of restaurants. The Others segment is mainly engaged in the other business.

name: LAM SOON HONG KONG LTD
businessSummary: Lam Soon Hong Kong Ltd is a Hong Kong-based investment holding company principally engaged in food manufacture and sale businesses. The Company operates its business through two segments. Food segment is engaged in the manufacture and manufacture and distribution of food products including flour, edible oils and specialty fats, and trading and distribution of health products. The food brands under the Company include Knife, Red Lantern, Golden Statue and American Roses Brand. Home Care segment is engaged in the manufacture and distribution of household and institutional cleaning products. The detergent brands under the Company include AXE, Labour and Procleanic.

name: ASIA COMMERCIAL HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Asia Commercial Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the sales of watches. The company operates its business through two business segments. The Watch Sales segment mainly operates retail and distribution of watch products. The Property Leasing segment mainly operates property leasing business. The Company mainly operates watch retail stores in the Chinese market.

name: KINGBOARD HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Kingboard Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacture and sales of laminates. The Company operates through six segments. The Laminates segment is engaged in the manufacture and sales of laminates. The Printed Circuit Board (PCB) segment is engaged in the manufacture and sales of PCBs. The Chemicals segment is engaged in the manufacture and sales of chemicals. The Property segment is engaged in property development and investment. The Investments segment engages in the bond investments business. The Others segment is engaged in hotel businesses, as well as the manufacture and sales of magnetic products.

name: COMPUTER AND TECHNOLOGIES HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Computer and Technologies Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in software development. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Application Services segment is mainly engaged in the provision of enterprise application software and e-commerce services for enterprises, including the provision of enterprise application software with implementation and ongoing support services, government e-commerce services, cloud services and other related value-added services. The Solutions and Integration Services segment is mainly engaged in the provision of IT solution implementation and application software development. The Investment segment is mainly engaged in property investment and securities treasury investment.

name: VCREDIT HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: VCREDIT Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of consumer financial services. The Company mainly provides credit products through pure online loan origination processes. The products are credit cards balance transfer products and consumption credit products.

name: NAMESON HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Nameson Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacturing and sales of knitted apparel products. The Company provides manufacturing services including raw material sourcing, product design, production and delivery. The Company knitted products include sweaters, pullovers, cardigans, vests and accessories.

name: TAI HING GROUP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Tai Hing Group Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in restaurant operations and management. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Hong Kong and Macau segment is engaged in restaurant operations and food sales in Hong Kong and Macau. The Mainland China segment is engaged in restaurant operations and food sales in Mainland China. The Company provides Chinese, Vietnamese and Japanese cuisine.

name: CONTINENTAL AEROSPACE TECHNOLOGIES HOLDI
businessSummary: Continental Aerospace Technologies Holding Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the general aviation aircraft piston engine business. The Company is engaged in the design, development and production of general aviation aircraft piston engines and spare parts, as well as the provision of aftermarket services and support for piston engines. The Company's customers are mainly from the United States, Europe and other regions.

name: SUN HUNG KAI & CO LTD

businessSummary: Analogue Holdings Limited is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the building services. The Company operates its business through four segments. businessSummary: Chinney Alliance Group Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the construction business. The Company operates its business through six segments. businessSummary: Fairwood Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in restaurants operation business. The Company mainly operates two businesses. name: GIORDANO INTERNATIONAL LTD
businessSummary: Giordano International Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the retail and distribution of apparel. The Company operates its business through two segments. name: AEON CREDIT SERVICE ASIA CO LTD
businessSummary: Aeon Credit Service Asia Co Ltd is a Hong Kong-based company engaged in the provision of financial services business. The Company operates its business through three segments. businessSummary: Johnson Electric Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacturing and sale of motion systems. businessSummary: Inspur Digital Enterprise Technology Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the information technology (IT) business. businessSummary: Tao Heung Holdings Limited is an investment holding company principally engaged in food and beverage businesses. businessSummary: Pacific Textiles Holdings Limited is a Hong Kong-based investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacturing and trading of textile products. businessSummary: Bamboos Health Care Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally providing healthcare staffing solutions services. businessSummary: APT Satellite Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of satellite transponder capacity services. businessSummary: King's Flair International (Holdings) Ltd is an investment holding company engaged in the design, research and development and distribution of kitchenware products. businessSummary: Tianneng Power International Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the battery manufacturing business. The Company operates its business through two segments. businessSummary: LH Group Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the operation of full-service restaurants. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Dental Service segment which comprises the provision of dental services and related treatments.

name: BAUHAUS INTERNATIONAL (HOLDINGS) LTD
businessSummary: Bauhaus International (Holdings) Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in apparel businesses. businessSummary: Chiho Environmental Group Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the resources recycling business. The Company operates its business through three segments. businessSummary: SSY Group Ltd, formerly known as Lijun International Pharmaceutical Holding Co Ltd, is an investment holding company principally engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of pharmaceutical products. name: TAN CHONG INTERNATIONAL LTD
businessSummary: Tan Chong International Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the distribution of motor vehicle. The Company operates through five segments. businessSummary: Jinhui Holdings Co Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in shipping business. The Company is engaged in ship leasing and ship ownership business.
