businessSummary: FWD Group Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the life insurance business. The Company is primarily engaged in the provision of participating life, non-participating life, critical illness, term life, medical and riders, unit-linked insurance, group insurance as well as other life insurance products. In addition, the Company is engaged in the sale of insurance products through the distribution channels, including bancassurance, agency, brokerages and independent financial advisers (IFAs), as well as other channels such as direct-to-customer (D2C) ecommerce platform. The Company mainly sells products within domestic market and to overseas markets.

name: GUANGDONG INVESTMENT LTD
businessSummary: Guangdong Investment Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the water distribution and sewage treatment. The Company operates its business through seven segments. The Water Resources segment engages in water distribution, sewage treatment, and construction of water supply and sewage treatment infrastructure. The Property Investment and Development segment engages in the development and sale of properties and provides property management services to commercial properties. The Department Store Operation segment operates department stores. The Electric Power Generation segment operates coal-fired power plants supplying electricity and steam. The Hotel Operation and Management segment engages in the hotel operation. The Road and Bridge segment engages in toll road operation. The Others segment provides treasury services.

name: CHINA MERCHANTS PORT HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: China Merchants Port Holdings Co Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in port-related business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Port Operation segment is principally engaged in container terminal operations and bulk cargo terminal operations. The Bonded Logistics Operation segment is principally engaged in logistics park operations, port transportation and airport cargo handling business. The Other Operation segment is principally engaged in property development, investment, and logistics, as well as corporate function businesses.

name: KA SHUI INTERNATIONAL HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Ka Shui International Holdings Ltd is a Hong Kong-based investment holding company principally engaged in the plastic businesses. The Company operates through five segments. Plastic segment is engaged in plastic injection products manufacture and sale business. Magnesium Alloy Die Casting segment is engaged in the die casting of magnesium alloy. Aluminum Alloy Die Casting segment is engaged in the die casting of aluminum alloy. Zinc Alloy Die Casting segment is engaged in the die casting of zinc alloy. Others segment is mainly engaged in the trading of lighting products, production of smart home products and provision of motor vehicle sales and repairing business.

name: MIDLAND HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Midland Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of property agency services for residential, commercial and industrial properties and shops. The Company is also engaged in the leasing of property, the operation of Internet Website and the provision of immigration consultancy services, administration and treasury services to group companies, as well as professional surveying consultancy and valuation services in Hong Kong through its subsidiaries. The Company's principal subsidiaries include Astra Profits Limited, Guangzhou Midland Property Agency Company Limited, HKP Estate Agency (Macau) Limited and Hong Kong Property Services (Agency) Limited.

name: YIP'S CHEMICAL HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Yip's Chemical Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in chemical businesses. The Company operates through four segments. Coatings segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture of and trading in coatings and related products. Inks segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture of and trading in inks and related products. Lubricants segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture of and trading in lubricants products. Properties segment is mainly engaged in the property investment.

name: GLORIOUS SUN ENTERPRISES LTD
businessSummary: Glorious Sun Enterprises Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the interior decoration and renovation business. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Interior Decoration and Renovation segment is mainly engaged in the interior decoration and renovation, and the sale of furniture business. The Export Operations segment is mainly engaged in the exports of apparel. The Financial Investments segment is mainly engaged in the treasury management and consulting services. The Retail, Franchise and Others segment mainly includes retail operation in Hong Kong and franchise sales under the Jeanswest brand in overseas markets within the casual wear and apparel domain.

name: CHEVALIER INTERNATIONAL HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Chevalier International Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the construction and engineering businesses. The Company operates through six segments. The Construction and Engineering segment is engaged in the aluminum windows and curtain walls, building constructions, building supplies, electrical and mechanical engineering, lifts and escalators-related businesses. The Car Dealership segment is engaged in the sale of cars. The Healthcare Investment segment is engaged in the senior housing properties investment business. The Property Development and Operations segment is engaged in the property development, cold storage and logistics businesses. The Property Investment segment is engaged in the residential and commercial property investment business The Others segment is engaged in the computer and information technology (IT), food and beverage retail, food trading, insurance and software development businesses.

name: LK TECHNOLOGY HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: LK Technology Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the design and manufacture of die-casting machines. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Die-casting Machine segment is principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of hot chamber and cold chamber die-casting machines. The Plastic Injection Molding Machine segment is principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of plastic injection molding machines and related accessories. The Computerized Numerical Controlled (CNC) Machining Centre segment is principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of CNC machining related products and accessories.

name: WULING MOTORS HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Wuling Motors Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in automotive businesses. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Automotive Components and Other Industrial Services segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive components and accessories, trading of steels, and provision of water and power supply services. The Commercial Vehicles Assembly segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of specialized vehicles such as new energy vehicles. The Vehicles’ Power Supply Systems segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of engines and engine related parts and other power supply products. The Other segment is mainly engaged in the property investment and other business.

name: DAH SING BANKING GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Dah Sing Banking Group Limited is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of banking, financial and other related services in Hong Kong, Macau and the People’s Republic of China. The Company operates its business through five segments. The Personal Banking Business segment is engaged in deposits from individual customers, the extension of residential mortgage lending and personal loans. The Commercial Banking Business segment is engaged in the acceptance of deposits from and the advance of loans and working capital finance and trade financing. The Treasury Activities segment is engaged in the provision of foreign exchange services and centralized cash management for deposit taking and lending, interest rate risk management. The Overseas Banking Businesses segment is engaged in the provision of personal banking and commercial banking business activities. The Others segment is engaged in other corporate investments and debt funding.

name: FOSUN INTERNATIONAL LTD
businessSummary: Fosun International Ltd is a company principally engaged in the operation and investments in global consumer business. The Company operates its business through five segments. The Happiness segment engages in the operation and investments in tourism and leisure, fashion consumer and lifestyle industries. The Health segment engages in the research and development, manufacture, sale and trading of pharmaceutical and health products and providing medical services and health management. The Insurance segment mainly engages in the operation of and investment in the insurance businesses. The Asset Management segment comprises principally the operation and investment of asset management, market investments, and investments in other companies of the Group. The Intelligent Manufacturing segment comprises principally the operation of and investment in the intelligent manufacturing and iron, steel, new functional materials and ore production.

name: CK ASSET HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: CK Asset Holdings Ltd is a company mainly engaged in the property development and investment business. The Company is mainly engaged in the property sales and property leasing business. Additionally, the Company is engaged in the hotel and serviced suite operation business, property and project management business. The Company is engaged in the pub operation business, investment in infrastructure and utility asset operation business as well. The Company operates its business in domestic and overseas markets.

name: SOUNDWILL HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Soundwill Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of property leasing services. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Property Development segment engages in the development of residential, commercial and industrial properties. The Property Leasing segment provides property rental services including signage rental and rental under ministorage operation. The Building Management and Other Services segment engages in the provision of building management, property repairs and maintenance services.

name: CITIC TELECOM INTERNATIONAL HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: CITIC Telecom International Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of telecommunications services. The Company is an Internet-based integrated telecommunications enterprise that principally provides mobile communication services, Internet services, international telecommunications services, enterprise services and fixed-line voice services. The Company is also engaged in the sale of mobile phone handsets and equipment. In addition, the Company is also engaged in the provision of value-added telecommunications services through its subsidiaries.

name: XINYI GLASS HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Xinyi Glass Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in manufacture and sales of glass. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Float Glass segment is engaged in the manufacture and sales of clear glass, F-green glass and European gray glass. The Automobile Glass segment is engaged in the manufacture and sales of glass in automobiles. The Construction Glass segment is engaged in the manufacture and sales of construction glass, such as tempered glass and laminated glass, among others. The Company is also involved in the manufacture and sales of rubber and plastic products and the provision of logistics services.

name: BOC HONG KONG HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: BOC Hong Kong (Holdings) Limited is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of banking and related financial services in Hong Kong. The Company operates its business through four segments: Personal Banking, Corporate Banking, Treasury and Insurance. The Company’s subsidiaries include Bank of China (Hong Kong) Limited, BOC Group Life Assurance Company Limited and Nanyang Commercial Bank, Limited. Through its subsidiaries, the Company is also engaged in the provision of nominee services.

name: CHINA MERCHANTS CHINA DIRECT INVESTMENTS
businessSummary: China Merchants China Direct Investments Ltd is an investment holding company primarily engaged in financial investments business. The Company operates through three segments. The Financial Services segment invests in companies engaged in financial services activities. The Information Technology segment invests in companies engaged in information technology activities. The Culture, Media and Consumption segment invests in companies engaged in culture, media and consumption activities.

name: EPRINT GROUP LTD
businessSummary: eprint Group Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the paper printing business. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Paper Printing segment is mainly engaged in the provision of leaflets, booklets, business cards, stationery and other paper printing products. The Banner Printing segment is mainly engaged in the provision of roll-up banners, mountings, stickers, posters, flags, promotional tables, outdoor banners and other digital printing products. In addition, the Company is engaged in the provision of artificial intelligence (AI) online design platform.

name: BEIJING ENTERPRISES HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Beijing Enterprises Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the gas business. The Company operates its business through five segments. The Gas segment distributes and sells pipeline natural gas and gas-related equipment. This segment also produces and sells oil and natural gas. The Water Business segment constructs sewage and water treatment plants and other infrastructure, provides water supply and provides consulting services. The Environmental Business segment provides waste incineration plant construction and waste treatment services as well as sells electricity, steam and heat generated from waste incineration. The Beer Business segment produces, distributes and sells beer products. The Other Business segment provides consulting services, property investment and corporate income and expenditure projects.

name: JARDINE MATHESON HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Jardine Matheson Holdings Limited is a holding company with diversified businesses focused principally on Asia. Along with subsidiaries, the Company operates its business through the following segments: Jardine Pacific, Jardine Motors, Jardine Lloyd Thompson, Hongkong Land, Dairy Farm, Mandarin Oriental, Jardine Cycle & Carriage and Astra. The Company and its subsidiaries provide services in the fields of property investment and development, motor vehicles and related activities, retailing, restaurants, engineering and construction, transport services, insurance broking, hotel investment and management, financial services, heavy equipment, mining and agribusiness.

name: TCL ELECTRONICS HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: TCL Electronics Holdings Co Ltd is an investment holding company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of televisions (TVs). The Company operates its business through six business segments. The TV segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of TVs. The Photovoltaic Business segment is engaged in the sale of photovoltaic power generation equipment and systems, provision of construction, operation and maintenance services and others. The All-Category Marketing segment distribution of air conditioners, refrigerators, washing machines and others. The Smart Mobile, Connective Devices and Services segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of mobile phones, smart connective products and smart display and services. The Internet Business segment is engaged in the membership cards, video-on-demand, advertising, vertical application and others. The Smart Commercial Display, Smart Home and Other Businesses segment is engaged in the supply of smart commercial display and others.

name: FIRST PACIFIC CO LTD
businessSummary: First Pacific Co Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the manufacturing and sale of consumer food products. Along with subsidiaries, the Company operates its business in Asia-Pacific through four segments. The Consumer Food Products segment is involved in the production and sale of consumer food products through PT Indofood Sukses Makmur Tbk (Indofood). The Telecommunications segment provides telecommunications services through PLDT Inc. The Infrastructure segment is involved in the infrastructure investment management through Metro Pacific Investments Corporation (MPIC). It is engaged in supply of electricity and water, operation of toll roads, hospital groups, railways and power plants. The Natural Resources segment is involved in the metal mining, and producing gold, copper and silver through Philex Mining Corporation (Philex). In addition, it is also engaged in integrated sugar and ethanol businesses.

name: CHINA RSRCS BLDG
businessSummary: China Resources Building Materials Technology Holdings Ltd, formerly China Resources Cement Holdings Ltd, is an investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of cement. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Cement segment is principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of cement and related products. The Concrete segment is principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of concrete and related products.

name: VICON HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Vicon Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the construction businesses. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Construction Work segment is engaged in the provision of foundation works and ancillary services. Leasing of Construction Machinery segment is engaged in the leasing of construction machinery.

name: SITOY GROUP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Sitoy Group Holdings Ltd is mainly engages in the manufacture and sales of handbags, small leather goods and travel goods. The Company operates through two business segments. The Manufacturing segment is engaged in the manufacture of handbags, small leather goods and travel goods for brands owned by other companies. The Retail segment is engaged in the manufacture and retail of handbags, small leather goods and travel goods for the brands owned by the Company, and the provision of advertising and marketing services. The Property Investment segment mainly invests in office spaces for its rental income or capital appreciation purposes.

name: CIRCUTECH INTERNATIONAL HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: CircuTech International Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in sales and distribution of Information Technology (IT) products business. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Sales and Distribution of IT Products segment is mainly engaged in the design, manufacturing and marketing of video surveillance systems and distributes third party IT products. The Repairs and Service Support segment is mainly engaged in the providing of repair, maintenance, and other service support for electronic products.

name: CHINA TRADITIONAL CHINESE MEDICINE HOLDI
businessSummary: China Traditional Chinese Medicine Holdings Co Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the traditional Chinese medicines (TCM) business. The Company operates its business through four segments. Yi Fang segment mainly manufactures and sales of concentrated TCM granules (CTCMG), TCM healthcare products, and TCM decoction pieces. Tian Jiang segment mainly manufactures and sales of CTCMG, TCM decoction pieces, and TCM healthcare products. The segment also provides Chinese medical related healthcare solutions, including Chinese medical consultation and diagnosis, TCM physiotherapy, and prescription with CTCMG and others, through its offline medical institutions. Tong Ji Tang segment mainly manufactures and sales of CTCMG, TCM decoction pieces and TCM finished drugs. The segment also manufactures and sales of healthcare products in great health industry. Medi-World segment mainly manufactures and sales of TCM finished drugs and provision of TCM Healthcare Solutions.

name: AHSAY BACKUP SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT CO LTD
businessSummary: Ahsay Backup Software Development Co Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of online backup software solutions. The Company operates through two segments. The Online Backup Software and Related Service segment primarily engages in the software license sales and leasing, provision of software upgrades and maintenance services and provision of other services. The Information Platform segment primarily engages in the provision of information sharing services and an analysis tool, sale of hardware devices and provision of other services.

name: DICKSON CONCEPTS (INTERNATIONAL) LTD
businessSummary: Dickson Concepts (International) Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the sale of luxury goods business. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Sale of Luxury Goods Business segment is engaged in the retail and wholesale of watches, jewellery, cosmetics and beauty products, fashion and accessories. The Securities Investment Business segment is engaged in the investment in listed and unlisted securities.

name: LEE'S PHARMACEUTICAL HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Lee's Pharmaceutical Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the development, manufacturing, marketing and sales of pharmaceutical products. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Imported Products segment is engaged in the sale of imported products. Its imported products include Keyan injection, Fipril oral solution and others. The Proprietary Products segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of self-developed products. Its R&D products include Resilicon Tablets, ADASUVE Inhalation Powder and others. The Company's medicines cover the fields of cardiovascular and infectious diseases, dermatology, oncology, gynecology and ophthalmology. The Company mainly operates its business in mainland China, Hong Kong and Taiwan.

name: CK HUTCHISON HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: CK Hutchison Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the retail business of health and beauty products. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Retail segment is mainly engaged in the retail business of health and beauty products, supermarkets, consumer electronics and electrical appliances, foreign wines, perfumes and cosmetics, as well as engages in the manufacturing and distribution of bottled water and beverages. The Telecommunication segment mainly provides integrated telecommunications and digital services. The Ports and Related Service segment is mainly engaged in the operation of ports and terminals, and the provision of port-related logistics services. The Infrastructure segment has diversified investments in energy, transportation, water treatment, waste management, waste-to-energy, building services infrastructure and infrastructure-related business. The Company also engages in finance and investment activities.

name: VTECH HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: VTech Holdings Limited is a Hong Kong-based investment holding company principally engaged in electronic products-related businesses. Its main businesses include the design, manufacture and distribution of consumer electronic products, such as electronic education toys and phones, among others. The Company operates through four geographical segments, including North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Others.

name: SUNDART HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Sundart Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in interior decoration engineering business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Interior Decoration Engineering segment is engaged in the interior decoration engineering business for commercial buildings, hotels, residential properties, serviced apartments and other properties. The Renovation and Extension and Construction Engineering segment is engaged in renovation and extension and construction business, including construction, interior decoration, repair, maintenance and renovation and extension works. The Manufacturing, Procurement and Distribution of Interior Decoration Materials segment is engaged in the manufacturing, procurement and distribution of interior decoration materials as well as provides construction optimization and prefabrication services for interior decoration projects.

name: HONG KONG FERRY HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Hong Kong Ferry Holdings Co Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in property development. The Company operates through five segments. Property Development segment is engaged in the development and sales of properties. Property Investment segment is engaged in the leasing of properties. Ferry, Shipyard and Related Operation segment is engaged in the operation of dangerous goods vehicular ferries, as well as the provision of cruise vessels, ship repair and ship maintenance services. Medical, Healthcare and Beauty Service segment is engaged in provision of medical, healthcare and beauty services. Securities Investment segment is engaged in debt and equity securities investment.

name: PACIFIC BASIN SHIPPING LTD
businessSummary: Pacific Basin Shipping Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the shipping business. The Company is mainly engaged in the provision of dry bulk shipping services. The Company mainly operates modern Handysize and Supramax dry bulk ships. The Company also engages in the management and investment of the Group’s cash and deposits.

name: YUEXIU TRANSPORT INFRASTRUCTURE LTD
businessSummary: Yuexiu Transport infrastructure Ltd is a company primarily engaged in the investment, construction, development, operation, and management of highways and bridges. The Company primarily engages in the investment, construction, and operation of highways and bridges, as well as the management of terminals and port facilities. In addition, the Company also engages in the leasing of service areas and gas stations.

name: CHINA EVERBRIGHT LTD
businessSummary: China Everbright Ltd is an investment holding principally engaged in the investment and financial services. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Fund Management Business segment is comprised of primary market investment, secondary market investment and Fund of Funds (FoF) investment. This segment mainly operates equity securities and derivatives investment, asset management and fund investment. The Principal Investments Business segment include key investee companies investments, financial investments and cornerstone investments. The key investee companies investments focusing on aircraft leasing, artificial intelligence of things (AIoT) and elderly care industry platforms. The financial investments focusing on investing in equity, debts, structured products. The cornerstone investments mainly holds stake in China Everbright Bank Co Ltd and Everbright Securities Co Ltd.

name: CHINA MENGNIU DAIRY CO LTD
businessSummary: China Mengniu Dairy Co Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacture and distribution of dairy products in China. The Liquid Milk Products segment mainly engaged in the manufacture and distribution of ultra-high temperature milk, milk beverage, yogurt and fresh milk. The Milk Powder Products segment mainly engaged in the manufacture and distribution of milk powder. The Ice Cream segment mainly engaged in the manufacture and distribution of ice cream. The Others segment principally engaged in the cheese business, manufacture of raw material of dairy products and trading business.

name: AEON STORES HONG KONG CO LTD
businessSummary: AEON Stores Hong Kong Co Ltd is a company principally engaged in the retail department store business. The Company is principally engaged in the retail department store business such as shopping malls, general department stores and supermarkets. The stores operated by the Company include AEON STYLE, AEON SUPERMARKET, Living PLAZA and Daiso Japan, among others.

name: VALUE PARTNERS GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Value Partners Group Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the asset management business. The Company is engaged in the provision of investment management services to investment funds and managed accounts. The Company's investment strategies cover equities, fixed income, multi-asset, alternative investments, real estate, and quantitative investment solutions. The Company is also engaged in the environmental, social and governance(ESG)business. The Company operates its business in domestic market and overseas markets such as Kuala Lumpur, Singapore and London.

name: SUN HUNG KAI PROPERTIES LTD
businessSummary: Sun Hung Kai Properties Limited is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the sale of property. Along with subsidiaries, the Company operates its business through six segments: the Property Sales segment, the Property Rental segment, the Telecommunications segment, the Hotel Operation segment, the Transport Infrastructure and Logistics segment, and the Other Businesses segment. The Property sales and Property rental segments operate in Hong Kong, Mainland China and Singapore. The Telecommunications segment is involved in the provision of mobile telephone services, and data centers and information technology (IT) infrastructure business. The Transport Infrastructure and Logistics segment is involved in transport infrastructure operation and management, port business, air transport and logistics business, and the operation of department stores and supermarkets through YATA Limited.

name: K WAH INTERNATIONAL HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: K Wah International Holdings Ltd is a Hong Kong-based investment holding company principally engaged in property development businesses. The Company is principally engaged in property development and property investment in Hong Kong and Mainland China. The Company invests and develops residential buildings, commercial buildings and other properties.

name: CROSS-HARBOUR HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Cross-Harbour Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the motoring school business. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Motoring School Operation segment is engaged in the investment in subsidiaries which operate driver training centers. The Electronic Toll Operation segment is engaged in the investment in a joint venture which operates an electronic toll collection system, provides telematics services, and intelligent transportation and surveillance system solutions. The Tunnel Operations segment is engaged in the investment in associates which operate the Western Harbour Tunnel franchise. The Treasury segment is engaged in the investing activities to receive dividend income and interest income, and manages an investment portfolio including unlisted funds, equity securities, debt securities, and bank deposits and cash.

name: GREAT EAGLE HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Great Eagle Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the real estate operation and related business. The Company operates through seven segments. The Hotel Operation segment engages in hotel accommodation, food and banquet operations and hotel management. The Property Development segment sells properties. The Property Investment segment engages in leasing of furnished apartments and properties held for investment potential. The Other Operations segment sells building materials, flexible workspace operation, investment in securities, provision of property management, maintenance and property agency services. The Results from Langham segment invest in Langham. The Results from Champion REIT segment invest in Champion REIT. The US Real Estate Fund segment generates income on property owned by the US Real Estate Fund.

name: TUNGTEX HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Tungtex Holdings Co Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the clothes business. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sales of garments. In addition, the Company is engaged in the operation of clothing brand stores. The Company mainly operates its business through three geographical segments, including North America segment, Asia and Europe segment and Others segment.

name: KINGSOFT CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Kingsoft Corporation Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the software and information technology services business. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Office Software and Services segment is mainly engaged in the design, research and development, and sales and marketing of the office software products and services of word processing system (WPS) Office. The Entertainment Software and Others segment is mainly engaged in the research and development of games, and the provision of personal computer (PC) games and mobile games services. The Company also provides cloud services such as cloud computing, storage, delivery and comprehensive cloud-based solutions.

name: UNITED ENERGY GROUP LTD
businessSummary: United Energy Group Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the petroleum and natural gas business. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Exploration and Production segment is mainly engaged in the activities relating to the exploration and production of crude oil and natural gas in Pakistan, Middle East and North Africa. The Trading segment is mainly engaged in activities relating to trading energy products, including petrochemical.

name: GOLDPAC GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Goldpac Group Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the production and sale of embedded software and secure payment products. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Embedded Software and Secure Payment Products segment is involved in manufacturing and sale of embedded software and secure payment products for smart secure payment. The Platform and Services segment is involved in provision of data processing services, system platforms and other total solutions for customers in business including financial, government, healthcare, transportation and retails by leveraging Fintech.

name: CHINA ORIENTAL GROUP CO LTD
businessSummary: China Oriental Group Co Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the Iron and steel business. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Iron and Steel segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sales of iron and steel products, trading of steel products, iron ore and related raw materials and sales of power equipment. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the development and sales of properties.

name: FOUNTAIN SET HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Fountain Set Holdings Ltd is a Hong Kong-based investment holding company principally engaged in the textile businesses. The Company operates through two business segments. The Production and Sales of Dyed Fabrics and Yarns segment mainly engages in the manufacture and sale of pure cotton, other pure fibers, knitted fabric and dyed yarns. The Production and Sales of Garments segment mainly engages in the garments manufacturing and sale business.

name: CHINA EVERBRIGHT ENVIRONMENT GROUP LTD
businessSummary: China Everbright Environment Group Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the energy and infrastructure-related businesses. The Company operates through four segments. The Environmental Energy Project Construction and Operation segment engages in the construction and operation of waste-to-energy plants, food waste, sludge, leachate and solid waste treatment. The Greentech Project Construction and Operation segment engages in the construction and operation of integrated biomass utilisation projects, solar and wind energy projects and environmental remediation. The Environmental Water Project Construction and Operation segment engages in the construction and operation of waste treatment plants, river-basin ecological restoration. The Others segment engages in the environmental protection technology research and development, environmental-related technological services provision and others. The Company also provides incinerator and water-cooled grate furnace equipment.

name: CHINA RESOURCES POWER HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: China Resources Power Holdings Co Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the investment, development and operation of power plants. The Company operates through two segments. Thermal Power segment is engaged in the investment, development, operation and management of coal-fired power plants and gas-fired power plants, as well as the sales of heat and electricity.

name: CHINA GAS HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: China Gas Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the gas business. The Company operates its business through six segments. The Sales of Piped Gas segment is engaged in the sale of piped gas through urban and township pipeline networks, trade and direct supply pipelines. The Sales of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) segment is engaged in the distribution of LPG for industrial users and commercial users. The Gas Connection segment is engaged in the provision of gas connection services for customers. The Engineering, Design and Construction segment is engaged in the gas pipeline construction business. The Value-Added Services segment is engaged in the sale of wall-hung boilers, kitchen gas appliances, smart home, bellows, alarms and bottled water. The Zhongyu Gas segment is mainly engaged in the natural gas sale and gas pipeline construction businesses.

name: TOWNGAS SMART ENERGY CO LTD
businessSummary: Towngas Smart Energy Co Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the sale and distribution of piped gas. The Company operates through three segments. The Gas Business segment primarily engages in the sales of piped gas and other gas-related energy, construction of gas pipeline networks under gas connection contracts and sales of gas-related household appliances and related products and other related value-added services. The Renewable Energy Business segment primarily engages in the sales of renewable energy, as well as other related energy and services. The Extended Business segment is primarily engaged in sales of gas-related household appliances and related products, and other related value-added services.

name: LEE & MAN PAPER MANUFACTURING LTD
businessSummary: Lee & Man Paper Manufacturing Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacture and trading of packing paper. The Company operates its business through three segments: the Packaging Paper segment, the Pulp segment and the Tissue Paper segment. Packaging Paper includes kraft linerboard, test linerboard, coated duplex board, white top linerboard and high strength corrugating medium. The Company is also engaged in the procurement of raw materials.

name: MTR CORP LTD
businessSummary: MTR Corporation Limited is principally engaged in railway operation. The Company has six segments. Hong Kong Transport Operations is engaged in the provision of passenger operation and related services for railway systems, airport expresses, as well as light rails and buses in Hong Kong. Hong Kong Station Commercial Businesses is engaged in the letting of advertising, retail and car parking spaces, the provision of telecommunication and bandwidth services and other commercial activities in Hong Kong. Hong Kong Property Rental and Management is engaged in the letting of retail, office and car parking spaces, as well as the provision of estate management services in Hong Kong. Hong Kong Property Development is engaged in property development near the railway systems. Railway, Property Rental and Management Businesses is engaged in the construction, operation and maintenance of mass transit railway systems. Mainland of China Property Development is engaged in property development.

name: SKYWORTH GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Skyworth Group Ltd is a Hong Kong-based holding company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sales of smart television (TV) systems. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Multimedia Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sales of smart TV systems in China and overseas markets, as well as the provision and sales of Internet value-added services of Coocaa system. The Smart System Technology Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sales of home access systems, intelligent manufacturing, automotive electronic systems, lighting products, security systems and other electronic products. The New Energy Business segment is engaged in the sales and installation of distributed photovoltaic power stations for residential use in the client retail sector in the China market. businessSummary: Intelligent Living Application Group Inc is a holding company principally engaged in the production and sales of mechanical locks. The Company is principally engaged in the design, manufacture and sale of mechanical locks such as deadbolts, entry locks, privacy locks and passage locks. In addition, the Company is also engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of smart locks. The Company distributes its lock products in the domestic market and overseas markets including the United States and Canada.

name: MEDIA CHINESE INTERNATIONAL LTD
businessSummary: Media Chinese International Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in publishing business. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Publishing and Printing segment is engaged in the publication, printing and distribution of newspapers, magazines, books and digital contents primarily in the Chinese language. The Travel and Travel Related segment is engaged in the sales of travel packages and provision of tour services.

name: HANG LUNG PROPERTIES LTD
businessSummary: Hang Lung Properties Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the property leasing business. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Property Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing of portfolio of properties carrying the '66' brand in Mainland China, including Shanghai, Shenyang, Jinan, Wuxi, Tianjin, Dalian, Kunming, Wuhan, and Hangzhou. It is also engaged in the development and sales of properties in Hong Kong, the property portfolio includes commercial properties, offices and residential and serviced apartments, among others. The Property sales segment engages in the sale of properties in Hong Kong, including units at The Long Beach, semi-detached houses at 23-39 Blue Pool Road.

name: HYSAN DEVELOPMENT CO LTD
businessSummary: Hysan Development Co Ltd is a company principally engaged in the properties leasing. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Retail segment engages in the leasing of space and related facilities. The Office segment engages in the leasing of office space and related facilities. The Residential segment engages in the leasing of residential properties and related facilities. The Property Development segment engages in the development and sale of properties.

name: MERCHANT HOUSE INTERNATIONAL LTD
businessSummary: Merchant House International Limited is a designer, manufacturer and marketer of leather boots and shoes, home and seasonal decorative items, and home textile. The Company operates in four segments: Home textile manufacturing, Home textile trading, Footwear manufacturing and Footwear trading. The home textile manufacturing segment manufactures and sells home textile products to the home textile trading segment. The home textile trading segment is engaged in the export trading of home textile products to overseas customers. The footwear manufacturing segment manufactures work boots and shoes, and sells directly to domestic customers. The footwear trading segment is engaged in the exporting trading of work boots and shoes to the overseas customers. The Company's subsidiaries include Loretta Lee Limited, Forsan Limited, Grandview Textiles Limited, Home Affairs Inc. and Carsan Trading Co. Ltd., among others.

name: NATURAL HEALTH TRENDS CORP
businessSummary: Natural Health Trends Corp is a company mainly engaged in the direct-selling and e-commerce business. The Company is engaged in the supply of the products in six distinct categories: wellness, herbal, beauty, lifestyle, home, and daily. Wellness products include dietary and nutritional supplements, vitamins and minerals. Herbal products include herbal supplements. Beauty products include facial skin care as well as hand and body care. Lifestyle products include supplements and topical gels. Home products include home appliances such as air purifiers and others. Daily products include oral care, hair care, and body care.

name: SHANGRI-LA ASIA LTD
businessSummary: Shangri-La Asia Limited is a Hong Kong-based investment holding company principally engaged in hotel operation. Hotel Ownership segment is engaged in hotel operation in Hong Kong, Mainland China, Singapore and Malaysia, among others. Property Rentals segment is engaged in the leasing of office properties, commercial properties and serviced apartments. Hotel Management segment is engaged in the provision of hotel management services. Property Sales segment is engaged in the sales of properties. The Company is also engaged in other businesses, such as wine trading and operation of golf courses. The hotels under the Company include Shangri-la and Hotel Jin, among others.

name: CHINA MEDICAL SYSTEM HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: China Medical System Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the production of medicines, as well as marketing, promotion and sales of drugs. The Company's products include Plendil, Ursofalk, Augentropfen Stulln Mono Eye Drops, Hirudoid, Atopic Piel Series and Vmonalisa, among others. Its major marketed products cover the cardio-cerebrovascular, gastroenterology, ophthalmology, dermatology and medical aesthetic fields. The Company distributes its products within domestic market and to overseas markets.

name: VITASOY INTERNATIONAL HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Vitasoy International Holdings Ltd is a company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of food and beverages. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Mainland China Business segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of soya milk, tea, juice, etc. in Mainland China. The Hong Kong Operation segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of soya milk, tea, water, juice, tofu, etc. in Hong Kong, sale of beverages in Macau, export of beverages from Hong Kong and the operating of tuck shops and catering businesses in Hong Kong. The Australia and New Zealand Business segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of soya milk and other plant milk products in Australia and sale of beverages in New Zealand. The Singapore Business segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of soya related products in Singapore, sale of beverages in Singapore and the export of soya related products.

name: LANGHAM HOSPITALITY INVESTMENTS LTD
businessSummary: Langham Hospitality Investments Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the own and investment in the portfolio of hotels. The Company operates its business through three segments, include The Langham Hong Kong segment, Cordis Hong Kong segment, Eaton HK segment. The Company’s segments are mainly engaged in the leasing of the hotels.

name: KONTAFARMA CHINA HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Kontafarma China Holdings Ltd, formely Tongfang Kontafarma Holdings Ltd, is an investment holding company principally engaged in pharmaceutical business. The Company operates its business through two business segments. The Pharmaceutical Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of prescription drugs, including chemical drugs and prescribed traditional Chinese medicines, and laboratory related products. The Fitness Business is segment is engaged in the operation of fitness centers, the provision of consultation services for fitness and health activities, as well as the operation of the franchise business for royalty fee income.

name: HANISON CONSTRUCTION HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Hanison Construction Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in construction engineering businesses. The Company operates through seven segments. The Construction segment engages in construction contract engineering businesses. The Interior and Renovation segment engages in decoration and renovation businesses. The Building Materials segment engages in the supply and installation of interior products and curtain walls, among others. The Health Products segment engages in the wholesales of healthcare products and operation of related retail stores. The Property Investment segment engages in the leasing of residential and commercial properties. The Property Development segment engages in the sales of residential and industrial properties, among others. The Property Agency and Management segment engages in the provision of agency and management services for properties.

name: CHINA DAYE NON-FERROUS METALS MINING LTD
businessSummary: China Daye Non-Ferrous Metals Mining Ltd is a Hong Kong-based investment holding company principally engaged in the sales of metal products. The Company mainly sells copper cathodes, copper products, gold and gold products, silver and silver products, sulphuric acid, sulphuric concentrate and iron ores, among others. It also provides copper processing services. The Company operates its business in China, Hong Kong and Mongolia markets.

name: MING SHING GROUP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Ming Shing Group Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company engaged in the provision of wet trades works services. The Company is engaged in the provision of services including tile laying works, brick laying works, floor screeding works, marble works.

name: CHINA HIGH SPEED
businessSummary: China High Speed Transmission Equipment Group Co Ltd is an investment holding company engaged in the wind and industrial gear transmission equipment business. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Wind and Industrial Gear Transmission Equipment segment is engaged in the design, development, manufacture and distribution of mechanical transmission equipment used in wind power and industrial applications. The Rail Transportation Gear Transmission Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and distribution of gear transmission equipment used in rail transportation. The Trading Business segment focuses on bulk commodity and steel industry chain. The Others segment principally comprises services on lighting projects, municipal landscape projects and engineering procurement construction projects.

name: PS INTERNATIONAL GROUP LTD
businessSummary: PS International Group Ltd is a company principally engaged in the logistics and optional ancillary logistics service provision business. The Company mainly operates cross border logistic services such as air freight forwarding, ocean freight forwarding, overland logistic and supply chain ancillary services. The Company also provides integrated solutions that combine ocean, air, and overland logistics. The Company mainly provides its services to cross-border merchants, brands and e-Commerce platforms.

name: JS GLOBAL LIFESTYLE CO LTD
businessSummary: JS Global Lifestyle Co Ltd is a company mainly engaged in the household appliances business. The Company operates through two segments. The Joyoung segment is mainly engaged in the design, manufacture, marketing, export and distribution of small kitchen electrical appliances under the brand of 'Joyoung'. The SharkNinja APAC segment is mainly engaged in the design, marketing, manufacture, provision of sourcing services, export, import and distribution of floor care products, hard-surface steam cleaning products, small kitchen appliances, personal care appliances and home environment appliances under the brands of 'Shark' and 'Ninja'.

name: INTELLIGENT GROUP LTD CLASS A ORD SHS
businessSummary: Intelligent Group Ltd is a company principally engaged in the provision of public relations consulting services. The Company is engaged in the provision of corporate and financial communications services, initial public offering (IPO) project planning services and other services. In addition, the Company is engaged in the provision of investor relations, media relations and event planning services.

name: CHINA CHENGTONG DEVELOPMENT GROUP LTD
businessSummary: China Chengtong Development Group Limited is a Hong Kong-based investment holding company principally engaged in property businesses. The Company operates through six segments. Property Development segment is engaged in holding land for property development projects. Property Investment segment is engaged in the provision of rental services and holding investment properties. Financial Leasing segment is engaged in the provision of financial leasing services, including the arrangement of sales and leaseback transactions. Trading of Coal segment is engaged in the trading of coal. Bulk Commodity Trade segment is engaged in the trading of bulk commodity. Hotel and Marine Travelling Services segment is engaged in the provision of hotel and marine travelling services.

name: BEIJING ENTERPRISES WATER GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Beijing Enterprises Water Group Ltd is a company mainly engaged in the water business. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Sewage and Reclaimed Water Treatment and Construction Services segment is engaged in the construction and operation of sewage and reclaimed water treatment plants and the provision of construction services for renovation projects. The Water Distribution segment is engaged in the distribution and sale of piped water and the provision of related services. The Urban Resources Services segment is engaged in the provision of urban environmental governance services and construction services, hazardous waste treatment services, waste electrical and electronic equipment treatment services and sale of recycling and reuse products. The Technical and Consultancy Services and Sale of Machineries segment engages in the provision of consultancy services and sale of machinery related to sewage treatment, and the licensing of technical know-how.

name: SWIRE PACIFIC LTD
businessSummary: Swire Pacific Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of beverages. The Company operates its business through five segments. The Beverages segment engages in the manufacture and distribution The Coca-Cola Company (TCCC), including sparkling and water. The Aviation segment comprises an associate interest in airlines providing passenger services and cargo services, aviation maintenance and repair business. The Property segment engages in property investment, hotel investment and management, and property trading, with an investment portfolio encompassing office and retail premises, hotels, serviced apartments and other residential accommodation. The Trading and Industrial segment retails and distributes footwear, apparel and related accessories, packages and sells sugar, operates bakery chains, and sells passenger cars, commercial vehicles, motorcycles and scooters. The Head Office, Healthcare and others segment engages in healthcare investments.

name: HUABAO INTERNATIONAL HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Huabao International Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the flavours and fragrances (F&F), and food ingredients business. The Company operates its business through four segments. The F&F and Food Ingredients segment is mainly engaged in the research and development, production and sale of flavours and fragrances products, and food ingredients. The Condiment segment is mainly engaged in the production, sales, marketing and distribution of condiments. The Aroma Raw Materials segment is mainly engaged in the research and development, manufacture and sale of aroma raw materials products. The Tobacco Raw Materials segment is mainly engaged in the research and development, production and sale of papermaking reconstituted tobacco leaves and new materials products that are applicable to tobacco industry.

name: SAMFINE CREATION HOLDINGS GROUP LTD CLAS
businessSummary: Samfine Creation Holdings Group Ltd is holding company mainly engaged in the provision of printing publications. The Company is principally engaged in the printing industry. The Company’s products include book products, such as children’s books, educational books, art books, notebooks, diaries and journals. The Company’s products also include packaging products, such as handcraft products, book sets, pop-up books, stationery products, products with assembly parts and other specialized products, shopping bags and package boxes.

name: SHENZHEN INVESTMENT LTD
businessSummary: Shenzhen Investment Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in property development. The Company operates its business through five segments. The Property Development segment is engaged in the development of residential and commercial buildings. The Property Management segment is engaged in the management of buildings developed by the group and external parties. The Property Investment segment is engaged in the investments in commercial buildings with leasing prospects. The Manufacturing segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial and commercial products. The Others segment mainly includes hotel business, manufacture and sale business of aluminum alloy products and agricultural products, provision of construction services and other businesses.

name: GLOBAL ENGINE GROUP HOLDING LTD CLASS A
businessSummary: Global Engine Group Holding Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of information and communication technologies (ICTs) solutions and services. The Company is engaged in the provision of data center and cloud computing services and other services. In addition, the Company is engaged in the provision of Internet of things (IoT) solutions.

name: WHARF HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Wharf Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the property development. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Development Property segment engages in the acquisition, development, design, construction, sales and marketing of properties. The Investment Property segment engages in the retail, office and serviced apartments leasing. The Hotel segment engages in the hotel operations. The Logistics Segment engages in the container terminal and air cargo operations.

name: GCL NEW ENERGY HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: GCL New Energy Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the electricity business. The Company is engaged in the development, construction, operation and management of solar power plants. The Company is also engaged the distribution of electricity. In addition, the Company is engaged in the provision of solar energy related services.

name: WANG ON GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Wang On Group Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the property development business. The Company operates its business through five segments. The Fresh Markets segment is engaged in the management and sub-licensing of fresh markets and butchery business include management of agricultural produce exchange markets. The Pharmaceutical segment is engaged in the production and sale of pharmaceutical and health food products. The Property Development segment is engaged in the development of properties. The Treasury Management segment is engaged in the provision of finance, investment in debt and other securities. The Property Investment segment is engaged in the investment in industrial and commercial premises and residential units for rental or for sale.

name: KINGMAKER FOOTWEAR HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Kingmaker Footwear Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the footwear products business. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Manufacture and Sale of Footwear Products segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of footwear products. The segment is also engaged in the subcontracting of footwear products. The Property Investment segment is mainly engaged in the property investment business.

name: HKT TRUST AND HKT LTD
businessSummary: HKT Trust and HKT Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the telecommunications and related services business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Telecommunications Services segment is engaged in the provision of telecommunications and related services including enterprise solutions, integrated home solutions and media entertainment. The Mobile segment is engaged in the mobile communications business. The Other Businesses segment is engaged in other new businesses including The Club membership platform, HKT Financial Services and health technology services as well as enterprise support services.

name: SOLARGIGA ENERGY HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Solargiga Energy Holdings Limited is a Hong Kong-based investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacture and trading of solar energy-related products. The Company’s main businesses include the manufacture and trading of polysilicon and monocrystalline silicon solar ingots and wafers and the provision of related processing services, the manufacture and trading of photovoltaic modules, the manufacture and trading of monocrystalline silicon solar cells, as well as the construction and operation of photovoltaic power plants.

name: CHINA JINMAO HOLDINGS GROUP LTD
businessSummary: China Jinmao Holdings Group Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in property business. The Company operates its business through five segments. The Urban and Property Development segment is engaged in urban comprehensive development, property development and land development. The Jinmao services segment provides property management services, value-added services to non-property owners, and community value-added services. The Hotel Operations segment is engaged in the provision of hotel accommodation and catering services. The Commercial Leasing and Retail Operations segment is engaged in the leasing of office buildings and retail commercial properties. The Others segment is engaged in the provision of design and decoration services, and the operation of an observation deck and other services.

name: SWIRE PROPERTIES LTD
businessSummary: Swire Properties Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in property investment business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Property Investment segment is engaged in the development, leasing and management of commercial, retail and residential properties. The Hotel segment is engaged in the investment and operation of hotels as well as owns and manages hotels in Hong Kong, Mainland China and the United States through Swire Hotels. The Property Trading segment is engaged in the development, construction and sale of residential properties.

name: POKFULAM DEVELOPMENT CO LTD
businessSummary: Pokfulam Development Co Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the property business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Property Investment and Management segment is engaged in the letting and management of commercial, industrial and residential properties. The Trading of Goods segment is engaged in the trading of visual and sound equipment, and home appliances. The Securities Investment segment is engaged in the investment in securities.

name: CHINA SHUIFA SINGYES ENERGY HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: China Shuifa Singyes Energy Holdings Ltd, formerly China Singyes Solar Technologies Holdings Ltd, is an investment holding company principally engaged in the construction and installation of curtain walls. The Company’s businesses cover the design, manufacture, supply and installation of conventional curtain walls and building integrated solar photovoltaic systems, as well as the manufacture and sale of solar power products. The Company is also involved in the sale of electricity and the operation and management of solar photovoltaic power stations.

name: ASIA TELE-NET AND TECHNOLOGY CORPORATION
businessSummary: Asia Tele-Net and Technology Corporation Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the design, manufacture and sales of electroplating equipment. The Company mainly operates three segments. The Electroplating Equipment segment engages in printed circuit boards (PCB) business which provides PCBs used in smartphone and car industries. The segment also engages in surface finishing business. The Treasury Management segment operates investments in listed shares, debt instruments, short time certificate of deposits or time deposits. The Property Investment segment operates rental business. The Company’s products are traded under the brand name of PAL.

name: MEILLEURE HEALTH INTERNATIONAL INDUSTRY
businessSummary: Meilleure Health International Industry Group Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the production and sale of cannabis health products. The Company operates through four segments. The Healthcare-Related Business segment is engaged in health management services, medical beauty services, and sales of health-related products and Cannabidiol (CBD) downstream products. The Property-Related Business segment is engaged in real estate sales agency, investment property leasing, and residential property development and sales. The Trading Business segment is engaged in the trading of building materials and new energy products, the provision of new energy product procurement services, and health-related product sales agency services. The Equity Investment Business segment is engaged in the management of investment portfolio.

name: K W NELSON
businessSummary: K W Nelson Interior Design and Contracting Group Ltd is an investment holding company. The Company principally engaged in the provision of interior designs, project management services and fitting-out works. The Company offers its services to the fields of banking, retail, healthcare, legal services, catering, education, energy, insurance, telecommunications, property management and logistics management.

name: GALAXY ENTERTAINMENT GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Galaxy Entertainment Group Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the gaming and entertainment business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Gaming and Entertainment segment is mainly engaged in the operations in casino games of chance or games of other forms, provision of hospitality and related services in Macau business. The Construction Materials segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale and distribution of construction materials in Hong Kong, Macau and Mainland China. The Corporate and Treasury Management segment is mainly engaged in the central treasury management and administrative function business.

name: HAO TIAN
businessSummary: Hao Tian International Construction Investment Group Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in construction machinery leasing business. The Company operates through five business segments. The Rental and Sale of Construction Machinery and Spare Part segment is engaged in the rental of construction machinery such as crawler cranes, as well as the sales of construction machinery and spare parts. The Provision of Asset Management, Securities Brokerage and Other Financial Service segment provides asset management, securities brokerage and other financial services. The Provision of Repair and Maintenance and Transportation Service segment provides repair and maintenance services for construction machinery, as well as transportation services such as local container transportation. The Money Lending segment provides mortgage loans and personal loan business. The Property Development segment is engaged in the development of residential, industrial and commercial properties.

name: DIRECTBOOKING TECHNOLOGY CO LTD CLASS A
businessSummary: DirectBooking Technology Co Ltd, formerly known as Primega Group Holdings Ltd, is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the provision of transportation and construction engineering services. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Soil and Rock Transportation segment is mainly engaged in the handling, loading and transportation of excavated materials such as soil and rocks. The Miscellaneous Construction Works segment is mainly engaged in the construction works business, which mainly includes excavation and lateral support (ELS) works and bored piling. Additionally, the Company is engaged in the trading of diesel oil.

name: TAI SANG LAND DEVELOPMENT LTD
businessSummary: Tai Sang Land Development Ltd is a Hong Kong-based investment holding company principally engaged in property businesses. The Company operates through four segments. Property Rental segment is engaged in the property rental and investment business. Property Related Services segment is engaged in the property development, property management and other property related services provision business. Hotel Operations segment is engaged in the hotel operation business. Catering Operations segment is engaged in the catering services provision business.

name: EMPEROR ENTERTAINMENT HOTEL LTD
businessSummary: Emperor Entertainment Hotel Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in hotel business. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Macau Operations segment is mainly engaged in the operation of hotel and leasing transactions business. The Hong Kong Operations segment is engaged in the operation of hotel and leasing transactions business.

name: CHAODA MODERN AGRICULTURE (HOLDINGS) LTD
businessSummary: Chaoda Modern Agriculture (Holdings) Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the growing and sales of agricultural products. The Company mainly engages in the growing and distribution of crops, fruits and vegetables, as well as breeding and sale livestock. Its agricultural products include melon, tangerine, cherry tomato, sweet pepper, broccoli, cabbage, cauliflower, pumpkins, among others. The Company mainly operates businesses in China.

name: SANAI HEALTH INDUSTRY GROUP CO LTD
businessSummary: Sanai Health Industry Group Co Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in pharmaceutical products. The Company operates its business through two segments. Pharmaceutical Products segment is mainly engaged in the development, manufacturing, marketing and sales of pharmaceutical products, sales of pharmaceutical related software and provision of consultancy services. Finance Leasing segment is mainly engaged in provision of finance leasing services.

name: DATRONIX HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Datronix Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the design, manufacturing and sales of magnetic components used in consumer electronics, data processors and other electronic systems. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Industrial Application segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sales of magnetic components for industrial use. The High Reliability Products segment is engaged in the manufacturing of high reliability magnetic components. The Communication and Networking segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sales of magnetic components for communication and networking equipment. The Data Processing segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sales of magnetic components for data processors and related systems.

name: LE SAUNDA HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Le Saunda Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the sales of footwear products, bags and accessories. The Company is mainly engaged in the design, development, manufacture and retailing of ladies’ and men’s footwear, handbags and fashion accessories products. Its proprietary brands include le saunda, le saunda MEN and LINEA ROSA. The Company sells its products through retail stores or online stores. The Company mainly operates businesses in Mainland China, Hong Kong and Macau.

name: HENGDELI HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Hengdeli Holdings Limited is a company principally engaged in the retail and distribution of high-end consuming Accessories. The Company operates its business through two segments. The High-End Consuming Accessories segment is engaged in the manufacture and distribution of watches accessories, provision of shop design and decoration services business. The Commodity Trading segment is engaged in the trading of iron ore and coal.

name: LEE KEE HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Lee Kee Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the trading of metal products. The Company is mainly engaged in the trading of zinc, zinc alloys, nickel, nickel-related products, aluminum, aluminum alloys, stainless steel and other electroplating chemicals products. The Company is also engaged in the alloy production business. In addition, the Company is engaged in the provision of metal testing and consulting services. The Company mainly operates its business Hong Kong and Mainland China markets.

name: NEW TIMES ENERGY CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: New Times Corporation Ltd, formerly New Times Energy Corporation Ltd, is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the non-ferrous metals and petroleum-related products refinery and trading businesses. The Company operates its business through two segments. The General and Commodities Refinery and Trading segment is engaged in the refinery and trading of non-ferrous metals and petroleum-related products. The Upstream segment is engaged in the exploration, development, production and sale of oil and gas. The Company operates its business in domestic market and overseas markets such as the United States, Canada and Argentina.

name: NEW CENTURY GROUP HONG KONG LTD
businessSummary: New Century Group Hong Kong Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in money lending business. The Company mainly operates its business through three segments. The Money Lending segment engages in the provision of mortgage loans and unsecured personal loans. The Property Investment segment invests in office space and commercial shops for their rental income potential. The Securities Trading segment engages in the trading of marketable securities for short-term investment purposes.

name: PTL LTD CLASS A
businessSummary: PTL Ltd is a holding company mainly engaged in the providing marine fuel logistics services. The Company is mainly providing its marine fuel logistics services for vessel refueling, primarily container ships, bulk carriers, general cargo vessels and chemical tankers. The Company is also engaged in the providing of one-stop solution for vessel refueling. The Company’s service includes supplying fuel for the use by customers’ vessels at various ports along their voyages in the Asia Pacific region, arranging vessel refueling activities, offering trade credit to customers for vessel refueling, providing contingency solutions to customers, handling disputes related to fuel products and others.

name: SHEEN TAI HOLDINGS GROUP COMPANY LTD
businessSummary: Sheen Tai Holdings Group Company Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the photovoltaic power generation business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Generation of Photovoltaic Power segment is engaged in the generation and sales of electricity. The Semi-conductors Business segment is engaged in the trading of semi-conductors and provision of agency services for trading of semi-conductors. The Properties Development and Related Services segment is engaged in the development and sales of properties and provision of property management services.

name: RYKADAN CAPITAL LTD
businessSummary: Rykadan Capital Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the property development business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Property Development segment is engaged in repositioning and enhancing the value of properties and managing development projects. The Asset, Investment and Fund Management segment is engaged in investing in and managing a property portfolio. The Distribution of Construction and Interior Decoration Materials segment is engaged in the distribution of quarry building material products.

name: KML TECHNOLOGY GROUP LTD
businessSummary: KML Technology Group Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of mechanical and electrical (M&E) engineering solutions and services. The Company is principally engaged in the provision of M&E engineering solutions and services encompass design, installation, testing and commissioning and maintenance of miscellaneous M&E engineering systems such as railway station M&E engineering services and architectural works, train-borne systems provisions, trackside and depot M&E works and different kinds of renovation works. In addition, the Company is also engaged in the provision of mobile ticketing and digital payment solutions and services, digital fabrication and maintenance services, transportation mission critical system solutions.

name: PROSPERITY REAL ESTATE INVESTMENT TRUST
businessSummary: Prosperity Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) is a REIT. The objectives of the REIT are to produce stable and sustainable distributions to unitholders and to achieve long-term growth in the net asset value per unit, by investing in commercial properties portfolio in Hong Kong. The REIT owns offices, commercial properties, industrial and office properties and industrial properties in the decentralized business districts of Hong Kong. Its investment portfolio includes The Metropolis Tower, Prosperity Place, Trendy Center, New Treasure Center, Prosperity Millennia Plaza, Harbourfront Landmark and Prosperity Center. The REIT is managed by ARA Asset Management (Prosperity) Limited.

name: SOUTH MANGANESE INVESTMENT LTD
businessSummary: South Manganese Investment Ltd, formerly CITIC Dameng Holdings Ltd, is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the mining and trading business of manganese. The Company operates through four business segments. Electrolytic Manganese Metal (EMM) and Alloying Materials Production segment engages in the mining and processing of EMM, manganese briquette, silicomanganese alloys, and other products.
