Manganese Mining segment engages in the mining and production of concentrates, natural discharging manganese powder and sand, among other manganese products. Battery Materials Production segment engages in the production and sale of electrolytic manganese dioxide (EMD), manganese sulfate, lithium manganese oxide, lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, and other battery materials products. Others segment engages in the trading of commodities including manganese ore, EMM and scraps, and the rental of investment properties and machinery.

name: CHUANG'S CONSORTIUM INTERNATIONAL LTD
businessSummary: Chuang's Consortium International Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in property development, investment and trading. The Company’s main businesses include property development, investment and trading, hotel operation and management, development and operation of cemetery, securities investment and trading and money lending business.

name: GEMDALE PROPERTIES AND INVESTMENT CORPOR
businessSummary: Gemdale Properties and Investment Corp Ltd, formerly Frasers Property China Ltd, is an investment holding company principally engaged in the property development. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Property Development segment engages in the development and sale of residential and commercial properties. The Property Investment and Management segment engages in the investment and management of business parks and commercial properties. The Micro-finance segment provides financial services to property buyers and small businesses. The Corporate segment provides corporate management services for the Company.

name: MINT INCORPORATION LTD CLASS A
businessSummary: Mint Incorporation Ltd is a holding company principally engaged in the interior design and fit out work businesses. The Company is principally engaged in the interior design and fit out work such as overall project management, supervision of the construction and installation of interior fit out works carried out by own subcontractors, procurement and supply of carpentry, joiner, integral furniture, fixtures and accessories as well as others. In addition, the Company is engaged in the creation of tailor-made interior design proposals.

name: CHINA CASTSON 81 FINANCE CO LTD
businessSummary: China Castson 81 Finance Co Ltd, formerly, China Internet Investment Finance Holdings Ltd is an investment company. The Company is principally engaged in the investing in equity and debt instruments of listed and unlisted companies in Hong Kong. The listed companies invested by the Company are engaged in the driving training business, kitchen appliances manufacturing business, value-added services, online advertising and fintech businesses, e-commerce business, insurance business and other businesses. The major objects of investment held by the Company include Tencent Holdings Ltd, China Life Insurance Company Ltd and others.

name: DESON DEVELOPMENT INTERNATIONAL HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Deson Development International Holdings Ltd is a Hong Kong-based investment holding company principally engaged in property development and investment business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Property Development and Investment Business segment is principally engaged in the property development of residential and commercial properties, as well as holding the investment properties. The Trading Business segment is principally engaged in the trading of medical equipment, home security and automation products. The Other segment mainly consists of hotel operations.

name: NORTH ASIA STRATEGIC HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: North Asia Strategic Holdings Ltd is an investment company mainly engaged in hi-tech distribution and services. The Company operates its business through four segments. Hi-tech Distribution and Services segment is engaged in the trading of surface mount technology (SMT) assembly machinery and spare parts and provision of related installation, training, repair and maintenance services for SMT assembly machinery. Leasing segment is engaged in provision of finance and trading of lease assets. Electronic Payment Solution segment is engaged in provision of payment solution that bridges online payment acquirers and the merchants. Property and Investment Holding segment is engaged in the provision of property and investment holding services.

name: VOBILE GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Vobile Group Ltd is a digital content asset protection and transaction software as a service (SaaS) provider. The Company develops a series of software services based on film and television gene digital fingerprint and watermark technology to protect the rights and interests of digital content assets such as television (TV), movies, and streaming media platforms and increase distribution revenue. The Company also provides digital asset protection and transaction-related digital infrastructure service capabilities for the third-generation Internet (Web3) such as blockchain and digital collection markets. The Company's business is divided into subscription type and transaction type, and its products include content monetization and content protection. The Company provides customers solutions through two business models of subscription service and value-added service.

name: CCSC TECHNOLOGY INTERNATIONAL HOLDINGS L
businessSummary: CCSC Technology International Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company engaged in the sale, design and manufacturing of interconnect products. The Company’s interconnect products include connectors, cables and wire harnesses used for industrial, automotive, robotics, medical equipment, computer, network and telecommunication and consumer products. The Company is engaged in the production of both OEM and ODM interconnect products for manufacturing companies.

name: CHINA MERCHANTS LAND LTD
businessSummary: China Merchants Land Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the properties business. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Properties segment is mainly engaged in the development and sales of properties and property leasing. The Asset Management segment is mainly engaged in the asset management for office premises and shopping malls business.

name: H&H INTL HLDG
businessSummary: Health and Happiness (H&H) International Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of pediatric nutrition and baby care products. The Company operates its business through five segments. The Infant Formulas segment is mainly engaged in the production and sales of milk formulas for infants, children and expectant and nursing mothers. The Adult Nutrition and Care Products segment is mainly engaged in the production and sales of vitamins, herbal and mineral supplements, skin care and sports nutrition products for adults. The Probiotic and Nutritional Supplements segment is mainly engaged in the production and sales of probiotic supplements for infants, children and expectant mothers. The Pet Nutrition and Care Products segment is mainly engaged in the production and sales of pet food and supplements. The Other Paediatric Products segment is mainly engaged in the production and sales of dried baby food and baby care products.

name: MOON INC
businessSummary: Moon Inc, formerly HK Asia Holdings Ltd, is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the wholesale and retail of prepaid products including such as subscriber identification module (SIM) cards and top-up vouchers. The prepaid products allow users to make local and international calls and use mobile data services. At the same time, the Company sells its products through self-operated retail stores, wholesalers and retailers within the Company's sales network. In addition, the Company is also engaged in cryptocurrency and Web 3.0 technology-related businesses.

name: CK INFRASTRUCTURE HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: CK Infrastructure Holdings Ltd is a company principally engaged in the development, investment and operation of infrastructure businesses. The Company is principally engaged in the development, investment and operation of energy infrastructure, transportation infrastructure, water infrastructure, waste management, waste-to-energy, household infrastructure and infrastructure related businesses. In addition, the Company is also engaged in the investment holding and project management as well as securities investment businesses. The Company operates its business in the People's Republic of China, the United Kingdom, Continental Europe, Australia, New Zealand, Canada and the United States.

name: NEW WORLD DEVELOPMENT CO LTD
businessSummary: New World Development Company Limited is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the property development. Along with subsidiaries, the Company operates its business through seven segments: the Property development segment, the Service segment, the Department stores segment, the Property Investment segment, the Infrastructure, the Hotel Operations segment, and the Others segment. The Property development segment is involved in the construction of the residential units. These include SKYPARK, BOHEMIAN HOUSE, Shenzhen New World Yi Shan Garden, Shenzhen New World Signature Hill, among others. The Service segment provides property and facility management, transport and other services. The Infrastructure Operations segment is involved in the operation of roads, environment projects, commercial aircraft leasing, container handling, logistics and warehousing services. The Others segment is engaged in telecommunications, media, technology and other strategic businesses.

name: HI SUN TECHNOLOGY (CHINA) LTD
businessSummary: Hi Sun Technology China Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the provision of payment transaction processing solutions. The Company operates through five segments. The Payment and Digital Service segment is mainly engaged in provision of payment processing services and related digital products and solutions. The Financial Solution segment is mainly engaged in the provision of information system consultancy, integration and operation services and sales of information technology products to financial institutions and banks. The Fintech Service segment is mainly engaged in provision of micro-lending, supply chain financing, factoring business, credit assessment services and related products and solutions. The Platform Operation Solution segment is mainly engaged in the provision of telecommunication and mobile payment platform operation services and operation value-added services. The Other segment is mainly engaged in electric energy measurement and solutions business.

name: MELCO INTERNATIONAL DEVELOPMENT LTD
businessSummary: Melco International Development Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in casino and hotel operations. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Casino and Hotel segment operates casinos and provides hotel services and facilities, including integrated resorts with gaming, accommodation, dining, entertainment, shopping and conferences and exhibitions. The Other segment engages in investment activities.

name: METALPHA TECHNOLOGY HOLDING LTD
businessSummary: Metalpha Technology Holding Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of cryptocurrency-related financial services. The Company provides design, sales, and trading services of cryptocurrency derivative products and offers asset management services to institutional clients.

name: ADR ON FUTU HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Futu Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company engaged in offering digitized brokerage platforms. The Company is involved in the provision of online brokerage services and margin financing services through software and websites. The Company mainly provides investing services through its digital brokerage platform under the name of Futu NiuNiu. The Company’s service offerings include trade executions and margin financings, which allow its clients to trade securities across markets, such as stocks, warrants, options and exchange traded funds (ETFs). In addition, the Company also provides financial information and online community services.

name: ULFERTS INTERNATIONAL LTD
businessSummary: Ulferts International Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the retail of furniture. The Company is principally engaged in the retail and wholesale of furniture, mattresses and bedding products through its stores across Hong Kong and Macau as well as via its online shopping platform. In addition, the Company provides planning and design services, including procuring custom-made furniture to final installations for corporate customers, as well as liaison services with furniture manufacturers.

name: HONBRIDGE HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Honbridge Holdings Limited is a Hong Kong-based investment holding company principally engaged in the new energy materials related businesses. The Company mainly operates through two business segments. The Mineral Resources Exploration and Trading segment is involved in the research and exploration of mineral resources and trading of copper and steel products. The Lithium Battery Production segment is involved in the research, production and sales of lithium batteries. The Company mainly conducts its businesses in Brazil, Hong Kong and the People’s Republic of China (the PRC). The Company is also engaged in the new energy vehicles related businesses through its subsidiaries.

name: TOP SPRING INTERNATIONAL HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Top Spring International Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the development and sale of residential and commercial properties. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Property Development segment is engaged in the development and sale of residential and commercial properties. The Property Management and Related Services segment is engaged in the provision of property management and related services to buyers and tenants of the Group’s self-developed residential and retail properties, as well as the provision of fitting-out services to group companies. The Property Investment segment is engaged in the leasing of shopping malls, clubhouses, serviced apartments and car parks and in deriving benefits from long-term property appreciation. The Education Related Services segment is engaged in the provision of education related services and products to students.

name: RICH GOLDMAN HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Rich Goldman Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the property leasing business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Property Leasing Business segment is engaged in the leasing the shops on the ground floor of the hotel property. The Money Lending Business segment is engaged in the providing unsecured personal loans and property mortgage services. The Hotel Operations Business segment is engaged in the hotel operations.

name: PIZU GROUP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Pizu Group Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the provision of explosives trading and blasting services. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Explosives Trading and Blasting Services segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of explosives. The segment is engaged in the provision of blasting operations as well. The Mining Operation segment is mainly engaged in the exploration, mining, processing and sale of pyrite, iron ore, copper and molybdenum.

name: POWELL MAX LTD CLASS A
businessSummary: Powell Max Ltd is a holding company principally engaged in the provision of financial communications services. The Company is engaged in the provision of financial communications services that support capital market compliance and transaction needs for corporate clients and their advisors in Hong Kong.

name: ZIJIN GOLD INTERNATIONAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Zijin Gold International Co Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the mining of gold and non-ferrous metal business. The Company is mainly engaged in the exploration, mining processing, and sales of gold and non-ferrous metal. The Company is mainly engaged in the sale of gold bars, alloy gold, gold concentrate and other products.

name: POWER ASSETS HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Power Assets Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the energy and utility-related businesses. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Investment segment is involved in the investment in power and utility-related businesses. The Investment in HKEI segment is involved in the investment in generation and supply of electricity business in Hong Kong. The All Other Activities segment is engaged in the other activities carried out by the Company. The Company’s business insists of generation of thermal and renewable power, the transmission of electricity and oil as well as the distribution of electricity and gas. The Company distributes its products within the domestic market and to overseas markets, including United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, Thailand, the Netherlands, Portugal and Canada.

name: ASIA ORIENT HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Asia Orient Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the financial investment business. The Company operates its business through five segments. The Financial investment segment is mainly engaged in the investment in listed debt securities and listed equity securities. The Property Leasing segment is engaged in the property rental business. The Hotel and Travel segment is engaged in the hotel operation and travel agency businesses. The Property Sales segment is engaged in the property sale business. The Others segment is engaged in the provision of products and services.

name: KIMOU ENVIRONMENTAL HOLDING LTD
businessSummary: Kimou Environmental Holding Ltd is a company that principally provides electroplating wastewater treatment and other supporting services for the development and operation of electroplating industrial parks. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Wastewater Treatment and Utilities segment operates electroplating wastewater treatment plants and provides services of utilities. The Rental and Facilities Usage segment conducts industrial park property development and management businesses. Sales of Goods and Ancillary Business segment provides sales of goods and raw materials and provision of other related environmental services to customers.

name: PCCW LTD
businessSummary: PCCW Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of technology and telecommunications services. The Company operates its business through three segments. The HKT segment of the Company is mainly engaged in enterprise solutions, mobile services, total home solutions and media entertainment business. Additionally, the segment is engaged in the provision of loyalty platform, financial services and healthtech services. The Media Business segment is mainly engaged in the provision of television service and Over-The-Top (OTT) digital media entertainment services. The segment is also engaged in the content production as well as artiste and event management business. The Other Businesses segment is primarily engaged in the provision of corporate support functions and other IT solutions businesses.

name: YT REALTY GROUP LTD
businessSummary: YT Realty Group Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the development and trading of properties. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Property Development and Trading segment is engaged in the development and trading of properties. The Property Investment segment is engaged in the investment of properties for rental income and potential capital appreciation. The Treasury Management segment is engaged in the investment of debt securities and time deposits for earning interest income.

name: GUANGDONG LAND HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Guangdong Land Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the property business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Property Development segment is engaged in the property development business. The Property Investment segment is engaged in the property investment, leasing and management operations business. The Other segment consists of corporate and other income and expense items.

name: CHINA VANADIUM TITANO MAGNETITE MINING C
businessSummary: China Vanadium Titano Magnetite Mining Co Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in iron ore mining, production and sales. The Company operates its business through four segments. The High-Fe Mining Operation segment is engaged in the sales of self-produced iron ore concentrates. The Trading segment is engaged in the sales of trading products. The Facility Management segment provides facilities management services to mining-related industries. The Corporate and Other segment supports the Group's non-operating activities.

name: PINE TECHNOLOGY HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Pine Technology Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in computer components and consumer electronic products business. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Other Brand Products segment is engaged in the distribution of other manufacturers’ computer components and consumer electronic products. The Trading Business segment is engaged in the sale of plastic products. The Computer Software and Hardware and System Development Service segment is engaged in the provision of computer software and hardware and system development services. The Group’s Brand Products segment is engaged in the manufacture and sales of market video graphics cards and other computer components under the Company’s brand name.

name: BRIGHT SMART SECURITIES & COMMODITIES GR
businessSummary: Bright Smart Securities & Commodities Group Ltd. is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of financial services. The Company operates through three business segments. The Securities Broking segment is engaged in the provision of broking services in securities traded in Hong Kong and selected overseas markets, as well as margin financing services to broking clients. The Commodities and Futures Broking segment is engaged in the provision of broking services in commodities and futures contracts traded in Hong Kong and overseas markets. The Bullion Trading segment is engaged in the provision of trading services in bullion contracts traded in overseas markets.

name: EMPEROR INTERNATIONAL HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Emperor International Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the property investment businesses. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Lease of Properties segment is engaged in the holding and rental of completed investment properties, including Emperor Group Centre, GF Tower, Emperor Commercial Centre, Emperor Hollywood Centre as well as others. The Properties Development segment is engaged in the properties development and redevelopment for sale purposes.

name: GLOBAL BIO-CHEM TECHNOLOGY GROUP CO LTD
businessSummary: Global Bio-chem Technology Group Co Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacturing and sales of biochemical products such as lysine and threonine. The Amino Acids segment is engaged in the manufacture and sales of corn-based amino acids products, including lysine and threonine. The Upstream Products segment is engaged in the manufacture and sales of corn starch, gluten meal, corn oil and other corn refined products. The Corn Sweeteners segment is engaged in the manufacture and sales of corn-based sweeteners products, including glucose, maltose, high fructose corn syrup, crystallized glucose and maltodextrin. The Polyol Chemicals segment is engaged in the manufacture and sales of corn-based biochemical products, including polyol chemicals, anti-freeze products, hydrogen and ammonia.

name: WAI KEE HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Wai Kee Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the construction business. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Construction, Sewage Treatment and Steam Fuel segment is engaged in the construction of civil engineering and building projects. The Segment is also engaged in the operation of sewage treatment plant and steam fuel plant. The Construction Materials segment is engaged in the production and sales of concrete and asphalt. The Quarrying segment is engaged in the production and sales of quarry products. The Property Development and Investment, Toll Road, Investment and Asset Management segment is engaged in the investment in Road King, an associate of the Group.

name: PRENETICS GLOBAL LTD CLASS A
businessSummary: Prenetics Global Ltd is a company principally engaged in the provision of diagnostic and preventive products and services. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Diagnostics segment is mainly engaged in the sale of precision oncology testing services. The Prevention segment is mainly engaged in the design and sale of genetics testing, including update services, and stool-based deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) tests for early colorectal cancer screening. The Company's products and services include CircleDNA, ACTOnco, ACTHRD and other products. The in-house developed consumer genetic testing product, CircleDNA, offers comprehensive DNA tests capitalizing on in-house developed testing algorithm. ACTOnco is a comprehensive cancer test used to guide treatment selection for major solid tumors. ACTHRD is a test for the homologous recombination deficiency status of cancer patients. The Company is also engaged in consumer health products by a new health and wellness brand IM8.

name: ORIENTAL CULTURE HOLDING LTD
businessSummary: Oriental Culture Holding LTD is an online provider of collectibles and artwork e-commerce services, which allow collectors, artists and art dealers and owners to access a art trading market. The Company provides customers of online platform with comprehensive services, including account opening, art investment education, market information, research, real-time customer support, and artwork warehousing services. The Company also provides industry solutions and related software products, system development and technical support services for cooperation e-commerce platform customers.

name: NEW CONCEPTS HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: New Concepts Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the environmental protection business. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Environmental Protection segment is engaged in kitchen waste treatment business, development and management of environmental protection industrial parks business as well as new energy materials business. The Construction Work segment engages in foundation works, civil engineering works and general building works business.

name: REITAR LOGTECH HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Reitar Logtech Holdings Ltd is a holding company mainly engaged in the provision of construction management and engineering design services. The Company is also engaged in the provision of asset management and investment. In addition, the Company is engaged in the provision of professional consultancy services in Hong Kong.

name: SINO BIOPHARMACEUTICAL LTD
businessSummary: Sino Biopharmaceutical Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the pharmaceutical business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Modernised Chinese Medicines and Chemical Medicines segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale and distribution of modernised Chinese medicine products and western medicine products. The Investment segment is mainly engaged in the long term investments business. The Others segment is mainly engaged in the related healthcare and hospital business.

name: PROSPEROUS FUTURE HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Prosperous Future Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the sale of frozen food and beverage products. The company operates its business through three segments. The Catering segment is principally engaged in the sales of frozen food and beverage products. The Financial Business segment is engaged in the professional services, such as fund establishment and management, consulting and coordination, corporate and accounting services, data analysis, provision of trading of securities and futures, contract-related services, provision of advice on securities and asset management services, securities investment and lending . The Property Holding segment is mainly engaged in property-related business.

name: HK ELECTRIC INVESTMENTS LTD
businessSummary: HK ELECTRIC INVESTMENTS LIMITED is a fixed single investment trust in Hong Kong with a focus on the power industry. The Company is a vertically integrated power utility and its operations comprise the generation, transmission, distribution and supply of electricity to Hong Kong Island and Lamma Island. Its principal operating subsidiary is The Hongkong Electric Company, Limited (HEC). HEC’s sole power generation facility is the Lamma Power Station which has an aggregate installed capacity of approximately 3,700 megawatt (MW). The Company provides electricity to approximately 568,000 registered customers on Hong Kong Island and Lamma Island.

name: CROCODILE GARMENTS LTD
businessSummary: Crocodile Garments Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the apparel business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Garment and Related Accessories segment engages in the retail and wholesale of fashion apparel, as well as garment manufacturing. Its products include men's shirts, jackets, trousers and accessories such as belts, scarves, shoes and bags. The Property Investment and Leasing segment engages in property investment and leasing. The Treasury Management segment engages in the trading of securities.

name: ASIA STANDARD INTERNATIONAL GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Asia Standard International Group Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in property development and investment business. The Company operates its business through five segments. The Property Sales segment is responsible for the development and sale of properties. The Financial Investment segment is engaged in the investment in securities and other financial assets to generate interest and dividend income. The Hotel Business segment is responsible for the operation and management of hotels. The Property Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing of properties and provision of related management services. The Other segment covers management services and other miscellaneous business.

name: ADR ON MELCO RESORTS & ENTERTAINMENT LTD
businessSummary: Melco Resorts & Entertainment Ltd is a Company engaged in the development and operation of resort facilities. The Company is engaged in the operation of casinos in Macau and Philippines. The Company operates three casinos based in Macau, namely, City of Dreams, Altira Macau and Studio City. In addition, the Company is engaged in the operation of hotels in Macau and Manila.

name: SHENZHEN INTERNATIONAL HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Shenzhen International Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the toll roads and general-environmental protection business. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Toll Roads and General-environmental Protection Business segment is mainly engaged in the development, operation and management of toll highways and sales of wind turbine equipment. The segment is engaged in the kitchen waste disposal projects construction, operation and equipment sales and operations of wind power stations as well. The Logistics Business segment is mainly engaged in the logistics parks business which mainly includes the construction, operation and management of logistics centers and integrated logistics hubs. The segment is also engaged in the provision of logistics services, port and related services as well as logistics park transformation and upgrading business.

name: GCL TECHNOLOGY HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: GCL Technology Holdings Ltd, formerly GCL-Poly Energy Holdings Ltd, is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of solar materials. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Solar Material Business segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of polysilicon and wafer products to companies operating in the solar industry. The New Energy Business segment is engaged in the development, construction, operation and management of solar farms. The Solar Farm Business segment is engaged in the operation and management of solar farms.

name: FAR EAST CONSORTIUM INTERNATIONAL LTD
businessSummary: Far East Consortium International Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in property development business. The Company operates its business through seven segments. The Property Development segment is engaged in residential property development projects. The Hotel Operations and Management segment operates and owns hotels. The Car Parking and Facilities Management segment operates car parks. The Securities and Financial Product Investment segment invests in securities and financial products. The Property Investment segment invests in retail and office buildings. The Gaming Operations segment owns and operates casinos. The Mortgage Services segment provides residential mortgage services.

name: CHINESE ESTATES HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Chinese Estates Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the development and trading of properties business. The Company operates its business through six segments: the Property Leasing for Non-retail Segment; the Investments and Treasury Products at FVTPL segment; the Property Development and Trading segment; the Property Leasing for Retail segment; the Unlisted Investments, Investment Holding and Brokerage segment and the Listed Equity Investments at FVTOCI segment. The Company is also engaged in cosmetics distribution and trading, provision of building and property management services.

name: VPOWER GROUP INTERNATIONAL HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: VPower Group International Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in investment, construction and operating businesses. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Investment, Building and Operating (IBO) segment is mainly engaged in the design, investment in, building and operation of distributed power generation stations to provide distributed power solutions. The System Integrator (SI) segment is mainly engaged in the design, integration, sales and installation of engine-based electricity generation units.

name: ALIBABA HEALTH INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY LT
businessSummary: Alibaba Health Information Technology Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the provision of Internet solutions for the medical and pharmaceutical industry, and is Alibaba Group’s healthcare flagship platform. The Company is mainly involved in the development of pharmaceutical and healthcare product and service sales business, the operation of pharmaceutical e-commerce platform and consumer healthcare services platform, the development of tracking and digital health business and Internet healthcare business using technologies such as cloud computing and big data.

name: TIME INTERCONNECT TECHNOLOGY LTD
businessSummary: Time Interconnect Technology Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sales of cable assembly business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Cable Assembly segment is mainly engaged in manufacturing and trading of cable assembly products. The Server segment is mainly engaged in manufacturing and trading of server products. The Digital Cable segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and trade of networking cable and specialty cable products.

name: CHINA NATURAL RESOURCES INC
businessSummary: China Natural Resources Inc is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the exploration and mining business and the wastewater treatment business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Wastewater Treatment segment is engaged in the sales of assembled equipment, provision of construction service and participation in PPP projects as operator. The Exploration and Mining segment is engaged in the exploration of lead, silver and other metals in the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region of the PRC and the trading of copper ores products. The Corporate Activities segment is engaged in management and financial activities at the corporate level.

name: ALPHA TECHNOLOGY GROUP LTD CLASS A ORD S
businessSummary: Alpha Technology Group Ltd is a company principally engaged in the provision of information technology (IT) services. The Company is engaged in the provision of comprehensive Managed IT Services to small and medium businesses. In addition, the Company is engaged in the provision of backup and disaster recovery services, help desk services and other services.

name: TROOPS INC
businessSummary: TROOPS Inc is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of consultancy services for insurance products. The Company operates its business through five segments. The Consultancy Services for Insurance Products segment is mainly engaged in the provision of consulting services that supports the insurance and financial management industry. The Money Lending segment is mainly engaged in the provision of mortgage loans. The Property Lease and Management segment is mainly engaged in the property investment business. The Advisory and Referral Services segment is mainly engaged in the provision of consulting and services. The Applications, Technology, and Services segment is mainly engaged in the provision of the development, operation and management of an online financial marketplace that provides one-stop financial technology solutions including application programming interface (API) services.

name: SOLOWIN HOLDINGS LTD CLASS A
businessSummary: Solowin Holdings Ltd is a holding company principally engaged in the corporate financial services provision. The Company operates through four business segments. The Wealth Management Services segment provides securities brokerage and investment advisory services. The Corporate Finance Services segment provides corporate consultancy services such as initial public offering (IPO) planning and advisory as well as company secretarial services such as statutory compliance and corporate structuring. The Asset Management Services segment provides investment management, investment advisory and fund subscription services. The Virtual Assets Services segment provides virtual assets trading, cryptocurrencies, security token offering (STO) and blockchain solutions.

name: SHENTONG ROBOT EDUCATION GROUP CO LTD
businessSummary: Shentong Robot Education Group Co Ltd is an investment holding company engaged in robot education. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Robotics Education and Other segment is engaged in the provision of robotics education courses in Heilongjiang Province, China. The Promotion and Management Services segment is engaged in the provision of promotion and management services for electronic smart cards 'Designated Shentong Cards'.

name: REGENCELL BIOSCIENCE HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Regencell Bioscience Holdings Ltd is a bioscience company that focuses on research, development and commercialization of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) for the treatment of neurocognitive disorders and degeneration, specifically attention deficit and hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and autism spectrum disorder (ASD). The Company launches three liquid based standardized TCM formulae candidates for mild, moderate and severe ADHD and ASD patients.

name: BITVENTURES LTD
businessSummary: BitVentures Ltd, formerly known as Santech Holdings Ltd, is a consumer-focused technology company principally engaged in health management service business. The health management services mainly include providing medical examination, chronic disease management, immune system enhancement, and anti-aging solutions. The Company is also exploring new opportunities in technology, including but not limited to new retail, social e-commerce and metaverse. The Company mainly conducts its business within domestic market.

name: DIGINEX LTD
businessSummary: Diginex Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the software as a service (SaaS) business. The Company operates its businesses through a subsidiary, Diginex Solutions (HK) Limited. Diginex Solutions (HK) Limited is mainly engaged in building end-to-end SaaS solutions for the future of ESG reporting and supply chain due diligence. The Company also provides advisory services to support ESG strategies.

name: EV DYNAMICS (HOLDINGS) LTD
businessSummary: Ev Dynamics (Holdings) Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the development and sales of electric vehicle business. The Company operates through three segments. The Development and Sales of Electric Vehicles segment is engaged in the development, design and manufacturing of new energy vehicles including electric buses, entire electric power and control systems, other buses. This segment also involves marketing and selling vehicle related components as well as providing big data platform for vehicle networking. The Mining segment is engaged in the mining of glauberite and production of mineral products. The Metal and Minerals Trading segment is engaged in the trading of metal and mineral products.

name: ADR ON SILICON MOTION TECHNOLOGY CORP
businessSummary: SILICON MOTION TECHNOLOGY CORPORATION is a provider of negative-AND (NAND) flash controllers for Solid State Drives (SSDs) and other solid state storage devices. The Company is mainly engaged in the design, development and sale of low-power semiconductor solutions for original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and other customers in the mobile storage market. The Company is mainly engaged in the development of NAND flash controller integrated circuits (ICs) for solid-state storage devices, as well as specialty radio frequency (RF) ICs for mobile devices. In the mobile storage market, the Company's products are controllers used in SSDs, Embedded Multimedia Cards (eMMCs) and other embedded storage products, as well as flash memory cards, universal serial bus (USB) flash drives and other expandable storage products. The Company's products are used in smartphones, tablets, personal computers (PCs) and other devices.

name: SEM HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Sem Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of electrical and mechanical engineering services. The Company primarily provides electrical and mechanical engineering services. The Company’s business scope primarily includes the supply, installation, and maintenance of electrical systems for new and existing buildings within commercial and residential developments, hotel developments, casino developments, public property, and hotel renovation projects, as well as cable trading.

name: LOTUS HORIZON HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Lotus Horizon Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of construction engineering services. Along with subsidiaries, the Company is engaged in the provision of design, supply, and installation services for facade works and building metal finishing works projects. The Company's business covers customized system design of facade works and building metal finishing works, shop drawings, sourcing and procurement of materials, material fabrication and processing, on-site installation works, performance testing, and post-installation maintenance. name: INNOVAX HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Innovax Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the provision of financial services. In addition, the Company is also engaged in the provision of placing and underwriting services, securities dealing and brokerage services, securities financing services, asset management services and money lending services.

name: REGAL REAL ESTATE INVESTMENT TRUST
businessSummary: Regal Real Estate Investment Trust is a Hong Kong-based real estate investment trust (REIT). The primary objectives of the REIT and the REIT Manager are to provide long-term, stable, growing distributions and capital growth for the unitholders of the REIT through active ownership of hotels and strategic investment in hotels, serviced apartments and commercial properties. name: GEMINI INVESTMENTS HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Gemini Investments Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the property and investment business. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Property Development segment is engaged in the leasing of self-acquired properties and the sale of food and beverages. The Securities and Other Investments segment is engaged in the investment in various securities and fixed income products. The Fund Investment segment is engaged in the investment in various funds and fixed income products.

name: HONGKONG AND SHANGHAI HOTELS LTD
businessSummary: Hongkong and Shanghai Hotels Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the hotel operation. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Commercial Properties segment engages in the development, leasing and sale of residential apartments, leasing of retail and office premises as well as operating food and beverage outlets in such premises. The Clubs and Services segment engages in the operation of golf courses, the Peak Tram, retailing of food and beverage products and laundry services and the provision of management and consultancy services for clubs.

name: CHINA SOUTH CITY HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: China South City Holdings Limited is principally engaged in property development. The Company operates its business through five segments. The Property Development segment is engaged in the development of integrated logistics and trade centers, residential and commercial ancillary facilities. The Property Investment segment is engaged in the investment in integrated logistics and trade centers, residential and commercial ancillary facilities. The Property Management segment is engaged in the management of the Company’s developed properties. The E-commerce segment is engaged in the development, operations and maintenance of an E-commerce platform. The Others segment is engaged in the provision of advertising, exhibition, logistics and warehousing services, outlet operations and other services.

name: MAJESTIC DRAGON AEROTECH HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Majestic Dragon AeroTech Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the unmanned aerial vehicles business. The Wholesale Business segment is mainly engaged in the wholesale of timepieces, accessories, garment and sportswear products. The Property Investment segment is mainly engaged in the investing and letting of properties.

name: CHINA STAR ENTERTAINMENT LTD
businessSummary: China Star Entertainment Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the film related business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Property Development and Investment Operations segment engages in the properties investment, development and management services in Macau. The Multi-Media and Entertainment Business Operations segment engages in the development, promotion and operation of livestreaming e-commerce in multi-channel network e-commerce platforms, also development and sales of private label products.

name: PALADIN LTD
businessSummary: Paladin Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the development of software and hardware. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Property Investment segment is engaged in the properties rental business.

name: ITC PROPERTIES GROUP LTD
businessSummary: ITC Properties Group Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in property development, sale and investment business. The Hotel and Leisure segment is principally engaged in the investment and management of hotels and resorts. The Securities Investment segment is principally engaged in the trading and investment of securities. The Financing segment is principally engaged in the provision of loan financing services.

name: GREAT WALL PAN ASIA HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Great Wall Pan Asia Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the property investment business. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Property Investment segment is mainly engaged in the property investment and rental business. The Financial Services segment is mainly engaged in the provision of asset management services.

name: DIT GROUP LTD
businessSummary: DIT Group Ltd is a company primarily engaged in prefabricated construction work. The Company develops, designs, produces, and sells prefabricated building components. In addition, the Company also provides decoration and landscaping services, licenses patented technologies, provides consulting services, and sells equipment.

name: CCT FORTIS HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: CCT Fortis Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the car distribution business. The Company operates through seven segments. The Ferrari Business segment imports and distributes Ferrari cars and provides after-sale services. The Maserati Business segment imports and distributes Maserati cars and provides after-sale services. The Valuable Collections and Logistics Business segment engages in the acquisition of classic cars and collectible precision devices for investment purposes, trading and sale of classic cars and car logistics business. The Other Operations segment supports startup businesses including multimedia operations, classic car service center operation, artist management and magazine publication. The Property Investment and Holding segment invest and holds properties. The Securities Business segment engages in securities trading and holding, and financial assets holding. The Cultural Entertainment Business segment engages in film operations.

name: TOP FINANCIAL GROUP LTD CLASS A
businessSummary: TOP Financial Group Ltd, formerly Zhong Yang Financial Group Ltd, is a company mainly engaged in the online brokerage business. The Company is mainly engaged in the provision of futures brokerage services and other services such as stock brokerage, options brokerage, consulting services, currency exchange services, structured note subscriber services, margin financing services as well as others. The Company opreates its futures and stock brokerage business mainly through two trading platforms, Esunny for futures trading and 2Go for stock trading.

name: ACME INTERNATIONAL HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Acme International Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the building maintenance unit (BMU) business. The Company operates its business through two segments. The BMU Systems Business segment is mainly engaged in the provision of design and build solutions for BMU systems. The Green New Energy Business segment is mainly engaged in the development, design, production and sale of new energy generation and energy storage system and provision of services for sales of electricity.

name: SJM HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: SJM Holdings Limited is a Hong Kong-based investment holding company principally engaged in gaming operation businesses. The Company mainly operates through two segments. The Gaming Operations segment is engaged in the operation of casinos and related facilities. This segment includes very important person (VIP) businesses, mass market businesses and slot machine businesses, among others. It operates Casino Babylon, Casino Casa Real, Casino Diamond and Casino Emperor Palace, among others. The Hotel and Catering Operations segment is engaged in the operation of hotels, as well as the provision of catering and related services. Its hotels include Grand Lisboa Hotel, among others.

name: ADR ON ALIBABA GROUP HOLDING LTD
businessSummary: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the provision of technology infrastructure and marketing platforms. name: ALIBABA GROUP HOLDING LTD
businessSummary: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the provision of technology infrastructure and marketing platforms. name: HONG KONG AND CHINA GAS CO LTD
businessSummary: Hong Kong and China Gas Co Ltd is a company principally engaged in the production, distribution and marketing of gas, water supply and emerging environmentally friendly energy businesses. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Gas, Water and Related Businesses segment is engaged in the gas, water and related businesses including utility businesses in Mainland China, and Hong Kong gas business. The New Energy segment is engaged in the coal mining, and exploration, drilling and sale of crude oil. The Property Business segment is engaged in the property business. The Other segment is engaged in the engineering and related business.

name: CHINA NETCOM TECHNOLOGY HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: China Netcom Technology Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company primarily engaged in smart retail operations. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Smart Retail Business segment primarily engages in the provision of new retail digital transformation solutions to and operation of new retail integrated software service platform for chain retailers and merchants, and provision of extended services such as smart retail systems and cloud services. The Automotive Culture Business segment primarily engages in buying and selling automotive-related accessories and peripheral products.

name: LUDA TECHNOLOGY GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Luda Technology Group Ltd is a holding company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of steel flanges and fittings products. The Company operates its business through two segments. The People's Republic of China (PRC) Manufacturing segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of stainless steel and carbon steel flanges and fittings products. The Hong Kong Trading segment is trading of steel pipes, valves and other steel tubing products.

name: SHENG TANG HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Sheng Tang Holdings Ltd, formerly Allurefem Holding Ltd, is an investment holding company principally engaged in performing repair, maintenance, alteration and addition (RMAA) works. The Company primarily provides repair, alteration and addition, maintenance, modification, rehabilitation, steel, civil and demolition works in various venues such as residential building, commercial building, carpark, road, footbridge and theme park. The Company also provides constructions and related alteration and additions works and facilities such as noise mitigation work, architectural metalwork, bus shelter, dangerous goods store building, innovative and creative structure such as air balloon. The Company provides various of corrosion protection solution including but not limited to installation of cathodic protection systems including sacrificial anodes protection and impressed current systems

name: TOM GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Tom Group Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the publishing business. The Company operates its business through four segments. Publishing Group segment is engaged in the publishing and circulation of magazine and book, sales of advertising and other related products. Advertising Group segment is engaged in the provision of media sales and marketing services. E-Commerce Group segment is engaged in the provision of services to users using the mobile and Internet-based marketplace and provision of technical services for e-commerce/ supply chain operations. Mobile Internet Group is engaged in the provision of mobile Internet services, online advertising and commercial enterprise solutions.

name: CK LIFE SCIENCES INTL (HOLDINGS) INC
businessSummary: CK Life Sciences Intl (Holdings) Inc is an investment holding company principally engaged in the development and sales of healthcare products. The Company is mainly engaged in human health businesses such as research and development, production, promotion and sales of health products and pharmaceutical products. The healthcare brands under the Company include Lipa, Vitaquest and Sante Naturelle, among others. Its pharmaceutical products include cancer-related pharmaceuticals and painkillers, among others. The Agriculture-related Businesses segment is engaged in the operation of vineyards, as well as the development, production, marketing and sales of agriculture and related products. Its agricultural products include fertilizers and crop protection products, among others.

name: ALCO HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Alco Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the design, manufacture and sales of consumer electronic products business. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Notebook Products segment is mainly engaged in the design and sale of commercial notebook and personal computers products. The Audio and Video (AV) Products segment is mainly engaged in the design and sale of consumer electronic products, including audio, video and tablet products.

name: HONG KONG EXCHANGES AND CLEARING LTD
businessSummary: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Ltd is a company mainly engaged in the operation of stock exchange business. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Cash segment is engaged in trading, clearing, settlement, custody and related services for equity products. The Equity and Financial Derivatives segment is engaged in trading, clearing, settlement, custody and related services for equity and financial derivatives products. The Commodities segment is engaged in trading, clearing, settlement and related services for metal and other commodity futures and options contracts. The Data and Connectivity segment is engaged in market data sales, platform and infrastructure services and related technology services.

name: BUDWEISER BREWING COMPANY APAC LTD
businessSummary: Budweiser Brewing Company APAC Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the brewing and distribution of beer. The Company produces, imports, markets, distributes and sells a portfolio of beer brands owned or licensed by the Company, including Budweiser, Stella Artois, Corona, Hoegaarden, Cass and Harbin. The Company also produces, markets, distributes and sells other non-beer beverages. The Company distributes its products primarily in China, South Korea, India, Vietnam and other Asia Pacific regions.

name: MF INTERNATIONAL LIMITED CLASS A
businessSummary: MF International Ltd is a holding company principally engaged in the provision of information technology (IT) services. The Company is principally engaged in the operation and supply of finance trading platforms, customer relationship management systems, liquidity solutions as well as others.

name: MMTEC INC
businessSummary: Mmtec Inc is a holding company primarily engaged in the provision of comprehensive, Internet-based technology services and solutions to the Chinese language speaking hedge funds, mutual funds, registered investment advisors, proprietary trading groups, and brokerage firms engaging in securities market transactions and settlements globally. The Company conducts its businesses through two segments. The Gujia, MM Future and HC Securities segment is engaged in providing market data services and consulting services. The MM Global segment provides clearing brokerage trading services. System and solutions include securities dealers trading support system and private fund investment management system. Financial technology solutions include modular website building, online account opening system, modular personal computer-based (PC-based) trading clients and mobile application (APP) trading clients for retail customers and others.

name: JOLIMARK HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Jolimark Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacture and sales of printers, tax control equipment and other electronic products. The Company engages in the printers and tax control equipment manufacture and sale business. In addition, the Company engages in the medical equipment, point of sale (POS) machine and mask manufacture and sale business.

name: ETOILES CAPITAL GROUP CO LTD CLASS A
businessSummary: Etoiles Capital Group Co Ltd, formerly Thrive Capital Co Ltd, is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the provision of investor relation service. The Company is mainly engaged in the management of public relations and investor relations. The Company is also engaged in conducting due diligence. In addition, the Company is engaged in the provision of other value-added services such as website design and promotional video production.

name: WELLCHANGE HOLDINGS CO LTD CLASS A
businessSummary: Wellchange Holdings Co Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the software business. The Company operates businesses through its operating subsidiary, Wching HK. The Company provides customized software solutions, cloud-based software-as-a-service (SaaS) platforms, and software design and development services.

name: DALIPAL HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Dalipal Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the oil and gas pipes business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Oil and Gas Pipes segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of oil and gas pipes, including natural gas, shale gas and coalbed methane. The New Energy Pipes and Special Seamless Steel Pipes segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of new energy pipes and special seamless steel pipes. The Other Products segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of other products.

name: JINCHUAN GROUP INTERNATIONAL RESOURCES C
businessSummary: Jinchuan Group International Resources Co Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the mining business. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Mining Operations segment is mainly engaged in the mining of non-ferrous metals, primarily copper and cobalt, in the DRC and Zambia. The Trading of Mineral and Metal Products segment is mainly engaged in the trading of mineral and metal products in Hong Kong.

name: TESSON HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Tesson Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the production and sales of lithium-ion power batteries. The Company is mainly engaged in the production and sales of lithium-ion motive battery, lithium-ion battery module, battery charging devices, battery materials machines and production lines, new energy solution and relevant equipment. In addition, the Company is also engaged in the import and export trading of products.

name: AGTECH HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: AGTech Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of electronic payment and related services. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Digital Payment and Related Businesses segment provides payment card services, ancillary services, e-wallet services, merchant acquiring services, and local consumer services. The segment also sells and leases payment terminals, equipment and related services. The Digital Banking Business segment provides digital banking services to individuals and small and medium-sized (SME) enterprises, including deposits, loans, transfers, cross-border remittances and e-commerce and others. In addition, the segment also provides internet securities investment services, insurance agency services and others. The Lottery Business segment sells and rents lottery hardware with related after-sales services, and provides offline lottery distribution, ancillary services, and others.

name: YOUZAN TECHNOLOGY LTD
businessSummary: Youzan Technology Ltd, formerly China Youzan Ltd, is an investment holding company principally engaged in the merchant service business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Merchant Service segment engages in the provision of e-commerce platform with software as a service (SaaS) products and comprehensive services through Youzan WeiMall, Youzan Retail, Youzan Beauty and other SaaS products. The Third-party Payment Services segment is involved in the provision of third-party payment services and related consultancy services. The Others segment provides products and services.

name: CENTRAL NEW ENERGY HOLDING GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Central New Energy Holding Group Ltd, formerly Central Holding Group Co Ltd, is an investment holding company mainly engaged in new energy and engineering procurement construction (EPC) business. The Company operates its business through five segments. The New Energy and EPC segment manufacturing and sales photovoltaic products and EPC. The Green Building and Construction Related Business segment engages in pile cap construction and building works, development, sale and holding properties for investment and leasing purposes, property management and construction materials supply. The Health and Wellness segment provides healthcare consulting and sales of healthcare products and healthy food. The Food and Beverage (F&B) Supply Chain segment provides supply chain of agricultural products, food and beverages. The Smart Energy Management Services segment is engaged in the sales and installation of energy-saving lighting, equipment and information technology development services.

name: CGN MINING CO LTD
businessSummary: CGN Mining Co Ltd is a company mainly engaged in the trading of natural uranium. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Natural Uranium Trading segment is engaged in the trading of natural uranium. The Property Investment segment is engaged in leasing business. The Other Investments segment is engaged in investment activities.

name: INSILICO MEDICINE CAYMAN TOPCO
businessSummary: InSilico Medicine Cayman TopCo is a company principally engaged in the research and development of artificial intelligence in pharmaceuticals. In addition, the Company is engaged in the copabdrug discovery and development of disease target identification, generation of novel molecules data, and predicting clinical trial outcomes.

name: HAPPY CITY HOLDINGS LTD CLASS A
businessSummary: Happy City Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the restaurant services business. The Company is mainly engaged in the operation of hotpot restaurants. The Company mainly operates the hotpot brand 'Thai Pot' and 'Gyu! Gyu! Shabu Shabu'. The Company is engaged in the provision of food and beverages as well.

name: CELLYAN BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD CLASS A
businessSummary: Cellyan Biotechnology Co Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the over the counter (OTC) pharmaceutical business. The Company mainly provides two services. The supply chain services mainly provide OTC pharmaceutical cross-border e-commerce supply chain services. The procurement and distribution services mainly provide OTC pharmaceutical cross-border procurement and distribution services.

name: GENERATION ASIA I ACQUISITION LTD
businessSummary: Generation Asia I Acquisition Ltd is a blank check company principally incorporated for purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The Company's main target is to pursue prospective targets in the technology, media and telecommunications (TMT), business services and consumer sectors although there is no restriction or limitation on industry or geographic region.

name: I-CABLE COMMUNICATIONS LTD
businessSummary: i-CABLE Communications Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of television subscription business and domestic free television programme service. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Media segment engages in the operation related to the television subscription business, domestic free television programme service, advertising, channel carriage, television relay service, programme licensing, theatrical release and other related businesses. The Telecommunications segment provides broadband internet access services, portal operation, mobile content licensing, telephony services, network leasing, network construction, mobile agency service as well as other related businesses.

name: SINOMAB BIOSCIENCE LTD
businessSummary: SinoMab BioScience Ltd is a Hong Kong-based biopharmaceutical company mainly dedicated to the research, development, manufacturing and commercialization of therapeutics for the treatment of immunological diseases. The Company primarily develops mAb-based biologics and new chemical entities (NCE) and its product SM03 is a mAb for the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis (RA). The Company is also developing drugs such as SM17, which has the potential to treat atopic dermatitis (AD), asthma, idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) and other immune diseases, and SN1011, which targets systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), pemphigus, multiple sclerosis (MS) and neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorders (NMOSD).

name: CITY COOLXUAN CO LTD
businessSummary: City Coolxuan Co Ltd, formerly Quantum Thinking Ltd, is an investment holding company principally engaged in the Short messaging service fee business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Short Messaging Service Fee segment is engaged in the short messaging service fee. The System Development Services segment is engaged in the system development services. The Sales of Hardware segment is engaged in the sales of hardware.

name: WIZZ AIR HOLDINGS PLC
businessSummary: Wizz Air Holdings Plc is a Hungary-based airline company. The Company provides low-cost low-fare passenger air transportation services on scheduled, short-haul and medium-haul point-to-point routes across Europe and into the Caucasus and the Middle East as well as North Africa and North-West Asia, connecting 155 destinations across 45 countries. Wizz Air Holdings Plc operates a fleet of more than 206 ultramodern Airbus A320 family aircraft. Airbus A321neo aircraft’s new generation engines offer environmental benefits with the lower environmental footprint per passenger. Wizz Air Holdings Plc works along with its subsidiaries: Wizz Air Hungary Ltd., Wizz Air UK Ltd., Wizz Air Abu Dhabi LLC, and Wizz Air Malta Ltd.

name: ADR ON WIPRO LTD
businessSummary: Wipro Limited is a technology services and consulting company. The Company operates through two segments: Information Technology (IT) Services, and IT Products. IT Services segment provides a range of IT and IT enabled services which include digital strategy advisory, customer centric design, technology consulting, IT consulting, custom application design, re-engineering and maintenance, systems integration, package implementation, cloud and infrastructure services, business process services, cloud, mobility and analytics services, research and development and hardware and software design. The IT Products segment provides a range of third-party IT products, which allows it to offer IT system integration services. These products include computing, platforms and storage, networking solutions, and software products. Its services include Applications, Artificial Intelligence, Business Process, Cloud, Consulting, Data & Analytics, Digital Experiences, Engineering, and Sustainability.

name: ADR ON DR REDDY'S LABORATORIES LTD
businessSummary: Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Limited is an India-based pharmaceutical company. Its products and services are spread across its core businesses of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), generics, branded generics, biosimilars and over-the-counter (OTC) pharmaceutical products. It works in the areas of gastrointestinal, cardiovascular, diabetology, oncology, pain management and dermatology. Its segments consist of Global Generics; Pharmaceutical Services and Active Ingredients (PSAI), and Others. The Global Generics segment consists of the Company's business of manufacturing and marketing prescription and over-the-counter finished pharmaceutical products ready for consumption by the patient, marketed under a brand name (branded formulations) or as generic finished dosages with therapeutic equivalence to branded formulations (generics). The Pharmaceutical Services and Active Ingredients segment consists of the Company's business of manufacturing and marketing APIs and intermediates.

name: ADR ON ICICI BANK LTD
businessSummary: ICICI Bank Limited is a diversified financial services company offering a range of banking and financial services to corporate and retail customers through a variety of delivery channels. The Company offers life and general insurance, asset management, securities broking and private equity products and services through specialized subsidiaries. Its segments include Retail Banking, Wholesale Banking, Treasury, Other Banking, Life Insurance, General Insurance, and Others. Its commercial banking operations for retail customers consist of retail lending, deposit taking, distribution of insurance and investment products and other fee-based products and services. It provides a range of commercial banking products and services, including loan products, fee and commission-based products and services, deposit products and foreign exchange and derivatives products to large corporations, middle market companies and small and medium enterprises. It offers agricultural and rural banking products.

name: WNS (HOLDINGS) LTD
businessSummary: WNS (Holdings) Limited is a digital-led business transformation and services company. It delivers a range of solutions, including industry-specific offerings, customer experience services, finance and accounting, human resources, procurement, and research and analytics to re-imagine the digital future of businesses. Its segments include Banking/Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI), Travel, Shipping/Logistics, and Utilities (TSLU), Manufacturing/Retail/Consumer, Hi-tech/Professional Services, and Procurement (MRHP), and Healthcare/Life Sciences (HCLS). The Company also provides data modernization and democratization services focused on the Snowflake platform. It offers strategy, execution, and managed service capabilities across data engineering, advanced analytics, and data science. Its financing and accounting services include Autonomous Accounting Platform (TRAC ONE-F), Financial Intelligence-in-a-Box (FIAB), and Sustainability and Technical Accounting and Reporting Consulting.

name: ADR ON HDFC BANK LTD
businessSummary: HDFC Bank Limited (the Bank) is a private bank. The Bank, together with its subsidiaries, is engaged in providing a range of banking and financial services, including retail banking, wholesale banking, treasury operations, insurance, asset management, stockbroking and other financial services businesses. Its segment includes treasury, retail banking, wholesale banking, and other banking operations. The treasury segment consists of net interest earnings from the Bank’s investment portfolio, money market borrowing and lending, and gains or losses on investment operations. The retail banking segment consists of digital banking and other retail banking. The wholesale banking segment provides loans, non-fund facilities and transaction services to corporates, emerging corporates, public sector units, government bodies, and others. The other banking operations segment includes parabanking activities such as credit cards, debit cards, third-party product distribution, and others.

name: ADR ON INFOSYS LTD
businessSummary: Infosys Limited is an India-based company which provides digital services and consulting. The Company enables clients in approximately 63 countries to navigate their digital transformation powered by cloud and artificial intelligence (AI). Its segments include Financial Services; Retail; Communication; Energy, Utilities, Resources and Services; Manufacturing; Hi-Tech; Life Sciences, and All other segments. The Company's solutions have been primarily classified as digital and core. Its digital solutions include experience, insight, innovate, accelerate, and assure. Its experience solutions include Infosys Aster, Digital Marketing, Digital Commerce and Infosys Metaverse Foundry. Its insight solutions include Infosys Topaz, Infosys Generative AI Labs, Data Analytics and AI, Infosys Sustainability Services and Applied AI. Its core solutions include application management services, proprietary application development services, traditional enterprise application implementation and others.

name: YATRA ONLINE INC
businessSummary: Yatra Online, Inc. is an India-based corporate travel services and online travel company. The Company provides services to over 1,200 corporate customers and 50,000 registered small and medium enterprise customers. The Company's operating segments include Air Ticketing, Hotels and Packages, and Other Services. Leisure and business travelers use Yatra India's mobile applications, its Website, and its other offerings and services to explore, research, compare prices and book a range of travel-related services. These services include domestic and international air ticketing on nearly all Indian and international airlines, as well as bus ticketing, rail ticketing, cab bookings and ancillary services within India. Its customers can review and book flights on all major Indian and international airlines, and accommodations at approximately 108,000 hotels in 1,500 cities and towns in India, as well as more than two million hotels around the world.

name: MAKEMYTRIP LTD
businessSummary: MakeMyTrip Limited is an online travel provider. The Company's segments include Air Ticketing, Hotels and Packages, and Bus Ticketing. The Air ticketing segment provides the facility to book domestic and international air tickets through Internet-based platforms. The Hotels and packages segment provides holiday packages and hotel reservations through Internet-based platforms, call centers, and franchise stores. The Bus ticketing segment provides the facility to book domestic and international bus tickets through Internet-based platforms. Through its primary websites, such as www.makemytrip.com, www.goibibo.com, and www.redbus.in, and mobile platforms, travelers can research, plan and book a range of travel services and products in India, as well as overseas. The Company's services and products include air ticketing, hotels and packages, bus tickets, rail tickets, car hire, activities and experiences, and ancillary travel requirements. It also provides an inter-city car rental service.

name: ADR ON SIFY TECHNOLOGIES LTD
businessSummary: Sify Technologies Limited is an India-based integrated information communications technology (ICT) solutions and services provider in India.
