The Company's products include kerosene heaters, such as oil fan heaters for household use and fuel stoves for business use; environmental equipment, such as humidifiers; coffee makers, coffee beans roasting equipment, smoke making machines, photosynthesis promotion machines and horticulture heaters, among others.

name: SANYU CO LTD
businessSummary: SANYU CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of brass bar steel and cold headed steel wires. Company has two business segments. The Brass Bar Steel segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of brass bar steel, as well as the precision machining of these products. The Cold Headed Steel Wires segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cold headed steel wires. This segment also leases land, buildings and equipment, among others.

name: HAKUTO CO LTD
businessSummary: Hakuto Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the sale, import and export of electronic and electric equipment and electronic components, as well as the manufacture and sale of industrial chemicals. It operates through four business segments. The Electronic Components Business segment sells semiconductor devices and general electronic components. The Electronic and Electric Equipment Business segment sells and provides services for printed circuit board (PCB)-related equipment and semiconductor manufacturing-related equipment. The Industrial Chemicals Business segment manufactures and sells petroleum and petrochemical-related products, pulp and paper-related products, and cosmetic bases. The Other Business segment is involved in solar power generation, contract work, service businesses, water treatment businesses, and insurance agency operations.

name: TOKYO RADIATOR MFG CO LTD
businessSummary: TOKYO RADIATOR MFG. CO., LTD. is a company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of heat exchangers, fuel tanks and press steel plates. The Company's products include parts for heat exchangers, such as radiators, exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) coolers, oil coolers and fuel coolers, among others; as well as automobile body components, such as oil pans, vacuum tanks, fuel tanks and selective catalytic reduction (SCR) tanks, among others. It mainly operates through three business segments: Japan, China and Asia.

name: DEAR LIFE CO LTD
businessSummary: Dear Life Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the real estate business and sales promotion business. The Company has two business segments. The Real Estate Business segment is engaged in real estate development and planning, investment and management of income-generating real estate, hotel ownership and management, and solutions. The Sales Promotion Business segment is engaged in staffing and referral for sales support positions in the real estate, insurance, and financial industries, as well as call center operations.

name: MAEZAWA INDUSTRIES INC
businessSummary: Maezawa Industries, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of water sewage equipment and water treatment equipment, as well as the environmental business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Environmental segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of water treatment equipment for water sewage systems, industrial water treatment equipment, purification equipment for soil and groundwater pollution and organic waste recycling equipment. The Valve segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of valves, taps and gates for water sewage systems. The Maintenance segment is mainly engaged in the repair, installation and maintenance of equipment for water sewage, as well as the maintenance and operation of waste water treatment facilities for water purification factories.

name: SHINAGAWA REFRA CO LTD
businessSummary: Shinagawa Refra Co Ltd, formerly Shinagawa Refractories Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company primarily manufactures and sells refractories, insulation materials, and fine ceramics, and performs furnace construction work. The Company operates through four segments. The Refractories segment mainly manufactures and sells shaped refractories, unshaped refractories, molded powder, quicklime, chemical products, and others. The Insulation Materials segment manufactures and sells refractory insulating bricks and ceramic fibers. The Advanced Materials segment manufactures and sells fine ceramics, inorganic coatings, and inorganic adhesives. The Engineering segment performs construction work for blast furnaces, converters, incinerators, and other facilities, as well as the design and construction of industrial furnaces. The Company also operates a real estate leasing business.

name: DAIICHI JITSUGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Daiichi Jitsugyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale and rental of various machinery, tools and parts. It operates through seven business segments. Plant & Energy Business segment sells energy development and production, gas and oil refining, chemicals, engineering, construction, and paper and pulp related products. Energy Solutions Business segment sells lithium-ion battery manufacturing related products. Industrial Machinery Business segment sells plastics, rubber, steel, and food related products. Electronics Business segment sells electronics, information and communications, electrical equipment, precision machinery, optics, audio, and musical instruments related products. Automotive Business segment sells automobile-related products. Healthcare Business segment sells pharmaceutical and pharmaceutical-related products. Aviation & Infrastructure Business segment sells aviation and disaster prevention related products. It also rents various machinery and tools.

name: ICHIKEN CO LTD
businessSummary: ICHIKEN Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in construction business, such as construction, civil engineering and interior finish construction, as well as real estate business. The Company opreates its business through two business segments. Construction segment is involved in the operation of the business related to general construction, civil engineering and other construction work. Real Estate segment is involved in the sale and leasing of real estate, as well as other business related to real estate.

name: SANSEI TECHNOLOGIES INC
businessSummary: Sansei Technologies, Inc., formerly SANSEI YUSOKI CO., LTD., is primarily engaged in the manufacture and installation of stage machinery, gaming machines, elevating machines and others. The Manufacture segment manufactures and installs stage machinery and elevating machinery for theaters and culture halls, art equipment such as electric decoration devices in television stations, events and concert venues, gaming machines such as roller coasters and towers, and elevating machinery such as elevators, escalators and packing devices. It also purchases products and conducts maintenance work. In addition, the Company is also involved in operation and provision of leisure facilities in amusement parks, and management of parks owned by the Company.

name: TYK CORP
businessSummary: TYK CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of refractories. The Company operates through four geographic segments including Japan, North America, Europe and Asia. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of refractory bricks for steel, amorphous refractories, graphite crucibles for non-ferrous metals, and new ceramics. In addition, the Company is also engaged in the sale of environment-related products, the manufacture and repair of ceramics and machinery, construction and repair business, transport business, as well as the operation of sports facilities.

name: KAGA ELECTRONICS CO LTD
businessSummary: Kaga Electronics Co Ltd is a Japan-based company that mainly manufactures and sells electronic components. The Company operates through four business segments. The Electronic Components Business segment develops, manufactures and sells semiconductors, general electronic components, electronics manufacturing service (EMS) and others. The Information Equipment Business segment sells finished products including personal computers, personal computer (PC) peripherals, home appliances, photo and video related products, as well as original brand products. The Software Business segment produces computer graphic (CG) videos and plans and develops amusement-related products. The Other Business segment repairs and supports electronics equipment, manufactures and sells amusement equipment and sells sporting goods.

name: TOHOKUSHINSHA FILM CORP
businessSummary: Tohokushinsha Film Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the advertising production, content production, media, and property. The Company operates through four business segments. The Advertisement Production segment is involved in the production of commercial messages (CMs) and sales promotion. The Content Production segment is engaged in digital production work, movie and program production, Japanese version production. The Media segment is engaged in the operation of communications satellite (CS) and broadcast satellite (BS) channels, program procurement, organization, and outsourcing of broadcasting related work. The Property segment is engaged in the co-planning and production of video contents, copyright business, as well as distribution of theaters and television. The Company is also engaged in the sale of video media, interior goods, and sake brewing and sales.

name: SAN HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: San Holdings Inc(Tokyo) is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in the provision of funeral services. The Company operates in four business segments. The Public Utility Group segment is operated in the Kansai area and the Tokyo metropolitan area, provides customers with funeral services. The Funeru Group segment provides funeral services, including associated products and services in Tottori. The Tarui Group segment provides customers with funeral services, including associated products and services in Hyogo Prefecture. The Holding Company Group segment leases real estate such as funeral halls and leases offices and parking lots.

name: MORIYA CORP
businessSummary: MORIYA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction business, civil engineering business and other related business. The Company operates through three business segments. Construction segment and Civil Engineering segment is involved in the construction business, civil engineering business and conducts contract business related to other general construction work. Real Estate segment is engaged in business related to real estate such as purchase, sale, rental and mediation of real estate. The Company is also engaged in the management of golf courses.

name: TSUGAMI CORP
businessSummary: TSUGAMI CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automatic lathes, grinders, machining centers, rolling machines. The Company operates through Japan, China, India, Korea and other region five geography segments. The Company is also engaged in the related research and other services. The products include CNC precision automatic lathes, including independent opposed gang tool type, opposed gang tool type, gang-tool slede & turret and chuck work; CNC lathes, including M08JL8-II, M06JC-II; turning centers, including TMA8J, TMA8H and TMA8F; machining centers, including vertical machining centers and horizontal machining centers; grinding machines, including CNC cylindrical grinding machines and small grinding machines; rolling machines, including CNC precision rolling machines and precision rolling machines.

name: FINANCIAL PARTNERS GROUP CO LTD
businessSummary: Financial Partners Group Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in fund and financial services business and aviation services business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Funds and Financial Services Business segment is engaged in leasing fund business, real estate fund business, insurance business, mergers and acquisitions (M&A) business, private equity business, trust business, securities business, real estate leasing business and others. The Aviation Services Business segment operates as an air transport operator and an aerial user operator, primarily engaged in passenger transportation and other businesses. The Company also operates private jet business through subsidiaries.

name: LOOK HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Look Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning, manufacture, import and sale of apparels and related products. The Company has seven segments. The Apparel Related segment includes four regional segments: Japan, South Korea, Europe, and Other Overseas. The Apparel Related segment is engaged in the planning, production and sale of apparels, the purchase and import of products, the sale of products through directly managed stores, department stores, shopping centers and electronic commerce, as well as the planning, production and sale of leather products in Japan, South Korea, Europe, Hong Kong, China and the United States. The Production And Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) segment is engaged in the OEM production and processing of apparel related products, and trading business. The Logistics segment is engaged in the inspection, shipment and storage of apparel products. The Restaurant segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of gelato products.

name: TOYODA GOSEI CO LTD
businessSummary: TOYODA GOSEI CO., LTD. is a company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of automobile parts and optoelectronic products. The Company operates in two business segments. The Automobile Parts segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of body sealing products, such as door weather strip and glass run; functionality parts, including functionality system components and fuel tank modules; interior and exterior parts, such as instrument panels and console boxes; safety system products, such as handles and air bag modules, as well as metal molds and machinery, among others. The Optoelectronic Product segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of high luminosity light-emitting diode lamp chip for liquid crystal backlights/ illumination light source.

name: TOKYO TEKKO CO LTD
businessSummary: TOKYO TEKKO CO., LTD. is mainly engaged in the steel business. The Company has two businesses. The iron and steel business is engaged in the manufacture and sale of small steel bars, mechanical joints of reinforcing bars and processed steel bars. The other business is engaged in the provision of freight transportation and equipment maintenance services, among others.

name: PARKER CORP
businessSummary: PARKER CORPORATION is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automobiles, steel, machinery and equipment, parts, materials and chemicals. The Company operates through five business segments. The Machinery segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of food machinery, shoemaking machinery, automotive equipment and other equipment. The Chemical Product segment provides sealing materials, undercoats, body weight reductions, hollow foam members as rigidity auxiliary materials, and glass sealing materials for automotive production lines. The Chemicals segment provides industrial cleaning agents and steel equipment. The Industrial Materials segment provides soundproofing materials for automobiles and home appliances. The Chemical Industry segment provides liquid crystal-related chemicals, car wash chemicals, other industrial chemicals and industrial hot air blowers. The other business is involved in petroleum-related products and real estate leasing business.

name: F.C.C. CO LTD
businessSummary: F.C.C. Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of two-wheeled vehicle clutches and four-wheeled vehicle clutches. The Company operates through two business segments. The Four-wheeler Clutch segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of clutch products for automatic vehicles and manual vehicles. The Two-wheeler Clutch segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of clutch products for motorcycles, scooters, all-terrain vehicles (ATVs) and general-purpose machine clutches, as well as other parts and components for two-wheeler and four-wheeler products.

name: METALART CORP
businessSummary: Metalart Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of precision die-forged products, and its products are mainly automobiles and construction machinery parts. The Company manufactures, processes and sells hot forged products and precision stamped and forged products used in automobiles, construction machinery, agricultural machinery, ships and other general industrial machinery. The Company provides parts shapes from forging to machining, centering on engine parts, suspension parts, transmission gears and other industrial parts.

name: AOKI HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: AOKI Holdings Inc. is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in the sale of fashion products. The Company operates in four business segments. The Fashion segment is engaged in the operation of chain stores for men's apparel, women's apparel and accessories under the names of AOKI and ORIHICA. The Anniversaire Bridal segment is engaged in the operation of a wedding hall under the name ANNIVERSAIRE OMOTESANDO. The Karaoke Room Operation segment is engaged in the operation of karaoke bars under the name COTE D'AZUR. The Complex Cafe segment is engaged in the operation of cafes under the name KAIKATSU-CLUB. The Company is also engaged in the leasing of real estate and non-life insurance agency business.

name: MATSUMOTO YUSHI-SEIYAKU CO LTD
businessSummary: MATSUMOTO YUSHI-SEIYAKU CO., LTD. is a Japan-based supplier of surfactants. The Company operates in two segments, including Japan and Indonesia. The surfactant business is primarily engaged in the production and sale of industrial surfactants for metals, can manufacturing and fiber uses. The others business is engaged in the production and sale of synthetic stabilizers and microspheres for fiber industry.

name: YAGI & CO LTD
businessSummary: YAGI & CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the trading, import and export of textile products. The Company operates business through raw material field, textile field and textile secondary products field. The Company is also engaged in the textile processing business, real estate business and other businesses.

name: WEDS CO LTD
businessSummary: WEDS CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the wholesale of automotive-related parts. The Company operates in four business segments. The Automobile-related Wholesale segment is engaged in the wholesale of automotive aftermarket parts including automotive wheels and car accessory parts and others to general markets. This segment also manufactures and sells three-piece aluminum wheels, through its subsidiaries. The Automobile-related Retail segment sells automotive aftermarket parts, such as automotive wheels, car accessory parts and others, to general consumers. The Welfare segment is engaged in the welfare business for the elders. The Others segment is engaged in the sale of mobile phones and the leasing of real estate. As of March 31, 2014, the Company had three subsidiaries, one associated company and one affiliated company.

name: MORY INDUSTRIES INC
businessSummary: MORY INDUSTRIES INC. is a company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of steel products. The Company operates in two business segments. The Japan segment is engaged in the manufactures and sells stainless tube, stainless bars, processed stainless products and steel tubes. The Indonesia segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of stainless tubes. The Company also sells automobile-related products and mail-order goods.

name: FUKUVI CHEMICAL INDUSTRY CO LTD
businessSummary: FUKUVI CHEMICAL INDUSTRY CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of synthetic resins and inorganic compounds. The Company has two business segments. The Construction Materials segment manufactures and sells glass fiber reinforced cement (GRC), windproof and permeable sheets, plastering materials, bus panels, interior base sheets, heat insulating materials, long cushions, system double floors, floor tiles, among others. The Industrial Materials segment manufactures and sells window frames, doors, furniture products, housing components, vehicle parts, furniture and precision chemical products, among others.

name: MURAKAMI CORP
businessSummary: Murakami Corp is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive rearview mirrors in Japan and overseas. The Company operates in three segments based on region. The Japan, Asia, and North America segments are engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive rearview mirrors and fine glass. The Company’s products include automotive rearview mirrors, hybrid inner mirrors that display rearward images captured by vehicle cameras on the rearview mirror, and concave and flat mirrors for head-up displays (HUD).

name: NEW COSMOS ELECTRIC CO LTD
businessSummary: NEW COSMOS ELECTRIC CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research, development, manufacturing and sales of gas sensors, the development, manufacturing and sales of gas alarms and detectors, as well as the maintenance of its products.

name: MANSEI CORP
businessSummary: MANSEI CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of electrical equipment and industrial systems, electronic devices and information communication equipment, and related services. The Company operates through four business segments. Electrical Equipment and Industrial System segment provides rotating machines, industrial fans, switches, watt-hour meters, transformers, indicators, generator and substation systems, measurement control systems, and other industrial mechatronic systems and equipment. Electronic Device and Information Communication Equipment segment provides semiconductors, optical equipment, liquid crystal panels, personal computers, printers, video equipment, embedded microcomputer software, and electronic manufacturing services. Equipment segment provides air conditioners, refrigerators, chillers, electric water heaters, lighting equipment, elevators, and related construction, maintenance, installation services. Photovoltaic segment provides power.

name: HOSHI IRYO-SANKI CO LTD
businessSummary: HOSHI IRYO-SANKI CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the medical gas business and household medical business. The Company operates in five business segments. The Medical Gas-related segment is engaged in the sale of medical oxygen gas, anesthesia gas and other general medical gases. The Household Medical-related segment is engaged in the rental and sale of oxygen generator for home use, equipment for continuous positive pressure respiratory therapy, home respirators and others. The Medical Gas Equipment Work-related segment is engaged in the design and construction of medical gas piping works, and the maintenance and inspection of medical gas plumbing facilities. The Nursing Welfare-related segment is engaged in the rental and sale of nursing welfare-related products, housing renovation, the operation of home-visit nursing and home care support offices, and related businesses. The Facility Care-related segment is engaged in the operation of pay nursing home and others.

name: EXEDY CORP
businessSummary: Exedy Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of manual and automatic transmission-related automobile components. The Company has two business segments. The Manual Transmission (MT) Related segment provides clutch discs, clutch covers and two-mass flywheels, among others. The Automatic Transmission (AT) Related segment provides torque converters and automatic transmissions parts. The others business provides motorcycle clutches, power shift transmissions and related parts, brakes, retarders and mechanical equipment, among others. This segment also provides transportation services.

name: NAGANO KEIKI CO LTD
businessSummary: Nagano Keiki Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of pressure gauges, pressure sensors, measurement and control equipment, die-casting, as well as related businesses and the manufacture and sale of application products. The Company has four business segments. The Pressure Gauge Business segment manufactures and sells pressure gauges, pressure switches, and thermometers. The Pressure Sensor Business segment manufactures and sells pressure sensors. The Measurement and Control Equipment Business segment manufactures and sells pneumatic equipment, air leak testers, pressure testers, pressure generators, and other application-developed products. The Die-Casting Business segment manufactures and sells die-cast products. The Company also operates real estate rental and automotive electrical equipment businesses.

name: SHINNIHON CORP
businessSummary: Shinnihon Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction business and development business. It operates in two segments. The Construction segment undertakes, plans, designs, and constructs architectural and civil engineering works, as well as architectural and civil engineering works using mainly precast and prestressed concrete members, earthquake-resistant reinforcement work using the out-frame construction method, and large-scale repair work for condominiums. The Development segment acquires land, constructs buildings, and sells them in lots or as a package. This segment also owns and rents office buildings, manages condominiums and buildings, and owns and rents Shin-Nihon building and apartment complexes.

name: DOSHISHA CO LTD
businessSummary: Doshisha Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the wholesale of lifestyle-related products. It operates through two business segments. The Development Type Business Model segment sells uniform products such as audio and video (A&V) related products, home appliances and household goods, storage related products, clothing, food and alcoholic beverages. The Wholesale Type Business Model segment sells watches, bags, and assorted gifts. It also engages in real estate, licensing, logistics, nursing care and welfare services, trading, and professional services.

name: IMAMURA SECURITIES CO LTD
businessSummary: Imamura Securities Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the investment and financial services business with financial instruments trading business as its core business and provides a wide range of services to its customers in both financing and asset management. The principal business is trading of securities, market derivatives transactions or foreign market derivatives transactions, intermediary, agency or agent for trading of securities, intermediary, agency or agent for brokerage of trading of securities in the exchange-traded financial instruments market, underwriting of securities, offering of securities or private placement of securities, the underwriting of securities, the offering or secondary offering of securities and the handling of the offering or secondary offering of securities, or the handling of private placements of securities. The Company is also engaged in businesses incidental to the financial instruments business, gold bullion trading, insurance sale.

name: MITANI CORP
businessSummary: MITANI CORPORATION is a Japan-based manufacturing company. The Company operates in three business segments. The Information Systems-related segment is engaged in the sale of information systems equipment, the development of software, as well as the maintenance of equipment and devices. The Corporate Supply-related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of construction materials, petroleum products and liquefied petroleum (LP) gas products, the manufacture and sale of gondola machinery, wind power generation business, sales and processing of plastic products, processing and sales of spices, as well as the rental business. The Lifestyle and Regional Services-related segment is engaged in the provision of information communications services such as cable television and Internet provider services, the operation of nursing homes, car dealerships, the production and sales of ready-mixed concrete, gas station operations, sales of LP gas and housing equipment, among others.

name: KIKUKAWA ENTERPRISE INC
businessSummary: KIKUKAWA ENTERPRISE, INC. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of woodworking machineries and machine tools. The woodworking machineries include machines which can process logs into square timbers, plates and small split materials, and machines which can secondary process timbers, plates, small split materials, plywood and fiberboards into products. The machine tools refer to machines processing irons, non-ferrous metals and other new materials.

name: KAMEI CORP
businessSummary: Kamei Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the energy business, food business and others. The Company has seven business segments. Energy segment distributes gasoline, kerosene, light oil, heavy oil, liquefied petroleum gas, light-emitting diodes (LEDs) and others. Food segment distributes agricultural and marine products, livestock products, beer and wine products, and operates supermarkets, and provides confectionery. Construction Related segment distributes housing appliances and equipment and operates renovation business. Automobile segment distributes domestic and imported cars and operates car leasing. Overseas and Trade business segment exports tires, bearings and tanker planes, and imports and sells seafood, apparel products, beer and wine. Pet segment sells pet food, pet supplies and gardening supplies. Pharmacy segment operates dispensaries and distributes drugs. It also provides information equipment and office supplies, property leasing, insurance agency service.

name: MEISEI INDUSTRIAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Meisei Industrial Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the construction business, mainly focusing on thermal insulation work, and the boiler business. The Company has two business segments. The Construction Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and construction of materials, both domestically and overseas, including thermal insulation work, building material construction (clean rooms), and refrigeration and low-temperature equipment construction. The Boiler Business segment is engaged in the manufacture, construction, sale, and installation of boilers and industrial machinery and equipment both domestically and overseas.

name: KYOWAKOGYOSYO CO LTD
businessSummary: KYOWAKOGYOSYO CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of bolts for construction machinery. The Company manufactures hexagon bolts, hexagon socket head bolts and special bolts, and sells products to the industries of construction machinery, automobile related and industrial machinery. It has four departments. The construction machinery division manufactures hexagon bolts, shoe bolts and nuts, hexagon socket head bolts, flathead bolts, special bolts, and swing machinery shafts. The automobile-related department manufactures forged products, including transmission input shafts, continuously variable transmission shafts, hollow parts, pinion shafts. The industrial machinery division manufactures JIS standard (JIS B 1180) hexagon bolts and JIS standard (JIS B 1176) hexagon socket head bolts. The other division manufactures special bolts for internal combustion engines of ships and generators, and for large scale buildings such as gymnasiums and stadiums.

name: KANAMOTO CO LTD
businessSummary: Kanamoto Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction-related business. The construction-related business rents and sells construction machinery and temporary construction materials. It provides construction machinery such as hydraulic excavators and dump trucks, temporary materials and houses, generators, and various hand tools. It is also engaged in the steel-related business, which sells steel products and other construction materials, the information-related business, which rents and sells computers and peripheral devices such as workstations and personal computer (PC) servers, and the welfare-related business, which rents and sells nursing care products.

name: NIPPON INFORMATION DEVELOPMENT CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Information Development Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the embedded solution business, information and communication technology (ICT) innovation business, financial system business, network solution business and other businesses. The Company operates in five business segments. The Embedded Solutions segment is engaged in the development and design of embedded software to customers. The ICT Innovation Business is engaged in the design and development of communication systems for customers. The Financial Systems segment provides financial business software to customers in the fields of life and non-life insurance, credit and securities, information and services. The Network Solution segment provides services such as system construction, infrastructure construction, security services, system maintenance and operation. The Others segment is involved in three businesses including data solutions business, product business and staffing business.

name: ZETT CORP
businessSummary: ZETT CORPORATION is principally engaged in the manufacture, wholesale and retail of sports products, as well as the provision of related services. Along with its subsidiaries, the Company operates Sport Business segment, which has four business divisions. The Wholesale division is engaged in the wholesale of sports equipment. It purchases products from approximately 300 companies and sells the products to retailers and mass merchandisers nationwide, the segment also sells baseball products in China. The Manufacturing division designs and develops baseball products and sports wears, it also designs, manufactures and sells health supplies. The Retail division sells products through directly-managed stores to general customers. The Others division provides logistic services to the Wholesale and Manufacturing divisions, and operates sports facilities.

name: GODO STEEL LTD
businessSummary: Godo Steel Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the steel business and agricultural materials business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Steel Business segment manufactures and sells wire rods, various large and medium-sized steel sections, rails, structural steel bars, reinforcing steel bars, processed steel bar products, processed wire rod products, threaded reinforcing bars, and sells machinery and steelmaking raw materials. The Agricultural Materials Business segment manufactures and sells organic fertilizers and chemical fertilizers. The Company is also engaged in crushed stone and crushed sand business.

name: KAWADA TECHNOLOGIES INC
businessSummary: KAWADA TECHNOLOGIES, INC. is a company engaged in the construction-related business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Steel Structure segment designs, manufactures and builds steel bridges and constructional steel frames. The Civil Engineering and Construction segment is involved in the design, manufacture and building of pre-stressed concrete (PC) bridges and pre-beam bridges, as well as the maintenance of bridges. The Construction segment is engaged in the design and subcontract of construction works. The Others segment is involved in the development, manufacture and sale of next-generation industrial robots, development and sale of software, the sale of system equipment, the architectural analysis, design and drawing of bridges, the sale of bridge accessories, the aircraft business, as well as the subcontract, planning, design, supervision and consulting of construction works.

name: KYORITSU ELECTRIC CORP
businessSummary: Kyoritsu Electric Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the intelligent factory automation (FA) system business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Intelligent FA System segment is engaged in the development, design, manufacture and sale of intelligent FA systems, equipment and other products for manufacturing research and development and production sites. The Information Technology (IT) Control and Scientific Measurement segment is engaged in the sale of FA equipment, IT equipment, control equipment, scientific analyzers, measuring instruments industrial equipment and others. The Company is also engaged in the leasing of real estate properties, and other business.

name: TOKYO STEEL MANUFACTURING CO LTD
businessSummary: Tokyo Steel Manufacturing Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacturing and sales of steel products. The Company’s products are divided into two categories: building materials and steel plate products. Building materials products include H-beams, high-standard electric furnace H-beams, special-sized H-beams, U-shaped steel sheet piles, I-beams, striped H-beams, channel steel, and deformed steel bars, which are steel materials mainly used in construction work. Steel plate products mainly include hot coils, pickled coils, hot-dip galvanized coils, striped coils, cut sheets, thick plates, and high-standard electric furnace steel plates.

name: MARUZEN CO LTD
businessSummary: MARUZEN CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of commercial kitchen equipment. The Company operates through three business segments. The Commercial Kitchen Equipment Manufacturing and Sales segment manufactures, purchases and sells commercial kitchen equipment. The Bakery Equipment Manufacturing and Sales segment manufactures, sells and maintains bakery equipment such as bakery factories. The Building Leasing segment leases buildings such as business hotels and nursing care-type nursing homes.

name: TANAKEN INC
businessSummary: Tanaken Inc, formerly Tanaken, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in demolition work of the building structure and supervision of various constructions incidental thereto. The Company provides overall business, including current situation survey, proposal of construction method, design, construction plan, neighbor correspondence and others. The Company also provides supervise construction work related to building construction demolition work, mountain work, basic demolition work and pile removal work. It proposes and provides various dismantling works in cost, construction term and safety concerning removal of harmful pollutants such as polychlorinated biphenyl (PCB), groundwater purification and soil improvement. The Company carries out work supervision, safety control, neighbor communication, guides and supervises cooperative companies, and carries out demolition work.

name: TERASAKI ELECTRIC CO LTD
businessSummary: TERASAKI ELECTRIC CO., LTD. is a company engaged in the manufacture and sale of marine and industrial systems, as well as electrical equipment. The Company operates in two business segments. The System segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of power distribution systems, monitoring and controlling systems, group starter panels, cogeneration systems and medical equipment, as well as the provision of maintenance and after services and engineering services for its products. The Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of low voltage breakers, such as air circuit breakers, electrical circuit breakers and leakage circuit breakers.

name: SHIKOKU BANK LTD
businessSummary: Shikoku Bank Ltd is a Japan-based regional bank mainly engaged in the banking business, leasing business and other financial businesses. The Banking business is engaged in the banking agency business and credit guarantee business. The Leasing business is involved in the leasing business. The others business is engaged in the computer-related business, the investigation and research related to industry, economics and finance, as well as the management and operation of investment business partnership assets.

name: KU HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: KU HOLDINGS CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale and maintenance of automobiles. The Company operates through two business segments. The Domestic Car Sales segment is engaged in the sale and maintenance of domestic and imported used cars. The Imported Car Dealer segment is engaged in the car’s sale and maintenance of Mercedes-Benz, BMW, MINI, Chrysler, GM, Volkswagen and Harley Davidson. The Company is also engaged in the provision of non-life insurance agency services.

name: KYOEI STEEL LTD
businessSummary: Kyoei Steel Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in domestic steel business, overseas steel business and environmental recycling business. The Company has three business segments. The Domestic Steel segment manufactures and sells steel products mainly for domestic civil engineering and construction steel products. The products include deformed steel bars, flat steel and I-shaped steel. The Segment also trades and transports steel products. The Overseas Steel segment manufactures and sells steel products mainly for overseas civil engineering, construction and ore-crushing steel products. The products include deformed steel bars, threaded bars and wire rods. The Environmental Recycling segment operates intermediate and final treatment of medical and industrial waste and engages in the reclaimed stone business. The Company is also engaged in port business, foundry business, civil engineering material sales business and insurance agency business.

name: TOUBUJYUHAN CO LTD
businessSummary: Toubujyuhan Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in real estate related business. The Company provide used real estate for reformed detached houses. It has four business segments. The Real Estate Trading segment involves in the sale of properties owned by the Company, and the brokerage sale of properties owned by others. The Real Estate Rental segment involves in the brokerage sale and rental management business of properties owned by other companies, as well as the sale of properties owned by the Company. The Real Estate-related segment involves in the contracting of remodeling of properties, agency sale of insurance such as fire insurance, as well as real estate-related goods sale through Internet. The Others segment involves in the sale of welfare related goods, the provision of equipment rental, silver renovation construction contracting and others.

name: INABATA & CO LTD
businessSummary: Inabata & Co Ltd is mainly engaged in the sale and manufacture of products in the fields of information and electronics, chemicals, consumer goods, synthetic resins, and other fields. The Company's main businesses are the buying and selling of goods, manufacturing and selling of products, and provision of services. It also develops domestic and overseas strategies. It operates in four segments. The Information and Electronics segment sells semiconductors and liquid crystal materials, machinery and equipment, dyes and pigments for copiers and printers, and materials. The Chemicals segment sells raw materials for automotive parts, resins and rubber, paints, inks and adhesives, papermaking chemicals, dyes and dyeing and weaving materials, wood and laminated lumber. The Consumer Goods segment sells pharmaceutical and agrochemical ingredients, fine chemicals, insecticides and toiletry ingredients. The Synthetic Resins segment sells general-purpose resins, engineering plastics and others.

name: NSW INC
businessSummary: NSW Inc, formerly Nippon Systemware Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in providing information technology (IT) solutions, service solutions and product solutions. The Company operates through three segments. The IT Solution segment consists of the business solutions business, the financial and public solutions business, and the system equipment sales business. The Service Solution segment consists of the digital solution business and the cloud/infrastructure service business. The Product Solution segment consists of the embedded development business and device development business.

name: TACHIBANA ELETECH CO LTD
businessSummary: TACHIBANA ELETECH CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of the factory automation (FA) equipment, industrial machinery, industrial devices, semiconductor and electronic devices and equipment, as well as the provision of maintenance and service for related business. The Company operates through three business segments. FA System segment offers programmable controllers, inverters, and electrical discharge machines. Semiconductor Device segment provides semiconductors and electric devices. Information Communication segment provides radiofrequency identification (RFID) system, surveillance cameras and thin clients. Facility segment provides air-conditioning equipment, solar power generation systems, all-electric appliances, room air conditioners, elevators, among others. The Company is also involved in the support for customers with contract manufacturing of electronic equipment (EMS) and contract manufacturing of metal processing (MMS).

name: ENDO LIGHTING CORP
businessSummary: ENDO Lighting Corporation is a Japan-based company engaged in the lighting equipment-related business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Lighting Equipment-related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of various lighting equipment. The Environment-related segment is involved in the sale of energy saving products, as well as the rental of lighting equipment and energy saving products. The Interior Furniture segment is engaged in the sales of interior furniture and supplies.

name: ONAMBA CO LTD
businessSummary: Onamba Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of electric wires and cables, wire harnesses, solar power generation-related products and harness processing machines and parts. The Company operates in three regional segments including Japan segment, Europe and the United States segment, and Asia (excluding Japan) segment. The Company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of components used for consumer electronic equipment, information office equipment and industrial electronic equipment, as well as general-purpose electric wires and communication cables. The main products include solar power generation wiring units, special cables, vinyl wires, eco wires, harness products and wires for various devices.

name: RHEON AUTOMATIC MACHINERY CO LTD
businessSummary: Rheon Automatic Machinery Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of food processing machinery, as well as other food manufacturing and sales businesses. Food processing machinery manufacture and sale business operates through Japan, North and South America, Europe and Asia regional segments. It develops, manufactures and sells food forming machines and bread making lines, as well as provides repairs services and purchased products (ovens, mixers, packaging machines). Food manufacture and sale business operates through North and South America and Japan regional segments and engages in the manufacture and sale of highly processed frozen foods such as croissants, Danish pastries, pies, cookies, and frozen roll-in dough and natural yeast bread starters. Food forming machines include universal automatic packaging machines, Cornucopia, Robot EP and others. Bread making lines include the Stress Free V4 System, Stress Free VM System and others.

name: NIRECO CORP
businessSummary: NIRECO CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of facility equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The Process segment offers process control equipment, automatic identification printing equipment, edge position control equipment for metal, level gauges for vortex molten steel and wide board gauges, among others. The Web segment provides edge position control equipment for printing and films, tension control equipment, registration control equipment and starch equipment. The Inspection Equipment segment offers plain inspection equipment, image processing and analyzing equipment, near-infrared analyzing system and fruit sorting equipment, among others. As of March 31, 2014, the Company had three subsidiaries.

name: KANEMATSU CORP
businessSummary: Kanematsu Corp is a Japan-based trading company. The Company operates in five segments. The Information and Communication Technology (ICT) Solutions segment provides infrastructure design, construction, and operation services, system consulting and others. The Electronics and Devices segment provides electronic parts and materials, semiconductors and liquid crystal manufacturing equipment and others. The Food segment provides frozen, dried, and canned fruits, frozen vegetables, coffee, sesame seeds, chia seeds, nuts, peanuts and others. The Steel, Materials, and Plants segment provides various steel plates, steel bars and wire rods, steel pipes, stainless steel products, general steel materials and others. The Vehicle and Aerospace segment provides automotive parts and mechanical parts, aircraft and aircraft parts, helicopters and helicopter parts and others. The Company also provides medium-density fiberboards, non-ferrous metals, insurance agents and brokerage and others.

name: HIMACS LTD
businessSummary: HIMACS, Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of value solution services. The Company mainly provides value-added solutions for computer and software systems. The Company provides two types of services. The system solution service is engaged in the provision of consulting services, the design, development, testing and implementation of operation systems. The system maintenance service is engaged in the provision of maintenance services for systems after operation.

name: MEIWA CORP
businessSummary: Meiwa Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the chemical-related businesses. It operates through four business segments. The First Business segment engages in the resources and environment business, flame retardants business and functional building materials business, providing rare earths and rare metals, environmental-related products, metal-related products, flame retardants, insulation materials and others. The Second Business segment engages in the petroleum products business, providing lubricants, base oils and additives. The Third Business segment engages in the high-performance materials business, functional chemicals business, synthetic resins business, and inorganic chemicals business, providing film products, printing raw materials, papermaking chemical raw materials, adhesive raw materials and others. The Automotive and Battery Materials Business segment engages in the automotive and battery materials businesses, providing automotive parts and battery materials.

name: ITOCHU ENEX CO LTD
businessSummary: Itochu Enex Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in home-life business, car-life business, industrial business, and power and utility business. The Company operates through four segments. The Home Life Business segment is engaged in the sale and provision of services of liquefied petroleum (LP) gas, kerosene, electric power, life-related equipment and smart energy equipment. The Car Life Business segment is engaged in the sale and provision of services of gasoline, kerosene, light oil, electric power, and automobiles. The Industrial Business segment is engaged in the sale and provision of services of gasoline, kerosene, light oil, heavy oil, LP gas, and gas-to-liquid (GTL) fuel, the import and export of petroleum products, and the lease of terminal tanks. The Power & Utility Business segment is engaged in electric power generation, steam, district heating service, comprehensive energy service, electric heat supply service, asset management, and rental car business.

name: TENOX CORP
businessSummary: TENOX CORPORATION is mainly engaged in the construction works, as well as the sale of construction materials. The Company operates in two business segments. The Construction segment is engaged in the construction business and the leasing of construction machinery. The Civil Engineering and Construction Consulting and Others segment is engaged in the provision of consultation services for civil engineering and construction, as well as brokerage services for construction properties. As of March 31, 2014, the Company had four consolidated subsidiaries.

name: RASA CORP
businessSummary: Rasa Corporation is mainly engaged in resource and metallic materials related business. The Company operates in six business segments. The Resources and Metallic Materials-related segment imports, exports and sells mineral products, mainly including zircon sand, and other goods. The Industrial and Construction Equipment-related segment engages in sale and maintenance of delivery equipment, and sale, rental and maintenance of shield tunneling machines and other construction machines. The Environment Facilities-related segment imports and sells high-pressure pumps. The Plant and Equipment Construction-related segment engages in design, construction and maintenance work related to plant and related equipment construction in various fields. The Chemical-related Products segment involves in the production and sale of plastics and chemicals. The Real Estate Rental-related segment leases real estate properties.

name: APPLIED CO LTD
businessSummary: Applied Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of personal computers (PCs). The Company operates in three business segments. The PC and Game segment is mainly involved in the sale of PCs and games; provision of support services and field services for PCs, as well as contract development of software. The Cosmetics and Sundries segment is involved in the retail of cosmetics and sundries. The Publication and Advertising segment is involved in the publication of information magazines and planning books, and the proposal of the whole advertisement and promotion services for companies.

name: TRANSCOSMOS INC
businessSummary: transcosmos Inc is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the provision of one-stop, high-value-added services both domestically and overseas. The Company has three business segments. The Individual Services Business segment is responsible for the outsourcing business developed by the Company itself. The Domestic Affiliated Companies Business segment is responsible for the outsourcing business developed by domestic group companies. The Overseas Affiliated Companies Business segment is responsible for the outsourcing business developed by overseas group companies.

name: KOYOU RENTIA CO LTD
businessSummary: KOYOU RENTIA Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the rental business, space design business and product sales business. The Company has three business segments. The Rental Related segment is engaged in the rental of furniture, fixtures and equipment (FF&E) and office automation (OA) equipment for construction site offices, events and corporations, as well as the provision of solar power generation systems rental services, information and communication technology ( ICT) environmental maintenance work and interior work, office relocation services and real estate brokerage services, and the storage, maintenance, delivery and sale of rental products. The Space Design segment is engaged in the rental of furniture for condominium galleries, the design and construction of condominium galleries, the interior modification work and condominium renovation work. The Product Sales segment is engaged in the sale of office furniture and equipment to government agencies.

name: RS TECHNOLOGIES CO LTD
businessSummary: RS Technologies Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the silicon wafer reclamation business. It operates through three business segments. The Wafer Reclamation segment reclaims, processes, and sells semiconductor silicon wafers, as well as provides oxide film deposition processing services. The Prime Silicon Wafer Manufacturing and Sales segment manufactures and sells prime silicon wafers, as well as new monitor wafers, dummy wafers, and silicon ingots. The Semiconductor-Related Equipment and Materials segment sells semiconductor-related equipment and consumables, manufactures and sells storage battery electrolytes, and manufactures and sells in-vehicle camera modules. It also engages in solar power generation business and technical consulting business.

name: SOKEN CHEMICAL & ENGINEERING CO LTD
businessSummary: Soken Chemical & Engineering Co., Ltd. is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemicals, the sale of devices and systems, as well as the provision of engineering services for manufacturing systems. The Company operates in two business divisions. The Chemicals division is engaged in the manufacture and sale of adhesives, fine particles, special performance materials and processed products. The Device System division is involved in the sale of devices and systems, the engineering of manufacturing systems, the provision of maintenance services for plants, and the import and sale of heating medium oil. As of March 31, 2014, the Company had nine consolidated subsidiaries and one associated company.

name: RICOH CO LTD
businessSummary: Ricoh Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, production, sales, and service activities for digital services, digital products, graphic communications, industrial solutions, and others. The Company has five business segments. Digital Services segment sells imaging equipment such as office multifunction devices and printers and provides information technology (IT)-related solutions. Digital Products segment is involved in the development and production of imaging equipment such as office multifunction devices and printers, and edge devices that support digital communication. Graphic Communications segment includes the commercial printing business and the industrial printing business. Industrial Solutions segment consists of the thermal business and the industrial products business. Industrial Products segment provides precision equipment parts. The Other segment is engaged in the digital cameras, 360-degree cameras, environment and healthcare business.

name: EIWA CORP
businessSummary: Eiwa Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial measurement and control equipment, environment monitoring and analytical equipment, measuring and testing equipment, and industrial machinery. Industrial instruments include level measurement equipment, pressure measurement equipment, temperature measurement equipment and distance measurement equipment. Environment monitoring and analytical equipment includes gas analysis and measurement equipment, meteorological and sea condition measurement equipment, water quality, concentration and viscosity measurement equipment. Inspection and measurement equipment includes pressure measurement equipment, material measurement equipment, and non-destructive inspection equipment. Industrial equipment includes security equipment, environment improvement equipment, air conditioning equipment and others.

name: FUJITA ENGINEERING CO LTD
businessSummary: FUJITA ENGINEERING CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction of comprehensive facilities, including the creation and maintenance of area space for construction equipment, industrial equipment and environmental equipment. The company operates through four business segments. The Construction segment includes building equipment, industrial equipment and environmental equipment. The Equipment Sales and Information Systems segment sells equipment, installs and sells information and communication equipment and develops and sells software. The Equipment Maintenance segment includes repair, maintenance, installation of air conditioning equipment and installation of housing equipment. The Electronic Component Manufacturing segment is involved in the inspection, classification, assembly and equipment manufacturing of electronic components. The Company is also involved in the water supply facility management contract business.

name: WESCO HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Wesco Holdings Inc. is a Japan-based holding company primarily engaged in general construction consulting business. The Company operates through five business segments. The General Construction Consulting segment involves in the provision of construction consulting, construction design, compensation consultant, environmental assessment, general survey, aerial survey and geological survey services. The Copy Bookbinding segment involves in the positive image printing, copy drawing, printing and bookbinding. The Real Estate segment involves in the subdivision and rental of real estate, as well as housing sales. The Sporting Facilities Operation segment involves in the operation of sporting facilities and related facilities. The Designated Management segment involves in the management of Suma Aqualife Park.

name: MARUFUJI SHEET PILING CO LTD
businessSummary: MARUFUJI SHEET PILING CO., LTD. is a Japan-based manufacturer of construction materials. The Company is principally involved in the sale, leasing, process and transportation of steel sheet piles, H-section steel, earth retaining steel materials, lining boards, temporary system bridges, reinforced soil wall materials and processed iron frames for buildings, as well as the related construction works. The Company has three business divisions. The Sales division is engaged in the purchase and sale of materials. The Factory division specializes in the storage of leased materials, as well as the provision of repair, maintenance, manufacture and processing services. The Transportation division provides product transportation services.

name: SEIKO EPSON CORP
businessSummary: Seiko Epson Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the printing solutions business, visual communication business, as well as wearable and industrial products business. The Company has three business segments. The Printing Solutions Business segment includes office and home inkjet printers, serial impact dot matrix printers, page printers, color image scanners, dry office paper machines, and commercial and industrial inkjet printers, inkjet print heads and other products. The Visual Communications Business segment provides products such as liquid crystal projectors and smart glasses. The Manufacturing and Wearables Business segment provides products such as industrial robots, small injection molding machines, watches, watch movements, quartz devices, semiconductors, metal powders, and surface treatment processing.

name: TAIHEI MACHINERY WORKS LTD
businessSummary: Taihei Machinery Works, Limited is a Japan-based manufacturing company. The Company operates in three business segments. The Plywood Machinery segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of plywood machinery including Veneer lace, dryer, hot press and others. The Woodworking Machinery segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of woodworking machinery including gang ripper, chipper, finger jointer and others. The Housing Materials segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of housing construction materials for two-by-four housing. The main products also include knife polishing machine, reeling device, log hole conveyor, log charger, veneer lace, finger joint system, moulder, mighty chipper and veneer chipper.

name: BSN MEDIA HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: BSN Media Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the broadcasting business and general broadcasting business. The Company is engaged in the planning, production, and sales of broadcast programs. The Company is engaged in the planning, production, sales, and entertainment of various events including art, music, sports, movies, theater, performing arts, and science. The Company is also engaged in the planning, publishing, and sales of publications.

name: BUSINESS BRAIN SHOWA-OTA INC
businessSummary: Business Brain Showa-Ota Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the consultation and development of business system. The Company operates through two business segments. Consulting and System Development segment is involved in the provision of consultation for accounting system and its peripheral system, system development and establishment, system development for financial institutions, among others. Management Service (BPO) segment is involved in the outsourcing of personnel, salary, labor, accounting and finance, system management, the dispatch of information technology (IT) engineers, medical office workers and others, as well as the provision of system support for insurance agencies of non-life insurance companies and system support for financial institutions.

name: JAPANIACE CO LTD
businessSummary: Japaniace Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of advanced engineering business that provides on-site development support and contract development. The Company participates in projects in four fields, such as software, infrastructure, mechatronics, and electronics. The Company is engaged in the provision of technology for projects in new areas such as artificial intelligence (AI), cloud, and next generation communications. Contracts with client companies are mainly dispatch contracts, but also partial contract contracts and quasi-delegation contracts. Business areas include software, infrastructure, mechatronics, electronics, and AI.

name: KAWASAKI KISEN KAISHA LTD
businessSummary: Kawasaki Kisen Kaisha Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the marine transportation business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Dry Bulk segment is engaged in the dry bulk transportation business. The Energy Resource segment is engaged in liquefied natural gas carrier business, electric power business, oil tanker business, and offshore business. The Product Logistics segment is engaged in the car carrier business, the logistics business, the near sea and inland shipping business, and the container ship business. The Company is also engaged in the ship management business, the travel agency business, as well as the real estate leasing and management business.

name: FUJI SEAL INTERNATIONAL INC
businessSummary: FUJI SEAL INTERNATIONAL, INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning, proposing, developing, manufacturing and sales of packaging systems centered on shrink sleeve labels, self-adhesive labels (pressure sensitive labels) and spouted pouches. The Company operates in five segments: Japan segment, the Americas segment, Europe segment, PAGO segment and Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) segment. The Company is engaged in the manufacturing and sales of packaging products, packaging machinery and related machinery as well as providing maintenance services. The Company’s products are used in food, beverages, dairy, home and personal care and pharmaceutical products, etc.

name: E J HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: E J Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of a general construction consulting business. The Company is engaged in the provision of a comprehensive construction consulting business that can provide an integrated service from planning to construction supervision for public works projects of government offices. The general construction consulting business includes construction consulting services such as planning, design, diagnosis, management, client support, and compensation consulting, as well as survey services such as surveying and geological surveys.

name: NATOCO CO LTD
businessSummary: NATOCO CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of paints, fine chemical products and thinners. The Company operates through three business segments. The Paint segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of synthetic resin paints and paint-related products. The Fine Chemicals segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of highly functional resins and various functional fine particles. The Thinner segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of pure and recycled thinners, as well as the collection, transportation and disposal of industrial waste.

name: HOKURIKU ELECTRICAL CONSTRUCTION CO LTD
businessSummary: HOKURIKU ELECTRICAL CONSTRUCTION CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the equipment construction business. The Company provides two kinds of services. The electric power facility construction work is engaged in the electrical construction related to power supply facilities such as power distribution facilities. The electrical and air-conditioning pipe work is engaged in the power equipment work, telecommunication work, pipe work, water supply work, fire-fighting work, and civil engineering work. The Company is also engaged in the rental of real estate.

name: AINAVO HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: AINAVO HOLDINGS Co., Ltd., is a Japan-based company involved in the large-sized property business and the detached house business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Detached House segment is engaged in the sale and construction of various tile products such as interior and exterior tiles, floor tiles, exteriors and other related products, and housing related products such as bathtubs, water heaters, system kitchens, sanitary equipment, solar power generation systems and other products. The Large-sized Property segment is engaged in the interior tile, exterior tile and floor tile construction works, the housing equipment construction works such as unit baths, system kitchens, bathtubs and others, the large ceramic tile works made of stones and dry methods, and the air conditioning and sanitary equipment works.

name: DAYTONA CORP
businessSummary: DAYTONA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning, development, manufacture and sales of motorcycle parts and accessories. The Company operates in three business segments. The Domestic Wholesale segment is engaged in the planning, development, manufacture and wholesale of motorcycle parts and accessories in Japan and overseas markets. The Asia Wholesale segment is engaged in the planning, development, manufacture and wholesale of motorcycle parts and accessories, mainly in Southeast Asia areas. The Retail segment is engaged in purchase of motorcycle after parts and supplies, as well as sales to end user. The other business is engaged in the solar power generation business.

name: OILES CORP
businessSummary: OILES CORPORATION is primarily engaged in the bearing equipment business. It has four business segments. The Bearing Equipment segment is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of oilless bearings and others. The Structural Equipment segment is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of support, seismic isolation and vibration suppression equipment, among others. The Construction Equipment segment is involved in the development, manufacture, sale, construction and maintenance of window operators, environmental equipment, and household equipment, among others. The Others segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of conduction equipment and others.

name: RYODEN CORP
businessSummary: Ryoden Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the purchase and sale of factory automation (FA) system products, refrigeration building system products, information and communication technology (ICT) system products, and electronics products, and the provision of services incidental to each business, as well as insurance agency business. The Company operates through four segments. The FA System business segment provides servo systems, inverters, and numerical control (NC) devices. The Refrigeration Building System business segment provides packaged air conditioners, chilling units, refrigerators and elevators. The ICT System business segment provides video and image information systems, medical facilities, and plant factory systems. The Electronics business segment provides memories, microcomputers, power devices, materials, and fabricated materials.

name: MINO CERAMIC CO LTD
businessSummary: MINO CERAMIC CO., LTD. is a Japan-based manufacturing company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial refractory products, the design and construction of plants and the sale of flooring and paving materials. The Company operates in four business segments. The Refractory segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of bricks, irregular refractory products and others, as well as the production of ceramic products. The Plant segment is engaged in the design and construction of industrial kilns and automated systems. The Construction and Paving Materials segment is engaged in the construction and sale of construction materials, as well as the manufacture and provision of paving materials and processed products. The Real Estate Leasing segment leases offices. The Company is also engaged in the sale of outsourced goods.

name: TSUBAKIMOTO KOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Tsubakimoto Kogyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the sale of machine parts, automation and labor-saving equipment and industrial materials. The Company has four business segments. East Japan Headquarters segment covers Hokkaido, Tohoku, Koshinetsu and Kanto. West Japan Headquarters segment covers Hokuriku, Kansai, Chugoku, Shikoku and Kyushu. Central Japan Headquarters segment covers the Tokai. The three segments handle products including power transmission components and equipment systems. Power transmission components include drive parts including speed reducers, conveyor chains, conveying parts, control devices, sensors, electronic equipment and others. Equipment systems include clean energy-related facilities, pharmaceutical-related equipment, chemical machinery, water treatment systems, food machinery, environmental equipment, machine tools, industrial robots, conveyors and others. Development Strategy Headquarters segment handles industrial materials and new products.

name: CHUGOKUKOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: CHUGOKUKOGYO CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of high-pressure gas containers, liquefied petroleum (LP) gas storage tanks and equipment, steel structure equipment products and facility equipment products. The Company operates through four business segments. The High-Pressure Equipment segment manufactures and sells high-pressure gas containers, LP gas equipment, LP gas storage tanks and other high-pressure gas storage tanks, as well as designs and constructs high-pressure gas-related equipment. The Steel Structure Equipment segment manufactures and sells inner covers and other various steel structure products for steel manufacturers. The Facility Equipment segment manufactures and sells feed tanks and containers, wastewater treatment equipment, livestock machinery, chemical tanks, deodorizers and various other reinforced plastic (FRP) products. The Transportation segment includes general area freight forwarding, moving and warehousing.

name: EIDAI KAKO CO LTD
businessSummary: EIDAI KAKO CO., LTD. is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of various synthetic resin molded products. The Company operates in two business segments. The Automobile Supplies-related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive floor mats. The Industrial Material-related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of air conducts, components and materials for household refrigerators, business desks, plastic bamboo panels, residential interior materials, bath lids, magazine sticks and terminal covers, as well as the sale of industrial materials including stands for drying machines and office chairs.

name: HARD OFF CORPORATION CO LTD
businessSummary: Hard Off Corporation Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the purchase and sale of reused goods. It operates through two segments. The Reuse segment operates the reuse shops Hard Off, Off House, Mode Off, Garage Off, Hobby Off, Liquor Off, and Book Off (Franchisee). Hard Off buys and sells computers, audio and visual equipment, musical instruments, and watches. Off House buys and sells brand-name products, furniture, and interior goods. Mode Off buys and sells women's and men's clothing, and bags. Garage Off buys and sells audio equipment, tires, dress-up products, and other automotive accessories. Hobby Off buys and sells trading cards and games. Liquor Off buys and sells alcoholic beverages, and glasses. Book Off buys and sells books, and compact discs (CDs). The Franchise (FC) segment operates the franchise chain business of the reuse shops Hard Off, Off House, Mode Off, Garage Off, Hobby Off, and Liquor Off. The Company is also engaged in systems development business.

name: KEIHIN CO LTD
businessSummary: THE KEIHIN CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of logistics business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Domestic Logistics segment is engaged in the warehousing storage business, warehouse cargo handling business, distribution and processing business, land transportation business, home delivery business and marine container transportation business, as well as the development of logistics system software, and the information processing business. The International Logistics segment is engaged in the international and air transportation business, customs clearance business, marine port operation business, and the ship agency business.

name: BUNKA SHUTTER CO LTD
businessSummary: Bunka Shutter Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of shutters, and housing and building materials. The Company operates in four business segments. The Shutter-related Products segment offers lightweight shutters, heavy shutters, over-sliding doors, panel shutters and window shutters. The Construction Material-related Products segment offers exterior products, cross-cut weatherboardings, doors, partitions and other related products. The Service segment is engaged in maintenance and repair of existing shutters and building materials. The Reform segment is engaged in the renovation of housing.

name: O-WELL CORP
businessSummary: O-WELL CORPORATION is engaged in the sales of products related to Paint Related business segment and Electrical and Electronic Parts business segment. The Company supplies various products and services related to paints and electric and electronic parts to various industries. The Paint Related business segment includes paints and surface treatment agents such as general purpose paints and industrial paints; chemical products and goods such as soundproofing materials, plastic sheets, heat-resistant ceramic products, adhesives, synthetic resin products, coating materials, measuring instruments; painting equipment and measuring instruments; completion works such as painting line related works and interior and exterior renovation related works.
