The Electrical and Electronic Parts business segment includes hall intergrated circuits (IC) and light-emitting diode (LED) lighting products.

name: TOGAMI ELECTRIC MFG CO LTD
businessSummary: Togami Electric Mfg. Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of electric machinery and other general machinery and equipment, as well as the provision of the undertakes construction work and incidental business activities. The Company is engaged in the provision of total support business from design and proposal of solar power generation system to construction and inspection including high voltage control equipment, exploration and measurement equipment, switchboards and environmental equipment business. The Company is involved in the manufacture and sale of electronic controllers, high-voltage switches for distribution, switchboards and system equipment, as well as the development of the software for electronic controllers, switchboards and system equipment. The Company is also involved in the provision of the dispatch information processing engineers and the training for computer personnel.

name: TAISEI ONCHO CO LTD
businessSummary: Taisei Oncho Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the equipment construction business. It operates through four regional segments including Japan, the United States, China, and Australia. The equipment construction business designs and constructs heating and cooling, water supply and drainage sanitation, electricity, constant temperature and humidity, dehumidification, heat exchange, and refrigeration and freezing. The construction business designs and constructs buildings and ancillary facilities. The real estate business rents out land and buildings for commercial and residential use. The other businesses include the sale of heating and cooling equipment, solar power generation, and others.

name: GLORY LTD
businessSummary: Glory Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale and maintenance of currency processing equipment, and the provision of electronic payment services and face recognition solutions. The Company has four business segments. Financial Market segment is engaged in the sale and maintenance of products to domestic financial institutions, original equipment manufacturer (OEM) and others. Distribution and Transportation Market segment is engaged in the sale and maintenance of products to domestic supermarkets, department stores, security transport companies, railway companies, tobacco manufacturers, hospitals, local governments and companies. Amusement Market segment is engaged in the sale and maintenance of products to domestic amusement halls. Overseas Market segment is engaged in the sale and maintenance of products to overseas financial institutions, security transport companies, retail stores, casinos and OEMs. It also provides unmanned payment system solutions.

name: TAZMO CO LTD
businessSummary: TAZMO CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacturing and sale of liquid crystal manufacturing equipment, semiconductor-related equipment, precision molding dies and plastic moldings. The Company operates in two business segments. The Processing Equipment segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance of electronic device manufacturing process equipment, such as liquid crystal display (LCD) processing machine, semiconductor processing machine and peripheral equipment. The Molding Dies and Plastic Moldings segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sales of precision molding dies and plastic moldings, including embossed carrier tapes and connectors for electronic equipment.

name: TEIKOKU ELECTRIC MFG. CO LTD
businessSummary: Teikoku Electric Mfg. Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in pump products. The Company operates through two business segments including the pump business segment and the electronic components business segment. The Pump Business segment manufactures, sells and provides after-sales services for pumps. Canned motor pumps include chemical equipment canned motor pumps, high-pressure gas equipment canned motor pumps, refrigeration and air-conditioning equipment canned motor pumps, semiconductor equipment canned motor pumps and power-related equipment canned motor pumps. Metering pumps include chemical equipment metering pumps, high-pressure gas equipment metering pumps, semiconductor equipment metering pumps and metering pumps for foaming devices. Other pumps include power-related equipment pumps and miscellaneous pumps. The Company also engages in special equipment-related business. Special equipment includes permanent magnet generators.

name: OTEC CORP
businessSummary: OTEC CORPORATION is mainly engaged in the sale of pipe equipment and materials. The Company operates in three business segments. The Pipe Equipment and Material Sales segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of steel pipes, joints, valves, sanitary ware and housing equipment. The Construction segment is engaged in the instrumentation works, electric works and maintenance works for both new and existing buildings. The Environment-related Equipment Sales segment is engaged in the sale of environment-related equipment. As of March 31, 2015, the Company had six subsidiaries, one associated company and one affiliated company.

name: GENKI GLOBAL DINING CONCEPTS CORP
businessSummary: Genki Global Dining Concepts Corp, formerly Genki Sushi Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in restaurant-related businesses. The Company operates through two segments. The domestic business operates sushi restaurants. The overseas business operates overseas franchises and sushi restaurants. The Company also purchases ingredients.

name: J-LEASE CO LTD
businessSummary: J-Lease Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the guarantee-related business, with a focus on rent guarantees for rental housing, offices and tenants, as well as the real estate related business and information technology (IT) related business. It operates through three business segments. The Guarantee Related Business segment provides rent guarantees for residential properties, commercial properties, parking lots and rental boxes, medical expenses guarantee services for medical institutions' unpaid medical receivables and child support guarantee services for single-parent households. The Real Estate Related Business segment provides rental brokerage services for foreign nationals looking for housing in Japan, rental management services for real estate owners and real estate rental services. The IT Related Business segment sells environmental inspection systems, develops software on a contract basis, and sells systems.

name: PRESS KOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Press Kogyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the automotive-related business and the construction machinery-related business. It operates through two segments. The Automotive-related Business segment manufactures and sells automotive parts and automotive molds. Products include frames, axle housings, axle units, panels, press molds, automatic welding equipment, and other automotive parts. The Construction Machinery-related Business segment manufactures and sells cabins for construction machinery and other parts for construction machinery. The Company also manufactures and sells construction-related parts and multi-story parking systems.

name: BELL-PARK CO LTD
businessSummary: Bell-Park Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the information and communication devices sale and service business centering on the operation of carrier shops. Among them, SoftBank Shops, au Shops, Y!mobile Shops and UQ Spots operate as the primary sales agent for mobile communication services, Docomo shop operates as a secondary agency. In the carrier shops, the Company arranges new contract of information communication service, sell products such as information communication equipment, conducts installment contract, maintenance business, fee planning and communication fee relates business. The co-sales stores operated by the secondary agency are limited to the sale of new contracts of information communication services and products such as information communication devices.

name: SHOWA PAXXS CORP
businessSummary: SHOWA PAXXS CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of packaging-related products. The Company has five business segments. The Heavy-duty Packaging Bag segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of bags for petroleum chemical products, cement and ceramic products, chemical agents, agricultural products, fertilizers and food products, among others. The Film Product segment manufactures and sells film products for thermal contraction packaging, pallet packaging, agriculture use and secondary processing use. The Container segment provides flexible containers, bulk containers and others. The Real Estate Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing of buildings and warehouses. The Other segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of packaging materials, machinery and other related products, as well as the management of buildings and the non-life insurance agency business.

name: TOYO DRILUBE CO LTD
businessSummary: Toyo Drilube Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in drilube business. The Company is engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and coating processing of drilube products, as well as in the provision of technical guidance services for drilube products coating process. The Company is engaged in the research and development of compounding technology and dispersion technology to uniformly disperse main components such as molybdenum disulfide, fluororesin, graphite, and resinous binders such as polyamide-imide, epoxy in solvent, as well as the development, manufacture and sale of dry lube products, and the provision of the manufactured dry lube products.

name: A&D HOLON HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: A&D Holon Holdings Co Ltd, formerly A&D Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of measuring instrument, medical and healthcare equipment. The Company operates through two segments. The Measuring Instrument segment provides measuring, control and simulation systems, electron guns for semiconductor exposure apparatus, analog to digital (AD) and digital to analog (DA) converters, testing machines, environmental measuring instrument, electronic balances, platform scales, indicators, counting scales and load cells. The Medical and Healthcare Equipment segment offers digital hemopiezometers for home use, blood pressure monitors, full automatic hemopiezometers, precision weighing scales and ultrasonic inhalators.

name: YAMATO CORP
businessSummary: YAMATO CORPORATION is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in facility works. The Company is involved in the design, supervision and construction work of construction facilities such as industrial air conditioning and hygiene equipment, general air conditioning and hygiene equipment, cold and frozen storage equipment for food distribution facilities, living-related processing equipment for environmental facilities. Through its subsidiaries, the Company also provides repair and maintenance services, as well as operation and repair management of water supply and sewerage facilities, among others.

name: AOYAMA ZAISAN NETWORKS CO LTD
businessSummary: Aoyama Zaisan Networks Company, Limited is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in property consulting services for asset owners and corporations. The Company earns remuneration through providing consulting services for assets succession, operation, and management. There are four types of revenue. Property consulting revenues are from property and financial consulting services that provide support from consultation to execution of property succession, operation and management. Real estate transaction revenues are from sales of individual real estate properties and sales of the Real Estate Co-ownership System which meet customer asset management needs. Sublease income is earned by renting and operating rental properties owned by asset owners. Other revenues are from network dues, seminars, and property consulting related books publication.

name: KIMURA CHEMICAL PLANTS CO LTD
businessSummary: KIMURA CHEMICAL PLANTS Co., Ltd. is engaged in the engineering, chemical machinery, and energy and environment businesses. The Engineering segment designs, manufactures, processes and sells various evaporation devices, crystallization devices, cleansing devices, stirring equipment, pressure containers, as well as stainless, steel and resin piping works. The Chemical Machinery is engaged in the design of various plants, the management and contract construction works of machinery manufacturing, existing facility removal, installation, piping, painting, thermal insulation, test operation adjustment and maintenance. The Energy and Environment segment is involved in the design, manufacture, process and sale of atomic fuel transportation casks and storage containers, nuclear fuel concentration equipment and irradiation-related facilities, among others.

name: WORLD CO LTD
businessSummary: World Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the brand business, digital business and platform business. It operates through four business segments. The Brand segment sells women's, men's, and children's clothing and accessories both domestically and internationally. The Digital segment, which consists of business-to-business (B2B) solutions and business-to-consumer (B2C) neo-economy, proposes digital solutions such as operating e-commerce malls specializing in fashion and providing information and logistics systems, and develops and deploys new digital-based services. The Platform segment operates platform businesses such as the production, procurement, and trading of clothing and accessories, as well as space creation support through the manufacture and sale of fixtures. The Common Department segment covers corporate-related operations, such as providing management and guidance to subsidiaries and covering staff expenses with revenue from management guidance fees.

name: SPORTSFIELD CO LTD
businessSummary: Sportsfield Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in sports personnel recruitment support business. The Company is engaged in sale support business, human resource introduction business and recruitment outsourcing business with its subsidiaries. Sports personnel recruitment support business can be divided into new graduate business (for new graduates) and mid-career business (for graduates). The new graduate business is for active athlete students, and mid-career business is for adults with experience in sports and competitions and retired professional and amateur athletes. The business is classified into event business for new graduates, human resource introduction business for new graduates, and human resource introduction business for existing graduates. Through these businesses, the Company is involved in the match of sports people with companies that want to hire sports people.

name: DAIKYONISHIKAWA CORP
businessSummary: DaikyoNishikawa Corp is a Japan-based company mainly manufactures and sells automotive parts. The Company operates in four segments based on region. It procures raw materials from trading companies and manufactures automotive parts such as instrument panels and bumpers, and housing parts such as bus unit components, and sells them to automobile manufacturers and housing equipment manufacturers. The Japan segment develops, manufactures, and sells automotive plastic parts, manufactures and sells housing equipment, designs and produces molding dies and precision jigs, provides life and non-life insurance agency services, and provides temporary staffing services. The North America segment and the ASEAN segment manufacture and sell automotive plastic parts. The China and Korea segment manufactures and sells automotive plastic parts, and designs and develops plastic parts, including automotive part design and technical services.

name: FALCO HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: FALCO HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the clinical testing business and the dispensing pharmacy business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Clinical Testing segment is engaged in the contracted clinical specimen testing business for hospitals and clinics, as well as the development and sale of electronic medical charts and other medical information systems, and the wholesale of in-vitro diagnostic drugs. The Dispensing Pharmacy segment is engaged in the operation of dispensing pharmacies.

name: DAIKO TSUSAN CO LTD
businessSummary: DAIKO TSUSAN CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the purchase and sale of various products for cable television (CATV) and information communication network. The Company is involved in the manufacture of various goods purchased from domestic and foreign manufacturers, such as wire and cable manufacturers, telecommunications machine equipment manufacturers and metal product manufacturers, for communication construction contractors, telecommunications carriers, electric power companies and government agencies. The products purchased by the Company are classified mainly as cables, materials, and equipment, and are used for indoor communication work, outdoor communication work, electric power construction at the sales destination. Cable products include local area network (LAN) & wide area network (WAN) cable, coaxial cable, optical cable. Material products include connecting materials, overhead wire hardware, and in-house lead-in & wiring materials.

name: MORESCO CORP
businessSummary: MORESCO Corporation is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemicals including special lubricating oil, synthetic lubricating oil, materials and hot melt adhesives. The Company operates in four geographical segments. Japan segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of the Company’s main products, as well as brake fluid and antifreeze for automobiles. China segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of special lubricants and hot melt adhesives through the Company’s subsidiaries in China. Southeast and South Asia segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of special lubricants and hot melt adhesives through the Company’s subsidiaries in Southeast and South Asia. North America segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of specialty and synthetic lubricants.

name: FRONTIER INTERNATIONAL INC
businessSummary: FRONTIER INTERNATIONAL INC., together with its subsidiaries, is principally engaged in the comprehensive promotion business, such as event & public relations (PR), as well as over-the-counter sales business. The event promotion business is involved in the planning, operation and production of field events. The campaign promotion business is involved in the management of the campaign secretariat and the premium & novelty planning production. The PR business is involved in the provision of PR, planning of public relations activities, as well as strategy formulation and advices. Space produce business is involved in the space development with event art and display, among others. Digital promotion business is involved in the planning and operation of digital campaign and the production of contents. The over-the-counter sales support business is involved in the provision of over-the-counter sales support and other services.

name: JK HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: JK Holdings Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of plywood, the processing and sale of wood, and the wholesale and retail of plywood, plywood secondary products, building materials and housing equipment. The Company has three business segments. The General Building Material Wholesale segment is mainly engaged in the wholesale of plywood, plywood secondary products, building materials and housing equipment. The Plywood Manufacturing and Wood Processing segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of structural plywood, long plywood, laminated wood and assembled processed products, and the processing and sale of wood. The General Building Material Retail segment is mainly engaged in the retail of plywood, plywood secondary products, building materials and housing equipment. The Company is also engaged in the franchise, real estate leasing, warehouse, transportation, construction and travel business, and the insurance agency business.

name: GALILEI CO LTD
businessSummary: Galilei Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of refrigerator-freezers, the manufacture and sale of medical and scientific products, the manufacture and sale of frozen and refrigerated showcases, large food processing machinery, large and small refrigerated panel equipment sales, and service maintenance. Products include commercial refrigerators and freezers, showcases, ice machines, quick freeze and thaw equipment, pastry and bakery equipment, sanitation-related equipment, equipment for hospitals and aged care facilities, cooking and processing equipment, service equipment, and medical and physical chemistry equipment.

name: FOSTER ELECTRIC CO LTD
businessSummary: Foster Electric Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the speaker business and mobile audio business. It conducts its operations through three segments. The Speaker segment manufactures and sells speaker products such as automotive speakers and speaker systems, and TV speakers. The Mobile Audio segment manufactures and sells mobile audio products including headsets, headphones, earphone drivers, and vibration actuators. Other segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sales of proximity warning speakers, vehicle emergency notification system speakers, and Fostex brand products.

name: SANGETSU CORP
businessSummary: Sangetsu Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in in the interior and exterior businesses. The Company operates through three business segments. The Domestic Interior segment is engaged in the planning, manufacture, and sales of interior materials such as wall coverings, flooring materials, and fabrics (curtains and chair fabrics), as well as the space creation business, which is involved in the entire space creation process from design to construction. The Domestic Exterior segment is engaged in the sale and construction of exterior products such as gates, fences, and terraces for both the residential and non-residential markets. The Overseas segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of interior materials overseas.

name: ANEST IWATA CORP
businessSummary: Anest Iwata Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of compressors, vacuum equipment, and painting equipment and facilities. It operates through five regional segments, including Japan, Europe, Americas, China, and Other. It manufactures its own branded compressors (mainly screw compressors) and painting equipment (mainly airbrushes) and sells them to customers in regions outside its region either directly or through group companies, including itself. The Other segment includes the business activities of its local subsidiaries in Taiwan, India, Thailand, South Korea, Vietnam, Indonesia, the Philippines, Australia, and South Africa. It also provides repair services.

name: MS&AD INSURANCE GROUP HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: MS&AD Insurance Group Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the insurance business. The Company has six business segments. The domestic non-life insurance business includes three segments: Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance, Aioi Nissay Dowa Insurance, Mitsui Direct General Insurance. The business is engaged in the sale of fire insurance, marine insurance, accident insurance, automobile insurance and other non-life insurance products in Japan. The domestic life insurance business includes two segments: Mitsui Sumitomo Aioi Life Insurance and Mitsui Sumitomo Primary Life Insurance. The business is engaged in the sale of personal insurance, personal annuity insurance, group insurance and other life insurance products in Japan. The Overseas Business segment is engaged in the insurance business in the United States, Europe, East Asia, Southeast Asia, South Asia, Australia and other regions. The Company is also engaged in the financial services business and risk related business.

name: NCS&A CO LTD
businessSummary: NCS&A CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of integrated information services, including the design, development, operation support and maintenance of systems. The systems development business is engaged in the design of systems, the development of software, and the sale of customized packaged software products. The services business is engaged in the provision of maintenance services for computer equipment and other hardware, and system support services for enterprise computer systems, as well as the operation of inbound and outbound call centers for distribution and mail order fields. The system equipment sales business is engaged in the sale of computer equipment and peripherals, and packaged software products.

name: WAKITA & CO LTD
businessSummary: Wakita & Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction machinery business, trading business, and real estate business. It operates through three business segments. The Construction Machinery Business segment sells and rents civil engineering and construction machinery, loading and transporting machinery, and others. The Trading Business segment sells and rents commercial facilities, video and audio equipment, nursing care products, and others. The Real Estate Business segment rents and sells real estate (commercial buildings, condominiums and others) and manages hotels.

name: SUMITOMO MITSUI FINANCIAL GROUP, INC
businessSummary: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in businesses related to financial services, centering on banking, leasing, securities, consumer finance, and system development and information processing. The Company consists of five business segments. The Wholesale Business segment provides services to large domestic corporations as well as small and medium-sized enterprises. The Retail business segment serves retail customers in Japan. The Global Business segment serves Japanese and non-Japanese clients overseas. The Market Business segment provides services for financial markets. The Headquarters Administration Business segment provides services that do not belong to any of the above business segments.

name: KVK CORP
businessSummary: KVK CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, process, purchase and sale of water taps, water supply and drainage fittings and piping members. The Company operates through Japan, China, and Philippines three geography segments. Main products include bathroom faucets, kitchen faucets, wash faucets, water discharge pipes, resin caps, shower heads and hoses.

name: NIHON PARKERIZING CO LTD
businessSummary: Nihon Parkerizing Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based manufacturer of chemical agents and equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The Chemical Agents segment manufactures and sells metal surface treatment chemicals, anti-rust oil, rolling mill lubricant, coating materials, electroless nickel plating and industrial detergents. The Equipment segment manufactures and sells metal surface treatment equipment and coating equipment. The Processing segment is engaged in the provision of anti-rust processing service and heat treatment processing service. The Company is also involved in the maintenance work of buildings, the manufacture and sale of metal specimen plates, the management and leasing of real estates.

name: TSUZUKI DENKI CO LTD
businessSummary: Tsuzuki Denki Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the information network solution services business. The Information Network Solution Services segment provides proposals, construction, operation and maintenance services for various solutions related to information networks. Services include sales of information and communication equipment, consulting, design, development and construction technology provision, operation and maintenance of information and communication equipment and software, and monthly cloud services.

name: STARTS CORP INC
businessSummary: Starts Corp Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in construction and real estate management businesses. It has 10 business segments. The Construction Business segment constructs rental housing and other properties based on construction orders, and contracts for the construction of custom-built detached houses. The Rental Brokerage Business segment brokers real estate rentals. The Sales and Purchase Brokerage Business segment brokers real estate sales. The Real Estate Management Business segment manages and rents real estate. The Condominium Sales Business segment sells houses and other properties. The Publishing Business segment operates a publishing business, the Hotel and Leisure Business segment operates hotels and inns, travel agencies, and restaurants. The Elderly Support and Childcare Business segment provides nursing care services, elderly support housing, and childcare services. It also has Finance and Consulting Business segment, Retail and Cultural Business segment.

name: ARCS CO LTD
businessSummary: ARCS COMPANY, LIMITED is principally involved in the supermarket business. In the retail business, the Company is engaged in the operation of supermarkets that mainly sell food products and home centers that sell home-related products, development printing enlargement (DPE) business, wholesale of pharmaceuticals, as well as manufacture and sale of bread. The other businesses include tourism business, building maintenance business, real estate leasing business, property insurance and life insurance agency business, wholesale business, food manufacturing business, industrial waste and general waste collection and transportation business, construction business, as well as discount business.

name: NHK SPRING CO LTD
businessSummary: NHK Spring Co Ltd is primarily engaged in the manufacturing and sale of automotive-related parts, such as suspension springs, seats and seat components, and precision components. It also manufactures and sells information equipment-related products, and engages in logistics activities. The Company operates in five segments. The Suspension Springs segment manufactures and sells coil springs, leaf springs, stabilizers, accumulators, torsion bars, stabilizer links and stabilizer linkers. The Seating segment manufactures and sells automotive seats, seat structural parts. The Precision Components segment manufactures and sells mechanical parts for hard disk drives (HDDs), wire springs, thin leaf springs, motor cores, fasteners, and precision-machined products. The DDS segment manufactures and sells HDD suspensions and semiconductor inspection probe units. The Industrial Equipment and Others segment manufactures, sells, and transports semiconductor process parts, ceramic products and others.

name: KOA SHOJI HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Koa Shoji Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the sale of active pharmaceutical ingredients and the manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals. The Company has two business segments. The Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients Sales segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of active pharmaceutical ingredients, which are raw materials (pharmaceutical ingredients) used to manufacture pharmaceuticals. The Pharmaceutical Manufacturing and Sales segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of prescription pharmaceuticals and over-the-counter pharmaceuticals, as well as purchases and sells them and undertakes contract manufacturing.

name: CANON INC
businessSummary: Canon Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in business activities ranging from development and production to sales and service in the fields of printing, medical, imaging, and industrial. The Company consists of four business segments. The Printing Business Unit segment provides digital continuous ledger printers and digital cut sheet printers. The Medical Business Unit segment provides diagnostic ultrasound systems and X-ray systems. The Imaging Business Unit segment is engaged in the provision of interchangeable lens digital cameras, interchangeable lenses, and compact digital cameras. The Industrial Business Unit segment is engaged in the provision of semiconductor lithography equipment. The Company also provides handy terminals and document scanners.

name: NISHIMATSUYA CHAIN CO LTD
businessSummary: Nishimatsuya Chain Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the retail of baby and children's lifestyle products. The children's clothing includes baby outerwear, underwear, and pajamas, boys' outerwear, underwear, and pajamas, and girls' outerwear, underwear, and pajamas. The Company also offers childcare and clothing accessories, baby formula and weaning supplies, hygiene and general merchandise, bedding, strollers and car seats, indoor items such as mats, chairs, racks, and walkers, hats, shoes, rain gear, and other clothing accessories, toys, and gift sets. The baby and maternity clothing includes newborn clothing, maternity products, and Japanese clothing. The Company also offers vending machine products. The Company’s products are sold primarily directly to customers through stores and online sales, primarily for cash or other payment. It also sells Nishimatsuya Chain Gift Cards for gifting.

name: NISHIKAWA KEISOKU CO LTD
businessSummary: NISHIKAWA KEISOKU CO., Ltd. is a company mainly engaged in the sale of engineering equipment. The Company operates in four businesses. The control and information equipment system business provides computers and computer systems for process automation (PA) and factory automation (FA) controlling, detection devices including thermometers and flow meters, as well as control equipment including controllers and sequencers. It also provides engineering services, software production, instrumentation works, and maintenance services. The measuring equipment business provides various electrometric tools, oscilloscopes, communication measurement instruments and measuring systems. The analytical instrument segment provides organic chemistry analyzers and inorganic analyzers, and produces software for data analysis. The industrial machinery and others business provides environmental testing devices, hydraulic equipment, pneumatic equipment, industrial robots and thermostat baths.

name: NAIGAI TEC CORP
businessSummary: Naigai Tec Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sales business and contract manufacturing business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Sale business purchases various components and equipment such as pneumatic equipment, vacuum equipment and temperature control equipment which are used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment, flat panel display (FPD) manufacturing equipment, and electronic equipment from domestic manufacturers, and sells to domestic users. The Contract Manufacturing business is engaged in the contract manufacture of equipment assembly, contract processing, process management, information equipment assembly, and maintenance services, and main business partners are semiconductor manufacturers, semiconductor manufacturing equipment manufacturers, FPD manufacturing equipment manufacturers, and electronic equipment manufacturers.

name: BROTHER INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: Brother Industries Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of office equipment and supplies. The Company operates in six business segments. The Printing and Solutions segment manufactures and sells communication and printing equipment like printers, multifunction devices and electronic stationery, among others. The Personal and Home segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of household sewing machines. The Machinery segment manufactures and sells industrial sewing machines, garment printer, machine tools, reducers and gears, among others. The Network and Contents segment is involved in the manufacture, sale and service of commercial karaoke equipment, as well as the provision of contents delivery services. The Domino segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial printing equipment. The Others segment is involved in the real estate business.

name: SHIBUYA CORP
businessSummary: Shibuya Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of products related to packaging plant business, mechatronics system business and agricultural equipment business. It has three business segments. Packaging Plant segment's products are bottling systems, including filling systems, capping systems; box making/packaging systems and pharmaceutical equipment systems, including pharmaceutical manufacturing systems and isolators; regenerative medical systems, including cell culture isolators. Mechatronics System segment’s products are cutting processing systems, including laser beam machines, water jet cutting machines; semiconductor manufacturing system, including solder ball mounter, light emitting diode (LED) inspection device; medical equipment, including laser surgery and treatment equipment; hydraulic press machines. Agricultural Equipment segment's products are agricultural sorting and sorting systems. It also provides staffing and travel agency services.

name: AICHI TOKEI DENKI CO LTD
businessSummary: Aichi Tokei Denki Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of measuring equipment and other special equipment. The Measuring Instrument segment carries four types of products: gas-related equipment, which include utility gas meters, liquefied petroleum (LP) gas meters, industrial meters, pressure equipment, gas meter systems and others; water work-related equipment, including various water supply meters, industrial water meters and sewage meters, bill management systems, emergency report systems for elderly housing and others; civil sensors and systems, including flow instrument and flow sensors, as well as instrumentation which include measuring, monitoring and control systems. The other businesses include the manufacture and sale of special equipment, such as precision molds.

name: XEBIO HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Xebio Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the general retail business, primarily sporting goods and equipment and apparel. The sports business division operates large sporting goods specialty stores and golf specialty stores. It also offers casual apparel. The fashion apparel division includes the Next business, which has a tie-up with a British manufacturer and retailer and exclusively sells products designed by the Company in Japan, and the X'style and Rookie USA businesses, which develop their own fashion lineup. Other businesses include sports eyeglass and sunglass specialty stores, sports drug specialty stores, and fancy stationery and sundry specialty stores. The Company also operates sports marketing business, credit card business, website management business, marketing agency business, e-commerce (EC) business, overseas contact center business, and research and development (R&D) business.

name: NARASAKI SANGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: NARASAKI SANGYO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of electric appliances, materials and fuel. The Company has five business segments. The Electric Appliances Related segment is engaged in the sale of motors, control equipment, heavy electrical equipment, refrigeration equipment, precision processing equipment and others. The Machinery-related segment is engaged in the sale of food manufacturing equipment, laborsaving logistics equipment, grain storage equipment and others. The Material and Fuel-related segment is engaged in the sale of cements, concretes, concrete piles, autoclaved lightweight concrete (ALC) plates, petroleum, gas, asphalts and others. The Marine Transportation-related segment is engaged in the provision of marine transportation, customs, harbor operation, trucking, warehousing and other services. The Construction machinery-related segment is engaged in the sale of concrete pump trucks, rotary snow plows and road cutting pavement equipment.

name: EBRAINS INC
businessSummary: EBRAINS,INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the design, manufacture and sale of backplanes, bus racks, and system chassis for industrial and industrial computers. The products are mainly used in application fields including communication equipment, electronic application equipment, electrical measuring instruments, traffic related equipment, and defense and others. The main applicable equipment includes Base station communication device, broadband related device, broadcast image device, power related, plant, medical device, super computer (HPC), semiconductor / integrated circuit (IC) measuring instrument, factory automation (FA) equipment, robot, intelligent road Transportation system related equipment (ITS), train onboard equipment, vehicle, ship, aircraft onboard equipment, air traffic control equipment, military vehicle, ship, aircraft onboard equipment, surveillance camera system, assembly machine, equipment, and among others.

name: DAIICHI KENSETSU CORP
businessSummary: DAIICHI KENSETSU CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction and real estate business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Construction segment is engaged in the construction and civil engineering works, including railway-related civil engineering and construction works, social infrastructure maintenance works, concrete repair works, renewal works, track maintenance and repair works, as well as the construction of public facilities, educational and cultural facilities, medical and welfare facilities, commercial facilities, offices, warehouses, factories, apartment buildings and others. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing and brokerage of real estate.

name: SAKAI HEAVY INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: SAKAI HEAVY INDUSTRIES, LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of road paving equipment, as well as road maintenance and repair equipment. The Company is mainly engaged in the design, manufacture, sale and repair of construction equipment, industrial machinery and related parts, the purchase and sale of used construction equipment, as well as the design, construction, supervision and contracting of road pavement and repair work. The Company is engaged in the production of vibratory single drum rollers, vibratory tandem rollers, static pneumatic tired rollers, vibratory combined rollers, vibratory three wheel rollers, rammers, plate compactors, walk behind rollers and other road paving equipment, as well as road planers, asphalt pavers, road cleaners, water sprinklers and other road maintenance and repair equipment. The Company distributes its products within the domestic market and to overseas markets, including the American, Indonesia, and China.

name: KURABO INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: Kurabo Industries Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in textile business, chemical products business, environmental mechatronics business, food and service business, and real estate business. It operates through five segments. The Textile segment manufactures and sells yarn, textiles, and textile products. The Chemical Products segment manufactures, processes, and sells soft urethane, functional resin products, residential building materials, nonwoven fabrics, and functional materials. The Environmental Mechatronics segment manufactures, sells, and maintains information system equipment, inspection and measurement systems, designs, manufactures, constructs, and sells various environment- and energy-related plants, operates biomass power generation, and manufactures and sells bio-related products. The Food and Service segment manufactures and sells freeze-dried foods and operates hotels and driving schools. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing of real estate.

name: JSP CORP
businessSummary: JSP Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of plastic products with enhanced functionality and economic efficiency, mainly using foaming technology. The Company operates business through two business segments. The Extrusion segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of polystyrene, polyethylene, polypropylene sheets, boards and others, using extrusion foam technology as its core. The Beads segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of foamed polypropylene, foamed polyethylene, and foamed polystyrene products based on bead foaming technology. The Company also operates businesses related to the sale of general packaging materials.

name: ART VIVANT CO LTD
businessSummary: ART VIVANT CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the purchasing and sale of prints, paintings and art, the installment sale agency business (credit business), the installment loan secured financing business, as well as the operation of resort hotels, fitness clubs and hot yoga studios. The Company operates in four business segments. The Art-related segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of prints, paintings and art products. The Financial Services segment is engaged in the installment sale and brokerage and financing business. The Resort segment is engaged in the operation of resort hotels. The Health Industry segment is engaged in the operation of yoga studios and fitness clubs.

name: NIKKATO CORP
businessSummary: NIKKATO CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in the ceramics and engineering business. The Company has two business segments. The Ceramics segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of functional ceramics such as thermal heating elements, oxygen sensors and ceramics filters, abrasion resistant ceramics such as ball mills and crushing balls, heat resistant ceramics such as thermocouple protection tubes, insulation tubes, core tubes, transportation rollers and heat treatment equipment, as well as physical and chemical ceramics such as evaporating dishes, crucibles and ceramics for experimental purposes. The products are mainly used for electronic parts, food, medicines, paints and others. The Engineering segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of heating equipment such as electric furnaces, vacuum furnaces and thermal treatment equipment, as well as measuring equipment such as temperature sensors, stress measurement equipment and measurement controllers.

name: KEIWA INC
businessSummary: KEIWA Incorporated is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of functional films and solutions that meet customer needs by adding Ultra Precision to the core technologies of sheeting, laminating and coating. The Company operates through two business segments. The Optical Sheets segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale and process of light diffusion films for flat panel displays. The Functional Products segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale and process of various products such as industrial packaging materials, industrial process paper, clean energy materials, building materials and agricultural materials.

name: CROPS CORP
businessSummary: Crops Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in mobile communication business, store sublease business, stationery packaging and materials wholesale business. It operates through five business segments. Mobile Communications segment is engaged in the operation of au shop in Aichi, Mie, Gifu, Shizuoka, Tokyo, and Kanagawa, and the operation of UQ Mobile in Aichi and Mie. Store Sub-Lease segment is engaged in the provision of store opening and closing support services and store management service centered on restaurants. Stationery Packaging Materials Wholesale segment is engaged in the planning and wholesale of stationery and packaging materials for 100 yen shops, mail order stores, wholesale stores and others. Building Maintenance segment is engaged in the provision of cleaning, facility management and security services for commercial facilities and office buildings. Temporary Staffing segment is engaged in the general worker and specific worker dispatch, and business contracts.

name: CRESCO LTD
businessSummary: Cresco Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of information services for software and embedded software development. The Company is also engaged in the sale of related products. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Software Development segment is engaged in the provision of application development, infrastructure system development and solution services. The Embedded Software Development segment is engaged in the development of embedded software in communication systems, car electronics and digital appliances field. The Company is also involved in the products sales business.

name: JAPAN PROCESS DEVELOPMENT CO LTD
businessSummary: Japan Process Development Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the system development and information service business. The Company has six business segments. The Control System segment is engaged in the development of energy systems, traffic systems and information processing systems. The Automotive System segment is engaged in the development of vehicle control systems and advanced driving assistance systems (ADAS). The Specific Information System segment is engaged in the development of satellite image processing systems and disaster prevention systems. The Embedded System segment is engaged in the development of systems embedded in storage devices and medical equipment. The Industrial and Public System segment is engaged in the development of systems for member and content management, integrated circuit (IC) cards and satellites. The Information Technology (IT) Service segment is engaged in the provision of services such as systems construction, maintenance and operation.

name: QUICK CO LTD
businessSummary: Quick Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the human resources service business and recruiting business. The Company operates through five business segments. Human Resources Service segment provides human resources introduction business, personnel dispatch, dispatch business contract, and operates nursery centers. Recruiting segment is engaged in the job advertising agency business and the provision of recruitment support tools, education and training service. Information Publishing segment publishes regional information magazines. IT and Internet-related segment plans and operates portal site for information on human resources and labor issues, other activities under the Japan's Human Resources Department brand, web promotion support, web and mobile applications and Artificial Intelligence solutions, and Information Technology (IT) engineer training and development. Overseas segment provides human resources introduction, dispatch and related service overseas.

name: ISAMU PAINT CO LTD
businessSummary: Isamu Paint Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of paints and related products. The Paint segment is divided into automobile repair, industrial, and architectural applications. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of various paints, thinners, aerosol products, the process of semi-finished products, the filling and subdivision work of products, and purchase and sale of related products. The Company is also engaged in the management of real estate rentals and parking lots.

name: IDEA CONSULTANTS INC
businessSummary: IDEA Consultants, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the environmental consultation business. The Company has four business segments. The Environmental Consultant segment is engaged in the environment-related planning, design, survey, analysis, predictive assessment and weather forecast. The Construction Consultant segment is engaged in the construction-related planning, design, survey, analysis and execution management. The Information System segment is involved in the development, construction, maintenance and operation of information systems. The Real Estate segment leases real estate properties.

name: JAPAN PROPERTY MANAGEMENT CENTER CO LTD
businessSummary: Japan Property Management Center Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of property management business nationwide, centered on lump-sum lease business. The Company rents real estate properties (rental housing such as rental condominiums and rental apartments) from real estate owners and subleases them to general residents. The Company is engaged in the rental management on behalf of landlords. Construction work, remodeling work, real estate property management and brokerage, and management of elderly housing are operated by partner companies (real estate management companies, construction companies, remodeling companies, and long-term care companies) nationwide. The Company is also engaged in the delinquency guarantee business, insurance business, broadband business (JPMC Hikari), sales business of building materials, and contract for renewal, remodeling and renovation work in the metropolitan area.

name: NICHIA STEEL WORKS LTD
businessSummary: NICHIA STEEL WORKS, LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of ordinary wire products, special wire products and rivet wire products. It operates through four business segments. Special Wire Products segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of hard steel wires, plated steel wires, steel flat wires, steel stranded wires, and wire ropes for motor vehicle industry, electric power and communications industries, and public works. Ordinary Wire Products segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of rock fall prevention nets, gabion, plated iron wires, and processed products using plated iron wires. Tack and Screw Product segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of torsia-type high-strength bolts, hexagonal high-strength bolts, and galvanized nithia (GN) bolts for civil engineering and construction industries. Real Estate Leasing segment is engaged in real estate leasing of buildings and land. It also sells plating processing and by-products.

name: COMPUTER ENGINEERING & CONSULTING LTD
businessSummary: COMPUTER ENGINEERING & CONSULTING LTD. is engaged in the industry automation business, system integration business and platform integration business. The industrial automation business mainly provides products and services that support innovation in field of manufacturing from the aspect of ICT to customers in assembly manufacturing industry. The system integration business mainly provides system integration services specialized in business types and tasks for customers in the manufacturing, finance, public, government, and local governments. The platform integration business provides the ICT infrastructure best suited to businesses promoted by customers and the business platform services necessary for business execution, with the company's own data center connected by the Network as the core.

name: TOA CORP (HYOGO)
businessSummary: TOA Corp is a Japan-based company operates manufacturing, sales, and related businesses mainly in the audio and video fields. The Company sells audio and video equipment and others through five segments: Japan, Asia Pacific, Europe and Middle East and Africa, America, China and East Asia. Additionally, the Japan segment produces audio equipment, video equipment. The Company’s products include emergency broadcast equipment, commercial broadcast equipment, wireless systems, intercom systems, sound systems, and loudspeaker equipment and others.

name: ADEKA CORP
businessSummary: ADEKA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemical products and food ingredients. The Company operates through three business segments. The Chemicals segment manufactures and sells resin additive products such as flame retardants; information and electric chemical products such as ultrapure semiconductor materials, light curing resin and others; functional chemical products such as additives, fire retardant, interfacial active agents and kitchen cleaning agents and others. The Life Sciences segment manufactures and sells agricultural chemicals, pharmaceuticals, quasi-drugs, veterinary medicines, wood medicines, and medical materials. The food segment manufactures and sells margarines, fats and oils for chocolate and others. The Company is also involved in the equipment plant design, construction and construction management, equipment maintenance, logistics, warehousing, leasing of vehicles, real estate, insurance agency and others.

name: TECHNO MEDICA CO LTD
businessSummary: Techno Medica Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in development, manufacture, sale and export of analysis device for clinical examination equipment and other medical equipment, as well as devices repair services. The blood collection tube preparation apparatus business provides blood collection peripheral equipment, such as blood and urine collection automation reception equipment, among others, as well as blood tube preparation systems. The laboratory test apparatus business provides blood gas analysis apparatus, electrolyte analyzers, erythrocyte sedimetation rate measuring machines, among others. The consumable goods business provides blood collecting tubes, labels, sensor cards, calibration packs, among others, as well as maintenance services.

name: RYOYU SYSTEMS CO LTD
businessSummary: Ryoyu Systems Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in provision of information services. The Company's main business can be divided into the design, development, operation and maintenance of information communication systems, the sale of information communication system related equipment. The Company is also engaged in the design, analysis and simulation of industrial products, as well as provision of information processing services using information communication systems.

name: HELIOS TECHNO HOLDING CO LTD
businessSummary: Helios Techno Holding Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the lamp business, manufacturing equipment business and human resources service business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Lamp segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of projector lamps, halogen lamps for general lighting, as well as light emitting diode (LED) lamps. The Manufacturing Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of alignment film printing equipment, special printing equipment, light source units for ultraviolet (UV) exposure equipment, as well as inspection and measurement equipment. The Human Resource Service segment is engaged in dispatching and contracting technical and general production workers.

name: KONISHI CO LTD
businessSummary: Konishi Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of synthetic adhesives and sealants used mainly in the civil engineering construction field. The Company operates through three segments. The Bond segment manufactures and sells industrial adhesives, general household adhesives, construction adhesives, construction and civil engineering adhesives, repair materials, sealants, wall covering adhesives, wax and adhesive tapes. The Chemical Products segment sells industrial chemicals, synthetic resins, resin moldings, electronic component materials and thin film materials. The Construction Business segment carries out repair, renovation and reinforcement work in the infrastructure and stock markets. The Company is also engaged in the real estate rental business.

name: TOMITA CO LTD
businessSummary: TOMITA CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of machine tools. The Company operates through four geography segments, including Japan, North America, Europe, Asia. The main machine products are general-purpose lathes, drilling machines, boring machines, broaching machines, and electrical machines. Tool equipment products are mainly pneumatic equipment, hydraulic equipment, cutting tools, electrical equipment, measuring equipment, machine equipment. The Company is also engaged in the provision of information consulting, mail order services and insurance sale services.

name: YUASA TRADING CO LTD
businessSummary: YUASA TRADING CO., LTD. is mainly engaged in the sale of industrial machinery and equipment. The Industrial Equipment segment is engaged in the sale of tools, industrial equipment, control equipment and logistics equipment. The Industrial Machinery segment is engaged in the sale of industrial machinery and equipment. The Housing Equipment, Piping and Air Conditioning segment is involved in the sale of piping, air conditioning equipment and housing equipment, the design, supervision and contracting of construction works, and the trading of land and buildings. The Construction and Exterior segment is involved in the sale of construction materials, as well as materials for landscape, exterior and civil engineering use. The Construction Machinery segment is involved in the sale and leasing of construction machinery and materials. The Energy segment is involved in the sale of petroleum products. The Company is also engaged in the sale of living-related products and wood products.

name: ESTIC CORP
businessSummary: ESTIC CORPORATION is engaged in manufacture, sale, repair and inspection of nut runners, hand nut runners, servo press and screw tightening equipment. The nut runner consists of alternating current (AC) turbo motors, sensors and controllers. It uses AC servomotor as the driving source, analyzes information from sensor though computer and controls the motor to tighten screws of bolts and nuts. The hand nut runner is a hand tool for tighten. The servo press is a press machine, consisting of AC servo motor, sensor and controller. The machine is applied in nut runner technology, uses AC servomotor as the driving source, presses object by changing the rotational force of the motor to linear motion through ball screw. The repair and inspection business provides repair of nut runners, hand nut runners, servo press, as well as inspection of accuracy for screw tightening.

name: OKAMOTO INDUSTRIES INC
businessSummary: Okamoto Industries Inc is a Japan-based company mainly provides industrial products for businesses and daily necessities for consumers. The Company operates in two segments. The Industrial Products segment manufactures, purchases, and sells plastic films, wallpaper, automotive interior materials, and industrial materials. The Daily Goods segment manufactures, purchases, and sells medical and daily necessities, shoes, clothing, and sporting goods. The Company also engages in product transportation and storage, and solar power generation businesses.

name: ENVIPRO HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: ENVIPRO HOLDINGS Inc. is a Japan-based holding company primarily engaged in the recycling of resources. The Company mainly collects metal scrap and industrial wastes discharged from corporations or dismantled properties, and transports them to intermediate treatment plants owned by its subsidiaries. In the intermediate treatment plants, the recycled wastes are treated through various processes, including shearing and cutting, dismantling, crushing and sorting, and solid fuel production to produce various products. The Company's products include iron scrap, non-ferrous (copper, aluminum, and stainless steel) scraps, and plastics. The Company also collects recycled resources from other recyclers. The Company's products are distributed to both domestic and overseas markets. It also conducts disabled welfare services, operation of photovoltaic power stations, recycling of rubbers, manufacturing and sales of rubber products.

name: SENSHU ELECTRIC CO LTD
businessSummary: Senshu Electric Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the sale of wires and cables, electrical materials, information related equipment and others. The Company is engaged in the provision of equipment wires, communication wires, fire protection wires, heat-resistant wires, network cables, thermocouples and compensating wires, instrumentation cables, magnet wires, power cables, control cables, insulated wires, signal cables, various eco cables, lightning rod wires, bare copper wires, robot wires, automobile wires, optical fiber cables and peripheral devices. The Company is also involved in the orders and sales of related control devices.

name: NIPPON YUSEN KK
businessSummary: Nippon Yusen KK is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the transportation business. The Company operates through six business segments. The Liner Shipping segment is engaged in international marine cargo transportation by liner ships, container terminal business, port transportation business, and tugboat business for the purpose of revenue. The Air Freight segment is engaged in air freight business. The Logistic segment is engaged in the warehouse and freight businesses, and the provision of marine, land and air transportation integrated logistics network services. Irregular Specialized Liner segment is engaged in international marine cargo transportation by trampers and tankers, ship chartering, and others. Real Estate segment leases, manages and sells real estate. The Others segment is engaged in the sale of equipment and machinery and petroleum products, the provision of information processing services, passenger vessel business, petroleum product wholesale business and others.

name: KH NEOCHEM CO LTD
businessSummary: KH Neochem Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of petrochemicals. The Company's business is divided into three business units. The basic chemical business’s main products include butyl alcohols, octyl alcohols and butyl acetates. The business is involved in the provision for the manufacture of paints, inks, commodity resins, plasticizers, detergents and others. The performance material business’s main products include isononanoic acids and octylic acids, among others. The business is involved in the provision of raw materials for surfactants, water-based paints, cosmetics, pesticides, as well as pharmaceutical products. The electronic material business’s main products include propylene glycol methyl ether-pure (PM-P) and propylene glycol methyl ether acetate-pure (PMA-P). The business is involved in the provision for semiconductors, display materials and optical materials, among others.

name: HOKUETSU CORP
businessSummary: Hokuetsu Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the pulp and paper business and packaging and paper processing business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Paper and Pulp Business segment manufactures and sells paper and pulp products. The Packaging and Paper Processing Business segment is engaged in manufacture and sale of paper containers and liquid containers, and the manufacture, processing, and sale of paper products. The Company is also engaged in the timber business, construction business, machine manufacturing, sales, and maintenance business, transportation and warehousing business, and used paper wholesale business.

name: SHIBAURA MACHINE CO LTD
businessSummary: Shibaura Machine Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of molding machines and machine tools. It operates through two business segments. Molding Machine segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale, installation, and maintenance of injection molding machines, extrusion molding machines and die casting machines. Products include all-electric injection molding machine EC-SXIII, EC-SX and EC-S series, hybrid type Injection molding machine ED and IS series, special specification injection molding machine, fine foam molding and control system. Machine Tool segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale, installation and maintenance of machine tools. Products include high-speed shape machines MPJ-M and MPJ series, horizontal boring machines BTD-100R12 and BTD-110H.R13/R16, grinding machines KWA-D and KT-C series. It is also engaged in manufacture and sale of industrial robots, servo motors, computer numerical control (CNC) devices, sewerage-related measuring equipment.

name: YAMADA CONSULTING GROUP CO LTD
businessSummary: YAMADA Consulting Group Co.,Ltd. is mainly engaged in the management consulting business, real estate consulting business and other businesses. The Company operates in four business segments. The Management Consulting segment conducts management consulting business, merger and acquisition capital consulting business, overseas business consulting business and others. The Real Estate Consulting segment provides real estate consulting, real estate sales brokerage and other businesses. The Educational Training and Financial Planner (FP)-related segment includes sales of FP-qualified courses, corporate training, and others. The Investment and Fund segment conducts the formation, operation, and investment of investment business associations.

name: SAKURA KCS CORP
businessSummary: SAKURA KCS Corporation is mainly engaged in the provision of information services and the sale of system equipment. The Company operates in three business segments, including Financial-related segment, Public-related segment and Industrial-related segment, which focus on financial institutions, local public authorities and general corporations, respectively. The Company involves in the customized development of application software, the development and sale of packaged software, the operation of system consulting business, the contracted calculation processing, the provision of application service provider (ASP) services, computer center management and operation services, business support services for financial institutions, data inputting services, housing services and hosting services, and computer maintenance services. The Company also involves in the maintenance of computers, the sale of various supplies, and the sale of various computers and other devices.

name: CTI ENGINEERING CO LTD
businessSummary: CTI Engineering Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of construction consulting services for public works such as rivers, dams, roads, the environment, and information. The Company operates in two business segments. The Domestic Construction Consulting segment is conducts comprehensive consulting business such as planning, survey, planning, design, orderer support, construction management, operation and maintenance of public works in Japan, and associated system development, maintenance management, general office work consignment and others. The Overseas Construction Consulting segment provides comprehensive consulting services for all construction projects such as excavation of projects overseas, the formulation, planning, investigation, design, construction management, operation and maintenance of master plans, and building-related businesses including structural design and equipment design.

name: YUASA FUNASHOKU CO LTD
businessSummary: YUASA FUNASHOKU CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the commercial business, hotel business, and real estate business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Commercial segment is mainly engaged in the wholesale of rice, flour, starch, sugar, fats and oils, feed, processed food and liquors. The Hotel segment is mainly engaged in the operation of hotels and restaurants. The Real Estate segment is mainly engaged in the real estate leasing business. The Company is also engaged in the logistics business and insurance agency business.

name: SODICK CO LTD
businessSummary: Sodick Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the equipment business. The Company has three business segments. The Machine Tool segment is mainly engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance of electric discharge equipment, machining centers and metal three-dimensional (3D) printers. The Industrial Machine segment is mainly engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance of horizontal injection molding equipment, vertical injection molding equipment and special-purpose molding equipment. The Food Machine segment is mainly engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance of noodle making equipment and rice cooking devices. The Company is also engaged in the manufacture and sale of mold and plastic molding products, the development, manufacture and sale of linear motor products and ceramics products, the development of hardware and software for numerical control (NC) devices, as well as the leasing of electric discharge equipment.

name: YODOKO LTD
businessSummary: Yodoko Ltd, formerly Yodogawa Steel Works Ltd, is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture, processing and sale of iron and steel products. The Company operates through four segments. The Steel Sheets-related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cold-rolled steel sheets, polished steel strips, hot-dip galvanized steel sheets, painted galvanized steel sheets, and other steel sheets, the manufacture and sale of building materials and exterior products, as well as the design and construction of construction works. The Roll segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of steel rolls and non-ferrous rolls. The Grating segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of gratings. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing and trading of real estate. The Company is also engaged in transportation and warehousing, golf course management, machinery plant sales, solar power generation electricity sales, and software design and development.

name: PREMIUM WATER HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Premium Water Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of natural mineral water and home office delivery business which manufactures natural mineral water. The main product is 12L natural mineral water, which includes in-house production and original equipment manufacturer (OEM) production in Fujiyoshida City, Yamanashi Prefecture; Asago City, Hyogo Prefecture; Asago City, Hyogo Prefecture; Omachi City, Nagano Prefecture; Hamada City, Shimane Prefecture and Minamiaso Village, Aso County, Kumamoto Prefecture. The Company provides mineral water delivery services centered on the brand PREMIUM WATER mainly through the three sales methods of direct sales, distributors, original brand name (OEM) and through demonstration sales, WEB and telemarketing. The Company lends water servers to customers of direct sales, distributors and special agents, and wholesales water servers to customers of agents. The Company also conducts as a sales representative.

name: JEDAT INC
businessSummary: Jedat Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the electronic design automation (EDA) software development and sales consultation business. The Company is engaged in the development, sale, support and consultation for computer aided design (CAD) software. In addition to the sale and support of EDA products, the Company is also engaged in the solutions business, such as software development, semiconductor design, and EDA environment construction support. The Company provides EDA products, maintenance services and solutions to customers. The main customers are semiconductor manufacturers, LCD panel manufacturers, electronic device manufacturers, mask manufacturers, and design contract companies. Sales to domestic customers are mainly direct sales. Sales to overseas customers such as the United States, Taiwan, Mainland China, and South Korea are conducted through local agents.

name: DAIWABO HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Daiwabo Holdings Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacture, processing and sale of textile products, sale of information equipment, manufacture and sale of machine tools. It has four business segments. Information Technology Infrastructure Distribution business sells computer and peripheral equipment, provides one-stop services of logistics and technical services, provides solution business of system development, network construction. Textiles business is engaged in manufacture, processing and sale of synthetic cotton, non-woven products, industrial materials products, textiles, knits, secondary products. Industrial Machinery business manufactures and sells machine tools, automatic machines. It is also engaged in hotel business, real estate leasing and management, provision of general affairs, personnel and financial services, development and operation of information processing systems, civil engineering and construction, insurance agency and finance business.

name: CUBE SYSTEM INC
businessSummary: CUBE SYSTEM INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of system solutions and services. It has three kinds of services. The system integration services are engaged in the provision of system user interface design, environment design, basic design, programming design and system testing services for customer's information system construction. The system outsourcing services are engaged in the services’ provision for system operation and evaluation, mechanism reform and system replacement. The professional services are engaged in the provision of systematization consulting service, database efficiency service, system monitoring service and other technical services by development tools and technology levels.

name: MITSUBISHI CHEMICAL GROUP CORP
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Chemical Group Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the functional products, healthcare and materials business. The Company operates through five segments. The Specialty Materials segment provides polymers and coatings additives, films and molding materials, and advanced solutions, including life solutions and information electronics. The Industrial Gases segment provides industrial gases. The Healthcare segment provides pharmaceuticals. The Methyl Methacrylate (MMA) segment provides MMA and Polymethylmethacrylate (PMMA). The Basic Materials segment provides petrochemical infrastructure, polyolefins, basic chemicals, and carbon. The Company also provides engineering, transportation and warehousing services.

name: ISB CORP
businessSummary: ISB CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in information service business and security system business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Information Service segment is engaged in development of embedded software for mobile, medical and automotive; verification of mobile equipment; software development in core system; data center service; the construction, operation, design and operation of infrastructure such as cloud; maintenance service; system operation service; the development and sale of commercial package products; the development of system and sale of equipment accompanying software development. The Security System segment is engaged in manufacture, sale and maintenance of access control system, electric lock and numeric keypad.

name: SAN-A CO LTD
