businessSummary: San-A Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of fresh and processed foods and other food products, clothing, home appliances, daily necessities, and other household goods, as well as dining out. It operates through two business segments. The Retail Business segment sells food products, clothing, and household goods, and provides dining out services. The Convenience Store (CVS) Business segment operates CVS Lawson franchise system and directly managed stores in Okinawa Prefecture. It also engages in product delivery, inspection, pricing, and sorting business, and non-life insurance agency business.

name: SUMITOMO WAREHOUSE CO LTD
businessSummary: Sumitomo Warehouse Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the integrated logistics business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Logistics segment is engaged in the warehousing, harbor transportation, international transportation and land transportation, as well as the development of software related to its logistics business. The Marine Transportation segment is engaged in the freight transportation using ships, and the operation of marine transportation agents. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the trading, leasing and management of business offices and lands.

name: KSK CO LTD
businessSummary: KSK CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the support of semiconductor design, embedded software development, software development, and network construction. The Company operates in three business segments. The System Core segment is engaged in the development and design of large-scale integration (LSI), the design of hardware systems, and the development of embedded software. The IT Solutions segment is engaged in the development of packaged software, the contract development of application software, the development of computer-aided design (CAD) systems and Website systems, data entry service, operator dispatch, as well as nursing-care and welfare service. The Network Service segment is engaged in the building, site adjustment, the operation and maintenance of communications and computer related systems, the operation and management of CAD systems, and support center business.

name: OVAL CORP
businessSummary: OVAL Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly operates in sensors manufacturing business. The sensors division manufactures and sells industrial measuring equipment and related equipment. The systems division manufactures and sells instrumentation and control and management equipment. The service devision is responsible for the maintenance of industrial measuring instruments and equipment, and the calibration of flow meters. Products include flow meters, electronic meters, peripheral and related equipment and system equipment.

name: MUSASHINO BANK LTD
businessSummary: Musashino Bank Ltd mainly operates banking business, and financial services including leasing business and credit guarantee services. The Company operates in three business segments. The Banking segment is engaged in the provision of deposit and loan services, exchange business and investment of securities business. The Leasing segment is engaged in the provision of finance-related leasing services. The Credit Guarantee segment is engaged in the provision of finance-related credit guarantee services. The other businesses include money lending, credit guarantee services related to card operations, the development, sales and maintenance of computer systems, research and study of the prefecture's economy and industry, management and tax consultations, the operation of seminars, the investment in venture companies, the management consultations, administrative agency services, regional trading company operations, consulting services, investment management and investment advisory services.

name: NOJIMA CORP
businessSummary: Nojima Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the sale of digital home appliances, related installation work, repairs and technical guidance. The Company operates its business through six segments. Digital Home Appliance Specialty Store Operation segment engages in the sale of digital audio-visual (AV) equipment, along with related services. The Segment also engages in the sale of information technology (IT) and information-related devices. Overseas segment engages in the sale of digital AV equipment, IT and information-related devices, household electrical appliances and home furniture. Carrier Shop Operation segment provides sales and related services for communication devices. Internet segment offers broadband connection services, along with communication, security and other related services. Product segment involves in the planning, design, development, manufacturing and sales of computers and provides related services. Financial segment offers financial product trading services.

name: NIPPON SHOKUBAI CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Shokubai Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemicals. It has two business segments. The Materials Business segment includes acrylic acid, acrylic esters, ethylene oxide, ethylene glycol, ethanolamine, special esters, superabsorbent polymers, maleic anhydride, and process catalysts. The Solutions Business segment includes polymers for concrete admixtures, glycol ethers, secondary compounds, alcohol ethoxylates, water-soluble polymers such as detergent raw materials, pharmaceutical intermediates, electronic information materials, iodine compounds, resins for adhesives and paints, ethyleneimine derivatives, adhesive products, automotive catalysts, denitrification catalysts, dioxin decomposition catalysts, exhaust gas treatment equipment, wet oxidation catalysts, and battery materials.

name: SYSTEM RESEARCH CO LTD
businessSummary: SYSTEM RESEARCH CO., LTD. involves in system integration and software development. The Company operates software related business. Its SI Services segment involves in planning, design, development of information systems. The software development business, centering on major companies, engages in system development and maintenance. Software project business creates, sells, and maintains programs for unspecified users. Product sales business conducts purchase and sale of products such as information equipment, software and others. Others include website management, cloud service.

name: TSURUMI MANUFACTURING CO LTD
businessSummary: Tsurumi Manufacturing Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of pumps. It operates through four regional segments including Japan, North America, Asia, and Europe. It manufactures, purchases, sells (including imports and exports), and leases various pumps, mainly submersible pumps, environmental equipment, and related equipment, as well as provides repair and after-sales services. It also engages in machinery and equipment installation, civil engineering, electrical work, piping, waterworks, cleaning facilities, steel structure construction, secondhand goods sales, fixed asset leasing, and the casting, manufacture, purchasing and sale of various pump parts. It is also engaged in real estate rental and machinery, office equipment and vehicle leasing business.

name: JAPAN LIFELINE CO LTD
businessSummary: Japan Lifeline Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture, import, and sale of medical devices, mainly in the cardiovascular field. The Company's products include cardiac pacemakers, implantable cardioverter defibrillators (ICDs), and biventricular pacemakers with defibrillation function (CRT-Ds) used to treat cardiac arrhythmias, electrophysiology (EP) catheters used to examine cardiac arrhythmias, ablation catheters used to treat arrhythmias, artificial blood vessels, frozen elephant trunks, and stent grafts used to treat aortic diseases, embolization coils, thrombus aspiration catheters, and stent retrievers used in cerebrovascular treatment, as well as colonic stents, gastric and duodenal stents used to treat digestive diseases, radiofrequency ablation electrode needles for the treatment of liver cancer, and bile duct tube stents.

name: SOFTWARE SERVICE INC
businessSummary: Software Service, Inc. is primarily engaged in providing medical information systems. The Company operates in three segments. The Medical Information Systems segment develops, sells and provides guidance of medical information systems, such as electronic charts and ordering systems. The Maintenance Service segment provides maintenance service for users of its medical information systems using online network. The Hardware Sales segment sells required hardware such as servers together with the introduction of the medical information systems.

name: TAKEUCHI MFG CO LTD
businessSummary: Takeuchi Mfg Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of construction machinery. The Company operates its business through five geographical segments: Japan, the United Sates, the United Kingdom, France and China. The Company’s main products are deep foundation excavators, disassembled electric mini backhoes, mini excavators and hydraulic excavators, as well as crawler loaders. It also provides standard machines, ultra-small turning machines, crawler loaders to the international market.

name: RASA INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: Rasa Industries, Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemicals such as flocculants for water treatment, industrial waste treatment machines and special screens, others business about precision machinery, catalyst regeneration for petroleum refining, as well as real estate leasing business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Chemical Products segment is engaged in production of phosphoric acid and phosphorus secondary salts, flocculating agents for water treatment, high-performance drugs for the electronics industry and antibacterial agents. The Machinery segment is engaged in production of digging machines, shredding related machines, municipal solid waste and industrial waste processing machines. The Electronic Materials segment is engaged in production of high purity inorganic materials and radioactive iodine adsorbents. In addition, the Company is also engaged in reprocessing business and real estate leasing business.

name: SUBARU CORP
businessSummary: Subaru Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture of Subaru automobiles. The Company operates through two business segments. The Automobile segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale and repairing of mini cars, small cars, ordinary cars and their parts. The Aerospace segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale and repairing of aircraft, space-related equipment and parts. The Company is also engaged in real estate leasing business.

name: ARATA CORP
businessSummary: Arata Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the wholesale of cosmetics, daily used products, household products and pet products. The Company's main business is the wholesale of daily necessities, cosmetics and others, mainly to drugstores, home improvement centers, supermarkets, and general merchandise stores. Health and beauty products include cosmetics, shampoo, soap, bath additives, and oral care products. Household products include laundry detergent, kitchen detergent, dishwashing detergent, and household cleaners. Home care products include insecticides, air fresheners/deodorizers, and batteries. Paper products include household paper, tissues, toilet paper, and disposable diapers. Household goods include plastic wrap/toilet paper, sponges/scrubbing brushes, cooking utensils, and cleaning supplies. Pet supplies include pet food and pet supplies.

name: NISSHINBO HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Nisshinbo Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the wireless and communications, microdevices, brakes and other businesses. The Company has seven business segments. The Wireless and Communication segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of wireless communication equipment. The Microdevice segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of electronic components. The Brake segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of friction materials for automobile brakes. The Precision Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of mechatronics products and plastic molded products. The Chemicals segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of rigid urethane foams, carbon products and others. The Textile segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cotton yarns, spandex products and clothing. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing and sale of real estate. The Company also sells food and industrial materials and provides telemedicine services.

name: MIRAIT ONE CORP
businessSummary: Mirait One Corp is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in the nippon telegraph and telephone (NTT) business, multicareer business, environment and social innovation business, as well as information communications technology (ICT) solution business. The Company operates through seven segments, including MIRAIT, MIRAIT Technologies, Lantrovision, TTK, Solcom and Shikokutsuken, Seibu Construction. The seven segments are involved in the information communication engineering, electrical equipment works and air condition maintenance business. The Company is also engaged in the communication infrastructure business, global business, and mobile network business.

name: S&B FOODS INC
businessSummary: S&B FOODS INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, processing and distribution of foodstuffs, with a focus on manufacturing and processing food products that use spices as raw materials. The Company operates in two business segments. The Foodstuff segment is involved in the production and sale of various spices and condiments, instant curry, tube products, retort curry and others, as well as the procurement of related raw materials. The Cooked Food segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cooked food.

name: SHOEI YAKUHIN CO LTD
businessSummary: SHOEI YAKUHIN CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in chemicals business. The Company mainly operates in three segments. The Chemicals segment is engaged in the sale of chemicals, including oleochemical, such as fatty acids, fatty amines, fatty alcohols and glycerin, as well as surfactants, among others. The Daily Necessities segment is engaged in the plan, development and sale of detergents, cosmetics and various ideas miscellaneous goods. The Civil Engineering and Construction Materials segment is engaged in the sale of ground improvement chemicals, repair materials, and environmental improvement chemicals.

name: ALTECH CORP
businessSummary: Altech Corporation is a Japan-based company that principally engaged in the provision of outsourcing services. The Company operates in two business segments. The Outsourcing Service segment is engaged in the dispatching of technicians for mechanical, electrical and information processing and designing; the undertaken of technology projects, as well as staffing and contracted operation of office support and computer-aided design (CAD) business. The Global segment is engaged in the installation and maintenance of industrial machinery and equipment for overseas Japanese factories, as well as the provision of human resource services. The Company has four subsidiaries.

name: OBARA GROUP INC
businessSummary: Obara Group Incorporated is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of welders and polishers. The Company operates in two segments. The Welders segment is primarily engaged in the manufacturing and sales of welding guns, electrodes and related devices to the automotive industry. The Polishers segment is primarily engaged in the manufacturing and sales of polishing machines to the electronics industry. The Company mainly operates in Japan, Asia-Pacific and the Americas areas.

name: ADVANCED MEDIA INC
businessSummary: Advanced Media, Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in the voice recognition business. The Voice Recognition segment operates through three business divisions. The Solution division is engaged in the planning, design, development of voice recognition solutions embedded with voice-recognition technology. The Product division provides applications embedded with voice-recognition technology. The Service segment provides other services utilizing voice-recognition technology. The Company provides its solutions, applications and services to enterprises and institutions in a variety of industries, including call centers, manufacture and distribution, mobiles, entertainment and education, medical and conference recording, as well as individual customers.

name: MCJ CO LTD
businessSummary: MCJ Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the computer related business and the general entertainment business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Computer Related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of computer products, the wholesale and sale of computer parts, as well as the development and sale of monitors. The General Entertainment segment is engaged in the operation of composite cafes under the aprecio brand and 24-hour fitness clubs under the MIRA fitness brand.

name: TOHO SYSTEM SCIENCE CO LTD
businessSummary: TOHO SYSTEM SCIENCE CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the software development and computer operation management. The Company operates through two business segments. The Software Development segment is engaged in the development of software for financial users such as insurance corporations, securities corporations and banks, as well as for communication industry. The Information System Service segment is involved in the operation and management of users' computers.

name: TOUMEI CO LTD
businessSummary: TOUMEI.CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly provides office-related services. The Company mainly operates in three segments. The Office Hikaru 119 segment is engaged in the sale of the Company’s brand Office Hikaru 119 which provides the one-stop office-related services including optical collaboration service to small medium enterprise (SME) and individual employers, besides it is also doing business as an agent of the NTT Group to handle optical line services. The Office Solution segment is engaged in the sale of information communication equipment such as business phones, unified threat management (UTM) equipment, network compatible multifunction machines, light emitting diode (LED) lighting equipment, electric lights and the providing of Rentakun services. The Financial Planning segment is engaged in the visiting shop insurance brokerage. Other business includes real estate leasing business.

name: CENTRAL AUTOMOTIVE PRODUCTS LTD
businessSummary: Central Automotive Products Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the wholesale, import and export of automobile parts, supplies and accessories, as well as the manufacture and sale of automobile supplies. It operates through two segments. The Auto Parts and Supplies Sales segment is engaged in the development, sale, import and export of automobile parts, supplies, new products and related services, the sale of new and used cars, and the manufacture and sale of chemical supplies. The Automobile Disposal segment is engaged in the disposal of vehicles certified as total losses by non-life insurance companies.

name: KOMERI CO LTD
businessSummary: KOMERI CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the home center business. The Company is engaged in the sale of hardware, tools and construction materials, as well as the green products such as horticulture, plants and agricultural materials. The Company is engaged in the store operation of Power and Home Center, which sell life related products, and the operation of Hard & Green, which is engaged in the sale of hardware and horticulture products. The Company is also engaged in the product storage and delivery business, information processing and software development business, credit card and related business, insurance agency business, renovation work, cleaning, repair and maintenance work. It is also engaged in the delivery of fuel to group companies, the sale of liquefied petroleum gas, gasoline, kerosene and related equipment, the sale of books, and real estate leasing business.

name: AICA KOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Aica Kogyo Co Ltd is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sales of chemical products and building materials. The Company operates in two segments. The Chemical Product segment offers interior and exterior finishing materials, flooring materials, adhesives and organic solids. The Construction Material and Equipment segment offers melamine facing plates, coated plywood boards, doors, interior materials, counters and nonflammable dressed lumbers. The Company operates its businesses in Japan and overseas.

name: DENYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Denyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial electrical machinery and equipment, including engine generators, engine welders, and engine compressors, as well as the sale of related repair parts and after-sales services. The Company operates through regional segments in Japan, America, Asia, and Europe. The Japan segment manufactures and sells engine generators, engine welders, engine compressors, and other products, as well as manufacturing and selling generators for disaster prevention and emergency use. The America segment manufactures and sells engine generators. The Asia segment processes manufacturing parts, manufactures engine generators, and sells and leases/rents engine generators and engine welders. The Europe segment sells engine generators and engine welders in Europe.

name: SEGA SAMMY HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Sega Sammy Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the gaming machine business, entertainment content business and resort business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Gaming Machine segment is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of pachislo machines and pachinko machines. The Entertainment Content segment is engaged in the development and sale of packaged games and amusement equipment centering on digital games, the development and operation of amusement facilities, the planning, production, sale of animation movies, as well as the development, manufacture and sale of toys. The Resort segment is engaged in the development and operation of hotels and golf courses in integrated resort business and other facilities business.

name: SUZUKI MOTOR CORP
businessSummary: Suzuki Motor Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of motorcycles, automobiles, outboard motors and electric wheelchairs, as well as development of logistics and other services related to each business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Four-wheel Business segment is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of mini vehicles, compact vehicles, and standard-sized vehicles. The Two-wheeled Business segment is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of motorcycles and buggy cars. The Marine Business segment manufactures and sells outboard motors. The Others Business segment is engaged in the electric wheelchair, solar power generation, and real estate businesses.

name: T.HASEGAWA CO LTD
businessSummary: T.Hasegawa Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of fragrances and related businesses. The Company operates through three segments, including Japan, Asia, and the United States, and operates in the Fragrance division and the Food division. The Fragrance division includes fragrances used in cosmetics such as perfumes and creams, toiletries such as shampoos and soaps, and household products such as detergents. The Food division includes essences, food oil-based flavors, food powder flavors, seasonings, fruit processed products, and natural colors used in beverages, sweets, frozen desserts, desserts, and instant noodle soups.

name: MERCURIA HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Mercuria Holdings Co Ltd mainly manages the business of group companies and conducts incidental operations as a holding company. Through the wholly owned subsidiary, the Company operates fund operation business, which is involved in the management and operation of collective investment funds for both Japanese and overseas investors, and principal investment business, which is involved in the provision of principal investments towards the funds which are managed and operated by the Company. The Company operates Investment Management segment. The Company provides business investments and asset investments towards future growth investments, value investments, buyout investments, real estate investments and cash flow (CF) investments.

name: SANKO TECHNO CO LTD
businessSummary: SANKO TECHNO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in fastening business and functional materials business. The Company operates in two business segments. Fastening segment is mainly involved in the manufacture and sale of post-installed anchor, drills and fasteners. The segment also conducts construction management related to construction of earthquake-resistant reinforcement business, maintenance and conservation business, as well as solar related business. Functional Materials segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of sheets made of fiber-reinforced plastics (FRP), electric hydraulic tools, measuring instruments, as well as electronic printed circuit boards for display boards and observation machines of vehicles, among others.

name: YOTAI REFRACTORIES CO LTD
businessSummary: YOTAI REFRACTORIES CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of refractory products, as well as the furnace installation engineering business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Refractory Products segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of various refractory bricks such as basic bricks, high alumina bricks, clay bricks and silica bricks, and unshaped refractory products for irons and steels, nonferrous metals, cements, glass, furnaces and environmental equipment related kilns uses. The Engineering segment is engaged in the design and construction of various industrial kilns and environmental facilities that use refractories, as well as the contacted maintenance business.

name: ICOM INC
businessSummary: ICOM INCORPORATED is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of wireless communication equipment and network equipment. The Company operates through four geographical business segments including Japan, North America, Europe, Asia and Oceania. The Company’s main product categories include land-based radio communication equipment, amateur radio communication equipment, marine radio communication equipment, other radio communication equipment, network equipment, among others. The Company is engaged in the provision of products including SATELLITE PTT, aviation radio, IC-M37J, IC-M36J and others for marine systems, IC-7851, IC-7700 and others for fixed equipment, wireless Local Area Network (LAN) terminals, communication function expansion units and other products.

name: YE DIGITAL CORP
businessSummary: YE DIGITAL Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of information processing services such as building and operating information systems and developing and selling information processing software. The Company’s two business solutions centered on business system construction and services, and the Internet of things (IoT) solution business, which focuses on solutions that utilize artificial intelligence (AI) and big data analysis technology, as well as contracted development of embedded and control systems. The business solutions business builds core systems for companies (sales management, production management, purchasing management, accounting management and others), develops systems for mobile communication carriers (mobile phone subscriber management, accounting management), and provides solution system services for health insurers. The IoT solutions business builds smart logistics solutions, IoT and machine-to-machine (M2M) solutions.

name: KOKUYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Kokuyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of furniture and business supply distribution businesses in the work style field, and stationery and interior retail businesses in the lifestyle field. It operates through four business segments. The Furniture Business segment is engaged in space design and consultation, as well as the manufacture, purchase, sale, and installation of office furniture. The Business Supply Distribution business segment is engaged in the purchase, logistics, and sale of office supplies. The Stationery Business segment is engaged in the manufacture, purchase, and sale of stationery. The Interior Retail Business segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of interior and lifestyle goods. It also operates antenna shops.

name: OSG CORP
businessSummary: OSG Corp is engaged in the manufacture and sale of precision machine tools, such as cutting tools, rolling tools, measuring tools, machine tools, and machine parts. The Company's cutting tools include thread cutting tools such as taps and dies, milling cutters such as end mills and indexable tools, and drills and other cutting tools such as drills and diamond tools. Its rolling tools include thread rolling dies and trimming dies. Its measuring tools include thread gauges. Other products include machine tools such as rolling machines, tooling tools, raw materials, and line head (LH) sticks. The Company primarily produces and sells precision machine tools. The Company conducts the domestic sales of precision machine tools, and overseas sales in the Americas, Europe and Africa, and Asia, as well as other local subsidiaries. The Company operates in four segments including Japan, the Americas, Europe and Africa, and Asia. It mainly produces and sells precision machinery tools.

name: SANWA HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Sanwa Holdings Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of building and commercial facility construction materials, as well as the provision of maintenance and renovation services. The Company operates in three geological segments, including Japan segment, North America segment and Europe segment. Its products include shutters and related products, doors for buildings, partitions, stainless products, front desk products, windows, doors for housing, exterior products, garage doors for houses, and vehicle doors, etc.

name: SANRIN CO LTD
businessSummary: SANRIN CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the energy related business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Energy Related segment is mainly engaged in the purchase and sale of petroleum, liquefied petroleum (LP) gas, general high-pressure gas, charcoal, solar power generation systems and housing equipment, as well as the insurance agency business. The Ice Making segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of ice. The Fruit and Vegetable segment is mainly engaged in the purchase and sale of vegetables and fruits. The Real Estate segment is mainly engaged in the building lots and buildings transaction business. The Company is also engaged in the transportation business, the construction business, as well as the management and rental of LP gas related equipment.

name: GOODDAYS HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: gooddays holdings, Inc. is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in information technology (IT) and real estate related business. The Company mainly operates in two segments. The IT segment provides IT solutions including system development and the segment includes three business categories: system engineer (SE) service business, contract business and sales business. The Living Tech segment involves in the renovation business of real estate and real estate agency business through the running of real estate mediation site. The Living Tech segment includes three business categories: real estate brokerage business, operation business and media business.

name: NIPPON FINE CHEMICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Fine Chemical Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacturing and sales of industrial, pharmaceutical and cosmetic chemicals as well as household products. The Company operates in two segments. The Industrial Products segment is engaged in the manufacturing, sales and purchasing of cosmetic raw materials, pharmaceutical intermediates, resin additives, leather oils, vegetable fats and oils, synthetic resin products etc. The Household Products segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sales of industrial detergents, medicated soap solution, eradication and disinfectant, and insect repellent etc. Other businesses include real estate operation and consignment business of pharmacology and safety test.

name: SEIBU ELECTRIC & MACHINERY CO LTD
businessSummary: Seibu Electric & Machinery Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of transport machinery, industrial machinery and precision machinery, sale aftermarket service activities, as well as the sale of machinery parts and multi-story parking equipment and operation of parking lots. The Company operates in three business segments. The Transport Machinery segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of logistics systems and transport equipment. The Industrial Machinery segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of valve actuators and gate drive devices. The Precision Machinery segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of ultra-precision and high-precision wire electric discharge machines and ultra-precision and high-precision numerical control (NC) lathes. The Company is also engaged in the sale of mechanical equipment parts and multi-story parking equipment, as well as parking lot management and other businesses.

name: ABC-MART INC
businessSummary: ABC-Mart Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of shoes and the planning and development of its own products. It operates through two geographical segments including domestic and overseas. It operates shoe retail stores ABC-MART nationwide and sells mainly shoes. In Japan, it sells its own products, mainly shoes, under its own brands such as HAWKINS, Danner, ABC Select, and White's Boots, as well as national brand products, through retail stores such as ABC-MART, ABC-MART GRAND STAGE, and ABC-MART SPORTS located throughout the country, providing products that incorporate market needs and trends. It also plans and develops its own shoes, produces these products at contract factories both in Japan and overseas, and supplies them to the domestic market.

name: ZERIA PHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Zeria Pharmaceutical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of ethical drug business, consumer healthcare business and other business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Ethical Drug segment is engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of ethical drugs. The Consumer Healthcare segment is engaged in the manufacture, purchase and sale of over-the-counter (OTC) drugs, health foods, quasi drugs and cosmetics related to self-medication. The others include insurance agency business and real estate business, as well as various maintenance business such as purchasing and sale of promotional materials.

name: ZENKOKU HOSHO CO LTD
businessSummary: ZENKOKU HOSHO Co., Ltd. is mainly engaged in the operation of credit guarantee business. The Company’s guarantee products comprise three categories. The housing loan guarantees are its core products, which can meet the diverse needs of customers, such as housing acquisition funds and refinancing funds, and renovation funds and others. It acquires guarantee fees from guarantee requesters through the classification by collateral valuation and other requirements such as annual income and years of service. Education loan guarantee products guarantee the borrowings of education funds, which deal with term loans, overdraft and other formats. About the use of funds, it deals with tuition fees, exam costs and others. The apartment loan guarantee products guarantee the borrowings of construction costs of rental housing.

name: OPEN UP GROUP INC
businessSummary: Open Up Group Inc, former BeNext-Yumeshin Group Co, is a Japan-based company engaged in human resource services, mainly dispatching engineers and business contracting. The Company operates in four business segments. The Mechanical and Electrical, Information Technology (IT) Domain segment consists of mechanical, electrical and electronic engineers such as development, design and manufacturing technology at domestic manufacturers, and construction and development of networks, servers, software at IT companies. Dispatch and contract work by IT engineers for operation system. The Construction Domain segment mainly dispatches construction management engineers and computer-aided design (CAD) engineers to companies in the domestic construction industry. The Manufacturing Domain segment mainly dispatches and outsources work in the manufacturing process for domestic manufacturers. The Overseas Domain segment is engaged in dispatch, recruitment, and personnel consulting.

name: SAN-IN GODO BANK LTD
businessSummary: San-in Godo Bank Ltd operates business related to financial services such as leasing, and credit guarantee, with a focus on banking. The Bank operates in two business segments. The Banking segment is engaged in the deposit, loan, securities investment, domestic exchange, foreign exchange, bond and bond registration businesses through the head office and branches. The Leasing segment is involved in the leasing business. The others business is engaged in the banking, leasing and credit guarantee business.

name: OKABE CO LTD
businessSummary: Okabe Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of construction equipment and materials, and also focuses on developing other business fields. The Construction-related Products segment develops, manufactures, and sells temporary and formwork products, civil engineering products, and structural equipment products, and uses its sales network to purchase and sell building materials from other companies. In the United States and Indonesia, it manufactures and sells building materials and also manages commercial real estate. Other businesses include the manufacture and sale of industrial machinery products, the development, manufacture, and sale of marine materials, the planning and sale of bolts and nuts for automobiles in the United States, and tenant leasing.

name: NIPPON KAYAKU CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Kayaku Co Ltd is engaged in the mobility & imaging business, fine chemicals business and life sciences business. The Company operates in three segments. The Mobility & Imaging segment includes safety systems, such as airbag inflators, micro gas generators and squibs, and polatechno, which produces components for liquid crystal displays (LCDs), LCD projectors, and X-ray analyzers. The Fine Chemicals segment provides functional materials such as epoxy resins, maleimide resins, curing agents, reactive flame-retardant resins, acrylic esters, Ultraviolet (UV)-curable resins, resists for microelectromechanical systems, cleaners for LCDs and semiconductors, sealants, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, dyes for inkjet printers, dyes for inkjet textile printing, industrial inkjet inks, materials and dichroic dyes for light-control glass. The Life Science segment includes pharmaceutical-related products such as anti-cancer agents, biological products, and real estate rental business.

name: MEDIKIT CO LTD
businessSummary: MEDIKIT CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company involved in the development, manufacture and sale of medical equipment. Its major products consist of artificial diagnostic equipment, which includes indwelling needles that are used for artificial dialysis purposes; indwelling venous needles (anesthesia type), which are used for blood and fluid transfusion purposes, and angiography equipment, which includes introducers and angiographic catheters.

name: BML INC
businessSummary: BML Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the testing business. Data processed in the host core system is reported to customers as test results. Customer unit price data and specimen testing performance data held by the host core system become billing data for customers, which is then linked to the automatic recording of sales. Other businesses include the medical information systems business. The testing business segment undertakes contract work such as clinical testing, while the medical information systems business segment manufactures and sells system equipment for medical institutions and provides medical information services.

name: ORIGINAL ENGINEERING CONSULTANTS CO LTD
businessSummary: ORIGINAL ENGINEERING CONSULTANTS CO., LTD. is a Japan-based engineering consultancy company specialized in the fields of water supply, sewerage works, sanitation and solid waste treatment. The Construction Consultant business is engaged in the research, planning, designing and construction supervision of water and sewage facilities, as well as the design and seismic diagnosis of buildings and structures. The Information Processing business is engaged in the information management for urban facilities, the development of software, the outsourcing design of facilities, and the provision of support services for system management.

name: TOYOTA TSUSHO CORP
businessSummary: Toyota Tsusho Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the trading of various products, the manufacture, processing, sale and investment of the related products, as well as the provision of services. The Company operates in seven business segments. The Metals segment processes, manufactures, treats, and sells steel products and nonferrous metal ingots, among others. The Global Components & Logistics segment manufactures and assembles mobility parts and develops, designs, and sells mobility accessories. The Mobility segment sells and services vehicles and vehicle parts. The Machinery, Energy and Plant Projects segment provides manufacturing and distribution equipment, parts and tools, and construction equipment. The Chemicals & Electronics segment provides automotive components, semiconductors and electronic components. The Foods & Lifestyle Segment provides processed foods, and food ingredients. The Africa segment operates mobility, healthcare, consumer, and infrastructure businesses.

name: AMANO CORP
businessSummary: Amano Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of time information systems and environment-related system equipment. The Company operates through two business segments. The Time Information System segment is involved in the manufacture, sale and export sale of information system equipment, mainly employment information systems and payroll systems, and time management equipment, mainly time clocks, the sale of parking system equipment, as well as parking lots operation management, software products development and others. The Environmental-related System segment provides dust collectors, powder and granular material pneumatic conveying systems, high-temperature poisonous gas removal systems and electrolyzed water generation equipment and cleaning equipment. This segment also provides welfare services, non-life insurance agency services, work environment measurement, environmental measurement certification business and related consulting services.

name: CANARE ELECTRIC CO LTD
businessSummary: Canare Electric Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of cables, harnesses, connectors, equipment (passive and electronic) and supplementary equipment for broadcasting and communication applications. The Company operates through six geogrephical segments, including Japan, the United States, South Korea, China, Taiwan and Singapore. The Company’s main products include broadcasting cables and connectors such as optical transmission systems, cables, connectors, patch panels and others, AV & console solutions such as lecture desks, AV wagons, terminal boards, AV outlets and others, Digital network products such as network storage and AV-over-IP system, optical devices such as beam profilers and laser-related products.

name: ARGO GRAPHICS INC
businessSummary: ARGO GRAPHICS Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in the product lifecycle management (PLM) business and electronic design automation (EDA) business. The PLM segment consists of PLM solution business, system building support business and hardware maintenance and other business. The PLM solution business is engaged in the provision of PLM solutions, which target at the productivity improvement in manufacturing processes. The system building support business provides system building support services for the servers and personal computer (PC) clusters of manufacturers. The hardware maintenance (HM) and other business maintains the machines provided by the PLM solution and the system building support businesses. The EDA segment sells computer aided design (CAD) systems for electronic components and micro fabrication, including large scale integrated circuits, liquid crystal displays and other flat panel displays (FPD), magnetic head and micro machine.

name: TOKIO MARINE HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Tokio Marine Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the domestic non-life insurance business, domestic life insurance business, overseas insurance business, and financial and other businesses. The Company operates through four business segments. The Domestic Non-Life Insurance Business segment is engaged in no-life insurance underwriting business and asset management business in Japan. The Domestic Life Insurance Business segment is engaged in life insurance underwriting and asset management services in Japan. The Overseas Insurance Business segment is engaged in overseas insurance underwriting and asset management services. The Financial and Other Business segment is mainly engaged in the provision of investment advisory services, investment trust outsourcing services, staffing services, as well as real estate management and nursing care business.

name: ASAHI KASEI CORP
businessSummary: Asahi Kasei Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the materials business, housing business and healthcare business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Materials segment provides styrene monomer, acrylonitrile, polyethylene, automotive-related fibers, electronic materials, mixed signal large scale integrated circuits (LSI), hall elements, deep ultraviolet light-emitting diodes (LEDs), pharmaceutical and food additives and others. The Housing segment provides construction contracting, renovation and other housing-related business, as well as lightweight aerated concrete (ALC), insulation materials and others. The Healthcare segment provides medical drugs, hemodialysis and apheresis related equipment, virus removal filters, cardiopulmonary resuscitation-related products and others. The Company also provides plant engineering, environmental engineering, various research and information provision businesses, and personnel dispatch and introduction services.

name: D I SYSTEM CO LTD
businessSummary: D I System Co Ltd is a Japan-based independent information service company engaged in conduction of system integration business and education service security solution business. The Company operates in two business segments. The system integration business is engaged in design and development of business applications, design and construction of infrastructure systems, and operation and maintenance of business application infrastructure systems. The educational service security solution business provides educational services such as computer languages, databases, servers, and networks. The Company also develops, sells, introduces, and maintains security products.

name: DOUTOR NICHIRES HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Doutor Nichires Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in coffee roasting, processing and sales, and the management of various types of restaurants. It operates through three business segments. The Japan Restaurant System Group segment operates a chain of restaurants, primarily directly managed stores and is engaged in the procurement, production and sale of ingredients. The Doutor Coffee Group segment mainly operates coffee chains through directly managed stores and franchise systems and engages in business activities including purchasing coffee beans, roasting and processing them, selling them at directly managed stores, earning income from wholesale and royalties to franchise stores, and selling coffee products to convenience stores and other outlets. The Other segment engages in the manufacture and wholesale of Western confectionery, the manufacture and sale of bread, the direct import and provision of rare, high-quality coffee beans and tea and overseas business.

name: SHIN-ETSU POLYMER CO LTD
businessSummary: Shin-Etsu Polymer Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the electronic devices business, precision molded products business, and housing and lifestyle materials business. The Company operates through three segments. The Electronic Devices segment manufactures and sells input/output components and peripheral parts for automobiles and electronic equipment. The Precision Molded Products segment manufactures and sells precision molded products such as semiconductor wafer and electronic component handling materials, and parts for office automation (OA) equipment and medical devices. The Housing and Lifestyle Materials segment manufactures and sells resin-processed products like food packaging materials and housing-related materials, as well as functional materials used in automotive and machine tool parts and electronic components. The Company also engages in construction-related businesses.

name: MEIDENSHA CORP
businessSummary: Meidensha Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in power infrastructure, social systems, industrial e-mobility, field engineering and real estate businesses. It operates through five business segments. Power Infrastructure segment provides heavy electrical equipment and systems for generating and transmitting electricity to electric power companies and other entities. Social Systems segment provides heavy electrical equipment and systems to government agencies, railway operators and private companies. Industrial Electronic Mobility segment provides component products for the semiconductor, general industrial, and electric vehicle (EV) fields, as well as systems for the automotive industry. Field Engineering segment is engaged in the maintenance and repair of electrical equipment. Real Estate segment engages in the leasing of real estate properties it owns. It also provides electrochemical measuring equipment and electrical insulation materials, and employee welfare services.

name: ASAHI YUKIZAI CORP
businessSummary: ASAHI YUKIZAI CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of industrial resin and plumbing equipment products. The Company operates its business through three business segments. The Pipe System segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of piping materials made of synthetic resin such as vinyl chloride, as well as the design and construction of piping works. The Resin segment manufactures and sells casting resins, resin coated sand for castings, resins for general industrial use, resins for foam materials, resins and derivatives for electronic materials, and resin molding materials. The Water Treatment & Resource Development segment is involved in the design, construction, maintenance and management of water treatment facilities, as well as the design and construction of drilling wells.

name: HOWTELEVISION INC
businessSummary: Howtelevision, Inc. mainly operates carrier platform business through the operation and management of the recruiting platform gaishishukatsu.com, Liiga and Elite Youth Recruiting DSP. The gaishishukatsu.com is a new graduate student recruitment platform, posting the recruiting information of companies. Liiga aims to support the skill development and career development of young working people who are registered members through columns, case studies and industry research. The DSP service collects fees by advertising distribution companies through the management of Elite Youth Recruiting DSP, an advertising distribution platform specialized for Elite Youth.

name: RION CO LTD
businessSummary: Rion Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and service of particle counters, medical equipment and environmental equipment. It operates through three segments. The Particle Counter segment manufactures and sells particle counters such as liquid particle counters and airborne particle counters. The Medical Equipment segment manufactures and sells hearing aids and medical testing equipment. The Environmental Equipment segment manufactures and sells sound and vibration measuring instruments such as sound level meters, vibration meters, seismometers and frequency analyzers.

name: CAWACHI LTD
businessSummary: Cawachi Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the retail business that operates drugstores selling pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, daily necessities, food, and alcoholic beverages, as well as drugstores with attached pharmacies whose main business is prescription dispensing. The Company’s products include pharmaceuticals such as cold medicines, gastrointestinal medicines, various vitamins, eye drops, external medicines, health foods, nursing care products, dispensing, cosmetics such as basic skincare, makeup, and men's cosmetics, hair care products, oral care products, detergents, paper products, pet supplies, and childcare products, general foods such as processed foods, daily necessities, confectionery, beverages, and alcohol.

name: NITTETSU MINING CO LTD
businessSummary: Nittetsu Mining Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in resource business, machinery & environment business, real estate business and renewable energy business. The Company operates in five business segments. Ore segment mainly sells limestone, crushed stones, processed products and other related products produced from limestone mines owned by the Company. Metal segment is involved in the smelting and sale of copper bullion and the sale of copper concentrate. Machinery & Environment segment is involved in the sale of water treatment agents and the manufacture and sale of environmentally-friendly products such as dust collectors. Real Estate segment is involved in the rental of office buildings, condominiums, stores, factories and warehouses, as well as the sale of real estate. Renewable Energy segment develops environment-friendly energy through the geothermal sector, solar power generation and hydroelectric power generation.

name: YOSHIMURA FOOD HOLDINGS KK
businessSummary: Yoshimura Food Holdings KK is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of support service for sales marketing, product development, production control, purchasing logistics, quality control, and business management. The Company operates through two business segments. The Manufacturing Business segment develops and manufactures its own products, and domestic subsidiaries sell them mainly through wholesalers to supermarkets, convenience stores, and drug stores throughout Japan, and overseas subsidiaries mainly sell to hotels, restaurants, supermarkets in Singapore and Malaysia. The Sales Business segment is engaged in the sale products to industrial food service providers, consumer cooperatives, supermarkets, hotels, restaurants.

name: MARUZEN SHOWA UNYU CO LTD
businessSummary: Maruzen Showa Unyu Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the lorry transportation business, port transportation business and on-site work. The Company operates through two business segments. The Logistics segment is involved in the lorry transportation business, freight transportation business (lorry, railroad, ocean shipping, coastal shipping, and air transportation), port transportation business (general port transportation, port cargo handling (onboard and coastal barge transportation), warehouse Business, customs clearance, packing, marine transportation and air transportation agency. The On-Site Work and Machinery Cargo Handling segment is engaged in the transportation, assembly, replenishing, storage and cargo handling of raw materials, products, heavy cargos and precision machinery in factories, as well as the leasing of machinery. The Company also provides services such as construction, security, real estate, insurance agency and car maintenance.

name: RAITO KOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Raito Kogyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in construction and other related business activities. The Company operates through the construction segment. The Construction segment undertakes slope and embankment protection works, foundation and ground improvement works, repair and reinforcement work, environmental restoration works, general civil engineering and building construction works, as well as contracting for construction projects and sales of construction materials. The Segment also provides labor contracting services within construction projects. The Company also engages in product and material sales, leasing vehicles, construction machinery and office equipment, management of welfare facilities, insurance agency services for property and life insurance, operation of senior housing with services, nursing care services and home-visit care business.

name: KOZO KEIKAKU ENGINEERING HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Kozo Keikaku Engineering Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of engineering consulting and product services. The Company operates through two business segments. The Engineering Consulting segment provides structural design and structural analysis consulting, environmental assessment and disaster prevention consulting, system development in the housing and construction field, decision support consulting, and information and communications technology consulting. The Product Services segment provides manufacturing-related services, architecture and civil engineering-related services, information and communications-related services, and other cross-industry services.

name: OSAKI ELECTRIC CO LTD
businessSummary: Osaki Electric Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the measurement and control business. It operates through three segments. The Domestic Measurement and Control segment manufactures and sells watt-hour meters, smart meters, instrument transformers, energy management systems, smart locks, distribution boards, monitoring and control devices, meter reading systems and equipment, and manages building facilities. The Overseas Measurement and Control segment manufactures and sells watt-hour meters, smart meters and related systems, and measurement and control equipment. The Real Estate segment is involved in the real estate leasing business.

name: UNIVERSAL ENGEISHA CO LTD
businessSummary: UNIVERSAL ENGEISHA CO.,LTD is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the green business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Green business segment is engaged in rental green business and horticulture related products handled business throughout Kansai area, Kanto area and overseas area. The Wholesale business segment is engaged in sales of artificial flower, exterior stone and decorative plant. The Retail business segment is engaged in sales of plant, decorative plant and gardening materials in shops.

name: YAMATO KOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Yamato Kogyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the steel business. It operates through four segments. The Steel (Japan) segment manufactures and sells H-beams, channel steel, I-beams, steel sheet piles, checkered H-beams, shipbuilding steel, castings, ship canning products, and heavy machinery processed products. The Steel (Thailand) segment manufactures and sells H-beams, channel steel, I-beams, and steel sheet piles. The Steel (Indonesia) segment manufactures and sells H-beams, channel steel, and equal-leg angle steel. The Track Supplies segment processes and sells turnouts, expansion joints, non-gap electron beam welded (NEW) crossings, adhesive insulated rails, derailment prevention guards, tie plates, and bolts. The Company is also engaged in the manufacture and sale of counterweights, transportation, medical waste disposal, and real estate businesses.

name: SUMITOMO CHEMICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Sumitomo Chemical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company that operates the chemical business. The Company has five segments. Essential & Green Materials segment manufactures and sells synthetic resins, raw materials for synthetic fibers, industrial chemicals, methacrylate, processed synthetic resin products, aluminum and alumina and synthetic rubber. Advanced Medical Solutions segment handles process development and contract manufacturing for pharmaceuticals and others. Information and Communication Technology (ICT) & Mobility Solutions segment handles optical products, semiconductor process materials, compound semiconductor materials, touch sensor panels, chemical products, engineering plastics and battery materials. Agro & Life Solutions segment handles agricultural chemicals, fertilizers, agricultural materials, pest control insecticides and materials for tropical disease control. Sumitomo Pharma segment handles small molecule pharmaceuticals. The Company also provides other businesses.

name: SEKISUI CHEMICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Sekisui Chemical Co Ltd is mainly engaged in housing business, environment and life line business, high-performance plastics business and medical business. The Company operates in four segments. The Housing segment is engaged in the manufacture, construction and sale of steel-frame and wood-frame modular housing, the sale of land for sale, renovation, real estate brokerage, rental management, interior and exterior sales and construction. The Environment & Life Line segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale and construction of polyvinyl chloride pipes and fittings, polyethylene pipes and fittings, plastic valves and others. The High-Performance Plastics segment manufactures and sells liquid crystal particles and photosensitive materials. The Medical segment manufactures and sells clinical diagnostic reagents, automatic analyzers and blood collection tubes. The other businesses include the provision of services for film-type lithium-ion batteries and products.

name: EBARA FOODS INDUSTRY INC
businessSummary: EBARA Foods Industry, Inc. is a food manufacturing company. The Food segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of sauce for various meat, such as barbecued meat sauce and chicken sauce; sauce for stew, such as Korean pickled cabbage hot pot sauce, and sauce for vegetables, such as pickle sauce, as well as the manufacture and sale of other food, including curry flakes, konjac and seaweed salads. The segment also involves in the manufacture and sale of soup, such chicken-bone soup and noodle soup. The others business is engaged in the advertising business, temporary staffing business, the operation of warehousing and cargo transportation businesses.

name: SYUPPIN CO LTD
businessSummary: Syuppin Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the purchase and sale of used and new goods through Internet or retail stores. It has four business segments. Camera segment operates Map Camera, selling used and new models, including Leica, Rollei, Hasselblad and Zeiss, as well as domestic and international digital cameras, film cameras and interchangeable lenses. Watch segment operates GMT, providing used and new mechanical watches, including Patek Philippe, A. Lange & Sohne, Rolex and Breitling. Under the trade name BRILLER, it offers women's watches, including Rolex, Cartier and Chanel, as well as designer bags. Writing Instruments segment operates KINGDOM NOTE as a writing instrument store stocking both new and used items, including brand-name fountain pens and ballpoint pens. Bicycle segment operates CROWN GEARS as a road bike store stocking both new and used items, including road bikes, mini-bikes, mountain bikes and others, as well as related parts and accessories.

name: TAKARA HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Takara Holdings Inc is Japan-based alcoholic beverage manufacturing holding company. The Company operates three segments. The Takara Shuzo segment manufactures and sells alcoholic beverages, including shochu, sake, and soft alcoholic beverages, as well as alcoholic seasonings such as mirin, food seasonings, and raw alcohol in Japan. The Takara Shuzo International Group segment exports alcoholic beverages from Japan, manufactures and sells alcoholic beverages overseas, and wholesales Japanese food ingredients. The Takara Bio Group segment develops bio-drug discovery technology through its reagent and equipment business and contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) business. The Company also engages in freight transportation, wine import and sales, and real estate rental businesses.

name: PILOT CORP
businessSummary: Pilot Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture, purchasing and sale of stationery items such as writing instruments and toys. The Company operates through four geographical segments: Japan, Americas, Europe, Asia (including Africa and Oceania). The Company’s main business is the manufacture and sale of writing instruments. Its main products include writing instruments such as fountain pens, ballpoint pens, mechanical pencils, multifunction pens, color pens, felt-tip pens, markers, drawing materials and drawing pens; stationery items such as business bags, correction items, office stationery, whiteboards, and notebooks. In addition to stationery supplies, the Japan segment is also involved in the manufacture, purchasing and sale of toys, precious metal accessories such as rings, and ceramic parts.

name: CANON ELECTRONICS INC
businessSummary: CANON ELECTRONICS INC. is a japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of components and electronic information equipment. The Company operates in two business segments. Component segment’s main products are shutter units, aperture units and laser scanner units. Electronic Information Equipment segment’s main products are document scanners, handy terminals and laser printers. The Company also provides customer information management services, business card management services, system development, maintenance and operation services, as well as medical equipment such as blood pressure monitors, sterilizers and medicine packaging machines.

name: YAMAZAKI BAKING CO LTD
businessSummary: Yamazaki Baking Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the food business, distribution business, and other businesses. The Company has three business segments. The Food Business segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of bread, Japanese and Western confectionery, prepared bread and rice dishes, confectionery and rice crackers. The Distribution Business segment is engaged in the convenience store business and the operation of food supermarkets. The Other Business segment is engaged in logistics business, contracting the design, supervision and construction of food manufacturing equipment, administrative contracting and outsourcing, non-life insurance agency business, and the manufacture and sale of cleaning agents for food manufacturing machinery and equipment.

name: STELLA CHEMIFA CORP
businessSummary: STELLA CHEMIFA CORPORATION is mainly engaged in the manufacture, import and sale of high-purity chemicals. The Company has six business segments. The High-purity Chemical segment manufactures and sells high-purity chemicals with a focus on fluoride used for etching agents, detergents, electrolytes for lithium-ion secondary batteries and others. The Transportation segment is engaged in the logistics business focusing on chemicals, the warehousing and customs clearance businesses. The Medical segment is involved in the development and research of cancer treatment drugs. The Cosmetics segment sells cosmetics such as basic skin care. The Energy Management segment is engaged in the development and sale of network-related equipment and software. The Others segment is engaged in the maintenance of automobiles, the provision of insurance agency services, as well as the manufacture and sale of photoluminescent products. As of March 31, 2014, it had 11 subsidiaries and one associated company.

name: NIPPON TELEVISION HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Nippon Television Holdings, Inc. is a certified broadcast holding company. The Company operates in three business segments. The Content Business segment is engaged in the sale of television advertising frames, the licensing of program contents, the production and publication of movies, the organizing of events, mail order business and the publishing and sale of publications, program broadcasting operations, homepage design and Website operation, as well as advertising and marketing business, among others. The Real Estate Leasing segment leases offices and commercial tenants and lands, and provides building management services. The Company is also engaged in ecology related business, the operation of stores and other businesses.

name: HEIWADO CO., LTD
businessSummary: HEIWADO CO., LTD. is mainly engaged in the retail sales and peripheral businesses. It has three segments. The Retail segment is engaged in sales of food products, clothing products, and daily goods. The Retail Peripheral segment involves rental of stores, management of commercial infrastructure and maintenance of buildings. The Others segment is engaged in management of suburban restaurants, family restaurants, amusements, bowling alleys, as well as development, sales and maintenance of real estate.

name: EBARA JITSUGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: EBARA JITSUGYO CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based manufacturing company operating in three business segments. The Environment segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of ozone densitometers, ozone application equipment, deodorization equipment, anti infectious disease measures, fish farm-related equipment and waste sorting equipment, among others. The Water Treatment segment is engaged in the design and construction of water supply facilities and sewerage facilities, as well as the provision of industrial waste water treatment services. The Wind and Hydraulic Powered Equipment and Thermal Equipment Related segment provides wind and hydraulic powered equipment, as well as the sale, construction and maintenance works of thermal equipment.

name: DENSO CORP
businessSummary: Denso Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of automotive parts in the areas of thermal systems, powertrain systems, mobility electronics, electrification systems, advanced devices, and non-automotive business. The Company operates through four segments, including Japan, North America, Europe, and Asia. Thermal system products include passenger thermals and commercial thermals. Powertrain system products include injection equipment, and engine equipment. Mobility electronics products include electronics products, and safety system products. Electrification system products include electrification components, power mobility electronics, and motors. Advanced device products include mechatronics systems, and sensing systems. Non-automotive business includes AUTO-ID-related products, and factory automation (FA)-related products. The Company also operates business activities through local subsidiaries in South America and other regions.

name: COMPUTER INSTITUTE OF JAPAN LTD
businessSummary: Computer Institute of Japan, Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of system development and related services. The system development services are engaged in the design, manufacture, operation and maintenance of systems. The consultation and research services provide system consultation and research services. The system and package integration services are involved in the integration services of system or its own software products. The other services are engaged in the provision of other services and the sale of computer products.

name: VERTEX CORP
businessSummary: Vertex Corporation is a Japan-based holding company engaged in the operation and management of subsidiaries which manufacture secondary concrete products and other related business. The Company’s subsidiary HOKUKON CO., LTD operates through four business segments: block business, pile business, construction business and other business. The Company’s subsidiary HANEDA ZENITH HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd operates business through four business segments: concrete products, ceramic business, construction business, as well as other business.

name: NICHIBAN CO LTD
businessSummary: NICHIBAN CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of medical products, adhesive tapes and adhesives, as well as related equipment. The Company has two business segments. The Medical segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals based on cloth, paper, cellophane and plastic, medical equipment, cosmetics, medical auxiliary tapes, taping tapes and other tapes for medical use. The Tapes segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of adhesive tapes, adhesive sheets and related equipment for home and office use, and industrial use.

name: FULLCAST HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Fullcast Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the human resource outsourcing business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Short-term Business Support segment is engaged in the provision of short-term, events-related human resource services and payroll management service, among others. The Sales Support segment includes agency sales and call center business. The Security and Others segment is engaged in the security guard business for public facilities and general corporations.

name: SAINT-CARE HOLDING CORP
businessSummary: SAINT-CARE HOLDING CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in nursing-care services. The Nursing-care Service segment provides visiting care service, home-visit bathing service, in-home long-term care management, home visit nursing, sales and rental of social welfare equipment, daily-life group care for the elderly with dementia, day care, short-stay daily-life care service, small-scale and multifunction type in-home care, regular visiting & as-needed handling type visiting care and home visit nursing, small-scale and multifunction type in-home care with home visit nursing, daily-life care service in specified facilities and home renovation service. The Company is also engaged in employment transition support business for disabled people, outsourcing business such as production of printed matters, the sale of nursing care insurance application service provider (ASP) systems, shared service business, personnel dispatch business and the sale of care robots.

name: NIPPON PARKING DEVELOPMENT CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Parking Development Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the parking lot business, the ski resort business and the theme park business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Parking Lots segment is engaged in the operation and management of parking lots, such as direct management, leasing, management, and monthly rental car businesses. The Ski Resorts segment is engaged in the operation and acquisition of ski resorts. The Theme Parks segment is engaged in the operation and acquisition of theme parks. The Company is also engaged in the car sharing business, education business, healthcare business, and renewable energy business, real estate business and other businesses.

name: MAZDA MOTOR CORP
businessSummary: Mazda Motor Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and distribution of automobiles and automobile parts. The Company operates through four segments, including Japan, North America, Europe and Other Regions. The Company is engaged in the manufacture of passenger cars and the sale of passenger cars and trucks. The Company's main product lines include passenger cars, mini vehicles, special edition vehicles, commercial and special purpose vehicles, and welfare vehicles. The Company also handles used vehicles.

name: NIFCO INC
businessSummary: Nifco Inc is a Japan-based manufacturing company primarily engaged in synthetic resin business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Molded Synthetic Resin segment manufactures and sells industrial plastics, fasteners, plastic precision molding components and molds. The Bed and Furniture segment is engaged in the production and sale of beds, the import and sale of furniture, and reclining chair business.

name: NEOJAPAN INC
businessSummary: NEOJAPAN Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of software business and system development service business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Software segment is engaged in the development of software centering on groupware, the operation of cloud services, as well as the sale, maintenance and consulting of licenses. The System Development Service segment is engaged in the development and maintenance of core systems and information systems for companies, and development of embedded systems for companies. The overseas business is engaged in the provision of Desktops-as-a-Service (DaaS) cloud services for enterprises, local market research business, as well as the exploration partner companies.

name: CHIYODA CORP
businessSummary: Chiyoda Corporation is a Japan-based company engaged in the integrated engineering business. The Engineering segment is engaged in the planning of various industrial and consumer facilities, as well as pollution control, environment improvement and disaster prevention facilities. This segment is also engaged in the design, procurement and installation of related devices and equipment, civil engineering and construction works, electrical works, instrument and pipe works, trial operation, as well as other related businesses. The other segment is engaged in the provision of travel services, air transportation services, consultation services on finance, accounting and tax, employee detachment and investigation, as well as the provision of education training and reemployment services.

name: ASIRO INC
businessSummary: Asiro Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of legal media sites for lawyer industry. The Company operates through two business segments. Legal Media-related Business segment is classified into legal media, which provides marketing support services to lawyers, and derivative media, which provides marketing support services to advertisers other than lawyers.
