Legal media includes divorce, traffic accident, inheritance, labor problem, criminal case, debt collection, debt consolidation, information technology (IT), and corporate legal lawyer navigations. Other derivative media include Carism, a career change agent media site, Uwaki Investigation Navigation, a field-specific detective media site, and Hitosagashi, a field-specific detective media site. The Legal Human Resources (HR) Business segment is engaged in the provision of job change support services for qualified lawyers, and operation of a specialized job change site NO-LIMIT for lawyers.

name: SENSHU IKEDA HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Senshu Ikeda Holdings Inc is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in banking business, as well as securities business, leasing business, credit guarantee business and credit card business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Banking segment includes deposit business, lending business, commodity securities trading business, securities investment business, domestic foreign exchange business, foreign exchange business, trusteeship of corporate bond enrollment and registration business and incidental business. The Leasing segment is involved in the provision of leasing services for industrial machines, machine tools, electronic calculators and office equipment. The Company is also involved in the provision of cash settlement, printing and outsourcing service, temporary staff service, as well as assessment and survey of collateral real estate, development and operation of station automatic teller machines (ATM).

name: TV ASAHI HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: TV Asahi Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in operations associated with program production. The Company operates through four business segments. The Television Broadcasting Business segment is engaged in operations related to the production and broadcasting of television (TV) programs. The Internet Business segment is involved in the production and rights licensing of video distribution with advertising and video distribution content via the Internet. The Shopping Business segment is involved in TV shopping programs and mail-order sales through electronic commerce (EC) sites. The Other Business segment includes music publishing, event business, equipment sales and leasing, and film investment.

name: KATO SANGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Kato Sangyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the food wholesale, logistics and other services. It operates through four business segments. The Ambient Temperature Distribution Business segment sells instant foods (including canned and retort foods), dried foods and grains, beverages, luxury items, seasonings, and other products. The Low Temperature Distribution Business segment wholesales low-temperature foods. The Alcohol Distribution Business segment sells alcoholic beverages. The Overseas Business segment is based overseas and mainly engages in wholesale of processed foods. Other businesses include logistics, insurance agency services, operation of restaurant franchises, and the supervision, management, and operation of some overseas affiliated companies.

name: NISSHIN SEIFUN GROUP INC
businessSummary: Nisshin Seifun Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the flour milling business, food business, and prepared meals and prepared foods business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Flour Milling segment manufactures and sells flour, bran, and flour-related products. The segment also sells frozen foods and their ingredients, operates restaurants using flour-related commercial products, and sells packaging materials. The Foods segment manufactures and sells premixes, wheat flour for home use, pasta, pasta sauce, frozen foods, food ingredients for baking and other uses, biochemical products, drug discovery research support business, and health foods. The Mid-market Foods and Prepared Foods segment manufactures and sells prepared foods such as boxed lunches, prepared foods, and cooked noodles, and operates directly managed department stores. The Company also operates businesses related to engineering, mesh cloth, and cargo handling and storage businesses.

name: TOEI CO LTD
businessSummary: Toei Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly involved in video-related businesses. It conducts operations through five segments. The Video-Related business segment produces and distributes theatrical films and television movies. It also produces and sells Digital Versatile Discs (DVDs) and Blu-ray Discs of these works, grants licensing rights for merchandise featuring characters appearing in the works, and grants video rights. The Exhibition business segment operates directly managed theaters and cinema complexes. The Event business segment plans and operates character shows and cultural events related to the Group's productions, and manages Toei Uzumasa Movie Village. The Tourism Real Estate business segment leases commercial facilities and operates hotels. The Construction and Interior Design business segment undertakes construction work and interior decoration contracting.

name: CHIBA BANK LTD
businessSummary: Chiba Bank Ltd is a Japan-based bank mainly engaged in the banking business and the financial services business. The Bank is engaged in the banking business, stores maintenance and management business, accounting business, employment placement business, receivables management and collection business, securities business, credit guarantee business, collection business, credit card business, leasing business, software development and information processing business, venture capital business, investment management and advisory business, research and consulting business, fintech research business, as well as the planning and development of financial services.

name: ADR ON SUMITOMO MITSUI FINANCIAL GROUP,
businessSummary: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in businesses related to financial services, centering on banking, leasing, securities, consumer finance, and system development and information processing. The Company consists of five business segments. The Wholesale Business segment provides services to large domestic corporations as well as small and medium-sized enterprises. The Retail business segment serves retail customers in Japan. The Global Business segment serves Japanese and non-Japanese clients overseas. The Market Business segment provides services for financial markets. The Headquarters Administration Business segment provides services that do not belong to any of the above business segments.

name: BANK OF NAGOYA LTD
businessSummary: Bank of Nagoya Ltd is a regional bank that conducts business related to financial services, such as banking, comprehensive finance leasing, outsourcing, and credit card business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Banking segment provides deposit, loan, domestic and foreign exchange, securities investment, commodity securities transactions, as well as bond registration services. The Leasing segment is engaged in the general finance leasing business. The Card segment is engaged in the credit card business and guarantee business. The other business activities include cash consolidation and scrutiny services, support for business succession, advice on initial public offerings and capital policies, and information and communication technology (ICT).

name: NAKAYAMAFUKU CO LTD
businessSummary: NAKAYAMAFUKU CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the wholesale business about household goods such as kitchen goods and dining goods, as well as the manufacture and sale business about horticulture and interior goods. The Company operates through five geographic segments including Hokkaido & Tohoku, Kanto, Chubu, Kinki and Chugoku & Kyushu. The Company is mainly engaged in the sale of kitchen goods, dining goods, sanitary goods, storage goods and season goods to retailers in Japan (home centers, supermarkets, mail order dealers, co-ops, specialty retailers). In addition, the Company is also engaged in the Internet mail order business, import and sale business of interior related products, as well as the manufacture and sale business of horticulture and interior goods.

name: BIC CAMERA INC
businessSummary: Bic Camera Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the product sale business and broadcasting satellite (BS) digital broadcasting business. It operates through two business segments. The Product Sale Business segment sells audiovisual products, home appliances, and information and communication equipment. The BS Digital Broadcasting Business segment broadcasts television via BS digital high definition. Its main business is the sale of audiovisual products such as cameras, televisions and recorders/video cameras, home appliances such as refrigerators, washing machines, cooking appliances and seasonal appliances, information and communication equipment such as personal computers, computer peripherals and mobile phones and other products. It operates stores under the brands Bic Camera, Kojima x Bic Camera, Sofmap, Janpara and others. It also operates online shopping. Through subsidiaries, it also operates mobile phone sales agency, radio advertising, logistics and other businesses.

name: DAITO TRUST CONSTRUCTION CO LTD
businessSummary: Daito Trust Construction Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in real estate-related business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Construction segment is engaged in the planning, design and construction of contracted works. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the brokerage, management and leasing of real estates, the provision of real estate information and guarantor contract business. The Financial segment is involved in the construction loan business, trust business, consulting business related to asset succession and asset management, and fire reinsurance business. It is also engaged in the sale of fuel (LP gas), operation of day service centers and childcare facilities, provision of home-visit nursing care services, sale and supply of electricity, operation of overseas hotel businesses, and the ship and print of documents.

name: TOA ROAD CORP
businessSummary: Toa Road Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction business, manufacture and sale of related construction materials and environmental businesses. The Company operates through two business segments. The Construction Business segment is engaged in paving, civil engineering and other construction work, as well as building demolition work. The Manufacturing, Sales, and Environmental Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of asphalt mixtures, asphalt emulsions, and other construction materials, as well as the intermediate treatment of construction waste, and the investigation and purification of contaminated soil.

name: SUBARU ENTERPRISE CO LTD
businessSummary: Subaru Enterprise Co., Ltd. is primarily engaged in the provision of road maintenance services. The Company operates in three business segments. The Road segment is engaged in the maintenance, cleaning and repair works of roads, the entrusted operation of expressway facilities and solar power generation business. The Leisure segment is engaged in the customer service business such as the distribution of movie films, the sale of food and beverage and other businesses. The Real Estate segment is mainly engaged in the leasing of real estate properties.

name: NJS CO LTD
businessSummary: NJS Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the water and sewerage business, and the environment business. The Company has two regional segments. The Company is mainly engaged in the construction consulting business, the development and provision of consulting services and software through the life cycle of water and sewage infrastructures, the provision of research, design, construction management and operation consulting services, the provision of disaster prevention and mitigation measures, environmental planning and environmental assessments, the provision of support services for water and sewage operation business, the provision of residents services, financial accounting and facility management services, and public-private partnership services, management improvement support services, the water and sewage consulting business in overseas, as well as the leasing, sale and management of real estate. The Company operates within the domestic market and to overseas markets.

name: GREMS INC
businessSummary: grems Inc is primarily engaged in providing consulting services, products and services related to energy, the sales of electric power, as well as development of renewable energy. The Company operates in three business segments. The Energy Cost Solution segment is engaged in the businesses related to the reduction of energy costs, such as consulting on reducing basic electricity charges for corporations, sales of commercial solar power generation systems and energy-saving products. The Smart House Project segment is engaged in the sale of residential solar power generation systems and storage batteries to general households, as well as the development of renewable energy. The Retail Electricity segment is engaged in the retail of electricity to corporate customers.

name: LIVING TECHNOLOGIES INC
businessSummary: Living Technologies Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of real estate platform. The Company is mainly engaged in the provision of matching services and branding services. The matching services are mainly engaged in the provision of real estate sale services, rental management services, renovations services, custom housings services, recruitment services and other Internet matching services for end users and member companies. The branding services are mainly engaged in the provision of advertisings services through Livin Match which is a vertical media operated by the Company to offer real estate companies comparison, as well as the advertisings sale services of other Internet advertising medias.

name: SYSTEM SUPPORT HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: System Support Holdings Inc, formerly System Support Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in cloud integration, system integration and outsourcing business. The Company operates in five business segments. The Cloud Integration segment provides technical support for the migration and use of cloud services (ServiceNow, Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud) and resales of licenses. The System Integration segment provides technical support for the introduction and use of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) packages, infrastructure construction such as databases, and consulting, design, development, operation and maintenance of information technology (IT) systems. The Outsourcing segment provides database services such as private clouds, data analysis and input. The Product segment develops and sells software. The Overseas segment provides system integration overseas, outsourcing of payroll and accounting work, recruitment services, and media management.

name: ROUND ONE CORP
businessSummary: Round One Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the comprehensive amusement business. The Company operates through Japan and United States two geographic segments. The Company is engaged in the operation of indoor leisure complex with bowling alleys, arcade games, karaoke, billiards, and Spo-Cha (a sports-themed facility with time-based admission). The Company also operates indoor complex leisure facilities in China, operates food and beverage businesses in the United States, and sells prizes.

name: ADR ON MITSUBISHI UFJ FINANCIAL GROUP IN
businessSummary: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in financial business. It operates through eight business segments. Retail & Digital Business Group provides financial services to individual customers and corporations. Commercial Banking & Wealth Management Business Group provides financial services to corporations and wealth management clients. Japanese Corporate & Investment Banking Business Group provides financial services to large Japanese corporations. Global Commercial Banking Business Group provides financial services to individuals, mid-sized enterprises, and other enterprises. Asset Management & Investor Services Business Group provides asset management, asset administration, and pension services. Global Corporate & Investment Banking Business Group provides financial services to large non-Japanese corporations. Global Markets Business Group provides foreign exchange, funding and other services. It also operates The Other segment.

name: MITSUBISHI UFJ FINANCIAL GROUP INC
businessSummary: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in financial business. It operates through eight business segments. Retail & Digital Business Group provides financial services to individual customers and corporations. Commercial Banking & Wealth Management Business Group provides financial services to corporations and wealth management clients. Japanese Corporate & Investment Banking Business Group provides financial services to large Japanese corporations. Global Commercial Banking Business Group provides financial services to individuals, mid-sized enterprises, and other enterprises. Asset Management & Investor Services Business Group provides asset management, asset administration, and pension services. Global Corporate & Investment Banking Business Group provides financial services to large non-Japanese corporations. Global Markets Business Group provides foreign exchange, funding and other services. It also operates The Other segment.

name: DEXERIALS CORP
businessSummary: Dexerials Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of optical materials, electronic materials and bonding materials. The Company operates in two business segments. The Optical Material Products segment is divided into three categories: optical films, optical resin materials and optical solutions. Main products are ultraviolet curable resins for optical discs, optical elastic resins and antireflection films. The Electronic Material Products segment is divided into four categories: bonding materials, anisotropic conductive films, surface mount fuses and microdevices.

name: JUROKU FINANCIAL GROUP INC
businessSummary: Juroku Financial Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the financial services, with a focus on banking. The Company operates through two business segments. The Banking segment is engaged in deposit operations, lending, trading of trading securities, securities investment, domestic foreign exchange, foreign exchange, corporate bond trusteeship, financial derivatives trading, and ancillary businesses, providing a diverse range of products and services as a regional financial partner. The Leasing segment is engaged in leasing operations and meets the leasing needs of the region. The Company is also engaged in research and development, financial instruments trading, credit card services, payment and digital solutions, management succession and mergers and acquisitions (M&A) advisory services, investment limited partnership operation and management, and regional revitalization consulting, meeting the financial needs of both individual and corporate customers.

name: MEDIPAL HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Medipal Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the wholesale of pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, daily necessities, and veterinary medicines. The Company operates in three segments. The Prescription Pharmaceuticals Wholesale Business segment engages in wholesale business targeting customers such as hospitals, clinics, and dispensing pharmacies. The Cosmetics, Daily Necessities, and General Pharmaceuticals Wholesale Business segment engages in wholesale business targeting customers such as drugstores, home improvement centers, convenience stores, and supermarkets. The Veterinary Medicines and Food Processing Raw Materials Wholesale Business segment engages in wholesale business targeting customers such as veterinary hospitals, livestock and fisheries producers, and processed food manufacturers. The Company also engages in preventive medicine, research and development of cutting-edge medical technology, non-life insurance agency services, and others.

name: ALSOK CO LTD
businessSummary: ALSOK Co Ltd, formerly Sohgo Security Services Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the security business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Security Business segment is engaged in mechanical security business, HOME ALSOK business, stationed security business and security transport business. The FM Business segment is engaged in facility construction, including piping and electrical work, facility management, environmental hygiene management, cleaning management, inspection and construction of firefighting equipment, and sales of various disaster prevention equipment. The Nursing Care Business segment provides home nursing care support, visiting nursing care, day care and facility nursing care. The Overseas Business segment provides stationed security services and mechanical security services, as well as facility management. The Company also engages in businesses related to supporting foreign nationals with specific skills.

name: SUMITOMO CORP
businessSummary: Sumitomo Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in diversified business activities in response to the diverse needs of its customers. The Company operates in nine segments. The Steel segment handles steel pipes and products. The Automotive segment trades vehicles, tires, and related items. The Transportation & Construction Systems segment deals with ships, aircraft, and construction machinery. The Infrastructure & Urban Development segment covers real estate, construction materials, logistics, insurance, and infrastructure. The Media & Digital segment provides digital solutions and telecom infrastructure. The Lifestyle segment includes retail, food, and healthcare business. The Mineral Resources segment engages in development, production, and trading of metals and derivatives. The Chemicals, Electronics & Agriculture segment handles plastics, chemicals, and agrochemicals. The Energy Transformation segment engages in infrastructure business.

name: NIPPO LTD
businessSummary: NIPPO LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial materials and plastic molded articles. The Company has four business segments. The Mobility segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of resin molded products such as powertrain mechanical components and electronic control components for automobiles. The Electronics segment is engaged in the sale of electric materials, parts, jigs and equipment for manufacturers of electronic components and clean energy. The Precision Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of resin molded products for office automation equipment, digital imaging equipment and medical equipment. The Household Equipment segment is engaged in the sale of resin molded articles, control units for blinds and nursing beds, high functional materials and equipment. The Company is also engaged in the radio frequency identifier (RFID) business.

name: NGK INSULATORS LTD
businessSummary: NGK Insulators Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the environmental, digital society, and energy & industry businesses. The company operates three business segments. The Environment Business segment provides automotive exhaust gas purification components and sensors. The Digital Society Business segment provides products for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, products for the electronics industry, beryllium copper products, and molds. The Energy & Industry Business segment provides sodium and sulfur batteries, insulators and overhead line fittings, equipment for power transmission, substation, and distribution, insulator cleaning equipment and disaster prevention equipment, corrosion-resistant equipment for the chemical industry, liquid and gas membrane separation equipment, combustion equipment and refractory materials, and radioactive waste treatment equipment. The Company also operates an insurance agency business and a golf course management business.

name: SIGMAXYZ HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: SIGMAXYZ Holdings Inc, formerly SIGMAXYZ Inc, is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in consulting business and investment business. The Company operates through Consulting business segment and Investment business segment. The Company aims to provide services to realize three types of transformation, including management transformation, digital transformation, and service transformation, in order to promote corporate transformation. The services include business strategy development, mergers and acquisitions (M&A), operational transformation, organizational transformation, utilization of digital technology and cloud solutions, project management, new business development, promotion of inter-company collaboration, and business investment.

name: NITTO FUJI FLOUR MILLING CO LTD
businessSummary: NITTO FUJI FLOUR MILLING CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the flour manufacture and food business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Flour and Food segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of flour, mix flour, food products, as well as the design and construction of flour manufacture and noodle making factories, as well as the wheat and wheat silo machines. The Restaurant segment operates Kentucky Fried Chicken (KFC) restaurants as franchisee, and also operates other kinds of restaurants. The Transportation segment is involved in the transportation of wheat and other products.

name: IRRC CORP
businessSummary: IRRC Corporation is a Japan-based company engaged in insurance sales business, solution business and system business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Insurance Sales business segment is engaged in insurance sales for individuals and corporations. The Solution business segment is engaged in the provision of insurance solutions to insurance agencies and other insurance sales companies. The System business segment is engaged in development, maintenance and sales of software.

name: DTS CORP
businessSummary: DTS Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operations & solutions, technology & solutions, and platform & services businesses. The Company operates in three business segments. The Operations & Solutions segment includes consulting for system implementation, system design, development, operation, and maintenance (including the design and construction of infrastructure and networks), and the creation of industry-specific solutions. The Technology & Solutions segment includes consulting for system implementation, system design, development, operation, and maintenance (including design, construction, and integration of infrastructure and networks), and installation, operation, and maintenance of solutions (in-house and other companies). The Platform & Services segment includes the introduction of cutting-edge information technology (IT) equipment, the construction of IT platforms, the operation design and maintenance of total information systems including cloud services.

name: SUMITOMO BAKELITE CO LTD
businessSummary: Sumitomo Bakelite Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacturing and sale of semiconductor-related materials, high-performance plastics and quality-of-life-related products. The Company operates through three business segments. Semiconductor Materials segment includes products including epoxy resin molding compounds for semiconductor encapsulation, liquid resins for photosensitive wafer coating, liquid resins for semiconductors and semiconductor substrate materials. High-Performance Plastics segment includes phenolic resin molding compounds, industrial phenolic resins, molded products, synthetic resin adhesives, copper-clad laminates made of phenolic resin, copper-clad laminates made of epoxy resin and aircraft interior components. Quality-of-Life Products segment includes medical device products and pharmaceuticals, melamine decorative laminates and sheets, vinyl resin sheets and composite sheets and others. The Company is also engaged in testing and others.

name: FUKUDA DENSHI CO LTD
businessSummary: FUKUDA DENSHI CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacture, purchase and sale of medical electronic equipment. The Company operates in four business segments. The Biopsy Device segment mainly involves in the manufacture, trading and sales of electrocardiographs, ultrasound diagnostic imaging equipment, automated hemocytometers, etc. The Biological Information Monitoring segment involves in the manufacture, trading and sale of biological information monitors. The Therapy Apparatus segment involves in the manufacture, trading and sale of defibrillators, ventilators, pacemakers, catheters, home rental business, etc. The Consumable Supplies and Others segment provides the consumable goods of equipment for all segments as well as repair and maintenance services.

name: KIRIN HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Kirin Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the integrated beverage business and the pharmaceutical business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Domestic Beer and Spirits segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of beer, low-malt beer, new genre products, wines and other liquor products in Japan. The Domestic Beverages segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of soft drinks in Japan. The Oceania Alcoholic Beverages segment manufactures and sells beer, Western-style liquors in Oceania and other regions. The Pharmaceuticals segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceutical products. The Company is also engaged in the domestic wine business, North American beverage business, and the biochemical business.

name: NICHIREI CORP
businessSummary: Nichirei Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in processed food business, fishery business, livestock business, low-temperature logistics business, real estate business and other businesses. The Company operates in five business segments. Processed Food segment is engaged in the manufacture, process and sale of frozen foods, processed agriculture products, retort foods and others. Marin Products segment is engaged in the process and trading of seafood products. Animal Husbandry segment is engaged in process and sale of poultry, breeds, as well as the sale of chicken for meat. Low-temperature Logistics segment is engaged in the third-party logistics business, the provision of storage, inventory control and others. Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing of office buildings and parking lots. The Company is also involved in the bioscience business, the personnel salary related business services, as well as the business related to greening management and cleaning services.

name: MITSUBISHI PENCIL CO LTD
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Pencil Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the writing instruments and writing instrument peripheral products business and other businesses. It operates through two segments. The Writing Instruments and Writing Instrument Peripheral Products segment manufactures and sells writing instruments and peripheral products such as cosmetics, which utilize the technology cultivated in the writing instrument business. Products include ballpoint pens, multi-function pens and customized pens, mechanical pencils, felt-tip pens and markers, pencils and colored pencils, seals and name pens, office and school supplies, and green nets. The Other Business segment is mainly involved in the manufacture and sale of adhesive tape and the sale of handicrafts.

name: DKS CO LTD
businessSummary: DKS Co Ltd is a Japan-based company that mainly manufactures and sells surfactants, amenity materials, urethane materials, functional materials, electronic device materials and other products. The Company has six segments. Surfactant segment manufactures and sells nonionic surfactants, anionic surfactants, cationic surfactants and others. Amenity materials segment manufactures and sells sucrose fatty acid esters, cellulose-based polymer materials, vinyl-based polymer materials and other materials. Urethane materials segment manufactures and sells polyether polyols, urethane prepolymers and urethane systems. Functional materials segment manufactures and sells photo-curable resin materials, water-based urethane resins, flame retardants and amide-based lubricants. Electronic device materials segment handles ionic liquids, battery materials, conductive pastes for electronic components and pellets for injection molding. Life science segment handles health food and disinfecting agents.

name: MAKINO MILLING MACHINE CO LTD
businessSummary: Makino Milling Machine Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacturing, sale and repair of machine tools. The Company operates through four business segments. The products include machining centers, numerically controlled (NC) electric discharge machines, NC milling machines, laser processing machines, computer-aided design (CAD)/computer-aided manufacturing (CAM) systems, as well as flexible manufacturing systems (FMS). The after-sales services include troubleshooting support, machine installation and test runs, explanations of operation methods and functions, as well as reinstallation and operation checks following factory equipment relocations and layout changes. The Company sells its products in Japan, the United States, other parts of North, Central and South America, China, other parts of Asia, Europe and other regions.

name: JAPAN AVIATION ELECTRONICS INDUSTRY LTD
businessSummary: Japan Aviation Electronics Industry Ltd manufactures and sells connectors, interface solution devices, and electronic equipment and components for aerospace applications, as well as procures and sells related equipment and parts. It operates through three segments. The Connector segment manufactures and sells various connectors for applications including mobile devices, automotive systems, industrial machinery and infrastructure, and gaming equipment. The Interface Solutions segment manufactures and sells automotive products such as in-vehicle electrostatic touch panels, and industrial machinery/infrastructure products including various touch input monitors and operation panels for industrial equipment and medical devices. The Aerospace segment manufactures and sells flight control systems, inertial navigation systems, defense and space electronics, vibration control and drive equipment for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, and products for industrial machinery and infrastructure.

name: TAKASHIMAYA CO LTD
businessSummary: Takashimaya Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged mainly in the department store business, as well as real estate, finance, and construction. The Company operates in four business segments. The Department Store Business segment sells apparel, personal effects, general merchandise, household goods, and food products. The Commercial Development Business segment engages in commercial development that generates synergies with the department stores, and in the management and operation of assets and facilities. The Financial Services segment engages in the brokerage of financial products such as savings and investment and group insurance, as well as the issuance of credit cards and financial services for group companies. The Construction and Decorating segment is engaged in interior design and construction. The Company also operates a mail-order business, wholesale business, and advertising business.

name: KAMIGUMI CO LTD
businessSummary: Kamigumi Co., Ltd. is mainly engaged in the logistics service business. The Company operates in two business divisions. The Domestic Logistics segment is engaged in the harbor transportation business, the warehouse business, the freight automobile transportation and other domestic transportation-related business. The Overseas Logistic segment is engaged in the international transportation business. The Company is also involved in the heavy construction machinery work business, the real estate leasing business, the sale and leasing of goods, the finance business, as well as the development, sale and maintenance of software, among others.

name: PRO-SHIP INC
businessSummary: Pro-Ship Incorporated is primarily engaged in the development and marketing of package systems, the entrusted development, and the operation management business of systems. The Company operates in two business segments. The Package Solution segment is involved in the operation of package solution business, ranging from the consultation to the implementation and maintenance of fixed assets systems and sales management systems. The Others segment is involved in entrusted development and operation management business.

name: RINNAI CORP
businessSummary: Rinnai Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of thermal equipment. The Company operates in six segments based on region: Japan, the United States, Australia, China, South Korea, and Indonesia. Domestically, the Company sells directly to customers, such as city gas companies, propane fuel distributors, housing equipment manufacturers, house builders, and pipe and building material distributors (some of which are supplied as original equipment manufacturers (OEM)), while subsidiaries sell to some customers.

name: TIS INC
businessSummary: TIS Inc mainly provides outsourcing business and cloud service related to IT investment, as well as software development and solutions. The Company operates in four business segments. The Service Information Technology (IT) segment provides knowledge-intensive IT services. The Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) segment provides business process outsourcing such as marketing and promotional work, clerical work and contract work utilizing a wealth of business and IT know-how. The Financial IT segment is engaged in the operation of high value-added businesses and IT-based business, based on specialized business and business know-how specialized in the financial industry. The Industrial IT segment is engaged in the operation of high value-added businesses and IT-based business, based on specialized business and business know-how specialized in the various fields other than finance. The other business provides real estate leasing and management business.

name: ALPHAPURCHASE CORP
businessSummary: AlphaPurchase Corp is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the provision of various required solutions to achieve indirect cost reduction. The Company operates two segments. Maintenance Repair and Operations (MRO) segment is mainly engaged in the sale of MRO products such as equipment and machinery repair supplies, stationery, office supplies on closed information technology platforms. Facility Management (FM) segment is mainly engaged in the provision of construction and other materials for new construction, renovation, and maintenance of commercial facilities, as well as maintenance and management of facilities and equipment. The Company also conducts business related to the collection, processing and provision of various types of information, as well as computer-based provision of information.

name: PERSOL HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: PERSOL HOLDINGS CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of general human resource services. The Company has six segments. The Dispatching and Business Process Outsourcing(BPO) segment is engaged in the provision of dispatching services, as well as consulting and other BPO services. The Recruiting segment is engaged in the recruitment advertisement and recommendation business. The PROGRAMMED segment is engaged in the facilities maintenance business and the staffing business. The PERSOLKELLY segment is engaged in the provision of staffing, recruitment, outsourcing and other services in Asia-Pacific under the PERSOLKELLY brand. The Information Technology Outsourcing (ITO) segment is engaged in the planning and development of communication networks and systems, as well as the information and communication technology (ICT) outsourcing business. The Engineering segment is engaged in the provision of human resource services in mechanical design and other technical fields.

name: MEITEC GROUP HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: MEITEC Group Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the engineering solutions business and engineer introduction business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Engineering Solutions segment is engaged in the provision of engineering solution services with a focus on engineer dispatch services. This segment includes high-end engineer dispatching business, middle-range engineer dispatching business, senior engineer dispatching business, registered staffing business whose main customers are the manufacturing industry, and general outsourcing business. The Engineer Introduction segment is engaged in the employment placement business for engineers. The Other segment is engaged in the business related to group management.

name: TANABE CONSULTING GROUP CO LTD
businessSummary: Tanabe Consulting Group Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the management consulting business. The management consulting areas include strategy consulting, digital transformation (DX) consulting and brand & design consulting. The services in the strategic consulting area include domain consulting, function consulting, human resources (HR) Consulting, mergers & acquisitions (M&A) alliance consulting, regional consulting, strategic domain & function study group and first call company (FCC) seminar. The services in the DX consulting area include digital marketing, management DX, branding DX, marketing DX and FCC academy cloud. The services in the brand & design consulting area include marketing strategy planning, branding, customer experience (CX) design, creative, and Web promotion. The sales promotion products include sales promotion tools, blue diaries and calendars.

name: MABUCHI MOTOR CO LTD
businessSummary: Mabuchi Motor Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacturing and sales of small motors. The Company operates through four regional segments including Japan, Asia, the Americas and Europe. The Company’s products are primarily used in automotive electrical equipment and life and industrial devices. The life and industrial devices mainly include health and medical equipment, home appliances and tools, precision and office equipment, as well as audio and visual equipment.

name: TAIYO HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Taiyo Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the electronics business and the medical and pharmaceutical business. The Company has two business segments. The Electronics Business segment develops, manufactures, sells, and purchases chemical materials for electronic components, including printed circuit board materials. The Medical and Pharmaceutical Business segment manufactures, sells, and undertakes contract manufacturing of pharmaceuticals. The Company also manufactures and sells dyes, pigments, chemicals, and inks, operates natural energy power generation businesses, operates restaurants, provides system engineering services, and develops systems.

name: DAIWA INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: DAIWA INDUSTRIES LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacturing and sales of freezers, refrigerators, showcases and ice machines, purchase and sales of cooling and heating equipment for commercial uses, and provision of inspection, repair and leasing services of its equipment. The Company is also engaged in design and construction of stores and kitchens, leasing of freezers, refrigerators and others.

name: KEEPER TECHNICAL LABORATORY CO LTD
businessSummary: KeePer Technical Laboratory Co., Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the car washing business. The Company operates its business in two segments. Its KeePer Products-related segment manufactures chemical products for car coating uses and tools for professional use, sells its products to car washing stores. Its KeePer Operation segment involves in the operation of KeePer LABO stores, providing car coating services.

name: NITERRA CO LTD
businessSummary: Niterra Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive products, ceramic products, and products related to new businesses. The Company operates three business segments. The Automobile-Related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of parts that are mainly assembled into automobiles, such as spark plugs and exhaust gas sensors. The Ceramics segment manufactures and sells cutting tools, industrial equipment components, semiconductor manufacturing equipment components, semiconductor packages, and oxygen concentrators for medical use. The New Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of products related to new businesses such as the environmental energy field. It also sells materials and provides welfare services.

name: KOHSOKU CORP
businessSummary: Kohsoku Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacturing and sales of food light packaging materials and industrial packaging materials. The Company operates through the packaging materials manufacturing and sales business segment. The Segment manufactures and sells printed paper containers including confectionery boxes, seals, labels and flyers, as well as planning and design services. The Company also manufactures and sells tea bags, wrapping paper, paper containers and provides sales of containers, pallets, basket carts and steel fish boxes. The Company manufactures and sells polyethylene bags, corrugated cardboard and cushioning materials.

name: NISSAN CHEMICAL CORP
businessSummary: Nissan Chemical Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the agricultural chemicals business, functional materials business and wholesale business. The Company operates through six business segments. The Agrochemicals Business segment provides herbicides, insecticides, fungicides, plant growth regulators, and other agrochemicals, as well as bulk veterinary pharmaceuticals. The Functional Materials Business segment provides display materials, semiconductor materials, and inorganic colloids. The Wholesale Business segment is engaged in the wholesale of chemical products. The Chemicals Business segment provides basic chemicals such as sulfuric acid, nitric acid, and ammonia, and fine chemicals such as specialty epoxies for encapsulants. The Pharmaceuticals Business segment provides bulk pharmaceuticals for hypercholesterolemia treatments and fine chemicals. The Others segment provides fertilizers, landscape gardening, transportation, plant engineering, and other services.

name: WACOM CO LTD
businessSummary: Wacom Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacturing, and sale of brand products and technology solution products, as well as service operations. The Company operates through two business segments. The Technology Solutions segment is engaged in the provision of digital pens, sensors, touch panel components and modules. They are used for mobile devices such as tablet computers, e-books and mobile terminals. The Branded Products segment provides three kinds of services. Creative business provides pen tablets, mobiles and displays. The consumer business provides stylus pens, smart pads, and digital stationery. They are mainly used for illustration and memo making on digital terminals. Business solutions provides pen tablets. They are mainly used in the fields of education, medical care, and digital signatures.

name: ZIGEXN CO LTD
businessSummary: ZIGExN Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in life media platform business which integrates the information on multiple media. The Company operates in two business segments. Its Life Media Platform segment is engaged in the development, operation and maintenance of media that integrate information from multiple Internet and paper media, specialized media that matches users and customers for specific industries and regions, as well as application Service provider (ASP) services. The Life Media Platform segment includes three fields: human resources field, real estate field and living field. The Others segment is engaged in the plan, development, operation and maintenance of new development services centered on the user billing model, leveraging the knowledge of the existing life media platform business.

name: SUMISEKI HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Sumiseki Holdings Inc is a Japan-based holding company primarily engaged in the coal business. It operates through three segments. The Coal segment is engaged in related transactions related to the purchase and sale of coal. The New Materials segment is engaged in the manufacture, purchase and sale of industrial artificial diamonds. The Quarrying segment is engaged in the extraction, processing and sale of rocks.

name: COMSYS HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Comsys Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the telecommunications carrier, information technology (IT) solutions, and social systems-related business. The Company has eight business segments. The Nippon COMSYS Group segment is engaged in the construction of telecommunications facilities focusing on Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corporation (NTT) group. The SANWA COMSYS Engineering Group segment is engaged in the construction of telecommunications facilities focusing on new common carriers (NCCs). The TOSYS Group segment, TSUKEN Group segment, NDS Group segment, SYSKEN Group segment and Hokuriku Denwa Kouji Group segment are engaged in the telecommunications facility construction business in the Shinetsu, the Hokkaido, the Tokai and Hokuriku, the Kyushu and the Hokuriku areas. The COMSYS JOHO SYSTEM Group segment is engaged in the information processing business. The Company is also engaged in the staffing business and the shared service business.

name: MIZUNO CORP
businessSummary: Mizuno Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of sporting goods. It manufactures and sells sports shoes, sportswear, baseball and golf products through four segments, including Japan, Europe, Americas, and Asia & Oceania. The Japan segment is also engaged in the construction of sports facilities, the operation and contract operation of sports facilities, school business, as well as the manufacture and sale of sports equipment, lifestyle products, and working products in Japan. The Asia & Oceania segment is also engaged in the construction of sports facilities.

name: SUNTORY BEVERAGE & FOOD LTD
businessSummary: Suntory Beverage & Food Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of beverages and food. It operates through four geographical segments. Japan segment manufactures and sells mineral water, coffee drinks, tea drinks, carbonated drinks, sports drinks and others, and engages in marketing and product planning for soft drinks in Japan. Asia Pacific segment manufactures and sells health foods BRAND'S Essence of Chicken series in Southeast Asia, energy drink V and the fruit juice drink JUST JUICE, sells the energy drink Sting and the Suntory brand tea drink TEA+ in Vietnam, carbonated drinks PEPSI in Thailand, Ribena and Lucozade in Malaysia, Hong Kong and Singapore. European segment manufactures and sells carbonated drinks Orangina and Schweppes, fruit juice drinks Oasis and Ribena and energy drinks and sports drinks Lucozade in Europe. Americas segment manufactures and sells soft drinks, spirits, beer, wine and others and operates restaurants in North America.

name: TAKACHIHO KOHEKI CO LTD
businessSummary: TAKACHIHO KOHEKI CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the search and development of technology products, the import and export business of products, as well as the installation, maintenance and system design of products. The Company operates through two business segments. The System segment is engaged in the provision of consulting service, system design service, system operation service, as well as installation and maintenance service of system equipment mainly for security products. This segment’s products include security products, such as advanced fire protection systems, other solution products including network equipment, and customer service products. The Device segment is mainly engaged in the sale and consultation of products, such as semiconductors and mechanical parts. This segment’s products include electronic products, such as semiconductors, electronic components and industrial products, such as slide rails, gas springs and keys.

name: LEOCLAN CO LTD
businessSummary: LEOCLAN Co.,Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the medical total solution business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Medical Total Solution segment is engaged in the contract sale of medical equipment and medical information system products based on consulting for medical institutions, prevention and examination facilities, nursing care and welfare facilities, as well as the related maintenance services business, the building interior work and medical equipment construction business. The Remote Image Diagnosis Service segment is engaged in the provision of remote diagnosis services through image data taken by magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and computed tomography (CT) for medical institutions without a radiation diagnosis specialist. The Provide Lunch segment is engaged in the provision of ordinary and recuperation meal services for nursing and welfare facilities.

name: AMADA CO LTD
businessSummary: Amada Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of metal processing equipment and metal machine tools, as well as the provision of related services. The Company operates in two segments. The Metal Processing Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of products such as laser machines, punch and laser combined processing equipment, press brakes, bending robots, shirring, plate processing system lines, factory automation (FA) computers and software, as well as welding equipment such as precision laser equipment and resistance welding equipment. The Metal Machine Tool segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cutting products such as metal cutting saws, shape steel cutting equipment, drilling equipment and metal cutting saws, press products such as mechanical presses, as well as machine tools such as grinding machines. The Company is also engaged in the real estate leasing business.

name: ZUKEN INC
businessSummary: ZUKEN INC. is a Japan-based company engaged in the research and development of software solutions which support the optimization of product design and engineering operations for manufacturing industries, as well as the provision of the software solutions. The Company operates through four geographic segments including Japan, Europe, the United States and Asia. The Company is mainly engaged in the research and development, sale and consulting of software and middleware products, technical support services business including staffing, support services business and the sale of network related products.

name: FP PARTNER INC
businessSummary: FP Partner Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the insurance agency business, which provides financial planning services mainly to individual and corporate clients. The Insurance Agency Business segment sells products of a total of 32 life and non-life insurance companies to individual and corporate clients, and provides face-to-face and online consultation, product explanation, contracting procedures, and follow-up services. It conducts business activities in Japan.

name: ANYCOLOR INC
businessSummary: Anycolor Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the video content-related business. The Company is mainly engaged in the operation of the virtual youtuber (VTuber) group Nijisanji, which is centered on the live streaming domain of video distribution on YouTube, as well as the commerce domain (sales of VTuber goods and other content and events), which expands the range of VTuber activities by providing contact points other than video distribution. The Company also develops business in the promotion domain, where uses the intellectual property (IP) it owns related to its VTubers to promote the products and services of its corporate clients. In addition, the Company is also engaged in the operation of overseas VTuber business as a new business domain.

name: KYOTO FINANCIAL GROUP INC
businessSummary: Kyoto Financial Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the management of banks and companies that can be designated as subsidiaries under the Banking Act, as well as related businesses. It is primarily engaged in banking, leasing, credit card, and financial instruments trading businesses, and other financial services. The banking business includes deposits, lending, trading of commodity securities, securities investment, domestic foreign exchange, foreign exchange, and trust services. It also operates an e-commerce mall, provides consulting services, economic surveys and research, financial instruments trading, investment services, business rehabilitation and debt management, credit guarantee services, and investment management services through its subsidiaries.

name: KING CO LTD
businessSummary: KING Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly involved in fiber products business. The Company has two business divisions. The Apparel division is involved in the wholesale of ladies apparels, fashion goods, apparel accessories, promotion materials, the planning, sale, logistics and clerical work agency businesses, as well as the sale of apparel store promotion items. The Textile segment is involved in the wholesale of textile products, through its subsidiary.

name: KOMATSU LTD
businessSummary: Komatsu Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the research, development, sale, sales finance of products such as construction machinery. The Company operates in three business segments. Construction Machinery & Vehicle segment provides drilling machinery, loading machinery, land preparation and roadbed machinery, transport machinery, forestry machinery, underground construction machinery, underground mining machinery, environmental recycling machinery, industrial vehicles, cast products and logistics services. Retail Finance segment is engaged in the sales finance business related to construction and mining equipment. Industrial Machinery & Others segment engages in the provision of forging machinery, sheet metal machinery, machine tools, defense-related equipment, temperature control equipment, and optical machinery.

name: KEWPIE CORP
businessSummary: Kewpie Corp is engaged in manufacture and sale of food products. The Company operates in six business segments. The Retail Market segment manufactures and sells mayonnaise, dressings, pasta sauces, delicatessen foods, packaged salads, baby foods, nursing care foods and others in the retail market. The Food Service segment manufactures and sells mayonnaise, dressings, vinegar, liquid eggs, frozen eggs, dried eggs, egg processed food and others in food service market. The Overseas segment manufactures and sells mayonnaise, dressings in China, Southeast Asia, North America markets. The Fruit Solutions segment manufactures and sells jams for household use and processed fruit products for industry use. The Fine Chemicals segment manufactures and sells hyaluronic acid and egg yolk lecithin as an ingredient for pharmaceuticals, cosmetics and foods. The Common segment sells food and food manufacturing machines.

name: ROHTO PHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Rohto Pharmaceutical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of eye care (eye drops, eyewash), skin care (external medications, lip balm, sunscreen, functional cosmetics), oral medication (gastrointestinal medicines, herbal medicines, supplements), and other products and services (in vitro diagnostic reagents) in the health and beauty care field. The Company operates through four regional segments. The Japan segment manufactures and sells eye care, skin care, oral medication, and other products (services). The Americas segment and the Europe segment mainly manufacture and sell skin care products (services). The Asia segment mainly manufactures and sells eye care and skin care products (services), as well as oral medication products (services).

name: COPRO-HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Copro-Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based holding company that manages the group’s business and handles incidental and operates engineer staffing business through its subsidiaries. The construction engineer staffing and placement service specializes in staffing and placement services for construction and plant engineers. Dispatched industries and duties site supervision and computer-aided design (CAD) operators in architecture, civil engineering, facilities and plants. The mechanical and electrical/semiconductor engineer staffing and contracting service provides staffing and contracting services for mechanical and electrical/semiconductor engineers. Industries and tasks include the development and design departments of major manufacturing companies (transportation equipment, industrial machinery, home appliances and agricultural machinery). The IT engineering staffing service operates Bscareer IT and provides systems development and other services to client companies.

name: JAC RECRUITMENT CO LTD
businessSummary: JAC Recruitment Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the recruitment business both domestically and internationally. It operates through three business segments including Domestic Recruitment Business, Domestic Recruitment Advertising Business, and Overseas Business. Recruitment business introduces candidates, primarily for permanent positions, to companies seeking employees, and serves as an intermediary for international recruitment, meeting various domestic and international human resources needs. Recruitment advertising business posts job postings, primarily for permanent positions, received from companies seeking employees on the recruitment advertising Website CareerCross, and works to acquire recruitment advertisements primarily from foreign and Japanese companies requiring bilingual personnel.

name: YOKOHAMA FINANCIAL GROUP INC
businessSummary: Yokohama Financial Group Inc, formerly Concordia Financial Group Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the banking business. The Company operates through the Banking segment. The Company is engaged in banking, securities, leasing, information services and research, venture capital, credit guarantee, credit card, securities investment trust management, investment consulting, investment banking, parts delivery, office agency, business administration, and other related businesses. The Company mainly operates in Yokohama and East Japan.

name: YOSSIX HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Yossix Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the food business includes direct management of pub chain stores and franchised store development as well as construction business centered on restaurant construction. The Company operates pub chains under various brands, including Nipachi, Yataiya, Yataizushi, Sento, Koreya, Yakiniku Genki, providing Sushi, iron-plate cooking, chicken black charcoal and others.

name: MATSUKIYOCOCOKARA & CO
businessSummary: MatsukiyoCocokara & Co, formerly Matsumotokiyoshi Holdings Co Ltd, is engaged in retail business, wholesale business and management support business. Retail business is engaged in operating chain stores of drugstores and insurance pharmacies, opening and operating insurance dispensing pharmacies, dispatching pharmacists and others. Wholesale business purchases and sells products handled by group companies and business partners that engage in retail business, develops franchise businesses, and supplies products to franchisees. The Management Support segment is involved in the management of group companies and contracting of indirect business, planning and development of private brand products, asset management and operation, the construction and maintenance of stores, as well as the operation of non-life and life insurance agency business.

name: SAKATA SEED CORP
businessSummary: Sakata Seed Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of horticultural products (vegetable seeds, flower seeds, bulbs, seedlings, and agricultural and horticultural supplies). The Company operates through three segments. The Domestic Wholesale segment produces or purchases vegetable seeds, flower seeds, bulbs, seedlings, and agricultural and horticultural supplies, and wholesales them to domestic seed companies. The Overseas Wholesale segment, through its headquarters and overseas subsidiaries, produces or purchases vegetable seeds, flower seeds, and seedlings, and wholesales them to overseas seed companies. The Retail segment produces or purchases products targeted at general gardening enthusiasts, sells them to home improvement stores, and also sells them through mail order. The Company also undertakes the construction and management of landscaping projects for government and private organizations, temporary staffing services, and contract research and development.

name: ASAHI GROUP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Asahi Group Holdings Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of alcoholic beverages, beverage and food products in Japan and overseas. The Company operates through four regional segments: Japan, Europe, Oceania, and Southeast Asia. The Japan segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of alcoholic beverages, beverages, foods, and pharmaceuticals. The Europe segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of alcoholic beverages. The Oceania segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of alcoholic beverages and beverages. The Southeast Asia segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of beverages. The Company also operates a Korean alcoholic beverage business and a feed business.

name: TOCALO CO LTD
businessSummary: Tocalo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in thermal spraying, with peripheral areas including thermo-reactive deposition and diffusion (TD) processing, zinc-aluminum coating (ZAC) processing, plasma transferred arc (PTA) processing, and physical vapor deposition (PVD) processing. It operates through three segments. The Thermal Spraying Processing (Standalone) segment provides thermal spraying processing for semiconductor and flat panel display (FPD) manufacturing equipment parts, and industrial machinery parts. The Domestic Subsidiaries segment provides PVD processing for cutting tools, blades, and automotive molds, and manufactures machine tool and precision machinery parts. The Overseas Subsidiaries segment provides surface modification processing, primarily thermal spraying and weld overlay, and thermal spraying, cleaning, and anodizing for semiconductor and FPD manufacturing equipment parts. The Company also provides TD processing, ZAC processing, and PTA processing.

name: NIPPON GAS CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Gas Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the gas business and related businesses, such as the production, supply, and sale of city gas, the sale of liquefied petroleum gas and gas equipment, and the construction of gas piping. It operates in four segments. The City Gas segment is engaged in the production, supply, and sale of city gas. The Liquefied Petroleum Gas segment sells liquefied petroleum gas and equipment for liquefied petroleum gas. The Order Construction and Gas Equipment segment is engaged in the construction of pipelines for the supply of city gas and liquefied petroleum gas, the sale of equipment and housing-related facilities. The Electricity segment is engaged in the sale of electricity. The Company is also engaged in the maintenance and construction of information and communications infrastructure, the operation of sports clubs, the management and operation of designated management facilities, and the sale of plants and agricultural products.

name: KODENSHA CO LTD
businessSummary: Kodensha Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the electrical facility construction business and product sales business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Electrical Facility Construction segment is engaged in the design, construction and contract of house wiring works, power transmission line construction, power generation and transformation construction, communication and air conditioning works. The Product Sales segment is engaged in the sale of general electrical equipment, industrial electrical and electronic equipment, heating and cooling equipment, and sale of electronic devices for control and measurement, substation equipment, machine tools, information and communication devices, refrigeration and air conditioning devices, elevators, and monitoring and control devices.

name: FUKUI COMPUTER HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Fukui Computer Holdings, Inc. is engaged in the development and sale of computer-aided design (CAD) software. It has two business segments. The Architecture CAD segment is engaged in the development, sale and maintenance of architecture CAD software, as well as the provision of Web service and other software services. The Measurement Civil Engineering CAD segment is engaged in the development, sale and maintenance of measurement CAD software and civil engineering CAD software.

name: SUMITOMO DENSETSU CO LTD
businessSummary: Sumitomo Densetsu Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the equipment work business. The Company provides electric power supply work, general electric work, information communication work, plant and air conditioning work and other equipment work, as well as related engineering services. The electric power supply work is mainly engaged in the design, construction and supervision of transmission and distribution equipment. The general electric work is engaged in the design, construction and supervision of electrical installation work and environment related work. The information communication work is engaged in the design, construction and supervision of telecommunication equipment work. The plant and air conditioning work is engaged in the design, construction and supervision of plants and air conditioning sanitary tubes. The Company is also engaged in the insurance agency business, the manufacture and repair of equipment, and the manufacture and sale of water heaters.

name: TOYO SUISAN KAISHA LTD
businessSummary: Toyo Suisan Kaisha Ltd is a Japan-based food manufacturing company. The Company operates through six business segments. The Seafood segment is engaged in the purchase, processing and sale of seafoods in domestic and overseas markets. The Overseas Instant Noodles segment provides cup and bag noodles mainly in the United States and Mexico. The Domestic Instant Noodles segment provides cup and bag noodles in Japan. The Low Temperature Food segment manufactures and sells steamed and roasted buckwheat noodles, raw ramen, boiled noodles, frozen noodles and commercial cocking products. The Processed Food segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of processed foods such as aseptic packaged rice, retort rice, soup, dashi-no-moto, bonito flakes, and paste products in Japan. The Frozen and Cold Storage segment is engaged in the provision of storage and freezing services. The Company also involves in the bag lunch, prepared food businesses.

name: SHIONOGI & CO LTD
businessSummary: Shionogi & Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the pharmaceutical business. The Company is mainly engaged in the research and development, purchasing, manufacturing, sales, and related activities of ethical pharmaceuticals. The Company is engaged in research and development, purchasing, manufacturing, and marketing of pharmaceuticals for the treatment of gram-negative bacterial infections, influenza virus infections, new coronavirus infections, invasive aspergillus infections, complicated urinary tract infections including pyelonephritis, Alzheimer's disease, chronic pain, cancer of the esophagus, bladder, head and neck, solid tumors, and other diseases. The Company provides products and services in Japan, Europe, North America, and other regions.

name: AWA BANK LTD
businessSummary: Awa Bank Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the banking services, leasing services and other financial services. The Company operates through two business segments. The Banking segment is engaged in the provision of deposits, lending, securities investment, domestic exchange, and foreign exchange services, and the provision of financial products and services through the sales of public bonds, investment trusts and insurance, financial products brokerage, and trust products. The Company is also engaged in the provision of banking services, credit guarantee services, credit card services, and management consulting services as supplements to the banking business. The Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing business.

name: NICHIAS CORP
businessSummary: Nichias Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of heat insulating and sealing materials for plants and housing, fluororesin products, filter products and others. The Company operates in five segments. The Construction and Sales for Plants segment is engaged in the construction and maintenance of hot insulation works, fire-retardant works, soundproofing works and disaster prevention works. The Industrial Products segment is engaged in the provision of gasket packing, fluorine resin products, heat insulating materials and filters. The Advanced Product segment offers pipes and machinery for handling heat, liquid chemicals and gas. The Automobile Parts segment offers cylinder head gaskets and other parts. The Construction Material segment offers noncombustible matters and adiabatic materials.

name: BASE CO LTD
businessSummary: BASE CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of software. The Company is engaged in the provision of system development services, enterprise resource planning (ERP) solutions and other solutions. The system development services are engaged in the provision of total system development services including requirements definition, basic design, detailed design, program design, programming, various tests, migration, release, operation and maintenance services for the financial, distribution and manufacturing fields. The ERP solution services are engaged in the provision of services in the ERP, customer relationship management (CRM), company-specific middleware component software and other areas. The other solution services are engaged in the provision of Nippon Individual Savings Account (NISA) opening services, card number recognition services using optical character recognition (OCR) function, as well as business process outsourcing ( BPO) services.

name: AVIC CO LTD
businessSummary: AViC Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the digital marketing business. The Digital Marketing Business segment provides high-quality digital marketing services mainly to clients with medium to small advertising budgets. The Company provides internet advertising services such as purchasing advertising space from media management companies, measuring advertising effectiveness, and acting as an advertising operation agent for clients. The Company also provides search engine optimization (SEO) consulting services that measure the effectiveness of SEO measures, such as optimizing the internal structure of target websites and creating content to be posted on them, and then provides comprehensive solutions and appropriate information dissemination for clients.

name: I'LL INC
businessSummary: I'LL INC is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of total solutions to medium and small size companies through information technology (IT). The Company operates in two businesses. The system solution business is engaged in the core system-related design and development, hardware maintenance, system operation support, network building and security management to corporate clients. The Web solution business is engaged in the provision of Web goods, including production and support of homepage, electronic commerce building and net shop centralized management software.

name: NIHON KOHDEN CORP
businessSummary: NIHON KOHDEN CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of medical electronic equipment, as well as the provision of maintenance and repair services. The Company mainly operates medical electronics related business. The Company offers electroencephalograph, electromyographic, evoked potential testing equipment, electrocardiographs, cardiac catheterization equipment, diagnostic information systems and related consumables (paper, electrodes, catheters and others), biological information monitors, clinical information systems, artificial respiration, artificial ear, hemocytometer, ultrasonic diagnostic equipment, research equipment and transformers, among others. The Company is also engaged in the sales promotion for its products, as well as the general affair-related and manpower dispatching businesses.

name: NIHON FALCOM CORP
businessSummary: NIHON FALCOM CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in the planning, development, production and sale of game software. The Company operates in two business divisions. The Product division is engaged in the planning, development, production and sale of role-playing game software, the production and sale of Japanese version of overseas game software, and the planning, production and sale of music compact discs (CDs). The License division is engaged in licensing permission for the development and sale of family game software in Japan, the localization and local marketing of the Company's software to overseas markets, the provision of services through mobile phones using its game software and game music, the download and sale of its game software online and the production and sale of books.

name: JAPAN TOBACCO INC
businessSummary: Japan Tobacco Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the tobacco business, the pharmaceutical business and the processed food business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Tobacco segment manufactures and sells manufactured cigarettes in Japan and overseas. The Pharmaceuticals segment is engaged in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of prescription pharmaceuticals. The Processed Foods segment manufactures and sells frozen and room-temperature processed foods and seasonings. In addition, the Company also engages in real estate leasing and other businesses. The Company's tobacco brand portfolio includes the Winston, Camel, Mevius and LD brands.

name: RIKEN KEIKI CO LTD
