businessSummary: Riken Keiki Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of various industrial measuring instruments, as well as related business activities. It manufactures and sells gas detection and alarm equipment and provides after-sales maintenance services related to the equipment. Its products include portable gas detectors, fixed gas detectors, and other measuring instruments. Portable gas detectors include multi-gas detectors and single-component gas detectors. Fixed gas detectors include detectors, alarms, analyzers, and other components. It also offers analytical instruments, including atmospheric photoelectron yield spectroscopy instruments and portable multi-X-ray analyzers. Its industrial gas detectors are used in places where gas is likely to be generated and in industries that use gas, including semiconductor manufacturing, oil refining, steelmaking, power generation, city gas, waterworks and sewerage, food manufacturing, and others.

name: SHIN MAINT HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Shin Maint Holdings Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of maintenance services for various facilities and equipment in stores. Main customers are major restaurant chains and retail chains. The one-stop maintenance services provide an emergency maintenance service that responds to sudden troubles in various facilities and equipment, and a preventive maintenance service that regularly checks, maintains, and cleans various facilities and equipment. The maintenance outsourcing service provides support to improve the maintenance capability of the kitchen equipment manufacturer by providing a maintenance system. The emergency maintenance service accepts repair requests 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. The preventive maintenance services provide tailored maintenance based on store conditions.

name: PILLAR CORP
businessSummary: PILLAR Corp, formerly Nippon Pillar Packing Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of fluid control related equipment products, mainly PILAFLON products (fluororesin products), mechanical seal products, and gland packing and gasket products. The products are used in industrial fields such as semiconductors and liquid crystal, as well as electricity, petroleum, automobiles, chemicals, ships, civil engineering and construction, food, and pharmaceuticals. The Company operates through two business segments. The Electronic Equipment Related Business segment mainly produces and sells resin-related products such as PILAFLON products. The Industrial Equipment Related Business segment produces and sells mechanical seal products, gland packing and gasket products. The Company also operates office building rental businesses, insurance agency businesses, and electricity sales businesses.

name: NITTO DENKO CORP
businessSummary: Nitto Denko Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the industrial tape business, the optronics business and the life science business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Industrial Tapes segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of basic functional materials such as bonding materials and protective materials, as well as automotive materials. The Optronics segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of information functional materials, printed circuits and process materials. The Human Life Science segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of nucleic acid contract manufacturing, nucleic acid synthesis materials, nucleic acid drug discovery, medical-related materials and other life sciences, membranes such as polymer separation membranes, and personal care materials such as functional films for hygiene materials. The Company is also engaged in the manufacture and sale of new businesses and other products.

name: WA INC
businessSummary: WA, Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in the plan and sale of women's shoes. The plan and sale of women's shoes business is involved in the product planning and development business, the product inspection business and the product sale business. The product sale business is involved in the retail sale at physical stores and EC sites, as well as wholesale and sale at other fashion brands. The Company is engaged in the sale of products under the brands of ORiental Traffic, WA ORiental Traffic, NICAL and OR KIDS.

name: MAKITA CORP
businessSummary: Makita Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of electric tools, air tools, horticultural equipment, household equipment. The Company operates in four regional segments including Japan, Europe, North America and Asia. The Company provides lithium-ion series products, high-pressure air tool series products, dust collector series products, wireless interlocking series products and disaster preparedness series products.

name: FORUM ENGINEERING INC
businessSummary: Forum Engineering Inc. operates the engineer dispatch and introduction business. The clients cover eight major industries in the mechanical and electrical fields, including automobiles, transportation machineries, industrial machineries, precision equipment, electrical equipment, home appliances, electronic components, and information and communications. The Company dispatches technical staffs to client companies for design and development, experiment and evaluation, production technologies, and quality assurance. The engineer dispatch service has three features, including management of client companies by department, skill-based matching using artificial intelligence, and recruitment of human resources through a unique route. The Company also conducts engineer introduction and other businesses, and provides human resources services including engineer dispatch service, electromechanical engineer recruitment service, as well as human resource management services.

name: CARLIT CO LTD
businessSummary: Carlit Co Ltd, formerly Carlit Holdings Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the chemicals, bottling, industrial materials, and engineering services business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Chemicals segment consists of six business fields: chemicals, chemical products, electronic materials, contract evaluation, ceramic materials, and silicon wafers. The Chemicals segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial explosives, hazard assessment tests, sodium chlorate, pesticides, organic conductive materials, abrasives, and silicon wafers for semiconductors. The Bottling segment handles the bottling processing and sales of soft drinks. The Metal Processing segment manufactures and sells silicon wafers for semiconductors, various heat-resistant refractories, and springs. The Engineering Services segment sells and paints industrial paints, and designs and supervises water and sewage and wastewater treatment facilities.

name: HORIBA LTD
businessSummary: Horiba Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of measuring instruments. The Company operates in five business segments. The Automotive segment is engaged in the provision of engine exhaust gas measuring devices, driveline test systems, engine test systems, brake test systems and other products. The Environmental and Process segment is engaged in the provision of flue gas analyzers, water quality measuring devices, air pollution monitoring analyzers and other products. The Medical segment is engaged in the provision of blood cell counting devices, immunoassay devices and other products. The Semiconductor segment is engaged in the provision of mass flow controllers, chemical solution concentration monitors and other products. The Scientific segment is engaged in the provision of water quality measuring device, particle size distribution measuring device and others.

name: NS SOLUTIONS CORP
businessSummary: NS Solutions Corporation is mainly engaged in the provision of information services. The Company operates in two business divisions based on the services offered to customers, including business solution business and service solution business. The business solution business provides solutions in total system lifecycle to meet customer needs based on knowledge and experience of business types and business operations. The service solution business provides information technology (IT) infrastructure solutions and outsourcing services, which combine platform construction technology and operation know-how to meet mission critical requirements.

name: SECOM CO LTD
businessSummary: Secom Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of security services. The Company operates in six business segments. The Security Services segment provides comprehensive security services, focusing on centralized systems for offices and homes. The Fire Protection Services segment provides various types of fire protection systems. The Medical Services segment provides various medical services, including home medical services, operation of senior residences, and sales of electronic medical records. The Insurance Business segment develops and sells insurance products. The Geospatial Information Services segment provides geospatial information services, geospatial information services, and other services. The Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) and Information and Communication Technology (ICT) segment provides information security services, large-scale disaster response services, data center operations, and BPO services.

name: CLEANUP CORP
businessSummary: Cleanup Corporation is a Japan-based manufacturing company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of machinery for housing, stores and offices use. The housing, store and office use equipment-related division is involved in the manufacture and sale of kitchen equipment, bathtubs and washbasins, as well as the supply of stainless raw materials and stainless steel materials. The others division is engaged in the ablation, coloring, processing and sale of stainless raw materials, the provision of transportation, cargo handling, physical distribution services, as well as nursing, manpower dispatching services.

name: UEKI CORP
businessSummary: UEKI CORPORATION is mainly engaged in construction business and real estate business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Construction segment is engaged in order and construction for construction work, leasing of construction materials and other construction contracts. The Real Estate segment is engaged in sale, leasing and development of real estate, as well as development of residential land. The Construction Material Manufacture and Sale segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of construction materials. Other businesses include development and sales of software, operation of paid nursing homes, operation of golf courses, and leasing of industrial waste treatment facilities.

name: YAMADA CORP
businessSummary: YAMADA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of refueling equipment and related products. The Company operates in five regional segments. The main products include automotive equipment such as hand pumps, bucket pumps, lubricators and other lubrication equipment and tire service equipment, exhaust gas emission systems, freon gas collection equipment and other environmental maintenance equipment for automobile maintenance shops and gas stations, as well as industrial equipment such as air pumps and double diaphragm pumps that transport chemicals, inks, adhesives and paint fluids. The Company is also engaged in the sale and repair of service parts. The Company operates within the domestic market and to overseas markets, including the United States, Netherlands, China and Thailand.

name: KAWAGISHI BRIDGE WORKS CO LTD
businessSummary: Kawagishi Bridge Works Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the design, manufacture and construction of steel frames and other steel structures. The Company’s contracted steel works mainly include site construction, design, and cost estimation for construction work in East Japan. The Company is also engaged in the manufacture, sale and installation of precast concrete products for construction.

name: SOMAR CORP
businessSummary: SOMAR CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in the high functional materials business, environmental materials business and food materials business. The Company has three business segments. The High Functional Material segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of films and other coating products, electrical insulation resins and other high functional resin products, circuit board materials and other electronic materials, as well as heat curable resins and other functional resin products. The Environmental Material segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial fungicides and other fine chemicals, as well as paper coating binders and other paper manufacturing chemicals. The Food Material segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of thickener, stabilizer, dehydrated vegetables and food ingredients. The Company is also engaged in the golf courses operation business, real estate rental management business, and insurance agency business.

name: TOKYO ELECTRON DEVICE LTD
businessSummary: Tokyo Electron Device Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the semiconductor and electronic device business and the computer system-related business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Semiconductor and Electronic Devices segment sells semiconductor products, boards and electronic components, software and services, as well as manufactures and sells private brand (PB) products. The Computer System-related segment sells network-related products, storage-related products, and security-related products, as well as provides maintenance and monitoring services.

name: SUGI HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Sugi Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the drug store and pharmacy business. Through its subsidiaries, it sells pharmaceuticals, health foods, cosmetics, and daily necessities, operates drug stores with pharmacies that provide prescription dispensing and home medical care in cooperation with local medical professionals, provides various services to consistently support customers' health maintenance and prevention, manages subsidiaries specializing in medical and healthcare-related businesses such as visiting nursing services and medical institution start-up support services, engages in trading and domestic wholesale businesses that export Japanese products, mainly drug store materials such as pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, daily necessities and food, and manages subsidiaries specializing in prescription dispensing.

name: NISSO GROUP CO LTD
businessSummary: Nisso Group Co Ltd, formerly Nisso Pronity Co Ltd, is mainly engaged in metal processing, rubber processing, construction, and tile business. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Metal Processing segment is engaged in planning, design, processing, manufacturing, and sales of various metal products in the construction, energy, and machinery and equipment fields. The Rubber Products segment is engaged in the planning, design, processing, manufacturing, and sales of various rubber products in the housing, machinery, and public infrastructure fields. The Construction segment is the construction business associated with the above businesses. Tile segment is engaged in planning, designing, processing, manufacturing, and sales of exterior and interior tiles for houses and buildings. It also provides manufacturing web services, contracted system development, and wood processing.

name: IMASEN ELECTRIC INDUSTRIAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Imasen Electric Industrial Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of mechanical products and electric products for automobiles, wire harnesses and assistive products. The Company operates through three business segments. The Auto Part Related segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of seat adjusters, window regulators and other automobile mechanical products, as well as lamps, electronic units, horns and other automobile electric products. The Wire Harness segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of wire harnesses for aircrafts and equipment. The Assistive Product segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of electric wheelchairs, artificial hands, artificial legs and non-powered walking support equipment. The Company is also engaged in the provision of welfare services for employees.

name: YOSHICON CO LTD
businessSummary: Yoshicon Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the real estate business. The Company has four business segments. The Residence segment is engaged in the planning and sale of condominiums and single family houses. The Real Estate Development segment is engaged in the planning, development, sale, brokerage and construction of real estate such as condominiums, houses, commercial and industrial facilities. The Rental and Management segment is engaged in the rental of condominiums, commercial and industrial facilities and parking lots, the management, design and construction of condominiums, as well as the power sales business. The Materials segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of concrete products for construction, precast concrete (PC) components for houses, as well as the civil engineering and construction business. The Company is also engaged in the beverage manufacturing business, food business, clothing sales business, advertising and insurance agency business.

name: ARTIENCE CO LTD
businessSummary: artience Co Ltd, formerly Toyo Ink SC Holdings Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture of chemical products. The Company operates through four business segments. The Color Materials and Functional Materials-Related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of organic pigments, processed pigments, colorants for plastics, color filter materials, inkjet materials and lithium ion battery materials. The Polymer and Coating-Related segment manufactures and sells paints for cans, resins, adhesives, adhesives, coating materials, natural materials and medical products. The Package-Related segment manufactures and sells gravure ink, flexo ink and gravure cylinder plate making. The Printing and Information-Related segment manufactures and sells offset ink, metal ink, printing machinery, printing equipment, prepress systems, printing materials, inkjet materials, and others. The Company also sells raw materials.

name: NAKAYAMA STEEL WORKS LTD
businessSummary: Nakayama Steel Works Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of iron and steel. It operates through three segments. The Steel segment manufactures and sells primary iron and steel products and secondary processed products. Its main products include steel plates such as hot-rolled steel strips, thick plates and intermediate plates, steel bars such as wire rods, bar-in coils and rebar, steel slabs and by-products. The Engineering segment accepts orders and sells steel fish farms and aquaculture farms, rolls, valves, and other products, as well as processes and assembles machinery. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the rental and sale of owned real estate, real estate buying and selling and brokerage, and other service businesses.

name: ELECOM CO LTD
businessSummary: Elecom Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacturing and sales of products related to personal computers (PCs), digital devices and home appliances, as well as businesses incidental to related services. The Company operates the development, manufacturing and sales of PC and digital device-related products business segment. The operations include the development, manufacturing and sales of PCs and storage products, maintenance, repair and data recovery services for PC-related products, manufacturing and sales of industrial storage devices, manufacturing and sales of consumer flash memory products, manufacturing and sales of broadcasting and communication equipment and electrical communication work, comprehensive customer support services for the group, planning, development, and sales of healthcare-related products, design, construction, operation and maintenance of information technology (IT) infrastructure and dispatching IT engineers and others.

name: MIXI INC
businessSummary: MIXI Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the digital entertainment business, sports business and lifestyle business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Digital Entertainment Business segment is engaged in the provision of games for smart devices, the implementation of related events, and the production and sale of goods. The Sports Business segment is engaged in the investment in sports team management and public sports related businesses. The Lifestyle Business segment is engaged in the management of services that are related to people's lives using the Internet. The main services include Kazoku Album Mitene, a photo and video sharing application for families, and minimo, a salon staff direct reservation application.

name: DMW CORP
businessSummary: DMW CORPORATION is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture, installation and sale of wind and water equipment. The Company’s main business is the manufacture and sale of wind and water equipment, energy recovery equipment for seawater desalination, wastewater treatment equipment, waste treatment equipment, switchboards, electrical instrumentation control equipment and telecommunication control equipment, as well as other related works. The Company’s main products include pumps including industrial pumps, large pumps, centrifugal pumps and submersible pumps, blowers including fans and blowers, as well as valves, among others.

name: NIKKISO CO LTD
businessSummary: NIKKISO CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial pumps, precision equipment and blood related products, among others. The Company operates in two business segments. Industrial Business segment conducts industrial business including the manufacture, sale and maintenance of industrial special pumps, as well as liquefied gas & industrial gas related equipment and devices. The Segment is also involved in precision equipment business, aerospace business and deep ultraviolet light emitting diode (LED) business. Medical Business segment’s products are dialysis-related products including hemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis, such as artificial dialysis machines, dialyzers, blood circuits, and powder-type dialysis agents. The Segment also manufactures, sells and maintains products and medicines related to CRRT (acute blood purification therapy), artificial pancreas devices that manage blood glucose, and energy devices for microwave surgery.

name: ISHIHARA SANGYO KAISHA LTD
businessSummary: Ishihara Sangyo Kaisha Ltd is principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemical industrial products in the organic chemical field, centered on agrochemicals, and the inorganic chemical field, centered on functional materials and titanium oxide, as well as other businesses. The Company operates three segments. The Organic Chemical segment includes agrochemicals such as herbicides, insecticides, and fungicides, veterinary medicines, pharmaceuticals, and organic intermediates. The Inorganic Chemical segment includes functional materials, titanium oxide, and other chemical products. The Others segment is engaged in trading and construction businesses. The trading business sells organic and inorganic chemical products and procures raw materials, as well as purchases and sells general chemical industrial products. The construction business constructs and repairs production facilities, and outsources the construction and repair of plants.

name: AMG HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: AMG Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in apartment sales business, custom-made building business, real estate management business and real estate leasing business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Apartment Sales segment is engaged in the sale of newly built apartment series More Grace for families in the Tokai area. The Custom-made Building segment provides unique custom houses and store construction based on the concept of houses to build with architects. The Real Estate Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing of apartments in Nagoya City, Aichi Prefecture and Gifu City, Gifu Prefecture. This segment is centered on Nagoya City and Gifu City. The Real Estate Management segment is engaged in the management of new apartments series More Grace and other real estate.

name: WDB COCO CO LTD
businessSummary: WDB coco CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the contract development of pharmaceutical companies. The Company is engaged in the provision of safety information management service as an agent and support for drug development, document support service, development support service and clinical development support service. The safety information management service provides support services such as input, evaluation drafting and report drafting. The document support service provides support services from QC (quality assurance) and translation of documents and materials necessary for marketing approval to PMDA (Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency) to the creation of approval application called CTD (Common Technical Document). The development support service provides services such as survey form management, filing of survey-related documents and call center operations. The clinical development support service provides support services for clinical trial related work.

name: ASTI CORP
businessSummary: ASTI CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of in-car electrical components, home electronics, communications and control equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The In-car Electrical Components segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of electronics control units, air condition control systems, in-car and marine wire harnesses. The Home Electronic segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale electronic control boards for washing machines, dish washers and drying tumblers. The Communications and Control Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of communication switch units and industrial robot controller boards. The Company is also engaged in the power electronics business and the medical business.

name: FENWAL CONTROLS OF JAPAN LTD
businessSummary: Fenwal Controls of Japan, Ltd. is mainly engaged in development of products based on heat control technology. The Company operates in four business segments. Fire Prevention and Extinction segment develops, manufactures and sells fire detection equipment, firefighting equipment, fire alarm systems, explosion control system, high sensitivity smoke detection (SAS) system and overheat alarm system, as well as engages in provision of services of the systems. Temperature Control segment develops, manufactures, sells, designs and services temperature controller, hot plate and equipment for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, thermocouple for high temperature furnace and other temperature control equipment and services this system. Medical segment develops, designs, manufactures and services artificial kidney dialysis equipment and medical equipment. Printed Circuit Board segment engages in artwork design, noise countermeasure and printed circuit board mounting assembly.

name: HAZAMA ANDO CORP
businessSummary: Hazama Ando Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction (civil engineering and architecture), and it also conducts business activities related to each business. The Company has three business segments. The Civil Engineering Business segment is involved in all civil engineering works both domestically and overseas. The Architecture Business segment is involved in all architectural works both domestically and overseas. The Group Business segment is involved in the sale and leasing of construction materials and the construction of civil engineering and architectural works through consolidated subsidiaries. The Company also includes survey and research contract work.

name: TOKAI SOFT CO LTD
businessSummary: TOKAI SOFT CO.,LTD. is an independent software development company. The Company mainly provides services related to software contract development and software development. The Company operates Software Development segment and is classified into three businesses, including embedded related business, manufacturing, distribution and business system related business, and finance and public related business. The embedded related business conducts the vehicle releted development business, as well as the consumer and industrial equipment related development business. The manufacturing, distribution and business system related business conducts the manufacturing and distribution system related development and business system related development business. The finance and public related business is engaged in the software development for major financial institutions and software development of various ministries and agencies, local governments, universities, public corporations.

name: MATSUI CONSTRUCTION CO LTD
businessSummary: MATSUI CONSTRUCTION CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction work, real estate business and sales of building materials. The Company operates through two business segments. The Construction segment is involved in the construction and civil engineering businesses, including contracting for construction work, ordering part of construction work and receiving orders for construction work. The Real Estate segment is involved in the sale of the real estate land and buildings, the leases housing and rental offices business , the sale of building materials, as well as the private finance initiative (PFI) business.

name: UNITED INC
businessSummary: United Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in investment, education, talent matching, and ad tech/content businesses. The Company operates through four business segments. The Investment Business segment invests in startup companies and manages funds. The Education Business segment operates online education, smartphone app development, and private tutoring schools. The Talent Matching Business segment provides recruitment process outsourcing (RPO) services such as scouting and recruitment support, as well as recruitment placement and designer-specific matching. The Ad Tech/Content Business segment plans, develops, and operates advertising distribution platforms for advertisers and advertising agencies and advertising management platforms for media outlets, plans, produces, and operates digital content, and engages in fan business and sports marketing.

name: PS CONSTRUCTION CO LTD
businessSummary: PS Construction Co Ltd, formerly P.S. Mitsubishi Construction Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in civil engineering business, construction business and manufacturing business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Civil Engineering segment is engaged in the construction of prestressed concrete (PC) and civil engineering works, the manufacture and sale of PC products, the operation of pavement, repair and foundation works of civil engineering structures, and the management of civil engineering equipment. The Building Construction segment is engaged in operation of PC works and other general construction works, as well as the manufacture and sale of PC products. The Manufacturing segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of concrete products. The Others segment is engaged in the sale, leasing and brokerage of real estate, and the provision of non-life insurance brokerage services.

name: DAINICHISEIKA COLOR & CHEMICALS MFG CO L
businessSummary: DAINICHISEIKA COLOR & CHEMICALS MFG. CO., LTD. is a Japan-based comprehensive manufacturer of high-tech and color science. The Company operates in five business segments. The Chemical Product segment is engaged in the manufacture and sales of paints and printing inks, inorganic and organic pigments and processed pigments for information display and recording, as well as colorants for fibers. The Chemical segment is engaged in the manufacture and sales of colorants for plastics such as master batches and resin compounds, as well as UV electron beam curable coating agent. The Macromolecule segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of urethane resin and nature polymeric products. The Printing Integrated System segment provides manufacturing and sales of printing ink and products and services incidental to the business. The Others segment is real estate leasing and financial business.

name: FEED ONE CO LTD
businessSummary: Feed One Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in livestock feed business, aquatic feed business, and food business. It operates through three segments. The Livestock Feed segment manufactures and sells compound feed, produces and sells pig and chicken eggs, and operates dairy farming business for the purpose of compound feed research. The Aquatic Feed segment manufactures and sells compound feed, purchases and sells marine products, and operates aquaculture business for the purpose of compound feed research. The Food segment purchases, processes, and sells meat and eggs. The Company is also engaged in overseas business, as well as the leasing and management of real estate.

name: SANSHIN ELECTRONICS CO LTD
businessSummary: SANSHIN ELECTRONICS CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sales of electronic devices and the providing of information technology (IT) solutions. The Company mainly operates in two segments. The Device segment is engaged in the sales of semiconductors and electronic components to electronics manufacturers, besides, it also provides technical support such as software development and module development. The Solution segment is engaged in information and telecommunications network business which provides infrastructure design, construction, operation and maintenance services to private enterprises, government agencies and municipalities.

name: NIPPN CORP
businessSummary: Nippn Corp, formerly Nippon Flour Mills Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the flour milling business and the food business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Flour Milling segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of wheat flour, bran, buckwheat flour and premix products. The Food segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of household wheat flour, premix, pasta, frozen food, prepared food and rice flour products. The Company is also engaged in the leasing of real estate, the manufacture and sale of pet food products, the design, manufacture and installation of equipment for food industry, the freight transportation business, the development of information processing systems, the sale of health food products, as well as the operation of donut shops.

name: IWABUCHI CORP
businessSummary: IWABUCHI CORPORATION is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of hardware and concrete poles for various electrical wiring applications. The Company is involved in the manufacture, purchasing and sale of traffic signal and road sign poles, as well as brackets for safety net in schools, the cable poles for cable television (CATV) cable laying use and disaster prevention administrative wireless facility use, the poles for telecommunication lines, the poles and concrete poles for power distribution line use tailored to various electric power companies, and poles for distribution lines within factories, and railway poles, among others.

name: NIPPON SODA CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Soda Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of products and the provision of services domestically and internationally in the fields of chemical materials, agribusiness, trading and logistics, engineering and eco solutions. The Company operates through five business segments. Chemical Materials segment manufactures and sells industrial chemicals, chemical products, functional materials, eco-care products, and pharmaceutical and industrial fungicides. Agribusiness segment manufactures and sells fungicides, insecticides, miticides, herbicides and other products. Trading and Logistics segment sells and imports/exports chemicals, functional products, synthetic resins, industrial machinery and equipment, and construction-related products domestically, and also provides transportation and warehousing services. Engineering segment constructs plants and engages in civil engineering work. Eco Solutions segment handles various types of industrial waste.

name: KYOKUTO BOEKI KAISHA LTD
businessSummary: Kyokuto Boeki Kaisha, Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the trading business. The Basic Industry Related division provides machinery and equipment for steel, nonferrous metals, automobile, chemicals, shipbuilding and plant engineering industries, electrical machinery, oil drilling related equipment and resources development equipment. The Electronics and Control System Related division offers electronic components and equipment, software, instrumentation and control systems, image processors, ground support electronic equipment and navigation equipment, as well as automatic control devices for thermal power stations. The Industrial Materials division provides combined material manufacturing machinery, as well as machines for textile processing, meat processing, resin finishing, coating, measurement and analysis, among others. As of March 31, 2014, the Company had 11 subsidiaries and eight associated companies.

name: HEIAN CEREMONY SERVICE CO LTD
businessSummary: HEIAN CEREMONY SERVICE CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly provides wedding and funeral services. The Company operates in four business segments. The Wedding Ceremony segment provides wedding ceremonies, as well as services such as weddings and coming-of-age ceremonies rental costumes, photography and dressing. The Funeral segment provides funeral related services and ancillary services such as the sale of Buddhist altars and utensils at homes, temples and congregations. The segment also provides franchise agreements and partnership agreements with funeral companies. The Mutual Relief Society segment is engaged in ceremonial funeral festival mutual aid society business, as well as the recruitment of members and the management of members' information, the provision of wedding and funeral agency services for its members. The Nursing Care segment provides home care services, facility services and rental housing business for the elderly. The Company also provides logistics business.

name: JAPAN PETROLEUM EXPLORATION CO LTD
businessSummary: Japan Petroleum Exploration Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the exploration and production (EP) business. The Company operates through four regional segments. The Japan segment is engaged in the EP business in Japan, which explores, develops, produces, and sells crude oil and natural gas, as well as the sale of crude oil. The Infrastructure and Utility business is engaged in the sale of natural gas and liquefied natural gas (LNG), power generation and sales of electricity, sales of biomass fuel, and contracted transportation of natural gas. The North America segment is engaged in the EP business in North America, which explores, develops, produces, and sells crude oil and natural gas. The Europe segment is engaged in the EP business in Europe, which explores, develops, produces, and sells crude oil and natural gas. The Middle East segment is engaged in the EP business in the Middle East, which develops, produces, and sells crude oil.

name: NAIGAI TRANS LINE LTD
businessSummary: NAIGAI TRANS LINE LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the international freight transportation business. The Company provides four types of services. The Less than Container Load (LCL) Export services include the nonstop consolidated marine transportation services connecting ports in Japan, as well as the consolidated marine transportation services through hub ports for the countries without nonstop ships. The Full Container Load (FCL) Export services include the freight transportation services in unit of containers. The LCL Import services include the cargo transportation services from abroad. The FCL Import services provide freight transportation services in unit of containers.

name: SUCCEED CO LTD
businessSummary: Succeed Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of educational services and human resources services. It has three business segments. The Education Human Resources Support segment introduces and dispatches human resources related to education such as home teachers, information and communication technology (ICT) support staff, school teachers, club activity instructors, Japanese language teachers to general households, private cram schools, school corporations and local governments. The Welfare Human Resources Support segment introduces and dispatches welfare-related human resources such as nursery teachers, nutritionists, after-school care instructors, social workers, and care staff to nursery schools, kindergartens, after-school care facilities, and care facilities. The Individualized Instruction Classroom Business develops a cram school Individual Guidance Academy Succeed that provides individualized learning guidance and a schoolchildren's club Pentas Kids.

name: BRIDGE INTERNATIONAL GROUP CORP
businessSummary: Bridge International Group Corp, formerly Bridge International Corp, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of various solution services that solve corporate sales challenges, with a focus on inside sales. The Company operates through three business segments. The Inside Sales Outsourcing Business segment conducts sales activities to prospective customers without meeting them face-to-face, using telephone, email, online conferencing tools, and also provides inside sales outsourcing services. The Process Technology Business segment provides consulting services, system solutions, operation support, and network solutions for corporate marketing and sales activities. The Training Business segment provides digital talent development training for companies.

name: WANTEDLY INC
businessSummary: Wantedly, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in operation of business social networking service(SNS) platform named Wantedly. The number of users per month at the end of May 2017 is 1,514,842. The Company operates through one segment: Business SNS. The segment provides company visit matching service Wantedly Visit, business card management application Wantedly People, business use specialized chat tool Wantedly Chat, media platform Wantedly and others. The company has one subsidiary.

name: EDION CORP
businessSummary: EDION Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of home electric appliances, and the operation of home electronics mass retailers from Hokkaido to Okinawa. The Company is engaged in the sale of home appliances through directly managed stores, mobile phone specialty stores, mail-order stores and franchise stores. The other business is involved in the operation of software specialty stores, the operation and development of information systems, the sale and construction of solar power generation systems, home remodeling, the purchase and sale of used information and communication equipment, and processing and sale of useful metals, the sale of office supplies, daily necessities, the sale of alcoholic beverages, the management of a professional soccer team, as well as the operation of programming classes.

name: TOKYO SANGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Tokyo Sangyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the electric power business, the chemical and environment business, the electronic precision equipment business and the life related business. The Company operates through four business segments. Electric Power segment is engaged in the provision of power generating equipment, power distribution equipment and other electric power related equipment. Chemical and Environment segment is engaged in the provision of plants and equipment for chemical, petroleum refining, pharmaceutical, textile, rubber, nonferrous metals and other industries. Electronic Precision Equipment segment is engaged in the provision of precision equipment, measuring devices, air conditioning and other related equipment. Life Related segment is engaged in the provision of water-saving automatic flusher, plastic bags and garbage collection bags. The Company is also engaged in the management and operation of buildings, and the real estate leasing business.

name: BUSHIROAD INC
businessSummary: Bushiroad Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in the development and acquirement of intellectual property (IP). The Company operates in two business segments. The Entertainment business segment is composed of five departments including trading card game department, mobile online games department, music department that engages in plan, production and management of music content and live performances and events, merchandising (MD) department that plans and releases goods related to IP, as well as media department that engages in book publishing and Internet radio operating. The Sports business segment is composed of the box office department, MD department that plans and sells goods, as well as the content department that product and distributes video content.

name: ARISAWA MFG CO LTD
businessSummary: Arisawa Mfg Co Ltd is a Japan-based mainly engaged in the manufacturing and sales of electronic materials, display materials, electric insulation materials, and industrial structural materials. The Company operates through four segments. Electronic Materials segment produces materials for flexible and rigid printed wiring boards. Industrial Structural Materials segment produces filament winding (FW) moldings, aircraft honeycomb panels and prepregs, pultrusion moldings, fiber reinforced plastic (FRP) ski seats, and others. Electrical Insulation Materials segment produces glass cloth, glass tapes, and prepregs for electric insulation. Display Materials segment produces three-dimensional (3D) display filters, special optical components and others.

name: DAI-ICHI LIFE HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Dai-ichi Life Holdings Inc is a Japan-based insurance holding company that mainly operates in the insurance business and owns domestic and overseas life insurance companies as subsidiaries, and manages the subsidiaries. The Company operates through three segments. The Domestic Insurance segment is engaged in the individual insurance, individual annuity insurance, group insurance, group annuity insurance and other life insurance business, the non-life insurance business, as well as the life insurance related business, such as the acquisition of securities, real estate and monetary claims. The Overseas Insurance segment is engaged in the insurance business overseas. The Other segment is mainly engaged in the management of group companies and asset management related businesses.

name: TOKUYAMA CORP
businessSummary: Tokuyama Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in chemical products, cement, advanced electronic materials, life science, and environmental business. The Company operates through five business segments. The Chemicals segment provides products such as caustic soda, soda ash, calcium chloride, sodium bicarbonate, sodium silicate, hydrogen, and vinyl chloride monomer. The Cement Segment provides products such as cement, ready-mixed concrete, cementitious solidifiers, and recycled resources. The Advanced Electronic Materials & Components segment provides products such as polycrystalline silicon, dry silica, silicon tetrachloride, and aluminum nitride. The Life Science segment provides products such as medical diagnostic systems, dental equipment, bulk pharmaceuticals and intermediates, plastic lens-related materials, and microporous films. The Environmental Business segment provides products such as ion-exchange membranes, plastic sashes, and recycled gypsum board.

name: ASAHI CO LTD
businessSummary: ASAHI CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of bicycles, parts and accessories, as well as the provision of maintenance and repair services for bicycles. Its bicycle products include ordinary bicycles, sports bicycles, children bicycles, electric bicycles and foldable bicycles. It is also involved in the sale of bicycle parts and accessories through the Internet. The Company carries bicycles of original brands as well as private brands manufactured from overseas, and provides its products to home centers (HCs).

name: NIPPON CARBON CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Carbon Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of carbon and silicon carbide products. The Company operates through three segments. The Carbon Products segment produces artificial graphite electrodes, impermeable graphite products, isotropic high-purity graphite products, mechanical graphite products, general-purpose carbon fibers and graphite fibers, resin-containing graphite fiber packing, flexible graphite sealing materials, and lithium-ion battery anode materials. The Silicon Carbide Products segment produces silicon carbide continuous fibers. The Other segment manufactures industrial machinery, repairs machinery, and rents parking lots.

name: OKURA INDUSTRIAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Okura Industrial Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the processing, manufacturing and sales of various polyethylene and polypropylene products, various optically functional film products, processed plywood, particle board and processed board, land development and building construction and sales, as well as hotel management and real estate leasing. It operates through three segments. The Synthetic Resin segment produces and sells synthetic resin products such as polyethylene film and polypropylene film. The New Materials segment produces and sells liquid crystal display-related materials such as optical functional films. The Building Materials segment is engaged in the production and sales of building materials such as particle board and processed board. The Company is also engaged in hotel business, information processing system development business, non-life insurance agency business, cable television broadcasting business, and real estate leasing business.

name: AISIN CORP
businessSummary: Aisin Corp is a Japan-based company mainly manufactures and sells automotive parts. The Company manufactures and sells automotive parts through five geographical segments, including Japan, North America, Europe, China and Association of South-East Asian Nations (ASEAN) & India. The Japan segment also manufactures and sells energy solution-related equipment. The automotive parts include powertrain-related parts including automatic transmissions (AT) and manual transmissions (MT), driving safety-related parts including brake master cylinders and disc brakes, body-related parts including power sliding door systems and power back door systems, and sunroofs, as well as other connected and sharing solutions (CSS)-related parts including car navigation systems. The energy solution-related products include gas heat pump air conditioners (GHP), cogeneration systems and shower toilets, among others. The Company is also engaged in the automotive parts business in Brazil.

name: SONOCOM CO LTD
businessSummary: SONOCOM CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of screen masks and photo masks for electronic industry. The Company operates through two business segments. The Screen Mask segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of screen masks for electronic components producing and printed circuit board surfaces mounting. The Photo Mask segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of photo masks for display element production. The Company is also engaged in the purchase and sale of printing machine, squeegees and other screen printing equipment.

name: MITSUBOSHI BELTING LTD
businessSummary: Mitsuboshi Belting Ltd. is a Japan-based manufacturing company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sales of belts and construction materials. The Company operates in three business segments along with its subsidiaries. The Domestic Belts segment manufactures and sells belts for automobiles, general industry and transportation use in domestic market. The Overseas Belts segment manufactures and sells belts for automobiles, general industry, office automation (OA) equipment and other use in overseas markets. The Construction Materials segment manufactures and sells waterproof sheets for construction and civil engineering use and related products. The Company also involves in the provision of equipment and machinery, third-party products, engineering structural forms and related services.

name: BELLSYSTEM24 HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Bellsystem24 Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the customer relationship management (CRM) business mainly including contact center operations. The Company has two business segments. The CRM segment is engaged in the traditional inbound and outbound call business, as well as the provision of customer support services, sales support services, technical support services and business process outsourcing (BPO) services for client companies through telephone, Web and social medias. The Others segment is engaged in the sale of content for general consumers on a monthly basis, and weather forecast content for businesses through mobile personal computers (PCs), as well as the general affairs and administrative business.

name: TSUTSUMI JEWELRY CO LTD
businessSummary: TSUTSUMI JEWELRY CO., LTD. is a Japan-based jewelry company. The Company is engaged in the manufacture, wholesale and retail of jewelry, such as rings, necklaces, bracelets and other accessories. The Company sells its products through its direct jewelry specialty stores.

name: SERAKU CO LTD
businessSummary: SERAKU Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of solutions of information technology (IT) infrastructure, web marketing communication and smart solution through the Internet. The Company includes 3 business segments. The IT Infrastructure segment supports network, server, building security, maintenance and contract development business by the company-owned qualified IT infrastructure engineers. The Web Marketing Communication segment is engaged in the construction and operation of website, as well as planning and operation of marketing for companies and organizations. The Smart Solutions segment is mainly engaged in development of web systems, smart phone applications and embedded systems.

name: ORICON INC
businessSummary: Oricon Inc. is a holding company. The Communication segment designs and operates Websites, operates Website advertising business, and provides entertainment system news distribution services. The Mobile segment provides contents delivery services, music delivery services and others. The Magazine segment edits and publishes magazines, including entertainment, audition information and entertainment business magazines, and sells advertisings. The Data Service segment provides marketing data and ranking information about music software, video software and books, as well as music databases. The Others segment is involved in the social game business, as well as the operation of Oricon Monitor Research (OMR). As of March 31, 2014, the Company had eight consolidated subsidiaries.

name: TECHNO QUARTZ INC
businessSummary: Techno Quartz Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, purchase and sale of quartz products for semiconductors. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of chromatograph equipment and consumables. Quartz glass products include quartz rings, large-diameter chambers, reactors, and cells for spectrophotometers. Processed products of crystalline silicon materials include gas shower plates and large plates.

name: MARUDAI FOOD CO LTD
businessSummary: Marudai Food Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the processed food business and meat business, as well as related services such as insurance agency services. The Company operates through two segments. The Processed Food segment manufactures and sells ham, sausages, and cooked processed foods. The Meat segment processes and sells meat products, including beef, pork and chicken. The Company is also engaged in insurance agency business.

name: AGC INC
businessSummary: AGC Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacturing and sales of glasses. The Company operates through five segments. The Architectural Glass segment manufactures and sells products such as float plate glass, molded glass, and screened and polished plate glass. The Automotive segment provides automotive glass, cover glass for automotive displays, and other products. The Electronics segment manufactures and sells products such as glass substrates for liquid crystal displays, glass substrates for organic electroluminescence (EL), and peripheral materials for displays. The Chemicals segment manufactures and sells products such as vinyl chloride, raw materials for vinyl chloride, and caustic soda. The Life Science segment provides synthetic pharmaceutical and agrochemical intermediates, bulk pharmaceuticals, and biopharmaceuticals. The Ceramics & Others business handles ceramics products, logistics and financial services.

name: HIRAGA CO LTD
businessSummary: HIRAGA CO., LTD. is engaged in the sale promotion-related business. The Company is engaged in comprehensive printing business, sales promotion, planning and management of sales promotion management system, digital marketing of WEB and social networking service (SNS). The Company is also providing service including flyers printing, sticker printing, store sales promotion, sorting, packing, management, delivery, material printing, reservation systems, inventory management systems, campaign systems, digital flyers, novelty seal promotion, and LINE official account opening and operation support.

name: GRAPHICO INC
businessSummary: Graphico Inc is mainly engaged in the planning and sales of health foods, cosmetics, sundries, and pharmaceuticals. The product categories are categorized into healthcare centered on health foods, beauty care centered on cosmetics, household products, ethical drugs and over-the-counter drugs, and others. The main sales channels are drug stores, general merchandise stores (GMS), home centers, and variety stores, and the Company also conducts mail-orders. Overseas, the Company sells through distributors in each country. The Company a fabless company that outsources manufacturing and logistics, focusing on product planning, development, marketing, promotion, and sales.

name: GUNZE LTD
businessSummary: GUNZE LIMITED is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture, process and sale of functional materials and machineries, the sale of innerwear, leg wear, textile materials, textiles, real estate business and other related business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Functional Solution segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of plastic-processed functional materials, medical materials and machinery. The Apparel segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of clothing and textile materials. The Life Create segment is engaged in the operation of commercial facilities, operates sports clubs, the sale of green trees, and generates solar power business.

name: RICKSOFT CO LTD
businessSummary: Ricksoft Co., Ltd. develops software that is mainly used for the provision of tool solution. The products used in the process management and assignment management. The Company performs comprehensively from proposal to license sale, consultant project participation, system integration (SI), training, operation support. The license and SI service business conducts license sale, consultant project participation, system integration (SI) and others. The cloud service business provides cloud environments. The software development business develops its own functions as add-on products to Jira and Confluence.

name: SHIMAMURA CO LTD
businessSummary: Shimamura Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in operating as a chain store group that sells soft goods, primarily clothing. It operates through two geographical segments, including Japan and Overseas. It operates through its flagship store Fashion Center Shimamura. Fashion Center Shimamura is a comprehensive clothing store targeting women aging from 20 to 60 and their families, offering everything from the latest trendy fashions to practical clothing, bedding and interior goods for everyday use. Avail is a young casual specialty store targeting people aged from teens to 40, offering total coordination of women's and men's clothing, shoes and accessories. Birthday is a specialty store for baby and children's goods offering a variety of products for all occasions. Chambre is a specialty store for miscellaneous goods and women's fashion targeting women aged from teens to 60. Divalo is a specialty store for fashion goods targeting women aging from 20 to 50 and their families.

name: WITZ CORP
businessSummary: WITZ Corporation is a Japan-based company engaged in provision of software. The Company operates in three business segments. The Embedded Systems segment is engaged in the provision of software development services for control devices, such as automobiles and industrial machinery. The Systems Engineering business segment is engaged in the provision of model-based technology for automobiles and virtual simulation technologies, such as automatic operation. The Functional Safety Development segment is engaged in the provision of consulting services to support functional safety measures of control devices using computers.

name: CORE CONCEPT TECHNOLOGIES INC
businessSummary: Core Concept Technologies Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of information technology (IT) services. The main business of the Company is to support the digital transformation of the manufacturing and construction industries by combining consulting capabilities and artificial intelligence (AI) technology. The company is also engaged in the supply of support for other industries, such as wholesale, retail, and information and communications, as well as digitization (adding new value through digital technology) support, customized Salesforce implementation support, and IT engineer procurement support.

name: AVANT GROUP CORP
businessSummary: Avant Group Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, sales and maintenance of software and systems to promote management reform, and the provision of software-based consulting and business process outsourcing (BPO) services. The Company operates through three segments. The Group Governance segment is engaged in the sale of licenses for DivaSystem, an in-house developed package software for consolidated management and consolidated accounting, and the provision of consulting services for its introduction. The Digital Transformation Promotion segment provides system integration services for the utilization of information called business intelligence (BI). The Outsourcing segment provides outsourcing services for operations such as consolidated accounting and consolidated tax payment.

name: SANKO CO LTD
businessSummary: SANKO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the precision components manufacturing and units processing business. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of press products, hinge products, mechatronics products such as liquid crystal monitor constant-speed opening and closing mechanisms, and car navigation monitor opening and closing mechanisms, as well as plastic products such as insulators, resin frames and resin gears for automotive-related products, housing equipment-related products, office equipment-related products and digital appliance-related products. The Company is also engage in the insurance agency business.

name: NIKKO CO LTD
businessSummary: Nikko Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of asphalt plants, concrete plants, environmental and conveying machinery, and crushers. It also conducts manufacturing contracting, real estate leasing, and home renovation sales. The Company operates through five segments. The Asphalt Plant-Related segment handles the production and maintenance services for asphalt plants, recycling plants, and related equipment. The Concrete Plant-Related segment handles the production and maintenance services for concrete plants and related equipment. The Environmental and Conveying-Related segment produces environmental and recycling plants, various conveyor systems, and related equipment. The Crushing Equipment segment manufactures and sells self-propelled crushers, jaw crushers, and similar equipment. The Manufacturing Contracting segment provides contract services including sheet metal fabrication, welding, and assembly. The Company also conducts temporary equipment.

name: NARUMIYA INTERNATIONAL CO LTD
businessSummary: NARUMIYA INTERNATIONAL Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in planning and sale of baby and children's clothing as a specialty store retailer of private label apparel. The Company mainly sells through department stores, shopping centers, outlet malls in real stores, as well as ecommerce such as own online sites and other companies' online sites. The Company's brands contain mezzo piano, BLUE CROSS, petit main, Lovetoxic and Pupil House.

name: LIKE INC
businessSummary: LIKE Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in childcare support services, comprehensive human resources services, and nursing care-related services. It has three business segments. The Comprehensive Human Resources Services segment provides staffing services, outsourcing services, recruitment services, and recruitment and education support services to client companies. The Childcare Support Services segment provides public childcare services, such as operating licensed nurseries and after-school clubs, and contract childcare services, operating on-site childcare facilities set up by hospitals, companies, universities and others. The Nursing Care-related Services segment operates paid nursing homes and other nursing care facilities with 24-hour nursing staff on-site, providing nursing care and nursing services to residents.

name: PEERS CO LTD
businessSummary: Peers Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the consulting business in the telecommunications industry. The Company is mainly engaged in the provision of consulting services, human resource solution services and information technology (IT) solution services. The consulting services are mainly engaged in the proposal of original training programs about management issues and sales issues for career shops and home appliance mass retailers, as well as the educational support services. The human resource solution services are mainly engaged in the holding of sale promotion events at sale sites, as well as the provision of educational support and dispatch services for foreign workers. The IT solution services are mainly engaged in the provision of sale skills and know-how services through video contents and applications.

name: NAKANO CORP
businessSummary: NAKANO CORPORATION is mainly engaged in the construction and real estate business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Construction segment is engaged in the construction business in Japan and Southeast Asia. The Real Estate segment is involved in the real estate leasing business in Japan and Southeast Asia. The Others segment is engaged in the insurance agency business, solar power business and private finance initiative (PFI) business.

name: AMIFA CO LTD
businessSummary: amifa Co., ltd. is a Japan-based Company engaged in lifestyle miscellaneous goods business. The Company is mainly engaged in the planning, manufacture, purchase and wholesale of lifestyle miscellaneous goods such as gift wrapping, design stationery, kitchen tableware, and flower-related products. The Company's products include one-price products, original equipment manufacturer products, fleur products and other products.

name: TDSE INC
businessSummary: TDSE Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in big data and artificial intelligence (AI) solution business. The business is divided into two categories, including consulting business centered on AI know-how and product business based on AI products. The consulting business centered on AI know-how provides integrated solutions centered on AI for companies aiming for data management, providing services including digital transformation and artificial intelligence (DX/AI) assessment, DX/AI consulting, analysis design/analysis, system construction/implementation, maintenance/tuning, and education. The product business based on AI products promotes the sale of its own AI products TDSE series and other companies' AI products, as well as services that provide business-specific AI modules to client companies.

name: MIURA CO LTD
businessSummary: MIURA CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacturing of boilers. The Company has five business segments. The Domestic Equipment Sale segment is engaged in the manufacture, processing, coating, assembly and sale of miniature through-flow boilers, as well as the manufacture and sale of related equipment. The Domestic Maintenance segment is engaged in the maintenance business in domestic market. The Domestic Laundry segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of commercial washing machines and dryer equipment in Domestic market. The Overseas Equipment Sale segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of miniature through-flow boilers and related equipment. The Company is also engaged in the management, inspection, maintenance of properties, life insurance and life insurance agency business.

name: YUSHIN CO
businessSummary: Yushin Co is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the development, manufacture, and sale of plastic injection molding take-out robots and related equipment. The Company operates through four geographic segments including Japan, the U.S., Asia, and Europe. The Company mainly develops, manufactures, sells, and provides after-sales service for injection molding product take-out robots and peripheral equipment, including labor-saving systems. Products include take-out robots, palletizing robots, attachment heads, stocking systems, and automation equipment.

name: NITTO KOGYO CORP
businessSummary: NITTO KOGYO CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of switchboard-related products, as well as the purchase and sale of information and communication equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The Switchboard-related segment manufactures and sells switchboards, cabinets, breakers, switches and parts, among others. The Information and Communication related Distribution segment purchases and sells information communication equipment and other materials. The Works and Services segment is engaged in the construction of electrical equipment and network systems, and the provision of maintenance service.

name: NITCHITSU CO LTD
businessSummary: NITCHITSU CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the machinery-related business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Machinery-related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of marine equipment and industrial equipment, the installation and sale of mechanized equipment, as well as the manufacture and sale of air preheaters and elements of air preheater. The Resource-related segment is engaged in the mining, processing and sale of crystalline limestone, the manufacture and sale of purified silica powders, the purchase and sale of siliceous sandstone, crushed stone, sand and gravel. The Real Estate-related segment is engaged in the leasing of office buildings. The Materials-related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of heat-resistant paints, and purchase, processing and sale of Linatex which is a high-purity natural rubber.

name: STANLEY ELECTRIC CO LTD
businessSummary: Stanley Electric Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive equipment products, component products and electronic applied products. The Company operates through three segments. The Automotive Equipment segment mainly manufactures automotive lighting products, which are sold to automobile manufacturers. The Components segment mainly manufactures electronic device products that are sold to manufacturers related to electrical machinery and automobiles. The Electronic Applied Products segment mainly manufactures electronic applied products such as units and modules that meet the specifications of customers, such as liquid crystal backlights, and operation panels that are sold mainly to electrical equipment, automobiles, and automobile-related manufacturers. In addition, the Company is also engaged in business activities such as promotion of employment of people with physical disabilities and financial and management services for groups.

name: FUJI CORP (MIYAGI)
businessSummary: Fuji Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of car accessories. The Company focuses on tires and wheels, and sells them through three sales formats: retail sales, mail order sales, and dealer sales. Retail sales are in suburban locations, mostly located along major roads. Mail order sales are conducted through sales Websites on the Company's own Website and online shopping malls, and sales are conducted both in Japan and overseas. Dealer sales involve direct sales to fellow retailers of car accessories, car dealers, home improvement centers, gas stations, as well as through wholesalers. The Company handles national and private brand wheels, which are procured directly from both within Japan and overseas and sold through retail sales, mail order sales, and dealer sales. The Company handles top domestic tires such as Yokohama, Dunlop, and Bridgestone, as well as imports luxury tires such as Michelin and Pirelli.

name: SHINNIHONSEIYAKU CO LTD
businessSummary: Shinnihonseiyaku Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the development and sale of cosmetics and healthcare products. The Company conducts business through direct mail order, wholesale distribution, and overseas sales channels. Major products and brands include cosmetics such as PERFECT ONE and PERFECT ONE FOCUS, as well as healthcare products including Fun and Health and Wellness Food. Wholesale sales distribute cosmetics and healthcare products nationwide to customers through wholesale to retailers such as drugstores, general supermarkets, variety stores, and sales agents. Overseas, sales focus primarily on e-commerce (EC) in East Asia including China, Taiwan, and Hong Kong, as well as in Thailand, Singapore, Vietnam, and other regions. In the United States, the Company is conducting test sales through both offline mail-order and EC channels.

name: NIPPON ELECTRIC GLASS CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Electric Glass Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of glass and other specialty glass products and glass manufacturing machinery, primarily in the electronics and information fields. In the electronics and information field, the Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of special glass products for displays and electronic devices. In the functional materials field, the Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of composite materials, medical, heat-resistant, architectural and other special glass products, as well as glass manufacturing machinery.

name: INTIMATE MERGER INC
businessSummary: Intimate Merger, Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in the data management platform business. The Company uses its own data management platform IM-DMP to support both online and offline marketing of client companies by utilizing data. IM-DMP is constructed from information obtained from a Web browser used on a personal computer, a smarphone, a tablet, or the like as an attribute database of Internet users. The features of IM-DMP include an Internet user attribute database and a database for converting instant messenger identification (IM-ID) into different IDs.

name: ORO CO LTD
businessSummary: Oro Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of solutions that strengthen companies both inside and out. The Company operates through two business segments. The Cloud Solutions Business segment develops and sells business systems provided by cloud services. It primarily develops and sells enterprise resource planning (ERP) packages ZAC and Reforma PSA. The Marketing Solutions Business segment provides various solutions that transform customer experiences with a digital focus, including digital strategy formulation and digital advertising management services.

name: NH FOODS LTD
businessSummary: NH Foods Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the food business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Processing Business Headquarter segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of ham, sausages and processed foods, as well as the manufacture and sale of marine products and dairy products in Japan. The Meat Business Headquarter segment is mainly engaged in the production and sale of meat, the breeding and raising of pigs and broilers, and the sale of meat products in Japan. The Overseas Business Headquarters segment is mainly engaged in the production, manufacture and sale of ham, sausages, processed foods and meat. The ballpark business is engaged in the operation of professional baseball teams and stadiums.

name: ZOJIRUSHI CORP
businessSummary: Zojirushi Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of cooking appliances, living products, household appliances and other products. The Company operates through manufacturing department, sales department, logistics department, as well as repair and recycling department. The cooking appliances include rice cookers, electric pots, electronic jars, hot plates, coffee makers, oven toasters, home bakeries and rice mills. The living products include glass thermos, stainless steel bottles, stainless steel lunch jars and stainless steel food jars. The household appliances include air purifiers, humidifiers, bedding dryers and tableware dryers. The other products include heat insulation containers, stainless steel vacuum panels and brown rice cold storages.

name: TECHNO RYOWA LTD
businessSummary: Techno Ryowa Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the design and construction of equipment, centered on air conditioning and sanitary equipment technology, sale of refrigeration (air conditioning) equipment and provision of repairs and renovations services.
