Air conditioning and sanitary equipment construction business designs and constructs large-scale air conditioning and sanitary equipment and small-scale air conditioning and sanitary equipment using cooling and heating (air conditioning) equipment. Electrical equipment construction business designs and constructs electrical equipment. Cooling and heating equipment sale business purchases cooling and heating (air conditioning) equipment as an agent and sells it to subsidiaries engaged in air conditioning and sanitary equipment construction. Other businesses construct solar power generation facilities and sell the electricity generated therefrom, build and rent apartment buildings, and act as a non-life insurance agency.

name: MERCURY INC
businessSummary: Mercury Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in operating in the real estate marketing solutions business segment. Based on the business concept of real estate big data x technology, the Company operates two businesses, the platform business and the digital marketing business, as well as other services. The platform business develops and provides services tailored to the business models of both new and used condominiums based on the real estate big data it possesses. The digital marketing business supports customer acquisition in condominium sales through Web marketing. Other services include the contract development of a direct mail delivery service system that distributes advertisements by assuming household attributes based on the floor plan and sales price of the condominium from a real estate database.

name: ZEON CORP
businessSummary: Zeon Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the elastomer materials business and the high-performance materials business. The Company operates through two segments. The Elastomer Materials segment produces and sells synthetic rubber, synthetic latex, and chemical products. The High-Performance Materials segment produces and sells high-performance resins, high-performance components, electronic materials, battery materials, toner, chemicals, and medical equipment. The Company also sells reaction injection molding (RIM) compounds, coatings, and other products.

name: YAMATO HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Yamato Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the home delivery, logistics and transportation businesses. The Company operates through three business segments. The Retail segment provides home delivery services to individual customers and small- and medium-sized corporate customers. The Corporate segment is engaged in transportation services for large corporate customers, planning and operation of distribution centers, customs clearance, and air freight forwarding agency services. The Others segment is engaged in information technology (IT) systems development, operation and management, automobile maintenance, fuel sales, non-life insurance agency, and freight trucking. The Company also develops information systems and provides fleet management services for carriers.

name: DENKYO GROUP HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Denkyo Group Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the wholesale of electrical goods and household goods. The Company operates through two business segments. The Electric Goods Wholesale Business segment is engaged in the sale of electrical products purchased from makers to retailers including the electronics retail stores, home centers and general merchandise stores. The segment is also engaged in the planning and manufacture of home appliances overseas, as well as the sale of products to domestic wholesalers and retailers. The Household Goods Wholesale Business segment is involved in the sale of household products to retailers including the electronics retail stores, home centers and general merchandise stores. The Company is also engaged in the electronic components sales business, home appliances repair and logistics delivery business, electrical-related systemization business and real estate management business.

name: HOUSE FOODS GROUP INC
businessSummary: House Foods Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of food products, and restaurant management business. The Company operates through five segments. The Spice/Seasoning/Processed Food segment manufactures and sells household products such as roux curry, roux stew, retort curry, spice products, and starch noodles in Japan. The Health Food segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale, and mail-order sales of health foods and functional beverages such as Ukon No Chikara, and C1000 in Japan. The International Food segment manufactures and sells soybean-related products such as tofu, curry products, and functional foods, mainly in the United States, China, and Southeast Asia. The Restaurant segment plans and operates restaurants around the world, including Curry House CoCo Ichibanya, which offers Japanese-style curry. The Other Food Related Business segment manufactures and sells prepared dishes, imports and sells ingredients, and analyzes food.

name: TOTETSU KOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: TOTETSU KOGYO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Civil Engineering segment is engaged in the plan, design, construction, supervision and other businesses related to general civil engineering work. The Construction segment is engaged in the plan, design, construction, supervision and other businesses related to general construction work. The Company is also engaged in the leasing business of commercial buildings, the environmental business, including the power generation business, the greening business, and the crushed stone recycling business, as well as the production, inspection and maintenance business of track maintenance machines, the manufacture and sale of railway-related products, and the railway-related consulting business.

name: ANA HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: ANA Holdings Inc is a Japan-based holding company principally engaged in the aviation business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Aviation segment conducts regular and irregular air transportation of passengers and cargo domestic and international flights. The Aviation-related segment provides services associated with air transportation such as airport handling and maintenance, and various services at the airport to customers and provide reservation information services by telephone. The Travel segment is engaged in the development and sale of packaged travel products, mainly made from airline tickets and accommodation. The Trading Companies segment mainly engaged in the import and export of aviation-related materials and mail orders. The Company is also engaged in the building management and temporary staffing business.

name: KISSEI PHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Kissei Pharmaceutical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the pharmaceutical business. The Company operates through four segments. The Pharmaceutical segment manufactures and sells prescription drugs, and also purchases and sells healthcare foods such as prescription drugs and foods for special medical purposes. The Goods Sales segment is engaged in the development, production and sale of noodles, the sale of various equipment, vehicles and fuel, as well as insurance agency business. The Information Services segment operates in three areas including system integration services, system resource services such as information-related equipment rental and network construction, and medical system development and sales. The Construction and Facility Maintenance segment provides comprehensive construction services ranging from building construction to the maintenance and management of equipment and facilities.

name: BEAGLEE INC
businessSummary: Beaglee Inc.is a Japan-based company engaged in the content platform business which provides content distribution service and an environment for creators. The main service provided by the content platform business is involved in the operation of a comic distribution Website Manga Okoku. The Company is also involved in some new related business with the assets and know-hows cultivated from the operation of Manga Okoku, such as the provision of the illustration distributed media ETOPICA, the manga-specialized crowd-funding service FUNDIY, as well as the native application business.

name: FEEDFORCE GROUP INC
businessSummary: Feedforce Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly provides support to companies in solving their problems and improving productivity in the fields of digital marketing and e-commerce by utilizing technologies such as performance-based advertising agency, data feeds, and identity (ID) integration. The Company operates through three segments. The Professional Services segment consists of two main services, Anagrams and DF PLUS, and provides marketing support and solutions using data feeds and listings. The Software as a Service (SaaS) segment consists of three main services, Social PLUS, dfplus.io, and EC Booster, and provides social login support tools, data feed marketing management tools, and automatic ad distribution tools. The Digital Transformation (DX) segment consists of five main services, App Unity, Rewire, FRACTA, TePs, and Shippinno, and provides services to support companies' DX through e-commerce business support services using Shopify and Shopify app development.

name: FP CORP
businessSummary: FP Corp is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the disposable food container business segment, focusing on the manufacture and sale of tray containers, lunch boxes, and similar products, while also handling the sale of packaging materials associated with these products. The Company operates through Disposable Food Container business segment. Its main activities include the manufacture and sale of synthetic resin disposable food containers, the sale of packaging materials and packaging machinery, and recycling operations converting collected containers into recycled raw materials. Through subsidiaries, it also handles the procurement and sale of packaging materials related to food container sales, the manufacture and sale of plastic film, printing, and various printing-related processing. Other businesses include the manufacture and sale of recycled products from collected PET bottles and the manufacture of corrugated cardboard.

name: TOHO GAS CO LTD
businessSummary: Toho Gas Co Ltd is a company primarily engaged in the gas business, construction and equipment and other businesses. The Company operates in three business segments. The Gas segment is engaged in the manufacture, supply and sale of gas, the reading of gas meters and the provision of gas charge recovery services. The Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG), Electricity and Other Energy segment is engaged in the electricity business, the sale of liquefied natural gas (LNG), the supply of heat, the sale of LPG and LPG equipment, the provision of LPG piping works, as well as the sale of coke and petroleum products. The Construction and Equipment segment is engaged in the provision of piping works for gas supply and the sale of gas equipment. The other businesses include LNG entrusted processing, the leasing and operation of real estate, the design and construction and the provision of utility service for plants and facilities, the sale of household equipment and others.

name: MORINAGA & CO LTD
businessSummary: Morinaga & Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in food manufacturing, food wholesale, real estate and services etc. The Company operates in three segments. The Food Manufacturing segment is engaged in manufacturing of confectionaries, foods, frozen desserts, jelly drinks, etc. The Food Wholesale segment is engaged in wholesales of commercial food. The Real Estate and Services segment is engaged in real estate rental business and management of golf courses. Other business involves in the financial services and other activities.

name: KAGOME CO LTD
businessSummary: Kagome Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, purchase and sale of foods at home and abroad. The Company operates through four business segments. The Processed Foods segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of beverages and seasonings. The main products are the Vegetable Life 100 series, tomato juice, tomato ketchup, tomato seasonings, sauces, and products for mail order and gifts. The International Business segment is engaged in the tomato seed development and agricultural production, as well as product development, processing, and sales. The Agriculture segment is engaged in the production and sale of fresh vegetables. Products include fresh tomatoes, baby leaves, and others. The Other segment is engaged in the real estate business and outsourcing business.

name: MIROKU JYOHO SERVICE CO LTD
businessSummary: MIROKU JYOHO SERVICE CO., LTD. is mainly engaged in the operation of software-related business. The Company provides development and sales of application software for business use, sales of general-purpose servers and personal computers, sales and maintenance of supply goods, management information services, training services, consulting services to small and medium-sized companies, mainly accounting firms (tax accountants and certified public accountants firms) and their advisors to support customer management. The Company’s main products and services include the sale of computer hardware, such as servers, personal computers and peripheral devices, the development and sale of business application software, the provision of comprehensive maintenance services for accounting firms, such as program update services, telecommunication support services and information services, the provision of business application software rental service and comprehensive maintenance service.

name: METAWATER CO LTD
businessSummary: METAWATER Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the design, construction, repair, maintenance and operation management of mechanical and electrical equipment for water purification plants, sewage treatment plants, waste treatment facilities and recycling facilities. The Company operates its business in two business segments. The Plant Engineering segment involves in the design, procurement and sale of mechanical and electrical equipment used in water purification plants and sewage treatment plants. The Service Solution segment involves in the repair, maintenance and operation management of mechanical and electrical equipment used in water purification plants and sewage treatment plants, providing equipment inspection, repair, maintenance and other services.

name: ASAHI KOGYOSHA CO LTD
businessSummary: Asahi Kogyosha Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the design, supervision, and construction of air conditioning and sanitary equipment. The Company has two business segments. The Equipment Construction Business segment focuses on the design, supervision, and construction of air conditioning and sanitary equipment, with its core technology. The Equipment Manufacturing and Sales Business segment, together with the Equipment Construction Business segment, utilizes its air conditioning and temperature and humidity control technologies to manufacture and sell environmental equipment, primarily precision environmental control equipment for semiconductor and flat panel display (FPD) manufacturing equipment.

name: DAI NIPPON PRINTING CO LTD
businessSummary: Dai Nippon Printing Co Ltd is a Japan-based engaged in business activities related to smart communications, life & healthcare, and electronics, mainly in the printing and soft drink businesses. The Company operates through three business segments. The Smart Communications segment is engaged in the provision of books, magazines, textbooks, e-books, digital marketing support for sales promotion and customer analysis, catalogs, flyers, pamphlets, calendars, thermal transfer products, and library operations. The Life & Healthcare segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of lithium-ion battery materials, solar battery materials, materials for transporting electronic components, multifunctional heat insulation boxes, fruit juice, functional beverages, interior and exterior materials, and pharmaceuticals. The Electronics segment manufactures and sells optical films for displays, large-size photomasks for liquid crystal displays, photomasks for semiconductor products, and other products.

name: KIYO LEARNING CO LTD
businessSummary: KIYO Learning Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the e-learning and education business. The Company provides cloud services that use information technology (IT) to streamline learning to individuals and companies. The Company is involved in the STUDYing business, which is an online qualification course for individuals, as well as the AirCourse business, which is an employee education cloud service for corporations. STUDYing is a concept-based online qualification course which provides about 26 courses for business person on smartphones, tablets, personal computers (PCs) and others. AirCourse is involved in the provision of employee education, the creating and delivering training courses, as well as the provision of centralized management of in-house education.

name: CEL CORP
businessSummary: CEL Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the rental housing business, which provides consulting and solutions for apartment management; the rental development business, which develops and sells real estate; and the rental management business, which provides property management services. The Company operates business through three segments. The Apartment Construction Subcontracting segment is engaged in the plan, design, construction, and contracting of apartments for single persons, specializing in the Tokyo area. The Stock segment is mainly engaged in the leasing and management of apartment buildings on a lump-sum lease basis, apartment management services such as rent collection, and repair work. The China Leasing segment operates a serviced factory business in Ningbo City, which takes advantage of the advantages of large factory buildings to provide size categories and functions that meet the needs of clients, and a serviced office business in three locations in Shanghai.

name: WIN-PARTNERS CO LTD
businessSummary: WIN-Partners Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the medical equipment supply business through its subsidiaries. The Company is mainly in the provision of medical device, such as catheters used in ischemic heart disease, pacemakers used in cardiac rhythm management area, artificial blood vessels used for cardiovascular surgery area, embolization coil used in peripheral vascular disease and brain surgery, as well as the provision of large -scale medical equipment, such as computed tomography equipment (CT) used in the radiology department and the operating room.

name: YAKULT HONSHA CO LTD
businessSummary: Yakult Honsha Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the beverage and food manufacturing and sales business. It conducts business through regional segments in Japan, the Americas, Asia-Oceania, and Europe. The Beverages and Food Products Manufacturing and Sales business (Japan) primarily manufactures and sells dairy products and noodles, and sells soft drinks. The Beverages and Food Products Manufacturing and Sales business (Americas) primarily manufactures and sells dairy products. The Beverages and Food Products Manufacturing and Sales business (Asia and Oceania) primarily manufactures and sells dairy products. The Beverages and Food Products Manufacturing and Sales business (Europe) manufactures and sells dairy products. Other businesses include the cosmetics manufacturing and sales business, the pharmaceutical manufacturing and sales business, and professional baseball operations.

name: VALTES HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Valtes Holdings Co Ltd, formerly Valtes Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly provides software testing services, web/mobile application development services, and offshore services. The Company operates through three segments. The Software Testing Services segment provides manufacturers and software vendor clients with effective testing services from a third-party neutral standpoint by accurately following up on a wide range of activities, including test planning, test design, test case creation, test execution, and test summary reports. The Web/Mobile Application Development Services segment provides web/mobile app development and web security diagnosis (vulnerability diagnosis) for web apps and mobile apps. In the Offshore Services segment, the Company's group company, VALTES Advanced Technology, Inc. provides testing services and contracted system development to support client companies in improving the quality of their products by sharing its know-how with group companies.

name: TAKASAGO THERMAL ENGINEERING CO LTD
businessSummary: Takasago Thermal Engineering Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in equipment construction business as well as manufacturing and sales of equipment. The Company has two segments. The Equipment Construction segment involves in the maintenance and general management of equipment, the design and construction of air conditioners, water supply and drainage facilities, technical assistance to overseas subsidiaries as well as the manufacturing, sales and installation of cleanroom related equipment and interior materials. The Equipment Manufacturing and Sales segment is engaged in the design, manufacturing and sales of air conditioners. Other business involves in the sales and leasing of real estates and insurance agency business.

name: ELAN CORP
businessSummary: Elan Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the nursing care and medical care related businesses. It mainly provides care support (CS) sets, a service that combines the rental of clothes and towels with laundry service and the provision of daily necessities, to patients admitted to hospitals and users of nursing care facilities such as nursing homes for the elderly, special nursing homes for the elderly, private nursing homes for the elderly, group homes, and care houses. When introducing CS sets, the Company designs plans for the components, provides operational support to hospitals and nursing care facilities for the elderly, and arranges for the delivery of nightwear and other items to linen suppliers. After the introduction, the Company collects usage fees from users and responds to inquiries.

name: SHOEI CO LTD
businessSummary: Shoei Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the helmet-related business, primarily manufacturing and selling motorcycle helmets. Products include helmets and related products. It mainly manufactures and sells motorcycle helmets and helmets for government use, and sells helmet parts. Through its subsidiaries, the Company is also engaged in agency management and marketing in Europe, sales of helmets and helmet parts, market research, and marketing in Southeast Asia, China, and Japan.

name: FURUNO ELECTRIC CO LTD
businessSummary: Furuno Electric Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of marine electronic devices and industrial electronic devices based on sensor technology centered on ultrasonic waves and electromagnetic waves. The Company operates through three business segments. The Marine Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of navigation equipment, fishing equipment, wireless communication equipment and others. The Industrial Business segment is engaged in the provision of medical equipment, intelligent transportation systems (ITS) equipment, global positioning system (GPS) equipment and aircraft electronics. The Wireless Local Area Network (LAN)/Handy Terminal Business segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of wireless LAN systems and handy terminals. The Company is also engaged in the electromagnetic environment test business, and digital communication business for the shipping industry.

name: ATLED CORP
businessSummary: ATLED CORP. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and sale of workflow products. The workflow products are the digitization of the business flow from deliberation, application, approval for various businesses. The main products are package softwares X-point and Agileworks, and cloud services providers X-point Cloud and ATLED WorkPlatform. X-point and X-point Cloud are targeted at small to medium-sized enterprises, Agileworks is targeted at medium to large enterprises, and ATLED WorkPlatform is targeted at software vendors and system development companies.

name: GMO PEPABO INC
businessSummary: GMO Pepabo, Inc. is principally engaged in the provision of low-priced Internet services to individuals. The Company operates in three business segments. The Hosting segment provides rental servers and domain acquisition services related to domain acquisition and utilization. The Electronic Commerce (EC) Support segment provides online shop opening and creation services that support the operation of e-commerce. The Hand-made segment is involved in the provision of handmade market services. The Company is also engaged in Internet advertising and media business.

name: QLS HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: QLS HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd is mainly engaged in childcare business, nursing care business and temporary staffing business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Childcare segment is engaged in the operation of childcare facilities, such as daycare centers. The Nursing Care segment is engaged in the operation of nursing care facility that provides home care support and home care. The Temporary Staffing segment is engaged in the provision of professional staffing service. The other business is engaged in the sale of communication equipment, such as mobile phones under contract.

name: NEXTONE INC
businessSummary: NexTone Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the copyright management business and casting business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Copyright Management business is engaged in receiving consignment form copyright holders to license the use of musical works and collect and distribute royalties. In music copyrights, there are mainly performance rights, recording rights, publishing rights, lending rights, broadcasting and cable broadcasting, interactive distribution, and commercial karaoke for business use. The Casting business is engaged in the provision of casting consulting, non-movie digital content (ODS) support, and event coordination. The Company is also engaged in the development and provision of rights processing systems such as copyrights and master rights, and content distribution system, and the development and operation of various in-house systems.

name: AI CROSS INC
businessSummary: AI CROSS Inc. is a Japan-based technology company. The Company provides messaging service, business chat service and artificial intelligence (AI) analytics service. The messaging service is a distribution platform service for delivering short message service (SMS) to mobile terminals owned by end users to domestic and foreign operators mainly engaged in business-to-consumer (B2C) business. The business chat service is a service that is intended to be used for business communication and business communication in companies. The AI Analytics service conducts research to enhance Engagement using AI technology. The other business is engaged in the development of system.

name: FABRICA HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Fabrica Holdings Co Ltd, formerly known as Fabrica Communications Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of the Internet service business centered on the used car sales business support cloud service symphony and the short message service (SMS) distribution platform Media SMS. The Company operates in four business segments. The U-CAR Solution Group segment is engaged in the provision of the used car sales business support cloud service symphony, as well as the support of businesses related to automobile after-sales service. The SMS Solution Group segment provides the SMS transmission service Media SMS for corporations. The Internet Service Group segment is engaged in the operation of automobile web magazines and the provision of used car batch assessment services. The Auto Service Group segment provides one-stop services for tow trucks and automobile maintenance business at designated factories.

name: JUSTSYSTEMS CORP
businessSummary: Justsystems Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning, development, and provision of software and related services. The Company is primarily engaged in the development and domestic sales of software. It provides software such as the Japanese input system ATOK and word processing software Ichitaro to individuals, and solutions such as document creation, data management, and business support to corporations. The Company also develops and provides software in the United States and Canada.

name: PROPERTY DATA BANK INC
businessSummary: Property Data Bank, Inc. is engaged in development of software for real estate and facility management, as well as provision of integrated asset management cloud service under the name @property. The cloud service mainly engages in provision and maintenance of @property, and support of users. It receives monthly usage fee and maintenance service fee by customer-based billing according to the number of registered building data on a monthly basis from customers. The solution service engages in business efficiency improvement for customers, who already introducing @ property or planning to introduce it. It also engages in provision of solution services according to customer specific needs.

name: SG HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: SG Holdings Co Ltd provides delivery business, logistics business and real estate business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Delivery segment provides hikyaku express courier, hikyaku large size courier service, mail service, specified letter service, art transport, delivery agent and food delivery. The Logistics segment provides distribution processing, logistics system construction, inventory storage and delivery management, international courier service and international air and sea transportation. The Real Estate segment provides real estate leasing and management, real estate development, asset management. The Company is also engaged in the transportation non-life insurance agency business, the sale of truck fuel, maintenance and sale of transportation vehicles, development and operation of logistics systems, provision of cash-on-delivery services for courier services, and the provision of human resources centered on work outsourcing in logistics facilities.

name: SUNDRUG CO LTD
businessSummary: Sundrug Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of pharmacies and the retail and wholesale of pharmaceuticals, cosmetics and daily necessities. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Drugstore segment primarily sells pharmaceuticals, cosmetics and daily necessities. The Discount Store segment mainly sells food products and household goods.

name: HPC SYSTEMS INC
businessSummary: HPC SYSTEMS Inc. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the provision of high-performance computer solutions for science and engineering fields. The Company operates in two business segments. High Performance Computer (HPC) segment is mainly involved in the development, manufacture and sale of high-performance computers for scientific and technological computations conducted by research and development institutions of universities and government agencies. Main products are cluster computers and personal cluster systems. Configure to Order (CTO) segment is involved in the development, manufacture and sale of embedded computers for industrial machinery. The Company also provides consulting services specializing in scientific and engineering calculations.

name: ASIAQUEST CO LTD
businessSummary: AsiaQuest Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the digital transformation (DX) business that supports system development, process improvement and business model transformation of client companies. The Company is engaged in the provision of Internet of Things (IoT) and artificial intelligence (AI) solutions, Web system and mobile application development services and cloud infrastructures. The IoT and AI solution service is engaged in the development of systems that utilize sensors, AI and big data. The Web system and mobile application development service is engaged in the development of Web systems and mobile applications, and the provision of interface design services, system architecture design services and others. The cloud infrastructure construction and operation service is engaged in the provision of cloud integration services such as migration works and cloud environment construction works, and the design, construction and operation of various cloud infrastructures.

name: LITALICO INC
businessSummary: Litalico Inc is a Japan-based real estate company that provides employment and learning support services in the field of disability welfare. The Company operates through four business segments. The Employment Support Business segment provides comprehensive support to people with disabilities seeking employment, from employment to workplace setup. The Child Welfare Business segment provides child development support services, after-school day care services and nursery school visit support services. The Platform Business segment operates a matching media platform and provides recruitment services for facility users and staff and provides software as a service (SaaS) product for facilities. The Overseas Business segment operates a publicly funded group home for people with severe behavioral disorders in Nebraska and provides services related to housing and daytime activity support in other areas.

name: INSOURCE CO LTD
businessSummary: Insource Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in education services business. It operates four businesses. Instructor dispatch type training business is a service that dispatches instructors to conduct training by level or skill-specific training commissioned by clients. The training can be provided in either face-to-face or online format. Open lecture business is a service that advertises hierarchical and skill-specific training programs similar to instructor-dispatched training programs as open seminars on its Website and provides the training. Information technology (IT) service business provides human resource (HR) tech services such as the learning management system (LMS) and HR support system Leaf, as well as the e-learning LMS based on Leaf. The other business provides online seminar administrative services, proprietary assessment services, and an expanded range of video educational content. Its main clients are divided into private sector and public sector.

name: ITO EN LTD
businessSummary: Ito En Ltd is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of tea and drinks. The Company operates in three business segments. The Leaf and Drink related segment purchases and manufactures tea leaf products, and sells them throughout Japan, mainly green tea, barley tea, and oolong tea. This segment also plans and develops beverage products, outsources production to manufacturers outside the group, and then purchases the finished products and sells them nationwide. The Food and Drink related segment operates and franchises restaurants of specialty coffee in Japan. The Others segment is involved in the manufacture and sell of supplements in United States.

name: BEAUTY GARAGE INC
businessSummary: BEAUTY GARAGE Inc. is primarily engaged in selling beauty equipment, store design business and other solution business. The Company operates in three segments. The Merchandising segment sells beauty equipment and cosmetics through Internet site, mail catalog and show room. In addition to purchasing from manufacturers, it also develops its own original brand products, and purchases and sells used beauty equipment. The Store Design segment is engaged in store design and construction supervision. The Other Related Solutions segment is engaged in providing a range of resources services for beauty salon operation.

name: HITACHI CONSTRUCTION MACHINERY CO LTD
businessSummary: Hitachi Construction Machinery Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of construction equipment, and the provision of related services. The Company operates in two business segments. The Construction Machinery Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of hydraulic excavators, ultra-large hydraulic excavators, wheel loaders and the provision of other related toral life cycle. The Specialized Parts & Services Business segment is involved in the development, manufacture, sale and provision of after-sales service solutions for mining equipment and machinery.

name: I CUBED SYSTEMS INC
businessSummary: i Cubed Systems Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of management services for managing mobile terminals as Software as a Service (SaaS), and the investing activities. The Company operates through two business segments. The CLOMO business segment provides functions for visualizing the usage status of mobile terminals, setting and restricting functions, and security measures as licenses, centered on CLOMO MDM, a mobile device management (MDM) service that centrally manages and operates mobile terminals and mobile personal computers (PCs). The CLOMO business segment also sells licenses for CLOMO SECURED APPs, which are applications for mobile terminals. The main services include CLOMO service and SECURED APPs service. The Investment Business segment is engaged in investment activities through corporate venture capital (CVC) and mergers and acquisitions (M&A). The main investment targets include mobile, SaaS, security and others.

name: USER LOCAL INC
businessSummary: User Local Inc is a Japan-based company that provides platform services utilizing big data and artificial intelligence (AI) to support client companies in decision-making and workstyle reform through improved operational efficiency. The Company has a data cloud business segment. The Segment offers services including the comprehensive digital marketing tool User Insight, the social media analytics tool Social Insight, the inquiry response support tool Support Chatbot, as well as the generative AI tool for corporate clients User Local ChatAI.

name: TBS HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: TBS Holdings Inc, formerly Tokyo Broadcasting System Holdings Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in broadcasting business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Media and Content segment is involved in the broadcasting-related business which conducts broadcasting, program production, video technology, audio technology, cable television broadcasting (CATV) investment, video investment and others; the planning production business which conducts video and audio software production, sales and distribution business, various events, program sales, video software production and sales, animation and music software planning and production. The Lifestyle segment is involved in the mail-order sales, general merchandise retailing, cosmetics manufacturing and sales business. The Real Estate and Others segment is involved in real estate leasing, maintenance and service business, studio management, heating and cooling management, insurance agency and other business.

name: OTSUKA CORP
businessSummary: OTSUKA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of system equipment, the installation support and maintenance services. The Company operates through two business segments. System Integration segment conducts consulting, hardware and software sales, contract software development, equipment installation and network construction. Service & Support segment provides office supply, maintenance services, as well as business support services. The Company is also involved in the car maintenance business and insurance business.

name: HOSHIZAKI CORP
businessSummary: Hoshizaki Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research and development, manufacture, sale and maintenance services for food service equipment. The Company operates in three regional segments including Japan, the Americas, Europe and Asia. The Company is engaged in the research and development of food service equipment, as well as the provision of consistent research system from product planning to commercialization. The Company is also engaged in the development of new product and advanced technology, improvement and improvement of existing products, as well as the provision of series development activities and cost reduction activities. The Company provides a system to utilize information obtained from sales and maintenance service activities and market quality information for product development.

name: SYSTENA CORP
businessSummary: Systena Corporation is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the business related to information technology (IT). The Company operates in eight segments. Solution Design segment engages in the provision of automatic operation, in-vehicle system, carrier service and others. Framework Design segment develops financial, industrial, public, and other key systems and develops basic systems. IT Service segment is engaged in the operation and maintenance of systems and networks, the provision of services of user support and data inputting, among others. Solution segment sells IT-related products and operates system integration business. Cloud segment sells and installs cloud software. Consumer Service segment plans, develops and sells game content for smartphones and tablets. Overseas segment is engaged in the solution business in overseas markets. Investment Development segment conducts new business.

name: CYBERAGENT INC
businessSummary: CyberAgent Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the media business, Internet advertising business, game business, investment development business and others. The Company operates in five business segments. The Media segment is engaged in the operation of ABEMA, a new television (TV) of the future, WINTICKET, an Internet voting service that allows users to watch live footage of bicycle and auto races and place bets online, the blog service Ameba, and tapple, a love-matching application that connects people through hobbies. The Internet Advertising segment is engaged in the advertising business, artificial intelligence (AI) business and others. The Game segment is engaged in the games business for smartphones. The Investment Development segment is engaged in the venture capital business. The Other segment is engaged in the crowdfunding management business.

name: STRIKE CO LTD
businessSummary: Strike Company, Limited is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in mergers and acquisitions (M&A) brokerage business. The Company conducts M&A brokerage business, including mergers, acquisitions, and capital alliances between companies as a certified public accountant and tax accountant company. The Company also performs incidental business including advisory business, support for M&A execution, due diligence business, company evaluation business, consulting service for improving corporate value, as well as financial consulting service, among others.

name: OPENWORK INC
businessSummary: OpenWork Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of a working data platform business based on employee reviews posted by individuals. The Company operates OpenWork, a company information site for changing jobs and finding employment based on employee word-of-mouth data. Users can learn about the actual situation of the enterprise from various angles and use it for changing jobs and finding employment. The Company also provides OpenWork Recruiting, a recruitment support service for companies that can turn job satisfaction into hiring power. In addition, the Company provides businesses that make use of employee word-of-mouth.

name: KURITA WATER INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: Kurita Water Industries Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of water treatment-related products, technology and maintenance services. The Company operates in two business segments. The Water Treatment Chemical segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of water treatment related chemicals and related equipment, as well as the provision of maintenance services. The Water Treatment Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of equipment and facilities related to water treatment, the provision of ultra-pure water, the provision of chemical cleaning and precision cleaning services, the purification of soil and groundwater, as well as the provision of maintenance services such as operation and maintenance of water treatment facilities.

name: NIPPON SHINYAKU CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Shinyaku Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals and functional foods. The Company has two business segments. The Pharmaceutical Business segment conducts research and development in three focus areas: hematology, intractable and rare diseases (pulmonary arterial hypertension, muscular dystrophy, etc.), and urological and gynecological diseases. The Functional Food Business segment conducts research and development mainly in three categories: health food ingredients, quality-stabilizing preservatives, and protein preparations. Other businesses include business support, non-life insurance agency and life insurance solicitation, real estate rental, and educational support services.

name: TAKUMA CO LTD
businessSummary: TAKUMA CO., LTD. is a company that is active in four business segments. The Domestic Environment and Energy segment is engaged in the design, construction, sale, operation and maintenance of general waste treatment plants, industrial waste treatment plants, resource recovery plants, sewage disposal plants, sludge incineration plants, biomass electric generation plants and generation gas turbine systems. The Overseas Environment and Energy segment provides waste power generation plants and biomass power generation plants. The Civilian Heat Energy segment offers miniature through-flow boilers and vacuum hot-water supply heaters. The Facilities and Systems segment is involved in the sale and maintenance of building facilities, semiconductor industry-use facilities and clean systems.

name: NOMURA RESEARCH INSTITUTE LTD
businessSummary: Nomura Research Institute Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of consulting services, development and product sales, operational services, and product sales services. The Company operates four business segments. The Consulting segment provides policy recommendations, strategic consulting, operational consulting, and systems consulting. The Financial IT Solutions segment provides system consulting, system development and operation services, IT solutions such as joint-use systems, and business process outsourcing (BPO) services, mainly for financial industry clients. The Industrial IT Solutions segment provides IT solutions such as system consulting, system development and operation services to the distribution, manufacturing, service, and public sectors. The IT Platform Services segment provides data center operations and management, IT infrastructure and network construction, and other services.

name: TEIKOKU SEN-I CO LTD
businessSummary: Teikoku Sen-I Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the disaster prevention, textile, and real estate leasing businesses. The Company operates through four business segments. The Disaster Prevention segment manufactures, purchases, and sells fire hoses, chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear, and explosive (CBRNE) disaster prevention equipment, rescue vehicles, special disaster prevention vehicles, and airport chemical fire trucks. The Textile segment manufactures, processes, and sells textile materials for government agencies and high-performance textile materials such as Nomex for industrial use for private demand. The Real Estate Leasing segment leases land for shopping centers, and others. The Other segment provides insurance agency services.

name: OBAYASHI CORP
businessSummary: Obayashi Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction and real estate businesses. It has five business segments. The Domestic Construction segment is engaged in the acceptance and construction of construction work, interior construction, sales and rental of construction materials and equipment, and comprehensive building management. The Overseas Construction segment is engaged in the construction work in North America and Southeast Asia. The Domestic Civil Engineering segment is engaged in the acceptance and construction of civil engineering work. The Overseas Civil Engineering segment is engaged in the civil engineering work in North America and Southeast Asia. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the buying and selling and leasing of real estate, and development business. It is also engaged in the private finance initiative (PFI) business, renewable energy business, information and communication technology (ICT) related business and financial business.

name: UT GROUP CO LTD
businessSummary: UT Group Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of temporary staffing and contract work services. It operates through four business segments. Motor Energy Business segment specializes in human resources services for major automobile manufacturers, providing just-in-time labor supply services to major clients and related companies in the automobile, auto parts manufacturers and battery-related industries. Semiconductor Business specializes in human resources services for major semiconductor manufacturers, systematizing job and career development for major clients and related companies in the semiconductor field. Agent Business segment provides temporary staffing and contract work, acts as a recruitment agent for job seekers and operates a paid job placement business. Next Career Business segment supports human resources strategies specializing in solving management issues and provides new workplaces where talent from major companies can utilize their skills.

name: CYBOZU INC
businessSummary: Cybozu Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and sale of software. It is primarily engaged in the development and license sales of groupware, the provision of software as a service (SaaS), cloud-based groupware, and internet services, and the provision of high-value-added system integration (SI). Its software products include Kintone, Cybozu Office, Garoon, and Mailwise.

name: M&A CAPITAL PARTNERS CO LTD
businessSummary: M&A Capital Partners Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of brokerage business of mergers and acquisitions (M&A), as well as the provision of related services. The Company is mainly targeting middle and small-sized enterprises, providing M&A agency service, using the business model that makes free debut money and promoting business expansion. The Company operates M&A related service business, including brokerage business, brokerage and advisory services, as well as database provision and media management business. In addition, the Company also operates administrative and general management consulting services.

name: JIMOTY INC
businessSummary: Jimoty, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the classified site operation business. The Company is engaged in the operation of a platform Jimoty that provides local information. The platform categorizes regional information from all over Japan by purpose, such as buying and selling goods, asking for help, recruiting members, renting and selling real estate, buying and selling used cars, recruiting full-time and part-time employees, various business advertising, events and others. The platform provides matching opportunities between users, and develops a customer support system through checking all submitted contents, drawing users' attention to offending users, taking measures to suspend use and others. The platform is also provides network advertising services such as automatic distribution, and marketing support services.

name: QUANTS RESEARCH INSTITUTE HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Quants Research Institute Holdings Inc, formerly M&A Research Institute Holdings Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in mergers and acquisitions (M&A) brokerage and other businesses. The Company operates through two business segments. The M&A Brokerage Business segment provides hybrid M&A brokerage services using technology centered on artificial intelligence (AI) and the support of M&A advisors. The Other segment is mainly engaged in consulting and asset management consulting businesses.

name: EARTH INFINITY CO LTD
businessSummary: Earth Infinity Co Ltd is mainly engaged in the energy business and electronic equipment businesses. The energy business outsources supply and demand management to intermediaries, and uses electricity procured from private power plants and electricity procured through market transactions with the Japan Electric Power Exchange using the power transmission and distribution network owned by general power transmission and distribution business operators, supplies electricity to customers in each business area. In addition, the business conducts sales activities centered on direct sales by employees. The electronic equipment business mainly offers energy cost reduction proposals and consulting by manufacturing, selling, and installing electronic breakers (breakers with built-in computers) for small and medium-sized enterprises.

name: TOSOH CORP
businessSummary: Tosoh Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of basic raw materials and functional products such as petrochemicals and chemical products. The Company operates in four segments. The Petrochemicals segment manufactures and sells olefin products such as ethylene and propylene, low-density polyethylene, high-density polyethylene, processed resin products, and functional polymers. The Chlor-Alkali segment manufactures and sells caustic soda, vinyl chloride monomer, vinyl chloride resin, inorganic and organic chemicals, cement, and urethane materials. The Functional Products segment manufactures and sells inorganic and organic fine products, measuring and diagnostic products, electronic materials, and functional materials. The Engineering segment manufactures and sells water treatment facilities and engages in construction and repair businesses. The Company also engages in transportation and warehousing, inspection and analysis, and information processing.

name: NAKANO REFRIGERATORS CO LTD
businessSummary: NAKANO REFRIGERATORS CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of frozen and refrigerated showcases for food stores. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of showcases for stores, the construction and maintenance of showcases for food stores, as well as the sale, construction and maintenance of showcases for food stores.

name: EKITAN & CO LTD
businessSummary: Ekitan & Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company providing information contents services. The Company operates in two business segments. The Consumer business develops a transit guide service Station Search Transit Information for individuals through mobile phones including smart phones. The Business for Corporate Users provides transit guidance services provided by the Company as application service provider (ASP) service for corporations such as mobile carriers, railroad companies and map companies.

name: JAPAN AIRLINES CO LTD
businessSummary: Japan Airlines Co Ltd is a Japan-based company that operates businesses including air transportation, cargo, finance and travel. The Company operates through three business segments. The Full-Service Carrier Business segment operates air transportation services connecting the world with Japan, cities with regions, as well as cargo and mail services that combine the cargo space of its own passenger aircraft and dedicated freighter aircraft. The Low-Cost Carrier (LCC) Business segment operates air transportation services connecting North America, Asia, Japan, China and other regions. The Mileage/Finance & Commerce Business segment operates mileage programs, provides credit card services and engages in wholesale business. The Company also operates a travel business. The travel business plans and sells travel using air transportation and develops and operates systems.

name: CYBERBUZZ INC
businessSummary: CyberBuzz, Inc. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the advertising and marketing business through social media such as blogs, Twitter, Facebook and Instagram. The NINARY service and Ripre service is involved in the advertising and marketing business by influencers who have a certain number of readers and followers in social media. The Pochicome service operates a monitor Website that anyone can use if they use social media. The to buy service operates an online media where influencers introduce their personal items and services as original articles. The SNS Account Management service supports the operation of social media accounts that are officially operated by client companies. In addition to sales of services operated by the Company, the Internet advertising agency sales service also sells advertising products centered on social media-related advertisements such as YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, and LINE.

name: LIB WORK CO LTD
businessSummary: Lib Work Co., Ltd., formerly SK home Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the detached residential business. The Company is engaged in the planning, design, sale, construction and supervision of custom homes such as residential houses, condominiums and others. The Company is also engaged in the real estate sale business, and the renovation and remodeling businesses in association with the detached residential business.

name: ADR ON KUBOTA CORP
businessSummary: Kubota Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the provision of agricultural machines, engines and construction machines. The Company operates in three business segments. Machinery segment manufactures and sells agricultural machines and agricultural products, such as tractors, tillers, combine harvesters, rice planters, lawn mowers. The Segment also provides construction machinery and engines for agricultural machinery, construction machinery, industrial machinery and generators. Water & Environment segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of pipe systems such as ductile iron pipes and synthetic pipes, industrial equipment such as reaction pipes, spiral steel pipes, air conditioning equipment, and various environmental plants, pumps, and other products related to the environment. Others segment mainly provides logistics and financial services, roofing materials and exterior wall materials.

name: JAPAN POST BANK CO LTD
businessSummary: JAPAN POST BANK Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in banking business. It primarily engages in deposit business, lending business, securities investment business, exchange business, government bonds, investment trust and counter sales of insurance products, intermediary business as well as credit card business. The Bank's main businesses include fund management, financing, asset and liability management, as well as fee-based business.

name: RESONA HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Resona Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of financial services such as banking and trust services, credit card services and venture capital services. The Company operates in four segments. The Retail Division segment is mainly engaged in consulting services related to personal loans, asset management, and succession of assets, etc., for individual customers. The Corporate Division segment is mainly engaged in business for corporate clients, focusing on support for business growth, including corporate lending, asset management using trusts, real estate operations, corporate pensions, and business succession. The Market Division Segment is mainly engaged in financing and investment of funds, foreign exchange, bonds, and derivatives through financial markets. The Kansai Mirai Financial Group segment is engaged in banking business in the Kansai region, including deposit and lending business.

name: AUCNET INC
businessSummary: AUCNET INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the automobile business and digital products business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Automobile segment is engaged in the provision of used car television (TV) auctions, shared inventory markets, live broadcast auctions, bid agency services, and vehicle inspection services. The Digital Products segment is engaged in the provision of auction and distribution related services for used smartphones and used personal computers (PCs) and other used digital devices. The Other Information Distribution segment is engaged in the provision of auction and distribution related services for branded products, used motorcycles, cut flowers and pots. It is also engaged in the development and provision of systems, the provision of communication, operation and maintenance services, the business related with used medical equipment, and overseas business.

name: SEIBU HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Seibu Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company operates in the real estate, hotel and leisure, and urban transportation and railway line businesses. It has three business segments. The Real Estate Business segment consists of development and leasing, investment management, management and others. The development and leasing business is engaged in real estate development, primarily in the Takanawa and Shinagawa areas, and the management and value-add of acquired properties in the real estate turnover business. The Hotel and Leisure Business segment consists of domestic hotel operations, overseas hotel operations, sports, and others. The Urban Transportation and Railway Line Business segment consists of railway operations, bus operations, railway line lifestyle services, sports, and others. Other businesses include rail passenger transportation, bus and taxi operations, leisure facility operations, and sports businesses.

name: M-UP HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: M-up Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in provision of content and distributing systems in entertainment business covering content holders to the users. The Company operates in three business segments. The Content segment is involved in the distribution business for mobile terminals. The E-commerce (EC) segment is involved in the sale of mail-order by mobile and personal computer (PC). The Electronic Ticket segment is involved in the electronic tickets and ticket trading, as well as the related services.

name: C.UYEMURA & CO LTD
businessSummary: C.Uyemura & Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the surface treatment materials business, surface treatment machinery business, plating processing business, and real estate leasing business. It operates through four segments. The Surface Treatment Materials segment mainly sells plating chemicals for printed circuit boards, plating chemicals for aluminum magnetic disks, industrial chemicals, and non-ferrous metals. The Surface Treatment Machinery segment mainly sells plating machines for printed circuit boards and aluminum magnetic disks. The Plating Processing segment is engaged in plating processes for plastics and printed circuit boards. The Real Estate Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing of office buildings, apartments, and factory sites.

name: RORZE CORP
businessSummary: Rorze Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture, and sale of semiconductor-related equipment and flat panel display (FPD)-related equipment. The Company operates through two segments. The Semiconductor/FPD-related Equipment segment develops, manufactures, and sells dust-free transport equipment for the semiconductor and liquid crystal display industries. Its main products include atmospheric wafer transport equipment (systems) such as equipment front end modules (EFEMs), wafer sorters, and N2 purge-compatible wafer stockers, vacuum wafer transport equipment (systems), wafer transport units (single units), fully automated vapor phase decomposition (VPD) equipment, large glass substrate transport equipment, and glass cutting machines. The Life Sciences segment develops, manufactures, and sells cell culture equipment for the drug discovery industry and other industries.

name: BAYCURRENT INC
businessSummary: BayCurrent Inc, formerly BayCurrent Consulting Inc, is a Japan-based comprehensive consulting firm that provides support for a wide range of themes including strategy, digital, and operations. The Consulting business segment offers planning and execution support to resolve significant management issues faced by client companies, such as formulating company-wide and business strategies to support top management decision-making, and supporting the consideration of business operations using digital technology. The Company understands the unique corporate culture and values of its clients, and provides proposals that it considers feasible and optimal.

name: SANRIO CO LTD
businessSummary: Sanrio Co Ltd is mainly engaged in character licensing, gift product planning and sales, and theme park business. The character licensing business involves licensing and managing merchandising rights. The gift product planning and sales business involves planning and selling gift products, greeting cards, and publications, as well as producing and selling video software. The theme park business involves operating theme parks and planning and performing musicals and other events. The other business involves selling and leasing robots, renting automobiles, and providing non-life insurance agency services. The Company operates in five business segments. The Japan segment includes gift products, merchandising rights, theme parks, robots, and non-life insurance agency services. The Europe segment includes gift products, merchandising rights, and loans. The North American, South American, and Asian segments include gift products and merchandising rights.

name: SCREEN HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Screen Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of semiconductor manufacturing equipment. The Company operates through four business segments. The Semiconductor Production Equipment (SPE) segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance of semiconductor manufacturing equipment. The Graphics and Arts Equipment (GA) segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance of printing related equipment. The Display Manufacturing Equipment and Film Forming Equipment (FT) segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance of display manufacturing equipment and film forming equipment. The Printed Circuit Board-related Equipment (PE) segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance of printed circuit board related equipment. The Company is also engaged in the provision of life science equipment, plan and production of documents, and development and sale of software.

name: USS CO LTD
businessSummary: USS Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the auto auctions business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Auto Auction segment is engaged in the operation of auto auctions with used car dealers as members, the management of motorcycle auctions with used motorcycle dealers as members, the provision of auto auction connection services by satellite TV line and Internet, the provision of used car information services, the land transportation agency of exhibited cars and successful cars of auto auction, as well as the provision of financial services for auto auction members. The Used Automobile Purchase and Sale segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of used cars and accident-affected vehicles. The other business is engaged in the recycling of used vehicles, the provision of agency services for used vehicles, the sale of solar power generation systems and rental cars, as well as production and sale of recycled plastics.

name: BUSINESS ENGINEERING CORP
businessSummary: Business Engineering Corporation, formerly Toyo Business Engineering Corporation, is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of information services. The Company operates in three business segments. The Solution segment is involved in the design, development and installation of corporate information systems, with the use of enterprise resource planning (ERP) packages developed by other companies. The Product segment is engaged in the sale of self-developed ERP packages through partner companies, as well as the design, development and installation of corporate information systems using its products. The System Support segment provides support services for system operation and maintenance, to companies with ERP system installed.

name: SANTEC HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Santec Holdings Corp, formerly Santec Corp, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of optical component-related and optical measuring instrument-related products. The Company operates through two business segments. Optical Components Related segment is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of optical components for optical transmission equipment. Products include optical monitors, optical attenuators, optical filters, and spatial light modulators (SLM). Optical Measuring Instrument Related segment is engaged in development, manufacture and sale of optical transmission equipment, measuring instruments for evaluation and inspection of optical parts, optical coherence tomography, and optical intraocular dimension measuring equipment. Products include wavelength tunable light sources, wavelength tunable filters, high-speed scanning lasers, optical coherence tomography (OCT) and others. It is also engaged in the system solution business.

name: MARUWA CO LTD
businessSummary: MARUWA Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of ceramic components, including electronic components, and lighting equipment. The Company operates through two segments. The Ceramic Components segment manufactures and sells electronic components, ceramic substrates, and products related to semiconductor manufacturing equipment. The Lighting Equipment segment is involved in the production and sale of the lighting equipment that uses light emitting diode (LED) in addition to conventional lighting equipment. The Company is also involved in the business of supporting foundation activities.

name: AZOOM CO LTD
businessSummary: AZoom Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in idle asset utilization business and visualization business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Idle Asset Utilization segment operates the monthly parking lot portal site CarParking and provides a monthly parking lot introduction service that introduce parking lots, as well as renting vacant parking lots from parking lot owners and subleasing them to users as monthly parking lots. The Company's business focuses on monthly parking sublease services. The Company also offer SMART KUKANYOYAKU, a Web reservation system that supports the operation of rental spaces such as conference rooms, gyms, studios and others, Coupa Search, a portal site for hourly parking lots, AdWall, a search site for outdoor advertising spaces. The Visualization segment utilizes specialized skills 3D computer graphics (3DCG) technology to help explain how buildings and spaces are used and how to visualize the finished product.

name: LASERTEC CORP
businessSummary: Lasertec Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the design, manufacture and sale of the inspection and measurement equipment. The Company is involved in the design, manufacture and sale of the semiconductor-related devices and other devices using optical application technology, as well as the provision of the related services. The Company’s main products include semiconductor related equipment such as photomasks and defect inspection or measurement equipment for various wafers, energy & environment related equipment for SiC wafer, transparent wafer defect inspection or review equipment, FPD-related equipment for FPD photomask defect inspection equipment, hybrid laser microscope laser microscope. The Company operates in North America and Europe, Japan and Asia.

name: ADVANTEST CORP
businessSummary: Advantest Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of semiconductor and component test system product lines and mechatronics-related product lines, as well as other related research and development, maintenance and service activities. The Company consists of three business segments. The Semiconductor and Component Test Systems Business segment provides test system products such as System on Chip (SoC) test systems and memory test systems for the semiconductor and electronic component industries. The Mechatronics-related Business segment provides test handlers for mechatronics-applied products that handle semiconductor devices, device interfaces that interface with the device under test, and nanotechnology-related products. The Services and Others segment provides comprehensive customer solutions, solutions for system-level testing of solid state drive (SSD) and other devices, support services, used equipment sales, and equipment leasing.

name: J.FRONT RETAILING CO LTD
businessSummary: J.Front Retailing Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the department store business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Department Store segment is engaged in the sale of apparel, general merchandise, household goods, foodstuffs, and others. The Shopping Center (SC) segment develops, manages, administers, and operates shopping centers. The Developer segment develops, manages, and operates real estate, and conducts interior decoration work and others. The Payment and Finance segment is engaged in the issuance and operation of credit cards. The Company is also engaged in wholesale trade, parking lot business, and leasing business.

name: KONAMI GROUP CORP
businessSummary: Konami Group Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the entertainment and sports businesses. The Company operates in four business segments. The Digital Entertainment segment is engaged in the production, manufacture and sale of mobile games, card games, home games and other digital contents. The Amusement segment is engaged in the production, manufacturing and sales of amusement machines. The Gaming and Systems segment is engaged in the production, manufacturing and sales of gaming machines and casino management systems, as well as the provision of related services. The Sports segment is engaged in the operation of fitness, swimming, gymnastics, dance, soccer, tennis, golf schools and other schools, as well as the sales of sports related products.

name: CAPCOM CO LTD
businessSummary: Capcom Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the digital content business, amusement facility business, as well as amusement equipment business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Digital Content segment develops and sells home video games and mobile content. The Amusement Facility segment operates stores equipped with game machines. The Amusement Equipment segment develops, manufactures and sells gaming machines to store operators. The Company also engages in character content-related businesses.

name: TRANSACTION CO LTD
businessSummary: Transaction Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the general sundry goods business and related operations. The Company operates an integrated business ranging from planning and design of eco-products, lifestyle products, and wellness products to production (contract), production quality control, and sales. The Company sells made-to-order products that meet customer and market demands directly to end-user companies. The Company also sells its own original easy-to-order products to wholesalers. The Company sells products to end-users, wholesalers, and others through e-commerce, primarily through its own website.

name: SHIBAURA MECHATRONICS CORP
businessSummary: SHIBAURA MECHATRONICS CORPORATION is a Japan-based manufacturer primarily engaged in fine mechatronics business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Fine Mechatronics segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of flat panel display (FPD) manufacturing equipment, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, maintenance equipment for railroad tracks and vacuum pumps. The Mechatronics System segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of FPD manufacturing equipment, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, vacuum application equipment, secondary battery manufacturing equipment, precision parts manufacturing equipment and automatic equipment, among others. The Distribution Equipment System segment is engaged in the provision of vending machines, automatic ticket machines and others. The Real Estate Leasing segment is involved in the leasing and management of real estate properties.

name: SEKISUI HOUSE REIT INC
businessSummary: Sekisui House Reit Inc is a real estate investment trust (REIT) company invests in residential and commercial real estate with the goal of securing stable earnings over the medium to long term. For residential real estate, the Fund invests mainly in the Tokyo 23 Wards, a key investment area for the Tokyo metropolitan area, where it believes there is abundant rental demand and a supply of high-quality properties. For commercial real estate, the Fund invests mainly in the three major cities (Tokyo 23 Wards, Osaka City, and Nagoya City), a key investment area for the three major metropolitan areas, where it believes there is strong demand as bases for tenant companies' business activities and where it believes there is potential for stable management. And investments in overseas real estate, the Fund limits its investments to residential real estate. The asset management company is Sekisui House Asset Management, Ltd.

name: OTSUKA HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Otsuka Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in medical, nutraceutical, consumer and other business activities in Japan and overseas. The Company operates in four business segments. The Medical Business segment produces and sells therapeutic drugs and infusions. The Nutraceutical segment produces and sells functional beverages, quasi-drugs and nutritional supplements. The Consumer Products segment produces and sells mineral water, beverages and food products.
