The Others segment manufactures paper containers, manufactures synthetic resin molded products, stores products, provides storage space, and produces and sells chemicals and liquid crystal evaluation equipment, spectroscopic analysis equipment, and other products.

name: TOWA CORP
businessSummary: Towa Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of precision molds for semiconductor manufacturing, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, medical devices and laser processing equipment, as well as after-sales services for the products. It operates through three business segments. The Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment segment manufactures and sells precision molds for semiconductor manufacturing, molding equipment, singulation equipment and other products and provides after-sales services for the products. The Medical Device segment manufactures and sells medical equipment and other products. The Laser Processing Equipment segment manufactures and sells laser processing equipment and provides after-sales services for the products.

name: FAST RETAILING CO LTD
businessSummary: Fast Retailing Co Ltd is a Japan-based holding company primarily engaged in the clothing business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Japan UNIQLO segment is engaged in the sale of casual clothing in Japan market under the brand of UNIQLO. The Overseas UNIQLO segment is engaged in the sale of casual clothing in overseas markets under the brand of UNIQLO. The GU segment is engaged in the sale of casual clothing in Japan and overseas markets under the brand of GU. The Global Brand segment is engaged in the planning, manufacture and sale of clothing in Japan and overseas markets, and operates Theory, PLST, COMPTOIR DES COTONNIERS and PRINCESSE TAM.TAM businesses. The Company is also engaged in the real estate leasing business and other businesses.

name: YAMAICHI ELECTRONICS CO LTD
businessSummary: Yamaichi Electronics Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of mechanical components such as integrated circuit (IC) socket products used in semiconductor inspection processes and connector products for electronic and electrical equipment. The Company operates through three segments. The Test Solutions segment provides burn-in sockets, test sockets, and semiconductor test-related services. The Connector Solutions segment manufactures and sells high-speed transmission connectors, card connectors, interface connectors, board connectors, pressure-welded connectors, mounting IC sockets, various other connectors, and YFLEX (high-speed transmission cables and mounting boards). The Optical-related Business segment manufactures and sells red, green, and blue (RGB) filters, ultraviolet (UV)/infrared (IR) cut filters, dichroic filters/mirrors, fluorescent dichroic filters, short/long-pass filters, band-pass filters, and semiconductor laser light sources.

name: SKY PERFECT JSAT HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: SKY Perfect JSAT Holdings Inc is a Japan-based holding company engaged in broadcasting business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Media segment is engaged in the broadcasting of fee-charging channels broadcasting service through optical fiber networks. This segment is also involved in the widespread broadcasting of fee-charging channels for client management and advertising, the digitalization and encipherment of broadcast signals, as well as the image and information transmission business through communication satellites and optical fibers. The Universe and Satellite segment provides communication services for public agencies, public institutions, corporate communication, international data communication and mobile communication. The company also operates a public relations business and an Internet portal.

name: MORIYA TRANS E&M
businessSummary: Moriya Transportation Engineering and Manufacturing Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacturing, sales, installation, maintenance and repair business of elevators in Japan and overseas. The Elevator segment is mainly engaged in the business related to cargo and marine elevators in Japan, as well as purchasing agency business, marine elevator installation and maintenance business overseas. Products include luggage elevators and marine elevators. Services include maintenance and repair. The Company conclude maintenance contracts and inspection contracts for elevators with clients, and carry out outsourced maintenance, repairs, and periodic inspections and inspections required by the Building Standards Act and the Industrial Safety and Health Act.

name: DISCO CORP
businessSummary: Disco Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of semiconductor manufacturing devices and precision processing tools, as well as the maintenance and related services business. The Company is engaged in the provision of dicing saws, laser saws, grinders, polishers, surface planers and other precision processing equipment, as well as dicing blades, grinding wheels, dry polishing wheels, grindstones for grinding and cutting and other precision processing tools.

name: EWELL CO LTD
businessSummary: eWeLL Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the operation of home-visit nursing dedicated electronic medical record iBow. The Company is engaged in the provision of cloud service and business process outsourcing (BPO) service. The cloud service is engaged in the provision of a variety of services mainly to home-visit nursing stations to solve problems in all aspects of the work of home-visit nursing stations. The BPO service is engaged in the provision of iBow office management agency service.

name: HOYA CORP
businessSummary: Hoya Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of healthcare-related products, medical-related products, electronics-related products, and imaging-related products, as well as related businesses. The Company operates in three business segments. The Life Care segment manufactures and sells healthcare-related products used in daily life in the health and medical fields, and medical-related products such as medical devices and medical supplies used in medical procedures. The Information and Communication segment manufactures and sells components essential for digital equipment, including electronics-related products that are indispensable for modern digital information and communication technology and imaging-related products that are necessary for capturing images and video as digital information based on optical technology. The Others segment is mainly engaged in the speech synthesis software business and the information system services business.

name: YOKOGAWA ELECTRIC CORP
businessSummary: Yokogawa Electric Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of control equipment. The Company operates in three segments. The Control segment provides comprehensive solutions ranging from on-site sensors such as flow meters, differential pressure/pressure transmitters, and process analyzers to production control systems, programmable controllers, industrial recorders, and various software to improve productivity and services to minimize plant life cycle costs. The Measuring Instruments segment provides waveform measuring instruments, optical communication-related measuring instruments, signal generators, and power, temperature, and pressure measuring instruments. The New Business and Others segment provides services utilizing the Internet of Things (IoT) and artificial intelligence (AI), manufacture and sales of biomass materials, and research, development, and contract manufacturing of bulk pharmaceuticals and other products.

name: MEC CO LTD
businessSummary: MEC Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemicals for electronic substrates and electronic components, as well as the sale of machinery and materials for electronic substrates. Through six segments, namely Japan, Taiwan, Zhuhai (China), Suzhou (China), Thailand, and Europe, the Company develops, manufactures, and sells chemicals for manufacturing electronic substrates and electronic components, and sells related machinery and materials. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemicals for electronic substrates and electronic components, including adhesion enhancers, etching agents, and other surface treatment agents, machinery for electronic substrates, including chemical treatment machinery and various pre- and post-treatment machinery, the sale of materials for electronic substrates, including copper foil and dry film, and the provision of machinery repair services.

name: FFRI SECURITY INC
businessSummary: FFRI Security Inc, formerly FFRI Inc, is a Japan-based company engaged in the cyber security business. The Company is engaged in the provision of security products such as FFRI yarai, a targeted attack countermeasure product, and FFRI yarai analyzer, a malware automatic analysis tool. The Company sells products by subscription license or perpetual license, and provides product update and maintenance services, as well as the copyright business. The security service business is engaged in the outsourced development of cyber security products, the investigation of computer system security robustness and impact when subjected to cyber attacks, as well as the provision of security investigation, analysis and research services. The main services include security measures support services for Internet of Things (IoT) devices and systems, as well as Prime Analysis, a service that provides consulting and security information, and FFRI Expert Seminar, a paid training for security engineers.

name: MITSUBISHI CORP
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in metal resources, natural gas, consumer industry and other businesses. It has ten business segments. Natural Gas segment engages in production and development of natural gas and crude oil. Comprehensive Materials segment engages in sales transactions of carbon, steel products. Chemical Solutions segment engages in sales, business development and investment in chemical-related fields. Metal Resources segment engages in investment and development of metal resources. Industrial Infrastructure segment conducts business in energy infrastructure and industrial plants. Automobile and Mobility segment provides value chain businesses. Food Industry segment conducts sales transactions in food related production. Consumer Industry segment provides products and services in the retail and apparel. Electric Power Solution segment provides power. Complex Urban Development segment conducts urban and real estate development.

name: WINGARC1ST INC
businessSummary: WingArc1st Inc is engaged in the development and sale of corporate software and services. The Company is engaged in data empowerment business, including form and document management solutions and data empowerment solutions. In the form and document management solution, the Company provides software used in Japan as a business foundation for forms and solutions based on them. It is used for creating, outputting, and managing forms in various places in society, from business forms such as invoices, delivery notes, shipping slips, and e-tickets to various certificates issued by public institutions. Main products include SVF, SVF Cloud and SPA. The data empowerment solution mainly sells software, provides cloud services, and provides maintenance support to end users. The main software and services include Dr.Sum and MotionBoard. The Company is also engaged in the provision of professional services.

name: AJINOMOTO CO INC
businessSummary: Ajinomoto Co Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the food business. The Company operates in three business segments. Seasonings & Foods segment is engaged in the provision of seasonings, nutritional and processed foods, and solutions & ingredients. The Frozen Foods segment is engaged in the provision of frozen foods. The Health Care and Other segment is engaged in the provision of pharmaceutical- and food-use amino acids, biopharmaceutical services, functional materials, and other products and services.

name: SONY GROUP CORP
businessSummary: Sony Group Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the games & network services (G&NS), music, movies, entertainment technology & services (ET&S), imaging & sensing solutions (I&SS) and other businesses. It has seven business segments. G&NS segment is involved in network service business, the manufacture and sale of home video game consoles and software. The Music segment mainly includes music production, music publishing and video media platform businesses. The Movies segment mainly includes film production, television program production and media network businesses. The ET&S field mainly includes the television business, audio, video business, still image, video camera business, smartphone business and Internet-related service business. The I&SS segment mainly includes the image sensor business. The Financial segment is involved in the insurance business and banking business. The Other segment consists of activities such as disc manufacturing business and recording media business.

name: FIXSTARS CORP
businessSummary: Fixstars Corporation is an information technology (IT) company. The Company operates in two business segments. Software Services segment is engaged in the development of software, focusing on embedded system for manufacturing industry, as well as grid framework and risk measurement for financial industry. Hardware Infrastructure segment provides multi-core processors and computing boards that are optimal for customers' products and business. The Company's main products consist of image processing processor-based computing boards and peripheral devices, and general-purpose equipment which includes graphics processing unit (GPU) and multi-core-based servers. The Company provides total solutions for customers in health care, industrial equipment, mobile, and financial sectors.

name: WEATHERNEWS INC
businessSummary: Weathernews Inc is a Japan-based company that collects meteorological, oceanographic, geological, hydrological and astronomical data together with customers and supporters and provides both corporate and individual clients with countermeasure content created based on highly accurate forecasts. The Company operates comprehensive content delivery services centered on weather information business segment. The Company provides weather services to a range of companies, including those in transportation and infrastructure across land, sea and air domains for corporate clients (B2B). The Company delivers weather services through applications and media platforms for individual clients (B2S).

name: MITSUI KINZOKU CO LTD
businessSummary: Mitsui Kinzoku Co Ltd, formerly Mitsui Mining and Smelting Co Ltd, is mainly engaged in functional materials business, metal business, mobility business and others. The Company operates in four segments. The Functional Materials segment provides copper foils such as ultra-thin copper foils with carriers and electrolytic copper foils for plant wiring boards, functional powders such as metal powders for electronic materials and tantalum oxide, battery materials such as hydrogen storage alloys, sputtering targets such as indium tin oxide, and ceramic products. The Metals segment manufactures and sells zinc, lead, copper, gold, and silver, as well as engages in resource recycling. The Mobility segment manufactures and sells exhaust gas purification catalysts, automotive door locks, die-casting products, and powder metallurgy products. The Other segment manufactures and sells drawn copper products and pearlite products, as well as engages in industrial plant engineering.

name: TAKEDA PHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Takeda Pharmaceutical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research, development, manufacturing and global sales of a wide range of pharmaceuticals. Its main business areas are divided into six, including gastroenterology, rare diseases, plasma-derived therapies, oncology (cancer), vaccines, and neuroscience (neuropsychiatric disorders). In research and development, the Company focuses on three priority disease areas, including gastroenterology and inflammatory diseases, neuroscience, and oncology, and also focuses on plasma-derived therapies.

name: TOKYO ELECTRON LTD
businessSummary: Tokyo Electron Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial electronics products, primarily semiconductor production equipment and flat panel display (FPD) production equipment. The Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment segment provides wafer-compatible batch-type thermal processing equipment, wafer-compatible semi-batch-type deposition equipment, wafer-compatible single wafer deposition equipment, wafer-compatible coater/developers, wafer-compatible plasma etch systems, and semiconductor test systems. The Company also provides logistics, facility management, and insurance services.

name: HIROSE ELECTRIC CO LTD
businessSummary: Hirose Electric Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacture and sale of multi-pole connectors, coaxial connectors, and other electronic components. The Company operates through two business segments. The Multi-Pole Connector segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of round connectors, square connectors, and connectors for printed wiring boards. The Coaxial Connector segment is engaged in the provision of coaxial connectors and optical connectors. It is also engaged in the manufacture and sale of electronic medical devices and micro switches.

name: ITMEDIA INC
businessSummary: ITmedia Inc. is mainly engaged in the operation of media businesses. The Company provides media services in information technology (IT) area. It mainly operates through two business segments. The Lead Gen business consists of IT & business fields including TechTarget Japan, Keymanznet, order navigation and ITmedia marketing, as well as industrial technology fields including TechFactory. Media Advertising business includes IT & business fields including IT, IT Strategy Research Center, ITmedia NEWS, ITmedia Enterprise, ITmedia Executive, ITmedia Business Online, industrial technology field including MONOist, EE Times Japan, EDN Japan, Smart Japan, as well as consumer fields including ITmedia Mobile, ITmedia PC USER, ITmedia LifeStyle and Nogura.

name: TOEI ANIMATION CO LTD
businessSummary: Toei Animation Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the video production and sales business, copyright business, and product sales business. It operates through three segments. The Video Production and Sales segment is mainly involved in the planning and production of various anime works for theaters and television, the sale of broadcasting rights and video rights for works, and video distribution services for personal computers and mobile devices. The Copyright segment licenses merchandising rights for characters that appear in the works it produces. The Product Sales segment develops and sells character products. The Company also plans and manages various events such as costume shows and musicals.

name: TDK CORP
businessSummary: TDK Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of passive components, sensor application products, magnetic application products and energy application products. The Company operates through four business segments. The Passive Components segment is engaged in the provision of ceramic capacitors, aluminum electrolytic capacitors, film capacitors, inductive devices, high frequency components, piezoelectric material components and circuit protection components. The Sensor Application Products segment is engaged in the provision of temperature and pressure sensors, magnetic sensors and micro electromechanical system (MEMS) sensors. The Magnetic Application Products segment is engaged in the provision of hard disk drive (HDD) heads, HDD suspensions and magnets. The Energy Application Products segment is engaged in the provision of energy devices and power supplies. The Company is also involved in the provision of mechatronics and micro actuators products.

name: JCU CORP
businessSummary: JCU Corp is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the chemicals business and the equipment business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Chemicals segment handles plating chemicals for printed circuit boards, electronic components, semiconductors, automotive parts and housing materials. The Equipment segment handles plating equipment for printed circuit boards and automotive parts, cleaning equipment for printed circuit boards utilizing plasma technology, power sales from solar power generation and liquid management systems. The Company is also involved in the cultivation and sale of grapes and seedlings for wine production.

name: SEIKO GROUP CORP
businessSummary: Seiko Group Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of watch business, electronic device business and system solution business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Watch segment is engaged in the manufacture, wholesale and retail of watches and watch movements, as well as watch repair and after-sales service. The Electronic Device segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of crystal oscillators, batteries and materials, printers, and precision parts. The System Solution segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of products related to wireless communication equipment, information network systems, and data services. The Company also operates the time creation and wako business, including the sale of equipment clocks and sports timing equipment, the development manufacture, sale, repair and after-sales service of clocks, the retail of luxury jewelry, apparel and miscellaneous goods, and real estate leasing business.

name: ADR ON SONY GROUP CORP
businessSummary: Sony Group Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the games & network services (G&NS), music, movies, entertainment technology & services (ET&S), imaging & sensing solutions (I&SS) and other businesses. It has seven business segments. G&NS segment is involved in network service business, the manufacture and sale of home video game consoles and software. The Music segment mainly includes music production, music publishing and video media platform businesses. The Movies segment mainly includes film production, television program production and media network businesses. The ET&S field mainly includes the television business, audio, video business, still image, video camera business, smartphone business and Internet-related service business. The I&SS segment mainly includes the image sensor business. The Financial segment is involved in the insurance business and banking business. The Other segment consists of activities such as disc manufacturing business and recording media business.

name: OBIC BUSINESS CONSULTANTS CO LTD
businessSummary: Obic Business Consultants Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in software business. The Company is mainly engaged in the development of business solution technology and information technology (IT) solution technology, as well as the sale of products to customers through sales partners and information technology, and the provision of services such as maintenance and introduction guidance. The Company is also engaged in the development and sale of business software such as master bills, the development of computer system integration business and system support business, as well as the sale of some software products, office automation (OA) related equipment and consumables.

name: KOTOBUKI SPIRITS CO LTD
businessSummary: Kotobuki Spirits Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of confectionery. It operates through six business segments. The Sucrey segment offers shop brands such as The MAPLE MANIA, Tokyo Milk Cheese Factory, and Francais. The KCC segment offers shop brands such as LeTAO and Now on Cheese. The Kotobuki Seika/Tajima Kotobuki segment offers shop brands such as Okashi no Kotobukijo and KanoZA. The Sales Subsidiary segment offers shop brands such as KONDITOREI KOBE. The Kujukushima Group segment offers shop brands such as Akaifusen and Ivorish. The Other segment engages in non-life insurance agency business, health food sales, and confectionery sales.

name: GOLDWIN INC
businessSummary: Goldwin Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of various sporting goods, mainly textile products. The Sporting Goods Related Business segment provides outdoor-related brand products such as mountaineering wear, marine wear and outdoor goods, athletic-related brand products such as training wear, fitness wear, swimwear, rugby wear and golf wear, winter-related brand products such as ski wear and snowboard wear, as well as functional underwear and high-tech wear (dustproof clothing). The Company is also engaged in logistics business, non-life insurance agency business, real estate-related business, venture investment business, and golf course management.

name: ITOCHU CORP
businessSummary: Itochu Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the trading business. Food segment produces, distributes and sells food products. Energy & Chemicals segment trades and operates in the fields of energy, chemicals and electricity. Living & Lifestyle segment operates in the fields of living materials and logistics, as well as real estate. Machinery segment engages in the infrastructure-related business, power generation and other businesses. Metals segment engages in metal mineral resource development, steel product processing, trade of iron, ore and coal, non-ferrous metals and light metals and steel products. Information & Financial segment engages in information technology (IT) solutions, mobile distribution and services in the information and communications field, as well as financial services and insurance businesses. Textile segment engages in global business in goods from textile raw materials, yarns and fabrics to clothing. Eighth segment collaborates with other segments.

name: OKINAWA CELLULAR TELEPHONE CO
businessSummary: OKINAWA CELLULAR TELEPHONE COMPANY is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the telecommunications business. The Company is engaged in the provision of mobile services, domestic and international communication services, and Internet services. The Company also provides dedicated services, au mobile phone services, au mobile phone terminal sales, renting and maintenance of communication equipment, and outsourcing lines. The Company is also engaged in the production and sales of agricultural business, and tourism business.

name: ULVAC INC
businessSummary: Ulvac Inc is a Japan-based company that operates a vacuum-related business, providing products as capital goods to industrial fields that utilize vacuum technology. The Company operates through two business segments. The Vacuum Equipment Business segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance of sputtering equipment for liquid-crystal displays, organic electroluminescence (EL) manufacturing equipment, take-up type vacuum vapor deposition equipment, sputtering equipment for semiconductor manufacturing, vacuum pumps and measuring equipment. The Vacuum Application Business segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance for vacuum-applied products including sputtering target materials and analytical equipment.

name: SHIN-ETSU CHEMICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Shin-Etsu Chemical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the chemical business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Life Environment Materials segment is engaged in the provision of polyvinyl chloride resin, caustic soda, methanol, chloromethane, and poval. The Electronic Materials segment is engaged in the provision of semiconductor silicon, rare earth magnets (for electronics industry and general use), semiconductor encapsulants, packaging materials for light-emitting diodes (LEDs), photoresists, mask blanks, and synthetic quartz products. The Performance Materials segment is engaged in the provision of silicones, cellulose derivatives, metallic silicon, synthetic sex pheromones, polyvinyl chloride-vinyl acetate copolymer resins, liquid fluoroelastomers, and pellicles. The Processing, Trading, and Technical Services segment is engaged in provision of resin processing products, technology and plant exports, product imports and exports, and engineering.

name: MITSUBISHI HEAVY INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of energy, plants and infrastructure systems, logistics, heating and cooling, drive systems. The Company operates through four segments. Energy Segment is engaged in the design, manufacturing, sales, services and installation of thermal power generation systems, nuclear power generation systems, wind power generation systems, aircraft engines. Plants & Infrastructure Segment is engaged in the design, manufacturing, sales, services and installation of steelmaking machinery, merchant ships, engineering, environmental equipment and mechanical systems. Logistics, Thermal & Drive Segment is engaged in the design, manufacturing, sales, services and installation of logistics equipment, heat and cooling products, engines, turbochargers and others. Aircraft, Defense & Space Segment is engaged in the design, manufacturing, sales, services and installation of civil aircraft, defense aircraft and others.

name: CHUGAI PHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Chugai Pharmaceutical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research, development, manufacture, sale, import and export of pharmaceutical products. The pharmaceutical products and medical devices for patients include ACTEMRA, Avastin, ALAGLIO, Aresensa, Kadosaira, Gazaiba, Seruseputo, Zeruborafu, Zeroda, Taruseba, Tecentoriku, Pajeta and other products. The products are mainly applied to the treatment of cancer, kidney diseases, kidney transplantation, bone and joint diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis, osteoporosis, knee osteoarthritis and locomotive syndrome, influenza, hemophilia and other diseases. The Company is also engaged in the provision of management services, transportation and storage services, as well as drug information literature research services. The Company operates within the domestic market and to overseas markets, including Switzerland, United Kingdom, Germany, France, China, Singapore, Korea and the United States.

name: OBIC CO LTD
businessSummary: OBIC Co., Ltd. is an information technology (IT) company. The Company operates in three business segments. The System Integration segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of total information systems for customers. The System Support segment is engaged in the provision of hardware maintenance and system operational support services. The Office Automation (OA) segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of general OA equipment and computer products. The Company is also engaged in the manufacture and sale of packaged software for financial accounting and other purposes through its associated companies.

name: JAPAN ELECTRONIC MATERIALS CORP
businessSummary: Japan Electronic Materials Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the development, manufacture, and sale of semiconductor testing components and electron tube components. It operates through two business segments. The Semiconductor Testing Components Related Business segment provides cantilever-type probe cards such as C-type probe cards, including CE series, and advanced probe cards such as V-type probe cards, including the VT series of vertical contact probe cards, the VS series of vertical spring contact probe cards, and the VE series of vertical + cantilever hybrid probe cards, and M-type probe cards, including the MC series, ML series, and MT series. The Electron Tube Components Related Business segment mainly provides cathodes and filaments.

name: JAPAN MATERIAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Japan Material Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the electronics-related business, graphics solution business and solar power generation business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Electronics-related segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture of special gas supply equipment, design and construction of supply piping, sale management of special gas, as well as the provision of technical services. The Graphics Solution segment is mainly engaged in the sale of graphic boards and digital signage related products. The Solar Power Generation segment is engaged in the sale of electricity to electric power companies by solar power generation.

name: SAMCO INC
businessSummary: SAMCO INC. is a Japan-based manufacturer of electronic part manufacturing equipment. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of thin-film depositing and processing equipment. Its major products include chemical vapor deposition (CVD) equipment, which is used to form semiconductor films, insulating film and thin metallic film that are used for manufacturing semiconductors and electronic parts; etching equipment, which is used in the micro-fabrication of materials such as semiconductor film and insulating film that lie on the surfaces of semiconductor substrates; cleaning equipment, which dry cleans the surfaces of substrates, as well as parts and other specialty equipment. The Company's products are used in fields that involve optical electronics, electronic parts, silicon, implementation and surface treatment, display devices and other fields. The Company also provides related maintenance service.

name: MICROAD INC
businessSummary: MicroAd Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the data platform business. The Data Platform business segment is mainly comprised of three services: data solution services, overseas consulting services, and digital signage services. Its main products include UNIVERSE DATA PLATFORM, a data platform; UNIVERSE Ads, an advertising platform; MicroAd COMPASS, an advertising revenue maximization service for media companies; COMPASS-FIT, an advertising platform, and MONOLITHS, an advertising distribution service.

name: SUMITOMO ELECTRIC INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: Sumitomo Electric Industries Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture, sale, and servicing of business products related to environmental energy. The Company operates its business through five business segments. The Environment and Energy-related Business segment provides electrical conductive products, wires, cables, and equipment for power transmission and distribution. The Information and Communication Related Business segment provides optical fiber cables, communication cables and equipment, optical fusion splicers. The Automotive Business segment provides network and system products such as wire harnesses, anti-vibration rubber and automotive hoses. The Electronics-related Business segment provides electronic wires, electron irradiation products, and flexible printed circuits. The Industrial Materials & Others segment provides steel wires for precision springs, steel cords, carbide tools, sintered parts, and semiconductor heatspreader substrates.

name: FUJI ELECTRIC CO LTD
businessSummary: Fuji Electric Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in business activities such as product development, production, sales, and services in the fields of energy, industry, semiconductors and food distribution. The Company operates through four segments. The Energy Segment provides geothermal power generation, hydroelectric power generation, thermal power generation, fuel cells, substation equipment, power storage systems, energy management systems. The Industry Segment provides products and services such as inverters, measuring instruments, sensors, drive control and measurement control systems, nuclear power related equipment, radiation equipment and systems, drive systems and door systems for rolling stock, systems for ships and harbors. The Semiconductor segment provides power semiconductors for industrial and automotive applications. The Food Distribution segment provides beverage vending machines, food and goods vending machines, store equipment, and money machines.

name: MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC CORP
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Electric Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the industry mobility, life and other businesses. The Company operates in six business segments. The Infrastructure segment is engaged in the social systems, power systems, defense and space and systems businesses, and provides electrical equipment for railway vehicles, wireless communication equipment and others. The Industry & Mobility segment is engaged in the factory automation (FA) system business and the automotive equipment business. The Life segment is engaged in the building system business and the air conditioning and home appliances business. The Business Platform segment is involved in the information systems and services business. The Semiconductor Device segment is involved in the electronic devices business. The Other segment provides materials procurement, logistics, real estate, advertising and publicity and finance.

name: BANDAI NAMCO HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Bandai Namco Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the digital business, toys and hobby business, intellectual property (IP) producing business, and amusement business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Digital Business segment plans, develops, and distributes network content, and plans, develops, and sells home video games and other products. The Toys and Hobby Business segment plans, develops, manufactures, and sells toys, capsule toys, cards, confectionery and food products, apparel, household goods, plastic models, premiums, stationery. The IP Production Business segment plans, produces, and operates animation and other visual and music content, manages and operates copyrights and copyrighted works, discovers and develops artists, and operates live entertainment businesses. The Amusement Business segment plans, develops, and provides after-sales service for amusement machines, and plans and operates amusement facilities.

name: NOHMI BOSAI LTD
businessSummary: NOHMI BOSAI LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacturing, sales and installation of fire alarm systems and firefighting equipment as well as the maintenance of these devices. The Company operates in three segments. The Fire Alarm Devices segment is engaged in manufacturing, sales and installation of automatic fire alarm equipment, environmental monitoring systems, fire doors, and smoke extinguishing facilities, etc. The Firefighting Equipment segment is engaged in manufacturing, sales and installation of various sprinkler equipment, foam fire extinguishing equipment, plant disaster prevention equipment, tunnel disaster prevention equipment etc. The Maintenance and Inspection segment is engaged in the maintenance, inspection and repair of various disaster prevention equipment. Other business includes construction and maintenance of parking lane traffic control systems as well as manufacture and sales of crime prevention equipment operated by its affiliate companies.

name: JEOL LTD
businessSummary: JEOL Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale, maintenance, development and research of scientific instruments, semiconductor related equipment, industrial and medical equipment, and related products and parts. It operates through three business segments. Science and Measurement Equipment segment manufactures and sells three types of equipment. Electron optical devices include electron microscopes, peripheral devices and others. Analytical instruments include nuclear magnetic resonance equipment, electron spin resonance equipment and others. Measurement and inspection equipment include scanning electron microscopes, analytical scanning electron microscopes, peripheral equipment and others. Industrial Equipment segment manufactures and sells electron beam lithography equipment, linear electron guns and power supplies and others. Medical Equipment segment manufactures and sells clinical test information processing systems, and automatic amino acid analyzers.

name: MARUMAE CO LTD
businessSummary: Marumae Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the precision cutting works. The Company is engaged in the manufacture of vacuum chambers and electrodes used in flat panel display (FPD) manufacturing equipment and semiconductor manufacturing equipment. The products include semiconductor manufacturing equipment related parts, FPD manufacturing equipment related parts, and other equipment parts. The semiconductor manufacturing equipment parts are vacuum parts for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and inspection equipment. The FPD manufacturing equipment parts are vacuum devices for manufacturing equipment apparatus and inspection apparatus used in liquid crystal and organic electro luminescence (EL). The other parts consist surface processing equipment for smart phone housing, solar cell manufacturing equipment parts, motorcycle racing parts, industrial equipment parts for camera and microscope, as well as parts for medical equipment.

name: DAISEKI CO LTD
businessSummary: Daiseki Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the environment-related business. The Company is engaged in the collection, transportation and intermediate treatment of industrial wastes, the investigation and treatment of contaminated soil, the collection, transportation and recycling of used batteries, the refining of lead, the sale of non-ferrous metal raw materials, tank washing and related services, the collection of volatile organic compounds (VOC) gases, the sludge reduction works, the sale of crude oil washing (COW) machines, as well as the manufacture and sale of petrochemical products.

name: FUJIMI INC
businessSummary: Fujimi Inc is a Japan-based company that principally engages in the manufacturing and sales of polishing materials and related products. The Company operates through four regional segments including Japan, North America, Asia and Europe. The Company manufactures and sells polishing materials that are used in a range of fields including semiconductors.

name: KINDEN CORP
businessSummary: Kinden Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the equipment construction business. Electrical work includes distribution work, general electrical work for buildings and factories, power transmission line work, and substation work. Information and communication work includes telecommunications work and instrumentation work. Environment-related work includes air conditioning pipe work. The Company is also engaged in water supply and drainage sanitary work, interior equipment work, civil engineering work, and other related businesses. It is also engaged in leasing and sales of vehicles, various non-life insurance agencies, maintenance and leasing of real estate, sales and engineering of information communication system equipment, wind power generation business, transportation of concrete utility poles, construction and maintenance management of firefighting equipment construction.

name: BRAINPAD INC
businessSummary: BrainPad Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of data analysis services for companies. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Analytics segment is engaged in the provision of data analysis services and optimization operations for companies aiming to support clients’ activities. The Solutions segment is engaged in the selection and provision of software products necessary for policy execution based on data accumulation, analysis and analysis results, and system development and operation. The Marketing Platform segment develops its own proprietary software from the data analysis algorithm mainly in the digital marketing field and provides products centered on Software as a Service (SaaS) type services, and maintenance service.

name: TOKYO OHKA KOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: TOKYO OHKA KOGYO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacturing and sales of materials and equipment. The Company operates in two segments. The Materials segment is mainly engaged in manufacturing and sales of electronics functional materials and high purity chemicals. The Equipment segment is mainly engaged in manufacturing, sales and maintenance of processing equipment for semiconductors and displays. The Company operates in Japan, Taiwan, South Korea, the United States, etc.

name: MONOGATARI CORP
businessSummary: Monogatari Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of restaurant business through direct management and franchise. The Company mainly operates large suburban-type restaurants in Japan under the brand name of Yakiniku Kingu, Marugen Ramen, Marugen II, Aged Soy Sauce Ramen Kyabeton, Okonomiyaki Honpo, Sushi & Shabu Shabu Yuzuan, Fish & Shellfish Samai Genya, Shabu Kani Genji So Honten, Gyutan Loving Yakiniku Happii, Aged Yakiniku Niku Gen, Yakitate Karubi, Kajitsuya Coffee and Thick Chinese Soba Gyoza Marufuku. The Company also operates a franchise business that collects royalties, franchise fees, and outsourcing fees from franchisees on a percentage-of-sales basis.

name: FUJITEC CO LTD
businessSummary: Fujitec Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale, installation and maintenance of elevators, escalators, moving walks and other products. The Company manufactures elevators and escalators in its domestic production sites and overseas production sites, located in North America, East Asia and South Asia. The Company sells, installs and repairs its products in both domestic and overseas sales bases.

name: NINTENDO CO LTD
businessSummary: Nintendo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of entertainment products in the field of home entertainment. The Company develops, manufactures, and sells hardware and software for portable and home console games. Its main products are game consoles, which are computer-based entertainment devices, and character goods and playing cards. Game consoles are hardware and software for handheld and home console games, which are developed by the Company and its affiliates, manufactured by the Company, and sold mainly by its affiliates in Japan and overseas. The Company also develops businesses utilizing its intellectual property (IP), such as video content and mobile applications.

name: HIDAY HIDAKA CORP
businessSummary: Hiday Hidaka Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of a chain of restaurants that mainly serve ramen, gyoza, and Chinese cuisine. It operates stores called Hidakaya, a name derived from its name. Menu items include Chuka Soba and Yasai Tappuri Tanmen. Stores with the Hidakaya name include two variations, including Chuka Soba Hidakaya and Chuka Shokudo Hidakaya. Rairaiken is included in the Hidakaya category as its menu is highly similar to that of Chuka Shokudo Hidakaya. Other store formats include Chinese restaurant Chuka Ichiban, yakitori restaurant Yakitori Hidaka, izakaya restaurant Taisho Sakaba Hidaka, snack and set meal restaurant Taisho Shokudo Hidaka, Taiwanese street food restaurant Yatai Ryori Tainan, and chicken white soup restaurant Ramen Hidaka.

name: KOBE BUSSAN CO LTD
businessSummary: Kobe Bussan Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacturing, wholesale, and retail of products for its gyomu supermarkets, operates gyomu supermarket stores under a franchise (FC) system, and also conducts restaurant and prepared food businesses as well as renewable energy businesses. The Company conducts business through three segments. The Gyomu Supermarket business segment is engaged in product planning, development, procurement, etc. as the franchise headquarters of Gyomu Supermarket. It also produces food products at its domestic and overseas consolidated subsidiaries as a food supply base. The Restaurant and Ready-Meal business segment operates three restaurant formats including Kobe Cook World Buffet, Premium Karubi, and Chisounai. The Eco Renewable Energy business segment is engaged in power generation business utilizing renewable energy. The Company also conducts tourism-related businesses.

name: AZBIL CORP
businessSummary: Azbil Corporation is engaged in the manufacture of automation equipment. It has three segments. The Building Automation (BA) segment offers network building automation systems, wide area management systems, actuators and control valves, as well as building and energy management, maintenance and consulting services. The Advanced Automation (AA) segment offers supervisory control systems, solution packages, controllers, combustion safety control equipment, etc. The Life Automation segment provides various gas meters, safety maintenance equipment, supply equipment, etc. The Company also conducts insurance agency business.

name: ASAHI INTECC CO LTD
businessSummary: Asahi Intecc Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of products in the medical and industrial equipment fields. It operates through two business segments. The Medical Business segment develops and manufactures minimally invasive treatment products (treatment guidewires and catheters) primarily used for intravascular treatment and sells them to hospitals and other facilities primarily through direct sales in Japan, mostly through distributors in overseas, and primarily through direct sales in the United States, France, Germany, and Italy. The Device Business segment develops and manufactures components for the medical and industrial equipment fields and sells them to manufacturers both in Japan and overseas. Products are used as medical equipment in areas such as circulatory system, abdominal, peripheral and cerebrovascular systems, as well as industrial equipment in a wide range of fields, including leisure, construction and automobiles.

name: INTERNET INITIATIVE JAPAN INC
businessSummary: Internet Initiative Japan Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of Internet business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Network Services and System Integration (SI) segment is mainly engaged in the provision of a combination of network services and system integration services, which mainly consist of Internet connection services, wide area network (WAN) services and outsourcing services, as well as the provision of comprehensive solutions. The Automated Teller Machine (ATM) Operation segment is engaged in the operation of bank ATMs and network systems.

name: KIKKOMAN CORP
businessSummary: Kikkoman Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of soy sauces, seasonings, beverages, wines and other food products. The Company operates in four business segments. The Domestic Food Manufacturing and Sale segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of soy sauces and seasonings, processed tomato products under the brand name Del Monte, cans, vegetable and fruit juices, soy milk drinks, wines, sweet cooking rice wines, commercial food materials and others. The Domestic Other Products segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of drugs and chemical products, as well as the real estate, logistic and indirect business. The Overseas Food Manufacturing and Sale segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of soy sauces, processed tomato products under the brand name Del Monte, cans and health food products in oversea markets. The Overseas Food Wholesale segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of oriental food products.

name: ADR ON FUJITSU LTD
businessSummary: Fujitsu Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in a total solutions business in the field of information and communications technology (ICT), providing a variety of services, as well as comprehensive services ranging from the development, manufacture, and sales of products and electronic devices that support these services, to maintenance and operation. The company operates in four business segments. The Service Solutions segment provides consulting services, cloud services, and other services. The Hardware Solutions segment provides system products, mainly sales and maintenance services for hardware such as servers and storage systems that form the foundation of ICT, as well as communications infrastructure such as cell phone base stations and optical transmission systems. The Ubiquitous Solutions segment mainly develops, designs, manufactures, and sells personal computers. The Device Solutions segment mainly provides electronic components such as semiconductor packages and batteries.

name: FUJITSU LTD
businessSummary: Fujitsu Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in a total solutions business in the field of information and communications technology (ICT), providing a variety of services, as well as comprehensive services ranging from the development, manufacture, and sales of products and electronic devices that support these services, to maintenance and operation. The company operates in four business segments. The Service Solutions segment provides consulting services, cloud services, and other services. The Hardware Solutions segment provides system products, mainly sales and maintenance services for hardware such as servers and storage systems that form the foundation of ICT, as well as communications infrastructure such as cell phone base stations and optical transmission systems. The Ubiquitous Solutions segment mainly develops, designs, manufactures, and sells personal computers. The Device Solutions segment mainly provides electronic components such as semiconductor packages and batteries.

name: SHIMADZU CORP
businessSummary: Shimadzu Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research, development, manufacture, sale and maintenance of scientific and precision equipment. The Company has four segments. Testing and Measuring Instruments segment is engaged in the provision of chromatographic analysis systems, mass spectrometry systems, light analysis systems, thermal analysis systems, bio-related analysis systems, water quality measurement systems and others. Medical Equipment segment is engaged in the provision of X-ray television (TV) systems, angiography systems, X-ray imaging systems and others. Aircraft Equipment segment is engaged in the provision of flight control systems, air management systems, cockpit display systems and others. Industrial Equipment segment is engaged in the provision of turbomolecular pumps and others. The Company is also engaged in the leasing and management of real estate business.

name: SQUARE ENIX HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Square Enix Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in digital entertainment, amusement, publishing, and rights/property businesses through its subsidiaries. The Company operates through four segments. The Digital Entertainment segment provides interactive digital content for home video game consoles ,including handheld consoles, and personal computers, smartphones, and other platforms. The Amusement segment is engaged in the operation of amusement facilities, as well as the sale and rental of amusement equipment for such facilities. The Publishing segment is involved in the publication and licensing of comic magazines, comic books, game-related books, and other materials. The Rights and Properties segment is engaged in the planning, production, sales, and licensing of derivative works.

name: MURATA MANUFACTURING CO LTD
businessSummary: Murata Manufacturing Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the production of semi-finished products, which are intermediate products of various electronic components. The Company operates through three segments. The Components segment provides capacitors, inductors, and electromagnetic interference (EMI) rejection filters. The Devices and Modules segment provides high-frequency modules, surface wave filters, lithium-ion rechargeable batteries, and sensors. The Others segment is engaged in the provision of healthcare equipment, solution business. The Company also provides employee benefits, leases real estate, and develops and sells products and software.

name: TOHO CO LTD (TOKYO)
businessSummary: Toho Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the movie, theater and real estate businesses. The Company operates in three business segments. The Movie segment is engaged in the distribution to movie theaters, domestic distribution of theatrical films, management of movie theaters, use of anime contents, sales of packages and art production for video works. The Theater segment is engaged in the production and performance of theater performances, the sale of theater tickets, and the management of entertainment production. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing, maintenance and management of real estate, the management, cleaning and repair of roads. The Company is also engaged in the sports facility management business, products sale business and the accounting consulting and guidance business.

name: KATITAS CO LTD
businessSummary: Katitas Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the used housing rehabilitation business. The Used Housing Rehabilitation segment purchases mainly used detached houses, renovates them, and then sells them. The used housing rehabilitation business includes purchasing, commercialization, and sales. Properties are purchased through purchase or auction. Commercialization business involves planning and carrying out plumbing replacement such as kitchens, toilets, sinks, and unit baths, wallpaper and floor replacement, layout changes, exterior wall painting, and exterior construction such as parking lot expansion. Sales are conducted through the Company itself and through intermediary sales.

name: TOYOKUMO INC
businessSummary: Toyokumo Inc is mainly engaged in the development and sale of cloud services for corporations. The Company provides two types of services, including the development and sales of safety confirmation service, which is a cloud service designed to easily share information in an emergency, and kintone linkage service, a cloud service in cooperation with kintone, a business application construction service. The safety confirmation service is a cloud service that confirms the safety of employees and others in the event of a disaster using mobile phones, smartphones, and personal computers. The kintone linkage services include services such as print creator, form bridge, kBackup, kViewer, kMailer, time stamp for kintone and data collect, among others.

name: TOBILA SYSTEMS INC
businessSummary: Tobila Systems Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the junk information filter business and other businesses. The Company operates through two business segments. The Junk Information Filter segment develops Tobilaphone to prevent malicious nuisance calls and fraudulent phone calls, and utilizes the Tobiraphone phone number database and nuisance phone number analysis algorithm to provide applications and services for mobile terminals such as smartphones and feature phones and fixed lines, selling TobiraphoneBiz for optical lines for corporate customers, developing products and services for unwanted information filters. It provides three kinds of services, including mobile filter service, fixed phone filter service, and business phone filter service. The Other Business segment is engaged in the sale of Website production management support system HP4U and commissioned development of systems.

name: KOEI TECMO HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Koei Tecmo Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the entertainment, amusement, and real estate businesses. The Company operates three business segments. The Entertainment Business segment mainly engaged in the development and sale of entertainment content. The Amusement Business segment engaged in the development of commercial amusement machines and the operation of game centers. The Real Estate Business segment mainly engaged in the operation and management of rental real estate. The Company also involves venture capital and securities management.

name: CURVES HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Curves Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of Curves, a fitness facility for women. The Curves segment is mainly engaged in the fitness club business. The domestic curve business is engaged in the introduction of system necessary for management guidance and business operation for franchisees (FC), the provision and sale of technology, equipment, product and printed matter, as well as the performance of support operations such as opening stores for franchisees and sale operations for members. The Company is also engaged in the development of directly managed stores. The overseas curves business is engaged in the management of royalties and sale of equipment used at stores to master franchisees around the world, including Japan, as well as the provision of operation support services to franchise member stores.

name: MARKLINES CO LTD
businessSummary: MarkLines Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of online information services specializing in the automobile industry. The Company operates automotive industry portal which provides solutions through eight business segments includes information platform segment, consulting segment, recruitment segment, LMC Automotive Ltd. products (market forecast information) sales segment, promotional advertising segment, teardown investigation data sales segment, and vehicle parts procurement agency segment. The Company forms the supply chain of the automotive industry with related companies providing products and services include complete vehicle manufacturers, supporting parts manufacturers, materials manufacturers, equipment and machinery manufacturers, software vendors, trading companies, and transportation companies.

name: CYBER SECURITY CLOUD INC
businessSummary: Cyber Security Cloud , Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the Web security business. The Company is engaged in the development and subscription of Web security services utilizing artificial intelligence (AI) technology. It is also engaged in the research of cyber attacks, and research and development of AI technology. Products include the cloud-based Web application firewall (WAF) Cyneural, AWS WAF's rule automatic operation service WafCharm, and AWS WAF's Managed Rules. Cyneural is a cloud-based security service that detects, blocks, and visualizes cyber attacks on Web applications. WafCharm is a service that attacks patterns and automatically operates AWS WAF rules. AWS WAF Managed Rules is a selected AWS WAF security rules set that are created independently by a security specialist.

name: PLUS ALPHA CONSULTING CO LTD
businessSummary: Plus Alpha Consulting Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the visualization engine business, the customer rings business and the talent palette business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Visualization Engine segment is engaged in the development and operation of Visualization Engine, a customer experience feedback system. The Customer Rings segment is engaged in the development and operation of CustomerRings, an integrated marketing platform. The Talent Palette segment is engaged in the development and operation of Talent Palette, a talent management system.

name: NEXON CO LTD
businessSummary: Nexon Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the development, production and distribution of online games for personal computers (PCs) and mobile games. The Company operates through five business segments: Japan, Korea, China, North America and Others. The PC online business is mainly engaged in the production, development and distribution of PC online games. Game titles include MapleStory, Arad Senki (Dungeon&Fighter) and EA SPORTS FC ONLINE. The consulting business provides consulting services related to the construction and management of billing systems, business strategy, game operation and marketing in China. In Korea, the Company also provides customer support and internet cafe operation services for PC online games and mobile games, and provides advertising platforms and operation management services. The Merchandising business produces and sells products using game characters. The mobile business develops and distributes mobile games played on the smartphones and tablets.

name: SINOPS INC
businessSummary: sinops Inc., formerly Link Inc., operates software package group sinops series to optimize inventory of retail, wholesale and manufacturing industries. The Company operates sinops (strategic inventory optimum solution) business. The Company provides package sales, rental sales, implementation support service and support service. The package sales service provides sinops series in batch sales type. The rental sales service provides the sinops series in usage fee type. The implementation support service provides system construction and operation construction services to maximize the implementation effect of sinops. The support service supports daily operation of sinops. The Company owns two types of sales, including direct sales to end users and sales by sales partners.

name: MISUMI GROUP INC
businessSummary: Misumi Group Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in factory automation (FA), die component, and Variation & One-stop by New Alliance (VONA) businesses. It operates through three business segments. FA Business segment develops and provides standard parts for automated machines (shafts, bushings, linear guides, positioning parts, pulleys, aluminum frames, stages), automatic positioning modules and various experimental and research equipment related to optical technology, and components for various equipment production sites. Die Component Business segment develops and provides press dies for metal plastic processing, standard mold parts (punches and dies, spring guides, ejector pins, core pins, guides, retainers), and precision mold parts, primarily for the automotive and electronic/electrical equipment sectors. VONA Business segment is general distribution business centered on online sale, provides manufacture and automation related equipment parts, indirect materials and others.

name: KANAMIC NETWORK CO LTD
businessSummary: Kanamic Network Co Ltd is a Japan-based Company engaged in the building of information sharing platforms and healthcare platforms in the medical, nursing, and health fields. The Company provides four kinds of services. The Kanamic Cloud Service provides cloud services, including information sharing platforms, nursing care management systems, and childcare support systems, to medical and nursing care workers include municipal government employees, doctors, nurses, care managers, and nursing care service providers. The Platform Service provide content services, such as Internet advertisement distribution that provide useful information to medical and nursing care workers. The Healthy Life Extension Service operates and franchises fitness gyms. The Other Services include customized development for major customers, project contracting for the government, consultation services for regional development projects, and other businesses related to Kanamik Cloud Services.

name: SMAREGI INC
businessSummary: Smaregi Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the cloud service business. The Company is mainly engaged in the provision of cloud systems for companies to manage and analyze information necessary for business management, including Sumaregi, a cloud-based point-of-sale (POS) register used by restaurants and retail stores to manage and analyze sales information. The Company is also engaged in the sale of peripheral devices for cash registers, such as tablets and receipt printers, used by users of cloud services.

name: SANTEN PHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Santen Pharmaceutical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of pharmaceuticals. The Company engages in global research and development, manufacture, sale, and marketing of pharmaceuticals in the ophthalmology field. The Company engages in prescription pharmaceuticals, over-the-counter pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and other businesses. The Company operates in Japan, Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA), China, and other regions.

name: TOKYO SEIMITSU CO LTD
businessSummary: Tokyo Seimitsu Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of semiconductor manufacturing equipment and precision measuring equipment. The Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of processing and inspection equipment for the manufacture of semiconductor, such as wafer probing machines and wafer dicing machines, as well as the provision of after-sales services and the development of related software. The Measuring Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of precision measuring equipment for three-dimensional (3D) vision systems, as well as surface roundness and profile shape measuring instruments including 3D coordinate measuring machine, true degree and column shape measuring machine, surface roughness measuring machine, wheel shape measuring machine and others.

name: RAKUMO INC
businessSummary: Rakumo Inc is engaged in information technology (IT) solution business. The Company’s main business includes Software as a Service (SaaS) service, which provides license services; solution service, which centered on installation support and business support related to license services; IT offshore development service that develops lab-type IT systems based in Vietnam. The SaaS service develops and sells the groupware product rakumo for companies, as well as selling agents of other company's licenses. rakumo is a general term for a group of services in corporate groupware for which the group handles planning and development. The solution service sells hardware of other companies related to the license service, in addition to solution services such as installation support and business support of own and other company’s SaaS services. IT offshore development services provides IT offshore development services based on its Vietnam subsidiary rakumo Company Limited.

name: CYND CO LTD
businessSummary: CYND Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and provision of a cloud-based reservation management system for hairdressing and beauty stores. The Company is engaged in the development and provision of BeautyMerit, which is a cloud-based reservation management system that supports the connection between stores and customers. The system provides services that support the construction of optimal customer experience (CX) and digital transformation (DX) such as attracting customers, reservations, treatments, accounting and after-sales follow-up services.

name: EGUARANTEE INC
businessSummary: eGuarantee, Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in the credit guarantee business. The Company is involved in the analysis and screening of information based on the corporate credit information database, as well as the promotion of liquidation for transference of credit risks. The Company provides guarantee services for industrial corporations, including the entrusted business for risks with bad debts, such as trading and contract agreements, as well as guarantee services for financial corporations, including the entrusted businesses for risks with financial obligations, advanced payment debts and repayment claims. The Company operates its business through community banks, major city banks, trust banks, security companies, commercial firms, major financial institutions, leasing companies, nonbanks, and insurance agents in Tokyo, Osaka, Kyushu and Nagoya Prefectures.

name: KAKAKU.COM INC
businessSummary: Kakaku.com Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of purchasing support Website Kakaku.com. The Company operates through two business segments. Internet Media segment is engaged in the operation of Websites that provide price comparison service, restaurant search and reservation service, real estate information, travel information, movie information, automobile information, bus information and inheritance procedure service. The segment also develops dynamic package system, movie contents and Website production. The Finance segment is involved in the insurance agency business.

name: RAKUS CO LTD
businessSummary: Rakus Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of information technology (IT) services. It operates through two business segments. The Cloud Business segment plans, develops and operates various cloud services, including the expense settlement system Raku-Raku Seisan, the electronic invoice issuance system RakuRaku Meisai, the sales management system Rakuraku Hanbai, the attendance management system RakuRaku Kintai, the email sharing and management system Mail Dealer, and the email marketing service HaiHai Mail. The IT Human Resources Business segment provides full-time staffing services specializing in IT engineers. Staffing services include system development, infrastructure construction and operation, machine learning, and quality control.

name: KEYENCE CORP
businessSummary: Keyence Corp is a Japan-based manufacturing company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of electronic applied equipment. The Company mainly manufactures and sells automatic controlling equipment, measuring instrument, information equipment and other electronic application equipment, as well as related systems. The Company also develops software for its products. Its products include sensors, meters, projectors, image processing devices, programmable logic controllers and touch panels, among others. In addition, the Company is also engaged in advertising and marketing businesses through its subsidiaries.

name: ORGANO CORP
businessSummary: ORGANO CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the water treatment engineering business and functional products business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Water Treatment Engineering segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale, maintenance and management of filtration equipment, pure water system equipment and other water treatment related equipment. The Functional Product segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of standard water treatment equipment, water treatment chemicals and food additives. The Company is also engaged in the chemical plant construction business.

name: RACCOON HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: RACCOON HOLDINGS, Inc. is primarily engaged in providing services facilitating business transactions between enterprises, mainly operating EC business. The Company operates in three segments. The EC segment is engaged in Super Delivery business, which operates wholesale site connecting retailers and manufacturers engaged in apparel and other goods business, as well as COREC business, which is a cloud-type ordering system that can collectively manage ordering in business-to-business transactions (BtoB) on the Internet. The Paid segment engages in invoice issuance and payment collection generated between company transactions. The Guarantee segment is engaged in the provision of accounts receivable and rent and court costs.

name: KANDENKO CO LTD
businessSummary: Kandenko Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the facilities construction business, the electric equipment sales business, the real estate business, the leasing business and the power generation business. The Equipment Engineering segment is engaged in the business related to electricity, pipe work and other equipment. This segment is also engaged in construction security business, as well as design and calculation business. The Company is engaged in the real estate business and the power generation business, the electrical equipment sales business and the leasing business. The Company is also involved in lease business of land, buildings and vehicles. The Company is also involved in the manufacture, sale and maintenance of software for cable television operators.

name: OLYMPUS CORP
businessSummary: Olympus Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of endoscopes, therapeutic equipment, scientific and other products. The Company operates through three business segments. The Endoscope segment provides gastrointestinal endoscopes, surgical endoscopes, and medical services. The Therapeutic Equipment segment provides gastrointestinal treatment instruments, urology products, respiratory products, energy devices, otolaryngology products and gynecology products. The Others segment provides biomaterials and orthopedic instruments. The Company is also engaged in the business activities, including holding companies and financial investments related to each business.

name: LY CORP
businessSummary: LY Corp, formerly Z Holdings Corp, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the Softbank business. The Company operates in three segments. The Media Business segment provides services such as LINE advertising and Yahoo advertising. It operates platforms such as LINE VOOM, LINE NEWS, Talk List, Talk Head View, Talk Head View Custom, LINE Official Accounts, LINE Promotion Stamps, Lived Blog, LINE Stamps, LINE GAME, LINE Divination, LINE LIVE and other platforms. The Commerce Business segment includes electronic commerce (EC) for goods sales, including shopping business, reuse business, ASKUL stand-alone business-to-business (BtoB) business, and service EC. It operates platforms such as Yahoo! Shopping, PayPay Mall, ZOZOTOWN, LOHACO, Charm, LINE Shopping, LINE FRIENDS, LINE GIFT, and MySmartStore. The Strategic Business segment conducts Fintech business and provides PayPay Consolidated, PayPay Bank, and other financial services. The Company also provides cloud-related services.

name: NITTO BOSEKI CO LTD
businessSummary: Nitto Boseki Co Ltd is principally engaged in the electronic materials business, medical business, composite materials business, materials and chemicals business, insulation materials business, and other businesses. The Company operates in six business segments. The Electronic Materials segment develops, manufactures, and sells glass fiber products for electronic materials. The Medical segment develops, manufactures, and sells in-vitro diagnostic reagents. The Composites segment develops, manufactures, and sells glass fiber products for plastic reinforcement materials. The Materials and Chemicals segment develops, manufactures, and sells glass fiber products for industrial materials, chemical products, interlining products, functional materials, and dishcloths. The Insulation Materials segment develops, manufactures, and sells glass wool products for insulation, heat retention, and sound absorption. The Other segment designs industrial machinery and equipment.

name: JMDC INC
