businessSummary: JMDC Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the health big data business, telemedicine business and dispensing pharmacy support business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Health Big Data segment is engaged in the provision of receipt data analysis and health promotion solutions, and personal health information platforms, the build, management and analysis of medical databases such as receipt data and medical examination data, the build and sale of drug databases, and the development and provision of systems using drug databases for medical institutions. The Telemedicine segment is engaged in the provision of remote image diagnosis matching services, and infrastructure systems for remote image diagnosis. The Dispensing Pharmacy Support segment is engaged in the development and provision of business systems and electronic medication record for dispensing pharmacies, as well as the operation of dispensing pharmacies.

name: NET ONE SYSTEMS CO LTD
businessSummary: Net One Systems Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the system construction of information and communications technology (ICT) and related services. The Company operates in four segments. The ENT segment offers products and services to general private companies. The SP segment offers products and services to telecommunication companies. The PUB segment offers products and services to central ministries, municipalities and companies providing social infrastructure. The Partner segment offers specialized products and services in collaboration with partner companies. Other businesses include server services and others. The Company has two product groups, the equipment product group which is engaged in purchasing and sales of networks and platforms for ICT systems as well as service product group which provides support and services on equipment and systems.

name: WITH US CORP
businessSummary: With us Corporation is mainly engaged in the provision of educational services. The Company operates in two business segments. The Tutoring School segment is engaged in the operation of tutoring schools with a focus on group and individual tutoring for elementary, middle and high school students. The High School Career Support segment involves in the operation of wide communication system high schools, examination guidance for obtaining various qualifications, the provision of examination guidance services for passing the high school level certification exams, as well as management of Japanese language schools. The others business is involved in the provision of information and communication technology (ICT) education and capacity development business, language services, as well as development of internal training portal sites.

name: NIDEC CORP
businessSummary: Nidec Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of precision small motors, in-vehicle products, home appliances, commercial and industrial products, equipment, electronic and optical components. The Company operates through 10 segments. The SPMS segment manufactures and sells motors for hard disk drives (HDDs) and other small motors. The AMEC segment manufactures and sells in-vehicle products. The MOEN segment, ACIM segment and Nidec Techno Motor segment manufacture and sell home appliances, commercial and industrial products. The Nidec Instruments segment manufactures and sells equipment, in-vehicle products, electronic components and other small motors. The Nidec Mobility segment manufactures and sells in-vehicle products. The Machinery Business Headquarters segment and the Nidec Advanced Technology segment manufacture and sell equipment. The Other segment manufactures and sells in-vehicle products, equipment, electronic components, other small motors.

name: FANUC CORP
businessSummary: Fanuc Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture, and sale of computer numerical control (CNC) systems used in production systems through automation and their application products based on CNC system technology, as a comprehensive supplier of factory automation (FA). The FA division is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of FA products, such as CNC systems and laser products. The Robot division is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of robot systems and other robotic products. The Robot Machine division is engaged in the development, manufacture, and sale of small cutting machines, electric injection molding machines, wire electrical discharge machining tools, and other products.

name: DAIKIN INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: Daikin Industries Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of air conditioners, refrigerators and chemical products. The Company operates in two business segments. Air Conditioner & Refrigerator segment manufactures, constructs and sells residential, commercial, marine air conditioners and refrigerator products. Chemical segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of chemical products, such as fluorocarbon gas, fluororesin and chemical machinery. The Company also conducts oil machinery business, special machinery business and electronic system business.

name: SYSMEX CORP
businessSummary: Sysmex Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the health care business. The Company conducts product development, manufacturing, sales, and service in domestic markets, and some products are developed, manufactured, and sold by subsidiaries. Overseas, the Company conducts the manufacturing and sales of products in the Americas, EMEA, China, and Asia Pacific through other companies. Along with its subsidiaries, the Company is involved in the development, manufacture, sale and service of clinical laboratory equipment, laboratory test drugs and products related to laboratory test.

name: MONOTARO CO LTD
businessSummary: MonotaRO Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in mail-order sales primarily through e-commerce, an internet-based distribution channel, selling industrial supplies to customers mainly consisting of domestic and international businesses. Products procured from domestic and international wholesalers and manufacturers are listed in the Company's online catalog on its website and in paper catalogs distributed to individual customers, and are sold directly to end users both domestically and internationally. The Company conducts its business through the Factory Indirect Materials Sales segment. The products handled primarily consist of factory indirect materials, such as consumables and repair supplies used routinely within factories.

name: ORIENTAL LAND CO LTD
businessSummary: Oriental Land Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the operation of theme parks and hotels. The Company operates in two business segments. Theme Park segment is engaged in the management and operation of the theme parks. Hotel segment is engaged in the operation of hotels, such as Disney Ambassador Hotel, Tokyo DisneySea Hotel MiraCosta and Tokyo Disneyland Hotel. The Company also operates the IKSPIARI business, the monorail business, and the Group's employee cafeteria operation business.

name: GMO FINANCIAL GATE INC
businessSummary: GMO Financial Gate Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of face-to-face payment services in the cashless payment market. Sales are divided into four categories including initial, stock, fee, and spread, depending on the content of the service. It provides two kinds of services. The payment processing service provides connection services to the payment information processing centers of payment service providers. It provides credit center terminal (CCT) and operates payment information processing center CCT Center. It also operates a 24/7 help desk. It has four business models. It is a payment service that can handle contact-type credit card payments, debit card payments, contactless electronic money payments, and code-type payments that can be displayed and read on a smartphone. The payment agency service has two business models, including comprehensive merchant contract and merchant agency contract.

name: COSMOS PHARMACEUTICAL CORP
businessSummary: Cosmos Pharmaceutical Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the retail of pharmaceuticals and cosmetics. The Company’s products include pharmaceuticals such as over-the-counter medicines, energy drinks, oral care products, nursing care products, vitamins, health foods, diet foods, and prescriptions, cosmetics such as cosmetics, men's cosmetics, hair care products, and bath additives, miscellaneous goods such as baby products, detergents, insect repellents, air fresheners, bath and toilet supplies, cooking supplies, gardening supplies, car supplies, and clothing, general foods such as processed foods, daily necessities, seasonings, sweets, beverages, alcohol, and tobacco.

name: JAPAN AIRPORT TERMINAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Japan Airport Terminal Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the facilities management and operation business, product sales business, and food and beverage business. The Company operates three segments. The Facilities Management and Operation segment is engaged in the leasing, maintenance, operation, and other services for airline passengers at Haneda Airport's passenger terminal facilities. The Product Sales segment is engaged in the sale of goods to airline passengers, wholesale of goods to airport terminal building companies, and other related businesses. The Food and Beverage segment is engaged in the provision of food and beverage services to users of Haneda Airport and Narita Airport, the manufacture and sale of in-flight meals, and other related businesses.

name: KYOWA KIRIN CO LTD
businessSummary: Kyowa Kirin Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of medical drugs. The Company operates in Pharmaceuticals business segment. The Company engages in the research, development, manufacture, sale, and import & export of prescription pharmaceuticals. The Company has drug discovery technologies in antibody therapeutics and hematopoietic stem cell gene therapy. Its development pipeline includes AMG531 for aplastic anemia untreated with immunosuppressive therapy, KHK4083/AMG 451 for moderate to severe atopic dermatitis, KHK4083/AMG 451 for moderate to severe asthma, and KK2845 for acute myeloid leukemia and others. In addition, through its subsidiaries, the Company develops, manufactures, markets, and contracts out biosimilar pharmaceuticals, and engages in wholesale and retail sales and insurance agency business. The Company operates in Japan and overseas.

name: MANI INC
businessSummary: MANI Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of surgical related products, eyeless needle related products, and dental related products. It operates through three business segments. The Surgical Related Products segment provides surgical equipment, including skin sutures, ophthalmic knives, deep sutures, bone saws, vascular knives, ophthalmic trocars, and vitreous forceps. The Eyeless Needle Related Products segment provides surgical needle-attached sutures, eyeless suture needles (materials for surgical needle-attached sutures), and eyed suture needles (surgical suture needles). The Dental Related Products segment provides dental root canal treatment equipment, including reamers, files, nickel titanium (NiTi) files, cleansers, and broaches, dental rotary cutting equipment, including diamond burrs, carbide burrs, stainless steel burrs, and peeso reamers, and dental materials, including dental restorative materials.

name: YASKAWA ELECTRIC CORP
businessSummary: Yaskawa Electric Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale, installation, maintenance, and engineering of electrical equipment. The Company operates through three business segments. The Motion Control segment develops, manufactures, sells, and provides maintenance services for alternating current (AC) servo motors, control devices, and inverters. The Robotics segment develops, manufactures, sells, and provides maintenance services for industrial robots. The System Engineering segment develops, manufactures, sells, and provides maintenance services for environmental and social systems and industrial automation drives.

name: YUKEN KOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: YUKEN KOGYO CO., LTD. is a company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of hydraulic, system products and environment equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The Japan segment, Asia segment and Europe segment are engaged in the manufacture and sale of hydraulic equipment, including hydraulic products, system products and environment equipment. The hydraulic products division is engaged in the manufacture and sale of oil pumps and motors, pressure-control valves, flow-control valves, directional-control valves and various hydraulic control equipment. The system products division is engaged in the manufacture, sale and maintenance of hydraulic systems for industrial machinery, standard hydraulic units and hydraulic cylinders. The environment equipment division is engaged in the manufacture and sale of automatic cutting compression machines, automatic polyethylene terephthalate (PET) bottles volume reduction machines, as well as automatic multi-compactors.

name: KYB CORP
businessSummary: KYB Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of hydraulic shock absorbers and hydraulic equipment, as well as the provision of services related to each business. The Company operates through three segments. The Automotive Components (AC) segment produces hydraulic equipment for automobiles, mainly hydraulic shock absorbers for automobiles and motorcycles, and power steering products. The Hydraulic Components (HC) segment produces industrial hydraulic equipment mainly for construction machinery, stage mechanisms, naval equipment, and vibration damping devices. The Aviation Equipment segment produces takeoff and landing gear, steering gear, and control equipment for aircraft. The Company also manufactures and sells concrete mixers, powder and granule transport vehicles, and special function vehicles.

name: NISSHIN GROUP HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: NISSHIN GROUP HOLDINGS Company, Limited, formerly NISSHIN FUDOSAN Co., Ltd., is mainly engaged in the real estate business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the planning and sale of condominiums, as well as the leasing of real estate properties. The Construction segment is engaged in the planning and construction of condominiums, as well as civil engineering works. The Real Estate Management segment is involved in the management of common areas of condominiums, buildings and leasing properties, the renovation and large-scale repair business, as well as the sale of leasing condominiums. The Golf Course segment operates golf courses.

name: HOSIDEN CORP
businessSummary: Hosiden Corporation is principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of electronic components. The Company has four business segments. The Mechanical Component segment provides connectors, jacks and switches. The Acoustic segment offers microphones, headphones, headsets, speakers and receivers. The Liquid Crystal Display Device segment provides passive liquid crystal display devices. The Composite Part and Others segment offers remote controllers and solenoids.

name: NIHON DENKEI CO LTD
businessSummary: NIHON DENKEI CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale, repair and calibration of electronic measuring instruments. The Company operates in three regional segments including Japan, China and Others. The Company is mainly engaged in the sale and manufacture of electronic measuring instruments, various system equipment, electronic components, as well as leasing and rental business. The business items include electronic measuring instruments, measuring instruments for communication, computers and peripherals, automatic and labor-saving equipment, measuring instruments for physics and chemistry, industrial application equipment, measuring instruments for production processes, environmental testing instruments, optical measuring instruments, and educational experiments, electronic parts, mechanical parts, measuring instrument leasing and rental services, curio dealers, building construction, jumping and construction business.

name: NIHON YAMAMURA GLASS CO LTD
businessSummary: Nihon Yamamura Glass Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of glass bottles, plastic containers, and glass for electronics, as well as the design, production, and sale of various related equipment and plants, as well as transportation, storage, and on-site operations. The Company operates through four segments. The Glass Bottle-Related Business segment manufactures and sells glass bottles, various packaging materials and machinery, bottle-making machines, and conveying equipment. The Plastic Container-Related Business segment manufactures and sells plastic caps. The Logistics-Related Business segment transports, stores, and performs on-site operations for products. The New Glass-Related Business segment manufactures and sells glass for electronics and glass parts for electrical and electronic devices. The Company also produces, processes, and sells agricultural products.

name: KURIYAMA HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: KURIYAMA HOLDINGS CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in sale and installation business of rubber and synthetic resin products. It operates through five business segments. Industrial Materials segment sells and installs rubber and resin products for construction and agricultural machineries, ships flooring and power plants. It is also engaged in design, development and manufacture of urea selective catalytic reduction (SCR) sensors. Sports and Construction Materials segment sells and installs construction materials such as rubber, plastic, braille tiles and metals. Other segment is engaged in the sale of sports apparel of brand MONTURA and dust control related products, the technical research and products development, and real estate management business. North America segment sells industrial hoses made of rubber, resin and metal. European segment manufactures and sells rubber lay flat hoses, industrial and firefighting hoses and nozzles in Europe and South America.

name: GLOBERIDE INC
businessSummary: Globeride Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of fishing equipment, golf equipment, and racket sports equipment. The Company operates through four regional segments: Japan, Americas, Europe, Asia and Oceania. The Japan segment manufactures and sells equipment, repairs, provides employee welfare services, and handles warehouse cargo. The Americas segment sells equipment. The Europe segment and Asia and Oceania segments manufacture and sell equipment.

name: KYORIN PHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Kyorin Pharmaceutical Co Ltd, formerly Kyorin Holdings Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the pharmaceuticals business. The Pharmaceuticals segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture, purchase, sales and testing of pharmaceutical products, the purchase of raw materials for pharmaceuticals, the evaluation of technologies, the inspection, analysis and negotiation of license affiliations, the operations related to clinical trials and information gathering such as searching for drug discovery seeds, as well as the drug candidate compound discovery research and compound evaluation business. The Company also conducts the diagnostic businesses and verifies and creates research targets that are directly linked to drug discovery.

name: NISSAN TOKYO SALES HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: NISSAN TOKYO SALES HOLDINGS CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the automobile related business and the information system related business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Automobile Related segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of automobiles and automobile components, as well as the maintenance and inspection of automobiles. The Information System Related segment is engaged in the sale of computer hardware and software, the provision of kitting, installation support, network construction and maintenance services for equipment, as well as the provision of help desks and data centers services. The Company is also engaged in the real estate leasing business.

name: CHUBUSHIRYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Chubushiryo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the feed business. The Feed segment manufactures and sells livestock feed for chickens, pigs, and cattle, as well as aquatic feed for fish. In addition, the Company is also involved in the sale of livestock and marine products to consumers, the sale of livestock equipment, the manufacture and sale of compound fertilizers, the leasing of real estate for utilizing former factory sites, insurance agency business, and egg business.

name: TOPY INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: Topy Industries Ltd is an automobile and industrial machinery parts manufacturing company. It operates in two business segments. The Steel segment produces steel using electric furnaces and rolls bar steel. H-beams, general shaped steel, and deformed steel bars are sold domestically and internationally, while deformed steel is supplied to the automotive and industrial machinery parts division. The Automotive and Industrial Machinery Parts segment provides automotive steel wheels, aluminum wheels, steel wheels for construction machinery, automotive press products, industrial fasteners, and industrial machinery parts. Industrial fasteners include automobiles, home appliances, and industrial machinery. The Industrial Machinery Parts segment provides undercarriage parts for bulldozers and power shovels, tip fittings for blades and buckets, and cutting edges. Other businesses include the wholesale sale of electricity, the manufacture and sale of synthetic mica and others.

name: MARUBUN CORP
businessSummary: MARUBUN CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the purchase and sale of semiconductors, electronic components, electronic equipment and other domestic and foreign electronics products. The Company operates through two business segments. The Device segment is engaged in the sale of semiconductors, including analog integrated circuits (ICs), standard logic ICs, memory ICs, microprocessors, special-purpose ICs, and custom ICs, as well as electronic components such as display panels, crystal units, connectors, printed circuit boards, and modules. The Systems segment is engaged in the sale of aerospace equipment, industrial equipment, laser equipment, information and communication equipment, and medical equipment. The Company is also engaged in the provision of maintenance and technical services for electronic equipment.

name: TECHNO SMART CORP
businessSummary: Techno Smart Corp. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture of machinery and equipment. The Company is engaged in the design, production and sale of various dryers, heat treatment machines, chemical processing machines, and other industrial machines, mainly coating and drying equipment for imparting various functions to substrates such as films, metal foils, and paper. Products include closed edge die (CED) coaters, die coaters, gravure coaters, micro bar coaters for cleaning, two-roll reverse coaters, double-sided simultaneous coaters, floating dryers, unwinder and winder equipment, butt-splicing devices, film feed devices and film laminate devices, among others.

name: WILLPLUS HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Willplus Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the distribution of new cars and used cars, as well as the vehicle maintenance and general insurance agent business. The Imported Vehicle Sales-related segment is engaged in the sale of new cars purchased from each importer, the sale of high-year-low-running used cars of each brand, the sale of other brands used cars in auto auction, the provision of vehicle maintenance services such as maintenance, repair and inspection services, as well as the sale of compulsory automobile liability insurances and optional insurances, and the sale of new cars from importers.

name: TOYO SEIKAN GROUP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Toyo Seikan Group Holdings Ltd is a Japan-based container manufacturer. The Company operates in five segments. The Packaging Container segment manufactures and sells containers made primarily from metal, plastic, paper, and glass. The Engineering, Filling, and Logistics segment manufactures and sells packaging container-related machinery and equipment, contracts the manufacture and sale of beverage filling products, aerosol products, and general filling products, as well as truck transportation and warehousing. The Steel Plate-Related segment manufactures and sells steel plates and processed steel plate products. The Functional Materials-Related segment manufactures and sells functional materials such as aluminum substrates for magnetic disks, optical functional films, glazes, pigments, gel coats, and trace element fertilizers. The Real Estate-Related segment rents out office buildings and commercial facilities. The Company also manufactures and sells automotive press dies and others.

name: SUMITOMO FORESTRY CO LTD
businessSummary: Sumitomo Forestry Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the forestry business, the procurement, manufacturing, processing, and sales of timber and building materials, contracting and renovating construction work for detached houses. The Company operates in four segments. The Timber and Building Material segment provides lumber products and building materials. The Housing segment conducts contracting construction work, after-sales maintenance and renovation, selling condominiums, leasing, managing, buying and selling, and brokering real estate, contracting exterior and landscaping work. The Construction and Real Estate segment is engaged in the sale of condominiums overseas, contracting for the construction of detached houses, the operation of panels and trusses, the development of apartment buildings and commercial complexes. The Resources and Environment segment is engaged in the renewable energy business and forestry resource business.

name: FB CARE SERVICE CO LTD
businessSummary: FB Care Service Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the nursing care business. The Company operates through two segments. The Welfare Equipment segment provides welfare equipment rental and sales based on the Long-term Care Insurance Law, and home care support. The Long-term Care segment includes pay nursing homes with nursing care, residential pay nursing homes, group homes, small-scale multifunctional home care, nursing small-scale multifunctional home care, day services, home-visit care, home-visit nursing care, and long-term care non-insurance services. The Company provides welfare equipment, home care support, and dominant care services in the Shinetsu and Kita-Kantou areas.

name: DAICEL CORP
businessSummary: Daicel Corporation is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of cellulose products, organic synthetic products, synthetic resin products, pyrotechnic products and others. The Company operates in five business segments. The Cellulose segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cellulose acetate, acetate tow for cigarette filters, carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC) and hydroxyethyl cellulose (HEC). The Organic Synthesis segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of acetic acid derivatives, epoxy compounds, semiconductor resist materials and others. The Synthetic Resins segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of polyester resins, wrapping plastics and others. The Pyrotechnic segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of propellant powder and emergency evacuation systems for aircraft passengers, among others. The Others segment is engaged in the provision of production innovation services and other businesses.

name: TOKYO SOIR CO LTD
businessSummary: TOKYO SOIR CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of women's formal wear and the sale of accessory accessories. The Company is a comprehensive women's formal wear maker that plans products for wear and accessories and wholesales it to department stores and chain stores nationwide. The Company provides black formal, color formal and accessory products.

name: NICCA CHEMICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: NICCA CHEMICAL CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of surfactants. The Company operates in two business segments. The Chemicals segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemicals for textile processing, chemicals for information recording paper, resin raw materials, commercial cleaning chemicals, chemicals for medical and nursing care facilities, and other functional chemicals. The Cosmetics segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of hair care agent, hair color agent, perm agent, scalp care agent and styling agent. The other business is engaged in the contracted construction of facility works.

name: AOYAMA TRADING CO LTD
businessSummary: AOYAMA TRADING Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in business related to clothing items. The Company operates in six business segments. The Business Wear business sells men's and women's business wear and related western goods, commissions correction processing of ready-made clothes, plans for in-store and outside performances, and plans sales consumables. The Casual business is engaged in the sale of casual clothing. The Card business is engaged in the provision of retail finance and credit services. The Printing and Media business is engaged in the printing various flyers and catalogs, publishing magazines, printing and sending direct mail. The Miscellaneous Goods Sales business sells daily miscellaneous goods and processed foods and operates Daiso & Aoyama 100 Yen Plaza. The Comprehensive Repair Service business provides comprehensive repair services such as shoe repair and key duplication. The Company is also engaged in reuse business and restaurant business.

name: PLANT CO LTD
businessSummary: PLANT Co., Ltd. is a company mainly involved in the operation of discount stores. The Company operates three types of stores under the names JOYFUL STORE, HOME CENTER and SUPER CENTER. The JOYFUL STORE is located in the urban areas, and primarily provides small-sized and small-sum groceries and other daily consumable goods. The HOME CENTER is found in the suburbs, and principally supplies Do-It-Yourself (DIY) items, garden supplies, food products excluding fresh food, as well as clothing. The SUPER CENTER is located in the rural areas, and mainly provides daily living-related products including fresh food and others.

name: TOKAI CARBON CO LTD
businessSummary: Tokai Carbon Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of carbon products. The Company operates five business segments. The Graphite Electrode Business segment provides graphite electrodes for electric steelmaking furnaces. The Carbon Black Business segment provides carbon black for rubber products, black pigments, and conductive materials. The Fine Carbon Business segment provides specialty carbon products, solid silicon carbide, and silicon carbide coatings. The Smelting & Lining Business segment provides cathodes for aluminum electrolysis, blast furnace blocks, and carbon electrodes. The Industrial Furnace and Related Products Business segment provides industrial electric furnaces and silicon carbide heating elements.

name: SCALA INC
businessSummary: Scala Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the software as a service (SaaS) and application service provider (ASP) business, the sales force automation (SFA) business and others. The Company has four business segments. The SaaS/ASP segment is engaged in the provision of SaaS and ASP type services that support communication between companies and people such as i-search and i-ask. The SFA segment is engaged in the license sale of sales support systems, the provision of cloud services, customized development services, sales consulting and skill training services. The Field Marketing segment is engaged in the provision of field activities and market research services. The Customer Support segment is engaged in the provision of customer support consulting services for call centers. The Company is also engaged in the operation of electronic commerce (EC) sites, the planning, editing and publishing of business books, the provision of recruitment and employment services and others.

name: SINTOKOGIO LTD
businessSummary: Sintokogio,Ltd. is a company mainly engaged in manufacture and sale of casting, surface treatment, environment, carrier, special machine business, and other equipment and components. The Company operates in five business segments. The Casting segment offers molding machines, casting sand processing devices, granular processing equipment and components. The Surface Treatment segment offers shot blasting machines, components of surface treatment equipment, as well as shot materials and abrasive materials. The Environment segment offers dust collectors, deodorization equipment, water processing equipment and other components. The Carrier segment offers lifting devices, conveyors and conveying system. The Special Equipment segment offers inspection and measurement devices, servo-cylinders, handling robot and ceramics products. The others engages in design of machinery, information-related business and welfare businesses.

name: KOMORI CORP
businessSummary: KOMORI CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of printing equipment, as well as the provision of related materials, finance services and real estate management services. The Company operates in three regional segments. The Japan segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of securities printing equipment and other printing equipment in Japan, Latin America and Asia, as well as the purchase and sale of small printing equipment, the provision of inks, paper, folding machines, electrical equipment and other equipment parts and printing materials. The North America segment is mainly engaged in the sale of printing equipment in the United States. The Europe segment is mainly engaged in the sale of printing equipment in Western Europe, Eastern Europe and the Middle East, as well as the manufacture and sale of paper printing equipment . The Company also operates in Hong Kong, Taiwan, Singapore, Malaysia and India.

name: KANEKA CORP
businessSummary: Kaneka Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in four business segments. The Material Solutions Unit segment includes general purpose vinyl chloride resin, caustic soda, polyvinyl chloride special resin, modifier, epoxy masterbatches, biodegradable polymer and modified silicone polymer. Quality of Life Solutions Unit segment includes styrene-based foam resin and molded product, styrene-based foam extrusion board, polyolefin foam, solar circuit construction method, polyimide film, optical material, graphite sheet, solar cells, storage batteries for housing, and acrylic synthetic fiber. The Health Care Solutions Unit segment includes medical devices, low molecular weight pharmaceutical raw materials, Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) and biopharmaceuticals. The Nutrition Solutions Unit segment includes functional food ingredients, lactic acid bacteria, margarine, shortening, baker's yeast, spices, antifreeze ingredients, dairy products, functional fertilizers and feeds.

name: KONICA MINOLTA INC
businessSummary: Konica Minolta Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the digital workplace, professional print, healthcare, and industry businesses. The Company operates four business segments. The Digital Workplace segment develops, manufactures, and sells multi-functional peripherals and related consumables, and provides information technology services and solutions. The Professional Print segment develops, manufactures, and sells digital printing systems and related consumables for the commercial and industrial printing markets. The Healthcare segment develops, manufactures, and sells diagnostic imaging systems for medical use, digitizes and networks medical sites, provides diagnostic services and solutions, and offers genetic testing and drug discovery support services. The Industry segment develops, manufactures, and sells measuring instruments, industrial and professional lenses, industrial inkjet heads, functional films used in displays, network cameras, and video-related equipment.

name: TRINITY INDUSTRIAL CORP
businessSummary: TRINITY INDUSTRIAL CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of equipment and automobile components. The Company has two business segments. The Equipment segment is engaged in the design, manufacture and sale of coating plant equipment such as pre-treatment systems, electrolytic coating systems, painting booths, drying ovens, air ventilation devices, exhaust-gas treatment equipment and conveyers, coating equipment such as electrostatic equipment, automatic coating systems, coating supply systems, automatic paint recoloring equipment and others, as well as industrial machines such as heat treating furnaces, autoclaves, electrostatic oiling machines, coating dryers, washers, leak testers, ultra filter (UF) and reverse osmosis (RO) equipment. The Automobile Components segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive interior and exterior products such as steering handles, door switch bases, center clusters and side mudguards.

name: FJ NEXT HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: FJ Next Holdings Co Ltd, formerly FJ Next Co Ltd, is mainly engaged in the real estate sales business in the metropolitan areas. The Company has four business segments. The Real Estate Development segment mainly develops, sells, brokers and of one-room mansions and family condominiums in the Tokyo metropolitan area, and also engages in the real estate business in the Izu area. This segment also provides financial services. The Real Estate Management segment mainly undertakes rental management from condominium division owners and building management contracts from management associations. The Construction segment mainly designs, constructs, inspects, and renovates buildings such as condominiums. The Hotel segment operates hot spring hotels in Shizuoka Prefecture.

name: TACHI-S CO LTD
businessSummary: Tachi-S Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive seats and seat components. The Company operates through six regional segments including Japan, North America, Central and South America, Europe, China, and Southeast Asia. In the Japan segment, it handles automotive seats and seat components, as well as real estate leasing. Its automotive seat products include those for HONDA, NISSAN, MITSUBISHI, TOYOTA, HINO, and others.

name: NIPPON LIGHT METAL HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Light Metal Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of alumina and chemical products, ingots, plates, extruded products, processed products, foil, and powder products. The Company operates through four business segments. The Alumina and Chemical Products and Ingots segment manufactures and sells alumina, aluminum hydroxide, various chemical products, and aluminum ingots and alloys. The Plate and Extruded Products segment manufactures and sells aluminum plates and aluminum extruded products. The Processed Products and Related Businesses segment manufactures and sells transportation-related products, freezers and refrigerator panels, and other aluminum processed products, as well as provides services such as transportation, information processing, and insurance agency services. The Foil and Powder Products segment manufactures and sells foil and powder products.

name: AXELL CORP
businessSummary: AXELL CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and sales of semiconductor products. The Company is engaged in the sale of light-emitting diode (LED) driver LSIs and memory modules while positioning graphic large-scale integration (LSI) as a core product for pachinko and pachislot machine market. The Company also sells graphics LSIs for liquid crystal display devices mounted on factory automation (FA) equipment, medical equipment, large construction equipment. The Company is also engaged in the development of evaluation boards and support software to reduce the development burden of customers. The Company is also engaged in the early commercialization activities in middleware, machine learning, blockchain and security four new areas.

name: FUJICOPIAN CO LTD
businessSummary: FUJICOPIAN CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of recording media for printing, as well as office consumables. The Company's products include thermal transfer media, such as thermal transfer ribbons and thermal carbon copies; impact ribbons, including encompassing cloth ribbons, film ribbons and link units; tapes, including correction tapes and glue tapes; functional films, including FIXFILM and others, as well as various carbon papers.

name: FIRST JUKEN CO LTD
businessSummary: First Juken Co., Ltd. is primarily engaged in developing and selling detached houses and contract work. The Detached Housing segment is engaged in the planning, development and sale, and contractor work of detached housing, and additionally insurance agency and other related business. The Others segment is engaged in condominium business, including development and sale of new condominiums, renovation and sale of existing condominiums, condominium rental and related business. The condominium business sells new condominium buildings and sells second-hand condominiums after renovation. The construction of new condominiums business engages in the purchase of land for sale, construction management, distribution and sale of various constructions.

name: NANSIN CO LTD
businessSummary: NANSIN CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of casters and dollies. The Company operates in three business segments. The Malaysia segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of casters in Malaysia. The China segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of casters and dollies in China. The Britain segment is engaged in the leasing of real estate in Britain.

name: NIPPON SEIKI CO LTD
businessSummary: NIPPON SEIKI CO., LTD. is a manufacturing company that operates in four business segments. The Automobile and General Instrument segment offers measuring gauges for four-wheel and two-wheel vehicles, head-up displays, general measuring gauges and various sensors. The Consumer Equipment segment offers operating panels for office automation (OA) and information equipment, controllers for air-conditioning and household equipment, assemblies for factory automation (FA) and amusement units, as well as high-density mounting boards. The Automobile Sales segment is engaged in the sale of new and secondhand automobiles, and the provision of car inspection and maintenance services. The Others segment is engaged in the transportation of cargoes, the development and sale of software, the entrusted accounting business, and the processing and sale of resin materials, the providing of displaying elements and modules for liquid crystal and organic electroluminescence (EL), among others.

name: KITANO CONSTRUCTION CORP
businessSummary: KITANO CONSTRUCTION CORP. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the plan, design, construction management and consulting for construction work. The Company operates through four business segments. The Construction segment is involved in the construction work and civil engineering work, incidental development business and solar power generation business, as well as the general management and security of buildings. The Golf Course segment is involved in the operation of Kawanakajima Country Club. The Hotel segment is involved in the hotel management of Solomon Kitano Mendana Hotel and Hotel Duparc Hanoi, as well as the hotel in Nagano City. The Advertising Agency segment is involved in the operation of advertising agencies.

name: OKAMURA CORP
businessSummary: Okamura Corp is a company mainly engaged in the manufacturing and sale of office environmental equipment, commercial environmental equipment and logistics system equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The Office Environmental segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of office furniture, communal facility furniture, security products and health care products. The Commercial Environmental segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of store shelves, freezer showcases, refrigerated showcases and store counters. The Logistics System segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of logistics equipment, such as storage racks for factories and warehouses, logistics automatic equipment and facilities. The Company also manufactures and sells fluid transmissions for industrial vehicles and construction machinery.

name: WAVELOCK HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: WAVELOCK HOLDINGS CO., LTD. is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of composite materials made from plastic, fiber and paper. The Company operates through four business segments. Interior segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of wallpaper products, as well as the sale of related products. Weaving segment is involved in the manufacture of net products made of synthetic fibers, as well ae the sale of insect-proof nets for general houses, insect-proof nets for rehabilitation, agricultural material nets, civil engineering materials and construction temporary materials. Advanced Technology segment is involved in the sale of metal decorative films, glitter tapes, special printing, functional films and sheets and opening tapes. Industrial Materials and Packaging Materials segment is involved in the sale of films and plastic sheets including construction temporary materials, agricultural materials, food packaging materials.

name: WATANABE SATO CO LTD
businessSummary: WATANABE SATO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the contracting operations of pavement works, civil engineering works and related business, as well as the manufacture and sale of asphalt mixtures. The construction department is mainly engaged in the provision of construction works, including pavement and civil engineering works. The product sales department is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of asphalt mixtures and related products, as well as the rental of equipment.

name: AXYZ CO LTD
businessSummary: AXYZ Co.,Ltd. is a Japn-based company mainly engaged in the provision of chicken. The Company operates through two business segments. The Food segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of processed chicken products such as fried chicken, liver stewed chicken, and chicken nuggets, using chickens raised by non-medication and directly managed fattening facilities breeding. The Company is also engaged in the manufacture and sale of zeolite products and shirasu balloons, and the sale of non-chemical fertilizer-reduced pesticide vegetables. The Restaurant segment operates Kentucky Fried Chicken and Pizza Hut franchise stores.

name: NPR-RIKEN CORP
businessSummary: NPR-Riken Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the management and administration of its subsidiaries and group companies, as well as other businesses incidental or related to such management and administration. The Company conducts its business through subsidiaries such as RIKEN and Nihon Piston Ring. The Riken Group is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive and industrial machinery parts, anechoic chambers, industrial furnaces and heating materials, construction-related parts, construction contracting, environmental maintenance, and factory repair and maintenance. Nippon Piston Ring Group is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive-related products, marine and other products, as well as logistics, services, and other business activities related to each business.

name: MARUO CALCIUM CO LTD
businessSummary: Maruo Calcium Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of calcium carbonate and related business. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of various types of calcium carbonate used in synthetic resins, paints, reinforcing fillers for rubber, and chemicals and food additives. The main products are compounded calcium carbonate and heavy calcium carbonate. The Company is also engaged in the purchase and sale of inorganic chemicals such as talc and silica.

name: SHINWA CO LTD
businessSummary: Shinwa Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture, sale and maintenance of production equipment and materials in the manufacturing industry. The Company operates in four regional segments. The Company is engaged in the sale of metal joints, industrial equipment, factory automation (FA) system related products, the provision of cover welding and spraying services, soldering services and maintenance works, the manufacture and sale of FA systems, as well as the logistics business, the real estate management business, the insurance agency business, and the manufacture and sale of resin products. The Company operates within the domestic market and to overseas markets, including the United States, Southeast Asia and China.

name: NADEX CO LTD
businessSummary: NADEX CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacturing and sales of electronics components, sales of industrial machinery, factory automation (FA) system business and welding solution business of resistance welding equipment. The Company operates in four segments: Japan segment, the Americas segment, China segment and Thai segment. The Company’s welding equipment & materials business includes resistance welding, arc welding, laser and industrial robots, etc. The factory automation business includes automatic and labor-saving car parts manufacturing facilities, electronic devices, manufacturing facilities, inspection and meters. The electronic control equipment business includes electronics, control components and equipment, power supply modules. The information technology (IT) solutions include manufacturing execution system (MES) solutions, equipment management solutions, energy management solutions and image inspection solutions, etc.

name: HOKUETSU METAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Hokuetsu Metal Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, processing and sale of steel products. The Company mainly provides steel bars, wire rods, shaped steels, ultra-high yield (UHY) hoops, fab decks, meshes, lock bolts, turn buckles, UN bolts, deformed bolts, UND self-drilling bolts, spring chains, among others.

name: DIRECT MARKETING MIX INC
businessSummary: Direct Marketing MIX Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the marketing business and on-site business. The Company has two business segments. The Marketing segment is engaged in the direct marketing business, consulting business and business process outsourcing business. The direct marketing business is engaged in the sale of products and services to end users on behalf of client companies through channels such as telephone contact, direct visit and Web contact by communicators. The consulting business is engaged in the provision of strategies and plans formulation services, system construction and actual operation services, as well as consulting services such as contact center operation and product development, training and market research. The business process outsourcing business is engaged in the labor saving and simplification support business. The On-Site segment is engaged in the temporary staffing business, including dispatch of communicators for marketing business.

name: OHASHI TECHNICA INC
businessSummary: OHASHI TECHNICA INC. is a Japan-based company engaged in the design, development, manufacture and sale of automotive parts such as engine related parts, automobile assembly parts and brake related parts, as well as the logistics business. The Company operates through six geographic segments including Japan, Americas, China, ASEAN, Europe and Taiwan. Japan segment and China segment are engaged in auto parts business and other related parts business. The Americas, ASEAN, Europe and Taiwan segments are mainly engaged in automotive parts. Automotive components include engine and mission components, differential components, brake components, body and chasse components and interior & exterior components.

name: LANDIX INC
businessSummary: Landix Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of one-stop solutions from real estate purchase to sale, sale brokerage, custom-made housing matching and after-sale follow-up after construction. The Company operates in two business segments. The SUMUZU segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of residential land, the brokerage of real estate, as well as the provision of introduction services for custom home construction. The Company is also engaged in the operation of own portal site SUMUZU. The Leasing segment is engaged in the purchase of profitable real estate. The Company is also engaged in the rental property management business and the insurance agency business.

name: KFC LTD
businessSummary: KFC, Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale, design and install of the construction materials, as well as the import, design and install of impermeable sheets and waterproof sheets, among others. The Company has three segments. The Fastener segment is mainly engaged in the sale of construction materials which related to after construction anchor. The Civil Engineering Materials segment is mainly engaged in the sale of tunnel excavation materials. The Construction segment is mainly engaged in the tunnel interior and renovation works.

name: ISHIZUKA GLASS CO LTD
businessSummary: ISHIZUKA GLASS CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of glass container-related products, houseware-related products, paper container-related products, plastic containers-related products, industrial equipment related products and others. The Glass Bottles-related segment manufactures and sells glass containers. Houseware-related segment manufactures and sells glass and ceramics dishes. The Paper Containers-related segment manufactures and sells paper containers and related filling machines. The Plastic Containers-related segment manufactures and sells preform for PET bottle. The Industrial Equipment-related business manufactures and sells heating and cooking utensils, such as top plate. The Others segment manufactures and sells ceramics products and metal caps.

name: FUKUDA CORP
businessSummary: Fukuda Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in construction and real estate businesses, and also provides non-construction related services. It operates through two segments. The Construction business segment is engaged in the acceptance and execution of construction work, as well as the rental and manufacturing/sale of construction-related equipment and materials. The Real Estate business segment is engaged in the sale, rental and development of real estate. The Company also rents and sells products and provides services other than those related to construction work, and operates welfare facilities.

name: YAKUODO HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Yakuodo Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company that operates a retail business dealing in pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, groceries, daily necessities and other lifestyle-related products. The Company operates the drugstore business segment. The Drugstore Business segment operates drugstore chain shops and dispensing pharmacies.

name: FUMAKILLA LTD
businessSummary: FUMAKILLA LIMITED is a Japan-based chemical manufacturing company. The Company operates in four business divisions. The Pesticide division manufactures and sells battery-operated mosquito destroyers and insect deterrents, mat-type and liquid mosquito destroyers, fly and mosquito insecticides, fumigants, as well as cockroach repellents in Japan, South Asia and other regions. The Gardening Equipment division manufactures and sells insecticides and disinfectants for gardening use, fertilizers, immunizer, herbicides and culture soil in Japan. The Disease Prevention Agents division manufactures and sells emulsions, oil solutions, powder and rat poisons in Japan. The Household Products division manufactures and sells dehumidifying agents, clothing repellents, pollen allergy products and sanitizers in Japan.

name: NANSO TRANSPORT CO LTD
businessSummary: NANSO Transport Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the freight car transport business, warehousing business, ancillary business, real estate business, construction business and other businesses. The Company operates through five business segments. The Lorry Transportation segment provides charter and freight trucks using freight trucks. The Warehousing segment is engaged in cargo storage operations using in-house and leased warehouses. The Ancillary segment is engaged in outsourcing work and general worker dispatching business in customer factories. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the provision of stores, offices and parking lots that meet customer needs, as well as the leasing business. The Construction segment is engaged in the construction and repair of buildings and other buildings of customers and the group company. The Company is also engaged in passenger car transport business and insurance agency business.

name: TAYCA CORP
businessSummary: TAYCA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemical products and electro ceramics. The Company operates in two business segments. The Titanium Oxide segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of titanium oxide, particle titanium oxide, particle zinc oxide, surface-treatment products and photocatalytic titanium oxide, among others. The Others segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of surface-acting agents, sulphonic acid and others, as well as the transportation and storage of industrial chemical products.

name: KG INTELLIGENCE CO LTD
businessSummary: KG Intelligence CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company in the provision of information service. The Company is mainly engaged in publishing of information magazines. Through its subsidiary, it is also engaged in operation of Internet information sites, design and development of software, as well as configuration, management and maintenance of networks.

name: DAIDO STEEL CO LTD
businessSummary: Daido Steel Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly provides special steel products, functional and magnetic materials, automotive and industrial machinery parts, engineering, and distribution and services. It operates through five segments. The Special Steel Products segment manufactures and sells special steel products. The Functional and Magnetic Materials segment manufactures and sells stainless steel products, rare earth magnets, high-alloy products, materials for electrical and others. The Automotive and Industrial Machinery Parts segment manufactures and sells die-forged products, steel machinery products for trucks, band saw materials and others. The Engineering segment manufactures and sells steel equipment and environmental equipment. The Distribution and Services segment engages in real estate, insurance, the group's employee welfare business, golf course management, analysis of steel and ceramics, development and maintenance of information systems, and building rental.

name: KUMIAI CHEMICAL INDUSTRY CO LTD
businessSummary: KUMIAI CHEMICAL INDUSTRY Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of agricultural chemicals and other chemical products. The Company operates in two business segments. Agricultural Chemicals & Agriculture-Related segment produces pesticides, such as insecticides, fungicides and herbicides, and sells them in Japan through the National Federation of Agricultural Cooperative Associations (JA ZEN-NOH). The Segment is also involved in the import and export of agricultural chemicals, the sale of greening materials, as well as the comprehensive maintenance of golf courses. Chemical Products segment manufactures and sells chlorotoluene and chloroxylene chemicals, fine chemicals, industrial chemicals, as well as polystyrene foam, among others. The Company is also involved in the rental business, power generation and selling business, construction business, printing business, logistics business, as well as information service business.

name: NANKAI PLYWOOD CO LTD
businessSummary: NANKAI PLYWOOD CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of wooden building interior materials, as well as the sale of electric wires and electrical equipment. The Company operates through two business segments. The Wood Related segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of ceiling materials, storage materials, plywood and others, as well as the handling, packaging and transportation of raw materials and products. The Electric Wire Related segment is involved in the sale of electric wires and electrical equipment. The Company is also involved in the production and process of industrial and household synthetic resin products, as well as the real estate rental business.

name: MIYAJI ENGINEERING GROUP INC
businessSummary: MIYAJI ENGINEERING GROUP, INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the bridge business. The Company operates in two business segments. Along with its subsidiaries, MIYAJI ENGINEERING segment is engaged in the design, production and site installation, the maintenance, repair and reinforcement of bridges, structural steel products and others; sales of fiber-reinforced plastics (FRP) structures; prestressed concrete bridges and other civil engineering works; as well as earthquake-proof and seismic isolation works for large and high-rise buildings, steel towers, chimneys, factory buildings and others. The MM BRIDGE segment is engaged in the production, installation, sales and repair of bridges, coastal structures, as well as the contract, design and supervise construction of civil engineering construction works.

name: ALTECH CO LTD
businessSummary: ALTECH CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the purchase and sale of industrial machine and equipment, as well as the manufacture and sale of plastic bottle preforms and plastic caps. The company operates through two business segments. The Business Firm segment is mainly engaged in the purchase and sale of industrial machinery, equipment, as well as the provision of related services. Main product of this segment is plastic bottle related inspection equipment, plastic bottle molding dies, security related devices and synthetic resin materials, among others. The Preform segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of plastic bottle preforms and plastic caps, as well as the provision of related services.

name: KURARAY CO LTD
businessSummary: Kuraray Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemicals. The Company operates through five business segments. The Vinyl Acetate segment provides functional resins and films such as poval, polyvinyl butyral (PVB), and EVAL. The Isoprene segment provides thermoplastic elastomer SEPTON, CLARITY, isoprene-related products, and GENESTA. The Functional Materials segment provides methacrylic resins, medical-related products, and carbon materials. The Textile segment provides synthetic fibers, artificial leather CLARINO, and non-woven fabrics. The Trading segment processes and sells synthetic fibers and artificial leather, and plans and sells other products. It is also engaged in the manufacture and sales of liquid crystal polymer film, rubber and resin processed products, design and construction of various plants, contracted production ancillary and logistics services, etc., warehousing and distribution and processing services, insurance, travel.

name: IIDA GROUP HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Iida Group Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the management and operation of subsidiaries engaged in the businesses of detached house sales, condominium sales, contract construction. It has six business segments. The Ichiken Group Business segment is engaged in the businesses of detached house sales, condominium sales, contract construction and others. The Iida Sangyo Group Business segment is engaged in the businesses of detached house sales, condominium sales, contract construction, real estate rental, hotel business, money lending, golf course business, and others. The Toei Housing Group Business segment is engaged in the businesses of detached house sales, contract construction and others. The Tact Home Group Business segment, Ernest One Group Business segment, and ID Home Business segment are engaged in the sale of detached houses, contract construction and others. It’s also engaged in the manufacture and sale of building materials such as concrete blocks.

name: TRE HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: TRE Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the waste treatment and recycling business, renewable energy business, environmental engineering business and resource recycling business. The waste treatment and recycling business includes collection and transportation, intermediate treatment, recycling and final disposal site. The renewable energy business operates a woody biomass power plant that mainly uses forest resources as fuel. The environmental engineering business develops, manufactures and sells environmental equipment, plants and specially equipped vehicles. The environmental consulting business includes measurement certification business, environmental measures business, hazardous waste investigation and analysis business. The resource recycling business includes metal recycling business, automobile recycling business, industrial waste treatment business, home appliance recycling business and other businesses.

name: KROSAKI HARIMA CORP
businessSummary: Krosaki Harima Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and development of refractories. It operates through four business segments. The Refractories segment manufactures and sells refractories mainly used in various industrial kilns. The Furnace segment designs, constructs, and repairs various kilns. The Ceramics segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of various industrial ceramics, as well as the sale of landscape materials. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the construction and leasing of stores and warehouses on company-owned land.

name: DAIDO SIGNAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Daido Signal Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of railway signaling equipment and industrial equipment, and the provision of maintenance and repair service to these equipment, as well as installation work of railway signaling equipment, the manufacture and sale of metal surface treatment and mold, and leasing of real estate. The Company operates through three business segments. The Railway Signal-related Business segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale and installation of railway signal security equipment. The Industrial Equipment-related Business segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of information and communication equipment, traffic signal equipment, railroad vehicle supplies, gas detectors, plastic molded products, metal surface treatments, and molds. The Real Estate-related Business segment mainly rents real estate.

name: TENSHO ELECTRIC INDUSTRIES CO LTD
businessSummary: Tensho Electric Industries Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive parts, logistics industry materials, mechanical parts and molds, as well as the real estate-related businesses. The Company operates through four business segments. The Japan Molding segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive parts, logistics industry materials, mechanical parts and molds. The China Molding segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of logistics industry materials, mechanical parts and dies. The American Molding segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of mechanical parts and dies. The Real Estate segment is mainly engaged in the leasing of buildings.

name: FUJIMAK CORP
businessSummary: FUJIMAK CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale, maintenance and repair of kitchen equipment for business uses. The Company provides the heating equipment such as oven equipment and the bakery equipment; the cooling equipment such as refrigeration equipment; the washing and sterilizing equipment such as dish washer and conveyer dish washer; the service equipment such as ice cream machine, and other kitchen equipment for business uses. The Company is also engaged in the delivery, storage and management of its products.

name: WDB HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: WDB HOLDINGS CO., LTD. is a company mainly engaged in the manpower dispatching business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Human Resource Service segment is engaged in the work of client customers mainly through temporary staffing and contracting contracts. The CRO (Contract Research Organization) business segment acts on and supports experimental work in basic research of pharmaceuticals, quasi-drugs, cosmetics and development work after clinical trial. The other business is engaged in the contracted manufacture of organic chemicals, as well as the product development and sale, and the research of the aquaculture and breeding of clams, fishes and algae, among others.

name: MITACHI CO LTD
businessSummary: MITACHI CO., LTD is a company mainly involved in the sale of semiconductors, liquid crystal products and electronic parts. The Domestic division is engaged in the purchase and sale of semiconductors, including universal integrated circuits (ICs), diodes, transistors, optical semiconductors and system large-scale integration (LSI); liquid crystal products, such as liquid crystal modules; electronic components, including resistors, condensers, switches and electronic printed boards; industrial equipment, such as chip mounters and printers, as well as other components, such as hard discs and electric motors. The Overseas division is engaged in the contracted manufacture and sale of electrical devices and electrical components, as well as the purchase and sale of electrical devices and electrical components. In addition, the Company is engaged in the contract processing of electronic products.

name: KUNIMINE INDUSTRIES CO LTD
businessSummary: KUNIMINE INDUSTRIES CO., LTD is a Japan-based company engaged in the raw mineral business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Bentonite segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of litter for civil engineering and construction, castings and pets, the purchase, sale and transportation of mud conditioning formulation and others. The Agriculture segment is engaged in the processing of agricultural chemicals, the manufacture, processing, sale and transportation of raw materials for agricultural base and processing products, agricultural materials, soil conditioners, and purified bentonite for pesticide applications. The Chemical Products segment manufactures and sells refined bentonite, environmental preservatives, and other products.

name: RIKEN VITAMIN CO LTD
businessSummary: Riken Vitamin Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of food products. It operates through three business segments. The Domestic Food segment manufactures and sells household foods (processed foods for general households), commercial foods (processed foods for the commercial market), and processed food ingredients (ingredients for processed foods, food improvers, and vitamins for the food industry). The products include seaweed products, dressings, extracts and seasonings, food improvers, vitamins, and health functional products. The Domestic Chemical Products and Others segment manufactures and sells chemical product improvers and feed additives. The Overseas segment manufactures and sells food improvers, chemical product improvers, extracts, and seasonings, and distributes its products in Southeast Asia, South Asia, the Middle East, Oceania, Europe, Africa, North America, Central and South America, China, Taiwan, and South Korea.

name: FUJISASH CO LTD
businessSummary: FUJISASH CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of building materials and aluminum profiles. The Company operates through three business segments. The Building Materials segment manufactures and sells curtain walls, sash and doors for buildings, sash and doors for mid- to low-rise buildings, sashes for renovation, sashes for houses, sliding doors and doors, interior fittings, and exterior products. The Shape Material Sales segment manufactures and sells aluminum shapes and precision processed aluminum products for external sales. The Environmental segment designs, manufactures and constructs a municipal garbage incineration facility fly ash treatment plant and associated chemicals, and a municipal garbage recycling facility. The Company is also involved in the real estate, transportation and storage management business.

name: DAIHO CORP
businessSummary: Daiho Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction business, focusing on civil engineering and architectural works. The Company operates in three business segments. The Civil Engineering segment is engaged in all civil engineering works. The Construction segment is engaged in all architectural works. The Others segment is engaged in real estate sales and rentals, as well as the sale and rental of construction materials.

name: DAI-ICHI CUTTER KOGYO KK
businessSummary: Dai-Ichi Cutter Kogyo KK is a Japan-based construction company mainly engaged in cutting and drilling works. The Company has three business segments. The Cutting and Drilling Construction segment is engaged in cutting work necessary for dismantling, cutting and drilling necessary for dismantling and removing concrete structures. The Building Maintenance segment is engaged in maintenance and inspection of water supply and drainage facilities, cleaning of water tanks, and cleaning of miscellaneous drainage pipes in housing complexes and office buildings. The Reuse and Recycling segment is engaged in the reuse and recycling services, including the purchase and collection of information technology (IT)-related equipment and used office automation (OA) equipment, data erasure services, sales to corporations and individuals, and office installation services for telecommunications equipment.

name: UEX LTD
businessSummary: UEX,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of stainless steel and other metal materials, the manufacture and sale of stainless steel and other metal processed products, and the manufacture and sale of mechanical equipment. The Company operates through three business segments. The Stainless Steel and Other Metal Materials Sales business is engaged in the cutting and sale of metal materials such as stainless steel plates, steel pipes, steel strips, and stainless steel pipes for semiconductor devices, the processing and sales of fake products, forged products, machined parts. The Stainless Steel and Other Metal Materials Manufacture and Sales business is engaged in the manufacture and sale of stainless steel weather covers and stainless steel pipe products. The Machinery Manufacturing and Sales and Engineering business is engaged in the design and manufacture of general industrial equipment mainly for food and chemicals, and the provision of engineering services.

name: PRINTNET INC
businessSummary: PRINTNET INC. mainly engages in the mail order business of printing materials and printing materials through the Internet. In its main business, the Company receives orders from customers on websites that include printing specifications and fees, receives printing data, conducts printing and processing businesses in domestic factories, as well as sends to customers. The Company provides pamphlets, free papers, leaflets, newspaper folding leaflets, company name envelopes, election posters, calendars and others on the company website.

name: TOKUDEN CO LTD
businessSummary: TOKUDEN CO., LTD. is a company engaged in the welding and welding-related businesses. The Company operates in two segments. The Works segment is involved in the welding of manufacturing machinery for the steel making, petrochemical, cement, home electrical appliance, automobile and food industries, as well as facility maintenance-related welding for the steel and non-ferrous metal industries. The Welding Materials segment purchases, manufactures and sells special welding materials, including flux wires, coated electrodes, various wire rods and pulverized materials. The Company is also involved in the sale of aluminum die-casting machine parts, including plunger sleeves, sprue bushes, plunger chips and ladles for automotive industry, the manufacture and sale of deodorization equipment, forced-air cooling apparatus.

name: SHIGEMATSU WORKS CO LTD
businessSummary: SHIGEMATSU WORKS CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of occupational safety and health protection equipment. The Company is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of various occupational safety and health protection equipment such as respiratory protective equipment with electric fans, dust masks, gas masks, air supply masks, self-contained respirators, evacuation and rescue products, protective clothing, protective gloves, soundproof protective equipment, protective glasses, N95 masks and other products. The Company is also engaged in the agency sale of self-contained respirators, as well as the maintenance, inspection and repair of various protective equipment.

name: TAOKA CHEMICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: TAOKA CHEMICAL COMPANY, LIMITED is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the chemical business. The Company is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceutical intermediates, agricultural chemicals intermediates, electronic components materials, resin raw materials, dyes and other fine chemicals, adhesives, rubber additives and other functional chemical materials, processed resins, varnishes and other functional resins, as well as plasticizers, methyl esters and other chemical products. The Company is also engaged in the chemical analysis contract business.

name: DCM HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: DCM Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based holding company that is mainly engaged in the home center business. The Company is engaged in the management of all Company-wide businesses. It consists of two business segments. The Home Improvement segment is engaged in the home improvement center business. The X-Price segment is engaged in the e-commerce (EC) business.
