The shared point service business is engaged in the operation of the point service.

name: WILLTEC CO LTD
businessSummary: WILLTEC Co.,Ltd. is engaged in the manufacturing support business, construction support business and EMS business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Manufacturing Support segment is mainly engaged in the manufacturing contracting and dispatching business, the mechanical and electrical engineer dispatching business, and the repair service business. The Construction Support segment conducts construction engineer dispatching business. The EMS segment includes contract manufacturing and electronic parts wholesale. The other businesses include support for the disabled, livestock industry business and overseas businesses.

name: TOBISHIMA CORP
businessSummary: Tobishima Holdings Inc manages the business of group companies and performs related business. Through subsidiaries, the Company is engaged in construction and development business. The construction business is mainly engaged in general construction business with civil engineering and architectural business, and through subsidiaries, it is engaged in construction work orders, earthquake reinforcement design, manufacturing and sales of materials, civil engineering work and diving work. The development business is engaged in real estate development, sales and rental, and through subsidiaries, it is also engaged in insurance agency business, boat sales, insurance and repair, real estate sales, rental and brokerage, real estate sales agency, information technology (IT) system development and maintenance, and through affiliated companies, it is engaged in digital transformation (DX) total support business.

name: C.S. LUMBER CO INC
businessSummary: C.S. LUMBER CO., INC is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the pre-cut business and other businesses. The Company mainly operates in three business segments. The Pre-cut segment is engaged in the pre-cut processing of lumbers, design of two-by-four method, as well as the manufacture and distribution of panels. The Construction Contracting segment is engaged in the construction contracting of wooden detached houses and wooden general buildings. The Real Estate Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing and management of real estates. The other business is engaged in the development and sale of detached houses.

name: DIC CORP
businessSummary: DIC Corp is a Japan-based Company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of printing inks, organic pigments, and synthetic resins. The Company operates three business segments. The Packaging & Graphics segment manufactures and sells gravure inks, offset inks, newspaper inks, jet inks, and polystyrene. The Color & Display segment manufactures and sells organic pigments, liquid crystal materials, and health care food products. The Functional Products segment manufactures and sells acrylic resins, urethane resins, epoxy resins, PPS compounds, and industrial tapes.

name: CHIYODA CO LTD
businessSummary: Chiyoda Co Ltd is primarily engaged in the retail and wholesale of footwear. The Company operates in two business segments. The Shoes segment is engaged in retail and wholesale of shoes. The Clothing segment is engaged in the retail of clothing. Stores include TOKYO SHOES RETAILING CENTER, SHOE PLAZA, CHIYODA HAKI-GOKOCHI, Chiyoda, cloverleaf, SPC. The brands include HYDRO-TECH, CEDAR CREST, Bio Fitter, Cristiano Rossani, fuwaraku, cloverleaf, ChiffonFit, KIREI WALK, FILA, be GAIA, Regent Street, Shutte, ELLE SPORT, McGREGOR, TEXACO, OCEAN PACIFIC, Yukiko Kimijima, Zipper, SAVOY, GERRY COSBY, SURPLUS, reyn spooner and AMERICANINO EDWIN.

name: A&A MATERIAL CORP
businessSummary: A&A Material Corporation is primarily engaged in manufacture and sale of building materials and various industrial products. The Company operates in two business segments. The Construction and Building Materials segment provides non-combustible materials and design and construction work, two-layer tubes, and design and construction work of steel frame refractory coating. The Industrials Products and Engineering segment manufactures and sells non-combustible textiles, equipment and materials for vessels, sound insulating materials, expansion joints and others, friction materials, seal materials, heat insulating materials, and design and construction work of thermal insulation, cold insulation, air conditioning, heat insulation, sound insulation, fireproofing. Additionally, the Company is also involved in real estate rental business.

name: POWDERTECH CO LTD
businessSummary: Powdertech Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells powder products, such as ferrite powder and iron powder products, as well as oxygen scavengers. The Company operates in two business segments. The Carrier segment manufactures and sells electrophotography carrier for copy machine and printer industry. The Iron Powder segment manufactures and sells various iron powder for powder metallurgy use, as well as oxygen scavenger and oxygen sensing agents for food industry. The Company also engages in logistics services related to their business and purchases raw materials through non-consolidated subsidiaries and other affiliated companies.

name: GRANTOMATO CO LTD
businessSummary: Grantomato Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the agri solution business. For store sales, the Company carries out a multi-store retail business of Grantomato stores that sell agricultural materials, agricultural equipment, agricultural materials such as pesticides, fertilizers and direct products, and FOODMART stores that sell groceries. There are two types of FOODMART stores: business supermarkets and FOODMART Grantomato. At FOODMART Grantomato, based on the purchasing network the Company builds a food mart system that is operated by focusing on pursuing originality, such as promoting sales of private brand products developed. For agricultural distribution, the Company cultivates rice, mandarin oranges, seed garlic, potatoes, tomatoes, cucumbers, eggplant seedlings, and flower seedlings through direct transactions with agricultural producers. For Fukushima Distribution Center (FDC) and Internet sales, the Company operates e-commerce business to provide products.

name: TOKYO ENERGY & SYSTEMS INC
businessSummary: TOKYO ENERGY & SYSTEMS INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in design and construction of electric power facilities and general electric facilities. The facility construction business is engaged in the construction and maintenance of thermal power generation facilities, nuclear power generation facilities, hydroelectric power generation facilities and solar power generation facilities, as well as the design and construction of substation facilities, general electric facilities, information communication facilities, and air conditioning equipment. The Company also involves in leasing and management of real estate, leasing and rental of tools, fixtures and vehicles, as well as provision of insurance agency business.

name: DAIKEN CORP
businessSummary: DAIKEN CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of eco-friendly materials, wooden interior building materials and housing equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The Materials segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of eco-friendly materials including insulation boards, die lawn, die light, medium-density fiberboard, tatami mats, eco-boards. The Building Materials segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of wooden interior building materials and housing equipment. The Engineering segment is engaged in interior construction of buildings, condominiums and stores, renovation and repair of houses, as well as apartment renovation business. The Company is also engaged in the purchase and sale of products such as plywood.

name: HI-LEX CORP
businessSummary: Hi-Lex Corp is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of control cables and accessories for the remote operation of motorcycles and automobiles, industrial equipment, residential equipment and ships. The Company has six geographical segments: Japan, North America (United States and Mexico), China, Asia (mainly South Korea, Indonesia and India), South America and Europe (United Kingdom, Hungary, Russia, Germany) based on the production and sales systems. The Japan segment is also engaged in the production and sale of medical equipment, besides control systems. The Europe segment is also engaged in the design, sale, purchasing and testing of western manufacturers for global models besides control systems.

name: GLTECHNO HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: GLtechno Holdings Inc is engaged in the management of its subsidiaries and group companies. Through its subsidiary, the Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of analytical equipment related products, semiconductor related products, and contactless integrated circuit (IC) card related products, and the purchase and sale of similar products, related research and development, and the provision of technical services. The subsidiary is engaged in the analytical equipment business, which develops, manufactures gas chromatograph and liquid chromatograph equipment, the semiconductor business, which manufactures quartz jigs and materials for semiconductors, optical polishing, and quartz cells for spectrophotometers, and the automatic recognition business, which develops, manufactures, and sells peripheral devices using contactless IC cards. Through its another subsidiary, the Company is also engaged in the manufacture and purchase of quartz products for semiconductors.

name: YOKOHAMA RUBBER CO LTD
businessSummary: Yokohama Rubber Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of tires for cars and other automotive products. The Company operates through two business segments. The tire business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of tires, tubes, aluminum wheels, and automotive accessories for passenger cars, trucks and buses, light trucks, agricultural machinery, construction vehicles, industrial vehicles, and forestry equipment. The multiple business (MB) segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of conveyor belts, various hoses, fenders, oil fences, marine hoses, and aviation parts. The Company is also engaged in the provision of sporting goods and information processing services.

name: TOSO CO LTD
businessSummary: TOSO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of interior decoration products. The Interior Decoration-related segment is engaged in the manufacture, purchase and sale of interior products including curtain rails, interior blinds, roll screens, roman shades and accordion-type partitions. The others business is engaged in the sale of nursing care products and plastic chains, the inventory management, packing, packaging and forwarding of interior products, as well as the non-life insurance agency business.

name: K'S HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: K'S Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the operation of electronics retail stores, providing home appliances, computers, computer peripheral equipment and mobile phones. The Company mainly provides electronic products, petroleum equipment, gas equipment, cooling and heating machines, watches, cameras, measuring equipment, medical equipment, communication equipment, education equipment, office equipment, computers and mobile phones, and others. The Company is also involved in the general freight vehicle transportation business and electrical construction business.

name: NIPPON STEEL CORP
businessSummary: Nippon Steel Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the steel manufacturing business, engineering business, chemical & material business and system solution business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Steel Manufacturing segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of steel products. The Engineering segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial machinery and equipment, steel structures, contracting of construction work, waste treatment and reclamation, and supply of electricity, gas, heat. The Chemical and Materials segment manufactures and sells coal chemical products, petrochemical products, electronic materials, semiconductor and electronic component materials and components, carbon fiber and composite materials, and fabricated metal products. The System Solution segment provides engineering and consulting services related to computer systems, outsourcing services using information technology, and various other services.

name: MRT INC
businessSummary: MRT Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of medical information platform based on Internet. The Medical Information Platform Business segment consists of medical human resources services and others. The medical human resources services include part-time and full-time physician introductions for physicians, mainly through physician referral websites, and part-time job introductions, career change introductions, and temporary placement services for nurses, pharmacists, clinical technologists, clinical engineering technologists, and radiology technologists, who are referred to as co-medicals. Others include provision of groupware to support medical office operations, provision of online medical treatment and health consultation services, provision of marketing and product development by physicians, publishing services, pharmaceutical promotion support for physicians, operation of registration and reception centers, and well-being services.

name: OKAYAMA PAPER INDUSTRIES CO LTD
businessSummary: Okayama Paper Industries CO., Ltd. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of paper boards and decorative paper boards. The Company operates through two business segments. The Paper Boards segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of inner base paper used for manufacturing of cardboards, and base paper cores used for papers, clothes, cellophanes, tapes threads and others. The Decorative Paper Boards segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of packaging and gift boxes for fruits and vegetables, food, electrical appliances and others. The Company is also engaged in the sale of products.

name: PUNCH INDUSTRY CO LTD
businessSummary: PUNCH INDUSTRY CO., LTD. is principally engaged in the manufacture and distribution of molds. The Company's main products are comprised of plastic molds, which are used for the manufacture of plastic products, such as the outer frame of digital cameras and mobile phones, as well as pressed molds, which are manufactured by pressing machinery. The main products manufactured by the Company include sprue bushings, gate bushings, ejector pins and other plastic molds, as well as guide bushes for die sets, punches, stripper guides and other pressed molds.

name: RYOYO RYOSAN HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Ryoyo Ryosan Holdings Inc is a Japan-based trading company mainly engaged in the purchasing and sales of devices and information and communication technology (ICT) products in the electronics field. The Company is engaged in the sales of devices, ICT products, and embedded products to domestic and foreign electronic equipment manufacturers and electronic equipment users. The Company is engaged in the operation of the device business, which sells semiconductors and electronic components, and the solution business, which sells information technology (IT) equipment. The Company is also engaged in the provision of design, development, technical support and other services, and development of solutions related to the above.

name: FREEBIT CO LTD
businessSummary: FreeBit Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly provides internet-related services primarily to businesses and individuals, leveraging its strengths in accumulated technical expertise such as developing core internet technologies and operating large-scale systems. It conducts business through three segments. The 5G Infrastructure Support segment provides business support services for Internet Service Providers (ISPs), mobile virtual network operator business support (MVNE) services, and cloud services for corporations. The 5G Lifestyle Support segment offers mobile communication services for individuals, internet connectivity services for individuals, internet connectivity services for apartment complexes, real estate-related services, and Web3-related platforms. The Corporate & Creator 5G Digital Transformation (DX) Support segment provides internet marketing services, ad technology services, and support platforms for creators. It also engages in startup investment and incubation.

name: NICHIWA SANGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: NICHIWA SANGYO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of mixed feed products with grains as the main ingredients, and other livestock products. The Company operates in two business segments. The Feed segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of mixed feed products for broilers, pigs, beef cattle, dairy cows, fishes, ducks, ostriches and rabbits, as well as the purchase and sale of livestock products. The Livestock Products segment is engaged in the production and sale of livestock products, the production of piglets, as well as the rearing and sale of pigs.

name: CHANGE HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Change Holdings Inc is a Japan-based holding company primarily engaged in the NEW- information technology (IT) transformation business and public tech business. The Company operates through two business segments. The NEW-IT Transformation Business segment is divided into the areas of resolving labor shortages and cybersecurity and provides solutions that bring about change to the business operations and business models of Japanese companies through new technologies and digital human resource development, improving productivity and added value, as well as internet security services. The Public Tech Business segment is divided into the regional revitalization and public digital transformation (DX) areas and provides platform business for hometown tax donations and solutions for government agencies.

name: JTEKT CORP
businessSummary: JTEKT Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of products related to the automotive, industrial machinery and bearings, and machine tools businesses. It operates its business through three segments. The Automotive segment manufactures and sells products for the automotive industry, including steering and driveline components such as electric power steering, hydraulic power steering, and electronically controlled 4WD couplings. The Industrial Machinery & Bearings segment manufactures and sells bearings for industrial machinery such as roller bearings, ball bearings, and bearing units. The Machine Tools segment manufactures and sells machine tools such as grinding machines, machining centers, cutting machines, control devices, and industrial heat treatment furnaces.

name: KEL CORP
businessSummary: KEL CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of connectors, racks, sockets and others. The connector business is involved in the manufacture and sale of connectors for electrical connection and disconnection between mounted printed circuit boards, devices, and between devices in electronic and electrical devices such as industrial devices and imaging devices. The socket business is involved in the manufacture and sale of integrated circuits (IC) sockets for IC into printed circuit boards. The rack business is involved in the manufacture and sale of racks that systematize storage of control boards and peripheral devices. The harness business is involved in the manufacture and sale of harnesses that connect connectors and cables.

name: H2O RETAILING CORP
businessSummary: H2O Retailing Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the department store business, food business, commercial facility business and other businesses. The Company operates through four business segments. The Department Store Business segment is engaged in the operation of department stores, mainly selling clothing, personal items, household goods, and food products. The Food Business segment is engaged in the operation of food supermarkets, as well as food manufacturing, food purchasing agency business, and individual home delivery business. The Commercial Facility Business segment is engaged in the rental management of commercial real estate, the operation of commercial facilities, the management of hotels, the maintenance and management of building facilities, and other businesses. The Other Businesses segment is involved in interior construction work, friendship associations, temporary staffing, restaurants, information processing services and other businesses.

name: INUI GLOBAL LOGISTICS CO LTD
businessSummary: Inui Global Logistics Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the overseas shipping business, warehousing and transportation business, and real estate business. It operates through three segments. The Overseas Shipping segment transports cargo by ship (operated by the Company) and provides time charter services to charterers (competitors). The Warehousing and Transportation segment is engaged in the warehousing business, including general warehousing and storage of duty-unpaid import and export cargo with permission from a bonded warehouse, the document storage business, which stores document boxes and fixtures in warehouses certified by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, and the freight transportation business, including the transportation of cargo deposited in warehouses and moving services. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the facility leasing business, renting out owned houses and offices.

name: NSK LTD
businessSummary: NSK Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of bearings, automobile-related products and precision machinery products. The Company operates in two business segments. The Industrial Machinery Business segment manufactures and sells bearings, precision equipment-related products, condition monitoring systems, and other products for general industry. The Automotive Business segment manufactures and sells bearings, automatic transmission parts, and other products for automobile and automobile parts manufacturers. Major products include ball bearings, hub unit bearings, tapered roller bearings, ball screws, linear guides, condition monitoring systems, and components for automatic transmissions. The Company also manufactures and sells steel balls and machinery and equipment.

name: NOK CORP
businessSummary: NOK Corp is a company principally involved in the manufacture and sale of sealing materials and flexible circuit boards. The Company operates in four business segments. The Seal segment manufactures and sells seal products mainly for the automobile industry, construction machinery industry, and general industrial machinery industry. The Electronic Component segment manufactures and sells electronic parts and others for the electronic equipment industry. The Roll segment manufactures and sells products for the office machine industry. The Others segment manufactures and sells special lubricants.

name: KYOEI SECURITY SERVICE CO LTD
businessSummary: Kyoei Security Service Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly providing security service. The Company’s Security Service segment includes service on facility and patrol security field as well as service on crowd control and traffic guard field. The facility and patrol security field includes services such as facility security service, reception/concierge service, parking lot security service and airport fire service. The crowd control and traffic guard field includes services like traffic guarding security service, event security service and highway security service. Other businesses include bodyguard service, parking lot management service, apartment management service, building and facility management service, among others.

name: MEIHO ENTERPRISE CO LTD
businessSummary: MEIHO ENTERPRISE CO., Ltd. is mainly engaged in the real estate business. The Real Estate Allotment Sale segment is engaged in the allotment sale of condominiums developed by the Company, the renovation and sale of pre-owned condominiums, the development of attached house and town house, as well as the allotment sale of properties as its joint venture business. The Real Estate Leasing segment leases condominiums and buildings. The Real Estate Brokerage segment is involved in the brokerage business of land for condominium use, as well as other brokerage businesses. The Others segment provides real estate leasing-related services, such as the acquisition of construction management fee and other various consulting reward.

name: HYOJITO CO LTD
businessSummary: HYOJITO Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the installation and operation of advertisements for guide maps around each station, as well as the general advertising agency business that handles traffic advertisements and outdoor advertisements. The Company operates in three business segments. The Navigator segment provides joint advertisement based on the self-developed peripheral guide map installed at railway stations and tram stops nationwide, municipal offices such as city halls, police boxes, police stations, driver's license examination sites. The AD Promotion segment provides advertisements using transportation media including inside cars and station premises, mass media including TV, radio, newspapers, magazines, as well as outdoor media including signboards and boards. The Sign segment provides services from planning and design of advertisements, signboards, information boards to construction by utilizing the network of railway companies, local governments.

name: PACIFIC INDUSTRIAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Pacific Industrial Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the press and resin products business and the valve products business. It operates through two segments. The Press and Resin Products segment manufactures and sells press and resin products and mold products for automobiles. The Valve Products segment manufactures and sells tire valves and valve core products, valve-related products, automotive tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS) products, compressor-related products, and electronic equipment products. In addition, the Company is also engaged in the development, sale, and provision of services for internet of things (IoT) products and applications, the use of recycled materials, the development and sale of upcycled products such as recyclable products, and the provision of non-life insurance agency services.

name: SHINMAYWA INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: ShinMaywa Industries Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of special-purpose vehicles. The Company operates five business segments. The Special-purpose Vehicles segment manufactures and sells special-purpose vehicles such as dump trucks, tailgate lifters, and garbage trucks, as well as forestry machinery. The Parking Systems segment manufactures, sells, maintains, and repairs mechanical parking facilities and aircraft passenger boarding bridges. The Industrial and Environmental Systems segment manufactures and sells automatic wire processors, vacuum products, and waste disposal facilities and equipment. The Fluids segment manufactures and sells pumps and water treatment-related products. The Aircraft segment manufactures and sells flying boats and aircraft parts for overseas aircraft manufacturers. The Company also engages in construction, real estate, and software businesses.

name: SUMITOMO OSAKA CEMENT CO LTD
businessSummary: Sumitomo Osaka Cement Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the cement business. The Company has seven business segments. The Cement segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cement and ready-mixed concrete products, the sale of electric power, the processing of recycled raw fuel. The Mineral Products segment is engaged in the provision of limestone, dolomite and aggregate products. The Construction Material segment is engaged in the provision of concrete structure repair materials and admixtures. The Optoelectronics segment is engaged in the provision of optical communication components and optical measurement equipment. The New Materials segment is engaged in the provision of ceramic products, nanoparticle materials and functional paints. The Battery Materials segment is engaged in the provision of secondary battery cathode materials. The Other segment is engaged in the real estate leasing business, engineering business and software development business.

name: TORISHIMA PUMP MFG CO LTD
businessSummary: Torishima Pump Mfg Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacturing and sales of various pumps, pump plants, environmental equipment, small hydroelectric power generation facilities, mechanical seals, and other pump-related equipment, as well as installation work, services, and electricity supply operations. The pump business primarily involves the manufacture and sale of pumps, pump plants, mechanical seals, and other pump-related equipment, as well as installation work and services. The environmental and new energy business primarily involves the manufacture and sale of environmental equipment, the planning, manufacture, and sale of recycled products from various types of waste, and the sale, installation work, and services for small hydroelectric power generation equipment, along with electricity supply services.

name: SUN FRONTIER FUDOUSAN CO LTD
businessSummary: Sun Frontier Fudousan Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based real estate company. The Company operates in four business segments. The Real Estate Revitalization segment is engaged in the re-planning business, including the remodeling of commercial properties; the building leasing business, as well as the real estate securitization business and the asset management business. The Brokerage segment offers sales brokerage services for commercial buildings and condominiums, and leasing brokerage services for offices and stores. The Property Management segment is involved in the operation of general properties management businesses, and the provision of cleaning, security and maintenance services. The Others segment is engaged in the construction planning business, such as the renovation planning, repair and renovation of commercial real estate, offices and condominiums, as well as the delinquent rent guarantee business. On September 9, 2014, it sold a building in Tokyo.

name: UPR CORP
businessSummary: UPR Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in rental and sales of pallets and other distribution equipment. The Company operates two segments. The Distribution segment is engaged in rental and sales of wooden and plastic pallets, metal distribution equipment such as nesting racks and basket cars, assist suits, other distribution equipment and related products. The Connected segment is engaged in rental and sales of location information solutions, services for remote monitoring solutions, rental and sales of related equipment, management, rental, sales and operation of car sharing business.

name: GOODPATCH INC
businessSummary: Goodpatch Inc conducts business activities with the aim of making people's lives more convenient and easier through design. The Company operates in two business segments. The Design Partner provides experience design (UI / UX) design support, and UX designers and UI designers design projects for client companies (clients) who mainly want to advance the design development of digital products such as websites and smartphone applications. It carries out the design process while leading the way and support the realization of the UI / UX design that client companies really need. The Design Platform segment is engaged in the support of UI / UX design support provided by the design partner business from various aspects. It supports the process from the effective use of design to the release as a product from the viewpoint of software, in-house design personnel, and design business environment, and functions as a platform that supports the design partner business.

name: ATOM LIVIN TECH CO LTD
businessSummary: ATOM LIVIN TECH Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the planning, development and distribution of interior hardware products which focuses on furniture hardware and architectural hardware products. The Company sells its products to house makers, housing facility and equipment makers, architectural material manufacturers and architectural hardware stores under the brand name ATOM. The Company operates its business as a fabless manufacturer. The Company is engaged in the provision of door locks, hinges, sliding hinges, hinged doors, sliding door locks, sliding door hardware products, overhead hanging sliding door fittings, moving partition fittings, folding door fittings, indoor aluminum fittings, handles, slide rails, wire baskets, storage and hanging brackets and others. The Company is also engaged in the real estate leasing business.

name: SEKISUI JUSHI CORP
businessSummary: Sekisui Jushi Corporation is a Japan-based manufacturing company mainly engaged in the transportation and landscape related products, sports facilities related products, living and construction products, integrated logistics materials related products business. The Company operates in two segments. The Public segment manufactures, processes and sells soundproof wall materials, traffic safety products, signs, thermal insulation pavement, protective fence, high field, shelter, artificial turf and others. The Private segment manufactures, process and sells mesh fences, artificial timber, meta color building materials, aluminum resin laminated composite boards, packaging bands, stretch films and others.

name: GREENS CO LTD
businessSummary: GREENS CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of hotel and restaurant, as well as the other related businesses. The Company operates through two businesses. Choice hotels business is involved in the operation of the brand hotel named Comfort which is a hotel specializing in accommodation to cities designated by government ordinances nationwide. Greens hotels business is involved in the development of the hotels tailored to local characteristics, from hotels with banquet halls and restaurants to accommodation-specific hotels. The Compnay is also involved in the rental business and real estate management business.

name: KIMOTO CO LTD
businessSummary: KIMOTO CO., LTD. is a manufacturer of films. The Company has four segments, including Japan, North America, East Asia and Europe. Through its segments, it is involved in the development of processing technologies for surface treatment on films, the manufacture and sale of various industrial materials, the sale of geographic information system (GIS)-related software, the provision of outsourced data processing services, as well as the contracting business of aerial photograph processing and duplication of drawings.

name: TAKEDA MACHINERY CO LTD
businessSummary: TAKEDA MACHINERY CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of shaped steel processing machines and circular saw machines for the processing of steel frames, steel materials, sheet metals and others. The Machine Tools Related segment is engaged in the development, design, manufacture and sale of shaped steel processing machines such as small shaped steel processing machines, flat plate drilling machines, H-shaped steel drilling machines and steel plate processing machines, as well as circular saw machines such as shaped steel cutting machines, unprocessed steel cutting machines and pipe cutting machines. The Company is also engaged in the provide after-sales services, as well as the purchase and sale of stamping dies.

name: A.D.WORKS GROUP CO LTD
businessSummary: A.D.Works Group Co.,Ltd. is mainly engaged in the management of the business of group companies and other related operations as a holding company. Through a wholly owned subsidiary and its affiliated companies, the Company operates two businesses, including profitable real estate sales business and stock-type fee business. The profitable real estate sales business seeks out and raises properties with high profitability, and operates the business through the process of property selection, purchase, value increasing and sales, centering on residential real estate with less than 500 million yen per building. The stock-type fee business supports all aspects of the management of real estate properties, and provides property management, real estate effective utilization consulting and real estate appraisal due diligence.

name: SLOGAN INC
businessSummary: Slogan Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the human resources creation business in new industrial areas. The Company develops business in the carrier service field and software as a service (SaaS) field. In the career service field, The Company operates a carefully selected job-hunting platform Goodfind for new graduate students, operates a consulting job hunting platform Fact Logic for new graduate students and provides job-hunting services that specialize in foreign-affiliated and Japanese consulting firms, operates a long-term intern referral platform for students, Intern Street, which specializing in recruiting start-ups and venture companies. In the media and SaaS field, The Company operates FastGrow, a business media for young innovation human resources that provides services that support recruitment public relations, branding, and service recognition of companies in new industrial fields, operates a SaaS-type human resources service TeamUp.

name: INTEGRATED DESIGN & ENGINEERING HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Integrated Design & Engineering Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the consulting business related to civil engineering and construction, urban space development such as urban planning and architectural design. The Company operates three businesses. Consulting business is engaged in research, planning, evaluation, and design of rivers and water resources, water supply and sewerage, agricultural and rural development, dams and power generation, traffic and transportation, urban and regional development in Japan and overseas. Urban spatial business is engaged in business composition, planning, design, and operation in the formation of urban spaces. Energy business is engaged in the manufacture and sale of power equipment and control devices, and planning and design of mechanical and electrical equipment and communication facilities.

name: NAKANISHI MFG CO LTD
businessSummary: NAKANISHI MFG.CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in manufacture and sale business of the commercial kitchen equipment and the real estate leasing business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Commercial Kitchen Equipment Manufacture and Sale segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of commercial kitchen equipment for group canteens such as school canteens of school, hospital and company. The main products of this segment include dishwasher, rice cooker and tableware disinfection storage machines. The Company is also engaged in shipping of products from the Nara plant to the users. The Real Estate Leasing segment is engaged in operation of office rental and parking lot rental for business persons.

name: ADR ON HONDA MOTOR CO LTD
businessSummary: Honda Motor Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the motorcycle business, the automobile business, the financial service business and the life creation business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Motorcycle segment is engaged in the research and development, production and sale of motorcycles, all-terrain vehicles (ATVs), side-by-side vehicles and related parts. The Automobile segment is engaged in the research and development, production and sale of automobiles and related parts. The Financial Service segment is engaged in the sales financing and leasing of its products. The Power Products and Other Business segment is engaged in the research and development, production and sale of power products and related parts.

name: NODA CORP
businessSummary: NODA CORPORATION is primarily engaged in manufacturing and selling housing materials and plywood. The Company operates in two segments. The Housing Materials segment manufactures and sells interior materials, housing equipment and fiberboards, and provides house-related works. The Plywood segment imports, manufactures and sells plywood.

name: LONSEAL CORP
businessSummary: LONSEAL CORPORATION is principally engaged in the processing and sale of synthetic resins. The Company operates in two business segments. The Synthetic Resin Processed Products segment provides architectural flooring materials, waterproofing materials, housing materials, wall covering materials, vehicle flooring materials, film bases, various waterproofing works. The Real Estate Leasing segment is involved in the leasing of shopping center facilities.

name: CAVE INTERACTIVE CO LTD
businessSummary: Cave Interactive Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and operation of mobile online games, the provision of support and management services for Internet video distributors, and the multi-channel network business. The Interactive segment is engaged in the development and operation of games for mobiles and computers such as Do Don Pachi Dai Fukkatsu, Death Smiles, Mushihimesama, Akai Katana and others, as well as the provision of live distribution services.

name: SATO SHO-JI CORP
businessSummary: SATO SHO-JI CORPORATION is a company primarily engaged in the metal business. The Company operates in five business segments. The Steel and Iron segment sells common steel, such as surface-treated steel plates, cold-rolled steel, pickling steel, hot-rolled steel and steel bars, special steel, such as structural carbon steel, structural alloyed steel, and tool steel, as well as architectural materials and equipment, among others. The Non-Ferrous Metal segment sells aluminum, zinc, metal silicon and copper alloy, among others. The Electronic Materials segment sells electrical materials such as laminated sheets for printed circuit boards (PCBs) and others. The Life Operation segment sells tableware, such as Western-style tableware and others. The Machinery and Tools segment sells machine tools, factory line kits, cutting tools, grinding wheels and working tools, among others.

name: INPEX CORP
businessSummary: Inpex Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in oil and natural gas (O&G) operations, primarily in the exploration, development, production, and marketing of oil and natural gas globally, as well as investments and loans to companies engaged in these activities. The Company operates through two segments. The Domestic O&G segment is involved in the Minaminagaoka gas field and the Naoetsu liquefied natural gas (LNG) terminal. The Overseas O&G segment is involved in the Ichthys Project, including Ichthys in Australia and surrounding exploration, as well as other projects in Australia (excluding Ichthys), Southeast Asia, Europe, Abu Dhabi. The Company also conducts the Net Zero5 field, transportation and marketing business, and civil engineering business.

name: GROWTH XPARTNERS INC
businessSummary: Growth xPartners Inc, formerly Growth X Partners Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the enterprise digital transformation (DX) business. The enterprise DX business includes the DX promotion support business, the DX support product and service business, and the digital service co-creation business. The DX promotion support business provides comprehensive support, including consulting and application development and cloud utilization, to help customers realize business transformation. The DX support product and service business sells products and services to support customers in promoting DX and earns scalable revenues through license revenues. The digital service co-creation business co-creates digital services to expand customers' businesses and increase revenues. The customers are enterprise companies that are leading companies in various industries, such as healthcare, retail and distribution, mobility, communications, construction, manufacturing, and finance.

name: OKAMOTO MACHINE TOOL WORKS LTD
businessSummary: Okamoto Machine Tool Works Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the machine tool business and the semiconductor-related equipment business. It operates through two business segments. The Machine Tool Business segment manufactures and sells grinding machines including surface grinders, form grinders, cylindrical grinders, internal grinders, gear grinders, dedicated and special grinders, and grinding processing peripheral equipment, precision gears, and castings. The Semiconductor-related Equipment Business segment mainly manufactures and sells back grinders, polishing machines, lapping machines, slicing machines, and ingot grinders.

name: MITSUI HIGH-TEC INC
businessSummary: Mitsui High-tec Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of molds and machine tools, electronic components, and electrical components. The Company conducts business through three segments. The Molds and Machine Tools segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of press dies and surface grinders, and other products. The Electronic Components segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of lead frames, and other products. The Electrical Components segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of motor core products, and other products.

name: NITTOC CONSTRUCTION CO LTD
businessSummary: Nittoc Construction Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the construction industry. Through its subsidiaries, it engages in civil engineering and materials sales, with the Company handling procurement of materials and other supplies. Focusing on specialized and special construction projects, it contributes to the development of comprehensive social infrastructure. It undertakes construction of roads, bridges, dams and power transmission networks supplying electricity, as well as water supply and sewerage systems handling large volumes of stormwater.

name: FURUKAWA CO LTD
businessSummary: Furukawa Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the industrial machinery business, rock drill business and other businesses. The Company operates in seven segments. The Industrial Machinery segment manufactures, sells, and provides services for pumps, steel structures, bridges, crushers, pulverizers and others. The Rock Drill segment provides rock drills, including hydraulic breakers, crushers, blasthole drills, tunneling and mining machinery and others. The UNIC segment provides UNIC cranes, mini crawler cranes and others. The Metal segment provides copper, gold, silver, sulfuric acid, limestone and others. The Electronic segment provides high-purity metallic arsenic, crystal products, aluminum nitride ceramics and others. The Chemical segment manufactures and sells crystal products, polyferric sulfate solution, and others. The Real Estate segment rents, buys, sells, and brokers real estate. The Company is also engaged in metal powder, casting and transportation businesses.

name: AKATSUKI INC
businessSummary: Akatsuki Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the mobile game business and live experience (LX) business in the entertainment area. The Company has a single segment of the mobile game business. The Mobile Game business is engaged in the provision of mobile games in the platform operated by Japan social networking service (SNS) operator, as well as app market provided by Apple Inc., Google Inc. and other companies.

name: KAKEN PHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Kaken Pharmaceutical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the pharmaceutical and real estate businesses. The Company has two business segments. The Pharmaceutical Business segment is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals, medical equipment, and agricultural chemicals. The Real Estate Business segment is primarily engaged in the rental of real estate related to Bunkyo Green Court.

name: MITSUI CHEMICALS INC
businessSummary: Mitsui Chemicals Inc is engaged in life and healthcare solutions, mobility solutions, information and communication technology (ICT) solutions, and basic and green materials business. The Company operates in four business segments. Life and Healthcare Solutions segment manufactures and sells vision materials, nonwoven fabrics, oral care materials, personal care materials and agricultural chemicals. The Mobility Solutions segment manufactures and sells elastomers, functional compounds and polypropylene compounds, and supports the development of new products for industrial products. The ICT Solutions segment manufactures and sells semiconductor and electronic component process materials, optical materials, lithium-ion battery materials, next-generation battery materials and others. The Basic and Green Materials segment manufactures and sells ethylene, propylene, polyethylene, polypropylene, catalysts, phenols, high-purity terephthalic acid, polyethylene terephthalate resin and others.

name: ENDO MANUFACTURING CO LTD
businessSummary: ENDO MANUFACTURING CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sales of operating golf club heads, stainless products and forging parts. The Company operates in three segments. The Golf segment is engaged in the planning, development, manufacture and sale of golf club heads, as well as the assembly of golf clubs. The Stainless segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of stainless metal sleeves for office automation (OA) equipment and others. The Automobile Forging Part segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of forging components for automobiles and others.

name: NASU DENKI TEKKO CO LTD
businessSummary: Nasu Denki Tekko Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of products related to the electric power and telecommunications infrastructure business and the transportation infrastructure business. The Company operates two business segments. The Electric Power and Telecommunications Infrastructure Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of steel towers and steel structures, steel pipe columns, overhead line materials, and information and telecommunications materials, as well as telecommunications tower facility construction. The Transportation Infrastructure Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of transportation system materials, road equipment construction, underground line equipment construction, and hot-dip galvanizing wage processing.

name: DKK CO LTD
businessSummary: DKK Co Ltd, formerly Denki Kogyo Co Ltd is a company mainly engaged in the electric communication- and high frequency-related business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Electric Communication segment is engaged in the manufacture, construction and sale of various antennas, reflector plates, steel towers and steel structures, plating processing of various telecommunications equipment and steel frames, as well as construction of electric communication facilities. The High Frequency-related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of high frequency induction heating equipment, various high-frequency power supplies for plasma, as well as processing of High-frequency heat treatment. The Company is also involved in the equipment lending business and solar power distribution business.

name: NITTO KOHKI CO LTD
businessSummary: NITTO KOHKI CO., LTD. is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of quick-connecting fuild couplings, machine tools and others. The Company operates in four business segments. The Quick-connecting Fluid Couplings segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of quick-connecting fluid couplings. The Machine Tools segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of machine tools. The Linear Motor Driven Pumps segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of linear motor driven pumps. The Construction Machinery segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of construction machinery.

name: ARTNATURE INC
businessSummary: ARTNATURE INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of custom-made wigs. The Company operates in three business segments. The Men’s business segment is engaged in the provision of custom-made wigs and other products and services to male customers. The Women’s business segment is engaged in the provision of customized wigs and other products and services to female customers. The Women’s Ready-Made business segment is engaged in the provision of ready-made wigs and other products and services to female customers.

name: LIFULL CO LTD
businessSummary: LIFULL Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of real estate related information services. The Company has two business segments. The HOME’S Related segment is engaged in the operation of the real estate information Website LIFULL HOME'S, the advertising agency business, the system development and Web production business, the provision of customer relationship management (CRM) services for real estate companies, and data management platform (DMP) service for developers, as well as the Internet marketing business. The Overseas segment is engaged in the operation of the aggregation site Trovit and overseas real estate information sites. The Company is also engaged in the operation of a series of Websites for nursing facilities searching, insurance shops searching and reservation, moving estimate and reservation, rental storage space information searching, as well as the insurance agency business and other businesses.

name: SUMITOMO HEAVY INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: Sumitomo Heavy Industries Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of general heavy machinery. It has four business segments. Mechatronics segment provides transmissions, motors, inverters, laser processing systems and precision positioning devices, and operates in North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, China and Japan. Industrial Machinery segment provides plastic processing machinery, cryogenic freezers, accelerators, medical machinery and equipment, forging presses and others in Japan, North America and Europe. Logistics & Construction segment provides hydraulic excavators and road machinery, construction cranes, transport and loading machinery, logistics systems, parking systems and forklifts in Japan, China, Indonesia and North America. Energy & Lifeline segment provides boilers and air pollution control equipment, water treatment equipment, industrial turbines and pumps, reaction vessels, food machinery and ships. It also has real estate, software and other business.

name: SEIKITOKYU KOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Seikitokyu Kogyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the construction business, mainly paving and civil engineering, as well as the manufacture and sale of paving materials. It operates through two business segments. The Construction segment is involved in paving, civil engineering, and other general construction work. The Paving Materials Manufacturing and Sales segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of paving materials such as asphalt mixtures. It is also involved in the electricity sales business, construction machinery sale business, and automobile leasing business.

name: NAGASE & CO LTD
businessSummary: Nagase & Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the import, export, manufacture and sale of a wide range of products. The Company operates through five business segments. Functional Materials segment offers raw materials for paints, inks, adhesives, and other products. Processed Materials segment offers dyes, pigments, functional pigments, resins, automotive repair and conductive paints and others. Electronics and Energy segment offers modified epoxy resins, fluorine products, and materials and equipment for semiconductor, display, as well as energy management system proposals, battery evaluation and healthcare services. Mobility segment offers general synthetic resins, and other materials and parts for automobile. Life-related segment offers raw materials for pharmaceuticals and agrochemicals, food additive, cosmetic additives, and radiation measurement service. The Company also offers logistics services, information processing and other professional services.

name: TOHOKU STEEL CO LTD
businessSummary: Tohoku Steel Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of specialty steel products, as well as the real estate leasing business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Specialty Steels segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of various specialty steel products such as heat-resistant steels for automotive, and magnetic materials, the processing and heat treatment of equipment parts and tools, as well as the rental, cleaning and security of factory land. The Real Estate Rental segment is engaged in the rental and maintenance of commercial facilities such as shopping centers, and rental houses, as well as the leasing of former factory land.

name: IWATANI CORP
businessSummary: IWATANI CORPORATION is a gas company. The Total Energy Division provides household, commercial and industrial liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), LPG supplying equipment, liquefied natural gas(LNG), gas products, and household kitchen appliances. The Industrial Gas and Machinery Division provides gas, helium, gas supplying equipment, welding equipment, industrial machinery and robots, pumps and compressors, as well as semiconductor and electronic parts manufacturing equipment, pharmaceutical and food machinery and environmental equipment. The Materials Division provides steel, nonferrous metals, functional films, display materials, electronic material, ceramic raw materials and biomass fuel. The Natural Industry Division provides frozen foods, health food, livestock systems, agricultural materials and equipment. The Others segment involves in finance, insurance, transportation and information processing businesses.

name: KOKYO INC
businessSummary: Kokyo Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the laser business. The laser-related product sales business is engaged in sale of laser-related products to companies, universities, and research institutes, with overseas and domestic manufacturers, the development and sale of laser-related products in-house, and mainly outsources manufacturing and assembly to subcontractors to sell original laser products. The other laser-related business operates the information sites Optipedia and Optinews regarding light and lasers, as well as disseminate information.

name: JAPAN POST INSURANCE CO LTD
businessSummary: JAPAN POST INSURANCE Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the insurance business. The life insurance business performs insurance underwriting and asset management. The Company operates other financial businesses related to other insurance companies. The Company also performs simplified life insurance management services commissioned by the management organization.

name: COLOPL INC
businessSummary: Colopl Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the entertainment business, and investment and development business. It operates through two segments. The Entertainment segment mainly develops and operates smartphone games. Its main products are native smartphone apps such as Shironeko Project, and Quiz RPG: The World of Mystic Wiz. It also develops and operates blockchain games, plans and develops software for home game consoles and personal computer (PC) games, and undertakes the development of game software released by other companies. The Investment and Development segment invests in information technology (IT) and entertainment companies in Japan and Asia.

name: POPPINS CORP
businessSummary: Poppins Corp, formerly Poppins Holdings Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly operates home service business including nanny service and babysitter, nursery service and housekeeping service, educare business including management of childcare facilities, and other service businesses including education training and research business, recruitment and dispatch business, and day service for seniors. The Company operates through two business segments. The Home Care Service segment mainly provides childcare and elderly care services by visiting homes such as childcare service business, elderly care service business, and housework support service business. The Educare segment mainly operates kindergarten and elementary school facilities. The other service businesses provide services for domestic training, overseas training, and others.

name: TOAGOSEI CO LTD
businessSummary: Toagosei Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the chemicals business and polymer and oligomer businesses. The Company operates through five business segments. The Core Chemicals segment manufactures and sells electrolytic products such as caustic soda, caustic potash, and sodium hypochlorite, industrial gases and acrylic monomers such as acrylic acid and acrylic acid esters. The Polymer and Oligomer segment manufactures and sells acrylic oligomers such as acrylic polymers, polymer flocculants, and light-curing resins. The Adhesive Materials segment manufactures and sells instant adhesives and functional adhesives. The High-Performance Materials segment manufactures and sells high-purity inorganic chemicals and inorganic functional materials. The Resin Processed Products segment manufactures and sells environmental infrastructure system products, building materials and civil engineering products. It also conducts new product research and development, transportation.

name: KYOKUTO KAIHATSU KOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Kyokuto Kaihatsu Kogyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the special vehicle, environmental and parking businesses. It operates through three business segments. Special Vehicle Business segment manufactures and sells special vehicle equipment, manufactures, installs and sells special equipment for automobiles, manufactures and sells parts for special equipment and repairs specially equipped vehicles. It also engages in the sale of used special purpose vehicles, provision of after-sales services and others. Environmental Business segment constructs various recycling facilities, manufactures and sells recycling equipment, and manufactures, sells and provides general services. It also engages in the service, operation and management of these facilities and others. Parking Business segment manufactures, installs, sells and maintains multi-story parking systems for condominiums and operates coin parking lots. It also engages in real estate rental business and others.

name: KORYOJYUHAN CO LTD
businessSummary: Koryojyuhan Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the real estate trading, rental, brokerage, management and other real estate related business in Ibaraki Prefecture and Tokyo Metropolis. The Company operates two business segments. Real Estate Distribution segment is involved in the sale of the Group’s real estate, trading and brokerage of real estate owned by others, as well as leasing brokerage of real estate owned by other companies. Real Estate Management conducts real estate rental business, real estate management business, as well as solar power generation power sale business. The Company is also engaged in business such as construction business, property insurance agency business, as well as coin parking lot management and operation business, among others.

name: ADVAN GROUP CO LTD
businessSummary: Advan Group Co Ltd, formerly Advan Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the import and sale of building finishing materials. The Company operates in three business segments. The Construction Materials Related segment is engaged in the import and sale of construction materials such as stones, tiles, housing-related products, fireplaces and stoves, faucets, system kitchens and other building materials, as well as the related construction works. The Real Estate Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing and management of distribution centers and other real estates. The Others segment is engaged in the wholesale of imported bricks, pots and other gardening-related products, as well as the logistics management business.

name: AICHI STEEL CORP
businessSummary: Aichi Steel Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of steel materials, forged products, electronic functional materials and parts, and magnetic application products. The Company operates through five segments. The Steel (Hagane) Company segment manufactures and sells special steel, produces steelmaking materials, and transports and stores steel products. The Stainless Steel Company segment manufactures and sells stainless steel and titanium, processes and sells special steel and stainless steel, and rolls, processes, and sells stainless steel. The Forging (Kitaeru) Company segment manufactures and sells die-forged products and forging die processed products. The Smart Company segment manufactures and sells electronic functional materials and parts, magnetic application products, plant activators, and metal fibers. The Other Businesses segment provides computer software development, product sales and greening services.

name: MARVELOUS INC
businessSummary: Marvelous Inc., formerly Marvelous AQL Inc., is mainly engaged in the entertainment business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Online segment involves in the planning, development and operation of online games and game applications with a focus on social games for social networking service (SNS). The Consumer segment involves in the planning, development and sale of software for home-use game machines, and commercial equipment and products for amusement facility operation companies, as well as the contracted development of game software. The Music and Video segment involves in the production of music and video contents with a focus on animations, the commercialization of music, videos and characters, the operation of delivery business, as well as the operation of performance business via the production of stage performance works, with the popular works of cartoons, animations and games as originals.

name: WAIDA MFG. CO LTD
businessSummary: Waida MFG. Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of machine tools. The Company develops, manufactures, sells, and repairs computer numerically controlled (CNC) grinders, mainly for the mold-related and cutting tool-related industries. Its main products and services include mold-related grinders, cutting tool-related grinders, other machinery, and after-sales services. Its mold-related grinders include form grinders and jig grinders. Its cutting tool-related grinders include indexable insert grinders and axial tool grinders. Its other machinery includes other metal processing machinery and auxiliary equipment. Its after-sales services include after-sales service, parts sales, and overhauls. The Company operates mainly in Japan, Mainland China, Taiwan, South Korea, Southeast Asia, South Asia, the United States, Europe, Africa, and other regions.

name: JOYFUL HONDA CO LTD
businessSummary: Joyful Honda Co Ltd is engaged in the sales of housing products including materials and professional supplies, interior and living products, and garden and farm products, the design and construction of renovation work and the sales of related products, and the sales of living products including daily necessities, pets and leisure products. The Company operates home center business and housing renovation business. The stores include large-scale retail stores and specialty retail stores. The products include material and professional supplies such as lumber, construction materials, paints, tools, hardware, work supplies and electrical parts, daily necessities such as everyday consumables, sanitary products, medicines, health care products, beverages and alcoholic beverages, garden and farm products such as flower seedlings, vegetable seedlings, plants, culture soil, fertilizer, bricks and paving stones, interior and living products such as floors, walls, windows, furniture and others.

name: EXEO GROUP INC
businessSummary: EXEO Group Inc, formerly Kyowa Exeo Corp, is mainly engaged in the engineering solution business and the system solution business. It consists of four business segments: Kyowa Exeo Group, C Cube Group, Seibu Denki Group and Nippon Dentsu Group. The segments are mainly engaged in the construction of equipment and urban infrastructure for communication carriers, network integration, and system integration, centering on their respective construction areas. The engineering solution business includes communication carriers that build and maintain communication infrastructure equipment, and urban infrastructure that builds and maintains various communication infrastructure equipment for local governments, government agencies, railway companies, private companies and others. The system solution business builds systems and provides system integration for various companies such as telecommunications carriers, finance and manufacturing. The Company also operates pipe work business.

name: NIPPON EXPRESS HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Nippon Express Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in logistics business, security transportation business, heavy goods construction business and logistics support business. The Company operates through four segments. The Logistics segment is mainly engaged in railway transportation business, truck transportation business, warehousing business, air transportation business, marine transportation business, and harbor transportation business. The Security Transportation segment is engaged in security services and related businesses. The Heavy Goods Construction segment is engaged in the transportation, erection, installation and incidental business of heavy goods. The Logistics Support segment is engaged in the sales of logistics equipment, packaging materials, vehicles, petroleum, liquefied petroleum gas and other products, the maintenance of vehicles, as well as real estate business, logistics finance business and worker dispatch business.

name: ALFRESA HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Alfresa Holdings Corporation is a Japan-based holding company primarily engaged in the wholesale of drugs. The Company operates in four business segments. The Pharmaceutical Wholesale segment is engaged in the wholesale of medical products, test reagents, as well as medical equipment and materials. The Self Medication Wholesale segment is engaged in the wholesale of general drugs. The Pharmaceutical Manufacture segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals, test reagents, medical equipment and implements, as well as pharmaceutical powders. The Medical-Related segment is mainly engaged in operation of pharmacies. The others business is engaged in the information system business, the transportation business, the warehousing business, the insurance agency business, the real estate management business, the sale of miscellaneous goods, as well as the manpower dispatching business, among others.

name: FERROTEC CORP
businessSummary: Ferrotec Corp, formerly Ferrotec Holdings Corp, is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of products used in semiconductor and flat panel display (FPD) manufacturing equipment, thermo-modules, as well as silicon products, magnetic fluids, sensors and their application products. The Company operates through three segments. The Semiconductor and Other Equipment Related segment is engaged in the production of vacuum seals, metal fabricated products for various manufacturing equipment, quartz products, ceramics products, chemical vapor deposition (CVD)-silicon carbide (SIC) products, silicon parts, quartz crucibles, and equipment parts cleaning. The Electronic Devices segment produces thermo-modules, substrates for power semiconductors, magnetic fluids, and sensors. The Automotive segment manufactures thermo-modules, substrates for power semiconductors, and sensors. It also manufactures saw blades, machine tools, and silicon products for solar cells.

name: GARDEN CO LTD (SHINJUKU, TOKYO)
businessSummary: Garden Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the restaurant business. The Restaurant Business segment is involved in the operation of restaurants, including ramen, restaurant, steak, and sushi restaurants, as well as franchise and real estate businesses related to its brands. Brands include Ichikakuya, Darumanome, Ichiryu, Terracho, Yamashita Honki Udon, Jonetsu no Sutameshidon, and Kaitenzushi Premium Kaiou. It conducts business activities in Japan and overseas.

name: SATO CORP
businessSummary: Sato Corp, formerly Sato Holdings Corp, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sales of automatic identification technology products like mechatronics products and supply products. The Company operates in three segments. The Automatic Identification Solution Japan segment is mainly engaged in the planning of the group management strategies, managements, asset lending, the manufacture and sales of mechatronics products and supply products as well as the manufacture and sale of industrial rubber products, synthetic resins, and radio frequency identification device (RFID) tags and labels. The Automatic Identification Solution Overseas segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sales of mechatronics products and supply products, as well as the manufacturing and sales of RFID tags and labels overseas. It is also engaged in the construction and civil engineering works.

name: DAISUE CONSTRUCTION CO LTD
businessSummary: DAISUE CONSTRUCTION CO., LTD. is primarily engaged in construction business. In addition to construction business, the Company is also involved in real estate, insurance agency, worker dispatching and security business.

name: SANSHA ELECTRIC MANUFACTURING CO LTD
businessSummary: Sansha Electric Manufacturing Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of semiconductors and power equipment. The Company operates through two business segments. The Semiconductor segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of module products and discrete products for diode thyristor triac. The Power Equipment segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of direct current power equipment, metal surface treatment power equipment, alternating current uninterrupted power equipment, motor control power equipment, electric furnace power equipment, dimming devices, light source machine power equipment, arc welding equipment, dental equipment and alternating current power equipment. The Company is also engaged in the installation, test, repair, maintenance and construction of equipment.

name: NIPPON PALLET POOL CO LTD
businessSummary: NIPPON PALLET POOL CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of pallet rental services. The Company is engaged in the rental of cargo handling and transportation equipment such as wooden pallets, plastic pallets, supporters, nesters, roll boxes, containers, racks, carts and others, as well as the operation of the pallet pool. The pallet pool operation business is engaged in the provision of pallet rental and recycling services for customers in pallets storage and management bases through the same standard pallets sharing and circulating system, as well as the provision of repair, maintenance and management services for pallets. The general palletization promotion business is engaged in the provision of unloading and transshipping services for cargo loaded on pallets, as well as transportation and storage services using forklifts and other loading equipment.

name: TOPPAN HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: TOPPAN Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the information and communication, lifestyle and industry, and electronics business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Information and Communication segment provides gift card application service provider (ASP) services, radio frequency identification (RFID) solutions, payment-related services, digital content production, back-office operation and customer contact services, securities, integrated circuit (IC) cards and others. The communication media business provides sales promotion (SP) tools and manages events. The Lifestyle and Industry segment provides flexible packaging materials, various containers, ink and others. The Electronics Business Segment is involved in provision of color filters for displays, anti-reflective films, small and medium-sized thin-film transistor (TFT) liquid crystal display panels, and light control films, as well as photomasks and flip-chip ball grid array (FC-BGA) substrates.

name: MITSUBISHI LOGISNEXT CO LTD
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Logisnext Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale and maintenance services of forklift trucks and other logistics equipment and maintenance parts. The Company primarily operates through two business segments. The Domestic segment is engaged in the domestically manufacture and sale of logistics equipment and maintenance parts, mainly forklift trucks, as well as the sale of related products and maintenance parts. The Overseas segment is mainly operated in the Americas, Europe, China and Asia. The Company is mainly engaged in the development, design, manufacture and sale of logistics system products such as battery forklifts, engine forklifts, container carriers, transfer cranes, transport robots, automated warehouses, and warehouse management systems (WMS). The Company is also engaged in the business of non-life insurance agency.

name: LAST ONE MILE CO LTD
businessSummary: Last One Mile Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the last mile business. The Company is engaged in the provision of services with high needs such as home delivery and Internet access at the timing of new life and centered on living infrastructure services such as electricity and natural gas. The Company is engaged in the operation of Marutto Change, a new life support platform for the mobile one-stop service. Marutto Change is a service in which the Lifeline Concierge uses a telephone or short message service (SMS) to act on behalf of or guide customers to lifeline and other new life procedures.

name: KUMAGAI GUMI CO LTD
businessSummary: Kumagai Gumi Co Ltd is mainly engaged in the construction business and related business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Civil Works segment is engaged in the investigation, survey, planning, design, supervisor of construction works, and the provision of general engineering. The Construction segment is engaged in the investigation, survey, planning, design, supervisor of construction of apartment houses, offices and government buildings, factories, power stations.
