The Subsidiaries segment conducts construction business, the manufacture and sale of equipment for construction, and provision of construction technology products.

name: MIRARTH HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Mirarth Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning, development, sale and liquidation business of the newly built condominium Leben series, as well as the energy business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Real Estate Sales Business segment mainly engages in the sale of newly built condominiums, income real estate and detached houses, as well as the renewal condominium business. The Real Estate Rental Business segment is engaged in the rental business of offices and residential condominiums. The Real Estate Management Business segment is engaged in the comprehensive management business of condominiums. The Energy Business segment conducts power generation business using renewable energy nationwide. The Company also engages in nursing care business, construction business, commissioned sales agency business, investment management business and hotel business.

name: KOBE STEEL LTD
businessSummary: Kobe Steel Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the steel business. The Company has seven business segments. The Steel and Aluminum segment includes steel strips, steel sheets, aluminum rolled products, steel billets, and pig iron for castings. The Profile segment includes steel castings and forgings, aluminum alloys, and magnesium alloy castings and forgings. The Welding segment includes welding materials, welding robots, welding power sources, and various welding robot systems. The Machinery segment is engaged in energy and chemical-related equipment, nuclear power-related equipment, and tire and rubber machinery. The Engineering Segment is engaged in various types of plants and civil engineering works. The Construction Machinery segment is engaged in hydraulic excavators, mini excavators, wheel loaders, and crawler cranes. The Electric Power Segment is engaged in electric power supply. The Company also engages in high-pressure gas container manufacturing, superconducting.

name: CRG HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: CRG HOLDINGS CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based holding company principally engaged in temporary staffing introduction related business. The Company operates three kinds of business. The temporary staffing introduction business includes worker dispatch business and paid employment introduction business. The outsourcing manufacturing business is engaged in the outsourcing manufacturing of pet related products, such as pet foods and pet hygiene goods from business partner manufacturers and their accompanying business. The other business provides services to improve productivity in client business activities. The services include business process outsourcing (BPO), salary calculation agency, recruitment agency, robotic process automation (RPA), system solution, as well as information technology (IT) related services.

name: ASAHI KAGAKU KOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: ASAHI KAGAKU KOGYO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based manufacturing company. Along with its subsidiary, the Company is engaged in the molding process of plastics products, the design and manufacture and molding dies for resins. The products of the Company are mainly used for electrical tools and automobiles. The Company operates its business in Japan, China and Thailand.

name: TSI HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: TSI Holdings Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the apparel related business and other business. The Apparel Related segment is mainly engaged in the planning, manufacture and sale of fashion and apparel products such as women's clothing, men's clothing and fashion accessories, as well as the license brand business, and the production and logistics business. The Company is also engaged in the other businesses such as the sales agency and staffing business, the synthetic resin products manufacturing and sale business, the store design supervision business, the food and beverage business, as well as the import and sale of cosmetics and soaps. The brands include apparel brands such as ADORE, and wander, Apuweiser-riche, Arpege Story, AVIREX, BAIT, BOSCH, BEAVER and others, food and beverage brands such as Urth Caffe, Patisserie Slier and others, as well as licensed brands such as PRIVATE LABEL, VIVAYOU, Pinky Girls, VertDense, MATERIA, NOVESPAZIO, BRIGITTE and others.

name: ALUE CO LTD
businessSummary: Alue Co., Ltd. is mainly engaged in the human resource development business. The Company provides corporate service and individual service. In the corporate service, the Company conducts business skill training, mind training and language research, promotes the growth of corporates and individuals, provides classroom-based research, overseas dispatch training, overseas classroom training and corporate ALUGO for government agencies, private enterprises, school corporations and local governments. In the individual service, the Company provides ALUGO of English conversation service provided for corporate customers for individuals to improve homework and counseling learning support, builds an accompanying system, provides services in the form of ALUGO.

name: WASEDA GAKUSHUKENKYUKAI CO LTD
businessSummary: Waseda Gakushukenkyukai Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the cram school business. The Company operates cram schools through three divisions. The seminar division operates W Wasedazemi, a group instruction school for elementary and junior high school students. The high division operates W Wasedazemi High School, a group instruction school for high school students. The first kobetsu division operates First Kobetsu, a private tutoring school for elementary, middle school, and high school students.

name: AOI ELECTRONICS CO LTD
businessSummary: Aoi Electronics Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of electronic components. The integrated circuit business division is engaged in the manufacture and sale of integrated circuits (ICs), optical sensors, wafer-level packages, and light-emitting diodes (LEDs), as well as the plating processing of electronic components. The functional components business division manufactures and sells print heads and various sensors.

name: UBE CORP
businessSummary: UBE Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in business related to chemicals, and molding machinery manufacturing. The Company operates through four business segments. The Performance Products segment manufactures and sells polyimide, separation membranes, ceramics, separators, and other products. The Resins & Performance Polymer Products segment manufactures and sells composites, nylon polymers, caprolactam, ammonium sulfate, industrial chemicals, fine chemicals, high-performance coatings, elastomers, and other products. The Machinery segment manufactures and sells die casting machines, extrusion presses, injection molding machines, industrial machinery, bridges and steel structures, and steel products. The Others segment manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals (active pharmaceutical ingredients and intermediates), supplies electric power, and buys, sells, leases, and manages real estate.

name: TOKYU CONSTRUCTION CO LTD
businessSummary: Tokyu Construction Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Construction (building) segment is engaged in the construction of offices, commercial facilities, educational facilities, cultural and social facilities, sports facilities, government office buildings, research institutes, training facilities, housing, medical and welfare facilities, logistics facilities. The Construction (civil engineering) segment is engaged in the construction of railways, dams, environmental sanitation facilities and roads. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the sales and leasing of real estate properties. It also engages in sales of vegetables, and rehabilitation work through its subsidiaries. It is also engaged in the development of artificial intelligence/Internet of Things (AI/IoT) platform that protects and manages photovoltaic power generation panels.

name: ALPS ALPINE CO LTD
businessSummary: Alps Alpine Co Ltd isa Japan-based company mainly engaged in businesses related to the components, sensors and communications, and modules and systems businesses. The company operates through three business segments. The Components Business segment manufactures and sells electronic components such as switches, actuators, and haptics. The Sensors and Communications Business segment manufactures and sells electronic components for sensors and communication devices. The Modules and Systems Business segment manufactures and sells automotive modules, infotainment, display, and sound products. The Company also operates businesses related to system development, office services, finance and leasing, and logistics.

name: SHINOBU FOODS PRODUCTS CO LTD
businessSummary: SHINOBU FOODS PRODUCTS CO., LTD. is engaged in the production and sale of prepared food products, such as sushi, rice balls, lunch boxes, prepared bread and other perishable food products. Through its subsidiary, the Company also engaged in leasing of real estate.

name: ITOHAM YONEKYU HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Itoham Yonekyu Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of processed meat products (ham, sausage, cooked processed foods) and meat products. The Company operates through two segments. The Processed Food segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of processed meat products such as ham, sausage, and cooked processed foods. The Meat segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of meat and cooked processed foods. In addition, the Company also provides administrative agency services, logistics services, and human resources and payroll-related services.

name: ALCONIX CORP
businessSummary: Alconix Corp is a Japan-based company mainly exports, imports, and domestically trades various products and raw materials, including aluminum, copper, nickel, rare metals, and rare earths, and is expanding into the manufacturing industry, primarily metal processing. The Company operates in four business segments. The Electronic Functional Materials segment deals in compound semiconductors, electronic materials, nickel products, and rare metals. The Aluminum and Copper segment deals in aluminum products (rolled products, extrusions, cast and forged products, beverage cans, foil) and others. The Equipment and Materials segment deals in copper and nickel plating materials and related chemicals, non-destructive testing equipment, marking equipment and related consumables, and mold overlay welding rods. The Metal Processing Business segment deals in metal processed parts such as aluminum, titanium, and other light alloys for communication equipment, and others.

name: RENGO CO LTD
businessSummary: Rengo Co Ltd is a paper box manufacturer. The Company operates in four segments. The Cardboard and Paper Processing-related segment manufactures and sells paperboards, corrugated boards and kraft pulps in domestic markets. The Soft-type Packaging-related segment manufactures and sells soft-type packaging products and cellophane in domestic markets. The Heavy Duty Packaging-related segment manufactures and sells heavy duty packaging products in domestic markets. The Overseas-related segment manufactures and sells paperboards, corrugated boards, corrugated boxes, soft-type and heavy duty packaging products in overseas markets. The other businesses include the manufacture of nonwoven cloth, the logistic business, insurance agency business, lease business and real estate business.

name: TOKYO KISEN CO LTD
businessSummary: Tokyo Kisen Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of services such as tugboat business, passenger ship business, stand and cafeteria business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Tugboat segment is involved in tugboat business, charter business, disaster prevention-related business and others. The Passenger Ship segment is engaged in tourism, car ferry and transportation ship businesses. The Stand and Cafeteria segment is engaged in the sale of goods associated with the car ferry business and restaurant cafeteria business.

name: DAIWA CYCLE CO LTD
businessSummary: Daiwa Cycle Co Ltd is a Japan-based company sells bicycles and bicycle parts and accessories, and provides bicycle maintenance and repair services, primarily at its stores. The Company operates its business through the Bicycle-Related Sales segment. The Company sells bicycles, including general-purpose, infant/child, sports, and electrically power assisted bicycles, as well as parts and accessories, including baskets, batteries, tires, helmets, and other items. The Company also provides various maintenance, repair, and other ancillary services, as well as long-term warranty services. In addition to directly managed stores, the Company sells directly to customers through franchise stores and e-commerce.

name: EIDAI CO LTD
businessSummary: Eidai Co., Ltd. is a company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of wooden building materials and wooden boards. The Company operates in two business segments. The Housing Materials segment manufactures and sells building materials, including floorings, stairs sets, interior doors, construction materials and system kitchens. The Wooden Board segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of raw material particle boards and cosmetic particle boards. The others business engages in utilization business of owned real estate, asbestos treatment work, measurement and analysis of work environment, sales of processed chemicals and other environmental businesses, as well as solar power generation business.

name: IZUMI CO LTD
businessSummary: IZUMI CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the general retail business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Retail segment is engaged in the sale of clothing, housing-related goods and food products through its shopping centers, general merchandise stores (GMSs) and supermarkets. The Retail-related segment is engaged in the credit and finance business, the management of shop facilities, as well as the operation of restaurants. The Company is also engaged in the wholesale business and the real estate leasing business.

name: ELECTRIC POWER DEVELOPMENT CO LTD
businessSummary: Electric Power Development Co Ltd is mainly engaged in electricity generation business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Electricity segment engages in power generation business including hydroelectric power generation, thermal power generation and wind power generation, as well as provision of electricity. The Electricity-Related segment engages in design, installation, maintenance and repair of electrical power equipment, the port operation of fuel and coal ash, the coal mine development, the import of coal, the procurement and manufacture of biomass fuel, the operation of public health facilities, as well as the provision of computer services. The Overseas Operation segment is in the operation of electrical power generation investment business and other related businesses, engineering and consulting businesses in overseas. The Others segment engages in new electricity business, environment-related business and others.

name: SEIKAGAKU CORP
businessSummary: SEIKAGAKU CORPORATION is principally engaged in the research, development, purchase, manufacture and sale of pharmaceutical products and limulus amebocyte lysate (LAL). The Company operates in two business segments. The Pharmaceutical business segment provides hyaluronan-based medicines for joint function improvement, ophthalmic operation boosters and submucosal injection materials for endoscopes, as well as drug substances for various pharmaceuticals. The LAL business segment provides reagents for measuring endotoxin.

name: SEKISUI HOUSE LTD
businessSummary: Sekisui House Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the detached house business, rental and commercial building business, civil engineering business and other related business. It has seven business segments. The Detached House segment designs, contracts and sells detached houses. Rental and Commercial Building segment designs, contracts and sells rental housing and commercial buildings. Architecture and Civil Engineering segment designs and contracts for construction and civil engineering work for commercial buildings. Rental Housing Management segment leases and manages rental housing. Remodeling segment remodels detached houses and rental housing. Development segment includes the brokerage and real estate business, condominium business and urban redevelopment business. International Business segment sells detached houses overseas, develops and sells residential land, and develops condominiums and rental apartments. It is also engaged in non-life insurance agency business.

name: 77 BANK LTD
businessSummary: 77 Bank Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of banking services, leasing services, and financial services such as credit card services. The Company operates through the Banking Business segment. Banking business includes deposit business, lending business, commodity securities trading business, securities investment business, domestic foreign exchange business, foreign exchange business, corporate bond trust business, agency business, debt guarantee (payment acceptance), government bonds, investment trust, over-the-counter sales of insurance products. The leasing business is engaged in financial-related leasing activities. It is also engaged in credit guarantee business, credit card business, financial product transaction business, research and consulting business, outsourcing of calculation business using electronic computing equipment, fund management business, and investment business.

name: SATA CONSTRUCTION CO LTD
businessSummary: Sata Construction Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction business. The Company is primarily engaged in the construction of civil engineering works and building construction works. In its construction business, the Company involves in the order entry and construction of works, as well as the sale of asphalt mixtures. Through one of its subsidiaries, the Company also involves in the provision of rental services of construction materials and equipment.

name: TAKIGAMI STEEL CONSTRUCTION CO LTD
businessSummary: Takigami Steel Construction Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the design, manufacture and sale of steel structure products. The Company operates in five business segments. The Steel Structure Products Manufacturing segment is engaged in the design, manufacture and construction of steel bridges, iron frames and other steel structure products and the development and sale of precast concrete products for bridges, and sale of asphalt additives. The Real Estate Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing and management of real estate properties. The Materials Sale segment is engaged in processing and sale of steel sheets and various steel materials. The Transportation segment is engaged in transportation of goods and other related business. The machine tool manufacturing segment is engaged in the design, manufacture and sale of machine tools, automotive machine tools, and jigs and tools. The Company also operates a solar power generation business.

name: ENEOS HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: ENEOS Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the energy business, oil and gas development business, and metal business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Energy segment is engaged in refining and sale of petroleum, the provision of lubricants, basic chemicals, functional chemicals, gas, coals, electricity, new energy and other products. The Oil and Natural Gas Development segment is engaged in the exploration, development and production of petroleum and natural gas. The Metal segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of copper foil, precision rolled products, precision processed products, thin film materials, development and mining of non-ferrous metal resources, non-ferrous metal products, as well as the industrial waste treatment, titanium and electric wires. The Company is also engaged in group common businesses such as asphalt paving, civil engineering work, construction work, land transportation, real estate rental and fund raising.

name: WILL GROUP INC
businessSummary: WILL GROUP, INC. is engaged in the human resource business focusing on temporary staffing, business contracting and recruitment business. Its Sales Outsourcing segment involves in the hybrid dispatch, general dispatch, and business contracting business, providing staff engaged in products sales, staff management, collection and report of sales information. Its Call Center Outsourcing segment involves in hybrid dispatch and general dispatch business, providing staff engaged in information providing and delivery, after services and claim handling to communication company. Its Factory Outsourcing segment involves in staff dispatch to companies in food, electrical equipment industries, among others. The Nursing Care Support segment provides nursing staff to companies operating nursing care facilities to provide stable operation of nursing care facilities. The Overseas HR segment develops human resources service business. Others segment involves in the general staff dispatch, among others.

name: NOVAC CO LTD
businessSummary: Novac Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in civil engineering and construction work. The Company operates through two business segments. The Civil Engineering Business segment is engaged in social infrastructure construction work (road construction, river construction, water supply and sewage construction, and land development work) mainly for public agencies such as local governments and highway companies. The Building Construction Business segment mainly carries out apartment building construction work ordered by private companies, and construction projects ordered by government agencies, such as schools, welfare facilities, government buildings, offices, and highway service areas. The Company also operates real estate rental business, renovation work and other businesses.

name: UMIOS CORP
businessSummary: Umios Corp, formerly Maruha Nichiro Corp, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the marine resources, food distribution and processed food business. It operates through three business segments. Marine Resources Business segment consists of the fisheries unit, aquaculture unit, which farms yellowtail, amberjack and tuna domestically and North America unit, which has business bases in North America and Europe. Food Distribution Business segment consists of the seafood trading unit, which has a sales network including procurement and market distribution of seafood, food distribution unit, which manufactures and sells marine products and commercial products to various business types and agriculture and livestock unit, which handles livestock and agricultural products. Processed Food Business segment consists of the processed food unit, and fine chemical unit. Other businesses include storage, transportation, and delivery of frozen foods and feed, as well as real estate.

name: TOMEN DEVICES CORP
businessSummary: Tomen Devices Corp is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the trading of semiconductors and electronic components. It conducts business through two segments which are Japan and Overseas. The Company's main products include semiconductor memory such as DRAM, NAND FLASH, multi-chip packages (MCPs), and solid-state drives (SSDs), and system-on-chip (SoC), display driver integrated circuit (DDI), complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) image sensor (CIS), power management integrated circuit (PMIC), system-in-package (SiP), foundry, and other large-scale integrated circuits (LSI), and displays such as liquid crystal panels (LCDs) and organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs), and light-emitting diodes (LEDs), multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCCs), batteries, and equipment.

name: COSMOS INITIA CO LTD
businessSummary: Cosmos Initia Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the residential business, solutions business, accommodation business, construction business, and related businesses. It operates through four business segments. The Residential segment sells new condominiums, detached houses and renovated condominiums, brokers condominiums, provides real estate management services, and develops condominiums for sale in Australia. The Solutions segment sells income-generating real estate, manages and operates real estate rentals, brokers income-generating real estate and commercial land, provides property consulting, and renovates and sells used income-generating real estate in the United States. The Accommodation segment sells and operates hotel facilities and plans and operates outdoor resorts. The Construction segment provides office relocation and interior construction, architecture and renovation work, and condominium gallery construction.

name: PRIMA MEAT PACKERS LTD
businessSummary: Prima Meat Packers Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of processed foods, and the processing and sale of meat. It also engages in logistics and other services related to each business. It has two business segments. The Processed Food Business segment is the organization that manufactures and sells ham, sausage, and processed foods, as well as processed foods manufactured and sold by group companies. The Meat Business segment is the organization that purchases and sells meat products, as well as meat-related products raised, manufactured, and sold by group companies. The Company also engages in consulting services such as inspection and hygiene management, the development, manufacture, and sale of physicochemical equipment, information processing, and human resources, insurance, and real estate services.

name: SUMITOMO RUBBER INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: Sumitomo Rubber Industries Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the tire, sports, and industrial products. It has three business segments. The Tire Business segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of tires and tubes for automobiles, construction vehicles, industrial vehicles, race and rally vehicles, and motorcycles, as well as the automotive business (puncture repair agents, air pressure warning devices). The Sports Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of sporting goods such as golf clubs, golf balls, and other golf and tennis equipment, as well as the operation of golf tournaments and golf and tennis schools. The Industrial Products and Other Business segment is engaged in the high-performance rubber business, including vibration control dampers, rubber for office automation (OA) equipment, and medical rubber, the daily necessities business, including kitchen and work gloves and wheelchair ramps and others.

name: OPEN HOUSE GROUP CO LTD
businessSummary: Open House Group Co Ltd, formerly Open House Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the real estate related business. The Company operates through five business segments. The Detached House-Related Business segment engages in brokerage (Open House), detached house sales (Open House Development), detached house subdivision (Hawk One), and construction contracting (Open House Architect). The Condominium Business segment develops and sells new condominiums. The Income-Producing Real Estate Business segment acquires, manages, and sells income-producing real estate in Japan. The Others segment is engaged in the U.S. real estate business, including sales, consulting, property management, and financial services related to U.S. real estate. The Pleasant Corporation segment plans, develops and sells mainly studio and family condominiums.

name: GMB CORP
businessSummary: GMB CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacture and sale of automobile parts. The Company operates in six business segments based on the regions. Each segment engages in manufacture and sale of automotive parts. The Company's main products include drive, transmission and control equipment parts, engine parts, and bearings. Drive, transmission and control parts include universal joints, steering joints, constant velocity joints and others. Engine parts include water pumps, water pump bearings and fan clutches. Bearings include tensioner and idler bearings, auto tensioner and idler bearings, ball bearings and others.

name: SEC CARBON LTD
businessSummary: SEC Carbon Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of carbon products and steel products. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of carbon products, contract work within its factories, research and development related to molten salt electrochemistry, and the manufacture and sale of steel products. Its carbon products include cathode blocks for aluminum smelting, artificial graphite electrodes, specialty carbon products, fine powder, and other carbon products. Its steel products include steel products made by electric furnace steelmaking.

name: TAKAHASHI CURTAIN WALL CORP
businessSummary: TAKAHASHI CURTAIN WALL CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction of building exterior walls. The Company operates in two business segments. The Precast Concrete (PC) Curtain Wall segment is engaged in the design, manufacture and construction of building exterior walls, mainly precast concrete curtain walls. The Aqua segment is engaged in the design and construction of bathing facilities and sports facilities. The other businesses include real estate leasing business and recreation facility management of the Company.

name: MITSUBISHI GAS CHEMICAL CO INC
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Gas Chemical Co Inc is a Japan-based chemical company. The Company operates in two business segments. The Green Energy & Chemicals segment manufactures and sells methanol, methanol and ammonia-based chemicals, life science products, general aromatic chemicals, special aromatic chemicals, foam plastics, and electricity. The Performance Chemicals segment manufactures and sells inorganic chemicals, plastic lens monomers, engineering plastics, electronic materials, and oxygen absorbers. The other businesses include real estate business.

name: TOYOBO CO LTD
businessSummary: Toyobo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the film and functional resin business, industrial material business, and textile and commerce business. It has five business segments. Film and Functional Resin segment manufactures, processes and sells packaging films, industrial films, industrial adhesives, engineering plastics and optical functional materials. Industrial Materials segment manufactures, processes and sells automotive fiber materials, super fibers, non-woven fabrics. Textile and Trading segment manufactures and sells functional clothing, apparel products, clothing textiles, and clothing fibers. Healthcare segment manufactures, processes and sells bio products, pharmaceuticals, medical membranes, medical devices, aqua membranes, and functional filters. It is also engaged in the assembly and sale of seawater desalination modules. The Real Estate segment sells, rents and manages movables. It also designs and constructs buildings and machinery and sells equipment.

name: KATO WORKS CO LTD
businessSummary: KATO WORKS CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of construction cranes, hydraulic excavators, and other products. The Company operates through Japan, China, and other region three geography segments. Products are cargo handling equipment, including all hydraulic truck cranes, rough terrain cranes, all terrain cranes, on-board truck cranes, crawler cranes; construction equipment, including hydraulic excavators, earth drills for foundation work, mini excavators, crawler carriers; industrial machinery, including vacuum suction road sweepers, universal suction trucks, snow sweepers; and forestry machines, including forwarders and tower yarders.

name: HALMEK HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Halmek Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the platform business for seniors, publishing the magazine Halmek, developing and selling products, and providing services such as travel and courses. The Company operates through two segments. The Halmek business segment is engaged in the publication of Halmek, a magazine for senior women, mail order business Halmek, advertising business, cultural business such as events, external sales of newspapers, and store operation business. The Nationwide Mail Order business segment is engaged in the mail order business Cotose for senior women and the advertising business.

name: MEIJI HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Meiji Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based holding company engaged in the management of subsidiaries that manufactures and sells food and medicines. The Company operates its business through two business segments. The Food segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of yogurt, milk, beverages, cheese, butter, margarine, cream, ice cream, frozen food, chocolate, gummi, gum, sports nutrition, powdered milk, liquid food, beauty food, general medicine, sugar, saccharified flour and others. The Pharmaceuticals segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of ethical pharmaceuticals, and animal drugs.

name: SHIKOKU ELECTRIC POWER CO INC
businessSummary: Shikoku Electric Power Co Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the electricity, information and communications, energy, and construction and engineering businesses. It has four segments. The Electricity Business segment is involved in power generation and sales, power transmission and distribution, and is engaged in power supply, wind power generation, nuclear power generation, thermal power generation, hydroelectric power generation, and solar power generation. The Information and Communications Business segment is involved in information system development, platform business, communications business, program production and broadcasting. The Energy Business segment provides comprehensive energy solution services, the design and construction of heat supply systems for buildings and factories. It also operates and manages biomass power plants and provides liquefied natural gas (LNG). The Construction and Engineering Business segment provides comprehensive engineering services.

name: SHINKO SHOJI CO LTD
businessSummary: Shinko Shoji Co., Ltd. is principally engaged in the sale, import and export of electronic components and assembly products. The Company operates in three business segments. The Electronic Components segment offers integrated circuits, semiconductor devices, circuit components, liquid crystal displays (LCDs), and other electronic components. The main products include microcomputers, system large-scale integrated circuits, memories, semiconductors, capacitors, ferrite cores, color LCDs and general electronic components. The Assembly segment offers assembly products. The Others segment is engaged in the sale of electronic equipment and contract development of microcomputer software. The main products include workstation server and computer peripherals.

name: CLIP CORP
businessSummary: CLIP Corporation is a company mainly engaged in the operation of education business, sports business and food business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Education segment is engaged in the operation of cram schools. The Sports segment is engaged in the operation of soccer schools. The Food segment is engaged in the home delivery of boxed lunches. The others businesses include the operation business of basket schools, the agriculture business, the sale of used golf club business and yakiniku restaurant business.

name: OKI ELECTRIC INDUSTRY CO LTD
businessSummary: Oki Electric Industry Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in public solutions, enterprise solutions, component products, electronic manufacturing services (EMS) businesses. It operates through four business segments. Public Solutions segment manufactures and sells communication equipment for road-related systems, aviation-related systems and others and provides system construction and solutions. Enterprise Solutions segment manufactures and sells automated teller machines (ATMs), cash processing machines, branch terminals, reservation and issuing terminals, check-in terminals, foreign currency exchange machines and others and provides construction and maintenance services. Component Products segment manufactures and sells edge devices, sensor networks, private branch exchanges (PBX) and others. EMS segment manufactures and sells design and production contract services, printed wiring boards, cables and others. It also promotes activities aimed at creating future businesses.

name: KANADEVIA CORP
businessSummary: Kanadevia Corp, formerly Hitachi Zosen Corp, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the design, manufacture, installation, sale, repair, maintenance, and operation of environmental equipment and plants, machinery and equipment, and infrastructure facilities. The Company operates through four business segments. The Environmental Business segment engages in the manufacture of various plants, such as waste incineration power generation and recycling facilities. The Machinery and Infrastructure Business segment engages in the manufacture of automobile press machines, boilers, plastic machinery, food machinery, pharmaceutical machinery. The Decarbonization Business segment engages in the manufacture of marine engines, denitrification catalysts, various process equipment such as pressure vessels, nuclear power-related facilities, and wind power generation. The Other Business segment engages in the operation and management of facilities such as dormitories and company housing.

name: SUZUKEN CO LTD
businessSummary: Suzuken Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceutical products. The Company operates in four business segments. The Pharmaceutical Wholesale segment sells pharmaceuticals, diagnostic drugs, and medical equipment and materials, among others. The Pharmaceutical Manufacturing segment manufactures pharmaceuticals and diagnostic drugs and others. The Insurance Pharmacy segment is engaged in dispensing operations based on prescriptions from medical institutions. The Medical-related Service and Others segment is engaged in the provision of manufacturer support services, such as the transportation of medicines and comprehensive support for the distribution of drugs for rare diseases; the nursing services; the manufacture of physiological examination equipment, such as electrocardiographic monitors and blood pressure monitors; as well as other services, such as the sale of medical books.

name: AOZORA BANK LTD
businessSummary: Aozora Bank Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the banking business. The Company also engages in business related to financial services such as financial products trading business and others, as well as debt management and collection business. The Company operates through five business segments. The Institutional Banking Group segment includes loans, deposits, sales of financial products, private equity investment, and other businesses. The Structured Finance Group segment includes acquisition finance, environmental project finance, rehabilitation finance, and real estate finance. The International Business Group segment includes overseas investment and financing. The Market Group segment includes the sale and trade of derivatives and foreign exchange products, and other businesses. The Customer Relation Group segment includes the sale of loans, deposits, and financial products to corporate clients, and the sale of deposits, mutual funds, and insurance to retail clients.

name: HAMMOCK INC
businessSummary: Hammock Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of solutions that solve customers' issues, needs, and problems using information technology (IT). The Company provides three solutions. Network solution develops and sells the AssetView series, which is software that comprehensively manages IT assets such as corporate personal computers (PCs) and PC networks from the perspective of security measures and provides solution services to comprehensively solve various issues surrounding IT asset management and operational support services. Sales digital transformation (DX) solution provides development, sales, and operational support services for Hot Profile and Hot Approach. Artificial intelligence (AI) data entry solution provides solutions for streamlining data entry operations based on AI optical character reader (AI OCR) technology, and its main products are AnyForm OCR and WOZE.

name: MRK HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: MRK HOLDINGS INC., formerly MARUKO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based apparel company. The Company is principally engaged in the purchase and retail of women's underwear, such as shapewear and lingerie, as well as health food and body care cosmetics, among others. The Company is also engaged in the provision of customer services, such as body makeup, to customers through its directly-managed stores nationwide in Japan. The Company sells products through direct-sale stores and franchise stores.

name: SEIKA CORP
businessSummary: SEIKA CORPORATION is engaged in sale of mechanical equipment in electric power, chemical and energy, industrial machinery, materials and measurement fields, as well as the related services. The Electric Power segment provides power generation facilities, environmental conservation facilities and the related equipment. The Chemical and Energy segment provides power generation equipment, environmental protection equipment and related equipment, as well as manufacturing equipment for processes. The Industrial Machinery segment provides machinery in medicine, food and beverage, brewing, plant engineering, textiles, publishing and printing fields, and the maintenance services. The Material and Measurement segment provides various materials, textile raw materials and other raw materials, as well as measuring instruments. The Global segment provides pumps, wastewater treatment equipment, textile and chemical equipment, raw materials and electronics packaging related equipment.

name: TAKAMATSU MACHINERY CO LTD
businessSummary: TAKAMATSU MACHINERY CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of machine tools and other industrial machines. The Company operates in three business segments. The Machine Tools segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale and the provision of maintenance services of computer numerically controlled (CNC) lathes, as well as the manufacture and sale of parts and collet chucks. The Information Technology (IT)-related Manufacturing Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture of IT-related manufacturing equipment. The Automobile Parts Processing segment is engaged in the processing of automobile parts.

name: GREE HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Gree Holdings Inc, formerly Gree Inc is a Japan-based company that manages the business operations of group companies. The Company operates five segments. The Game and Animation Business segment operates and develops various smartphone games on GREE, as well as WFS, Pokelabo, and GREE Entertainment. The Company also creates, develops, and produces IP. The Metaverse business segment develops and operates the smartphone metaverse REALITY and operates a VTuber office that manages and produces talents. The DX business segment provides DX support to client companies mainly in marketing fields. The Commerce Business segment develops the media business centered on the aumo excursion information media, as well as the software as a service (SaaS) business and the digital gift business. The Investment business segment invests mainly in the Internet and IT in Japan and overseas through fund investments and startup investments. The Others segment includes new development and other businesses.

name: TAKE AND GIVE NEEDS CO LTD
businessSummary: Take And Give Needs Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the domestic wedding business. The Company operates through the Domestic Wedding Business segment. The Domestic Wedding Business segment is involved in the planning and operation of domestic house weddings and restaurant weddings, as well as various product planning. The Company is also involved in the finance and credit business, travel business and childcare business.

name: NAIGAI CO LTD
businessSummary: NAIGAI CO.,LTD. is mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale, import and export of textile products such as socks. The Company operates in two business segments. The Wholesale segment is engaged in the plan, manufacture and sale of textile products such as socks. The Company outsources socks production to subcontractors and purchased products, and also imported products from trading companies including overseas subsidiaries. In addition, it exports products to overseas. The Mail Order segment is engaged in the development of mail-order sales of textiles and leather products through television, catalogs, and the Internet. The Company’s brands include NAIGAI COMFORT, NAIGAI PERFORMANCE, NAIGAI STYLE, NAIGAI TRADITIONAL and other.

name: ISUZU MOTORS LTD
businessSummary: Isuzu Motors Ltd is a Japan-based automobile manufacturer. The Company is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automobiles, parts, and industrial engines, and provides logistics and other services related to these products. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of commercial vehicles and light commercial vehicles (LCVs), such as large-sized trucks, buses, small-sized trucks and pick-up trucks, as well as automobile components and industrial engines.

name: HIRANO TECSEED CO LTD
businessSummary: Hirano Tecseed Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacturing and sales of coating-related equipment, chemical processing equipment and other industrial machinery. The Company has three segments. The Coating Equipment segment manufactures and sells coating and laminating equipment for applications including secondary battery electrodes, magnetic tape, packaging composite films, adhesive tapes, synthetic leather, flooring materials, wallpaper, decorative boards and insulation boards, as well as drying and heat treatment equipment. The Chemical Processing Equipment segment manufactures and sells polymer processing machinery for applications including plastic film, film deposition, electronic printed circuit boards, ceramic sheet forming and high-temperature processing, as well as vacuum deposition equipment and drying and heat treatment equipment. The Other segment manufactures, sells, repairs and modifies dyeing and finishing machinery and equipment parts.

name: SEIBU GIKEN CO LTD
businessSummary: Seibu Giken Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale, and provision of installation and other services for desiccant dehumidifiers and volatile organic compounds (VOC) concentrators. Desiccant dehumidifiers dehumidify air by adsorbing moisture inside a honeycomb using adsorbent materials such as silica gel or zeolite. Since air does not need to be cooled, it is characterized by its ability to dehumidify even at low temperatures or in low dew-point environments where there is little moisture in the air. VOC concentrators selectively adsorb volatile organic compounds, collectively known as benzene and toluene, which cause air pollution generated from paint, into the VOC concentrator rotor to make it possible to detoxify exhaust gas emissions by selectively adsorbing VOC concentrating rotors. Product-related services is engaged in the provision of installation, maintenance, and rotor replacement services.

name: QOL HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Qol Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the pharmacy business, business process outsourcing (BPO) business, and pharmaceutical business. It operates through three business segments. The Pharmacy Business segment manages insurance pharmacies and operates QOL Pharmacy. The BPO Business segment operates contract sales organization (CSO) business, contract research organization (CRO) business, temporary staffing business, and publishing-related businesses. The Pharmaceutical Business segment manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals.

name: TAIKISHA LTD
businessSummary: Taikisha Ltd is principally engaged in the environmental systems business and painting systems business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Environmental Systems segment offers general air-conditioning facilities for offices, schools, hotels, stores, research institutes, theaters, halls, hospitals and residential homes, as well as the industrial air-conditioning facilities for clean rooms in factories that manufacture semiconductors, electronic components, precision machinery, pharmaceuticals, foodstuffs and others. The Painting Systems segment provides the painting facilities for factories that manufacture vehicle bodies, bumpers, railway vehicles, construction vehicles and airplanes.

name: POLE TO WIN HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Pole To Win Holdings Inc, formerly Poletowin Pitcrew Holdings, Inc., is a holding company mainly engaged in the provision of Internet-related debug and verification services. The Company operates through two segments. The Testing and Verification & Evaluation segment is engaged in the detection of software bugs through the provision of debug services for home-use software, social applications, mobile contents, contents for smart phones and tablet personal computers (PCs), PC software, as well as pachinko (Japanese pinball) and pachisuro instruments, verification services for information technology (IT) home electronics, as well as translation services for home-use games, mobile contents and PC software. The Internet Supporting segment is engaged in the detection of illegal and harmful information. In addition, the Company is also engaged in the publishing and media businesses.

name: HS HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: HS Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the securities business. The Company operates in five segments. The Banking segment is engaged in deposit business and lending business. The Securities segment is engaged in the brokerage and commission of securities and derivative products, underwriting and sales of securities, handling of recruitment, sales of securities, handling of private offerings of securities, as well as other securities business. The Accounts Receivable Management business is engaged in the collection of perform credit management. Information Technology (IT) business is engaged in the development of mobile application and distribution of digital contents. The Other business is engaged in venture capital business and merger & acquisition business.

name: MAXELL LTD
businessSummary: Maxell Ltd, formerly Maxell Holdings Ltd, is mainly engaged in the manufacturing and sales of energy, industrial materials and electric appliances and consumer products. The Company mainly operates through three business segments. The Energy segment manufactures and sells secondary batteries, such as coin type lithium secondary batteries, industrial lithium ion batteries and electrodes, and consumer lithium ion batteries, primary batteries such as lithium primary batteries and button batteries, and charger and battery packs. The Industrial Materials segment manufactures and sells optical components, functional materials, electroforming and precision parts, semiconductor-related embedded systems, mold and synthetic resin molded parts, adhesive tapes, radio-frequency identification (RFID) systems and Integrated Circuit (IC) cards, industrial rubber products and others. The Electric Appliance and Consumer segment manufactures and sells projectors, small electric equipments and others.

name: KOA CORP
businessSummary: KOA Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of resistors, integrated circuits (ICs), composite components, and other circuit components for electronic devices both domestically and overseas. The Company operates through four regional segments: Japan, Asia, America, and Europe. Its main products include surface-mount resistors, low-ohmic resistors and power shunts, leaded resistors, temperature sensors and thermistors, inductors, fuses, varistors, low-temperature co-fired ceramics (LTCC) wiring boards and hybrid ICs, and others (check terminals and handling products).

name: MITSUBISHI KAKOKI KAISHA LTD
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Kakoki Kaisha Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in engineering business and industrial machinery business. The Company operates through two segments. The Engineering segment provides city gas and oil-related plants, various chemical industrial plants, hydrogen production equipment, sewage treatment equipment, industrial wastewater treatment equipment, various water treatment equipment, and corrosion-resistant containers made of fiberglass-reinforced plastic (FRP). The Industrial Machinery segment provides products such as oil purifiers, various separators and filters, dust removal equipment for seawater intake, and mixers.

name: ODK SOLUTIONS CO LTD
businessSummary: ODK Solutions Company, Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of information processing outsourcing services to school corporations, securities companies and general business corporations, as well as the provision of system integration for securities finance companies and others. The Company provides comprehensive information services, such as the operation, development and maintenance of information systems. The Company's main services include information processing outsourcing services, contract calculation services, software development, network construction services and office automation (OA) equipment sales.

name: MEBUKI FINANCIAL GROUP INC
businessSummary: Mebuki Financial Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of comprehensive financial services centered on banking business. The Company is mainly engaged in the provision of banking business, as well as other business related to financial services such as leasing business, securities business, credit guarantee business and credit card business.

name: PRONEXUS INC
businessSummary: PRONEXUS INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the production of corporate disclosure and investor relations (IR) related documents. The Company is involved in the provision of four kinds products. Listed companies disclosure-related products include the production support for the legal disclosure documents and contents of listed company. Listed companies IR-related products include the production support for the IR tools and contents of listed company. Financial products disclosure-related products include the production support for the legal disclosure documents and sales promotion tools for investment trust and real estate investment trust management companies. Database-related products include database for the searching of corporate information, financial information and legal information.

name: HONDA MOTOR CO LTD
businessSummary: Honda Motor Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the motorcycle business, the automobile business, the financial service business and the life creation business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Motorcycle segment is engaged in the research and development, production and sale of motorcycles, all-terrain vehicles (ATVs), side-by-side vehicles and related parts. The Automobile segment is engaged in the research and development, production and sale of automobiles and related parts. The Financial Service segment is engaged in the sales financing and leasing of its products. The Power Products and Other Business segment is engaged in the research and development, production and sale of power products and related parts.

name: DIAMOND ELECTRIC HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Diamond Electric Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of electronic control devices such as ignition coils and electrical components for automobiles. The Company operates through three business segments. The Automotive Equipment segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sale, and supply of maintenance services for automotive ignition coils and electrical components. The Energy Solutions segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sale, and supply of maintenance services for power conditioners for solar power generation and hybrid systems for energy storage. The Electronic Devices segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sale, and supply of maintenance services for ignition devices for home heating and cooling systems and hot water supply systems, electronic control devices, and other products.

name: TAIHEIYO CEMENT CORP
businessSummary: Taiheiyo Cement Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of cement products. The Company operates in four business segments. The Cement segment provides concrete. The Resources segment provides aggregates and limestone products. The Environmental Business segment provides waste recycling and desulfurization materials. The Building Materials & Construction segment provides secondary concrete products and lightweight foamed concrete (ALC). The Company also operates businesses related to real estate, engineering, information processing, finance, transportation and warehousing, chemical products, sports, and electric power supply.

name: SUN A. KAKEN CO LTD
businessSummary: Sun A. Kaken Company, Limited is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of light packing products, industrial materials and functional materials. The Company operates in three business segments. The Light Packing Materials segment manufactures and sells easy-to-unseal films, food packages, medical packaging materials, flexible drink containers and air buffering materials, among others. The Industrial Materials segment provides release coated papers, materials for adhesive tape, polyethylene laminated paper and resin cloths. The Functional Materials segment provides various surface protection films, as well as processed products of adhesive films. As of March 31, 2014, the Company had one subsidiary and two associated companies.

name: ADR ON TOKYO LIFESTYLE CO LTD
businessSummary: Tokyo Lifestyle Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the deal in Japanese-origin beauty and health products, household goods, luxury items, electronics, toys, and others. The Company operates drugstores. The Company is involved in the retail business of cosmetics, health foods, daily necessities, decorative goods, and confectionery. The Company operates and maintains online product sales systems. The Company also operates online mail order businesses. The Company operates in Japan, Hong Kong, North America, the UK, Thailand, and other countries, selling through directly operated stores, online shops, franchises, and wholesale.

name: KEIYO BANK LTD
businessSummary: Keiyo Bank Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of financial services centering on banking business. The Company is engaged in the provision of financial products and services to customers in the region by focusing on deposit and lending operations, as well as domestic and foreign exchange operations, agency services such as Bank of Japan agency, securities investment operations, over-the-counter sales of government bonds and other public bonds, investment trusts, and insurance products, and trust agency services. Other services include fund management, mergers and acquisitions (M&A) and consulting, credit card services, credit guarantee services, and collateral valuation services.

name: TASUKI HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Tasuki Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the life platform business, software as a service (SaaS) business, digital transformation (DX) consulting business, liquidation business, condominium sales business, and asset holding business. The life platform businesses include the business that develops and sells Internet of Things (IoT) residences for newly built investment, the refining business that acquires used properties, increases their value, and then sells them, as well as the asset management business. The SaaS business develops TASUKI TECH as a SaaS-type multi-platform for real estate developers. The finance consulting business provides real estate financing services. The Company conducts construction contract business, brokerage business, and real estate consulting business.

name: SUNNEXTA GROUP INC
businessSummary: Sunnexta Group Inc, formerly Japan Corporate Housing Service Inc is mainly engaged in the provision of solutions that solve issues related to human resources and general affairs. The Company operates in three business segments. The Corporate Housing Management Agency segment is engaged in the outsourcing business of company housing, dormitories and parking lots for client companies. It provides client company management services such as introduction of rented company housing properties, contract and occupancy procedures, payment of rent, and checking of restoration costs when leaving. The Facility Management segment provides total management services from repairs based on facility management centered on condominiums. The Others segment provides cost reduction and operational efficiency services for the management departments of client companies, and secure support services for systems, equipment, and equipment related to crime prevention, disaster prevention, security and safety.

name: TAKANO CO LTD
businessSummary: TAKANO CO.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of living related equipment, inspection and measurement equipment, industrial equipment and exterior products, as well as the sale of machine and tools. The Company operates through five business segments. The Living Related Equipment segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of office chairs, as well as chairs for medical and healthcare facilities. The Inspection and Measurement Equipment segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of atomic force microscope (AFM) equipment and film inspection equipment. The Industrial Equipment segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of solenoid actuators and unit components. The Exterior Product segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of flip-up gates, carports, terraces and awnings. The Machine and Tool segment is mainly engaged in the purchase and sale of machine and tools.

name: MITSUBISHI LOGISTICS CORP
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Logistics Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the logistic business. It has two business segments. The Logistic segment is engaged in the warehousing, land transportation, port transportation and international transportation handling businesses. The warehousing business involves depositing, storing, warehousing, unloading, and other operations. The land transportation business transports cargo and acts as a transportation agent. The port transportation business involves the loading and unloading of cargo, transportation, carrying in and out of sheds and other cargo handling areas, storage. The international transportation handling business involves development of international transportation systems, and handling of international transportation of goods. The Real Estate segment involves the rental and management of buildings, the management and operation of parking lots and shopping centers, the design and contracting of various construction works and real estate sales.

name: AIR WATER INC
businessSummary: Air Water Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacture and sale of industrial gas, chemical, medical, energy related products. It has eight business segments. Industrial Gas-related segment manufactures and sells industrial gas and installs high-pressure gas equipment. Chemical-related segment manufactures basic and fine chemical products. Medical-related segment provides medical gas products and hospital equipment construction. Energy-related segment offers liquefied petroleum gas and kerosene. Agriculture and Food-related segment manufactures and sells fruit, vegetables, frozen food, processed meat products and soft drinks. Logistics-related segment provides logistics service on high pressure gas and general cargo. Seawater-related segment manufactures and sells salts and salt-making by-products, as well as fused magnesia and magnesium oxide. The Other segment consist of aerosol business. It also develops green chemicals and biofuels and provides rehabilitation system.

name: GOLDCREST CO LTD
businessSummary: Goldcrest Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in real estate development and related businesses, primarily in popular areas of the Tokyo metropolitan region. The Company operates through four business segments. The Real Estate Sales segment plans, develops and sells new condominiums under brands including Crest City and Crest Form. The Real Estate Leasing segment engages in the rental of office buildings, condominiums and other properties. The Real Estate Management segment provides comprehensive management services for condominiums and other properties. The Hotel segment operates and manages hotels. The Company is also involved in real estate brokerage, sales agency services, loan administration and advertising and promotional services.

name: NORITAKE CO LTD
businessSummary: Noritake Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacturing and sales of products in the industrial products, ceramics materials, engineering and tabletop divisions. The Company operates in four business segments. The Industrial Products segment, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells grinding wheels, diamond tools, cutting and offset grinding wheels and others. The Ceramic Materials segment, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells electronic pastes, transfer paper, painting materials, thick-film circuit boards, gypsum, ceramic cores, porous ceramic components and others. The Engineering segment manufactures and sells firing furnaces, drying furnaces, mixing equipment, filtration equipment, carbide circular saw cutting machines, road cutters and others. The Tabletop segment manufactures and sells ceramic tableware, other tableware-related products, decorations and art objects.

name: KYOKUTO SECURITIES CO LTD
businessSummary: KYOKUTO SECURITIES CO., LTD. is a financial company. The Company's main business consists of securities dealing and securities brokerage. It operates in four business segments along with its related companies. Financial Product Trade segment is engaged in the domestic financial instruments dealing. Real Estate segment is engaged in the operation of real estate business specializing in the rental of stores. The Investment segment is engaged in the investment business. Investment segment is engaged in the operation of investment business. Investigation and Research segment is engaged in the investigation and research of domestic and overseas economic and financial securities markets.

name: DKK-TOA CORP
businessSummary: DKK-TOA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company principally engaged in measurement instrument business and real estate leasing business. The Company operates its business through two business segments. Measurement Instrument Business segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of environmental and process analysis instruments, scientific analysis instruments, industrial gas detection alarms, as well as electrodes and standard solutions. The segment also provides maintenance services. Real Estate Leasing Business segment owns one rental building adjacent to the Company in Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo and conducts real estate leasing business.

name: JAIC CO LTD
businessSummary: JAIC Co.,Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in education-integrated recruitment services. The college business is engaged in the provision of education-integrated human resource introduction services and educational opportunities for SMEs with less than 300 employees. The Company is also engaged in the provision of a wide range of detailed education and training services including Job College service, Women's College service, Second College service, New College service, Leader College service, Seven Habits training service, Harada Method training service, Discovery training service, and new employee training Basics of Work services.

name: NIPPON KINZOKU CO LTD
businessSummary: NIPPON KINZOKU CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of cold-rolled stainless steel strips, specially polished steel strips and processed products, as well as the development of related business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Polished Steel Strip segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of cold-rolled stainless steel strips and polished specialty steel strips. The Processed Product segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of mold steel and stainless precision steel.

name: DIGITAL HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Digital Holdings Inc, formerly OPT Holding Inc is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the Internet advertising business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Marketing segment provides Internet advertising for large companies, digital marketing, related services, and digital marketing solutions for local small and medium enterprises. The Synergy Investment segment is involved in the investment in Internet-related venture companies, the information collecting in the United States, the development of artificial intelligence (AI) and AI platforms, the provision of digital shift support education services for companies, and the general trade operated in China.

name: DIVE INC
businessSummary: Dive Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the tourism human resources (HR) business, regional revitalization business, and information system business. The Company operates through three segments. The Tourism HR Business segment provides HR services specializing in resort jobs, and provides temporary staffing and placement services to resort hotels and inns, restaurants, theme parks, leisure facilities, ski resorts, and other tourist facilities throughout Japan. The Regional Revitalization Business segment operates lodging facilities such as glamping facilities in five locations throughout Japan. The Information System Business segment provides general support services for clients' information systems.

name: KANSAI ELECTRIC POWER CO INC
businessSummary: Kansai Electric Power Co Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the comprehensive energy and power provision business, the information and communication business, and the real estate business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Energy segment is engaged in the provision of solutions such as electricity, gas, and utility services. The Power Transmission and Distribution segment is engaged in the safe and stable supply of electricity. The Information Technology & Telecommunications segment is engaged in the provision of comprehensive information and telecommunications services. The Living & Business Solutions segment is engaged in the provision of real estate-related services and lifestyle and business-related services.

name: TORAY INDUSTRIES INC
businessSummary: Toray Industries Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the textile business, functional chemicals business, carbon fiber composite materials and other businesses. It has five business segments. Textile segment provides nylon, polyester, cotton, spun yarns, woven and knitted fabrics, nonwoven fabrics, artificial leather and apparel products. Functional Chemicals segment provides nylon, acrylonitrile butadiene styrene (ABS), polybutylene terephthalate (PBT), polyphenylene sulfide (PPS) and other resins products, polyester, electronic information materials and others. Carbon Fiber Composite Materials segment provides carbon fibers, carbon fiber composite materials and carbon fiber molded products. Environment and Engineering segment provides water treatment equipment, information-related equipment, and construction materials. Life Sciences segment manufactures, processes and sells the pharmaceuticals and medical equipment. It also provides analysis, investigation and research services.

name: ENBIO HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: EnBio Holdings, Inc is a holding company principally engaged in the environmental business. The Company, together with its subsidiaries, operates through three business segments. Soil Contamination Countermeasures segment is engaged in the investigation of soil contamination, design and construction of purification work, and risk consulting to its customers. Soil Contamination Related Equipment And Materials Sales segment is engaged in the import and sale of equipment, materials and purification agents used in onsite investigation and remediation. Brown Field Utilization segment is engaged in the purchase of polluted land and resale of it after purification. As of March 31, 2013, the Company had three subsidiaries and one associated company.

name: NIPPON PAPER INDUSTRIES CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Paper Industries Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the paper and paperboard business, lifestyle-related business, energy business, and wood, building materials, civil engineering, and construction-related business. It has four business segments. The Paper and Paperboard Business segment manufactures and sells paper, paperboard, pulp, and papermaking raw materials. The Lifestyle-related Business segment manufactures and sells household paper, processed paper products, and chemical products. The Energy Business segment manufactures and sells electricity. The Wood, Building materials, Civil Engineering, and Construction-related Business segment purchases and sells wood, manufactures and sells building materials, and engages in civil engineering and construction. Other businesses include logistics and leisure businesses.

name: KAWAI MUSICAL INSTRUMENTS MANUFACTURING
businessSummary: KAWAI MUSICAL INSTRUMENTS MANUFACTURING CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of musical instruments, material processing and information-related business. It has two business segments. Musical Instrument Education segment is engaged in the sale of pianos, electronic musical instruments, musical instrument toys and wind, strings and percussion instruments, the operation of music and physical education classes, the provision of musical instrument tuning and repair service, and the publication and sale of music scores and books. It is also engaged in the manufacture and sale of software used in music education. Material Processing segment is engaged in metal materials processing for electronic and electrical parts, automotive parts, as well as the manufacture and sale of pig iron castings and materials of soundproof rooms and acoustic components. It is also engaged in information-related business, finance-related business, insurance agency business.

name: CHUOKEIZAI-SHA HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Chuokeizai-Sha Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in publishing business that publishes and sells specialized books and magazines related to corporate management and other fields, as well as publishing related business about advertising contract agent. The publishing business is engaged in the planning, editing, production and sale of books, magazines, and mooks, as well as the planning and production of corporate PR magazines and newsletters. The publishing related business is engaged in advertising agency contract business for media mainly in the fields of tax and accounting, as well as the planning and production of corporate product catalogs and sales promotion brochures. The Company is also engaged in the storage, loading & unloading, inventory management of publications, as well as the management and leasing of real estate.

name: DENA CO LTD
businessSummary: DeNA Co Ltd mainly provides Internet services for mobile and personal computers (PC). The Company operates in five business segments. The Game segment provides mobile game-related services such as Mobage, which distributes game applications in Japan and overseas. The Live Streaming segment provides live streaming services such as Pococha and IRIAM in Japan and overseas. The Sports segment provides sports related services such as Yokohama DeNA BayStars and Yokohama Stadium, and Kawasaki Brave Thunders and Sports Club Sagamihara in Japan. The Healthcare and Medical segment provides health big data related services and healthcare and medical related services such as Join, which is a medical digital transformation (DX) related service, in Japan and overseas. The New Business and Other segment provides new businesses and other services in Japan, such as e-commerce (EC) business and other new businesses.

name: LAOX HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Laox Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in domestic retail business, overseas business, lifestyle fashion business, and asset business. The Company operates through four segments. The Domestic Retail segment sells mainly food and cosmetics in domestic shops through real shops and online stores. The Overseas segment focuses on high-quality Japanese products and develops trade, global e-commerce (EC) and support for expansion into China through various channels and networks, whether direct-to-consumer (BtoC) or business-to-business (BtoB), real or online. The Lifestyle Fashion segment sells gift-related products through multiple sales channels. The Asset segment is engaged in the operation and management of commercial complexes, restaurants, and cultural events, and the sale and brokerage of real estate.

name: T&D HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: T&D Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the life insurance business. The Company operates four business segments. The Taiyo Life Insurance segment provides life insurance services to the household market. The Daido Life Insurance segment provides life insurance business to the small and medium-sized business market. The T&D Financial Life Insurance segment operates with the boarding agency market as its respective sales market and has different sales products under its own sales policy. The T&D United Capital segment is engaged in strategic business investments in the life insurance business and new growth business areas.

name: WATAHAN & CO LTD
businessSummary: Watahan & Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the retail business, construction business and trading business. The Company operates in three segments.
