The Retail segment is dealing with the home center items, daily goods, processed foods, fresh foods, prepared dishes etc. It also provides a one-stop shopping center where shopping is completed at one place by having a wide range of everyday necessities. The Construction segment is engaged in various construction works such as interior and exterior work, multi-purpose parking lot construction, civil engineering construction work and sales of civil engineering materials, etc. The Trading segment is engaged in the import and sales of pharmaceutical raw materials such as witepzole, acetaminophen, dalteparin, nitroglycerin etc. as well as raw materials for chemical products such as candelilla, jojoba oil, yucca, chicle etc. Other business involves in real estate leasing business.

name: AZ-COM MARUWA HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: AZ-Com Maruwa Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the logistics business that primarily includes third-party logistics (3PL) and transportation and delivery services. The Logistics Business segment is mainly engaged in center operation, general cargo transportation and warehousing business. Others provide services, including document storage rental business and real estate rental business. It conducts business activities in Japan.

name: ROLAND CORP
businessSummary: Roland Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the electronic musical instrument business. The Company is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of electronic musical instruments. The main products include electronic pianos, electronic drums, synthesizers, guitar related equipment, dance and disc jockey (DJ) related equipment, video related equipment, effectors, musical instrument amplifiers and others. The Company is also engaged in the development and sale of software products for music and media producers, the sale of headphone products, as well as the manufacture and sale of electronic organs.

name: MATSUDA SANGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Matsuda Sangyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the precious metals-related business and the food-related business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Precious Metals-related Business segment is engaged in the recovery and refining of precious metals, the sale of precious metal bullion, chemical products, electronic materials and others, and the collection, transportation, and disposal of industrial waste. The Food-related Business segment is engaged in the sale and transportation of raw materials for food processing, such as seafood, agricultural products, and livestock products.

name: DAIWA HOUSE INDUSTRY CO LTD
businessSummary: Daiwa House Industry Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly is engaged in comprehensive business operations in the lifestyle infrastructure industry. The Company operates through six core business segments. The Detached Houses segment is engaged in custom-building and sales of detached houses. The Rental Houses segment is engaged in development, construction, management, operation, and brokerage of rental housing. The Condominium segment develops, sells, and manages condominiums. The Commercial Facilities segment develops, constructs, manages, and operates commercial facilities. The Business Facilities segment develops, constructs, manages, and operates logistics and manufacturing facilities, medical and nursing care facilities, and other facilities. The Environmental Energy segment includes the development and construction of renewable energy power plants, renewable energy power generation, and electricity retailing. The Company also develops other businesses.

name: AJIS CO LTD
businessSummary: AJIS CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in physical inventory service business and retail support service business. The Company operates its business through three business segments. Domestic Inventory Service Business segment conducts the physical inventory service business in Japan. Retail Support Service Business segment conducts retail support service business including centralized replenishment service, staffing, customer service, check service, as well as advertising planning and production. Overseas Inventory Service Business segment conducts the physical inventory service business overseas.

name: STAR MICRONICS CO LTD
businessSummary: Star Micronics Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the special machinery business and machine tool business. It operates through two business segments. The Special Machinery Business segment manufactures and sells small printers. The Machine Tool Business segment manufactures and sells computer numerically controlled (CNC) automatic lathes and other machine tools. It operates in Japan, the United States, the United Kingdom, Thailand, Europe, and Asia.

name: TOHO ZINC CO LTD
businessSummary: Toho Zinc Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of non-ferrous metal products, the exploration, development and production of non-ferrous metal resources, the manufacture and sale of electronic parts, environment and recycle business, the logistics and other business. The Company operates in four businesses. The Smelting & Refining segment manufactures and sells zinc and lead products, electrolytic silver, and sulfuric acid. The Environment & Recycling segment manufactures and sells zinc oxide and waste treatment and reclamation. The Mineral Resources segment explores, develops, produces, and sells non-ferrous metal resources. The Electronic Components & Functional Materials segment manufactures and sells electronic components, electrolytic iron, plating, and equipment components. The Company also operates businesses related to soundproofing materials, civil engineering, construction, plant engineering, transportation, and environmental analysis.

name: RHYTHM CO LTD
businessSummary: Rhythm Co Ltd, formerly Rhythm Watch Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company engaged in the clocks business, connection terminal business, precision business, and electronic business. The Company has four business segments. The Connection Terminal segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of tab terminals, taping terminals, terminal blocks and others used in automobiles, solar power generation and home appliances. The Clock segment is engaged in the provision of clocks such as wall clocks, table clocks, alarm clocks, digital clocks, equipment clocks, clock movements, universal serial bus fans and disaster prevention administrative radios. The Electronic segment is engaged in the provision of electronic manufacturing services (EMS) for electronic devices, information related devices, in-vehicle devices. The Precision segment is engaged in the provision of precision parts for industrial equipment, optical equipment, office and communication equipment. It also operates logistics business.

name: SANOYAS HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Sanoyas Holdings Corporation is a holding company mainly engaged in the shipbuilding business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Shipbuilding segment is mainly engaged in the building bulk carriers for domestic and overseas ship owners, and repair of ships for private and government vessels. The Land segment is involved in the manufacture and rental of elevators for construction work; the manufacture and maintenance of mechanical parking devices; the manufacture of mechanical parts and other products; the engineering work of air conditioning, drainage and environmental work; software development; sales of ship equipment; security business; management of real estate; as well as insurance agent business. The Leisure segment is engaged in manufacture of amusement park machine, management of amusement parks, operation and maintenance of amusement facilities, operation of Ferris wheel and accompanying facilities, and management of leisure facilities.

name: OSAKA STEEL CO LTD
businessSummary: Osaka Steel Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the steel business. The Company group is comprehensively engaged in the production and sale of ordinary steel products, as well as their transportation. It is engaged in the manufacture and sale of steel products such as steel sections, bars, and flat steel, as well as steel billets and processed steel products, as well as the transportation and on-site work of steel products.

name: OSAKA GAS CO LTD
businessSummary: Osaka Gas Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in domestic energy and gas, domestic energy and electric power, overseas energy and life and business solutions businesses. The Company consists of three business segments. The Domestic Energy Business segment is engaged in the production, supply, and sales of city gas, sales of gas appliances, gas piping installation, liquefied natural gas (LNG) sales, LNG transportation, liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) sales, industrial gas sales, and power generation and electricity sales. The Overseas Energy Business segment is engaged in development, investment, and energy supply related to natural gas, etc. The Life & Business Solutions segment develops and leases real estate, provides information processing services, and sells fine materials and carbon materials products.

name: MITSUBOSHI CO LTD
businessSummary: MITSUBOSHI CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of rubber electric wires, plastic electric wires, extruded synthetic resin products and electrical heating wires. The Company operates through three business segments. The Electric Wire segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of natural rubber-sheathed flexible cables, synthetic rubber-sheathed flexible cables, polyethylene cables, welding cables, control cables, plastic-sheathed flexible cables and plastic cords. The Polymatech segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of extruded synthetic plastic products, injection synthetic products, vacuum synthetic products and high performance tubes. The Electrical Heating Wire segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of electrical heating wires and ribbons.

name: MUSASHI SEIMITSU INDUSTRY CO LTD
businessSummary: Musashi Seimitsu Industry Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive powertrain parts, suspension parts, steering parts, and transmission parts. The Company operates its business through five geographical segments: Japan, Americas, Asia, China and Europe. Its products are used in industries such as automobiles, machine tools, and industrial machines. Powertrain (PT) products includes planetary gear assemblies, differential gear assemblies, bevel gears, ring gears, camshafts, and balance shafts. The linkage and suspension (L&S) products include suspension arm assemblies, suspension ball joints, steering ball joints, and various joints for connection. Motorcycle products include motorcycle transmission gear assemblies, motorcycle camshafts, motorcycle kick starter components, other motorcycle drivetrain components, and general-purpose engine components.

name: TS TECH CO LTD
businessSummary: TS Tech Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automobile and motorcycle parts. It operates through four regional segments, including Japan, Americas, China, and Asia & Europe. Japan, Americas, and Asia & Europe segments are mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automobile seats and interior parts, and motorcycle seats and plastic parts. China segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automobile seats and interior parts.

name: IMAGE MAGIC INC
businessSummary: Image Magic Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in developing its business as a digital transformation (DX) company for manufacturing that utilizes the system. The On-demand Print Solution (ODPS) segment provides on-demand print services for products such as apparel and miscellaneous goods using the Internet, and provides on-demand print mechanisms to businesses such as apparel makers and printing companies. The on-demand print service is a service that prints and delivers the data submitted by the customer through the Internet site in a short delivery time from the order received, and is promoted by two channels, in-house sales and orders from partner companies. ODPS provides a production management system that has been improved with DX know-how as a cloud service, and sells hardware (printers, folding machines, packing and shipping machines) related to the production and shipping processes cultivated through the on-demand print service.

name: TOHOKU ELECTRIC POWER CO INC
businessSummary: Tohoku Electric Power Co Inc is mainly engaged in the power supply business. It operates in two segments. The Power Generation and Sales segment supplies electricity from thermal, nuclear, and renewable energy sources, provides services using renewable energy, retails electricity and provides solution services, and provides corporate and indirect functions. The Power Transmission and Distribution segment provides power network services.

name: LAXUS TECHNOLOGIES INC
businessSummary: Laxus Technologies Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of Luxus, a subscription-based sharing service for branded bags to general consumers in Japan. The Company provides the opportunities for general consumers to use high-quality branded bags through smartphone apps and Internet sites. The Company operates through a subscription service with a flat-rate fee. The age range of Luxus users is from their 20s to 50s, with the majority being in their 30s and 40s. The Company also allows users to purchase any rental bag they like, and also starts business to business/consumer (BtoB/C) sales, which selects the most appropriate sales destination from domestic reuse select shops, auctions, overseas e-commerce sites depending on the market value of the bag.

name: TOYO CONSTRUCTION CO LTD
businessSummary: Toyo Construction Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the general construction business, including marine and land civil engineering and building construction, as well as real estate operations. The Company operates through four business segments. The Domestic Civil Engineering segment and the Domestic Building Construction segment are engaged in civil engineering and building construction projects within Japan. The Overseas Construction segment undertakes civil engineering and building construction projects outside Japan. The Real Estate segment engages in real estate sales and leasing in Japan. the Company is also involved in insurance agency services, sales and leasing of goods, vessel leasing, as well as the manufacturing and sales of sanitary equipment and indoor and outdoor toilet facilities.

name: STG CO LTD
businessSummary: STG Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the casting, processing and sale of metal parts. The Company is mainly engaged in the design of metal molds, as well as the casting, processing, finishing and chemical conversion of magnesium alloy parts and other metal parts. The Company is mainly engaged in the production of magnesium alloy parts and other metal parts for projectors, single-lens reflex cameras, automobiles, copiers and medical devices.

name: TAUNS LABORATORIES INC
businessSummary: Tauns Laboratories Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the business of developing, manufacturing and marketing in vitro diagnostic products and research reagents. The Company operates its business in the in vitro diagnostic products business segment. The Company’s main product is antigen test kit that uses immunochromatography to enable rapid diagnosis at the patient's side without the need for special equipment. The products include ImunoAce Flu, ImunoAce SARSCoV-2 II, ImunoAce SARSCoV-2 Saliva, ImunoAce SARSCoV-2/Flu, ImunoAce Adeno, ImunoAce Strep A Neo, ImunoAce hMPV, ImunoAce Mycopiasma, ImunoAce RSV Neo and ImunoAce Noro.

name: GRANDY HOUSE CORP
businessSummary: Grandy House Corporation is a Japan-based real estate company. The Company operates in three segments. The Real Estate Sales segment is engaged in the purchase of land for sales, the authorization of development licenses, the management of residential land developing works, the design, construction and sale of housings, as well as the provision of maintenance services. The Construction Material Sales segment is engaged in the sale of construction materials and members with a focus on precut materials. The Real Estate Leasing segment is involved in the leasing of buildings and condominiums, as well as the parking business.

name: JAPAN EYEWEAR HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Japan Eyewear Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of eyeglasses through its subsidiaries. The Company operates in two business segments. The Kaneko Optical Business segment encompasses the businesses of each brand category under the Kaneko Optical brand and provides fashionable eyeglasses based on trends. The Four Nines business segment encompasses business by brand category under the Four Nines brand, designs and sells luxury brand eyeglasses, and has an sales network of directly managed stores and dealers.

name: LOGOS HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Logos Holdings Inc is mainly engaged in the housing sales business. Through the subsidiaries, the Company mainly provides services related to custom-built homes, condominiums, and land sales, renovations and group homes, support for construction companies including housing design assistance and information technology (IT) consulting, Computer-Aided Design (CAD) operations including housing assistance and cost estimation. The Company also designs, constructs, and sells housing, buys and sells real estate, and provides brokerage and mediation for target customers using the products and brands of the subsidiaries. The Company operates custom-built housing business, digital transformation (DX) support business, and offshore development business. The DX support business supports digital efficiency in the housing industry. The offshore development business is engaged in the residential offshore CAD service business.

name: EDULAB INC
businessSummary: EduLab Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of testing development, implementation, analysis, educational services for English and other tests. The Company operates through five segments. The Testing and Other Licensing segment provides testing services and learning services centered on languages to educational institutions, private companies, and individuals. The Educational Platform segment provides and operates learning services such as Stagia Eiken, Stagia Kanken, and Stagia Math Test, as well as media services. The Test Center segment establishes test centers nationwide and provides test centers for various qualifications, certification exams, and university entrance exams. The Artificial Intelligence (AI) segment provides services and products using AI technology researched and developed in-house. The Test Operation and Outsourcing segment provides services related to test question creation, system construction, management, operation, and scoring.

name: TEAR CORP
businessSummary: TEAR Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the funeral business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Funeral segment is in the operation of directly-managed funeral hall, under the name Funeral Hall Tear in Tokai, Kanto and Kansai. It engages in implementation of funeral ceremonies at directly-managed funeral halls, individual homes and temples, as well as in the provision of Buddhist memorial services for end of mourning and anniversary of death after the funeral ceremonies. This segment also established a unique membership system under the name Tear’s Association. The Franchise segment provides Funeral Hall Tear business nationwide, signs a franchise agreement for business companies of different industries. It is engaged in the provision of entrance know-how to the funeral service industry, development of properties, provision of operational guidance with supervisors, as well as sales of funeral incidental products.

name: KANTO DENKA KOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: KANTO DENKA KOGYO CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the fine chemicals business and basic chemicals business. The Company operates through five business segments. The Basic Chemical segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of basic chemicals such as inorganic and organic chemicals. The Fine Chemical segment is involved in the fine chemicals such as fluorine gas and battery materials. The Iron segment is involved in the sale of basic chemicals and fine chemical, as well as the maintenance of containers. The Equipment segment is involved in the equipment related work. The Company’s main products include silicon tetrafluoride (CF4), sulfur hexafluoride (SF6), lithium hexafluorophosphate (LiPF6), magnetite, liquid caustic soda, aluminum chloride and vinylidene chloride, among others.

name: NS TOOL CO LTD
businessSummary: NS Tool Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the production and sale of end mills, which are cutting tools that are attached to machining centers (machine tools) to process metals. The Company operates in two business segments. End Mill segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cutting tools centering on carbide small-diameter end mills. Others segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of plastic moldings focusing on tool cases. The product sizes include end mill (6mm or less), end mill (over 6mm), and end mill (others).

name: HOKURIKU ELECTRIC POWER CO
businessSummary: Hokuriku Electric Power Company is a Japan-based company engaged in supply of electricity mainly to Toyama Prefecture, Ishikawa Prefecture, Fukui Prefecture and part of Gifu Prefecture. The Company is mainly engaged in general electricity business, such as supply of electricity. The segment is also engaged in the maintenance of power equipment, power related facility operation and management business, equipment maintenance and construction work business, manufacture and sale of materials and equipment, management and service of real estate, commercial business as well as information and communication business. The materials and equipment business is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of power products and equipment, such as concrete products, electricity meters, switches and transformers. The real estate management business includes the energy solution business, rental and management business of real estate, as well as staffing business.

name: MIZUHO FINANCIAL GROUP INC
businessSummary: Mizuho Financial Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the banking, trust banking, securities, and other financial services. The Company operates through five business segments: Retail & Business Corporations Company (RBC), Corporate & Investment Banking Company (CIBC), Global Corporate & Investment Banking Company (GCIBC), Global Markets Company (GMC), and Asset Management Company (AMC). The CIBC segment operates for clients of large corporate corporations, financial corporations and public corporations in Japan. The GCIBC segment operates for clients of overseas-affiliated Japanese companies and non-Japanese companies. The GMC segment is engaged in investment business in interest rates, equity, among others. The AMC segment is engaged in the development and provision of products that meet the asset management needs of clients from individuals to institutional investors.

name: JFE HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: JFE Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning of business strategy, the management of business and risk, as well as the presentation of group investor information. The Company mainly operates its business through three segments. The Steel segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of steel products, processed steel products and raw materials, as well as the delivery, facility maintenance and construction businesses. The Engineering segment is engaged in engineering, recycling, and electric power retailing businesses related to energy, urban environment, steel structures, and industrial machinery. The Trading segment purchases, processes, and sells steel products, raw materials for steelmaking, non-ferrous metal products, and food products.

name: ARCLANDS CORP
businessSummary: Arclands Corp, formerly Arcland Sakamoto Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in retail business, wholesale business, restaurant business and real estate business. The Company operates through four segments. The Retail segment sells household goods, household products, food products and other items to general consumers and professionals (contractors) through Home Centre Musashi, Super Center Musashi, Musashi Pro, NicoPet, Super Viva Home, Viva Home, arts and crafts specialist Ark Oasis, Vysees, and food specialty store Musashi Shokuhinkan. The Wholesale segment mainly sells do-it-yourself (DIY)-related products to home centers nationwide and group companies. The Restaurant segment operates restaurants such as Katsuya, a pork cutlet specialty restaurant. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing of real estate. In addition, the Company also operates a sports club JOYFIT and a fitness gym FIT365.

name: TVE CO LTD
businessSummary: TVE Co Ltd, formerly Toa Valve Engineering Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance of various industrial valves, as well as the decontamination and decommissioning business. The Company has three business segments. The Valve segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale, dismantlement, inspection, repair and maintenance of high temperature and high pressure valves for power plants such as nuclear power plants and thermal power plants, and various industrial valves and parts for ships, petrochemical plants and others, as well as the manufacture of cast steel parts for valve products. The Steelmaking segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cast steel products for construction equipment and other industries. The Decontamination segment is engaged in the radioactive removal business in Fukushima Prefecture.

name: BRIDGESTONE CORP
businessSummary: Bridgestone Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the tire business. The Company operates its business through five business segments. The Japan segment is engaged in the premium tire business, the solutions business, and the chemicals and diversified products business. The China, Asia, and Oceania segment is engaged in the premium tire business and the solutions business. The Americas segment is engaged in the premium tire business, solutions business, and diversified products business. The Europe, Russia, Middle East, India and Africa segment is engaged in premium tire business and solution business. The Others segment is engaged in other businesses.

name: HOWA MACHINERY LTD
businessSummary: Howa Machinery,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of machine tools, pneumatic hydraulic equipment and electronic machines, firearms, building materials and specially equipped vehicles. The Company operates through six business segments. The Machine Tool-related segment is engaged in the production of machining centers, various special-purpose machines, and pneumatic hydraulic equipment. The Firearms segment is engaged in the production of rifles, mortars and hunting rifles. The Domestic Sales Subsidiary segment is engaged in the sale of steel and other products. The Building Materials segment is engaged in the production of aluminum sash doors, steel sash doors, and waterproof boards. The Specially Equipped Vehicle segment is engaged in the production of road cleaning vehicles, industrial cleaning machines, automatic floor cleaning machines. The Real Estate Rental segment is engaged in the leasing of land and buildings.

name: SUN LIFE HOLDING CO LTD
businessSummary: SUN LIFE HOLDING CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based holding company engaged in the operation and management of group companies which conduct ceremony, nursing care and other related business. The Company provides hotel & bridal service, funeral & Buddhist sermon service, nursing care service and other related services, for regional customers and mutual aid association members in the members' system (mutual benefit association). The Company’s subsidiary SUN LIFE CORPORATION operates in four business segments: hotel business, ceremonial business, other business and company-wide (common).

name: ODAWARA AUTO-MACHINE MFG CO LTD
businessSummary: ODAWARA AUTO-MACHINE MFG.CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of bus fare collection equipment and the provision of maintenance services for its products. The Company's products and goods include bus fare collection equipment-related products, such as fare collection equipment with immediate calculating function and general function, and safes and software for fare collection equipment, card equipment-related products, such as magnetic card systems, noncontact integrated circuit(IC) card systems and software for card equipment, as well as other equipment for bus, such as numbered ticket issuing equipment, checkout devices, data management servers, liquid crystal display (LCD) fare displays and related software, among others. The Company is also involved in the manufacture and sale of light-emitting diode (LED) fare displays, routing display systems, roll paper for numbered ticket issuing equipment.

name: ASUKANET CO LTD
businessSummary: Asukanet Company, Limited is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the digital processing and production of photos and images. The Company operates in three business segments. The Memorial Design Services segment is engaged in the provision of digital processing services for portraits of deceased persons, the provision of funeral-related production services. The Personal Publishing Services segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of individual photo albums targeting at the professional photography markets and general consumer markets. The Aerial Imaging segment is engaged in the research and marketing activities related to aerial imaging technology.

name: UNITED SUPER MARKETS HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: United Super Markets Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the supermarket business and related support businesses. The Supermarket segment is engaged in the supermarket business, mainly selling food products, daily necessities, and clothing, as well as the fresh food processing business, food processing, manufacturing and sales, vegetable processing and packaging, and prepared food manufacturing. In addition, the Company is also engaged in the real estate business, product development business, quality control and quality inspection business, contract business, temporary staffing business, education business, retail store operation business such as cash registers, facility management business, store support contract business, and agricultural production business.

name: MENICON CO LTD
businessSummary: Menicon Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the vision care business and others. The Vision Care Business segment manufactures and sells contact lenses and contact lens care products. Besides traditional hard and soft contact lenses, the Company manufactures and sells disposable contact lenses, including daily disposable, biweekly, and monthly replacement contact lenses. The Company also manufactures and sells contact lens care products, which are solutions for cleaning, disinfecting, and storing contact lenses. The Company also offers a flat-rate membership system called Menicon Eye Life Support Plan. By paying an initiation fee and a fixed monthly membership fee, the Company offers coverage for loss, damage, and prescription changes, allowing users to continue wearing contact lenses safely and optimally. Other businesses include the development and sale of veterinary medical products, materials for promoting rice straw decomposition and others.

name: CASIO COMPUTER CO LTD
businessSummary: Casio Computer Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the business of developing and producing consumer and system products through to sales and service. The Company operates through four business segments. The Watches and clocks segment is engaged in the provision of watches and clocks. The Consumer segment is engaged in the provision of electronic dictionaries, calculators, electronic stationery, electronic musical instruments. The Systems segment is engaged in the provision of handheld terminals, electronic cash registers, management support systems. The Others segment is engaged in the provision of molded parts and molds.

name: HASEKO CORP
businessSummary: Haseko Corp is mainly engaged in housing related business. The Company mainly operates in four business segments. The Construction-related segment is engaged in the planning, design and construction of condominiums, the contract construction, as well as the sale and rental of construction materials and equipment. The Real Estate-related segment is engaged in the management of condominium sales business, the sale and rental of condominiums, and the sale of detached houses. The Service-related segment is engaged in the repair of condominiums, interior renovation, rental and rental management of condominiums, management of company housing, sale of condominiums, real estate distribution brokerage, printing business, building management of condominiums, operation of paid nursing homes, and nursing care insurance business. Its Oversea-related segment is engaged in the development and sale of real estate and the operation of commercial facilities in the United States.

name: JAPAN BUSINESS SYSTEMS INC
businessSummary: Japan Business Systems Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in providing cloud services, consulting and information technology (IT) services. The Company operates through three business segments. The Cloud Integration segment mainly supports the introduction of Microsoft's cloud products Azure (Microsoft Azure) / M365 (Microsoft365) / D365 (Dynamics365) and peripheral cloud services. The Cloud Service segment undertakes maintenance, operation, and improvement in cloud utilization, including Azure / M365 / D365, and provides consistent support. The License & Products segment mainly provides cloud solutions such as Microsoft's Azure, M365, and D365, which are the basis of customer system development, and licenses and related equipment as resale. In addition, the Company also rents real estate.

name: PARIS MIKI HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Paris Miki Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of eyeglasses and other products. The Company operates through two segments. The Japan segment is engaged in the retailing of eyeglasses, the manufacture and repair of eyeglass frames in Japan, as well as the general construction and interior finishing business, store design and construction, medical-related business support, investment business, and health-related business. The Overseas segment is engaged in the retailing of eyeglasses in various countries and regions overseas, and the operation of eye care facilities overseas.

name: ADR ON ANA HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: ANA Holdings Inc is a Japan-based holding company principally engaged in the aviation business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Aviation segment conducts regular and irregular air transportation of passengers and cargo domestic and international flights. The Aviation-related segment provides services associated with air transportation such as airport handling and maintenance, and various services at the airport to customers and provide reservation information services by telephone. The Travel segment is engaged in the development and sale of packaged travel products, mainly made from airline tickets and accommodation. The Trading Companies segment mainly engaged in the import and export of aviation-related materials and mail orders. The Company is also engaged in the building management and temporary staffing business.

name: SMILE HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Smile Holdings Inc, formerly Kids Smile Holdings Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in early childhood education business. The Company is mainly engaged in the management of subsidiaries, the operation of accredited daycare centers and preschool integrated daycare centers, as well as childcare and early childhood education business for raising children. The Company is mainly engaged in the management of nursery schools and development of early childhood education programs. The Company provides childcare and education services through the operation of Kids Garden and Kids Smile, and the KIDS GARDEN PREP SCHOOL, an unlicensed preschool integrated nursery, Kids Garden Classrooms which are preschool classroom, and after-school care and after-school programs for school-age children. The Company operates childcare facilities approved by local governments, unlicensed childcare facilities, preschools, swimming schools, and global schools mainly in the Tokyo metropolitan area.

name: LION CORP
businessSummary: Lion Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of consumable goods and industrial products. The Company operates in three business segments. The General Consumable Goods segment purchases and manufactures consumable goods, as well as sells its products through agent stores. This segment also involves pet food trading and over-the-counter management business. The Industrial Goods segment trades industrial products and kitchen cleanser. The Overseas segment manufactures and sells general consumable goods and chemical materials in overseas markets. The Company is also engaged in the design, construction and maintenance of the Company's equipment and the transportation of its products, the real estate, agency and welfare businesses.

name: KOSE HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Kose Corp is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of cosmetics. The Company operates through two business segments. The Cosmetics Business segment's main products include products from brands such as Kose, SEKKISEI, ESPRIQUE, LECHERI, ONE BY KOSE, Cosme Decorte, Predia, INFINITY, JILLSTUART, ADDICTION, and tarte. The Cosmetary Business segment's main products include products from brands such as Visee, FASIO, MAKE KEEP, NAILHOLIC, softymo, SUNCUT, CLEAR TURN, and STEPHEN KNOLL NEW YORK. The Company also engages in the amenity products business and real estate rental business.

name: ASAHI DIAMOND INDUSTRIAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Asahi Diamond Industrial Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of diamond tools, as well as related business. It manufactures and sells diamond tools (including cubic boron nitride (CBN) tools and grinding wheels) mainly for the electronics and semiconductor, transportation equipment, machinery, stone and construction industries. The types of tools include grinding tools, precision cutting tools, cutting tools, wear-resistant tools, wire drawing tools and dressers. It distributes products mainly to Japan, Asia & Oceania, Europe, North America and Central America.

name: CENTRAL JAPAN RAILWAY CO
businessSummary: Central Japan Railway Co is a Japan-based company mainly involved in the provision of railway services. The Company operates in three business segments. The Transportation segment is engaged in the operation of Tokaido Shinkansen railways and the conventional railways in the Tokai area, as well as the provision of bus services. The Distribution segment is engaged in the operation of department stores in JR central towers, as well as the merchandising business in train compartments and stations. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing and sale of station buildings and other real estate. The Company also operates a hotel business, travel agency business, advertising business, railroad car manufacturing business, and construction business.

name: KYUSHU LEASING SERVICE CO LTD
businessSummary: KYUSHU LEASING SERVICE CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the leasing and installment business. The Company operates in five business segments. The Leasing and Installment segment is engaged in the leasing and installment sale of machinery and equipment. The Financing segment is engaged in the leasing of cash and the purchase of debts. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing and sale of real estate, as well as the investment in anonymous associations. The Fee Business segment is engaged in the soliciting of life insurance, the agency for automobile leasing, the provision of real estate-related services, as well as the nonlife insurance agency business. The Others segment is engaged in the electric power sales business, as well as the goods sales business.

name: COSEL CO LTD
businessSummary: Cosel Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of direct current stabilized power supplies. The Company conducts business through five segments. The Japan Production and Sales segment manufactures and sells unit power supplies, onboard power supplies, and noise filters, and manufactures component transformers used in power supplies. The North America Sales segment sells unit power supplies, onboard power supplies, and noise filters. The Europe Production and Sales segment sells unit power supplies, onboard power supplies, noise filters, and other products. The Asia Sales segment handles sales of unit power supplies, onboard power supplies, and noise filters. The China Production segment manufactures unit power supplies and exports these products manufactured in China to each sales business company.

name: HITO COMMUNICATIONS HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Hito Communications Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the outsourcing business, temporary staffing business, electronic commerce (EC) and television shopping (TC) support business, and wholesale business. It operates through four segments. The Outsourcing segment undertakes a series of operations from manufacturers and telecommunications carriers. The Temporary Staffing segment dispatches staff to manufacturers, telecommunications carriers, and supermarkets and general merchandise stores (GMS) according to the needs of the destination. The EC/TC Support segment provides sales support using e-commerce and television shopping. The Wholesale segment is engaged in the manufacture and wholesale of clothing. The Company also provides system development related services, limousine services for the wealthy, land operating services for foreign tourists visiting Japan, social welfare services such as home care and group home management, and online customer services.

name: SANKO SANGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: SANKO SANGYO CO., LTD. is primarily engaged in the planning, manufacture and sale of special printed products, such as adhesive labels, stickers and panels. The Company operates in three geographical business segments, including Japan, China and ASEAN. The Company provides special printed products in the fields of electrical equipment, such as mobile phones, digital cameras, video cameras, recorders and personal computers among others. The Company is also engaged in the provision of special printed products to equipment for transportation use and printing.

name: CITIZEN WATCH CO LTD
businessSummary: Citizen Watch Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in watch business, machine tools business, device business, electronic machinery business and others. The Company consists of four business segments. The Watches and Clocks Business segment produces and sells watches and movements. The Machine Tool Business segment produces and sells computer numeric control (NC) automatic lathes and other equipment. The Devices Business segment provides light-emitting diodes (LEDs), automotive parts, quartz devices, and small motors. The Electronic Equipment and Others Business segment provides printers, health care equipment, and other items.

name: IDEC CORP
businessSummary: IDEC CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of control equipment related products. The Company operates in four geographic segments, including Japan, America, EMEA and Asia Pacific. The main business is manufacturing and sale of human machine interface (HMI) solutions, in-board equipment solutions, automation solutions, safety and explosion-proof solutions, systems, and others. HMI solutions include switches, joysticks and indicator lights. In-board equipment solutions include switching power supplies, terminal blocks, control relays sockets, circuit protectors and others. Automation solutions include programmable controllers, programmable displays, photoelectric switches and automatic recognition devices. Safety and explosion-proof solutions include safety-related equipment and explosion-proof equipment. The Company is also engaged in manufacture and sale of systems, collaborative safety robot system business and environment energy business.

name: SOJITZ CORP
businessSummary: Sojitz Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the buying, selling, and trading of goods, the manufacture and sale of products, the provision of services, the planning and coordination of projects, and financial activities. The Company operates in seven business segments. The Automotive segment is engaged in the wholesale of automobiles. The Aviation Industry and Transportation Projects Segment is engaged in aviation, transportation, and social infrastructure projects. The Infrastructure & Healthcare segment is engaged in the environmental infrastructure business. The Metals, Mineral Resources & Recycling Segment conducts mineral resources and resource recycling businesses. The Chemicals Segment provides various chemical raw materials and products. The Living Essentials & Agribusiness segment provides various food raw materials. The Retail & Consumer Services segment provides food and consumer goods distribution and convenience store operations.

name: SHARP CORP
businessSummary: Sharp Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of telecommunications equipment, electrical equipment and components. It operates through five business segments. The Smart Life & Energy segment provides refrigerators, superheated steam ovens, microwave ovens, small cooking appliances, air conditioners, washing machines, vacuum cleaners, air purifiers, fans, dehumidifiers, humidifiers, electric heating equipment, plasma cluster ion generators, and hairdressing equipment. The Smart Office segment provides digital multifunction devices, information displays, and business projectors. The Universal Network segment provides televisions, Blu-ray Disc recorders, audio equipment, cell phones, tablet terminals, routers. The Display Devices segment provides display modules, in-vehicle cameras. The Electronic Devices segment provides camera modules, sensor modules, opto sensors, opto-devices, wafer foundries, semiconductor lasers.

name: DVX INC
businessSummary: DVx Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of medical equipment for circulatory system diseases. The Company operates in two business segments. The Arrhythmia segment mainly sells cardiac pacemakers, implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICDs), electrode catheters and ablation catheters. The Ischemia segment is engaged in the import and sale of automated contrast medium injectors under the name ACIST, excimer laser angioplasty systems, as well as sale of coronary artery stent products as agency business. The others business is engaged in the sale of neurosurgical products, general surgery related products, gastrointestinal related products, radiation protection supplies, among others.

name: NISSUI CORP
businessSummary: Nissui Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in marine products business, food business, fine business and logistics business, as well as research and services related to each business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Marine Products Business segment is engaged in the fishing business, aquaculture business, as well as processing and trading business. The Food Business segment is engaged in the processing business and the chilled business. The Fine Business segment is engaged in the production and sale of pharmaceutical raw materials, functional raw materials, and functional foods. The Logistics Business segment is engaged in refrigerated warehouse business, delivery business and customs clearance business. The Company is also engaged in the construction, repair, operation and engineering of ships.

name: CHUBU ELECTRIC POWER CO INC
businessSummary: Chubu Electric Power Co Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in a variety of businesses in its core area of energy business supplying electricity and gas, as well as overseas energy business, construction and manufacturing related to energy business, and real estate business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Mirise segment is engaged in the sale of electricity and gas and provides various services. The Power Grid segment provides power network services. The JERA segment is engaged in upstream and procurement of fuel, power generation, and sales of electricity and gas. The Company also operates businesses in renewable energy, business creation, global business, nuclear power, and administrative overhead.

name: OPRO CO LTD
businessSummary: OPRO Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the cloud services business. The Company’s sales are comprised of product sales, product maintenance sales, and other sales, with a focus on cloud sales, which is the Company's current main service. The product sales are sales of on premised products that have been sold since before the launch of cloud services, and product maintenance sales are sales of maintenance related to those on premised products. The main sales are cloud service licenses fees recorded monthly. The Company also provides data optimization solution, which is a solution that can process and sort information, personnel information and other report data held by companies, as well as a variety of information held by government, public institutions, and sales management solution, which is a solution that supports business processes by centrally managing a variety of sales-related information necessary to achieve management and business goals.

name: CELLSOURCE CO LTD
businessSummary: CellSource Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in regenerative medicine related business and consumer business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Regenerative Medicine Related business segment is engaged in the provision of contracted services for processing tissues and cells derived from fat and blood to medical institutions, and support services for regenerative medicine laws and regulations related to safety assurance such as regenerative medicine, as well as sales of medical equipment. The Consumer business segment is engaged in the sales of cosmetics and facial products to general consumers.

name: OHMOTO GUMI CO LTD
businessSummary: OHMOTO GUMI CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in civil engineering and construction works. The Company operates in two business segments. The Construction segment is involved in the provision of construction work. The Civil Engineering segment is involved in the provision of civil engineering works. The others business includes the environmental improvement business, as well as the insurance agency business.

name: GENOVA INC
businessSummary: Genova Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the medical platform business and the smart clinic business. The Company operates in two business segments. In the medical platform business, the Company operates Medical DOC and provides medical information to people who seek correct preventive information and health knowledge. In addition, Medical DOC provides a database of information on medical institutions nationwide and provides a function that allows easy searches by region or medical department. NOMOCa-Stand, which is the main service of the smart clinic business, is a smart simple automatic payment machine and revisit reception machine for medical institutions (bedless clinics). It also provides CLINIC BOT, a customer relationship management system (CRM) service using LINE. In addition, the Company also provides Website creation for medical institutions and the operation and maintenance of created Websites.

name: NULAB INC
businessSummary: Nulab Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the cloud services business. The Cloud Services Business segment is primarily engaged in service development and marketing. Its main products include Backlog, a tool to manage, Cacoo, a visual collaboration tool, Typetalk, a business chat tool, and Nulab Pass, a tool to facilitate ID management and improve information security and governance in organizations. The Company operates within Japan market and overseas market.

name: IKK HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: IKK Holdings Inc, formerly known as IKK Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the wedding business, nursing care business, food business, photo business, and marriage brokerage business. The Company operates through five business segments. The Wedding segment provides planning and management services related to wedding ceremonies and receptions. The Nursing Care segment operates paid nursing homes and provides nursing care services. The Food segment is engaged in the planning, development, and sales of gifts, confectionery, and gift products. The Photo segment provides planning and operating services of photo weddings and photo studios. The Marriage Brokerage segment provides planning and management services related to marriage brokerage.

name: MITSUBISHI PAPER MILLS LTD
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Paper Mills Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the functional products business and the paper materials business. The Company has two business segments. The Functional Products Business segment handles information and specialty paper products, functional materials, photographic materials, inkjet paper and others. The Paper Materials Business segment handles printing paper, pulp and others. The Company also engages in engineering services such as the maintenance, design, and manufacture of factory equipment.

name: NC HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: NC Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based holding company engaged in the manufacture of conveyors and multi-story parking equipment, as well as the staffing business and software development business. The Company has four business segments. The Conveyor Related segment is involved in the manufacture, installation and sale of belt conveyors and auxiliary equipment. The Multi-Story Parking Equipment Related segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of multi-story parking equipment. It is also involved in the construction, maintenance and inspection of related works. The Temporary Staffing Related segment provides general worker dispatching and paid employment placement services. The Solar Power Generation System segment is involved in the sale of solar power generation plants, as well as the sale and installation of solar power generation system equipment.

name: BLUE ZONES HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Blue Zones Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company that manages and operates subsidiaries that operate food supermarkets and trading businesses, as well as related businesses. The Company primarily operates supermarkets that mainly sell food. The Company is also engaged in a range of store-related businesses, wholesale and import of food and beverages assistance with food manufacturing, processing, packaging and other related businesses.

name: NANTO BANK LTD
businessSummary: Nanto Bank Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in banking, leasing and credit guarantee and other financial business. The Company operates through two business segments. Banking segment is engaged in the deposits, loans, domestic exchange and foreign exchange. Leasing segment is engaged in the provision of leasing properties ranging from office equipment to large industrial equipment and automobiles for customers. The Company is also engaged in the provision of credit guarantee business, real estate leasing and management business, software development business, credit card business, employment service and securities business.

name: CLASSICO INC CLASSICO ORD SHS
businessSummary: Classico Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the planning, development and sales of medical apparel products for healthcare professionals including doctors and nurses. The product lineup includes lab coats, scrubs (two-piece medical wear), patient garments and related accessories. The Company operates under the medical apparel business segment. Products are sold through a range of channels including official online stores for domestic and international markets, physical retail locations including its store in Tokyo's Shin-Marunouchi Building and other commercial facilities in Osaka, Nagoya and Yokohama, pop-up stores, corporate sales within Japan and cross-border e-commerce platforms including Tmall for the Chinese market, as well as through overseas subsidiaries.

name: SENKO GROUP HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Senko Group Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the logistics business, the trading business and other business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Logistics segment is mainly engaged in the automobile transportation business, the rail transportation business, the maritime transportation business, the international transportation business and the warehousing business, as well as the packing and moving of raw materials and products on the shipper's premises, the operation of distribution centers. The Trading segment is mainly engaged in the oil sales business, the trading sales business and the trading business. The Other segment is mainly engaged in life support business, the food service business and the information processing contract business. The Company also operates worker dispatching business, paid employment agency business and training business.

name: HACHIJUNI NAGANO BANK LTD
businessSummary: Hachijuni Nagano Bank Ltd, formerly Hachijuni Bank Ltd, is mainly engaged in the provision of financial services, including banking business and leasing business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Banking segment provides deposit, loan, domestic exchange, foreign exchange and others. This segment is also engaged in the provision of credit card services, credit guarantee services, and debt management and collection services through its subsidiaries. The Leasing segment is engaged in the provision of leasing services. The Company is also engaged in securities trading, investment, investment management, regional trading, and electric power (power generation) businesses.

name: E-GUARDIAN INC
businessSummary: E-Guardian Inc. is a company mainly engaged in the bulletin board post monitoring business. The social support business focuses on the development of new services such as monitoring, customer support, operation and analysis, and deep sales to existing customers. The game support business conducts multi-lingual customer support orders from Chinese and Korean overseas game companies entering the Japanese market. Ad space business conducts the expansion of provision services such as ad space management, drafting management, ad writing, etc. Other businesses include hiring and training of human resources.

name: TERA PROBE INC
businessSummary: Tera Probe Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in contract wafer testing and final testing within the semiconductor manufacturing process. The semiconductor manufacturing process is generally divided into the front-end process, where semiconductor chips are fabricated on wafers, and the back-end process, where semiconductor chips are assembled and packaged. The inspection performed in the front-end process is called wafer testing, and the inspection performed in the back-end process is called final testing. The Group undertakes both testing processes. Furthermore, the Company contributes to reducing customers' wafer test costs through contracted program development and probe card design, comprehensive support from device evaluation to mass production, and proposals for improving test efficiency.

name: INTEGROUP INC
businessSummary: Integroup Inc is a Japan-based company that provides mergers and acquisitions (M&A) brokerage services mainly to small and medium-sized companies. The Company operates in the M&A Brokerage business segment. The M&A Brokerage service provides one-stop support to business owners who wish to sell their companies, from initial consultation, assessment of the expected sale price, proposal of potential buyers and transfer schemes, preparation of necessary materials, selection of potential buyers, proposal to potential buyers, meeting with potential buyers, negotiation of terms and conditions, arrangement of basic agreement and final contract. The service is remunerated only when an M&A transaction is concluded.

name: MATERIAL GROUP INC
businessSummary: Material Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly operates three businesses: public relations (PR) consulting business, digital marketing business, and PR platform business. The PR Consulting Business segment provides support from strategy design to implementation of measures to deliver information on corporate brands, products, and services to consumers, consumers, and other stakeholders through the media and social networking service (SNS), and to increase awareness and transform perceptions, mainly through various PR methods and marketing communication measures, including advertising. The Digital Marketing Business segment provides support for the design and execution of marketing communication strategies in the digital domain, creative advertising production services, and sales of the Flipdesk web-based customer service tool. The PR Platform Business segment provides CLOUD PRESS ROOM, a platform for connecting with the media in real life and on the Web.

name: YAMADA HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Yamada Holdings Co Ltd is mainly engaged in the business of selling home appliances and information appliances. The Company operates through two business segments. The Denki segment is engaged in the sale of home appliances such as televisions, refrigerators, and washing machines, as well as information appliances such as PCs and cell phones, and home renovation, furniture, interior design, and other products related to the home. The Housing Construction segment is engaged in the sale of detached houses and other housing units, and manufacture and sale of bathrooms, kitchens, and other housing equipment. It also operates environmental businesses, financial businesses, and businesses related to building materials.

name: MEGACHIPS CORP
businessSummary: MegaChips Corporation is a Japan-based company engaged in the design, development, manufacture and sale of system large-scale integrations (LSIs) based on the basic technologies of image, audio and telecommunication sectors, and electronic components and system machinery equipped with its system LSIs. The Company’s main products Include LSIs for entertainment devices such as game consoles, image processing LSIs for digital cameras, LSIs for liquid crystal display (LCD) panels, and video surveillance system equipment for security field, among others. As of March 31, 2014, the Company had four subsidiaries.

name: TOSEI CORP
businessSummary: Tosei Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in real estate revitalization, real estate development, real estate leasing, real estate fund and consulting, real estate management, and hotel businesses. It operates through six segments. The Real Estate Revitalization segment revitalizes and sells properties with deteriorated asset value. The Real Estate Development segment is engaged in the sale of condominiums and detached houses to individual customers, as well as the sale of rental condominiums and office buildings to investors. The Real Estate Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing of office buildings and condominiums. The Real Estate Fund and Consulting segment provides asset management services for real estate funds. The Real Estate Management segment provides comprehensive property management services. The Hotel segment operates hotels.

name: YOKOWO CO LTD
businessSummary: Yokowo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of various electronic devices, including vehicle communication comfort & safety (VCCS) products, circuit testing connector (CTC) products, fine connector and medical device (FC&MD) products, and incubation center products. It operates through four business segments. VCCS segment develops and provides antenna systems that utilize antenna, microwave, and modularization technologies. CTC segment globally develops and provides semiconductor testing connectors for all front-end and back-end inspection processes. FC&MD segment's FC business manufactures and sells fine spring connectors. MD business provides original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) guidewires, medical catheters, and other products. Incubation Center segment works on developing products in new fields such as advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), and others.

name: MITSUI O.S.K. LINES LTD
businessSummary: Mitsui O.S.K. Lines Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the shipping business. The Company operates in six business segments. The Dry bulk Carrier segment is engaged in the operation of dry bulk carriers. The Energy Transportation segment owns and operates coal carriers that transport coal for thermal power generation, oil tankers, offshore businesses, and tramp ships, including liquefied natural gas (LNG) carriers, and is engaged in marine cargo transportation. The Product Transportation segment owns and operates pure car carriers and transports marine cargo. The Well-Being Life segment is engaged in real estate business, including land and building rental and building management, passenger and cargo transportation, and cruise business. The Associated segment is engaged in tugboat business and trading company business. The Other segment is engaged in ship management of ships other than transport ships and LNG ships, financial business such as group fund raising and others.

name: H.U. GROUP HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: H.U. Group Holdings Inc, formerly Miraca Holdings Inc is a Japan-based holding company engaged in manufacture and sale of clinical test drugs, entrusted clinical examination and sterilization related business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Outsourced Clinical Testing segment accepts special tests from medical institutions. The Clinical Laboratory Medicine segment manufactures and sells clinical laboratory medicines and sells them to medical institutions and contract clinical laboratory companies. The Sterilization segment mainly entrusts the sterilization of medical equipment used for medical treatment in hospitals of large-scale hospitals and the related operations. The New Development & Others segment is involved in the homecare & welfare equipment business, self-medication & health insurance business, food & environment & cosmetics inspection business.

name: SUMIKEN MITSUI ROAD CO LTD
businessSummary: SUMIKEN MITSUI ROAD CO., LTD. is mainly engaged in the construction business, as well as the manufacture and sales of related materials. The Company operates in three business segments. The Construction segment is involved in the pavement construction, civil engineering work, building construction and others. The Manufacturing and Sales segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of construction materials. The Others segment is involved in the sales of electricity and real estate transaction-related business.

name: NOMURA CO LTD
businessSummary: Nomura Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in research and consulting for creating customer-attracting environments, as well as planning, design, production, and construction, as well as the revitalization and operation and management of various facilities and events. The Display segment provides one-stop services required for spaces, from research, planning, and consulting to design, production, and construction, as well as the operation and management of facilities and events, for specialty stores, department stores, mass retailers, commercial complexes, public relations and sales promotion facilities, museums, art galleries, leisure facilities, and exhibitions and events. Services include marketing research, master planning, spatial design, content design, project management, interior supervision, facility operation, public relations, and tourism/regional revitalization.

name: SANKYO SEIKO CO LTD
businessSummary: SANKYO SEIKO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the fashion related business, the textile related business and the real estate leasing business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Fashion Related segment is mainly engaged in the planning, manufacture and sale of fashion products, the import and sale of overseas brand products, as well as the licensing business. The Textile Related segment is mainly engaged in the processing, planning, manufacture and sale of textile and clothing products. The Real Estate Leasing segment is mainly engaged in the leasing of real estate owned by the Company and group companies, including office, hotels and buildings. The Company is also engaged in the building maintenance business and interior decorating business.

name: BOOKOFF GROUP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: BOOKOFF GROUP HOLDINGS LIMITED is a Japan-based holding company engaged in the operation and management of subsidiaries which operate reuse store and book off online business, as well as other related business. The Company operates three kinds of business. The reuse store business is involved in the operation of head office and other chain and the reuse shop BOOKOFF which provides books and software. The BOOKOFF online business is involved in the operation of reuse shop BOOKOFF Online on the Internet. The Hugall business operates a reuse business that is not limited to store type business and purchases and sells products. The Company also involved in the operation of shops of the newly published bookstore Aoyama Book Center, Ryusui Shobo and yc-vox, the planning, designing and construction of its own stores’ interior and exterior works, processing of products to be sold at stores, as well as the operation of Internet review Website Booklog.

name: TEIJIN LTD
businessSummary: Teijin Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the materials, textiles and products, healthcare, information technology (IT) and other business. It has four business segments. The Material segment includes the high performance materials business, which manufactures and sells aramid fibers, resins and others, and the composite molding materials business, which manufactures and sells composite molding materials. The Textiles and Products segment manufactures and sells textile products and manufactures and sells polyester fibers and textiles. The Healthcare segment manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals and medical devices, provides home medical services, and manufactures and sells other healthcare-related products. IT segment operates, develops, and maintains information systems, and provides electronic comic distribution services. It also manufactures and sells battery components, and develops, manufactures and sells regenerative medicine products and implantable medical devices.

name: DMG MORI CO LTD
businessSummary: DMG Mori Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of solutions covering machine tools such as machining centers, turning centers, multi-tasking machines, 5-axis machines, additive manufacturing machines, and other products, software such as user interfaces, technology cycles and embedded software, measuring equipment, repair and restoration support, applications, and engineering. The Company operates in two business segments. The Machine Tools segment manufactures and sells machine tools. The Industrial Services segment provides services and solutions related to machine tools, manufactures and sells measuring equipment, and develops and sells software, image processing hardware.

name: NAKAKITA SEISAKUSHO CO LTD
businessSummary: NAKAKITA SEISAKUSHO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of automatic control valves, butterfly valves and remote controllers for ships and power plants. The Company offers three types of products: automatic control valves, which include auto actuated valves, servo actuated control valves, remote control valves, cylinder valves, safety valves, air purge-type automatic regulatory equipment, actuators, valves for nuclear plants, superheated steam pressure reducers and attemperators, other special automatic control valves and controlling equipment; butterfly valves, which include manual butterfly valves, remote control butterfly valves, and butterfly valves for low-temperature use, and remote controllers, which include cargo handling and ballast remote controllers and remote water level indication and warning equipment for ships.

name: RICOH LEASING CO LTD
businessSummary: Ricoh Leasing Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of leasing services and related business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Leasing and Finance segment is engaged in the provision of finance leases, operating leases, installment sales and credit for office and information-related equipment, medical equipment, industrial machine tools, measuring instruments, as well as corporate loans, industry-specific loans, housing loans, condominium loans. In addition, the Company provides corporate loans, industry-specific loans, housing loans, condominium loans, and other loans. The Services segment is engaged in the provision of invoicing and accounts receivable collection services, medical and nursing care reimbursement factoring services, factoring services for the Ricoh Group, and relocation management services. The Investment business includes solar power generation, housing leasing, and real estate related businesses.

name: STREAM CO LTD
businessSummary: Stream Co., Ltd. is mainly engaged in the Internet retail business. It operates in three business segments. The Internet Retail segment is engaged in the sale of products through its Websites (e-commerce (EC) CURRENT, eBEST and TOKKA COM) and mobile sites. The products offered by the Company include personal computers (PCs); computer peripheral equipment, such as monitors, printers and digital cameras; home electrical appliances, such as televisions, refrigerators, washing machines and vacuum cleaners; software, such as business and game software, as well as new products such as watches, miscellaneous goods and others. This segment also provides warranty extension and repair agency services. The Beauty & Healthcare business conducts sales business for daily necessities including cosmetics and health foods. The Others segment is involved in the sales support business and online game business.

name: ESOL CO LTD
businessSummary: eSOL Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in operation system (OS) development for embedded devices and contract development of embedded software. The Company operates its business through two business segments. The Embedded Software segment is mainly involved in the development and sale of real-time operating system (RTOS) and development support tools, as well as the provision of engineering services. The Sensing Solution segment is involved in the development and sale of automotive printers, cold handy terminals, environmentally handicapped handy terminals, sales support software, as well as the proposal of the sensor network system to the markets where information and communication technology (ICT) is behind, such as agriculture and fishery business.

name: KASAI KOGYO CO., LTD
businessSummary: Kasai Kogyo CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive interior parts. The Company operates through Japan, North America, Europe, and Asia four geography segments. The Company is engaged in the design, development, manufacture and sale of automotive interior parts, the manufacture, sales, and technical development of automotive resin interior parts, and the manufacture of automotive ceiling materials. The Company is also engaged in the provision of insurance agency services and business contracts.

name: NISHI-NIPPON RAILROAD CO LTD
businessSummary: Nishi-Nippon Railroad Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based transportation company. The Company operates in five business segments. The Transportation segment operates railroad, bus, taxi and other transportation-related business. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing and allotment sale of real estate properties, as well as other real estate-related businesses. The Distribution segment is involved in the storage business. The Logistics segment is involved in the international and domestic logistics business. The Leisure and Service segment is involved in the hotel, leisure, travel, restaurant, advertising agency and other business. The Company is also engaged in the integrated circuit (IC) card, automobile maintenance-related, construction and metal recycle business.

name: MITSUBISHI HC CAPITAL INC
businessSummary: Mitsubishi HC Capital Inc, formerly Mitsubishi UFJ Lease & Finance Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the financial business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Customer Finance segment is engaged in the finance lease and installment sale of machinery, equipment and fixtures, as well as the provision of monetary loan services and other related financial services. The Asset Finance segment is engaged in the operating lease of machinery and transportation equipment, the investment and loan businesses related to real estate, the management of securities, the finance business related to aircrafts and ships, as well as the leasing of office buildings.

name: ZENITAKA CORP
businessSummary: Zenitaka Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction and real estate businesses. The Company operates in two segments. The Construction segment is engaged in the comprehensive construction business, including civil engineering, architectural and other construction related businesses, as well as the leasing of construction equipment and materials. The properties include government buildings, cultural and research facilities, educational facilities, communication facilities and data centers, office buildings, medical facilities, production facilities, commercial facilities, housing, energy facilities, road facilities, railway facilities, water supply and sewerage facilities.
