The Real Estate segment is engaged in the sale, leasing, brokerage, and management of real estate properties.

name: TOKYU FUDOSAN HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Tokyu Fudosan Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the real estate business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Urban Development segment develops, leases, operates and sells office buildings and commercial facilities, and develops, leases and sells condominiums and rental housing. The Strategic Investment segment develops, leases, operates and sells renewable energy power generation facilities and logistics facilities. It also manages real estate private placement funds, and asset management and investment. The Management and Operation segment is involved in the management of condominiums and buildings, renovation work, sales of member-only resort hotels, management of hotels, golf courses and ski resorts, corporate welfare contracting, environmental greening and landscaping. Real Estate Distribution segment is involved in real estate brokerage, sales agency, management and operation of rental housing and student apartments and subleasing business.

name: TOWA PHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Towa Pharmaceutical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals. The main products are generic drugs, which are launched after the efficacy and safety of new drugs have been confirmed for a certain period of time. It is a drug with the same effect, usage and dosage. The Company is involved in the sale and outsourced manufacture of products and generic drugs. The Company is involved in the research and outsourced manufacture of active pharmaceutical ingredient and soft capsules. The Company is also involved in the planning, development, contract manufacturing of health foods, general foods, miscellaneous goods and others.

name: TODA CORP
businessSummary: Toda Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engages in construction, civil engineering, domestic investment and development, domestic group companies, overseas group companies, and environment and energy. It has six business segments. The Construction Business segment engages in construction work both domestically and overseas. The Civil Engineering Business segment engages in civil engineering work both domestically and overseas. The Domestic Investment and Development Business segment engages in independent real estate development, sales, and leasing. The Domestic Group Companies Business segment includes construction, civil engineering, real estate management, hotel services and others. The Overseas Group Companies Business segment includes construction work and related businesses overseas conducted by overseas consolidated subsidiaries, independent real estate development, sales, and leasing, hotel services. The Environment and Energy segment engages in power generation and sales.

name: HITOMILE CO LTD
businessSummary: HitoMile Co Ltd, formerly Kakuyasu Group Co Ltd, is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in formulating management strategies and providing support to each group company for the sustainable growth of the Company's group. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Time Delivery business segment provides free delivery service 365 days a year and free of charge on a one-hour time frame to individual restaurants, general consumers, and corporate customers from locations such as small shipping warehouses and Nandemo Sakeya Kakuyasu stores. The Route Delivery business segment makes daily deliveries from distribution centers to customers such as restaurant chains, hotels and restaurants. The In-Store Sales business segment provides in-store sales to customers who visit the various Nandemo Sakeya Kakuyasu stores. The Company also engages in e-commerce (EC) business, wholesale business to other alcoholic beverage distributors, and logistics.

name: VISION INC
businessSummary: VISION INC. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the global WiFi business, and the information and communication services business. The Company operates in two segments. The Global WiFi segment is engaged in the rental of mobile WiFi routers in Japan and other countries. The Information and Communication Services segment is engaged in the fixed communication services business, the sale of mobile communication equipment and office automation (OA) equipment, as well as the creation of homepages. The Company is also engaged in the higher time sharing services business, the media business and the mail order business.

name: MIROKU CORP
businessSummary: Miroku Corporation is primarily engaged in hunting rifle, machine tool and automobile-related businesses. The Company operates in three business segments. The Hunting Rifle segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of shotguns, sport rifles and shotgun-related products. The Machine Tool segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of deep hole processing machines, ultra-precision grinding machines and deep hole processing tools, among others. The Automobile-related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive handles, automobile-related products and others. The Company also purchases and sells woodworking products.

name: NISSAN MOTOR CO LTD
businessSummary: Nissan Motor Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automobiles and parts, as well as the provision of sales financial services. The Company operates through two business segments. The Automotive segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of electric vehicles, compact cars, light cars, minivans, commercial vehicles, trucks, micro buses and other automobiles, as well as related parts. The Sales Finance segment is engaged in the sales finance business and the leasing business to support sales activities of automobile business.

name: KOITO MANUFACTURING CO LTD
businessSummary: Koito Manufacturing Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive lighting equipment, aircraft parts, railway vehicle parts, and various electrical equipment, as well as related logistics. It operates through five segments based on region. The Japan segment is involved in the manufacture of light-emitting diode (LED) headlamps, headlamps and auxiliary lights, signal lights, high-mounted stop lamps, halogen bulbs, various other small bulbs, other lighting fixtures, railway vehicle control equipment, road traffic signals, traffic control systems, road and tunnel lighting, facility lighting, residential equipment, environmental control equipment, aircraft parts and electronic components, headlamp cleaners, sensor systems (LiDAR), railway vehicle seats, transportation services, and insurance services. The Americas, China, Asia, and Europe segments are involved in the manufacture of LED headlamps, headlamps and auxiliary lights, and others.

name: CALBEE INC
businessSummary: Calbee Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of potato-based, wheat-based, and corn-based snacks and cereal foods. The Food Manufacturing and Sales Business segment manufactures and sells snacks and cereal foods, procures raw materials, manufactures primary processed products, and procures and sells potatoes and sweet potatoes. The Company is also engaged in the logistics business. It conducts business activities in Japan and overseas.

name: YAMAHA CORP
businessSummary: Yamaha Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the musical instruments business, the audio equipment business and other businesses. The Company operates through two business segments. The Musical Instruments Business segment manufactures and sells musical instruments, operates music schools and other facilities, and produces and sells music and video software. The Audio Equipment Business segment provides various solutions for both consumer and commercial use. It consists of a wide range of products from home audio equipment, music production and distribution equipment, professional audio equipment, and network equipment. The Company also engages in components and equipment business, consisting of electronic devices, automotive interior components, and factory automation (FA) equipment, as well as the golf goods business and resort business.

name: V TECHNOLOGY CO LTD
businessSummary: V Technology Co., Ltd. is a manufacturing company. The Company is mainly engaged in the development, design, manufacture and sale of inspection systems, repair systems and measuring systems used for the manufacture of flat panel display (FPD), such as liquid crystal display (LCD) and plasma display panel (PDP). Through its subsidiaries, the Company is also engaged in the provision of product sales support service and maintenance service, as well as the sale of consumable parts. As of March 31, 2014, the Company had three subsidiaries and one associated company.

name: DATA APPLICATIONS CO LTD
businessSummary: Data Applications Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the software related business. The Company is engaged in the development, sale and maintenance of basic software products, supporting the business processes of companies centered on data exchange middleware, and the provision of introduction and operation service of software products. The Company operates through Software-related segment. Products include an enterprise data linkage platform ACMS Apex, an integrated electronic data interchange (EDI) server ACMS B2B, EDI clients ACMS Lite Neo and ACMS/WS, and a Web-EDI system platform ACMS Web Framer, file exchange ACMS Web/deTrade II and others.

name: MITSUI SOKO HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Mitsui Soko Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the warehouse business, port transportation business and global flow business. The Company operates in two business segments. Logistics segment provides logistics services. These services include warehouse storage & handling, port work & transportation, overseas logistics & multiple integrated transport, air freight transport, third-party logistics (3PL), supply chain management support, as well as land freight transport services, among others. Real Estate segment provides services centered on the building leasing business.

name: IDEMITSU KOSAN CO LTD
businessSummary: Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd is Japan-based company primarily engaged in fossil fuel-related businesses. The Company operates five business segments. The Fuel Oil segment is engaged in the production, sales, import & export, and trading of refined petroleum products. The Basic Chemicals Segment is engaged in the production and sale of olefins and aromatics products. The High Functional Materials segment is engaged in lubricants, functional chemicals, electronic materials, functional pavement materials, and agribio products. The Power & Renewable Energy segment is engaged in power generation (includes thermal, solar, wind), power sales, and solar cell operations. The Resources segment is engaged in exploration, development, production, and sales of energy resources such as crude oil, natural gas, and coal. The Company also conducts insurance and intra-group service businesses.

name: MITSUI MATSUSHIMA HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Mitsui Matsushima Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in a variety of businesses, including consumer goods, industrial products, and finance. The Company operates through four segments. The Consumer Goods segment is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of extendable straws, the purchase and sale of food and beverage supplies, and others. The Industrial Products segment is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of mask blanks, and others. The Finance and Other Businesses segment is primarily engaged in real estate-backed loans for businesses, and others. The Energy Business segment consists of the Coal Production segment, and the Coal Sales segment. Due to the closure of existing mining areas in the Australian coal mining business, the Coal Production and Coal Sales segments of the Energy Business segment were discontinued at the end of the fiscal year ending March 2024.

name: YAMAICHI REAL ESTATE CO LTD
businessSummary: Yamaichi Real Estate Co Ltd, formerly Yamaichi Uniheim Real Estate Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the development, sale, leasing, management and brokerage of real estate. The Company operates through three business segments. The Real Estate Development and Leasing segment develops and leases residential and commercial real estate properties and operates a parking lot business. The Real Estate Development and Sales segment develops residential land, sells land, and contracts for construction of detached houses. The Condominium segment mainly plans and sells condominiums. The Company is also engaged in the lease, sale, and management of condominiums for seniors, home nursing care and in-home care support services, operation of Japanese restaurants, and management of hot spring facilities. The Company also provides non-life insurance agency services and electricity sales.

name: KASUMIGASEKI CAPITAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Kasumigaseki Capital Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the real estate consulting business, which mainly involves consulting and management related to real estate investment, as well as the development of profitable real estate. The Company operates through four businesses. The logistics business develops rental type refrigerated warehouses. The hotel business develops apartment hotels, which are medium-to long-term stay hotels for group stays of 4 to 8 people, with a focus on rooms for large groups, where there is a supply-demand gap. The healthcare-related facility business is currently focusing on the development of hospice housing among healthcare-related facilities. The Company's overseas business focuses on the United Arab Emirates (Dubai) and enters the real estate market.

name: NIPPON INSURE CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Insure Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of services related to the guarantee business. The guarantee business includes rent obligation guarantee service, nursing care expense obligation guarantee service, and hospitalization expense obligation guarantee service. The rent obligation guarantee service provides guarantees for rent obligations in rental housing and other properties. The nursing care expense obligation guarantee service is a guarantee product that assumes the risk of nonpayment of nursing care facility fees by concluding a guarantee consignment contract between a nursing care facility user and the company, and acting as a joint guarantor for the facility user. The hospitalization expense obligation guarantee service is a guarantee product that assumes the risk of nonpayment of hospitalization expenses by concluding a guarantee consignment contract with hospitalized patients and becoming a joint guarantor.

name: CHUGOKU ELECTRIC POWER CO INC
businessSummary: Chugoku Electric Power Co Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the electric power business, comprehensive energy supply business and information and communication business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Electric Power Business segment supplies electricity based on the Chugoku region as the basis for business development. The Comprehensive Energy Supply Business segment is engaged in the sale of liquefied natural gas (LNG) and provision of energy utilization services such as electricity and heat sales. The Information and Communications Business segment provides telecommunications services and information processing services that utilize information and communication technology (ICT). The Company also provides environmental harmony creation, business and life support, and electric power business support.

name: FIRST BANK OF TOYAMA LTD
businessSummary: First Bank of Toyama Ltd is mainly engaged in banking business and financial services related business such as leasing business. The Bank mainly operates in two business segments. The Banking segment is engaged in deposit business, lending business, domestic exchange business, foreign exchange business, and commodity securities trading business. The Company also conducts banking business, including bank administrative services. The Leasing segment is engaged in leasing business. The Bank is also engaged in credit business, credit guarantee business and money lending business.

name: NAGAILEBEN CO LTD
businessSummary: Nagaileben Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning, manufacture, and sale of various medical wear, as well as shoes and other products. It sells medical wear used by medical professionals and caregivers, which are products that it plans and develops itself, supplied by its manufacturing subsidiary. For some medical wear, it purchases and sells products produced overseas and domestically from its manufacturing subsidiary and general business partners. It also purchases and sells shoes from general business partners.

name: NIPPON PAINT HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Paint Holdings Co Ltd is a company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of coating materials and fine chemicals products. The Company is involved in the manufacture and sale of paint for automobile-, general- and industrial-uses, as well as fine chemicals. The Company operates in four business segments. The Japan segment conducts paint for automobile-, general- and industrial-uses, as well as fine chemicals business. The Asia segment conducts paint for automobile-, general- and industrial-uses, as well as fine chemicals business in China Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Korea, Southeast Asian countries, India. The Oceania segment conducts paint business, such as paint for general-, industrial-uses, and paints peripheral businesses. The Americas segment conducts paint for automobile business and contruction coating materials business.

name: S-POOL INC
businessSummary: S-Pool Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of outsourcing and temporary staffing services. It operates through two business segments. The Business Solutions segment provides services that support the utilization of potential labor resources, such as seniors and people with disabilities, and outsourcing services that undertake part of corporate's business. It provides services that primarily support the recruitment, training and retention of people with intellectual disabilities, and services that help freelance talent solve management and operational issues for companies, and other services. The Human Resources Solutions segment provides human resources-related services such as temporary staffing and recruitment services, office support services such as call centers, in-store sales support services for smartphones and home appliances, and human resources services related to customer service in the hotel industry.

name: JGC HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: JGC Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the general engineering and functional materials manufacturing businesses. The Company operates in two business segments. The Integrated Engineering segment is engaged in the planning, design, procurement, construction and testing of equipment, appliances and facilities for petroleum, petroleum refining, petrochemicals, gas, liquefied natural gas (LNG) and others, as well as the water and power generation business. The Functional Material Manufacture segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of products in the catalyst field, nanoparticle technology field, clean and safety field, electronic materials, high-performance ceramics field and the next generation energy field. The Company is also involved in consulting, office support, desalination, and crude oil and gas production and sales.

name: MAKOTO CONSTRUCTION CO LTD
businessSummary: Makoto Construction Co, Ltd. is mainly engaged in the detached house selling and real estate brokerage businesses. The Company operates in two business segments. The Detached House Selling segment is involved in the plan, design, construction and sale of built-for-sale houses and custom-built houses. The segment is also involved in the information collection about building sites, the planning of business interest scheme, the planning of land use, the planning and design of buildings, the purchase of land, the land development application business, the designing business, the purchase of materials, the outsourcing of construction works, the management of construction work, as well as maintenance and repair works. The Real Estate Brokerage segment is involved in the house selling brokerage business.

name: KOJIMA CO LTD
businessSummary: Kojima Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sales of home appliances and other products. The Company operates the Product Sales business segment of audio-visual products, home appliances, information and communication equipment products, and others. The Company also repairs and installs home appliances and electrical products. The audio-visual products include cameras, televisions, recorders and video cameras, audio products and others. The home appliances include refrigerators, washing machines, cooking appliances, seasonal appliances, hairdressing appliances and others. The information and communication equipment products include personal computers, computer peripherals, computer software products, mobile phones and others. Other products and services include games, watches, sporting goods, toys, pharmaceuticals and daily necessities, construction work including housing equipment and others.

name: YAMAHA MOTOR CO LTD
businessSummary: Yamaha Motor Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the land mobility, marine, robotics, financial services and others. The Company operates in four business segments. The Land Mobility Business segment manufactures and sells motorcycles, intermediate parts, parts for overseas production, four-wheeled buggies, recreational off-highway vehicles, electrically assisted bicycles, electrically assisted bicycle drive units (e-Kits), electric wheelchairs, automobile engines, automobile components. The Marine Business segment manufactures and sells outboard motors, water vehicles, boats, fishing boats and Japanese-style boats. The Robotics Business segment manufactures and sells surface mounters, semiconductors manufacturing post-engineering equipment, industrial robots and industrial unmanned helicopters. The Financial Services Business segment provides sales financing and leasing for its products. The Company also provides golf cars, generators, general-purpose engines and snowplows.

name: KYUSHU RAILWAY CO
businessSummary: Kyushu Railway Company is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in transportation, construction, station buildings and real estate, distribution and food business, as well as other business around Kyushu in Japan. The Company operates in four business segments. The Transportation segment operates railway business, bus business, marine business and car rental business. The Construction segment operates construction business, vehicle mechanical equipment engineering business, and electrical construction business. The Real Estate and Hotel segment engages in leasing and sale of real estate, parking lot operation, senior business, hotel business and operation of complex tourism facilities. The Distribution and Food segment engages in retail industry, catering industry and agriculture industry.

name: POPER CO LTD
businessSummary: POPER Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of software as a service (SaaS) business management platform for educational providers, mainly for cram schools. The Company provides the SaaS business management platform Comiru, the online class and home study support service ComiruAir, and the labor management and communication service ComiruHR for instructors. The SaaS business management platform Comiru offers three plans, Comiru FREE, Comiru BASIC and Comiru PRO, to improve the efficiency of back office operations and strengthen communication with parents. The online class and home study support service ComiruAir supports online classes and home study for students. The labor management and communication service ComiruHR for instructors, efficiently adjusts shifts for instructors, aggregates salaries and labor, and communicates related to these.

name: LEADER ELECTRONICS CORP
businessSummary: LEADER ELECTRONICS CORPORATION is primarily engaged in the manufacture of electrical measuring instruments. The video-related equipment business includes video signal-related products for commercial and consumer video equipment, and others, such as video signal generators, waveform monitors, vector scopes and camera test systems. The radio wave-related equipment business includes high-frequency signal generators, television field-strength meters, and characteristic testers for electronic components, such as standard signal generators, television field-strength meters, automatic digital broadcasting related equipment. The others business provides basic measuring instruments, repair services, parts and others.

name: KATSURAGAWA ELECTRIC CO LTD
businessSummary: KATSURAGAWA ELECTRIC CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of large format digital equipment, large format copying machines and micro motors, among others, as well as the research and services related to its businesses. The Image Information Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of large format digital equipment, such as LED full-color printers, as well as micro motors.

name: YOKOHAMA WRIGHT INDUSTRIES CO LTD
businessSummary: YOKOHAMA WRIGHT Industries Co.,LTD is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the pile removal business. The Pile Removal segment is mainly engaged in the development of extracting piles, which are underground structures of existing buildings, as well as the provision of construction business based on the know-how and ideas accumulated as a construction company specializing in pile removal work. The pile removal business is mainly engaged in the driving of piles into the ground to support the building so that it does not sink or tilt when building the infrastructure. The Company also provides existing pile removal work, demolition and civil engineering work, underground obstacle removal work and mega solar business.

name: TWINBIRD CORP
businessSummary: Twinbird Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of home appliances, and new cooling technology free piston stirling coolers (FPSC) and its applied products. The Company is engaged in the planning, manufacture and sales of home electric appliances, quality management and production management. Products are light emitting diode (LED) desk stand, rice cooker, microwave oven, home bakery, toaster, coffee maker, stick type cleaner, handy cleaner, horizontal cleaner, hand steamer, air purifier, refrigerators, shoe dryers, humidifiers, circulators, electric fans, washing machines, refrigerators, electronic refrigerators, bathroom liquid crystal display televisions, radios, waterproof compact discs (CDs) players, massagers, head care, face steamers, and beauty and health equipment, FPSC refrigerator-freezers.

name: W-SCOPE CORP
businessSummary: W-Scope Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of separators for lithium-ion secondary batteries. Microporous membranes made of polyolefin are generally used for the separators of main products, and their role is to separate the positive and negative electrode materials while ensuring lithiumion conductivity between the positive and negative electrodes. In addition, when the battery becomes abnormally hot and reaches a high temperature, the safety mechanism (shutdown property) in which the polyolefin melts and closes the pores plays an important role in stopping the movement of lithium ions and safely stopping the battery's function, responsible for battery safety.

name: RENOVA INC
businessSummary: Renova Inc is a Japan-based company that develops, owns and operates renewable energy power plants. The Company operates through two business segments: the Renewable Energy Power Generation Business segment and the Development and Operation Business segment. The business objective is to develop and operate power generation projects using multiple sources of energy, including solar power, biomass power, onshore and offshore wind power, geothermal power and hydroelectric power. The Company also promotes the green transformation (GX) business, which involves storage batteries and new fuels including ammonia and hydrogen.

name: ABALANCE CORP
businessSummary: Abalance Corporation, formerly Realcom Inc., is mainly engaged in software license sales, system construction, and the distribution and sale of construction machinery,as well as green energy related business. The Company operates in three business segment. The Information Technology (IT) segment is involved in the introduction of core product Knowledge Market to its new customers, as well as the sale of licenses, the provision of system integration, and operation and maintenance businesses. The Construction Equipment Sale segment is involved in the trading of construction machinery in domestic market and to overseas markets. The Green Energy segment is involved in the trading of solar panels and related products, power plant construction and solar power generation.

name: PCA CORP
businessSummary: PCA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the computer software business. The Company is mainly engaged in the development, manufacturing, sale and maintenance of computer software, the support of computer software installation and operation, as well as the provision of cloud service. The Company is mainly engaged in the production of PCA cloud software for core business cloud service, PCA hyper software for core business systems, PCA KAIKEI DX software for financial accounting, and PCA KYUYO DX software for salary calculating.

name: IYOGIN HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Iyogin Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in financial services such as leasing, with a focus on banking operations. It operates through two business segments. The Banking segment is involved in deposit services, lending, securities investment, foreign exchange, banking agency services, credit guarantee services, credit card services, and investment fund management. The Leasing segment is involved in leasing services. It is also involved in information processing contracting, software development, and securities businesses.

name: CHUGOKU MARINE PAINTS LTD
businessSummary: Chugoku Marine Paints Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of paint, as well as the provision of contract painting services. The Company has five geographical segments, including Japan segment, China segment, Korea segment, Southeast Asia segment and Europe and America segment. Japan segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of paint, as well as the management of real estate business. The other four reporting segments are engaged in the manufacture and sale of paint.

name: ATSUGI CO LTD
businessSummary: ATSUGI CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture, purchase and sale of socks and inner wear products. The Company has three business segments. The Textile segment is primarily involved in the manufacture, purchase and sale of textile products, as well as the provision of logistics services. The Real Estate segment is mainly engaged in the sale and leasing of real estate properties. The Others segment is involved in the purchase and sale of nursing care products.

name: TEKKEN CORP
businessSummary: TEKKEN CORPORATION is a company primarily engaged in the civil engineering business and construction business. The Civil Engineering segment is engaged in the civil engineering works. The Construction segment is engaged in the construction works. The Real Estate segment is engaged in businesses related to house and land development. The Ancillary segment engages in the sales of equipment and materials related to civil engineering work. The Others segment is engaged in the the operation of sports facilities, as well as private finance initiative businesses.

name: EUGLENA CO LTD
businessSummary: Euglena Co Ltd is a Japan-based company that sells food and cosmetics using microalgae including Euglena (Japanese name: Midorimushi) and develops and manufactures biofuels. The Company operates through three business segments. The Healthcare Business segment is mainly engaged in the planning and sales of healthcare products including food and cosmetics, the supply of original equipment manufacturers (OEM), as well as the development and production of raw materials. The Biofuel Business segment is mainly engaged in research and development, production and sales of biofuels, as well as the development of cultivation technology for microalgae, primarily Euglena. The Other Business segment is mainly engaged in the manufacturing and sale of organic compound fertilizers, genetic analysis services, social business, as well as research and development in new fields.

name: NS GROUP INC
businessSummary: NS Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly operates a rent guarantee business mainly through its subsidiaries, which offers a rent guarantee service that reports on delinquency payments, and a collection agency service. The rent guarantee service involves acting as a joint guarantor for tenants and promising to guarantee rent. If the tenant fails to pay rent, the Company will make a subrogation payment and later collect the subrogated rent from the tenant. The rent guarantee business is primarily for residential properties, commercial properties (offices and stores), and others (parking lots, leased land, factories and others). The collection agency service involves partnering with financial institutions that provide collection agency services to collect rent on behalf of real estate companies and property lessors.

name: KAIRIKIYA CO LTD
businessSummary: Kairikiya Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the food and beverage business. The Company is engaged in the operation of directly managed stores, independent stores and franchise chains (FC). Their main product is Seabura Shoyu Ramen, which is a soup based on soy sauce and chicken stock with pork back fat added to it. The Company operates a takeout specialty store whose main product is fried chicken and a ramen shop whose main product is tanmen.

name: TO BOOKS INC
businessSummary: TO Books Inc is a Japan-based company that creates and develops intellectual property (IP). The Company operates an IP production structure that integrates IP discovery, editing, and comic book adaptation, as well as planning for audio, stage, and anime adaptations, and merchandise development. It also operates a reproducible creation model that starts with web novels, primarily discovering works from Web novels posted on free novel submission sites, and developing them into books and comic book adaptations. It employs an integrated production system for the creation, production, and development of audio content and the planning and production of stage and anime productions. It has sales channels that allow direct contact with readers and viewers through its official online store and official Web manga site, Corona EX.

name: KITAKEI CO LTD
businessSummary: KITAKEI CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of new construction materials, housing materials, housing equipment and related construction services mainly to timber stores, construction materials stores, construction companies, and housing companies. Interior building materials mainly include flooring, wall materials, ceiling materials, indoor doors, construction materials, stairs, handrails, counters, wall storage. Equipment includes kitchen, bath, vanity, toilet, water heater, ventilator, air conditioner, fireplace, floor heating, lighting equipment, door phones. Chemical products and hardware-related products include heat insulating materials, humidity control materials, waterproofing materials, soundproofing and sound insulating materials, gypsum boards, nails, screws, construction hardware, adhesives and paints. Exterior building materials include exterior wall materials, roofing materials, gutters, eaves, fences, gates, carports, tiles.

name: SOIKEN HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Soiken Holdings Inc. is a Japan-based holding company. The Company operates in six business segments. The Biological Evaluation System segment is engaged in evaluation test of food and research support of medicine. The Healthcare Support segment is engaged in the provision of service about certain health guidance and healthcare insurance. The Cosmetics segment is engaged in manufacturing and sales of cosmetics. The Dietary Supplements segment is engaged in sales of unique dietary supplements. The Marketing segment is engaged in the marketing research of health supplement and sales of energy drink. The Functional Material Development segment is engaged in development and sales of functional materials, such as lactoferrin.

name: DIP CORP
businessSummary: dip Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in human resources service business and digital transformation (DX) business. The Company operates through two segments. The Human Resource Service segment conducts internet job advertising and nurse recruitment, and operates recruitment information sites such as Baitoru, Baitoru NEXT, and Hatarakonet. The DX segment develops and provides services that utilize artificial intelligence (AI) and robotic process automation (RPA). Services include recruitment page cobots, interview cobots, HR cobots, human resources (HR) cobots, and regular cobots.

name: FELISSIMO CORP
businessSummary: FELISSIMO CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in mail-order business centered on clothing, clothing accessories, and lifestyle-related products. In Japan, The Company is engaged in mail order sale of apparel, apparel goods including clothing, personal products, life-related items including houseware, daily necessities, health-related products, handicraft and leisure-related products, food, among others. In addition, the Company is also engaged in order reception, inquiry response, information processing, merchandise management, and order shipment business at the Company's orders and distribution centers.

name: ADR ON NISSAN MOTOR CO LTD
businessSummary: Nissan Motor Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automobiles and parts, as well as the provision of sales financial services. The Company operates through two business segments. The Automotive segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of electric vehicles, compact cars, light cars, minivans, commercial vehicles, trucks, micro buses and other automobiles, as well as related parts. The Sales Finance segment is engaged in the sales finance business and the leasing business to support sales activities of automobile business.

name: INTER ACTION CORP
businessSummary: INTER ACTION Corporation develops, manufactures, purchases and sells light source device, solar power-related products, and image inspection devices. The Company has three business segments. The Light Source Equipment is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of light source device for testing in the production process of imaging semiconductors (charge coupled device (CCD) and complementary metal oxide semiconductor (CMOS)), and display devices. The Solar Power-related Product segment develops, purchases and sells solar simulators, cell testers, solar power modules. The Imaging Inspection segment develops, manufactures and sells Internet protocol (IP) modules, discrete fourier transformation (DFT) test systems, camera module test equipment and related components. As of May 31, 2014, the Company had five subsidiaries.

name: ZENHOREN CO LTD
businessSummary: Zenhoren Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the rent debt guarantee business. The rent debt guarantee is a service that guarantees rent payment to lessors. The Company makes the subrogation payment on behalf of the lessee and collect the subrogated rent from the lessee at a later date for the lessee who fails to pay the rent. The Company provides rent obligation guarantee service that guarantees the payment of rent to the lessor, a joint guarantor is not required, and the lessee can smoothly conclude a lease contract. The Company provides the rent obligation guarantee service through property management companies and real estate brokerage firms that sign guarantee business agreement contracts.

name: FUKUYAMA TRANSPORTING CO LTD
businessSummary: Fukuyama Transporting Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the transportation business and charter business, as well as other businesses such as distribution and processing business, international business, and real estate rental. It operates through four segments. The Transportation segment and Charter segment are involved in freight transportation, port transportation, and businesses incidental to the transportation business such as product payment collection agency. The Distribution and Processing segment is involved in warehousing business, and distribution and processing business. The International segment is involved in international transportation, international freight forwarding, and customs clearance. In addition, it is also involved in real estate rental, goods sales, convenience store, non-life insurance agency, bowling, travel, security, labor dispatch, and electrical equipment installation businesses.

name: NISSIN FOODS HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Nissin Foods Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based holding company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of instant foods, such as instant noodles. The Company is also involved in other food business, logistics business and other related businesses. The Company also conducts business overseas through the manufacture and sale of instant noodles and other products. The Company operates the instant noodles business, refrigerated and beverages business, and confectionery business through six segments, including Nisshin Foods segment, Myojo Foods segment, Refrigerated and Beverages Segment, Confectionery Segment, Americas Segment, and China Segment. Nisshin Foods segment, Myojo Foods segment, Americas segment and China segment manufacture and sell instant bag noodles and cup noodles. Refrigerated and Beverages Segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of chilled products, frozen products and beverages. The Confectionery Segment manufactures and sells confectionery products.

name: NISSHA CO LTD
businessSummary: Nissha Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of industrial materials, devices, and medical technology. The Company operates through three segments. The Industrial Materials segment includes in-mold decoration (IMD), in-mold labeling (IML), in-mold electronics (IME), transfer foil, injection molding, metallized paper, and sustainable molded products. The Devices segment includes film touch sensors, force sensors, and gas sensors. The Medical Technology segment is engaged in contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) of minimally invasive medical surgical equipment and medical wearable sensors, as well as the manufacture and sale of its own brand products.

name: SOLASTO CORP
businessSummary: Solasto Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the medical-related contract business, and the nursing care and childcare business. The Company has two business segments. The Medical Related Contract segment is engaged in the provision of contract and staffing services such as reception, accounting, medical fee billing, hospital management support and other medical office related services. The Nursing Care And Childcare segment is engaged in the provision of home help services, day services, paid nursing homes with long-term care services, care houses, residential-type paid elderly homes, home care support services, group homes, home-visit nursing care services, childcare services, as well as the rental and sale of welfare equipment. The Company is also engaged in the provision of education and training services such as medical and nursing care related courses, the skill certification test business, the real estate leasing business, and the insurance agency business.

name: GRANDES INC
businessSummary: GRANDES, Inc. is a real estate company mainly engaged in the construction and sales of residential properties. The Company operates through two business segments. The Real Estate Sales segment is engaged in the planning, development and sales of residential buildings and speculative houses. The Real Estate Rental Management segment is engaged in the management, maintenance and inspection of rental condominiums and tenant buildings.

name: UNIPRES CORP
businessSummary: Unipres Corp is a Japan-based company mainly manufactures and sells automotive parts. It operates in four segments by region: Japan, Americas, Europe, and Asia. The body pressed parts business manufactures and sells body press parts, and outsources part or all of the manufacturing process to subsidiaries, who then receive materials from the Company and carry out production. The precision parts business manufactures and sells transmission parts, and outsources part or all of the manufacturing process to subsidiaries, who then receive materials from the Company and carry out production. The plastic parts business manufactures and sells plastic parts, and outsources part or all of the manufacturing process to subsidiaries, who then receive materials from the Company and carry out production. In the other businesses, subsidiaries design and construct the Company's factory plants, act as insurance agents, transport the Company's products domestically and others.

name: HOKKAIDO ELECTRIC POWER CO INC
businessSummary: Hokkaido Electric Power Co Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in power generation and retail electricity businesses. The Company operates its business through two business segments. The Hokkaido Electric Power Segment is engaged in corporate functions (group headquarters functions) and power generation and retail electricity business. The Hokkaido Electric Power Networks segment is engaged in electric power transmission and distribution. The Others segment includes electrical and telecommunications engineering, comprehensive real estate management, civil engineering and construction work, periodic inspection, maintenance, and repair work at power plants, and telecommunications business.

name: TOKYO GAS CO LTD
businessSummary: Tokyo Gas Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the gas, electricity, energy-related businesses and real estate businesses. The Company operates through four business segments. The Energy Solutions segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of city gas, liquefied natural gas (LNG) sales, trading, electricity, engineering solutions (engineering, energy services) and others. The Network segment is engaged in the transportation and supply of city gas. The Overseas segment is engaged in the overseas resource development and investment, energy supply and others. The Urban Business segment is engaged in the real estate development and rental and others.

name: MIZUHO LEASING CO LTD
businessSummary: Mizuho Leasing Company, Limited, formerly IBJ Leasing Company, Limited, is mainly engaged in lease, installment sales and various financial transactions for industrial machinery, transportation equipment, information-related equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The Leasing and Installment segment is engaged in the installment sales business of leasing operations (including expiration of lease transactions and property sales due to halfway cancellation) and production facilities, construction earthmoving machines, commercial facilities etc. for industrial machine tools, transportation equipment, information related equipment. The Finance segment is involved in corporate finance, ship financing, factoring business and investment business of securities owned to earn profits for business purpose. The Others segment is engaged in used property buying and selling, solar power selling business.

name: HEIWA PAPER CO LTD
businessSummary: HEIWA PAPER CO.,LTD. is engaged in the Japanese paper and Western paper wholesale business. The Japanese and Western paper wholesale business sells Japanese and Western paper. The warehousing and paper processing business is involved in the delivery, storage and packing of its products, as well as the paper processing business.

name: NMS HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: nms Holdings Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the human solution (HS) business, the electronics manufacturing services (EMS) business and the power supply (PS) business. The Company operates in three business segments. The HS segment is engaged in the provision of production dispatch services, contract manufacturing services and repair customer services. The EMS segment is engaged in the provision of mounting and assembly services for electronic device boards in Japan and overseas. The PS segment is engaged in the design, development, manufacturing and sale of products in the power supply field.

name: KYUSHU ELECTRIC POWER CO INC
businessSummary: Kyushu Electric Power Co Inc is a Japan-based company mainly involved in the electric power business. It has four business segments. The Domestic Electric Power segment mainly consists of domestic power generation and retail business, as well as power transmission and distribution business in the Kyushu region. Other Energy Services segment includes power supply such as construction and maintenance of electric facilities, gas and liquefied natural gas (LNG) sales businesses, renewable energy businesses, and overseas businesses. The Information Technology Communication (ICT) Service segment mainly includes data communication business, optical broadband business, telecommunications construction and maintenance business, information system development business, and data center business. Others segment mainly includes real estate business and paid nursing home business.

name: OKAYA ELECTRIC INDUSTRIES CO LTD
businessSummary: OKAYA ELECTRIC INDUSTRIES CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of electronic products. Along with its subsidiaries, the Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of noise-related products, such as noise suppression, capacitors, noise filters and others; surge products, including surge absorbers and others; display-related products, such as light-emitting diodes (LEDs), liquid crystal display (LCDs), field sequential products and others; as well as sensor-related products. The Company mainly operates its business in domestic and overseas markets.

name: ADR ON TOYOTA MOTOR CORP
businessSummary: Toyota Motor Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the automotive business, as well as financial services and other businesses. It operates through three business segments. The Automotive segment designs, manufactures, and sells automobiles, including sedans, minivans, compact cars, sport utility vehicles (SUVs), and trucks, as well as related parts and accessories. The Financial Services segment provides financing and vehicle leasing services to complement the sales of automobiles and other products manufactured by itself and its affiliates. The Other segment engages in information and communications services. It also oversees manufacturing and sales companies, conducts public relations and research activities, oversees financial companies, and develops various mobility products, primarily software.

name: OHMORIYA CO LTD
businessSummary: OHMORIYA Co., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the food production and sale business covering all food products mainly including seaweed, as well as the real estate leasing business. The Food Production and Sale segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of commercial laver products such as home laver, advanced products and sprinkles, both in Japan and overseas. Main products include seasoned laver, grilled laver, sprinkle, ochazuke, soup, among others.

name: ACOM CO LTD
businessSummary: Acom Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in loan and credit card business, credit guarantee business, overseas financial business, debt management and collection business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Loan and Credit Card segment provides the unsecured loan business and the credit card business with MasterCard as the main product. The Credit Guarantee segment is engaged in credit guarantee business. The Overseas Financial segment includes unsecured loan business in Thailand and the Philippines, installation loan business in Thailand (individual credit purchase brokerage business), and banking business in Indonesia. The Debt Management and Collection segment provides servicer business including debt management and collection business. The others include contracting a contact center and dispatching human resources business.

name: ATEAM HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Ateam Holdings Co Ltd, formerly Ateam Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the entertainment business, the lifestyle support business and the electronic commerce (EC) business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Entertainment segment is engaged in the planning, development and operation of games and tool applications for smartphones, tablet terminals and other smart devices. The Lifestyle Support segment is engaged in the planning, development and operation of comparison sites and information sites that provide information closely related to life events and daily life. The EC segment is engaged the planning, development and operation of multiple E-Commerce sites that handle a variety of products, including lujo, RESP, and OBREMO.

name: TOKYO CENTURY CORP
businessSummary: Tokyo Century Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in businesses related to leasing and financing. The Domestic Leasing Business segment provides leasing and financing and related services for information and telecommunications equipment, office equipment, transportation equipment, and commercial and service equipment. The Auto Mobility Business segment provides auto leasing, car rental, car sharing, and other services for corporate and individual customers. The Specialty Business segment provides domestic and overseas lease financing and related services for products such as ships, aircraft, and real estate. The International Business segment provides lease financing and related ancillary services in East Asia, ASEAN countries, North America, and Latin America, as well as automobile business. The Environmental Infrastructure Business segment engages in power generation business, lease financing, and related ancillary services in Japan and overseas related to renewable energy.

name: HONMA GOLF LTD
businessSummary: Honma Golf Ltd is engaged in the manufacture and sale of golf-related products and provision of services related to products. The Company is engaged in the design, development, manufacture and sales of various golf clubs under the brand of Honma. The Company is also engaged in the provision of golf balls, bags, clothing and other accessories. The Company sells products in Asia, North America, Europe and other regions.

name: TOAMI CORP
businessSummary: TOAMI CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of civil engineering and building materials. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of various wire meshes such as welded wire meshes, rebar grids, welded wire meshes for reinforcing openings, stainless steel welded wire meshes, one-way meshes and solid foundation rebar units, reinforced processed products such as TOAMI hoops, spiral hoops, power rings, polygonal hoop bars for circles and spiral bars for seismic reinforcement, wire meshes for glass, mesh fences, as well as special welded wire mesh products such as C panels and blank panels. The Company is also engaged in the purchase and sale of reinforcing steels, gabions, square gabions and other products.

name: W TOKYO INC
businessSummary: W TOKYO Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the utilizing of the TOKYO GIRLS COLLECTION brand. The Company is engaged in the TGC production business that receives income from sponsorship money, ticket sales, and brand exhibition fees of TOKYO GIRLS COLLECTION. The Company operates content production and branding business that earn advertising casting income and creative production income by branding products. The Company is also engaged in digital advertising business, develops affiliate service provider (ASP) Affiliate Walker and official media girlswalker.

name: OKUMURA CORP
businessSummary: OKUMURA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the general construction and related businesses such as civil engineering and construction. The Company operates through three business segments. The Civil Engineering segment and Construction segment are engaged in civil engineering, construction and other general construction work. The Real Estate segment is involved in the sale and leasing of real estate. The Company is also involved in the manufacture and sale of construction materials and equipment, as well as the Private Finance Initiative (PFI) business.

name: KIYO BANK LTD
businessSummary: Kiyo Bank Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in businesses related to financial services, centering on the banking business. The Banking business is engaged in deposit, lending, domestic and foreign exchange, and other services. The Company is also engaged in office work agency services, job placement services, credit guarantee services, leasing services, venture capital services, investment services, credit card services, program creation and sales, and contracted computing services.

name: IMAGINEER CO., LTD
businessSummary: Imagineer Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of content and renewable energy business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Content segment is involved in the provision of mobile content and mobile commerce, the manufacture of character goods, the development and provision of software for home video game consoles, as well as the license business. The mobile content is involved in the development for platforms centering on stamps and applications. The mobile commerce is engaged in the plan, manufacture and sale of original goods limited to Websites. The Renewable Energy segment is involved in the renewable energy business centered on small hydropower generation. The Company is also involved in the publishing business centering on Yakyu Taro.

name: FUJI PHARMA CO LTD
businessSummary: Fuji Pharma Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of medical products. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of hormone medicines for obstetrics and gynecology department, as well as injectable drugs for radiological department such as radiopaque dye for urinary tracts and blood vessels through its branches. The Company's products are primarily used to treat dysmenorrhea, endometriosis, pregnancy and childbirth, and menopause.

name: OKINAWA ELECTRIC POWER CO INC
businessSummary: Okinawa Electric Power Co Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the electric power business, and construction and other businesses to supplement and support the electric power business or to make effective use of management resources. The Company operates through two business segments. The electric utility segment is engaged in the provision of service to customers in Okinawa Prefecture, combining power generated by the Company with power received from other sources. The electric utility segment is engaged in the provision of power generation, general transmission and distribution, and retail electricity services. The construction business segment is engaged in the provision of civil, building, electrical, plumbing, and telecommunications construction, as well as installation and maintenance of electric power facilities. The Company is also engaged in contract operation of electromechanical equipment and real estate business.

name: HINO MOTORS LTD
businessSummary: Hino Motors Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of trucks and buses, and the provision of related services. The Company operates in two regional segments, including Japan and Asia. The Company is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of various trucks, sightseeing buses, route buses, industrial diesel engines and other products, the manufacture of machined parts, forged parts, dies, electrical components and other products, the assembly of automobiles and unit parts, as well as the sale of automobiles. The Company operates within the domestic market and to overseas markets, including Asia, North America, Oceania and others.

name: ADR ON MIZUHO FINANCIAL GROUP INC
businessSummary: Mizuho Financial Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the banking, trust banking, securities, and other financial services. The Company operates through five business segments: Retail & Business Corporations Company (RBC), Corporate & Investment Banking Company (CIBC), Global Corporate & Investment Banking Company (GCIBC), Global Markets Company (GMC), and Asset Management Company (AMC). The CIBC segment operates for clients of large corporate corporations, financial corporations and public corporations in Japan. The GCIBC segment operates for clients of overseas-affiliated Japanese companies and non-Japanese companies. The GMC segment is engaged in investment business in interest rates, equity, among others. The AMC segment is engaged in the development and provision of products that meet the asset management needs of clients from individuals to institutional investors.

name: JAFCO GROUP CO LTD
businessSummary: JAFCO Group Co Ltd is a Japan-based company specializes in venture investments and buyout investments through fund management. The Company operates fund management business. The Company solicits investments from institutional investors and business companies once every three and a half years. The fund's management period is 10 years, with a two-year extension period. The Company seeks promising companies, accumulates new investments over a three and a half-year period, and builds a portfolio for each fund. The Company also increases its post-investment management involvement, working with entrepreneurs to grow businesses and improve corporate value. The Company aims for an exit through an initial public offering (IPO) or mergers and acquisitions (M&A). Its primary sources of revenue are management fees and success fees from funds, as well as capital gains on direct investments in funds. The Company operates in Japan, the United States, Asia, and other regions.

name: SOCIONEXT INC
businessSummary: Socionext Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of System-on-a-Chip (SoC) to be developed under the Solution SoC business model. The Company's business is focused on custom SoCs that are designed specific to particular customers. The Company partners with customers who require unique advanced SoCs for new service and product differentiation, and provides intellectual property (IP), electronic design automation (EDA) tools, and technologies ranging from software to process, assembly, and test. The Company's solution SoC business model allows it to work with customers to create these upstream designs, thus making its products available to customers who do not possess upstream design capabilities.

name: ADR ON NOMURA HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Nomura Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the securities, investment, and other financial services business across the world. The Company has three business segments. The Sales segment provides investment consultation services to individual clients in Japan. The Investment Management segment provides investment management services and investment solutions, including the establishment and management of investment trusts, discretionary investment services for domestic and foreign investors, fund management and administration for investment corporations and institutional investors, and silent partnership management. The Wholesale segment is engaged in the sale and trading of bonds, equity securities, derivatives, and foreign exchange, as well as investment banking services such as the bonds and securities underwriting business, merger and acquisition (M&A) business and financial advisory services. The Company operates in Japan, the Americas, Europe, Asia and Oceania.

name: NOMURA REAL ESTATE HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Nomura Real Estate Holdings Inc is a real estate holding company. The Company operates in five business segments. The Housing segment is engaged in the development and allotment of condominiums, detached houses and residential properties, the development of housing for seniors, as well as the contracting of reform work business. The Urban Development segment is engaged in the development, leasing and sale of office buildings, logistics facilities and commercial facilities. The Asset Management segment provides asset management services for private placement funds, REITs and real estate securitized products. The Brokerage and CRE segment is engaged in the brokerage and consulting of real estate. The Operation Management segment is engaged in the management of office building and condominiums. The Company is also engaged in trading and leasing of land and buildings.

name: FUETREK CO LTD
businessSummary: FueTrek Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the licensing of software. The License segment is engaged in converting what has been developed and designed into intellectual property rights. The Video and Media segment is a video production business and an advertising agency business that perform planning, production of video such as television programs. The Others segment is the basic business field that performs entrusted development and automotive software development, the transcription business field that provides services that transcribe voice data provided by customers in characters, and the international business field that performs inbound and outbound business.

name: DENKA CO LTD
businessSummary: Denka Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of electronic and advanced products, life innovation, elastomers and infrastructure solutions, and polymer solutions. The Company operates through four business segments. The Electronics & Advanced Products segment provides electronic packaging materials, fine ceramics, fused silica, acetylene black, electronic circuit boards, and industrial tapes. The Life Innovation segment provides vaccines, diagnostics, and oncology virus products. The Elastomers and Infrastructure Solutions segment provides chloroprene rubber, cement, specialty admixtures, fertilizers, carbide, refractories, and environmental materials. The Polymer Solutions segment offers tylene monomers, polystyrene resins, clearenes, heat-resistant and transparent resins, poval, yarn for synthetic wigs, and food packaging materials. The Company also operates plant engineering and trading businesses.

name: PIGEON CORP
businessSummary: Pigeon Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, purchase and sale of childcare and nursing products. It has six business segments. Domestic Baby and Mom segment manufactures and sells childcare and women’s products. Products are mainly weaning related products, skin care products, wet tissues, baby foods and outing products. China segment manufactures and sells products in China, South Korea, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Russia. Lansinoh segment manufactures and sells products in United States, Germany, United Kingdom, Turkey, China. Singapore segment manufactures and sells products in ASEAN countries such as Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand and Malaysia, as well as India, Australia and Middle East. Healthcare and Nursing Care segment manufactures and sells products and provides nursing care services. Products are incontinence products, care facility products. Children Support segment operates childcare facilities and infant classrooms and provides baby-sitting services.

name: GEECHS INC
businessSummary: geechs inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in information technology (IT) staffing business and games business. The Company operates through six segments. The IT Staffing segment is engaged in introducing IT freelances to companies in need. The IT Talents Development segment is engaged in school business for training IT engineers who are active in global. The Game segment collaborates and partner with game distributors to entrust the planning, development and operation of native application games for smartphones based on Unity. The Video segment entrust video and video production related to promotion on the Internet. The Internet segment operates Gridge, a specialized golf information site which can also deliver advertisements of golf equipment manufacturers and apparel companies. The Global Recruiting segment introducing foreign students studying in Japan and Japanese students studying abroad with companies in need of global talents.

name: SHIMA SEIKI MFG. LTD
businessSummary: SHIMA SEIKI MFG., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of flat knitting equipment, design systems, gloves and socks knitting equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The Flat Knitting Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of computer flat knitting equipment and semi jacquard flat knitting equipment. The Design Systems Related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of computer design systems, as well as apparel computer-aided design (CAD) and computer-aided manufacturing (CAM) systems. The Gloves and Socks Knitting Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of seamless gloves and socks knitting equipment. The Company is also engaged in the manufacture, sale and trading of textile materials, the planning, manufacture and sale of textile products, the operation of hotels, the manufacture and sale of knitting equipment and design system parts, as well as the repair and maintenance business.

name: ACCRETE INC
businessSummary: Accrete Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of short message service (SMS) . The SMS is a service for sending messages of up to 70 full-size characters to devices only by the telephone number of the other party. The short message peer to peer (SMPP) international gateway service provides SMS distribution between domestic users and foreign SMS aggregators through SMPP. SMPP is a communication protocol used between mobile phone operators.

name: DAIO PAPER CORP
businessSummary: Daio Paper Corporation is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of paper products. The Company operates in two business segments. The Paper and Paper Board segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of papers, paper boards, newsprint paper, printing paper and related materials. The Home and Personal Care segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of sanitary paper products, disposable diapers, feminine care products, wet wipes.

name: SAMTY HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Samty Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in real estate development business, real estate solutions business, overseas business, real estate rental business, hotel rental and operation business, and real estate management business. The real estate development business plans, develops, and sells its own brand 'S-RESIDENCE' series. The real estate solutions business acquires, rehabilitates, and sells profitable real estate. The overseas business is engaged in overseas investment and housing development business. The real estate rental business is engaged in the rental of condominiums, office buildings, and commercial facilities. The hotel rental and operation business is engaged in the rental and management of hotels. The real estate management business manages condominiums, office buildings, and commercial facilities.

name: HIROGIN HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Hirogin Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of banking services and financial services. The Company is engaged in the collateral real estate evaluation business, financial product trading business, bond management and collection business, asset management business, credit card business and credit guarantee business. The Company is also engaged in the leasing and auto-leasing business, factoring business, investment business and other comprehensive financial business.

name: USHIO INC
businessSummary: Ushio Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacturing and sales of products related to its Industrial Process, Visual Imaging, Life Science, and Photonics Solution businesses. The Company operates through four segments. The Industrial Process segment focuses on the semiconductor market, producing and selling exposure lamps, office automation (OA) lamps, and optical devices. The Visual Imaging segment focuses on the cinema and general imaging markets, producing and selling projector lamps and imaging equipment. The Life Science segment concentrates on environmental hygiene solutions and the healthcare market, producing and selling UV therapy devices and light sources. The Photonics Solution segment produces and sells solid-state light sources.

name: COLUMBIA WORKS INC
businessSummary: Columbia Works Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of real estate development services and related business activities such as real estate leasing and management services, hotel management services, and asset management services. The Real Estate Development Business segment mainly includes residences (rental condominiums), offices, and hotels, and develops residences under the Blance and LUMIEC brand names and offices under the BIASTA brand name. Real estate leasing and management services mainly involve leasing and managing commercial facilities, offices, and residences. Hotel management services provide hotel management services through the creation of art hotels and other spaces. Asset management services provide asset formation, asset management, and asset preservation services on behalf of investors.

name: INTAGE HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: INTAGE HOLDINGS Inc., formerly INTAGE Inc., is a provider of marketing research and consulting services. The Market Research and Consulting segment is engaged in marketing research operations, including customer panel research, retail shop panel research and other research activities; customized research services, including Internet research, mail survey, visiting interview survey and qualitative research, as well as the provision of related consulting services. The System Solution segment is engaged in the development and sale of software, the operation of systems and data centers, and the provision of various related consulting services. The Drug Development Support segment is engaged in the contract research organization (CRO) business. As of March 31, 2014, the Company had 24 subsidiaries and one associated company.

name: SOLIZE HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Solize Holdings Corp, formerly Solize Corp, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the engineering partnering of global product development through the use of 3D technology and other digital technologies. In addition to the production of prototypes, the Company also provides services such as research and development, design (styling), control, design, and analysis, which are the pre-production processes of prototypes, and production preparation, and the post-production process, such as production preparation and the production of final parts using 3D printers. The Company operates through two business segments. The Design segment is engaged in the support of product development and corporate business model transformation. The Manufacturing segment is engaged in the provision of evaluation and verification models for product development, as well as sales and operational support for 3D printers.

name: ORIENT CORP
businessSummary: Orient Corporation is a Japan-based consumer credit company. The Company operates in consumer credit business through four business segments. The Personal Installment segment is engaged in the provision of installment services for personal consumption such as school expense and housing improvement loans through reimbursement and credit guarantee methods. The Card and Financing segment operates in company own card business, affiliated credit card business, cashing service business, loan card business and other businesses. The Bank Guarantee segment is engaged in the provision of joint and several guarantee services for consumer’s financing activities. In addition, the Company is also involved in the credit management and collection business, as well as consumer credit peripheral business. The Settlement and Guarantee segment performs rent settlement guarantee, accounts receivable settlement guarantee, retail lease guarantee and collection agency.

name: NOMURA HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Nomura Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the securities, investment, and other financial services business across the world. The Company has three business segments. The Sales segment provides investment consultation services to individual clients in Japan. The Investment Management segment provides investment management services and investment solutions, including the establishment and management of investment trusts, discretionary investment services for domestic and foreign investors, fund management and administration for investment corporations and institutional investors, and silent partnership management. The Wholesale segment is engaged in the sale and trading of bonds, equity securities, derivatives, and foreign exchange, as well as investment banking services such as the bonds and securities underwriting business, merger and acquisition (M&A) business and financial advisory services. The Company operates in Japan, the Americas, Europe, Asia and Oceania.

name: FUYO GENERAL LEASE CO LTD
businessSummary: Fuyo General Lease Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of the leasing of machinery, equipment, and fixtures, real estate leasing, installment sales, and financial transactions such as loans. It has three segments. The Leasing and Installment Sales segment is engaged in the leasing of information-related equipment, office equipment, industrial machine tools, and other items (including property sales upon the expiration or cancellation of lease transactions), real estate leasing, and installment sales of commercial facilities, production facilities, and hospital facilities.
