The Materials segment develops, manufactures, sells, and services electronic materials, display materials, industrial materials, fine chemicals, graphic communication system materials, and inkjet materials. The Business Innovation segment develops, manufactures, sells, and services digital multifunction devices, solutions, and services. The Imaging segment develops, manufactures, sells, and services instant photo systems, color films, color paper, services, and equipment for photo printing, digital cameras, and optical devices.

name: GOOD COM ASSET CO LTD
businessSummary: Good Com Asset Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning, development, sales, and management of new investment condominiums under its own brand, the GENOVIA series. The Company operates through four business segments. The Wholesale segment sells new condominiums under its own brand to domestic and overseas corporations. The Retail Sales segment sells new condominiums under its own brand to domestic and overseas individual investors. The Real Estate Management segment manages rental properties and buildings for sold condominiums, as well as collecting rents and guaranteeing rent obligations before handing them over to customers. The Other segment provides investor relations (IR) and capital policy consulting for new listings and post-listings, sells real estate fractionalized products, Good Com Fund, and operates real estate fund business.

name: AEON CO LTD
businessSummary: Aeon Co Ltd is a pure holding company that develops comprehensive finance, developers and services focusing on retail businesses. The Company operates in eight segments. The General Merchandise Stores (GMS) segment mainly operates general supermarkets. The Supermarket (SM) segment operates supermarkets, convenience stores and small supermarkets. The Discount Store (DS) segment operates discount store business. The Health & Wellness segment operates drug stores, dispensing pharmacies. The Integrated Financial segment operates credit card business, fee business, banking business and insurance business. The Developer segment develops and leases shopping centers. The Service and Specialty Store segment operates specialty stores that sell general facility management services, amusement, food service, family casual fashion and shoes. The International segment operates retail businesses in the ASEAN region and China. The others include mobile marketing business and digital business.

name: HEIWA REAL ESTATE CO LTD
businessSummary: HEIWA REAL ESTATE CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in leasing business and real estate solution business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Leasing segment specializes in the development, leasing, management and operation of stock exchanges, offices, commercial facilities and housing. The Real Estate Solution segment is engaged in the development, sales, operation and management of real estates for revenue, development and sales of residential houses as well as real estate agency business. The Others businesses include the maintenance and repair of building equipment, contract work for repair, insurance agency business, etc.

name: TOKYO ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY HOLDINGS IN
businessSummary: Tokyo Electric Power Company Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in businesses related to electric power. The Company operates through five segments. The Holdings segment provides management support, common services to each core operating company, and nuclear power generation and other businesses. The Fuel & Power segment sells electricity generated by thermal power plants, procures fuel, develops thermal power sources, and invests in fuel businesses. The Power Grid segment supplies electric power through transmission, substation, and distribution, and constructs and maintains transmission, distribution, and communication facilities. The Energy Partner segment proposes total solutions in line with customer requirements, provides services, and conducts power supply procurement business. The Renewable Power segment sells electricity generated from renewable energy sources, maintains and manages facilities, and develops and invests in new renewable energy power sources.

name: NKK SWITCHES CO LTD
businessSummary: NKK SWITCHES CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of various industrial switches. The Company operates in three regional segments. The Japan segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of various industrial switches, and the processing of switches manufactured by external customers in Japan. The America segment is involved in the sale of switch products in North America. The Asia segment is involved in the assembly processing of switch products in China, and the sale of products in Hong Kong, China, and rest of Asia.

name: MODEC INC
businessSummary: Modec Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction of floating oil production facilities and the provision of various related services. Its primary business is the provision of engineering, procurement, construction, and installation (EPCI) services and charter services (leasing and operation services) for floating production, storage, and offloading facilities, such as floating production, storage, and offloading (FPSO), floating storage, and offloading (FSO), and tension-moored platforms (TLP), used in the midstream of offshore oil and gas production. Its primary clients are government-affiliated and private oil and gas development companies overseas. It also provides after-sales services, such as parts supply and engineering support, for FPSOs and other facilities it builds and delivers to oil and gas development companies, as well as management and operational support to affiliates and joint ventures.

name: HOKUHOKU FINANCIAL GROUP INC
businessSummary: Hokuhoku Financial Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of comprehensive financial services centered on the banking business. The Company operates in two business segments including Hokuriku Bank and Hokkaido Bank. The Company provides regional financial group with offices in the three major metropolitan areas of Hokkaido, Hokuriku, and Tokyo, Nagoya, Osaka. The Company primarily offers comprehensive financial service functions that respond to a wide range of needs such as securities business, leasing, credit card, venture capital, software development, servicer business. The Hokuriku Bank segment and Hokkaido Bank segment offer banking business. The Company also provides securities business, leasing business and credit card business.

name: INTEGRAL CORP
businessSummary: Integral Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the private equity (PE) investment fund business. It forms and manages funds with the aim of investing primarily in unlisted companies. As a general partner (GP), it manages PE investment funds, earning management fees and providing management support to investee companies. It aims to expand profit opportunities by making principal investments in addition to investments through PE investment funds under certain rules. In addition to PE investments, it also invests in other asset classes such as real estate, growth and infrastructure as part of its medium- to long-term growth strategy.

name: CHOFU SEISAKUSHO CO LTD
businessSummary: Chofu Seisakusho Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacturing and sales of water heaters, air-conditioning equipment, system equipment, as well as solar devices. The Company operates through the residential-related equipment manufacturing and sales business segment. Water heater products include oil-fired water heaters, oil bath boilers, gas water heaters, gas bath boilers, electric water heaters and EcoCute systems. Air-conditioning products include oil stoves, gas stoves, hot water heating systems, geothermal heat pumps and snow-melting systems. System equipment includes system baths, artificial marble bathtubs and system kitchens. Solar devices include solar water heaters, solar hot-water supply systems and solar-powered underfloor ventilation fans.

name: BROADMEDIA CORP
businessSummary: Broadmedia Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the multimedia distribution business. The Company has six business segments. Education segment operates the wide-area correspondence high schools, the Renaissance Japanese Language Institute and programming schools. Media Content segment sells television broadcasting rights, video-on-demand (VOD) rights and others. Studio Production segment produces Japanese subtitles and dubbing. Broadcasting segment provides programs to broadcasters, and undertakes video production, and operates the Fishing Vision Club and provides fishing content to video content providers. Technology segment provides Akamai services (content delivery network (CDN) services, security services), cloud solutions, digital cinema services, and other solution services. The Other segment operates the e-sports team CAG OSAKA, plans and manages e-sports-related events, and plans, develops, and sells games for the Nintendo Switch and virtual reality (VR) software.

name: OPTIM CORP
businessSummary: OPTiM Corp is a Japan-based company that mainly engages in providing management services (administration and operation services) and information technology (IT) support services (assistance with the use and management of information devices IT applications and services). The Company operates the license sales and maintenance support services (optimal) business segment. The X-Tech services offer integrated platforms and industry-specific digital transformation (DX) solutions utilizing artificial intelligence (AI) and the Internet of things (IoT). The mobile management services enable unified management and security measures for smart devices and personal computers (PC) through cloud-based solutions. Other services include remote support, AI-powered camera analytics and electronic book services, among a diverse range of products.

name: OPTIMUS GROUP CO LTD
businessSummary: Optimus Group Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of comprehensive automotive-related service business internationally. It exports and sells used cars from Japan to overseas markets, provides comprehensive services, purchases used cars from Japanese auto auction operators, performs maintenance, decontamination and others for exports, and provides other services. It operates through five business segments. Import/Export segment purchases and sells used cars, with New Zealand as its primary market. Logistics segment focuses on marine transportation for used car exports from Japan and land transportation of new cars to Australia. Services segment provides a range of services for businesses such as used car dealers in New Zealand, and general consumers. Inspection segment provides inspection services necessary for used car exports. Retail/Wholesale segment operates retail and wholesale business for new and used cars, with Australia as its primary market.

name: SERIA CO LTD
businessSummary: Seria Co Ltd. is a Japan-based discount retailer of general merchandise that sells products at a single price of 100 yen. The Company is involved in the retail of consumer products through stores, as well as the wholesale of products to franchisees, big clients and overseas agents. The Company offers daily miscellaneous goods such as make-up goods, kitchen supplies, eating utensils, washing and bathing goods, sanitary products, cleaning substances, cosmetics, accessories, sewing goods, stationery, toys, character goods, gardening goods, health products, hygiene products, clothes, cleaning products, storage goods, tools, umbrellas, electrical appliances, pet goods, interior goods, outdoor products and seasonal products, among others. It also provides sweet stuff including instant foods, seasonings, canned food, noodles, rice, confectionery, drinks, bakery products, sweets and others.

name: NAMURA SHIPBUILDING CO LTD
businessSummary: Namura Shipbuilding Co Ltd mainly manufactures and sells ships, machinery and steel structures, and repairs ships. The Company operates in four business segments. The New Shipbuilding segment manufactures and sells various ships. The Repair Ship segment repairs ships. The Steel Construction and Machinery segment purchases the materials, manufactures marine equipment such as crankshafts. The Others segment is involved in the software development, sales of information equipment, equipment maintenance, security operations, ship maintenance and after-sales service and others.

name: PENTA-OCEAN CONSTRUCTION CO LTD
businessSummary: Penta-Ocean Construction Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction and development business, equipment leasing business and shipbuilding business, as well as the sale of construction materials. The Company operates in four business segments. The Domestic Civil Engineering segment conducts civil engineering works in the domestic markets. The Domestic Construction segment conducts construction works in the domestic markets. The Overseas Construction segment is involved in the provision of construction works in overseas markets. The Others segment engages in the independent development, sales and rental of real estate.

name: HULIC CO LTD
businessSummary: Hulic Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the real estate business and insurance business. It operates through two business segments. Real Estate segment has three kinds of business. The real estate leasing business manages approximately 250 rental properties (excluding real estate for sale) that are owned and managed mainly near stations in the 23 wards of Tokyo. Real estate development business is performed according to the characteristics of the property location. Asset management business is entrusted with asset management business. It also provides real estate rental, building management and cleaning business. The Insurance segment is engaged in non-life insurance agency business such as fire insurance and automobile insurance, life insurance such as fixed-term insurance and endowment insurance, and solicitation business. It is also engaged in the design, repair and construction work on owned buildings, hotel and inn management and agricultural production in Vietnam.

name: NANKAI ELECTRIC RAILWAY CO LTD
businessSummary: Nankai Electric Railway Co., Ltd. is primarily engaged in the transportation business. The Company has six business segments. Nankai Electric Railway Co., Ltd. is primarily engaged in the transportation business. The Company has six business segments. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing and sale of real estate. The Distribution segment is engaged in the operation of shopping centers, station business and others. The Leisure Service segment is engaged in the amusement park business, the tour business, the hotel business, the boat race facility leasing business, the building management and maintenance business, funeral business and others. The Construction segment is engaged in building construction works. The Others segment is involved in the accounting and information processing businesses, among others.

name: MUTOH HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: MUTOH HOLDINGS CO., LTD. is primarily involved in the development, manufacture and sale of information graphics-related equipment. The Company operates in four business segments. The information graphics-related Equipment segment offers large-format inkjet printers for graphic arts, computer aided design (CAD) plotters, industry-specific plotters, imaging scanners, 3D printers and other related supply products. The Information Services segment provides services for CAD and related software, as well as software development and system integration services. The Design Measuring Equipment is engaged in the provision of drafting and design equipment, optical measuring equipment. The Real Estate Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing of real estate. The Company also offers sports support goods and restaurants business.

name: HYAKUGO BANK LTD
businessSummary: Hyakugo Bank Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly provides financial services such as leasing business mainly banking. The Company mainly operates through two business segments. The Banking segment provides deposit services, loan services, domestics exchange services and foreign exchange services. This segment is involved in the investment trust and insurance counter sales, financial product intermediation, merger and acquisition (M&A) and syndicated loans. This segment is also engaged in the examination and adjustment of cash, the storage and management of documents and accounting books, the survey and evaluation of real estate, the placement agency and personnel management business. The Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing business. The Company is also engaged in the trading of financial products, the credit card and credit guarantee business, the provision of regional industry survey- and consulting-related services, as well as the processing of information business.

name: PANASONIC HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Panasonic Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture of electronic products. The Company operates in five segments. The Living segment develops, manufactures, and sells refrigerators, microwave ovens, rice cookers, washing machines, solar power generation systems, fuel cells, bicycles, and nursing care-related products. The Automotive segment develops, manufactures, and sells in-vehicle infotainment systems, head-up displays, in-vehicle switches, and automotive mirrors. The Connect segment develops, manufactures, and sells in-flight entertainment systems and communication services, electronic component mounting systems, welding machines, projectors, and professional-use camera systems. The Industry Segment develops, manufactures, and sells electronic components, motors, and electronic materials. The Energy segment develops, manufactures, and sells automotive cylindrical lithium-ion batteries, primary batteries, and small rechargeable batteries.

name: JAPAN SYSTEM TECHNIQUES CO LTD
businessSummary: Japan System Techniques Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the software business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Software segment is engaged in the development of software that is tailor-made to meet the individual needs of customers. The GAKUEN segment is engaged in the development and sale of school business reform packages and related services. The System Sale segment is engaged in the sale and maintenance of information technology (IT) equipment, hardware and software, as well as the building of information and communication infrastructure. The Medical Big Data segment provides services for automatic inspection, analysis, and notification of medical expenses for receipts.

name: DEMAE-CAN CO LTD
businessSummary: Demae-can Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the Demae-can business. The main business involves operating delivery-specialized websites and apps. The Demae-can business includes website operation and management, system development, advertising operation and management, and delivery agency services. The Demae-can business primarily consists of Demae-can and Yahoo! Quick Mart. Demae-can is a delivery service featuring restaurants across numerous genres, as well as retail stores like supermarkets and convenience stores offering beverages, alcoholic drinks, and daily necessities. Yahoo! Quick Mart is a service delivering fresh food and daily necessities in as little as 30 minutes.

name: ITOKURO INC
businessSummary: ItoKuro Inc. is a Japan-based company, mainly engaged in media services and consulting services. The Company operates Internet media business segment. It's media services is engaged in operating specialized domain-specific portal site in education industry. It's consulting services is engaged in supporting the marketing activities of client companies in education industry. The main features of the media service are a locomi stock model, a large volume of customers, and a performance-based billing system.

name: TOKYO KIKAI SEISAKUSHO LTD
businessSummary: TOKYO KIKAI SEISAKUSHO, LTD. is principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of printing machinery and press control systems. The Company operates the Printing Machinery-related segment. The segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of printing machinery related products, as well as the provision of related maintenance service.

name: PASONA GROUP INC
businessSummary: Pasona Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly provides human resources (HR) solutions. It has six segments. The Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) Solutions segment accepts or undertakes tasks from clients and processes them through a system of employees and workers who have signed employment contracts to carry out the tasks. The Expert Solutions segment recruits and registers temporary staff and dispatches them to companies. The Career Solutions segment recruits and registers job seekers and job seekers, while also collecting job information and conducting a fee-based employment placement business to match mutual needs. The Global Solutions segment provides a full range of HR related services overseas, including recruitment, temporary staffing and contract work, payroll, and education and training. The Life Solutions segment engages in childcare support and education, nursing care, and life support businesses. It also has the Regional Revitalization and Tourism Solutions segment.

name: FRONTIER MANAGEMENT INC
businessSummary: Frontier Management Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of various management support services and financial support services. The Company operates through two business segments. The Consulting and Advisory Business segment is divided into management consulting business, mergers and acquisitions (M&A) advisory business, turnaround support business and other businesses. Management consulting business provides services such as formulating management strategies and others. M&A advisory business provides advice and assistance on all aspects of M&A and organizational restructuring. Turnaround support business provides support to companies that require turnaround support. Other business provides research in connection with the turnaround support and M&A advisory. The Investment Business segment operates investment business involving the dispatch of management personnel with the aim of improving the long-term and sustainable corporate value of investees.

name: AEROEDGE CO LTD
businessSummary: AeroEdge Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly based in the processing, manufacturing and sale of aircraft engine parts and other products. The Company operates through two businesses. Thr aircraft engine parts processing business is engaged in the processing, production and sale of titanium-aluminum low-pressure turbine blades mounted on commercial aircraft and aircraft engines. Aircraft engine mainly consists of fan, low pressure compressor, combustor, high pressure compressor, high pressure turbine and low pressure turbine. The other processing business is engaged in the commissioned processing of parts for electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft, flying cars, and parts for gas turbines.

name: VRAIN SOLUTION INC
businessSummary: VRAIN Solution Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the provision of artificial intelligence (AI) systems and digital transformation (DX) consulting businesses that utilize technologies such as AI and Internet of things (IoT) technologies for the manufacturing industry. The Company operates through two businesses. The AI system business plans, researches, and develops AI systems as a solution to improve productivity. The Company also provides them in combination with peripheral hardware such as imaging equipment, depending on the manufacturing environment of the production line and problems for customers. Its main products include the AI visual inspection system Phoenix Vision/Eye. The DX consulting business provides services that support DX promotion for customers.

name: DAIEI KANKYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Daiei Kankyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in environment-related businesses centered on waste treatment and resource recycling. The environment-related segment is engaged in the provision of one-stop services for waste collection, transportation, intermediate treatment, recycling, and final disposal, as well as total solutions for contaminated soil, from investigation to remediation. The environment-related business is divided into seven categories: waste treatment and resource recycling, soil remediation, energy creation, forest conservation, facility construction and operation management, consulting, and others. The Company also operates a valuable resources recycling business consisting of aluminum pellets and recycled plastic pallets.

name: ZENSHO HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Zensho Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the food industry. The Company has six segments. The Global Sukiya segment operates the beef bowl chain Sukiya domestically and overseas. The Global Hama Sushi segment operates the sushi chain Hama Sushi domestically and overseas. The Global Fast Food segment operates various fast food businesses, including takeout sushi, domestically and overseas. The Restaurant segment operates the restaurant business domestically and overseas. The Retail segment operates supermarkets, etc. The Headquarters and Support segment provides support services for each business type. Other businesses are mainly external sales manufacturing and wholesale, nursing care, and livestock and fisheries businesses.

name: AND FACTORY INC
businessSummary: and factory, inc mainly engages in Smartphone APP business and Internet of Things (IoT) business. The Company operates three segments. The Smartphone APP segment develops and operates a bulletin board application called strongest series that seeks the strategy of popular smartphone game applications managed by other companies and recruits partners of multiplayer, as well as provides saevices through distribution platform such as App Store. The IoT segment develops IoT platform applications that enable operation of multiple IoT devices, develops accommodation area related technology, and provides IoT service. The Other segment operates the advertising agency business related to advertisement distribution service using the smartphone application or media managed by the company as a publication medium.

name: SHIGA BANK LTD
businessSummary: Shiga Bank Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of financial services centered on the banking business. The Bank is engaged in the provision of deposits, loans, domestic exchange, foreign exchange and securities investment services. The Bank is also involved in the finance leasing business, installment sales business, venture capital investment business, credit card business, cashing business, the operation of automated teller facilities outside its offices, as well as the provision of document storage and management services, real estate assessment services, data processing services, mortgage guarantee services and business operation-related consulting services.

name: BP CASTROL KK
businessSummary: BP Castrol KK is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of Castrol and bp brand automotive lubricants. The Company is engaged in product development, raw material procurement, marketing and sales activities. Its main products include gasoline engine oil, diesel engine oil, automotive gear oil, automatic transmission fluid (ATF) including continuously variable transmission (CVT) fluid, brake fluid and car care products. The automotive lubricants market is divided into the passenger car market, motorcycle market, and commercial vehicle market, and products are supplied through direct sales or agency sales. The consumer business in the passenger car market is centered on sales to car shops, home improvement centers, and tire shops, while the business-to-business (BtoB) business is centered on sales to domestic car dealers, imported car dealers, and auto repair shops.

name: TOKYO METRO CO LTD
businessSummary: Tokyo Metro Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in businesses related to railroads. The Company operates through three business segments. The Transportation Business segment owns a subway network consisting of nine lines, mainly in the Tokyo metropolitan area, and operates and manages trains as well as maintains and manages railroad facilities. The Real Estate Business segment is based on business development that can generate synergy effects with the railroad business, and leases real estate, mainly office buildings and hotels, such as Shibuya Mark City, along the Company's railway lines. The Distribution and Advertising Business segment operates commercial facilities such as Echika at stations along the Company's lines, and is involved in the advertising business, which mainly handles advertising inside stations and trains, and the information and telecommunications business, which leases optical fiber and other services.

name: YA-MAN LTD
businessSummary: Ya-Man Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the beauty and health related business. It is engaged in the research, development, manufacture, purchase and sale of household beauty and health equipment and cosmetics, as well as the purchase and sale of variety sundries. The Company mainly has four business segments. The Mail Order segment sells products to consumers through mail order houses, as well as to catalog retailers and Internet retailers. The Store Sales segment is engaged in the sale to electronics retail stores, large department stores and variety shops. The Direct Sales segment sells products to consumers through infomercials, magazines, newspapers and Websites. The Overseas segment sells its products to overseas mail dealers, wholesalers and, individual consumers.

name: COCONALA INC
businessSummary: Coconala Inc is a Japan-based company which operates a marketplace named Coconala for skills to buy and sell services based on individual knowledge, skills and experience. In Coconala, sellers list services that make use of their knowledge, skills, and experience. The Company can provides various services including design, illustration, Website production, video and music production, writing, support and agency for business marketing, as well as beauty, fashion, and career consultation. Other services include the operation and development of the lawyer consultation site Coconala Legal Counseling and the face-to-face service market Coconala Meets. The Coconala Legal Counseling is a matching site for in-house registered lawyers and users. The Coconala Meets is a marketplace where it is possible to provide skill services in real face-to-face after matching buyers and sellers on the Internet and adjusting the location and time.

name: MEDICAL NET INC
businessSummary: Medical Net, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in media platform business, medical institution management support business and medical business-to-business (BtoB) business. The Company operates through three business segments. Media Platform segment operates a dedicated portal that provides specific information about the body, health, beauty and parenting. Medical Institution Management Support segment provides search engine marketing (SEM) services that includes search engine optimization (SEO) services and listing advertising (search-linked advertising) operation agency services, corporate Website creation and maintenance services, as well as agency sales services. It also operates dental clinics and sells equipment, instruments and medicines to dental clinics. Medical BtoB segment operates a BtoB portal site that includes dental workers.

name: NIHON M&A CENTER HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Nihon M&A Center Holdings Inc, formerly Nihon M&A Center Inc, is a Japan-based company principally involved in the merger and acquisition (M&A) brokerage business. The Company mainly works on projects of small and medium-sized enterprises in Japan. The Company mainly operates M&A brokerage business. The flow of the M&A brokerage business includes marketing, contracting of the transferring company, evaluation of the transferring companies, proposal to the buyer companies, various negotiations and adjustment of contracts. Other businesses include the operation of membership organizations (membership fee income) of regional M&A centers operated by accounting offices in each region.

name: KEISEI ELECTRIC RAILWAY CO LTD
businessSummary: Keisei Electric Railway Co Ltd is a Japan-based company that operates transportation, logistics, real estate, leisure service, construction and the other business segment. The Company operates in six segments. The Transportation segment operates railways, buses and cabs. The Distribution segment is involved n the sale of products through stores, department stores. The Real Estate segment sells, leases and manages properties. The Leisure Service segment operates hotels, travel services. The Construction segment is engaged in contracting of civil engineering and building construction work. The Others segment is involved in maintenance of rolling stock, automobiles and others.

name: LIXIL CORP
businessSummary: LIXIL Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in water technology business, housing technology business, building technology business, housing and service business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Water Technology segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of sanitary equipment, faucet fittings, bathrooms, system kitchens. The Housing Technology segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of sashes, doors, shutters, interior building materials. The Building Technology segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of curtain walls. The Housing and Service segment is engaged in the provision of housing solutions, the sale and management of real estates, as well as the provision of mortgages.

name: PEPPER FOOD SERVICE CO LTD
businessSummary: Pepper Food Service Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of restaurants. The Company operates through four business segments. The Ikinari! Steak Business segment is engaged in the operation of charcoal-grilled steak restaurant Ikinari! Steak, operated directly by the group, a franchise, or a consignment business. The Pepper Lunch Business segment has three businesses: franchise business, direct management business and consignment business. It operates stores such as Pepper Lunch, Pepper Lunch Diner, 92's and food court type Charcoal-grilled Hamburg Steak Kuni, Tokyo 634 Burg, Musashi Hamburg. The Restaurant Business segment operates custom-cut steak restaurants, tonkatsu stores, beef tongue restaurants and others as a direct management, franchise and consignment business of the group. The Product Sales Business segment sells ingredients such as tonkatsu sauce, frozen pepper rice, dressing, and lux ham, as well as chopsticks.

name: SHIZUOKA FINANCIAL GROUP INC
businessSummary: Shizuoka Financial Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in banking business, and other financial services such as leasing and financial instruments trading. It operates in two segments. The Banking segment is engaged in banking business, focusing on deposits, lending, securities investment, and foreign exchange. The Leasing segment is engaged in leasing business, focusing on finance and leasing transactions. In addition, the Company is also engaged in management consulting, payment collection, initial public offering support, small and medium-sized enterprise revitalization support, financial instruments trading, marketing support, advertising agency, paid employment placement, investment advice for real estate private placement funds, and consulting.

name: SEPTENI HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Septeni Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the Internet advertising business. The Company operates its business through two business segments. The Internet Marketing segment is involved in the provision of Internet advertising support, the operation of marketing platforms such as cloud-based customer relationship management (CRM) services and affiliate networks, and the other businesses that support Internet marketing for companies. The Media Content segment provides manga contents, recruitment platform, social contribution platform, medical platform, childcare platform.

name: GUNGHO ONLINE ENTERTAINMENT INC
businessSummary: GungHo Online Entertainment Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of online games via the Internet. The Company is mainly engaged in the planning, development, operation and distribution of smartphone games. The main products in smartphone games are Puzzle & Dragons, Ragnarok M: Eternal Love, Puzzle Radar, Summons Board, Kerihime Sweets, Yokai Watch World, TEPPEN. The Company is also engaged in the planning, development, operation, distribution and sale of consumer game software for home-use game consoles and portable game consoles, the production of game software, as well as the sale of products to customers through wholesale trading companies, retail stores and content distributors.

name: HIKARI TSUSHIN INC
businessSummary: Hikari Tsushin Inc is a holding company mainly engaged in the corporate service business, personal service business, and agency sales business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Corporate Service segment is engaged in the sale of products planned and developed in-house, such as communication line services, electric power, and various systems, to small and medium-sized enterprises. The Personal Service segment mainly sells products planned and developed in-house, such as communication line services and home water distribution, to individuals. The Agency Sales segment is engaged in the sale of various products such as telecommunications carriers, insurance companies, and manufacturers.

name: TENTIAL INC
businessSummary: Tential Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of the TENTIAL conditioning brand. The conditioning brand business develops and sells products that can be easily incorporated into daily life to support good health, including the BAKUNE line of nightwear designed to improve the quality of sleep when worn. The Company's main products are the BAKUNE RECOVERY WEAR series of nightwear using a special fiber with far-infrared radiation effect, the MIGARU series of comfort tech wear, INSOLE series, Recovery Sandals series, and Comforter series. The products are sold through the Company's e-commerce site tential.jp, Amazon, Rakuten Ichiba, Yahoo! Shopping and other e-commerce malls, TENTIAL stores, clothing stores, general merchandise stores and electronics retailers.

name: JAPAN HOTEL REIT INVESTMENT CORP
businessSummary: Japan Hotel Reit Investment Corp is real estate investment trust (REIT) company. It aims to achieve sustainable growth in asset and stable earnings from mid-to long-term perspectives. The Fund mainly invests in hotel real estate. Its property portfolio includes Namba Oriental Hotel, Hotel Nikko Alivila, Ibis Tokyo Shinjuku, Dormy Inn Kumamoto, Chisun Inn Kamata. The asset manager of the Fund is Japan Hotel REIT Advisors Co., Ltd.

name: ASTELLAS PHARMA INC
businessSummary: Astellas Pharma Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sales of pharmaceutical products. The Company mainly operates Pharmaceutical Products business segment. The main products include XTANDI, BETANIS, MIRABETRIC, BETMIGA and new products ZOSPATA, EVERENZO and ENHOLTUMAB VEDOTIN, among others.

name: KAJIMA CORP
businessSummary: Kajima Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the civil engineering business, the construction business and the real estate development business. The Company operates through five business segments. The Civil engineering segment is engaged in the civil engineering business. The Construction segment is engaged in the construction business. The Development segment is engaged in the general real estate development business, the design, structural design and other design business, as well as the general engineering business. The Domestic Affiliates segment is engaged in the sale of construction materials and equipment, the contract of specialized work, as well as the general leasing business and the building leasing business in Japan. The Overseas Affiliates segment is engaged in the construction business and the real estate development business in overseas regions such as North America, Europe, Asia and Oceania.

name: DOWA HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: DOWA Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the recycling and metal processing business. The Company operates five business segments. The Environment and Recycling segment is engaged in waste disposal, soil remediation, resource recycling, and logistics. The Smelting segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of gold, silver, copper, lead, zinc, zinc alloys, indium, platinum. The Electronic Materials segment manufactures and sells high-purity metal materials, compound semiconductor wafers, conductive materials, battery materials, magnetic materials, and reduced iron powder. The Metal Processing segment manufactures and sells copper, brass, and copper alloy products. The Heat Treatment segment is engaged in heat treatment and surface treatment of metal materials for automotive parts, and manufacture, sales, maintenance of heat treatment processing equipment. The Company also operates real estate leasing, construction, management, and technical support services.

name: SERENDIP HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: SERENDIP HOLDINGS Co Ltd operates Professional Solutions business, Investment business, and Manufacturing business. The Professional Solution business includes manager dispatch business, such as professional manager dispatch and management consulting (business succession and business revitalization), engineer dispatch business, such as the design, development and information technology engineer dispatch, and software development. The Investment businesses include investment, mergers and acquisition-related businesses, including funds, joint investment, and financial advisory. The Manufacturing business includes automotive suppliers including automobile interior and exterior parts (luggage room interior parts, exterior parts such as fender liners and rear wheel house liners) and automobile precision parts (automatic functional parts), as well as factory automation equipment including connector automatic assembly machines, and battery-related automatic assembly machines and others.

name: HUMAN TECHNOLOGIES INC
businessSummary: Human Technologies Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the software as a service (SaaS) business for an attendance management service. The Company is mainly engaged in the development and sale of the cloud attendance management system KING OF TIME. Its main functions include overtime management, schedule/shift management, administrator privileges, workflow (application/approval), among others.

name: C CHANNEL CORP
businessSummary: C Channel Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the media business, electronic commerce (e-commerce) business and overseas business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Media segment is engaged in the provision of native video advertising services that plans, produces and distributes video advertising content for corporates, as well as the advertising and ad network services, event holding services, sample product sales services and influencer marketing services through the video media application C CHANNEL and mama+ in Japan. The E-commerce segment is engaged in the sale of apparel products, beauty equipment and cosmetic products in Japan through applications and social networking services (SNS). The brands include KOBE LETTUCE, Isn't She?, N WITH., and BELL PALETTE. The Overseas segment is engaged in the overseas expansion of the C CHANNEL business mainly in the Asian regions such as China, Indonesia, Philippines, Singapore, Malaysia and Vietnam.

name: ADISH CO LTD
businessSummary: Adish Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of customer relations services, including support for social applications (Apps), social risk posting monitoring and cyber bullying countermeasures. The Company provides four kinds of services. Social app support provides customer support services that respond to inquiries from users on behalf of client companies. Internet monitoring provides a service that monitors posts made by users 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, and responds to alerts, reports, warnings, non-display, when inappropriate posts are found. School guardian provides consulting services to monitor writing and potential personal information breaches on the Internet that could be an issue in school life and use them in student guidance. Front support provides services for companies to maintain and improve connections with users and form a fan community by interacting with users using social media.

name: MITSUI FUDOSAN CO LTD
businessSummary: Mitsui Fudosan Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the leasing, sales, management and other businesses. The Company operates in five business segments. The Leasing Business segment is engaged in the leasing of office buildings and commercial facilities. The Sales Business segment sells condominiums and detached houses to individual customers, and sells rental housing and office buildings to investors. The Management Business segment is engaged in non-asset businesses such as property management, brokerage and asset management. The Facility Sales Business segment is engaged in hotel and resort business, and sports and entertainment business. The Other segment is engaged in the design, construction supervision and construction contracting of new housing, renovation work for homes and renewal work for offices and commercial facilities, golf course business, retail of flowers, seeds and seedlings, gardening supplies, specified power transmission and distribution, and others.

name: LAND CO LTD
businessSummary: LAND Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based real estate company. The Company operates through Real Estate business segment. The Company is mainly engaged in the trading and investment of real estate properties, including renewable energy related investment such as photovoltaic power plants, real estate related consulting business, as well as other real estate business aimed at acquiring fee through brokerage business. The Company mainly operates in domestic market.

name: THK CO LTD
businessSummary: THK Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of linear motion (LM) guides and ball screws, as well as transportation equipment components such as link balls and suspension ball joints. The Company operates in five segments including Japan, Americas, Europe, China, and Others. The industrial equipment business primarily manufactures and sells mechanical components, mainly linear motion systems, and industrial machinery. The transportation equipment business primarily develops, designs, manufactures, and sells steering parts, suspension parts, and brake parts for transportation equipment such as automobiles and motorcycles. Linear motion systems are mechanical components used in linear motion of machinery. It directly sells to manufacturers and distributors of industrial machinery, including machine tools, industrial robots, and semiconductor manufacturing equipment, while other companies sell to other manufacturers and distributors.

name: SOTETSU HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Sotetsu Holdings, Inc. is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in transportation business, distribution business and others. The Company mainly operates five business segments. Transportation segment provides railway, car business and others. Distribution segment involves in the operation of supermarkets and distribution business. Real Estate segment engages in the sale and leasing of properties. Hotel segment is engaged in the development and operation of hotels. The Others segment engages in the building maintenance business, the supply of heat and other businesses.

name: STARTLINE CO LTD
businessSummary: Startline Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in employment support services and welfare services for people with disabilities. It develops new value-added services such as coffee roasting and plant cultivation and provides various options (services) for the employment and work of people with disabilities. The disability employment support services business offers the roastery-type disability employment support service BYSN, the indoor farm-type disability employment support service IBUKI, the satellite office service with employment support for people with disabilities INCLU, the satellite office service with employment support for people with disabilities INCLU ONE, the employment support services for people with disabilities with improved customer service quality RESQWO, TASKI (TASKI COFFEE), as well as training and consulting services. The disability welfare business offers FITIME and GOOD THE GOOD.

name: SUMITOMO METAL MINING CO LTD
businessSummary: Sumitomo Metal Mining Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in resource development, manufacturing and sales of non-ferrous metal products, and manufacturing and sales of battery materials and functional materials. The Company operates through three business segments. The Mineral Resources segment is engaged in the exploration, development, production and sales of non-ferrous metal resources and products in Japan and overseas. The Smelting & Refining segment smelts and sells copper, nickel, ferronickel, zinc and other metals, and smelts and sells gold, silver, platinum, palladium and other precious metals. The Materials segment manufactures, processes, and sells battery materials, powder materials, crystal materials, and tape materials, as well as lightweight foamed concrete, automotive exhaust gas treatment catalysts, chemical catalysts, and petroleum refining desulfurization catalysts. The Company also operates businesses related to real estate and engineering.

name: TOYOTA INDUSTRIES CORP
businessSummary: TOYOTA INDUSTRIES CORPORATION is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of automobiles, industrial vehicles and textile machinery. The Company operates in three business segments. The Automobile segment manufactures and sells automobiles, engines, compressors for automotive air-conditioners, and electronic equipment, among others. The Industrial Vehicle segment provides forklift trucks, warehouse equipment, automatic warehouse, vehicles for high-place work, logistics solution and sales finance business. The Textile Machinery segment offers weaving machines and spinning machines, as well as yarn quality measurement equipment and cotton grading equipment.

name: OSAKA TITANIUM TECHNOLOGIES CO LTD
businessSummary: Osaka Titanium Technologies Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the titanium business and the high-performance materials business. The Company operates through two segments. The Titanium segment manufactures and sells sponge titanium, titanium ingots, titanium tetrachloride, and titanium tetrachloride aqueous solution. The Advanced Materials segment manufactures and sells high-purity titanium, silicon monoxide (SiO), spherical titanium powder (TILOP), and powdered titanium.

name: TSUBAKI NAKASHIMA CO LTD
businessSummary: TSUBAKI NAKASHIMA CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of precision balls, ball screws and air blowers. The Company operates through three segments. The Precision Component segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of ball bearings, ceramic balls, cemented carbide balls, glass balls, plastic balls, carbon steel balls and other precision ball products, as well as rollers, retainers and sheet metal parts. The Linear segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of precision ball screws, ball screws for high-load, precision miniature ball screws, caged precision ball screws, hollow shaft ball screws, precision rolled ball screws, general industrial ball screws and other ball screw products, as well as air blowers. The Others segment is engaged in the real estate leasing business.

name: MARUBENI CORP
businessSummary: Marubeni Corp is engaged in the import, export and transaction of various products through domestic and overseas networks. The Company has sixteen segments. The Lifestyle segment includes apparel, footwear, daily necessities, sporting goods. The Information Solutions segment includes services utilizing digital technology in the ICT and logistics fields. The Food 1 segment includes dairy products, sugar, processed foods and beverages. The Food 2 segment includes feed grains, soybeans, wheat. The Agri segment includes agricultural materials sale business. The Forest Products segment includes papermaking raw materials and paperboard. The Chemicals segment includes petrochemicals and electronic materials. The segments also include the Metals, the New Energy Development Promotion Department, the Energy, the Electricity, the Infrastructure Projects, the Aviation and Ship, the Finance, Leasing and Real Estate, the Construction & Industrial Machinery, Next Generation Business Development.

name: LANCERS INC
businessSummary: LANCERS,INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the platform business. The Company is engaged in the operation of a freelance platform Lancers that matches freelances and companies online. The Company is engaged in the provision of services in online stuffing platform area and crowdsourcing area. The online stuffing platform is a service in which clients can request work from specific lancers either directly or through agents and directors. The main work includes work with a high unit price such as system development and operation, design and creative production, article creation and others. The Company develops and provides directly order to freelancers services and selected freelancers introduction services in the area. The crowdsourcing is a service that requests work from an unspecified number of lancers and orders work based on deliverables. The main work includes work with relatively low unit costs such as data entry, article creation, logo design and others.

name: ODAKYU ELECTRIC RAILWAY CO LTD
businessSummary: Odakyu Electric Railway Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in transportation, distribution, and real estate businesses. The Company operates three business segments. The Transportation segment is engaged in railroad, bus, cab, route, and cableway operations. The Distribution segment is engaged in department store and store operations. The Real Estate segment is engaged in real estate sales, real estate leasing, and other businesses. The Company is also engaged in the hotel, restaurant, travel, golf course, railroad maintenance, building management and maintenance, advertising agency, accounting agency, insurance agency, planning, design, and operations, and temporary staffing services.

name: BRANGISTA INC
businessSummary: Brangista.Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the digital magazine business. The Company provides two kinds of services. The digital magazine service is engaged in the provision of digital magazine advertisements business and the production of digital magazines. Its electronic magazines mainly include Tabiiro, GOODA, and SUPER CEO. Solutions and other services are engaged in the provision of various supporting sales promotion services. Electronic commerce (EC) support provides one-stop support for planning, production, development, operation for EC sites. Customer relationship management (CRM) services are engaged in the provision of planning and operation for sale activities.

name: MANDOM CORP
businessSummary: Mandom Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of cosmetics. The Company operates through three geographic segments, including Japan, Indonesia and Other Countries. Main products are hair styling, hair coloring, hair care, skin care, body care, foot care, hand care, fragrance and other products. The Company is also engaged in insurance agency business and management business of the Company's headquarters building.

name: LINK-U GROUP INC
businessSummary: Link-U Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of a server platform business that provides one-stop data distribution based on original servers designed in-house, as well as artificial intelligence (AI) solutions that appropriately store, analyze, and process that data. The Internet service business includes recurring service, initial development and maintenance development service, and other services that occur on-site. The recurring service provides server maintenance operation including server procurement, system construction, and data center installation. The initial development and maintenance development service provides contracted development for acquiring recurring service projects. Other services mainly consist of spot development projects such as Website development.

name: UNITIKA LTD
businessSummary: UNITIKA LTD. is a Japan-based manufacturing company that mainly engages in macromolecule business, function materials business and other businesses. The Company operates in three segments. The Macromolecule segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of plastic film, resin, nonwoven cloth and others. The Functional Materials segment is engaged in the provision of functional materials, such as glass fiber products, glass beads, activated carbon fiber, among others. The Fiber segment is engaged in the production and sale of various types of fiber, such as thread and cotton. In addition, the Company is also involved in the design of factory equipment, construction management and equipment maintenance business, among others.

name: TOKYU CORP
businessSummary: Tokyu Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the transportation business, real estate business, leisure service business, as well as hotel and resort business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Transportation segment is engaged in the operation of railways and airports, the provision of bus transportation services, as well as the railway related business. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the sale, management, leasing and brokerage of real estate, as well as the construction business. The Leisure Service segment in engaged in the operation of department stores, chain stores and shopping centers, as well as the credit cards business, cable television business, advertising agency business and video business. The Hotel and Resort segment is engaged in the operation of hotels and golf courses.

name: NIPPON COKE & ENGINEERING CO LTD
businessSummary: NIPPON COKE & ENGINEERING COMPANY, LIMITED is principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of coke, general coal and powder and granular equipment, as well as the call center business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Coke segment manufactures and sells coke. The Fuel Sales segment is engaged in purchasing and sale of coal and petroleum coke, and call center business. The Comprehensive Engineering segment is engaged in manufacture, sale and maintenance of chemical equipment and other equipment, as well as collecting, transportation and processing of industrial waste. The others business includes cargo handling business, real estate sales and leasing business.

name: SANKEI REAL ESTATE INC
businessSummary: Sankei Real Estate Inc is a closed-end real estate investment trust (REIT) company. It aims to manage its assets primarily through investment in real estate and other specified assets, and its basic policy is to manage its assets with the aim of securing stable profits over the medium to long term and achieving steady growth in its managed assets through continuous investment. It aims to build a portfolio centered on investments in office buildings and invests in properties other than office buildings to diversify use and increase investor value. Its real estate properties include S-GATE NIHONBASHI-HONCHO, S-GATE AKIHABARA, Hibiya Sankei Building, Hatchobori Sankei Building, Hotel Intergate Tokyo Kyobashi, Hotel Intergate Hiroshima, SANKEILOGI Settsu, Hotel Intergate Kyoto Shijo Shinmachi and others. Its asset manager is Sankei Building Asset Management Co Ltd.

name: INVINCIBLE INVESTMENT CORP
businessSummary: Invincible Investment Corp is a real estate investment trust (REIT) company. It aims to manage its assets primarily through investment in real estate and other assets and achieve steady growth and securing stable profits from a medium- to long-term perspective. The Fund mainly invests in real estate in capital region (Tokyo, Kanagawa, Chiba and Saitama prefectures), designated cities, major cities across the country and their surrounding areas, as well as overseas. Its property portfolio includes Nisshin Palacestage Daitabashi, Growth Maison Gotanda, Growth Maison Kameido, AEON TOWN Sukagawa, Hotel MyStays Kanda, Hotel MyStays Asakusa, Hotel MyStays Kyoto-Shijo and others. The asset manager of the Fund is Consonant Investment Management Co Ltd.

name: KAO CORP
businessSummary: Kao Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of consumer products and chemical products. The Company operates in five business segments. The Hygiene & Living Care segment provides fabric care products, home care products, and sanitary products. The Health & Beauty Care segment provides skin care products, hair care products, and personal health products. The Life Care segment is mainly involved in the provision of commercial hygiene products, health drinks and other life care products. The Cosmetic segment produces counseling cosmetics and self-cosmetics. The above four business segments are included in the consumer products business. Chemical segment provides oil and fat products, such as oleochemical alcohols, oleochemical amines, fatty acids, and edible oils and fats for commercial use, functional material products, such as surfactants, additives for plastics, and high-performance water reducers for concrete, as well as specialty chemicals products.

name: MARUI GROUP CO LTD
businessSummary: Marui Group Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the retail and fintech business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Retailing segment is engaged in the purchase and sales of clothing, decorative items, household products, the leasing and operation of commercial facilities, the interior decoration of stores, advertising, the subcontracting of fashion product logistics, the maintenance and management of buildings. The Fintech segment specializes in credit card business, as well as the provision of consumer loans, rental guarantee, information system services, the leasing of real estate, investment trust sales, and small-amount short-term insurance business.

name: SOMPO HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Sompo Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the non-life insurance business, life insurance business, and other businesses. The Company operates through four business segments. The Domestic Non-Life Insurance Business segment is mainly engaged in non-life insurance underwriting, asset management, and related businesses in Japan. The Overseas Insurance Business segment is mainly engaged in insurance underwriting and asset management businesses in the United States, the United Kingdom, Turkey, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, China, Brazil, India, and other regions. The Domestic Life Insurance Business segment is mainly engaged in life insurance underwriting and asset management businesses in Japan. The Nursing Care and Healthcare Business segment is mainly engaged in the provision of nursing care service and nursing care-related services. The Company is also engaged in asset management business, risk management business, defined contribution pension business and others.

name: SPACEMARKET INC
businessSummary: Spacemarket Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of the platform SPACEMARKET where any space can be rented and borrowed, the provision of the public facility reservation management system Spacepad, as well as the operation of spaces on behalf of the owner. SPACEMARKET is a platform where any space can be rented and borrowed, and provides a service that allows anyone to rent and borrow space easily and conveniently over the Internet or smartphone. The Company also supports the operation of shared spaces, and upon request from owners, selects, orders, and installs furniture and equipment suitable for the shared space, and prepares the interior, takes promotional photos, writes listing text, sets prices, creates rules for use, and lists the space on SPACEMARKET. It also handles reservations and rentals, cleaning, replenishing equipment, responding to inquiries, and brushing up the listing content on behalf of the owner.

name: SAAF HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: SAAF Holdings Co Ltd, formerly ITbook Holdings Co Ltd, is mainly engaged in the ground investigation and improvement business, human resources business, system development business. The Company operates in seven segments. The Ground Investigation and Improvement segment provides ground investigation and surveying, ground improvement, and real estate services. The Human Resources segment provides technician dispatch, human resources dispatch and teacher dispatch. The System Development segment provides new system development, hardware sales, and others. The Consulting segment provides reorganization and reconstruction of business and information systems. The Warranty and Inspection segment provides ground guarantee, housing completion guarantee. The Construction Tech segment is engaged in the rental and sale of geotechnical survey equipment. The Overseas segment is engaged in geotechnical surveys and ground improvement. Other businesses include financial services and others.

name: TAIYO YUDEN CO LTD
businessSummary: Taiyo Yuden Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of electronic components. The Company’s main products include multilayer ceramic capacitors, inductors, high frequency devices, and conductive polymer hybrid aluminum electrolytic capacitors and others. The Company sells and supplies finished products to domestic and overseas set manufacturers and sales affiliates. The Company also supplies raw materials and semi-finished products to domestic and overseas manufacturing affiliates. The Company also provides services to employees, temporary staffing, and consulting on environmental measurements.

name: MAMEZO CO LTD
businessSummary: Mamezo Co Ltd, formerly Mamezo Digital Holdings Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company engaged in information services business. It operates in four service businesses. Cloud Consulting Services provides companies with consulting services for promoting in-house development using cutting-edge technologies, including cloud computing, enterprise resource planning (ERP) implementation and educational services. Artificial Intelligence (AI) Consulting Services provides companies promoting digital transformation with AI-based data utilization and system design, algorithm development and consulting, generative AI implementation support services. AI Robotics Engineering Services provides consulting and development services for AI software development, model-based development (MBSE) and process improvement to companies. Mobility Automation Services provides development support for AI software and hardware related to the automotive, aerospace, educational services and consulting for factory automation.

name: ONO PHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Ono Pharmaceutical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the pharmaceutical business. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of prescription and over-the-counter drugs. The Company has been particularly focused on research and development of prescription drugs, positioning them as its core business. The Company’s products include injectables, oral medications, and patches.

name: CASY CO LTD
businessSummary: CaSy Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the housekeeping service business. The Company operates a matching platform that provides cleaning services, cooking services, and other lifestyle services (house cleaning services and storage services) in the service areas of nine prefectures (Tokyo, Kanagawa, Saitama, Chiba, Osaka, Hyogo, Kyoto, Aichi, and Miyagi). The cleaning services provides services such as house and room cleaning and tidying. The cooking services include food preparation, kitchen cleanup, and food shopping. The other lifestyle services include house cleaning services (cleaning services by specialized companies for air conditioners, ventilation fans) and tidying and storage services (advice on tidying and storage, including consulting on decluttering). The Company also sells online gift certificates for housekeeping services.

name: SURUGA BANK LTD
businessSummary: Suruga Bank Ltd. is a Japan-based bank engaged in the banking business, as well as the provision of other financial services such as leasing business, loan business and guarantee servive. The Bank operates in two business segments. The Banking segment is engaged in the provision of deposit services, loan services, and domestic and foreign exchange transactions services, as well as the counter sale of securities, investment trust and insurance. The Others segment is engaged in the provision of loans, leasing services, manpower dispatching services, credit guarantee services, system development services and credit cards services, among others.

name: EISAI CO LTD
businessSummary: Eisai Co Ltd is a Japan-based pharmaceutical company mainly engaged in the research and development, manufacture, sale, import and export of pharmaceuticals. The Company operates in two business segments. The Pharmaceutical segment is engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals for medical use, generic drugs, general medicines, among others. The segment operates in five regions including Japan, Americas (North America), China, EMEA (Europe, Middle East, Africa, Russia, Oceania), Asia and Latin America (Korea, Taiwan, India, ASEAN, Latin America). The Others segment is involved in license revenues and pharmaceutical raw materials business. The Company is also engaged in the provision of brands such as the anticancer drugs Lembima and Halaven on the nerve and oncology areas.

name: TOTO LTD
businessSummary: TOTO Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of restroom, bath, kitchen and washroom products. The Company operates through six business segments. The Japan Housing Equipment Business segment, the Mainland China Business segment, the Asia and Oceania Business segment, the Americas Business segment and the Europe Business segment are engaged in the manufacture and sale of sanitary ware, heated toilet seats, unit bathrooms, system kitchens and washstands, faucets, electric water heaters, handrails, bathroom ventilation heaters and dryers, faucets, seats for seated toilets, plastic and rubber molded parts, plastic bathtubs and marbright counters, and others. The Company provides after-sales services such as repair work for these products. The Company also installs, sells, designs and contracts housing equipment. The New Area Business segment is engaged in the provision of ceramic products. The Company is also engaged in the office buildings rental business.

name: KADOKAWA CORP
businessSummary: Kadokawa Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the publishing and intellectual property (IP) creation business, and others. The Company operates through five business segments. The Publishing and IP Creation Business segment publishes and sells books, e-books, e-magazines, and magazines, sells online advertisements, and plans and sells other IP creation-related products. The Animation and Live-Action Video Business segment plans, produces, and distributes anime and live-action video, licenses video distribution rights, and sells video package software. The Game Business segment plans, develops, and sells game software and network games. The Web Services Business segment operates video community services, plans and manages various events, and distributes mobile content. The Education and EdTech Business segment plans and manages online education and vocational schools. The Company also plans and sells character goods, and others.

name: VISASQ INC
businessSummary: visasQ Inc. operates the knowledge platform business. The Company provides service that matches customers with advisors with business knowledge and sets up hourly telephone calls and face-to-face interviews according to customer needs. The services provided by the knowledge platform business include visasQ interview, visasQ expert survey, visasQ outsourcing, visasQ project, visasQ web exhibition in the full support format visasQ, and visasQ lite in the self-matching format visasQ lite. The registrants include manufacturing, retailing, eating and drinking, living, medical and healthcare, business support, finance, education, media, construction and real estate, energy infrastructure, agriculture, forestry and fisheries, among others. It covers a wide range of industries and occupations, including management departments, information technology (IT) and systems, new businesses and research and development (R&D), overseas businesses, professionals, and production and procurement.

name: NIPPON SHEET GLASS CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Sheet Glass Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the architectural glass business, automotive glass business, and functional glass business. It operates through four segments. The Architectural Glass segment manufactures and sells flat glass products and processed glass products for interior and exterior use for the building materials market, as well as glass for solar panels. The Automotive Glass segment manufactures and sells various glass products for the new car assembly and repair markets. The Functional Glass segment consists of several businesses, such as the manufacture and sale of thin glass used for display cover glass, lenses and light guides for printers, and the manufacture and sale of glass fiber products such as engine timing belt components. The Other segment operates other small businesses.

name: FUJI CORP (AICHI)
businessSummary: Fuji Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of electronic component mounting robots and machine tools. It operates through two business segments. The Robot Solutions segment is engaged in the production of electronic component mounting robots and semiconductor manufacturing equipment. The Machine Tools segment is engaged in the production of machine tools. It is also engaged in the manufacture of control equipment, electronic equipment, and image processing development.

name: MITSUI & CO LTD
businessSummary: Mitsui & Co Ltd is a Japan-based general trading company. The Company operates through seven segments. The Mineral & Metal Resources segment is engaged in resource development, manufacture, sales, and trading of steel and non-ferrous metal raw materials. The Energy Segment trades oil and gas, coal, and related products, and operates an electric power business. The Machinery & Infrastructure segment manufactures, sells, and trades machinery and equipment, as well as leases, finances, and operates infrastructure businesses. The Chemicals segment manufactures, sells, and trades chemicals and housing materials. The Iron & Steel Products segment manufactures, sells, and trades steel products. The Living Essentials segment manufactures, sells, and trades food and consumer goods, and conducts wellness-related businesses. The Next-Generation & Functional Businesses segment engages in the information and telecommunications business, logistics business, insurance business and media business.

name: CTW CAYMAN CLASS A
businessSummary: CTW Cayman is engaged in the provision of Web-based gaming platform. It offers players an immersive digital space through its flagship hypertext markup language 5 (HTML5) platform, G123.jp. Its platform showcases a diverse selection of free-to-play games inspired by popular Japanese animations, including Queen’s Blade, So I’m a Spider, So What? and Goblin Slayer. The HTML5-based G123.jp platform removes common barriers to gameplay, such as downloads, installations, and mandatory registrations, ensuring that seamless, instant access is available to players worldwide across different types of devices, including mobile devices beyond just personal computers (PCs). It is mainly engaged in serving game developers as its core customers by providing a comprehensive platform that helps them generate revenue and reach a global audience. It offers intellectual property (IP) resources along with ancillary support, as well as distribution and marketing services, to game developers.

name: ROHM CO LTD
businessSummary: Rohm Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily manufactures and sells electronic components. The Company operates through three business segments. The Large-Scale Integration (LSI) segment produces LSIs including analog, logic and memory. The Semiconductor Device segment produces transistors, diodes, power devices, light-emitting diodes and semiconductor lasers. The Module segment produces print heads and optical modules. The Company is also engaged in the resistor business.

name: POLARIS HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Polaris Holdings Co Ltd, formerly Kachikaihatsu Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the hotel business and the real estate business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Hotel segment is involved in the hotel management, consultancy, operation and franchise business. The Real Estate segment operates in five kinds of businesses. The real estate leasing business is involved in the leasing and operation of office buildings and condominiums. The real estate trading business is involved in the purchase and sale of office buildings and condominiums. The real estate development business is involved in the provision of information collection, survey, analysis, planning and construction services. The real estate investment business is involved in the investment of silent partnership in special purpose company (SPC) that holds trust beneficiary rights. The real estate management business is involved in the trust of the operation management business.

name: AI STORM CO LTD
businessSummary: AI Storm Co Ltd, formerly Gexeed Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the information technology (IT) consulting and digital signage businesses. The Company operates through two business segments.
