The IT Consulting Business segment provides system consulting, business consulting, Chief Information Officer (CIO)/Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) support, and Web marketing support. The Digital Signage Business segment sells light-emitting diode (LED) displays, liquid crystal display (LCD) displays, and operates ad trucks. The Company also develops artificial intelligence (AI) solutions, analyzes and optimizes data using AI, and applies AI to education and logistics. It also collects, transports, stores, processes, and disposes of various types of waste.

name: COCA-COLA BOTTLERS JAPAN HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Coca-Cola Bottlers Japan Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the beverage business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Beverages segment is engaged in the purchasing, manufacture, sale, bottling, packaging, distribution and marketing of carbonated drinks such as coca and cola, coffee and tea beverages, and mineral water in Japan, as well as vending machine related business, real estate business, insurance agency, the procurement of raw materials and materials, the development and maintenance of information systems. The Healthcare and Skincare segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of green juice made from kale, health foods and cosmetics and related products, as well as investment business.

name: LETECH CORP
businessSummary: LeTech Corp is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the real estate related business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Real Estate Solutions segment is engaged in the purchase real estate from property information of various sources, raises asset value by applying value up, as well as sales properties to high net worth individuals. The Real Estate Solutions segment includes detached housing, land effective utilization, residential development, commercial development, and renovation. The Real Estate Rental segment is engaged in the rental of real estate owned by the Company. The Company also engages in the real estate consulting business and the nursing care business including paid nursing home, housing for the elderly with the service, installation, operation and management of the group home, care prevention support service based on the care insurance law, and home care insurance business.

name: OPTORUN CO LTD
businessSummary: Optorun Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacturing and sales of optical thin-film deposition equipment. The Company has the film deposition equipment business segment. The Company’s products include optical thin-film forming systems, anti-fouling film deposition systems, reactive plasma deposition systems, sputtering deposition systems for optical films, sputtering deposition systems for semiconductor optical films, plasma atomic layer deposition systems and ultra-multilayer thin-film forming systems. The products are used in applications including touch panels and housings for smartphones and tablets, biometric sensors, camera modules, light emitting diode (LED) light sources, automotive cameras and surveillance cameras.

name: NTT INC
businessSummary: NTT Inc, formerly Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp, is engaged in the comprehensive information and communications technology (ICT) business, the regional communications business, and the global solutions business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Comprehensive ICT Business segment is engaged in the mobile phone business, inter-prefectural communications services in the domestic telecommunications business, international communications business, solutions business, system development business, and related businesses. The Regional Communications Business segment is engaged in the provision of intra-prefectural communications services in the domestic telecommunications business and related businesses. The Global Solutions Business segment is engaged in the system integration, network systems, cloud, global data centers, and related businesses. The Other (Real Estate, Energy) segment includes real estate business, energy business and others.

name: SRE HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: SRE Holdings Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the AI x Real solution business that provides real estate distribution services utilizing agent system and artificial intelligence (AI) technology. The Company is engaged in the real estate business, information technology (IT) platform business and AI solution business. The real estate business is engaged in the acquisition and operation of profitable real estates, the development of assets such as smart homes that combine Internet of Things (IoT) and AI technology, as well as the provision of consulting and other real estate distribution services. The IT platform business is engaged in the provision of a real estate trading platform Ouchi Direct that based on IT and AI technology, and the IT platforms for various industries. The AI solution business is engaged in the provision of consulting services for various industries such as financial tech (Fintech) and real estate tech (RET) fields.

name: NABTESCO CORP
businessSummary: Nabtesco Corporation is a Japan-based company engaged in the component solution business, transport solution business and accessibility solution business. The Company operates through three segments. The Component Solutions segment is engaged in the design, manufacture, sale, maintenance and repair of industrial robot parts and construction equipment. The Transport Solution segment is engaged in the design, manufacture, sale, maintenance and repair of railway vehicles brake and automatic door devices, aircraft parts, marine control devices and related parts. The Accessibility Solution segment is engaged in the design, manufacture, sale, installation, maintenance and repair of automatic door devices for buildings and general industries, platform safety equipment and related parts. The Company is also engaged in the design, manufacture, sale, maintenance and repair of packaging machines, machine tools, forging machines, and other general industrial machines.

name: COVER CORP
businessSummary: Cover Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the character intellectual property (IP) development of virtual entertainers VTuber who are active using motion capture technology and anime look avatars, and the management of hololive production. The Company operates through the VTuber business segment, which is divided into four business areas. The distribution/content business provides video content through the video distribution platform, and also provides music content through the music streaming service. The live/event business provides offline or online events such as live concerts, fan meetings, and domestic and overseas exhibitions. The merchandising business sells character goods and digital contents based on VTuber IP. The licensing/tie-up business provides the right to use proprietary IP to manufacturers of external products or contents, and provides promotion and media appearances of other companies by VTuber through tie-up advertisements.

name: INFORMATION STRATEGY AND TECHNOLOGY CO L
businessSummary: Information Strategy and Technology Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the digital transformation (DX)-related business. The DX-Related Business segment consists of Tier 0 system development, which realizes DX for customers, and the WhiteBox service, which realizes DX for the system development industry. Tier 0 system development is an agile development method in which customers and engineers collaborate on development through repeated proposals and consultations, and can be changed in response to changes in business conditions. WhiteBox is a service that can be used by system development companies or freelancers who apply to use the service and are accepted as members.

name: DENTSU GROUP INC
businessSummary: Dentsu Group Inc is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the provision of communication-related services with a focus on advertising. The Company operates in four business segments, including Japan, Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA) and Asia Pacific (APAC). The Company's advertising business involves the handling of advertising work for newspapers, magazines, radio, television, the Internet, sales promotion, movies, outdoor, transportation and other areas, as well as the planning, production and marketing of advertising expressions, public relations (PR) and content services. The Company's information services business involves the sale of information services and information-related products. Other businesses include the provision of specialized functions in the corporate field, office rental and building services. Through its affiliated companies, the Company is engaged in advertising and advertising-related services, information services and other services.

name: KEIKYU CORP
businessSummary: Keikyu Corp is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in transportation, real estate, leisure and services, and distribution businesses. It operates through four business segments. Transportation segment is engaged in the management and operation of railway stations, bus business, as well as the taxi business. Real Estate segment sells and rents land and buildings. Leisure and Service segment is engaged in the operation of hotels and inns, leisure facilities, golf courses, and restaurants. Distribution segment sells products mainly through department stores and retail stores. It is also engaged in construction, civil engineering, and electrical equipment work, repair and modification of transportation equipment, building management services, and driving school operations.

name: DAIICHI SANKYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Daiichi Sankyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals. The Company is involved in the research, development, manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals, as well as the provision of intermediates and basic materials for pharmaceutical producing in Japan, the United States, Europe and other markets. The Company is also engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of over-the-counter drugs and vaccines, the provision of administrative services such as human resources and accounting services, real estate leasing and insurance agency business.

name: TEAMSPIRIT INC
businessSummary: TeamSpirit Inc. mainly provides professional services for enterprises. The Company provides two types of service: license and professional service. The license service is provided by TeamSpirit and TeamSpirit Leaders products. TeamSpirit is mainly SaaS which integrates attendance management, work management, man-hour management, expense adjustment, electronic approval, calendar, SNS, among others. TeamSpirit Leaders is one of the family products of TeamSpirit, and it is the project of project cost management that is used in combination with TeamSpirit as the main business. Professional service is a premier support product, and it mainly consists of paid support work carried out by a consultant in charge for the customer's production operation and steady operation.

name: KEIHANSHIN BUILDING CO LTD
businessSummary: Keihanshin Building Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the rental of land and buildings, as well as the building management, construction contracting business. The Land and Building Leasing segment is involved in the rental of office buildings, data center buildings, Windsville, commercial buildings and other commercial buildings, as well as the maintenance and cleaning of buildings and machinery. The Company is also involved in the construction, equipment contracting and real estate brokerage business.

name: TRUE DATA INC
businessSummary: True Data Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of data marketing-related services. The Company is a provider of data marketing-related services, including the provision of analysis and disclosure support tools that utilize point-of-sale (POS) data with customer identification (ID) from retailers nationwide, including supermarkets and drugstores. Services are divided into solutions for manufacturers, solutions for retailers, and solutions for all industries. The company provides services such as Eagle Eye and Dolphin Eye for manufacturers' solutions, and Shopping Scan for retail solutions. Solutions for all industries are services that provide data, analysis reports, and artificial intelligence (AI) related to consumer purchasing.

name: SKYLARK HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Skylark Holdings Co Ltd, former Skylark Co Ltd is primarily engaged in the restaurant business and also engaged in the development of businesses such as food sales and support for group companies. In the restaurant business, in addition to developing family restaurants and buffets in Japan and selling food products, The Company also develops restaurants overseas. The restaurant brands include Gusto, Bamiyan, Syabuyo, Jonathan's, Yumean, Steak Gusto, Karayoshi, Aiya, Musashi No Mori Coffee, Grazie Gardens, Totoyamichi, chawan, Tonkaratei, La Ohana and others. Other businesses include food sales, food delivery, store cleaning and maintenance, store product delivery, and linen supply support businesses for group companies.

name: GRCS INC
businessSummary: GRCS Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the protection of companies from the complex external environment by improving the efficiency of information management, mainly through the use of technology. The Company focuses on the perspectives of governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) and security, and develops businesses to solve corporate issues arising from changes in the external environment. At present, the Company mainly operates in the security domain. By introducing dedicated tools for risk management, regulatory/policy management, internal audit, incident management, and other operations, the Company is able to help improve the efficiency of information management and achieve cross-company understanding and management. The company has a single segment, GRC Solutions, which is divided into Solutions and Product divisions based on the content of services.

name: YASHIMA & CO LTD
businessSummary: Yashima & Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based trading company mainly engaged in the sale of body products and electrical products to railway operators and others, as well as the electronic components to general industries. The railway business provides electrical products for railway vehicles, car body products, vehicle-mounted products, connectors and electronic parts. The general business provides connectors and electronic parts. In addition, the Company provides repair and modification products for thermal power plants overseas, various processed harness products, power devices such as power supply units, and water generators containing micro bubbles.

name: ADR ON LEIFRAS CO LTD
businessSummary: Leifras Co Ltd is a Tokyo-based company mainly engaged in the children's sports school business and school club support business. It operates in two divisions. The sports division includes the sports school business, event business, and alliance business. The sports school business operates sports schools. The event business aims to develop children's human skills and revitalize local communities through sports and other experiential activities and events. The alliance business partners with professional sports teams and operates joint schools. The social division includes the school club support business, which provides sports coaching in school club activities and physical education classes, the community collaboration business, which promotes local sports, the LEIF after-school day care service business, which supports children with disabilities and developmental characteristics through soccer therapy, and the healthcare business, which provides exercise programs for the elderly.

name: TSUKURUBA INC
businessSummary: Tsukuruba Inc is a Japan-based company develops by combining Information and communication technology and design. The Company operates in two business segments. Cowcamo segment is involved in the provision of services, such as property information distribution services through online media, broker services by the Company’s own agents, as well as support services for sellers and business utilizing customer needs and property data. The segment provides its services through the renovation and second-hand housing distribution platform cowcamo. Shared Workplace segment develops business centered on the sharing service of workspaces that provides working place combining services with renovated office spaces as a subscription type service. The Segment provides Co-working space co-ba, whose main customers are people and organizations such as startups, individual business owners and creators, as well as HEYSHA, which can rent office space flexibly according to the growth and change of Company.

name: NEXT GENERATION TECHNOLOGY GROUP INC
businessSummary: Next Generation Technology Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in providing support for the successive acquisition of manufacturing and manufacturing-related companies and the management of the acquiring companies. As a serial acquirer, the Company grows by conducting a series of mergers and acquisitions (M&A) of manufacturing companies at appropriate valuations. In acquiring companies, the Company receives referrals of potential acquirers primarily from corporate M&A advisors and financial institutions, for which it pays a fee. The Company provides various types of management support to the acquired companies, including the dispatch of executives, for which it receives a management support fee from each company.

name: MOVIN' STRATEGIC CAREER CO LTD
businessSummary: Movin' Strategic Career Co Ltd is a Japan-based company that provides recruitment services to professional firms, focusing on the human resources consulting industry. The Company operates through the recruitment business segment. The Recruitment Business segment focuses on supporting management consultants in recruiting. The recruitment service introduces full-time candidates to companies seeking full-time positions. Career advisors obtain job details from companies seeking full-time positions and match candidates who meet the job requirements from a registered user database (or external job-hunting Websites). Career advisors also conduct interviews with registered users who wish to change jobs, provide career consultations on desired job types, confirm their intentions to change jobs, introduce job openings that match the registered user's career aspirations, send resumes and other information and provide support and advice from the job interview to joining the company.

name: UNICHARM CORP
businessSummary: Unicharm Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of baby care-related products, feminine care-related products, healthcare-related products, clean & fresh-related products, pet care-related products. The Company operates in three business segments. The Personal Care segment is engaged in the provision of baby care-related products including paper diapers, feminine care-related products including sanitary items, as well as healthcare-related products, including incontinence articles for adults and powder puffs. The Pet Care segment is engaged in the provision of pet food products and pet toiletry products. The Others segment offers industrial materials-related products and others. Its brands include moony, Silcot, Wave, Sofy and Lifree.

name: OMRON CORP
businessSummary: Omron Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of electrical machinery and equipment, electronic application machinery and equipment, precision machinery and equipment, and medical machinery and equipment. It operates through five business segments. Industrial Automation Business (IAB) segment provides programmable controllers, motion control equipment, sensor equipment, industrial cameras and code readers, inspection equipment and others. Healthcare Business (HCB) segment provides electronic blood pressure monitors, nebulizers, low-frequency therapy devices, electrocardiographs and others. Social Systems Solutions & Services Business (SSB) segment engages in energy business, station service systems, traffic management systems and others. Device & Module Solutions Business (DMB) segment provides relays, switches, connectors and others. Data Solutions Business (DSB) segment engages in data healthcare business, corporate health business, and other businesses.

name: EIKEN CHEMICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Eiken Chemical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacturing and sales of test drugs. Through its subsidiaries, the Company conducts contract the manufacturing of diagnostic reagents and purchases, manufactures and sells diagnostic reagents. The products and services include microbial testing reagents, urine testing reagents, immuno-serological test reagents, biochemical testing reagents and instrument food environment-related media. The Company sells its products in Japan and overseas markets.

name: PLAID INC
businessSummary: Plaid Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of customer experience (CX) platform KARTE to businesses operating websites and smartphone applications in a cloud format. The Company is engaged in the development of the CX platform KARTE. By incorporating KARTE into websites and smartphone applications operated by businesses, businesses collect and analyze data on the behavior of users who visit those websites and smartphone applications, organize and visualize data on a user-by-user basis, and personalize communication via websites, smartphone applications, emails and chats to each user or user segments. The Company is also engaged in the operation of a media called XD to provide information on the Internet.

name: VERITAS IN SILICO INC
businessSummary: Veritas In Silico Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the pharmaceutical discovery platform business. The main business is small molecule drug discovery targeting messenger ribonucleic acid (mRNA) using the ibVIS platform, which integrates digital technology including in silico ribonucleic acid (RNA) structural analysis technology and drug discovery technology, through joint drug discovery research with pharmaceutical companies to create mRNA-targeted small molecule drugs.

name: SUN CORP
businessSummary: Sun Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the development, manufacturing, and sales of global data intelligence, entertainment-related, new information technology (IT) related, and wellness businesses. It operates through four segments. The Global Data Intelligence segment develops, manufactures, and sells mobile data transfer devices and related services for sale to criminal investigation agencies and similar entities (Digital Intelligence Business). The Entertainment-Related segment develops, manufactures, and sells pachinko machine components, such as control boards, primarily sold to pachinko machine manufacturers. The New IT-Related segment primarily develops, manufactures, and sells machine-to-machine (M2M) communication devices and Internet of Things (IoT) solutions, and develops and sells business support systems for B2B applications. The Wellness segment develops and sells products and services primarily aimed at improving sleep quality within the digital health field.

name: ASGENT INC
businessSummary: Asgent, Inc. is a Japan-based security solution vendor engaged in the distribution of network security related products and product combination services using consulting know-how. The Company is engaged in the import and sale of network security-related products, as well as the provision of related services.

name: SHIMANO INC
businessSummary: Shimano Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of bicycle components and fishing tackle. The Company conducts business through three segments. The Bicycle Components segment manufactures and sells drivetrain components such as derailleurs, braking components such as brakes, other bicycle parts, and related accessories. The Fishing Tackle segment manufactures and sells reels, rods, and fishing gear. The Other segment manufactures and sells rowing-related equipment and other products.

name: METAPLANET INC
businessSummary: Metaplanet Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the Bitcoin treasury business, hotel business, and other businesses. The Company operates in two segments. The Bitcoin Treasury Business segment focuses on maximizing Bitcoin yields (profitability) and creating long-term shareholder value. The Hotel Business segment operates hotels, providing a space for Bitcoin enthusiasts, business professionals, and educators to learn from each other. In addition, the Company utilizes its exclusive license for Bitcoin Magazine Japan to promote the spread and education of Bitcoin. It is also engaged in the acquisition, holding and disposal of real estate and real estate trust beneficiary rights, as well as business using advanced technologies such as Web3, blockchain and non-fungible tokens (NFTs).

name: MILBON CO LTD
businessSummary: Milbon Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of cosmetics, as well as related service businesses. The products it manufactures or handles are divided into five categories, including hair care products, hair dyes, permanent wave products, cosmetics, and others. Hair care products include shampoos, hair treatments, hair tonics, hair creams, liquid and foam hair styling products, setting lotions, and hair sprays. Hair dyes include oxidative hair dyes, acidic hair dyes, hair dyes, and hair bleaches. Permanent wave products include thioglycolic acid-based permanent wave products, cysteine-based permanent wave products, and hair straighteners. Cosmetics include skin care and makeup cosmetics. Others include health foods and beauty equipment.

name: TAKARA BIO INC
businessSummary: Takara Bio Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in businesses related to reagents, instruments, contract services and gene therapy. The Company has one business segment. The reagents, instruments and contract services business provides biotechnology-related research reagents, laboratory instruments and contract services to universities, research institutions and corporations, offering products in the fields of molecular and cell biology based on technologies including polymerase chain reaction (PCR), next-generation sequencing, genome editing and stem cells. The Company also promotes its contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) business, which includes contract manufacturing of regenerative medicine products and genetic analysis services. The gene therapy business advances the development of gene therapy drugs including genetically modified T-cell therapies and next-generation chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) technologies.

name: MODALIS THERAPEUTICS CORP
businessSummary: Modalis Therapeutics Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the research and development of gene therapy drugs using the core platform CRISPR-GNDM technology. The Company develops gene therapy drugs that use CRISPR-GNDM technology, which is a unique platform technology, for genetic diseases caused by errors in the genetic code and epigenetics. The Company has two business models. Collaborative model pipeline opens CRISPR-GNDM technology to partners, and develops therapeutic drugs with partners' funds for the targets selected by the partners. In-house model pipeline selects targets using the Company's own CRISPR-GNDM technology and develops therapeutic agents. The Company's pipeline consists of a collaborative model pipeline of 5 items such as MDL-201 and an in-house model pipeline of 2 items such as MDL-101.

name: SEVEN BANK LTD
businessSummary: Seven Bank Ltd is engaged in the provision of financial services such as automatic teller machine (ATM) service, Internet banking service, and loan service. The Company operates its business through two business segments. Domestic Business segment is involved in the ATM platform business that installs ATMs at stores such as Seven-Eleven and Ito-Yokado, as well as at airports, stations, financial institution stores. The Segment also provides settlement account services including ordinary deposits, time deposits, loan services, overseas money transfer services, debit services, as well as the contract work from other financial institutions. The Overseas Business segment provides ATM services mainly in the United States and Indonesia. The Company also conducts investment advisory business.

name: KYORITSU MAINTENANCE CO LTD
businessSummary: Kyoritsu Maintenance Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the dormitory management business, hotel business and others. The Company operates in five segments. The Dormitory segment is engaged in the operation of student and company dormitories. The Hotel segment is engaged in the operation of business and resort hotels. The General Building Management segment is engaged in the provision of management services for office buildings and residential buildings. The Foods segment is engaged in the restaurant business, the food catering business and the hotel restaurant business. The Development segment is engaged in the provision of construction, planning, design and brokerage services for real estate, as well as the condominium business and other development related businesses. The Company is also engaged in the management of homes for the elders, the provision of supporting services for single people, the insurance agency business and other related businesses.

name: CYBERDYNE INC
businessSummary: Cyberdyne Inc is engaged in the research, development, manufacture, sale, and maintenance management related to Cybernics technology. The Company mainly uses human and the Internet of Things (IoH/IoT), robots, and artificial intelligence (AI) Cybernics technology to develop Cybernic systems. It develops the Cybernics treatment service business and the training service business that utilize Cybernics technology. The Company develops in various fields centered on HAL. HAL is a robot treatment device for the purpose of improving and regenerating the physical function of patients, a welfare device and life support device for the purpose of supporting independence, and a work support equipment. It can be used for various purposes by being worn and used by people. The Company is also involved in the productization of AI-equipped transport robots; cleaning robots; Cyin, which is used for communication with people with disabilities, and electrocardiography devices.

name: RETTY INC
businessSummary: Retty Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of a real name gourmet platform Retty that accumulates restaurant recommendation information and restaurant information nationwide, and provides individually optimized restaurant information to users. Store information such as store data, real name recommendation data, browsing log data, follow-up and action data are stored in Retty. The Company is engaged in the provision of two services. The fun relationship management (FRM) service is a subscription business model in which a fixed monthly service fee income is earned from contracted restaurants. It provides online sales promotion services, advertising services and customer management systems. The advertising content services consist of advertising solutions that send Retty users to customers through tie-ups, ad technology and alliances, as well as content solutions that accumulate and provide content to cosmetics, apparel, travel, real estate and other industries.

name: HOGY MEDICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Hogy Medical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of medical consumables and other products, as well as related services. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of medical consumables, medical devices, and medical nonwoven fabric products. The Company provides sterilized supplies, surgical nonwoven fabric products, remanufactured single-use medical devices, endoscope holders, and endoscopic surgical sponges for medical professionals.

name: EMNET JAPAN CO LTD
businessSummary: eMnet Japan Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the internet advertising business. The Company is involved in the provision of services such as search advertising, operational display advertising, social media advertising, video advertising, affiliate advertising, ad network advertising, digital signal processor (DSP), data management platform (DMP), smartphone advertising, native advertising, application advertising and net advertising. The Company also provides one-stop advertising including planning, operation, analysis and improvement, and provides comprehensive services as a consultant on internet advertising. The Company also gains know-how from the experience of advertisement operation on the client's electronic commerce (EC) sites and receives the creative production order at its own company.

name: ANRITSU CORP
businessSummary: Anritsu Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in development, manufacture, and sale of electronic measuring instruments, food and pharmaceutical quality assurance systems, environmental measuring equipment and devices. It has three business segments. Communications Measurement segment offers measuring instruments for digital communications and Internet Protocol (IP) networks, optical communications, mobile communications, general-purpose radio frequency (RF), microwave and millimeter wave band measuring instruments. PQA segment offers automatic weighing machines, automatic electronic scales, foreign object detectors and comprehensive quality management and control systems. Environmental Measurement segment offers electric vehicle (EV) and battery testing equipment, support services for local 5th generation mobile communications systems (5G) and monitoring solutions. It also engages in sensing and device services, logistics, welfare services, real estate leasing and others.

name: MITSUI E&S CO LTD
businessSummary: Mitsui E&S Co Ltd, formerly Mitsui E&S Holdings Co Ltd, is primarily engaged in ship, marine development, machinery, and engineering businesses. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Ship segment provides ships, naval vessels, high-speed passenger ships, offshore structures, underwater equipment, design engineering services, ship-related equipment and machinery, and steel structures. The Marine Development segment provides floating offshore oil and gas production, storage, and offloading facilities. The Machinery segment provides marine and land-use diesel engines, marine equipment, gas engines, steam turbines, blowers, compressors, gas turbines, among others. The Engineering segment provides power generation projects and general overseas civil engineering and construction work. The Company also engages in land-based diesel power plant business, information and communication equipment business, system development business, gas-related engineering, among others.

name: DIGITAL GARAGE INC
businessSummary: Digital Garage, Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in the marketing technology business, the financial technology business, the incubation technology business and the long term incubation business. The Company has four business segments. The Marketing Technology segment is engaged in the comprehensive promotion business, the data management business, as well as the advertising products development and marketing business. The Financial Technology segment is engaged in the provision of electronic payment solutions such as credit card payments and convenience store payments, as well as the design, development and operation of Internet systems and electronic commerce (EC) systems. The Incubation Technology segment is engaged in the strategy support type venture incubation business. The Long Term Incubation segment is engaged in the development and management of medias, the development and support of data security related systems, and the financial business utilizing blockchain.

name: KUSURI NO AOKI HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Kusuri No Aoki Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the neighborhood-type retail business of pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, daily necessities, foods, and dispensing pharmacies. The Company operates drugstore business with an assortment of products that include daily necessities, with pharmaceuticals and cosmetics as core products. The Company provides five types of products. Health products include pharmaceuticals, health foods, and medical supplies. Beauty products include counseling cosmetics, face care products such as face wash, body care products, hair care products, and oral care products. Life products include baby-related products, nursing care products, sanitary products, detergents, household products, pet food, clothing products, and home appliances. Food products include processed foods, daily foods, fresh foods, seasonings, confectionery, beverages, liquor, and other foods. Pharmaceutical products include pharmaceuticals prescribed at pharmacies.

name: JAPAN CRAFT HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Japan Craft Holdings Co Ltd, formerly Fujikyu Holdings Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the retail business and the management of group companies. The Company's main business is the general retail business centered on yarn, handicraft supplies, fabrics, Japanese and Western clothing, clothing products and household goods. Along with a handicraft specialty store chain consisting of Craft Heart Tokai, Craft World, Craft Park and Craft Loop, the Company carries out the store sales business that develops a household goods specialty store Suntreme. The Company also operates mail-order sales that sell to general customers through online shops and media such as catalogs and also engages in the real estate leasing business.

name: GREEN MONSTER INC
businessSummary: Green Monster Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of investment learning support business. The Company is engaged in the development and operation of smartphone applications that allow hands-on learning about foreign exchange (FX), stock investment, and asset formation through game-like demo trading and simulations rather than classroom lectures. The main products include FX Navi, an FX demo trading application, Toushika, a money plan simulation application, and Kabu Tasu, a stock investment demo trading application. The Company is also engaged in the provision of financial planning services for corporations and individuals through subsidiary, including financial education, life planning proposals, home purchasing, and advice on inheritance planning.

name: NOMURA REAL ESTATE MASTER FUND INC
businessSummary: Nomura Real Estate Master Fund Inc is a real estate investment trust (REIT) company. It aims to achieve sustainable growth in asset and stable earnings from mid-term to long-term perspectives. The Fund mainly invests in commercial buildings and logistic facilities located in the three major metropolitan areas (metropolitan area, Chukyo area and Kinki area), other major cities including ordinance-designated cities or surrounding areas. The Fund manager is Nomura Real Estate Asset Management Co., Ltd.

name: KUBELL CO LTD
businessSummary: kubell Co Ltd, formerly Chatwork Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of business communication tools developed in-house and sales agent of security software. The Company operates in two segments. The Chatwork segment is mainly engaged in the development and provision of business chat tool Chatwork. It is also engaged in the provision of advertising service and various services using Chatwork as a service platform. The sgement also develops and provides cloud storage services, such as Secure SAMBA. The Security segment purchases and sells security software. The Security Segment is engaged in the purchases and sales of security software. The Company’s sales site uses web advertisement and affiliate programs to attract customers and sell software.

name: FURUYA METAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Furuya Metal Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial precious metal products. The Company operates through five business segments. The Electronics segment manufactures and sells electronic components used in the manufacturing process of electronic products. The Thin Film segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of precious metal targets used in thin film formation. The Thermal segment manufactures and sells temperature sensors mainly used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment. The Fine Chemicals and Recycling segment manufactures and sells precious metal compounds and recovers and refines precious metals. The Supply Chain Support segment sells major precious metal raw materials that are not related to product orders. Other businesses mainly sell purchased products, and others.

name: MOBILE FACTORY INC
businessSummary: Mobile Factory,Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in mobile service. The Company provides social application service and contents service. Social Application Service is focus on delivering services of game application through SNS platforms and application markets. Contents Service mainly provides sites, such as ringer melody and divination sites, which are operated by telecommunication carriers.

name: TOYO ENGINEERING CORP
businessSummary: Toyo Engineering Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) business. The EPC business involves research and development cooperation, planning, design, equipment procurement, construction, commissioning, and technical guidance for plants in oil, gas, petrochemicals, general chemicals, water, power generation, advanced production systems, pharmaceuticals, fine chemicals, biotechnology, the environment, resource development, artificial intelligence and other industries. With a global structure, it operates a comprehensive engineering business that meets changing customer needs. It also engages in temporary staffing, real estate management, travel, and insurance agency services.

name: PIALA INC
businessSummary: PIALA INC. is mainly engaged in the Electronic Commerce (EC) support business. The Company promotes EC transformation. The EC support business provides clients with EC marketing and advertising marketing services specialized mainly in beauty, health and food fields such as cosmetics and health foods. The EC marketing mainly focuses on customer attracting, provides Key Performance Indicator (KPI) guarantee service using RESULT Series, operates through marketing support business related to advertising agency and customer support service, conducts RESULT Series solution including RESULT MASTER equipped with Data Management Platform (DMP) and Artificial Intelligence (AI). The advertising marketing provides fee-based services, conducts EC support service by proposing various media and methods from ordinary media to niche media such as local newspapers and area-limited magazines in accordance with client's direct marketing issues.

name: SEVEN & I HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Seven & i Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the distribution business, primarily in domestic convenience store operations, overseas convenience store operations, superstore operations, and finance-related operations. The Company operates in four business segments. The Domestic Convenience Stores segment is engaged in convenience store operations through direct management and franchise system. The Overseas Convenience Stores segment is engaged in convenience store operations through both directly managed and franchised stores. The Superstore segment is engaged in the retail business that provides a comprehensive range of daily necessities such as food and daily necessities. The Finance-related segment is engaged in banking, credit card, leasing, and other businesses. The Company also operates businesses related to department stores, specialty stores, and real estate.

name: WOLVES HAND CO LTD
businessSummary: WOLVES HAND Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the veterinary hospital business. The main businesses are the operation of veterinary hospitals and pet salons, provision of software for veterinary hospitals, distribution of veterinary medical education seminars, and the manufacture and sale of medical equipment and instruments. The veterinary hospital operation business provides veterinary medical care at veterinary hospitals. The pet salon operation business provides grooming services and operates pet hotels. The veterinary hospital software provision business develops and sells the customer management system Wantaro for veterinary hospitals. The veterinary medical education seminar distribution business operates the information site VMN for veterinarians and creates seminar content. The medical equipment manufacturing and sales business researches, develops, manufactures, sells, leases, and imports and exports medical equipment and medical instruments.

name: MORI HILLS REIT INVESTMENT CORP
businessSummary: Mori Hills Reit Investment Corp is real estate investment trust (REIT) company. It aims to achieve sustainable growth in asset and stable earnings from mid- to long-term perspectives. The Fund mainly invests in real estate asset like office building, housing and commercial facilities. Its property portfolio includes Roppongi Hills Mori Tower, Ark Mori Building, Roppongi Hills Mori Tower, Ark Mori Building, Koraku Mori Building, Akasaka Tameike Tower, Holland Hills Mori Tower And Roppongi view tower. The asset manager of the Fund is Mori Building Investment Management Co., Ltd.

name: CAULIS INC
businessSummary: Caulis Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the money laundering and cyber security business. The Money Laundering and Cyber Security Business segment is mainly engaged in the provision of Fraud Alert, a cloud-based unauthorized access detection service for corporate clients. Fraud Alert consists of three services: Fraud Alert login detection service, Fraud Alert deposit and withdrawal detection service, and Fraud Alert new account opening detection service.

name: PORT INC
businessSummary: PORT Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of Internet media business. The Company provides career-based media Career Park!, finance-based media Manet, medical-based media Online Clinic, Port Medical and Doctors’ Diet services. The main features of the Internet media business include membership model and cross sales of Internet solutions and products and services. Career-based Internet media Career Park! is a career information platform that helps career selection centering on job hunting and career change. Finance-based Internet media Magnet uses the media development know-how cultivated in Career park!, operates as a money-related life support type media. Medical-based Internet media Online Clinic provides knowledge of diseases supervised by medical specialist teams. Doctor's Diet provides online diet advice and exercise videos.

name: GENDA INC
businessSummary: Genda Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in management guidance and other management oversight as a pure holding company. The Company operates through two segments. The Entertainment Platform business segment is positioned as the domain connecting intellectual property (IP) content with fans, primarily centered on amusement facility operations, including karaoke and food & beverage (F&B). The Entertainment Content business segment is broadly divided into Character Merchandising (MD) and Content & Promotion, and is positioned as the upstream business domain of the Entertainment Platform business.

name: HAMAMATSU PHOTONICS KK
businessSummary: Hamamatsu Photonics KK is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of photomultiplier tubes, imaging equipment and light sources, optical semiconductor elements, image processing and measuring devices, and other optical-related products. The Company operates through three business segments. The Electronic Tube segment manufactures and sells photomultiplier tubes, imaging equipment and light sources. The Optical Semiconductor segment manufactures and sells optical semiconductor elements. The Imaging Measurement Equipment segment manufactures and sells image processing and measuring devices. The Company also engages in semiconductor laser-related businesses and hotel businesses.

name: GLP J-REIT
businessSummary: GLP J-REIT is a Japan-based investment company. The Company aims to achieve sustainable growth in asset and stable earnings from mid- to long-term perspectives. The Company invests in logistic facilities and related real estate properties mainly located in Kanto and Kansai regions and other areas. The asset manager of the Company is GLP Japan Advisors Co Ltd.

name: ORIX JREIT INC
businessSummary: Orix JREIT Inc is real estate investment trust (REIT) company. It aims to achieve sustainable growth in asset and stable earnings from mid-to long-term perspectives. The Fund mainly invests in real estate-related assets that are used in offices located in major cities across the country. Its property portfolio includes Round Cross Mita, Shibuya Pine Building, Round Cross Akihabara, Orix Ikebukuro Building and Hamamatsu Act Tower, among others. The asset manager of the Fund is ORIX Asset Management Corporation.

name: CYFUSE BIOMEDICAL KK
businessSummary: Cyfuse Biomedical KK is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of cell products. The Company is engaged in the development of pipelines for obtaining approval for regenerative medicine products and contract research cell products in the field of regenerative medicine. The Company is engaged in the development of cell products as tools for drug discovery support for pharmaceutical companies in the drug discovery support field. The Company is engaged in the development and sell of three-dimensional cell stacking system equipment equipped with basic technology, apply technology for cell product development, and develop new technology in the device field.

name: ADR ON TAKEDA PHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Takeda Pharmaceutical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research, development, manufacturing and global sales of a wide range of pharmaceuticals. Its main business areas are divided into six, including gastroenterology, rare diseases, plasma-derived therapies, oncology (cancer), vaccines, and neuroscience (neuropsychiatric disorders). In research and development, the Company focuses on three priority disease areas, including gastroenterology and inflammatory diseases, neuroscience, and oncology, and also focuses on plasma-derived therapies.

name: KDDI CORP
businessSummary: KDDI CORPORATION is a telecommunications company. The Company operates in four segments. The Personal segment is engaged in the provision of communication services for personal and home, including au mobile phone, and fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) and cable television (CATV) services, among others. The Life Design segment provides commerce services, financial services, payment services, and content services such as video, music and information distribution. The Business segment offers various communication services, the sale of mobile handset, data center services and various Information and Communication Technology (ICT) solutions/cloud-based services to enterprise customers. The Global segment offers various communication services, data center services and various ICT solutions/Cloud-based services to to overseas customers. The Company also provides communication equipment maintenance service, as well as the research and development services of information communication.

name: SOFTBANK CORP PREFERRED
businessSummary: SoftBank Corp is a Japan-based company mainly provides wholesale software, broadband, electronic commerce (EC), and other information services. The Company operates through five segments. The Consumer segment provides electric power services. The segment also purchases mobile handsets from handset manufacturers and sells them to agents operating SoftBank stores and other retail outlets or to individual customers. The Enterprise segment provides a variety of corporate services, including mobile services and fixed-line communication services. The Distribution segment provides cloud services mainly for corporate customers and commercial products such as software and mobile accessories for individual customers. The Media & Ecommerce segment provides online and offline services. The Media segment provides advertising-related services, online shopping services, and reuse services. The Finance segment provides cashless payment services, financial services, and payment agency services.

name: SOFTBANK CORP
businessSummary: SoftBank Corp is a Japan-based company mainly provides wholesale software, broadband, electronic commerce (EC), and other information services. The Company operates through five segments. The Consumer segment provides electric power services. The segment also purchases mobile handsets from handset manufacturers and sells them to agents operating SoftBank stores and other retail outlets or to individual customers. The Enterprise segment provides a variety of corporate services, including mobile services and fixed-line communication services. The Distribution segment provides cloud services mainly for corporate customers and commercial products such as software and mobile accessories for individual customers. The Media & Ecommerce segment provides online and offline services. The Media segment provides advertising-related services, online shopping services, and reuse services. The Finance segment provides cashless payment services, financial services, and payment agency services.

name: MATSUI SECURITIES CO LTD
businessSummary: MATSUI SECURITIES CO., LTD. is a Japan-based securities company engaged in financial product trading business. The Company conducts stock brokering and underwriting operations through Internet transactions. The Company mainly conducts stock brokering business for individual investors and provides online securities trading service Net Stock. The Company provides services such as consignment trading and underwriting of stocks, futures and options, offering and sale of market derivatives, as well as foreign exchange margin trading, among others.

name: ADR ON NIDEC CORP
businessSummary: Nidec Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of precision small motors, in-vehicle products, home appliances, commercial and industrial products, equipment, electronic and optical components. The Company operates through 10 segments. The SPMS segment manufactures and sells motors for hard disk drives (HDDs) and other small motors. The AMEC segment manufactures and sells in-vehicle products. The MOEN segment, ACIM segment and Nidec Techno Motor segment manufacture and sell home appliances, commercial and industrial products. The Nidec Instruments segment manufactures and sells equipment, in-vehicle products, electronic components and other small motors. The Nidec Mobility segment manufactures and sells in-vehicle products. The Machinery Business Headquarters segment and the Nidec Advanced Technology segment manufacture and sell equipment. The Other segment manufactures and sells in-vehicle products, equipment, electronic components, other small motors.

name: SHIMIZU CORP
businessSummary: Shimizu Corp is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the construction business. The Company operates in two business segments, construction business and investment development business. The Company is involved in leasing of land and buildings, sales and leasing of construction materials and equipment, construction work, construction, maintenance and operation of public facilities, engineering, and life cycle valuation (LCV).

name: NAKANISHI INC
businessSummary: Nakanishi Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of dental medical equipment, dental chairs, and general industrial cutting and grinding equipment. The Company operates through four business segments. The Dental Business segment manufactures and sells treatment handpieces, laboratory micromotors and handpieces, surgical handpieces, and sterilizers. The DCI Business segment manufactures and sells dental chairs and other products. The Surgical Business segment manufactures and sells bone cutting equipment, which is essential for surgical fields such as neurosurgery. The Machinery Business segment manufactures and sells manual grinders and machine-mounted spindles.

name: TAISEI CORP
businessSummary: Taisei Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the civil engineering business, the construction business and the development business, as well as other business further associated with each business. The Company operates in three business segments. Civil Engineering segment operates business related to the construction of civil engineering works. Construction segment operates business related to general construction of buildings. Development segment operates business related to real estate in general, including sale, leasing, management and placement of real estate. The Company also operates businesses related to the construction industry, such as contract research, technology provision, and environmental measurement, as well as logistics, leisure-related, and other service businesses.

name: REVOLUTION CO LTD
businessSummary: Revolution Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the real estate, investment, real estate credit, and crowdfunding businesses. The Company operates through four business segments. The Real Estate Business segment is engaged in the sales and brokerage of real estate, primarily in major metropolitan areas such as Tokyo. The Investment Business segment aims to earn investment returns through investments in special purpose companies (SPCs) that invest in domestic and international companies and financial products such as securities. The Real Estate Credit Business segment operates a money lending business that provides funds secured by real estate. The Crowdfunding Business segment operates a crowdfunding business. It raises funds, primarily from an unspecified number of individuals, for investment targets such as real estate, and then invests in them.

name: MITSUBISHI ESTATE CO LTD
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Estate Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in commercial real estate, Marunouchi, housing, overseas, investment management, and design supervision and real estate services. The Company operates through six business segments. The Commercial Real Estate Business segment develops, leases, operates, and manages various asset types, as well as parking lots and district heating and cooling. The Marunouchi Business segment develops, leases, operates, and manages office buildings in the Otemachi, Marunouchi, and Yurakucho areas, as well as district heating and cooling. The Housing Business segment constructs, sells, leases, manages, renovates, and brokers condominiums and detached houses, and others. The Overseas Business segment develops, leases, and manages real estate overseas. The Investment Management segment manages real estate investments. The Design Supervision and Real Estate Services segment engages in the design and supervision of architecture, and others.

name: SAPPORO HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Sapporo Holdings Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the alcoholic beverages, food and beverage, and real estate businesses. The Company is organized into three business segments. The Alcoholic Beverages Business segment manufactures and sells alcoholic beverages and operates various types of restaurants. The Food and Beverage Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of food products and drinking water. The Real Estate Business segment leases real estate. The Company also provides insurance agency services and indirect business services to affiliated companies.

name: CYBERSOLUTIONS INC
businessSummary: CyberSolutions Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the development and sales of cloud-based email and email security services for corporate clients. The Company operates the digital communication and cybersecurity business segment. The security solutions business plans and sells products and services related to security and risk management, including email sanitization, threat protection and information leakage prevention. The email security products and services include Cloud Mail SECURITYSUITE, MailGates, CyberMail-ST, Cybermail-CDR and Enterprise Audit, a messaging archive solution. The communication solutions business plans and sells products and services related to business communication including email, business chat and groupware. The Company’s products and services include CyberMail, CYBERMAIL, CYBERCHAT, EMERGENCYMAIL, SecureDrive (cloud storage service), SecureBoard (cloud groupware service) and SecureCommunicationONE (integrated collaboration service).

name: HANDS CO LTD
businessSummary: Hands Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the business of construction. The Company operates through three segments. The Construction segment mainly carries in and out materials at construction sites. The Engineering segment mainly carries out various construction work such as solar panel installation, steel frame construction, and platform door installation. The Repair segment mainly repairs interior scratches on detached houses and apartment houses.

name: ADR ON PICOCELA INC
businessSummary: Picocela Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of mobile communications platform that merges the edge and the cloud through enterprise wireless mesh. The Company provides proprietary wireless multi-stage relay technology/PicoCELA Backhaul Engine (PBE), products and solutions based on cable-less & wireless multi-stage hop technology, and PicoManager, which is a cloud management system.

name: RYOHIN KEIKAKU CO LTD
businessSummary: Ryohin Keikaku Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in sale of products under the brands of Mujirushi Ryohin and MUJI. The Company has four segments including Domestic segment, East Asia segment, Europe and Americas segment as well as Southeast Asia and Oceania segment. The Domestic segment is engaged in sale and supplement, the operation of camp sites and house sale business. The East Asia Business segment is engaged in product sales and restaurant business in East Asia. The Southeast Asia & Oceania Business segment is engaged in product sales and restaurant business in Southeast Asia and Oceania. The Europe and America Business segment is engaged in product sales and restaurant business in Europe and America. The Company is also involved in food and beverage sale under Cafe&Meal MUJI brand, the operation of camp sites, sale of houses and sale of IDEE brand products.

name: RAKUTEN GROUP INC
businessSummary: Rakuten Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the Internet services, FinTech, and mobile business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Internet Service segment is mainly engaged in the operation of electronic commerce (EC) sites, including Rakuten Ichiba, as well as online cashback sites, travel reservation sites, portal sites, digital content sites and messaging services. It is also involved in the sale of advertisements on these Websites, and the operation of sports facilities. The FinTech segment is engaged in the provision of credit card-related services, banking and securities services, cryptocurrency (virtual currency) intermediation, insurance services and electronic money services. The Mobile segment is engaged in the provision of communication services and messaging services, as well as operation of digital content Websites. The Company also operates marketing support business, Rakuten delivery business and real-time takeout business.

name: MEDICAL DATA VISION CO LTD
businessSummary: Medical Data Vision Co.,Ltd. is a company engaged in the medical data network business. The Data Network Service provides management support systems for medical institutions and health insurance unions, as well as EVE, Medical Code and CADA-BOX for hospitals. The Data Utilization Service provides corporate services and personal services based on the medical and health information accumulated through the data network services, various analysis data to pharmaceutical companies, research institutes, patients and consumers. The segment provides various services, such as MDV analyzer, ADHOC research service, OTC, H&BC and insurance company services, as well as Media logs and others.

name: MAKUAKE INC
businessSummary: Makuake, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the crowdfunding business. The Company is engaged in the provision of Makuake service, Makuake Incubation Studio service and other services. The Makuake service is engaged in the operation of the crowdfunding platform Makuake, as well as the provision of matching services on the Internet for companies and individuals who want to realize and accelerate products or services using new ideas and technologies, and multiple individuals who support the projects. The Makuake Incubation Studio service is engaged in the provision of various incubation services in the products development area, such as new products planning, partners matching to realize planning, project strategy planning and marketing report creation. The other services is engaged in the provision of electronic commerce (EC) site management services, advertising distribution services, Makuake SHOP services and sales channel introduction services.

name: PRISM BIOLAB CO LTD
businessSummary: PRISM BioLab Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the drug discovery business. The Company operates through Japan drug discovery business segment. The Company builds a new drug discovery platform and develops new drugs. The Company conducts research and development of pharmaceuticals using their owned drug discovery platform technology PepMetics technology. There are two business models. The in-house development business is engaged in the select of drug discovery targets and creates programs in-house. The joint development business creates programs using their owned technology to target drug discovery targets for pharmaceutical companies.

name: UNIPOS INC
businessSummary: Unipos Inc, formerly Fringe81 Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and consultation of Internet advertising technology, as well as the provision of Website services mainly in human resources (HR) tech fields. The advertising business includes advertising agency service, media growth service and solution service. The advertising agency service is involved in the sale of Internet advertisements. The media growth service is involved in the provision of planning, development and operation of advertising goods for smartphone media including applications. The solution service is involved in the provision of advertising strategy’s decision-making support products for advertisers who receive Internet advertising. The Unipos business is involved in the provision of a service named Unipos for mutual evaluation and praise.

name: FUJIKURA LTD
businessSummary: Fujikura Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in business activities such as manufacturing, sales, and services of products across the Information Technology, Electronics, Automotive, Energy, and Real Estate business divisions. The company operates in five business segments. The Information Technology segment provides optical fiber, optical cables, telecommunication components, optical components, optical related equipment, network equipment, and construction work. The Electronics business segment provides printed circuit boards, electronic wires, hard disk components, and various connectors. The Automotive Business segment provides wiring harnesses, electrical components, and other products for automobiles. The Energy Business segment provides power cables, communication cables, aluminum wires, coated wires. The Real Estate business segment leases real estate.

name: FIT EASY INC
businessSummary: Fit Easy Inc is a Japan-based company mainly operates FIT-EASY, an amusement fitness club that incorporates not only fitness training equipment but also amusement elements, as well as franchise chains (FCs). The Fitness Club Management segment is primarily involved in the development of stores and services that utilize the know-how of amusement fitness clubs, the operation and planning of stores that will become third places (a third place neither at home nor at work), and franchise expansion. Amusement fitness clubs aim to create spaces that can be enjoyed with all five senses, where customers can use amusement facilities such as FIT-GOLF (simulation golf) and FIT-SAUNA (private sauna), FIT-RACE (a full-scale racing simulator supervised by a professional driver), FIT-LOUNGE (a co-working space where customers can bring their own personal computers (PCs) to work or have online meetings), and self-beauty treatments according to their own hobbies and preferences.

name: FICHA INC
businessSummary: Ficha Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the image recognition software development business. The Company is mainly engaged in the development of Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) that supports the driving operation of automobile drivers that detect pedestrians, vehicles, lanes, signs, mainly for in-vehicle cameras and drive recorders. The main customers are auto parts manufacturers and drive recorder manufacturers called companies that directly supply parts to automobile manufacturers (Tier 1). In addition, the Company is also engaged in the installation of software for Driver Monitoring System (DMS), which can detect face recognition and sight, dangerous driving, sleepy driving, in the vehicle through an automobile parts manufacturer.

name: FISCO LTD
businessSummary: FISCO Ltd. is engaged in the provision of information services. It mainly operates through nine business segments. The Information Service business provides corporate information for corporations and individuals, providing financial information and virtual currency information, real time distribution, Internet distribution, outsourcing, among others. The ICT IOT Device business includes agricultural ICT business and, research and development of robot business, among others. The FinTech System Development business includes system development, cloud services, and ASP services for nursing care establishments. The Internet Travel business includes e-market place management of travel related products. The Advertising Agency Services business includes advertising agency work, planning, editing, production and issuance of advertisement publications. It also engages Consulting business, Brand Retail Platform business, Virtual Currency / Block Chain business as well as Other business.

name: HUMAN MADE INC
businessSummary: HUMAN MADE Inc is a Japan-based company that operates the lifestyle brand HUMAN MADE and the additive-free curry shop CURRY UP, which uses original spices. The Company globally engages in a range of collaborations and production activities, including corporate branding support, product development and spatial design. The Company operates under the branding business segment. The product planning and production business involves designing and producing high-value-added items. These include products under the HUMAN MADE brand, as well as collaborations with creators, artists, musicians and domestic and international brand companies. The Company disseminates product information globally. The Company sells products via retail and wholesale through its own e-commerce Website and physical stores. The Company operates dining establishments and licenses out its owned intellectual property (IP).

name: HARMONIC DRIVE SYSTEMS INC
businessSummary: Harmonic Drive Systems Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the speed reducers business. The Company is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of precision speed reducers, precision actuators and control devices. The Company is mainly engaged in the production of speed reducers, rotary actuators and linear actuators. The Company distributes its products within the domestic market and to overseas markets, including the Americas and Europe.

name: HEARTSEED INC
businessSummary: Heartseed Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in research and development of regenerative medicine products. The Company has established cardiac regenerative medicine, a therapy in which microtissue (cardiomyocytes) derived from iPS cells are transplanted into the heart, and conducts business activities for patients with severe heart failure. Target diseases include dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM), old myocardial infarction (OMI), and dilated-phase hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (D-HCM). Except the pipeline's leading cardiac treatment HS-001 (administration of regenerated myocardium derived from allogeneic iPS cells to the myocardium), the Company also conducts research into the creation of myocardium using autologous iPS cells that do not pose immune rejection reactions and iPS cells with HLA knockout.

name: JAPAN STEEL WORKS LTD
businessSummary: Japan Steel Works Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in industrial machinery business. The Industrial Machinery segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale, and provision of maintenance services for resin manufacturing and processing machinery, electronic component and display manufacturing equipment, and semiconductor-related equipment. The profile and engineering segment manufactures and sells general cast and forged steel products such as power generation components and nuclear power related components, cast and forged steel components such as functional materials, clad steel sheets, etc. The segment also engages in various non-destructive testing and welding processes, and monitoring, maintenance, inspection, and repair of various equipment and devices. The other segment is engaged in the research, development, manufacturing and sales of new products, and business support and management service business.

name: NANO HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Nano Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the micellar nanoparticle technology to develop innovative pharmaceuticals, focusing on anticancer drugs that encapsulate small molecule drugs within nanoparticles. The Company operates through a single segment encompassing the research and development, manufacturing, and sales of pharmaceuticals and related services. The Company conducts non-clinical and early-stage clinical trials, then licenses the resulting development candidate assets to pharmaceutical companies, thereby developing an RNA drug discovery business that efficiently brings RNA medicines to the market. In promoting RNA drug discovery, the Company leverages its experience in drug delivery system anticancer drug development and manufacturing, nucleic acid drug research and development, and a variety of DDS selection options based on this experience, creating and licensing assets that enable rapid progress in pharmaceutical development.

name: DELTA-FLY PHARMA INC
businessSummary: Delta-Fly Pharma, Inc. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals. The Company's development pipeline includes anticancer drug candidate compound DFP-10917 whose target disease is refractory or recurrent acute myelogenous leukemia, anticancer drug candidate compound DFP-14323 whose target disease is lung cancer, anti-cancer drug candidate compound DFP-11207 whose target disease is solid cancer, anticancer drug candidate compound DFP-14927 whose target disease is solid cancer or blood cancer, anticancer drug candidate compound DFP-10825 whose target disease is peritoneal dissemination metastatic cancer.

name: TSUKUBASEIKO CO LTD
businessSummary: TSUKUBASEIKO Co,.Ltd. is mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of electrostatic chucks. The electrostatic chucks generate high adsorption power at low voltage and realize cordless and thin Carrier type electrostatic chucks. The Company's products include supporters, stages and others. The supporters is a system of electrostatic chuck which can maintain adsorption power for a long time even if it is separated from a power supply unit, and generate adsorption by using power supply units when adsorbing the materials. The stages is a system of electrostatic chuck to which a power supply unit belongs, supplies power when adsorbing the materials and stops power supply when releasing the material to be attracted. The other products include small electrostatic chucks, including other applied products of electrostatic chucks, embedded in handling materials for semiconductor wafers.

name: SORACOM INC
businessSummary: Soracom Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the Internet of Things (IoT) platform business. The IoT Platform Business segment mainly provides SORACOM, an IoT platform that solves common issues faced by client companies when introducing and operating IoT. It provides IoT devices, IoT subscriber identity modules (SIM), communication lines required for IoT, data storage and visualization applications required for IoT services, and network services as platform services. The Company also provides consulting services and undertakes contract work such as technology development support.

name: M3 INC
businessSummary: M3 Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of services centering on the platform of healthcare. The Company has five business segments. Medical Platforms segment conducts marketing-related businesses in Japan utilizing the Internet and real operations centered on medical employee specialized site m3.com. Evidence Solution segment is engaged in the contract research organization (CRO) business that supports clinical development work and research, and site management organization (SMO) business that manages the clinical trial operations. Career Solutions segment is engaged in human resource services for healthcare professionals. Site Solution segment provides operational support for medical institutions and home-visit nursing services. Overseas segment provides services of medical related marketing support, research and careers, utilizing the medical employee specialized sites in the United States, the United Kingdom, China, Korea, India, France, Germany and Spain.

name: CELLSEED INC
businessSummary: CellSeed Inc. is mainly engaged in the regenerative medical business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Regenerative Medical Support segment is engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of temperature-responsive cell incubators.
