The Cell Sheet Regeneration Medical segment is involved in the research and development of cell sheet regenerative medical products.

name: STEMRIM INC
businessSummary: StemRIM Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the regenerative medicine business. The Company is engaged in the development and research of medicines based on new action mechanism to promote functional regeneration and healing of biological tissue damaged and lost function due to injury or illness. The Company’s main product is stem cell regeneration-inducing medicine. The stem cell regeneration-inducing medicine is a medicine which can obtain the same therapeutic effect as regenerative medicine only by administering the medicine without using living cells and tissues.

name: SCHOO INC
businessSummary: Schoo Inc is a Japan-based company that develops businesses mainly originating from learning and education. For learners, the Company offers Schoo for Business, a training service for corporations, and Schoo for Personal, a learning service for individuals, while for teachers at institutions of higher education and adult education providers, it offers Schoo Swing, a learning management platform service. Schoo for Business is an online training service for developing autonomous human resources. Schoo for Personal is an online learning service. Schoo Swing is a cloud-based learning management platform service.

name: SYMBIO PHARMACEUTICALS LTD
businessSummary: SymBio Pharmaceuticals Limited is a Japan-based pharmaceutical company. Along with medicine specialists, contract research organizations (CROs) and other pharmaceutical companies, the Company is engaged in the design and operation of clinical tests, the manufacture and sale of new drugs specializing in three therapeutic areas: cancer, blood diseases and autoimmune diseases. The Company develops new medicines using chemical compounds proofed by preclinical tests and clinical tests. The Company manufactures and sells medicines through domestic and foreign pharmaceutical companies. The Company's pipelines include anticancer drugs, such as SyB L-0501, SyB L-1101 and SyB C-1101.

name: SYNSPECTIVE INC
businessSummary: Synspective Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the satellite data business using satellite constellations and data analysis technology. It develops, manufactures and operates synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellites. It operates satellite constellations through the development and manufacture of small SAR satellites and related systems, sells the acquired data, and develops and sells solutions. It has two services. Data sale service sells data acquired from small SAR satellite StriX series. Customers are governments. The demand is for public security, disaster prevention/mitigation, infrastructure/land development and others. Solution provision services include ground movement monitoring, flood damage analysis and other solutions. Customers are governments, and companies involved in non-life insurance, infrastructure development and others, and the Company responds to demand for damage assessments, safety management of equipment and construction, environmental surveys and others.

name: SCIENCE ARTS INC
businessSummary: Science Arts Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and sale of Buddycom, a live communication platform that connects deskless workers. The Company operates through two segments. The Buddycom segment is engaged in the development and sale of Buddycom, a live communication platform that connects deskless workers, and sale of accessories such as earphone microphones and headsets. The ALTIBASE segment is engaged in the sale of licenses and supply of support for ALTIBASE, a hybrid database.

name: KOZO HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: KOZO Holdings Co Ltd, formerly Kozosushi Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the retail business, food and beverage business and distribution business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Retail Business segment is divided into retail business and franchise (FC) business. The retail business sells takeaway sushi. The FC business enters into contracts with franchisees based on a franchise system, provides name recognition and credibility through the use of trademarks, and provides guidance on store construction, product manufacturing, product sales and receives royalty income. The Food and Beverage Business segment operates eat-in style restaurants and FC business. The Distribution Business segment is divided into delivery business and food wholesale business. The delivery business sells home delivery of in-house cooked products. The food wholesale business is engaged in wholesale of commercial food ingredients.

name: CHORDIA THERAPEUTICS INC
businessSummary: Chordia Therapeutics Inc is a Japan-based drug discovery venture company mainly engaged in the research and development of novel anticancer drugs for commercialization. The Company's main business is the research and development of small molecule breakthrough drugs (first-in-class) with novel actions in the field of oncology, where there is a high unmet medical need. The Company concentrates on management and research operations (exploratory, preclinical, and clinical research), particularly in the discovery, evaluation, optimization, and clinical testing of candidate compounds, and outsources basic research, active pharmaceutical ingredient and drug product manufacturing, distribution, and sales to its various external partners to advance its business.

name: BRIGHTPATH BIOTHERAPEUTICS CO LTD
businessSummary: BrightPath Biotherapeutics Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of pharmaceutical products. The Company is a biopharmaceutical venture company focused on developing cancer immunotherapeutic. The Companies business model covers drug discovery research and early clinical development of cancer immunotherapy; conducting of early-phase clinical trials; and development, manufacturing, and launching of the drugs as commercial products in Japan and abroad. The Company also generates the revenues from license fees from the pharmaceutical companies.

name: KUDAN INC
businessSummary: Kudan Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the artificial perception (AP) project. The AP is a technology advocated and developed by the company group. It is a series of software that mathematically processes the data acquired by the camera and three-dimensional (3D) sensor by a computer program, outputs the stereoscopic effect and kinesthetic sense in real time and performs storage and collation. The Company develops AP technology by reconstructing the existing technology called computer vision (a set of basic technologies for sensors and image processing centered on two-dimensional processing) and using it as a foundation.

name: GEEKLY INC
businessSummary: Geekly Inc is a Japan-based company which operates a recruitment agency specializing in the information technology (IT), web, and game industries. The Company operates through a single segment: Recruitment Agency. It provides support to both job seekers and companies seeking candidates, primarily for positions such as engineers, creators, and project managers. It also operates Geekly Media, which publishes information on job changes in the IT industry, career development support, industry trends, technology trends, and company interviews. It also operates Geekly Review, a platform that aggregates reviews and selection experience stories about companies in the IT industry, and provides information on companies and the selection process.

name: QPS HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: QPS Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the earth observation satellite data business. The Company is engaged in the development and manufacture of small synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellites and provides earth observation satellite data and images acquired by these satellites. The Company researches, develops, designs, manufactures, sells, operates, manages, and maintains satellites, onboard equipment, precision instruments, electronic devices, ground facilities, software, and information and communications networks. The Company also plans and manages space technology research groups, workshops, and seminars, and provides satellite-related technical consulting, operational support, contract work, development guidance, lectures, education, and writing services.

name: KIPS CO LTD
businessSummary: Kips Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in venture finance business and event media business. The Company operates in two business segments. In the Venture Finance business segment, the advisor business advises on capital policies of venture companies; the investment business provides investment and advice to venture capital firms. In the Event Media business segment, the event business is responsible for managing events related to support for venture companies in local governments and business companies; in the media business, the company produces articles and publishes advertisements for the monthly information magazine THE INDEPENDENTS published by the company.

name: CHIOME BIOSCIENCE INC
businessSummary: Chiome Bioscience Inc. is a company mainly engaged in the research and development of antibody drugs, and the provision of development support services. The Company operates in two business segments. The Drug Discovery segment is engaged in the research and development of specific antibodies based on new antigens and mechanisms and licensing to pharmaceutical companies. The Drug Discovery Support segment is engaged in development of lead antibodies for therapeutic drugs in collaborating with pharmaceutical companies in Japan and overseas.

name: OPEN DOOR INC
businessSummary: Open Door Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of travel related services. The Company is engaged in the operation of travel products comparison Website TRAVELKO which provides online search, comparison, reservation, inquiry services of package tours, hotels, airline tickets and other travel products for users. The Company is also engaged in the operation of the hotel reservation Website Hoterea for individual customers and the airline tickets reservation Website Traverea, as well as the sale of travel products for corporate customers.

name: ELEMENTS INC
businessSummary: ELEMENTS Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research and development of image recognition engines and data analysis platforms. The Company is engaged in the development and provision of personal authentication solutions such as LIQUID eKYC, an online identity verification service and personal optimization solutions in food, clothing, and housing utilizing biometrics, image analysis, and machine learning technologies. Personal authentication solutions include the biometric authentication business, which develops authentication services using biometric information. Personal optimization solutions include the behavioral analysis business, which develops personal optimization services for offices and residences, and the body shape analysis business, which develops personal optimization services for women's shoes and personal optimization services for clothing, as well as the purchase analysis business, which develops personal optimization services for food retail.

name: EDGE TECHNOLOGY INC
businessSummary: EDGE Technology Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the artificial intelligence (AI) algorithm business. The AI algorithm business provides AI solution services, AI education services, and develops and sells AI products. AI solution services incorporate AI algorithms into existing businesses and systems, and implement and operate them. AI education services include services such as education courses for individuals specializing in AI technology, corporate training, and paid employment agencies specializing in the AI field. AI product service is a service that sells products that implement AI.

name: ABEJA INC
businessSummary: ABEJA Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in digital platform business. The Company operates through the digital platform business. The Company is classified into two main areas base on ABEJA Platform. In the transformation area, introducing the ABEJA Platform and providing professional services that meet the digital transformation needs of companies. In the operation area, various systems built on the ABEJA Platform are provided as general mechanisms and services.

name: ASAKUMA CO LTD
businessSummary: ASAKUMA CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of restaurants. The Company is mainly engaged in the operation of Asakuma and Yappari-Asakuma restaurants which offer steaks and hamburgs. The Asakuma restaurants are mainly engaged in the provision of steaks, hamburgs and salads. The Yappari-Asakuma restaurants are mainly engaged in the provision of steaks and hamburgers as fast food. The Company is also engaged in the operation of various restaurants, including Farmers Garden, Yebisusan, Orandazaka Coffee, Surabaya and Wayang Bali.

name: AXELSPACE HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Axelspace Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of small satellites. The Company operates through two business segments. The AxelLiner Business segment provides development, manufacturing, and operation services for small satellites, as well as commissioned testing and research services related to space development from government agencies. The AxelGlobe Business segment provides image data of the earth's surface obtained from its small satellites, analysis services for that image data, and solution services based on the analysis results.

name: AVILEN INC
businessSummary: AVILEN Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the artificial intelligence (AI) solutions business. The AI Solutions Business segment provides two services: the AI Software Unit and the Build-up Unit. The AI Software Unit supports the implementation of AI and data utilization in business processes by utilizing AVILEN AI, a self-developed technology core module. The Build-up Unit supports organizational assessment, roadmap formulation, and organizational development through cross-functional AI human resource development for management, employees, corporate planning, engineers and others, and provides data and analytics (D&A) strategy consulting as a service that spans both units.

name: ISPACE INC
businessSummary: ispace Inc is primarily engaged in lunar development business. The Company provides payload services, data services, and partnership services using its own landers and rovers. In the payload service, the Company loads the customer's cargo, which is the goods to be transported to the moon, onto the Group's landers and rovers, and provide transportation to the moon. In addition to direct data collection, the data service confirms the customer's need to collect data using the Company's payloads, send the results back to earth as data, analyze them, and utilize them in the next stage of research and development (R&D). The partnership service is a partnership program in which the Company sells a package that includes rights to use the Company group's activities as content, exposure of its logo in advertising media, and data usage rights, and collaborates in technological and business development.

name: CELSYS INC
businessSummary: CELSYS Inc, formerly ArtSpark Holdings Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the business management of subsidiaries that plans, develops, sells, licenses, and maintains and manages computer software and peripherals, as well as related businesses. The Company operates through two segments. The Creator Support segment promotes the research and development and practical application of graphic technology, and expands the product lineup that supports new content production techniques and new devices. The User Interface (UI)/User Experience (UX) segment develops products centered on the in-vehicle software development platform CGI Studio and the UI authoring software group UIConductor, with a focus on the automotive (four-wheel and two-wheel) sector.

name: BROADLEAF CO LTD
businessSummary: Broadleaf Co., Ltd. is engaged in provision of industry-specific business applications through the network, maintenance services and supplies, and various network services on the industrial platform, mainly to the automobile aftermarket industry and other markets. The system sales business develops and sells industry-specific business applications, work analysis and optimization softwares, as well as purchases and sells personal computer (PC) bodies and printers. The system support business provides maintenance services, as well as purchases and sells documents and office automation (OA) supplies. The network service business provides database service, server service, settlement agency service of automobile recycling parts, electronic parts ordering function of automobile parts, support tool of tablet type business, as well as analysis service of ecommerce and data.

name: VALUENEX JAPAN INC
businessSummary: VALUENEX Japan Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in algorithm business. The Company includes ASP service, which provides analysis tool for big data based on algorithm, as well as consulting service and sale of report. The ASP type license service consists of TechRadar Scope, TechRadar Vision and DocRadar. The consulting service includes research consulting and coaching. The research consulting is performed by using TechRadar and DocRadar technology on research and analysis according to customer's request. The coaching is engaged in nurturing human resources for information analysis for customer.

name: TRIAL HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Trial Holdings Inc is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in the distribution and retail business and retail artificial intelligence (AI) business through its subsidiaries. The Company operates through two business segments. The Distribution and Retail segment mainly operates discount stores under the Trial brand that mainly provide daily necessities, home appliances, apparel goods, hobby goods, among others. Store formats include mega center, supercenter (SuC), smart and small store. The Retail Artificial Intelligence (AI) segment mainly provides products and solutions to retailers and food and consumer goods manufacturers that help improve customers' shopping experiences, physical store operations, and the efficiency of advertising and sales promotion activities. The Company also engages in resort-related businesses such as inn facilities and golf course management, as well as construction and real estate management business.

name: DAIFUKU CO LTD
businessSummary: Daifuku Co Ltd is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of material handling systems and equipment, as well as the manufacture and sale of car wash machines, industrial personal computers and interface boards. The Company operates in five business segments. The Daifuku segment manufactures and sells material handling systems and equipment, and car wash machines, and provides after-sales services. The Content segment develops, manufactures, sells, and provides after-sales services for personal computer (PC) peripherals and industrial computer network equipment. The DNA segment manufactures and sells material handling systems and equipment, mainly in North America. The CFI segment manufactures and sells clean room transport systems, mainly to semiconductor manufacturers in South Korea, and provides after-sales services for clean room transport systems, mainly to semiconductor manufacturers in China. The other businesses include after-sales services.

name: ACSL LTD
businessSummary: ACSL Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of industrial flight robot, the order development, production and sale of unmanned systems utilizing drones. With the latest autonomous control technology as the core, The Company promotes the development of application-specific drones through on-site inspections, dialogues, and demonstrations of customers in order to provide drones that substitute and evolve the operations of customers. Proof-of-concept (PoC) services are provided to core clients, mainly large companies, on the premise of providing a one-stop system construction from the examination stage to the actual introduction of drones.

name: GOODSPEED CO LTD
businessSummary: Good Speed Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally involved in the sale of used cars and motorcycles, automobile sales, and related businesses. The Company provides used car sales, car purchasing, maintenance and body repair, insurance agency, rental car, and gas station services. The used car sales business operates MEGA specialty stores for used cars, domestic car specialty stores, and imported car specialty stores. The car acquisition business acquires cars through batch acquisition assessment sites operated by multiple companies. The maintenance and sheet metal business provides services such as the maintenance of sold cars and car inspections. Insurance agency business provides agency service of general insurance companies. The car rental business provides vehicle rental services.

name: GIFT HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: GIFT Holdings Inc, formerly GIFT Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in food business. The Company operates directly managed stores mainly based on Yokohama family ramen, provides food materials and operation skills to producer stores. The directly managed store division consists of the domestic directly operated store business division and overseas directly managed business division. The produce business division concludes a basic transaction contract with the store owner who is going to start a new ramen shop and continuously purchases noodles, sauce, soup and ingredients from the store owner's produced store.

name: RIGAKU HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Rigaku Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in providing analytical solutions centered on X-ray technology for research and development as well as industrial applications. The multi-purpose analytical instruments business develops and sells measurement and analytical instruments that utilize X-ray technology, including X-ray diffraction, X-ray fluorescence analysis, and X-ray transmission (imaging) analysis. The semiconductor process control equipment business provides semiconductor process control equipment used for in-line quality inspection by semiconductor manufacturers and for research and development and quality control by semiconductor equipment manufacturers. The parts and service business provide after-sales services such as sales of consumables and replacement parts, hardware and software upgrades, repairs and inspections, preventive maintenance contracts, and equipment relocation support, as well as elemental parts and other analytical instruments.

name: KOKUSAI ELECTRIC CORP
businessSummary: Kokusai Electric Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of business activities primarily in the manufacturing, sales, and maintenance of semiconductor manufacturing equipment. The Company is engaged in the manufacturing and sales of equipment used in semiconductor manufacturing. The main products include batch film deposition equipment, treatment equipment for film quality improvement, units for measuring instruments and cleaning equipment and others. The Company is also engaged in the provision of after services for semiconductor manufacturing equipment such as sales of consumable parts and other components, new and used equipment, as well as relocation and modification of equipment.

name: HEALIOS KK
businessSummary: Healios KK is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in business in the somatic stem cell regenerative medicine field and in the iPSC regenerative medicine field, which involves research, development and manufacture of regenerative medicine products (iPSC regenerative medicines) utilizing technologies related to induced pluripotent stem cells (iPS cells, iPSCs). The somatic stem cell regenerative medicine field develops and markets cell therapy drugs for acute stroke and acute respiratory distress syndrome using MultiStem, a somatic stem cell product for which the Company holds patent and patent licensing rights. The iPSC regenerative medicines include the creation of universal donor cells (UD), next-generation iPSCs that reduce the risk of immune rejection regardless of human leukocyte antigen (HLA) type using gene editing technology.

name: EAST JAPAN RAILWAY CO
businessSummary: East Japan Railway Co is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the transportation, distribution and services, and real estate and hotel businesses. The Company operates in three business segments. The Transportation segment is involved in passenger transportation, primarily railway services, as well as travel, cleaning and maintenance, station operations, facility maintenance, railway vehicle manufacturing, and railway vehicle maintenance. The Distribution and Services segment is involved in lifestyle services such as retail and food service, wholesale, truck transportation, and advertising agency business. The Real Estate and Hotel segment is involved in lifestyle services such as shopping center operation, office building rental, hotel business, and real estate development and sales for these businesses. The Company also engages in credit card and information processing businesses.

name: G-NEXT INC
businessSummary: G-NEXT Inc provides Discoveriez, a platform for digital transformation (DX) of customer service, mainly in the cloud format for companies of various sizes and industries. The Company operates Customer DX platform business segment. Discoveriez is a software unifying the contents of calls, emails and chats from customers received at the call center, sharing information with stakeholders such as internal departments and outside the Company, approving and recording response processing by workflow, risk management, quality control and new product development information, aggregation and analysis in a cloud format. The Company provides two services, including the cloud business, which provides a versatile platform Discoveriez that sublimates the know-how cultivated through conventional on-premises customer service counters into a cloud type, and the on-premise business, which is an on-premise customer service counter service.

name: NIPPON PROLOGIS REIT INC
businessSummary: Nippon Prologis REIT Inc. is a Japan-based real estate investment trust (REIT). It aims to achieve sustainable growth in asset and stable earnings from mid- to long-term perspectives. The REIT mainly invests in logistic facilities, focusing on A class logistic facilities. Its portfolio included Prologis Park Ichikawa 1, Prologis Park Zama 1 , Prologis Park Kawajima , Prologis Park Osaka 2, Prologis Park Maishima 3 , Prologis Park Kasugai, Prologis Park Maishima 4, Prologis Park Kitanagoya, Prologis Park Tagajo and Prologis Park Takatsuki, among others. The asset manager of the REIT is Prologis REIT Management K.K.

name: MICRONICS JAPAN CO LTD
businessSummary: MICRONICS JAPAN CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of semiconductor measuring instruments, as well as semiconductor and liquid crystal display (LCD) testing equipment. The Company operates in two business segments. The Probe Card segment develops, manufactures and sells semiconductor measuring instruments, and provides related maintenance service. The Testing Equipment (TE) segment develops, manufactures and sells LCD testing equipment and semiconductor testing equipment, and provides related maintenance service.

name: IBIDEN CO LTD
businessSummary: IBIDEN CO., LTD. is primarily engaged in the manufacture of electronic and ceramic products. It operates in two business segments. The Electronics segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of printed circuit boards (PCBs) and package substrates, as well as the design of PCB patterns. The Ceramics segment offers environment related ceramic products, special carbon products, fine ceramic products and ceramic fibers. The others business engages in provision of housing equipment and melamine decorative laminated sheets, design and construction of slopes, garden landscape and various facilities, synthetic plastic processing, agricultural seafood processing, information service business, automobile transportation, oil marketing, business support, investment, financing, and land ownership and management business.

name: ISETAN MITSUKOSHI HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Isetan Mitsukoshi Holdings Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the department store business, credit & finance business/customer organization management business, and real estate business. It operates through three segments. The Department Store Business segment sells clothing, personal items, miscellaneous goods, household goods, and food. The Credit & Finance Business/Customer Organization Management Business segment is involved in credit cards, money lending, non-life insurance agency, life insurance solicitation agency, and customer organization management businesses. The Real Estate Business segment is involved in real estate rental, tenant management, and building interior design. In addition, the Company is also involved in retail, manufacturing/import/export/wholesale, logistics, human resources services, information processing services, media, and travel businesses.

name: NOTE INC
businessSummary: note Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the media platform business and intellectual property (IP) content creation business. The Company has two business segments. The Media Platform Business segment operates the consumer to consumer (CtoC) media platform named note, the software as a service (SaaS) for corporate information dissemination named note pro, and provides corporate-sponsored contests on note, among other corporate services. The IP and Content Creation Business segment is involved in planning and representing creators' works, content production and sales, and contracted planning and content production from external companies.

name: FINATEXT HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Finatext Holdings Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of cloud-based core systems for financial business, and data analysis services. The Company operates through three business segments. The Financial Infrastructure segment is engaged in the provision of core systems required to operate financial services as a cloud-based software as a service (SaaS) type. The FinTech Solutions segment is engaged in the provision of support services for digital transformation and digital marketing for financial institutions. The Big Data Analysis segment is engaged in the promotion of data utilization, and the provision of data analysis services.

name: CREEMA LTD
businessSummary: Creema Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of creator empowerment business. The Company is involved in the operation of customer to customer (CtoC) handmade marketplace Creema. The Company Provides four services. The marketplace service is involved in the online purchase and sale of original handmade works directly. The platform service provides a platform service that provides marketing support for store creators, companies and local public organizations. The event store service provides a handmade marketplace and develops craft events and editorial shops that directly connect creators and users in the real world. The crowdfunding service provides a purchase-type crowdfunding service Creema SPRINGS that specializes in supporting the creative activities of creators of the genre.

name: PHOTOSYNTH INC
businessSummary: Photosynth Inc mainly develops services that utilize Internet of Things (IoT) devices such as smart locks and cloud-type authentication platforms, and provides them through a subscription model. The Company mainly operates Akerun business. The Akerun business develops related services centered on personal authentication and security using edge terminals such as smart locks that connect to the cloud and the Internet for corporations and housing toward the realization of a keyless society. The Akerun business is provided as Hardware Enabled Software as a Service (HESaaS) based on a subscription model, has access authentication platforms and cloud security systems, and owns value as an authentication platform that utilizes the access authentication platform.

name: RESONAC HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Resonac Holdings Corp is a Japan-based comprehensive chemical company. The Company has four business segments. The Semiconductor and Electronic Materials segment provides semiconductor front-end process materials, including high-purity gases and functional chemicals, semiconductor back-end process materials, including epoxy encapsulants and die bonding materials, and device solutions, including hard disks and others. The Mobility segment provides automotive parts, including plastic molded products and friction materials, and lithium-ion battery materials, including aluminum laminate films, conductive additives for positive and negative electrodes. The Innovation Materials segment provides functional chemicals, functional resins, coating materials, ceramics, and aluminum functional components. The Chemical segment provides petrochemicals, chemicals, basic chemicals, graphite electrodes and others, including olefins, organic chemical, industrial gases, liquefied ammonia and others.

name: NEC CORP
businessSummary: NEC Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the information technology (IT) services and social infrastructure businesses. The Company operates through two business segments. The IT Services segment provides system integration (system construction and consulting), support (maintenance), outsourcing and cloud services, and system equipment and software services. The Social Infrastructure segment provides network infrastructure (core networks, cell phone base stations, optical transmission systems, and marine systems), software and services for telecommunications carriers, and system equipment, system integration (system construction and consulting) and support (maintenance) in the aerospace and defense domain.

name: EBARA CORP
businessSummary: Ebara Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in manufacturing, sales, construction, maintenance, and services across the building and industrial, energy, infrastructure, environmental, and precision and electronic industries. The Company operates its business through five segments. The Building & Industrial segment provides standard pumps, chillers, and blowers. The Energy Segment provides custom pumps, compressors and turbines. The Infrastructure segment provides custom pumps and tunnel blowers. The Environment segment provides municipal waste incineration plants, industrial waste incineration plants, and water treatment plants. The Precision and Electronics segment provides vacuum pumps, chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) equipment, plating equipment, and waste gas treatment equipment. The Company also provides business support services.

name: NITORI HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Nitori Holdings Co Ltd is engaged in the sale of furniture and interior goods. The Company operates through two business segments. The Nitori Business segment is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of furniture and interior goods, as well as real estate rental, advertising services and logistics services. The Shimachu Business segment is engaged in the sale of furniture, interior goods and home improvement products.

name: FURUKAWA ELECTRIC CO LTD
businessSummary: Furukawa Electric Co Ltd is a Japa-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of products that develop and apply technologies developed in the infrastructure, electrical & electronics, and functional products businesses. The Company operates four business segments. The Infrastructure segment provides optical fiber, optical fiber cables, metal communication cables, optical related components, and optical semiconductor devices. The Electrical and Electronics segment provides automotive components, batteries, windings, copper and copper alloys, plated products, processed products for electronic components, and specialty metal materials. The Functional Products segment provides cable conduit materials, foam products, tapes for semiconductor manufacturing, electronic components and heat-dissipating products. The Services, Development segment mainly provides hydroelectric power generation, new product research and development, and real estate leasing.

name: RECRUIT HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Recruit Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in human resources (HR) technology business, matching & solutions business, and staffing business. The Company operates through three segments. The HR Technology segment provides job advertisements and recruitment solution services globally through online job matching platforms such as Indeed and Glassdoor. The Matching & Solutions segment operates mainly in Japan and consists of the human resources field and sales promotion field. The human resources field provides support services for individual users' job search activities and corporate clients' recruitment activities. The sales promotion field operates a vertical matching platform for each business field that connects individual users with corporate clients, and software as a service (SaaS) for corporate clients. The Staffing segment provides temporary staffing services such as clerical staffing, manufacturing work and light work staffing, and professional staffing.

name: PASSLOGY CO LTD
businessSummary: Passlogy Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in development and sale of authentication security software which based on identity authentication technology. The Company is mainly engaged in own product development business. PassLogic is an authentication security software for enterprises and organizations that has been commercialized as an authentication system using the pass logic method of the its own authentication technology. It provides PassLogic products to customers mainly through distributors and service providers.

name: INFOMART CORP
businessSummary: Infomart Corporation is a Japan-based company principally involved in the business to business (BtoB) electronic commerce (e-commerce) business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Order Receiving segment provides ordering and ordering of B to B platform for streamlining daily ordering and receiving work. The Standards segment provides BtoB Platform Specifications to promote the creation of a framework for food safety and security. The E-Commerce Service (ES) segment provides BtoB Platform Invoice to realize paperless by electronic conversion of intercompany invoices and BtoB Platform negotiations to improve efficiency of business negotiation as a purchasing sales tool. The Company is also engaged in the provision of menu (recipe) development services and research & promotion services for the domestic food industry.

name: BROAD ENTERPRISE CO LTD
businessSummary: Broad Enterprise Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of Internet services mainly to apartment complexes built and managed by condominium owners, property management companies, and house builders. The Company provides a comprehensive range of Internet services under the brand name B-CUBIC, from installation of Internet systems for laying optical fiber lines in apartment complexes to maintenance and servicing of the Internet connection environment after the Internet system has been installed. Condominium owners, property management companies, and house builders have a need to increase the added value of their properties as a means of improving occupancy rates, and in order to meet this need, the Internet of Things (IoT) product BRO-CUBIC will be offered along with the IoT intercom system BRO-LOCK with face recognition.

name: ASICS CORP
businessSummary: ASICS Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of sports products, such as sports shoes, sportswear, sports equipment and others. The Company operates through six business segments. The Japan Region, Americas Region, Europe Region (including the Middle East and Africa), Oceania/Southeast and South Asia Region, and the East Asia Region segment mainly sell sporting goods. The Others segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of HAGLOFS brand outdoor products.

name: GIFTEE INC
businessSummary: Giftee Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in e-gift platform business. It generates, distributes, and sells e-gifts that can be sent and used online via smartphones and other devices. The Company mainly offers four services. The giftee service allows individuals to send gifts via email or social networking services (SNS). The giftee for Business service provides e-gifts and distribution tools to corporations and other organizations. The eGift System service provides a software-as-a-service (SaaS) system that enables corporations to generate, distribute, sell, settle, and manage performance of e-gifts. The local currency service provides a solution that enables the circulation of currency and gift certificates that can only be used in specific regions, which were previously issued on paper or cards, via smartphones. The Company also provides the YouGotaGift.com Ltd. service, the Sow Experience service, and other services.

name: SHISEIDO CO LTD
businessSummary: Shiseido Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of cosmetics, toiletries, personal care products, barber and beauty products. The Company operates through six business segments. The Japan segment is engaged in the sale of cosmetics, fragrance, toiletries, personal care products, beauty food and over-the-counter drugs in Japan. China segment and Asia Pacific segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cosmetics, toiletries and personal care products respectively in China and Asia-Oceania other region. Americas segment and Europe segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cosmetics and toiletries respectively in the Americas, as well as Europe, the Middle East and Africa. Travel Retail segment is engaged in the sale of cosmetics and toiletries in duty free shops around the world. The Company also conducts manufacturing businesses and food and beverage businesses.

name: MINKABU THE INFONOID INC
businessSummary: MINKABU THE INFONOID,Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in media business and solutions business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Media business segment includes revenue from information media for investors such as https://minkabu.jp/, https://kabutan.jp/ (Kabutan) and the like obtained from The Company and the services that The Company plays a part of the site management through business alliance, and part Record billing revenue from paid services offered at the site. In the solution business segment, the Company provides information-based FinTech solutions that processed content generated using artificial intelligence (AI) for investor information media managed by The Company and cloud input data collected on the site. It records revenue from application service provider (ASP) service to be provided to third parties, software development work accompanying them and maintenance and operation work.

name: PEPTIDREAM INC
businessSummary: PeptiDream Inc. is a Japan-based bio-venture company started by the University of Tokyo and principally engaged in the discovery and development of non-standard peptide therapeutics. The Company operates the Peptide Discovery Platform System (PDPS), a drug development platform system and conducts research and development (R&D) on new drug candidates based on the joint R&D with pharmaceutical companies in Japan and overseas. The Company is involved in the business centered on drug development based on special peptides. The Company's businesses include drug discovery joint R&D, PDPS technology loan (PDPS technology license) and expansion of its own pipeline through strategic alliance (strategic alliance or in-house drug discovery).

name: TOHO TITANIUM CO LTD
businessSummary: Toho Titanium Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in titanium metal business, as well as the manufacture and sale of catalyst products such as propylene polymerization catalysts, and electronic component materials such as ultrafine nickel powder. The Company operates through three segments. The Titanium Metal segment produces titanium sponge, titanium ingots, high-purity titanium, and titanium processed products. The Catalyst segment produces propylene polymerization catalysts. The Chemicals segment produces electronic component materials such as ultrafine nickel powder and high-purity titanium oxide.

name: ORACLE CORP JAPAN
businessSummary: Oracle Corp Japan is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of software including database, middleware and application, hardware including servers, storage and network equipment, the provision of cloud services and the support for product introduction and use. The Company operates in three business segments. The Cloud & License segment is engaged in the sale of database management software, middleware, application software used in corporate activities, and the provision of services for these software and hardware through the Internet, as well as the provision of software license renewal rights and technical support. The Hardware Systems segment is engaged in the sale of servers, storage, engineered systems, network equipment, as well as the provision of technical support, repair service and maintenance for hardware products. The Service segment provides consulting services, advanced customer support services.

name: TIMEE INC
businessSummary: Timee Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the plan, development and operation of applications. The product is Timee, which is a part-time job application connects people who want to work in their spare time with stores and companies that want immediate manpower.

name: SUMITOMO REALTY & DEVELOPMENT CO LTD
businessSummary: Sumitomo Realty & Development Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in businesses related to real estate. The Company operates its business through five business segments. The Real Estate Leasing segment leases and manages office buildings and condominiums, and operates and manages hotels, event halls, and commercial facilities. The Real Estate Sales segment sells condominiums and detached houses. The Construction Completion segment is engaged in contracting for construction and renovation of detached houses and condominiums. The Real Estate for Sales segment engages in real estate brokerage and sales agency services. The Others segment is engaged in the fitness club business, restaurant business.

name: ANICOM HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Anicom Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of non-life insurance, pet Internet services, veterinary clinic management, and health innovation businesses. The Company has four business segments. The Non-life Insurance Business segment includes pet insurance and pet liability insurance. The Pet Internet Services Business segment operates breeder matching sites and foster parent matching sites for adoptions. The Veterinary Clinic Management Business segment operates veterinary clinics. The Health Innovation Business segment promotes animal health checks and develops and sells oral and intestinal care products based on various tests. The Company also provides veterinary clinic support, insurance agency services, and genetic testing.

name: YUKIGUNI FACTORY CO LTD
businessSummary: Yukiguni Factory Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the production and sale of mushrooms and processed mushroom foods, including maitake mushrooms, eringi mushrooms, buna shimeji mushrooms, mushrooms, hon shimeji mushrooms, and hatake shimeji mushrooms. The Company operates its business through the Mushrooms business segment. The Mushrooms business segment is engaged in the production and sale of mushroom products such as maitake mushrooms, eringi mushrooms, and bunashimeji mushrooms. Other businesses include the outsourced production and sale of health food products, operation of a product store, and the sale of culture medium activator.

name: MCDONALD'S HOLDINGS COMPANY JAPAN LTD
businessSummary: McDonald's Holdings Company Japan Ltd is a Japan-based holding company engaged in the operation of hamburger restaurants business through its subsidiaries and affiliated companies. The Company's main business is formulating and executing consolidated management strategies for group companies and real estate rental. Through its affiliates, the Company operates hamburger restaurant business through franchisees as well as directly managed stores. The Company pays royalties on licenses. In Japan, the Company grants sub-licenses of know-how and trademarks to franchisees who operate franchise stores, and receives royalties from the franchisees.

name: JCR PHARMACEUTICALS CO LTD
businessSummary: JCR Pharmaceuticals Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the pharmaceutical business. It manufactures, purchases, and sells prescription drugs, regenerative medicine products, and pharmaceutical raw materials. Through its subsidiaries, it is also engaged in purchasing business, procurement and sales of medical and research equipment, facility management, market research, management and supervision of outsourced clinical trial operations, management of intellectual property and licensing, clinical operations, regulatory affairs, and development in Brazil and Europe, and distribution management of pharmaceuticals and their raw materials.

name: MONEY FORWARD INC
businessSummary: Money Forward,Inc. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the platform service business. The Company provides two services. The money forward cloud service is involved in the provision of a cloud enterprise resources planning (ERP) service platform. The platform provides management support for medium-sized and small enterprises to improve efficiency of management and back office operations based on data. The personal financial management (PFM) service is involved in the operation of Money Forward ME platform for solving problems and issues related to personal money through various services.

name: RAKSUL INC
businessSummary: Raksul Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of support platforms for companies and sole proprietors. The Company operates through four business segments. The Raksul segment operates Raksul, a sharing platform for printing and customer-attraction support. It develops and provides a system for collecting printing orders from customers nationwide via the Internet, placing those orders with printing companies and printing during non-operating hours of the printing presses. The Novasell business operates the television (TV) advertising platform Novasell. The Hacobell business operates Hacobell, a logistics platform. The Josys business is a one-stop corporate information technology (IT) platform for operations from hardware procurement to storage and kitting as well as software management.

name: AMIYA CORP
businessSummary: Amiya Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the data security business and network security business. The Company operates two business segments. The Data Security segment is involved in the development, sale and maintenance of log management software products, as well as the construction, auditing and operation support of information security management systems. The Network Security segment is involved in the consulting, design, construction and operation agency of network security systems, as well as the development and sale of cloud network services. The segment is also involved in the sale and rental of network equipment to build network security systems and provide services.

name: ZOZO INC
businessSummary: ZOZO Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged mainly in the operation of the fashion e-commerce site ZOZOTOWN and the fashion media site WEAR. The ZOZOTOWN business consists of purchase and manufacturing sales, consignment sales, and USED sales. USED sales is a secondary distribution business that buys used fashion merchandise, mainly from individual users and sells it while maintaining its own inventory. LINE Yahoo Commerce business sells products through online shopping malls and online auction services. The business-to-business (BtoB) business provides services to support various fulfillment-related operations, including e-commerce site system development, design production, logistics contracting, and marketing support. The advertising business provides advertising space by utilizing the user reach base of ZOZOTOWN and WEAR. The Company also operates businesses related to shipping and settlement fee revenues.

name: TRIPLA CO LTD
businessSummary: Tripla Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the hospitality solution business. The Company provides information technology (IT) services for accommodation facilities including tripla Book, tripla Bot, tripla Connect, and tripla Pay. tripla Book is a cloud-based official Website reservation system for accommodation facilities. tripla Bot is a service that displays a chatbot on the official Website of accommodation facilities, and automatically answers questions from users (guests) using artificial intelligence (AI) developed in-house. tripla Connect is a customer relationship management (CRM) and marketing automation (MA) tool specialized for accommodation facilities. tripla Pay is a service that provides a local payment system specifically for accommodation facilities.

name: TERUMO CORP
businessSummary: Terumo Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of medical devices and pharmaceuticals. The Company operates in three segments. The Cardiovascular Company segment provides guidewires for angiography, catheters for angiography, introducer sheaths, coils, stents and bag embolization devices for treatment of cerebral aneurysms, artificial lungs and artificial heart-lung machines. The Medical Care Solutions Company segment provides hospital care solutions, life care solutions, and pharmaceutical solutions. The Blood and Cell Technology Company segment provides blood bags, component blood collection systems, automated blood product systems, pathogen reduction systems, and centrifugal blood component separators.

name: ASTROSCALE HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Astroscale Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in research and development of technologies related to on-orbit services such as debris removal, and in-space demonstrations. The Company provides four services, including end-of-life (EOL) service, active debris removal (ADR) service, life extension (LEX) service, and in-situ space situational awareness (ISSA) service. EOL service is a removal service to prevent satellites that have finished operating from becoming debris. ADR service is a service to remove existing debris by launching a servicer of the Company's group, capturing the existing debris, descending its orbit, and burning it in the atmosphere. LEX service is a service to extend the operational period of a satellite or to transfer it to another orbit. ISSA service launches observation satellites, safely approaches objects at close range, and acquires data on the target object, which can be used to analyze the cause of failures and to understand the target object.

name: PAN PACIFIC INTERNATIONAL HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Pan Pacific International Holdings Corporation, formerly Don Quijote Holdings Co.,Ltd., is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the retail business and tenant leasing business. The Company has two business segments. The Retail segment is engaged in the retail sale of household appliances, daily commodities, food, watch and fashion supplies, sports and leisure goods and do it yourself (DIY) products, as well as the operation of big convenience and discount store under the name Don Quijote, family discount store under the name MEGA Don Quijote, comprehensive supermarket under the name Nagasakiya and the home center under the name Doit. The Tenant Leasing segment is engaged in the attract and manage tenant of commercial facilities. The Company is also involved in the real estate related business, the marketing business and the financial services business.

name: SMS CO LTD
businessSummary: SMS Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in developing and operating diverse information services in fields of nursing care, medical, career and healthcare. The Company operates the building information infrastructure suited to an aging society and related services business segment. The career division provides services including job placement for nursing care professionals, qualification schools, direct recruiting, job placement for nurses and job placement for childcare workers. The nursing care and disability welfare division operates management support platforms for nursing care and disability welfare service providers. The overseas division develops businesses including medical platforms and global career services. The business development division offers services including remote health guidance for health insurance associations, remote occupational health services for companies, information services for home renovation contractors and funeral company referral services.

name: JAPAN ELEVATOR SERVICE HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: JAPAN ELEVATOR SERVICE HOLDINGS CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of the maintenance and inspection service for elevators and escalators, as well as the renewal service for elevators. The Company operates three kind of businesses. The maintenance and inspection business is involved in the provision of maintenance, inspection, replace and repair services for the engine performance and the operation safety of elevators and escalators. The renewal business is involved in the provision of a full range of main components’ replacing service, the removal service of products already in the field, as well as the new setting service for elevators which are installed 20 years ago. The others business is involved in the sale of parts for elevator’s maintenance.

name: RAKUTEN BANK LTD
businessSummary: Rakuten Bank Ltd is a Japan-based bank mainly engaged in the provision of online banking service. The Company is an Internet bank that provides banking services over the Internet without physical branches. The Company utilizes the Internet to provide services to both individual and corporate customers. In the individual business, the Company provides services related to personal life, including receipt of salary and bonuses; account transfers for utility bills such as electricity, gas, and water; cell phone bills; credit card usage fees, and repayment of loans; transfers to make various payments; money transfers; overseas remittances; and asset management. In the corporate business, the Company uses technology to provide banking services, including loans, deposits, and foreign exchange, tailored to customer needs. It also operates businesses related to the trust business and other businesses.

name: GMO INTERNET GROUP INC
businessSummary: GMO Internet Group Inc, formerly GMO Internet Inc, is engaged in Internet infrastructure business, Internet advertising and media business, Internet finance business, crypto asset business and incubation business. The Company operates through five segments. The Internet Infrastructure segment is engaged in domain business, cloud hosting business, electronic commerce (EC) support business, security business, and access business. The Internet Advertising and Media segment is engaged in Internet advertising business, Internet media business, and Internet research business. The Internet Finance segment provides financial instruments trading services such as online securities trading services and foreign exchange margin trading services. The Crypto Asset segment is engaged in the business related to crypto asset exchange and mining. The Incubation segment invests in unlisted companies, mainly Internet-related companies. The Company is also engaged in the mobile entertainment business.

name: RENESAS ELECTRONICS CORP
businessSummary: Renesas Electronics Corp is a Japan-based semiconductor manufacturer mainly engaged in the research, design, development, manufacture, sale and servicing of semiconductor products. The Company operates in two business segments. The Automotive segment is engaged in vehicle control business which provides semiconductors for controlling the engine and body of automobiles, and vehicle information business which provides semiconductors for in-vehicle information devices such as car navigation systems. The segment mainly provides microcontrollers, system-on-chip (SoC), analog semiconductors and power semiconductors. The Industry, Infrastructure and Internet of Things (IoT) segment is engaged in the industry business that supports the smart society, the infrastructure business and IoT business. The segment mainly provides microcontrollers, SoCs and analog semiconductors. The Company is also engaged in the development and contracted production of semiconductors.

name: SANSAN INC
businessSummary: Sansan Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and sales of digital transformation (DX) services that change the way people work. The Company operates through two business segments. The Sansan/Bill One Business segment is engaged in the provision of the sales DX service Sansan and the accounting DX service Bill One. The Eight Business segment is engaged in the provision of the business card app Eight and the event transcription service logmi series.

name: FREEE KK
businessSummary: freee KK is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and provision of software as a service (SaaS) services to improve the back-office productivity of small businesses. Freee accounting is an integrated cloud accounting software for sole proprietors and corporations. Freee human resource management is an integrated cloud human resource management software for corporate clients. Freee sales is integrated cloud sales management software for sole proprietors and corporations. Freee tax return is a cloud-based tax filing software that seamlessly integrates with freee accounting and is offered to accounting firms and small corporations. Freee sign is an electronic contract service offered to sole proprietors and corporations. In addition, the Company offers freee card and freee card Unlimited as financial services designed to improve the cash flow of small businesses.

name: WELBE INC
businessSummary: Welbe, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in provision of disability welfare services. The employment transition support business provides employment training, including preparation and correction of application forms, mock interview and practical training in workplace. The business also provides specific consultation support and independence training for people with disabilities. The rehabilitation business provides instruction for growth and development for pre-school children with developmental disorders and lesson support for primary school students, junior high school students, and high school students after school classes and during long vacation.

name: KAWASAKI HEAVY INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: Kawasaki Heavy Industries Ltd is general engineering manufacturer. The Company operates in six business segments. The Aerospace Systems segment manufactures and sells aircraft, aircraft engines, and space-related equipment. The Rolling Stock segment manufactures and sells rolling stock, snow removal equipment, and other products. The Energy Solution & Marine segment manufactures and sells energy-related equipment and systems, hydrogen-related equipment, marine propulsion-related equipment and systems, plant-related equipment and systems, ships, and crushers. The Precision Machinery & Robotics segment manufactures and sells hydraulic equipment, industrial robots, and other products. The Powersports & Engines Segment manufactures and sells motorcycles, off-road vehicles (SxS, ATV), personal watercraft (PWC) jet ski, general-purpose gasoline engines, and other products. The Others segment is engaged in commerce, sales and order brokerage, and management of welfare facilities.

name: MERCARI INC
businessSummary: Mercari Inc is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the operation of consumer-to-consumer (CtoC) platforms. The Company operates through two segments. The Japan Region segment operates Marketplace, which operates the Mercari flea market app in Japan, as well as payment and finance and cryptocurrency-related businesses in Japan. The US segment operates the Mercari flea market app in the United States. The Company also engages in sports business and other businesses.

name: HENNGE KK
businessSummary: Hennge KK is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of services to customers mainly in the form of software as a service (SaaS). The HENNGE One business develops HENNGE One, which reduces security risks without compromising the convenience of cloud services for companies that introduce cloud services to improve business efficiency. The Professional Services and Others business develops email delivery package software that delivers large volumes of email securely at high speed. The Customers Mail Cloud is a cloud-based email delivery service that delivers large volumes of email at high speed to mobile phones, personal computers (PCs), and smartphones.

name: MEDLEY INC
businessSummary: Medley Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the development and provision of various Internet services in the medical healthcare field. It operates through three business segments. Human Resources Platform Business segment operates and provides JobMedley, a performance-based recruitment system; Guppy, a pay-per-view recruitment system and JobMedley Academy, an online training service for the nursing care field. Medical Platform Business segment operates and provides CLINICS, a cloud-based medical support system; Pharms, a family pharmacy support system; MEDLEY, a medical information service; MALL, an electronic medical record system for hospitals; Dentis, a cloud-based dental business support system and @link, a reservation system for hospitals and clinics with beds. New Services segment operates and provides the Kaigo-no-Honne, a nursing care facility search site for those looking for nursing care facilities and Medley Soki Shikin Support.

name: INFORICH INC
businessSummary: Inforich Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of a charger rental service for smartphones. The mobile battery sharing service ChargeSPOT is based on the concept of being able to borrow and return anywhere. Battery stands installed mainly in urban areas, such as stations, entertainment facilities, convenience stores, and restaurants. Overseas, The Company also develops the ChargeSPOT business in Hong Kong, Taiwan, mainland China, and Thailand. The mobile battery rented out at ChargeSPOT is an independently developed product.

name: OKAMURA FOODS CO LTD
businessSummary: Okamura Foods Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the salmon aquaculture business, processing business (domestic and overseas processing), and overseas wholesale business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Aquaculture Business segment is engaged in the farming and sale of adult salmon in Aomori and Denmark. The Domestic Processing Business segment is engaged in the processing and sales of fish egg products such as sardines and salmon roe at domestic factories. The Overseas Processing Business segment is engaged in processing and sales of seafood such as salmon and mackerel at overseas factories. The Overseas Wholesale Business segment is engaged in the overseas wholesale of Japanese food products, including seafood.

name: LIBERAWARE CO LTD
businessSummary: Liberaware Co Ltd is a Japan-based company that mainly provides digital transformation (DX) solutions for infrastructure facilities and equipment using hardware technology centered on drones and software technology for processing, processing, and managing captured images and video. The Company operates its business through infrastructure DX business segment. The Drone business provides data that contributes to surveying, inspecting, and measuring infrastructure and plants using drones, and manufactures and sells drones. The Digital Twin business constructs and provides digital images, three dimensions (3D) data, and information that contributes to the detection of abnormalities, using image processing technology for data acquired by drones. The Solution Development business develops new solutions based on its technological capabilities and know-how.

name: TREND MICRO INC
businessSummary: Trend Micro Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, sales and provision of computer security products and related services. The Company operates through four geographic segments: Japan, North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. Solutions include cyber risk management, cloud-native application protection, protection of hybrid cloud environments and others. Platforms include enterprise cybersecurity platforms, cloud security, endpoint security, network security and others. Services include incident response services and others.

name: LIGHTWORKS CORP
businessSummary: Lightworks Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the human capital management (HCM) cloud service business. The Company is engaged in the provision of HCM platform provision service and online English conversation service utilizing HCM cloud. The HCM platform provision service operates CAREER SHIP, a human resources development platform, by providing HCM solutions for enterprises and education fields as cloud services. The online English conversation service utilizing HCM cloud provides online English conversation under the OLECO brand in the cloud as content that can effectively utilize the learning management platform provided for cram schools.

name: VELTRA CORP
businessSummary: VELTRA Corporation is engaged in the operation of domestic and overseas experienced optional tour online reservation site VELTRA. The Company operates travel related business that manages the travel online service of the local experience tours. The Company mainly operates three departments. The overseas travel department provides services mainly for Japanese overseas trips. The inbound department provides services for visitors to Japan. The global department provides services all over the world for global travelers. VELTRA operated by the Company operates websites that correspond to four languages, including Japanese, English, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional) and Korean, and the sites of the local experience tour corresponds to all over the world. The Company contracts directly with domestic and overseas operating companies and offers services in various lineups including sightseeing tours, cultural experiences, gourmet tours, shows, museums, cruises, restaurants and others.

name: GMO PAYMENT GATEWAY INC
businessSummary: GMO Payment Gateway, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of payment agency services, finance related services and payment activation services. The Company operates in three business segments. The Payment Agency segment is engaged in the provision of online and continuous payment agency services and face-to-face payment agency services. The Finance Related segment is engaged in the provision of payment, remittance services and other money services, the provision of transaction lending to finance growth funds, as well as the provision of early payment services to improve the cash flow of member stores. The Payment Activation segment is engaged in the provision of mobile payment, authentication, notification and other services, as well as the provision of customer collection support services to improve sales of member stores.

name: ROBOT PAYMENT INC
businessSummary: Robot Payment Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of Internet payment agency services. The Company operates in two business segments. The Payment segment is engaged in the provision of Internet payment services mainly for electronic commerce (EC) of business-to-consumer (BtoC) businesses, and business-to-business (BtoB) businesses. The Financial Cloud segment is engaged in the provision of cloud services that streamline and automate billing, collection, application and reminder operations for BtoB and BtoC businesses.

name: NIPPON SANSO HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Nippon Sanso Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of gas and related equipment. The Company operates in five segments which are Japan Gas segment, the United States Gas segment, the Europe Gas segment, the Asia and Oceania Gas segment, and the Thermos segment. The Company provides gas products, including oxygen, nitrogen, argon, carbon dioxide, helium, hydrogen, acetylene, medical gas, liquefied petroleum (LP) gas and special gas; equipment and materials, including electronic related equipment, fusing equipment, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, welding materials, medical equipment, air separation equipment; the assembling, processing, inspection and maintenance of electronic components; and stainless steel thermos bottles.

name: IHI CORP
businessSummary: IHI Corp is engaged in the resources, energy and environment, social infrastructure, industrial systems and general machinery, and aerospace and defense. The Company operates in four business segments. Resource & Energy & Environment segment provides land-use prime mover plants, marine engines and other prime movers, carbon solutions, and nuclear power equipment. Social Infrastructure segment provides bridges and sluices, transportation systems, shield systems, concrete construction materials, and urban development. Industrial System & General-Purpose Machinery segment provides vehicle turbochargers, parking, rotating machinery, heat and surface treatment, material handling equipment, and logistics and industrial systems machinery. Aerospace & Space & Defense segment provides aero engines, rocket systems and space applications, and defense equipment systems. The Company also provides services for equipment and devices for communications, electronics, electrical measurement.

name: JAPAN EXCHANGE GROUP INC
businessSummary: Japan Exchange Group Inc is a Japan-based financial instruments exchange holding company that lists securities and derivatives, provides trading venues, clearing and settlement services, and index and information services. The Company operates through the Financial Instruments Exchange Business segment. The spot market is centered on the stock market. The derivatives market offers trading of index futures, index options, government bond futures, government bond futures options, securities options, and commodity futures. Trading systems include arrowhead for the spot market and J-GATE for the derivatives market. Information services provide real-time information on securities trading and derivatives transactions, such as contract prices, as they occur and change, as well as index information calculated based on stock price information and various statistical information, to market participants such as trading participants and information vendors.

name: HITACHI LTD
businessSummary: Hitachi Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacturing and sales of products and provision of services. The Company has five business segments. Digital Systems & Services segment provides services such as system integration, consulting and cloud services, information technology (IT) products and software and automated teller machines (ATMs). Green Energy & Mobility segment provides power grids, renewable energy, nuclear power and rail systems. Connective Industries segment provides elevators and escalators, home appliances and air conditioning, measurement and analysis systems for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and medical analysis equipment, industrial and distribution solutions, water and environmental solutions, and industrial equipment. Automotive Systems segment offers powertrain, chassis, advanced driver assistance and systems for two-wheelers. The Others segment is engaged in the management, sale and rental of real estate.

name: KIOXIA HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Kioxia Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale, research and development, and other services of memory and related products. The business is classified into solid state drive (SSD) & storage, smart devices, and other by application based on the use of the products. SSD & storage includes SSD products and memory products mainly for personal computers (PCs), data centers, and enterprises. Smart devices include embedded memory products with control functions used in consumer devices such as smartphones, tablets, and televisions, as well as in-vehicle and industrial applications. Others include retail products such as SD memory cards and universal serial bus (USB) memory.

name: THECOO INC
businessSummary: Thecoo Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the fan community platform management business, the influencer marketing business and the online advertising business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Fanicon segment is engaged in the distribution, operation and management of fan community application platform Fanicon for general users. The Corporate Sales segment is engaged in the influencer sales business, the online advertising business, and the online marketing consulting business.

name: ADR ON ROBOT CONSULTING CO LTD
businessSummary: Robot Consulting Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of platform service focusing on human resource solutions with an intention to expand into legal technology and the metaverse. The Company’s major product is Labor Robot, a cloud-based human resource management system that helps users track employee attendance and sales orders and journalize accounting items. The Company provides the information relating to grant applications with Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (MHLW), which provides grants to small and medium-sized businesses to enhance their working conditions and employee welfare. The Company also supports users who want to apply for a subsidy with Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) for the information technology(IT) system installation subsidy by connecting users interested in applying for a subsidy with partners specializing in subsidy applications.

name: JAPAN DISPLAY INC
businessSummary: Japan Display Inc. is engaged in the development, design, manufacture and sale of small and medium-size displays and related products.
