Its Printcraft segment is a manufacturer of greetings cards and personalized gifts and sells its output intra-group to stores and online businesses. The Company’s subsidiaries include Sportswift Limited, Printcraft Limited, Getting Personal Limited, and others.

name: CREIGHTONS PLC
businessSummary: Creightons Plc is engaged in the development, marketing, manufacture and supply of personal care, beauty and fragrance products, which includes the development of brands. The beauty products sector offers products for haircare, skincare, bath & body, male grooming and fine fragrances. Its operations are organized into three business streams: own branded business, private label business and contract manufacturing business. Its own branded business develops, markets, sells and distributes products developed and owns the rights to or brands it has licensed. The brands in the branded business include Feather and Down, Balance Active, The Curl Company, Emma Hardie and T-Zone. The private label business focuses on private-label products for high street retailers and supermarket chains, with most of the stock manufactured to forecast. Its contract manufacturing business develops and manufactures products on behalf of third-party brand owners and are typically manufactured to order.

name: FIRSTGROUP PLC
businessSummary: FirstGroup plc is a private sector provider of public transport services. The Company's divisions include First Bus and First Rail. First Bus is a bus operator in the United Kingdom with a fleet of approximately 3,000 buses and coaches. It provides tendered bus services for local authorities and is an operator in the majority of its local areas, including major urban centers such as Glasgow, Bristol and Leeds. Its adjacent services business provides a range of bus and coach services, including schools, private tour operators, airports and airlines, and distribution centers. First Rail is a rail operator which operates a fleet of approximately 1,800 locomotives and rail carriages through two DfT contracted train operating companies: West Coast Partnership (WCP), (incorporating Avanti West Coast and West Coast Partnership Development) and Great Western Railway (GWR), and two open access routes (Hull Trains and Lumo). The Company also has sightseeing bus operations.

name: SEVERFIELD PLC
businessSummary: Severfield plc is a United Kingdom-based structural steel company that offers various products, such as severstor, modular frames, seversafe, fabsec, rotoflo, siloflo, pressure relief valve and bin activators. The Company's services include design, manufacturing, fabrication, delivery, construction and project management. Its segments include Core Construction Operations and Modular Solutions. Its Commercial & Industrial division designs, fabricates and constructs structural steelwork for various sectors, including commercial offices, stadia & leisure, industrial & distribution, data centers, retail and health and education. The Modular Solutions division consists of the modular product ranges of Severfield Modular Solutions, Construction Metal Forming, and its cold rolled steel joint venture business. Its projects include Stadia & Leisure, Industrial, Bridges, Transport Infrastructure, Nuclear, Commercial, Education, Power and Energy, and Distribution.

name: NWF GROUP PLC
businessSummary: NWF Group plc is a United Kingdom-based specialist distributor of fuel, food, and feed across the United Kingdom. The principal activities of the Company and its subsidiaries are the sale and distribution of fuel oils, the warehousing and distribution of ambient groceries and the manufacture and sale of animal feeds. The Company's segments include Fuels, Food, and Feeds. The Fuels segment is engaged in the sale and distribution of domestic heating, industrial and road fuels. The Food segment is engaged in the warehousing and distribution of clients' ambient grocery and other products to supermarkets and other retail distribution centers. The Feeds segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of animal feeds and other agricultural products. The Company operates through its subsidiaries, which include NWF Distribution Holdings Limited, NWF Agriculture Holdings Limited, NWF Fuels Holdings Limited, New Breed (UK) Limited, and others.

name: VAN ELLE HOLDINGS PLC
businessSummary: Van Elle Holdings plc is a geotechnical contractor. The Company provides a range of ground engineering techniques and services, including ground investigation, general and specialist piling, rail geotechnical engineering, modular foundations, and ground improvement and stabilization services. Its segments include General Piling, Specialist Piling and Rail, and Ground Engineering Services. The General Piling segment provides ground engineering and foundation solutions on open site construction projects. Ground Engineering Services offers a range of ground investigation services and modular foundation systems for residential solutions, as well as precast concrete modular foundation solutions such as Smartfoot. Its Specialist Piling and Rail segment provides a range of piling and geotechnical solutions in operationally challenging environments. It serves diverse end markets including residential and housing, infrastructure and regional construction.

name: HENRY BOOT PLC PREFERRED
businessSummary: Henry Boot PLC is a United Kingdom-based company, which is engaged in land promotion, property investment and development. Its segments include Property investment and development, Home building, and Land promotion. The Company's property investment and development activities include property investment, property development, housebuilding and associated trading activities. Its land promotion segment includes land management, development and trading activities. The Company operates within three key markets: industrial and logistics, residential and urban development. Its primary subsidiaries include Hallam Land Management Limited, Henry Boot Developments Limited, Stonebridge Homes Limited and Banner Plant Limited.

name: HENRY BOOT PLC
businessSummary: Henry Boot PLC is a United Kingdom-based company, which is engaged in land promotion, property investment and development. Its segments include Property investment and development, Home building, and Land promotion. The Company's property investment and development activities include property investment, property development, housebuilding and associated trading activities. Its land promotion segment includes land management, development and trading activities. The Company operates within three key markets: industrial and logistics, residential and urban development. Its primary subsidiaries include Hallam Land Management Limited, Henry Boot Developments Limited, Stonebridge Homes Limited and Banner Plant Limited.

name: HEAVITREE BREWERY PLC PREFERRED
businessSummary: The Heavitree Brewery PLC is a United Kingdom-based independent, family-owned tenanted and leased pub company. The Company operates through its leased estates segment. Its business is engaged in the running and development of a leased and tenanted estate in the southwest of England. It operates approximately 64 leased and tenanted public houses along with non-core assets and a dormant managed estate. Its geographical segments include the United Kingdom and the United States. It provides facilities, including a beer garden/outside area, children's play area, parking, and accommodation. It owns over 50 pubs concentrated mainly in the Exeter and South Devon area. The Company's pubs include Anchor Inn, The Ashcott, The Atmospheric Railway, The Beach, Bell Inn, Brunswick Arms, Church House Inn, Claycutter's Arms, Court Farm Inn, The Cleave, The Clifton, The Cricket Inn, The Exeter Inn, The Green Dragon, Half Moon Inn, and Court Farm Inn.

name: HEAVITREE BREWERY PLC
businessSummary: The Heavitree Brewery PLC is a United Kingdom-based independent, family-owned tenanted and leased pub company. The Company operates through its leased estates segment. Its business is engaged in the running and development of a leased and tenanted estate in the southwest of England. It operates approximately 64 leased and tenanted public houses along with non-core assets and a dormant managed estate. Its geographical segments include the United Kingdom and the United States. It provides facilities, including a beer garden/outside area, children's play area, parking, and accommodation. It owns over 50 pubs concentrated mainly in the Exeter and South Devon area. The Company's pubs include Anchor Inn, The Ashcott, The Atmospheric Railway, The Beach, Bell Inn, Brunswick Arms, Church House Inn, Claycutter's Arms, Court Farm Inn, The Cleave, The Clifton, The Cricket Inn, The Exeter Inn, The Green Dragon, Half Moon Inn, and Court Farm Inn.

name: PORTMEIRION GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Portmeirion Group PLC is a United Kingdom-based company that is focused on the homeware sector. The principal activity of the Company is that of a marketer and distributor of ceramic tableware, home fragrance, cookware and giftware, glassware, candles, placemats, coasters, and other associated products, and is engaged in manufacturing ceramics and home fragrance products. Its brands include Spode, Portmeirion, Royal Worcester, Nambe, Pimpernel and Wax Lyrical. The Company designs, manufactures, and distributes its branded products around the world to its customers. Its two manufacturing sites include a ceramics factory in Stoke-on-Trent and a home fragrance site in the Lake District. Its segments include the UK and North America. It sells its products through wholesale (national and independent retailers), e-commerce, and retail. Its wholesale customers are omni-channel retailers with both physical stores and online sites.

name: MICHELMERSH BRICK HOLDINGS PLC
businessSummary: Michelmersh Brick Holdings PLC is a United Kingdom-based clay product specialist. The Company's principal activity is as a manufacturer and distributor of clay bricks and prefabricated brick components used in the construction industry. The Company's brands include Blockleys, Carlton, FabSpeed, Freshfield Lane, Michelmersh, Floren.be and Hathern Terra Cotta. These divisions operate within a fully integrated business, combining the production of precision-made bricks, pavers, special shaped bricks, bespoke Terra Cotta products and prefabricated brick components. Blockleys produces extruded wire cut facing bricks, clay pavers, paving accessories and special shapes. Freshfield Lane produces a varied selection of clamp-fired stock facing bricks and clay pavers. FabSpeed specializes in prefabricated off-site building components and products. The Company also includes a landfill operator, New Acres Limited, and seeks to develop landfill and development opportunities on ancillary land assets.

name: SYNECTICS PLC
businessSummary: Synectics plc is a United Kingdom-based company, which provides advanced security and surveillance systems. The Company specializes in providing solutions for specific markets where security and surveillance are critical to operations, such as energy, public space, transport, infrastructure, and leisure and hospitality. The Company operates through two segments: Systems and Ocular. The Systems segment develops and delivers its proprietary, technology-led solutions to specialist markets globally, including oil and gas, gaming, transport, critical infrastructure and public space through local systems integrators and channel partners. It offers a proprietary software platform, Synergy, which is tailored to the requirements of clients and specialist hardware for oil and gas markets. The Ocular segment delivers integrated solutions, services, and support directly to end-users in the United Kingdom and Ireland. The Company also offers COEX camera station range.

name: EUROCELL PLC
businessSummary: Eurocell PLC is a United Kingdom-based manufacturer, distributor and recycler of polyvinyl chloride (PVC) window, door, and roofline products. The Company’s segments include Profiles, Building Plastics, Alunet, and Corporate. The Profiles segment includes extrusion and sale of PVC window and building products to the new and replacement window market across the United Kingdom. This segment includes Vista Panels, S&S Plastics, and Eurocell Recycle North. The Building Plastics segment is engaged in the sale of building plastic materials across the United Kingdom. The Alunet segment is engaged in the sale of aluminum window and composite door products to the new and replacement market in the United Kingdom. This segment includes Alunet Systems, Comp Door, JDUK and UK Doors (Midlands). Its products include fascias and soffits, decking and fencing, windows and doors, guttering and drainage, external cladding, roofing and insulation, interior products, tools and accessories, among others.

name: BLACKROCK INCOME AND GROWTH INVESTMENT T
businessSummary: BlackRock Income and Growth Investment Trust plc is a United Kingdom-based investment trust company. The Company's principal activity is portfolio investment. The Company's investment objective is to provide growth in capital and income over the long-term through investment in a diversified portfolio of principally United Kingdom listed equities. The Company invests in various sectors, including financial services; pharmaceuticals and biotechnology; support services; household goods and home construction; media; food producers; mining; banks; gas, water and multiutilities; tobacco; oil and gas producers; non-life insurance; travel and leisure, industrial engineering, life insurance, general industrials and others. The Company's investment manager is BlackRock Investment Management (UK) Limited. The Company's alternative investment fund manager is BlackRock Fund Managers Limited.

name: CLOSE BROTHERS GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Close Brothers Group plc is a United Kingdom-based specialist banking company providing lending, deposit taking. The Company’s segments include Commercial, Retail, and Property. The Commercial segment lends to small and medium-sized enterprises through its in-house teams, where loans are originated via its direct sales force or introduced by third-party distribution channels. This segment includes invoice finance, energy, and intermediated asset finance. The Retail segment provides finance to individuals and businesses through a network of intermediaries. The Property segment provides residential development finance and loans to property developers and investors across mainland the United Kingdom (UK) and Northern Ireland, through its two brands, Close Brothers Property Finance and Commercial Acceptances. It also provides financial services and advice to small businesses and individuals.

name: STHREE PLC
businessSummary: SThree plc is a United Kingdom-based global specialist talent partner focused on roles in Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics, providing permanent and flexible contract talent. Its segments include DACH, Rest of Europe, Netherlands including Spain, United States, and Middle East & Asia. DACH segment includes Austria, Germany and Switzerland. Rest of Europe segment includes Belgium, France and the United Kingdom. Middle East & Asia segment includes Dubai and Japan. Its brands include Computer Futures, Progressive, Real, Huxley and others. Progressive Recruitment is involved in start-up and blue-chip multinational sectors, providing sought-after specialists in engineering, life sciences, information technology, global energy, construction and supply chains. Computer Futures is a specialist IT recruitment provider. Real Staffing is engaged in recruitment for the pharmaceuticals, medical devices and biotechnology sectors, with specialist services within the public sector.

name: JUPITER FUND MANAGEMENT PLC
businessSummary: Jupiter Fund Management plc is an asset management company. The Company’s principal activity is to act as a holding company for a group of investment management companies. The Company offers a number of investment strategies within four core asset classes: equities, fixed income, multi-asset and alternatives. It offers a range of actively managed investment strategies through two principal client channels: retail, wholesale & investment trusts and institutional. It provides investment expertise across a range of capabilities, including United Kingdom equities, European equities, Global equities, Systematic equities, Asian and Emerging Market equities, Multi-manager and Fixed Income. Its product types can be broadly categorized into pooled funds and segregated mandates. It operates principally in the United Kingdom with international operating subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Ireland, Singapore, Switzerland, and Luxembourg. Its Luxembourg entity has branches across continental Europe.

name: VOLVERE PLC
businessSummary: Volvere plc is a United Kingdom-based industrial holding company. The Company invests in or acquires companies which require growth capital. The Company also acquires any company that is complementary to its existing portfolio, or which is in a sector in which it has specialist knowledge. The Company’s food manufacturing segment is engaged in the production and sale of food products to third party customers. Its portfolios include NMT Group and Shire Foods. NMT Group is a medical devices company that developed a safety syringe to prevent needlestick injury. Shire Foods is a manufacturer of frozen pies, pasties and sausage rolls. Shire Foods customers include retailers, food service companies and independent wholesalers.

name: CREST NICHOLSON HOLDINGS PLC
businessSummary: Crest Nicholson Holdings plc is a United Kingdom-based residential housebuilder, operating primarily in the South of England and the Midlands. The Company is structured into five regional divisions: Midlands and Yorkshire, Southwest, South, Chiltern, and Eastern. All divisions are engaged in residential-led, mixed-use developments in the United Kingdom. Its divisions are supported by a number of central functions, which help to support and drive consistent performance across the business. It builds strategic relationships within the private rented sector and with registered providers of affordable housing. The Company's subsidiaries include Crest Nicholson Developments (Chertsey) Limited, Crest Nicholson Residential Limited, Clevedon Investment Limited, CN Finance plc, Crest Nicholson (Bath) Holdings Limited, Crest Nicholson (Peckham) Limited, Ellis Mews (Park Central) Management Limited, Harbourside Leisure Management Company Limited, and others.

name: JET2 PLC
businessSummary: Jet2 plc is a United Kingdom-based leisure travel company. The Leisure Travel business specializes in offering package holidays through its ATOL-licensed provider, Jet2holidays, to leisure destinations in the Mediterranean, the Canary Islands and to European Leisure Cities, and to scheduled holiday flights by its airline, Jet2.com. Resource allocation decisions are based on the entire route network and the deployment of its entire aircraft fleet. All Jet2holidays customers fly on Jet2.com flights, and therefore these offerings are inextricably linked and, together, represent the only segment within the Group. Jet2 operates from approximately 13 United Kingdom airport bases at Belfast International, Birmingham, Bournemouth, Bristol, East Midlands, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Leeds Bradford, Liverpool John Lennon, London Stansted, London Luton, Manchester and Newcastle. The Company’s other brands include Jet2CityBreaks, Jet2Villas, Indulgent Escapes and VIBE.

name: BRCK GROUP PLC
businessSummary: BRCK Group PLC, formerly Brickability Group PLC, is a distributor and provider of specialist products and services to the United Kingdom (UK) construction industry. The Company’s business comprises four divisions: Bricks and Building Materials, Importing, Distribution and Contracting. Its Bricks and Building Materials incorporates the sale of quality building materials to all sectors of the construction industry, including national house builders, developers, contractors, general builders and retail to members of the public. Its importing business sources building materials from around the world and makes them accessible to sectors within the UK. Its distribution focuses on the sale of the distribution of a range of products such as windows, doors, radiators and others. Its contracting business is a provider of cladding, flooring and roofing installation and remediation services, supply and installation of traditional slate, tile and metal roofing and quality flooring.

name: TRIFAST PLC
businessSummary: Trifast plc is a United Kingdom-based company, which is engaged in the design, engineering, manufacturing and distribution of industrial fastenings and Category C components principally to global assembly industries. The Company provides customer support from across key regions in the United Kingdom and Ireland, Asia, Europe and North America. It offers various products, such as screws and bolts; nuts; washers, circlips, rings, seals, and O-rings; fasteners for sheet metal; fasteners for plastic, enclosure hardware; plastic hardware; cable glands; security fasteners; spacers and pillars; tooling and driver bits, and other hardware. It supplies to customers in over 70 countries across a range of industries, including automotive, smart infrastructure, medical equipment, distributors and other. It delivers comprehensive support to its customers across every requirement, from concept design through to technical engineering consultancy, manufacturing, supply management and global logistics.

name: ARCONTECH GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Arcontech Group PLC is a United Kingdom-based provider of products and services for real-time financial market data processing and trading. The principal activities of the Company and its subsidiaries include the development and sale of proprietary software and provision of computer consultancy services. It provides software products and bespoke solutions for the collection, processing, distribution and presentation of time-sensitive financial markets data. Its products include CityVision, which is a market data platform; CityVision MVCS, which is a multi-vendor contribution; Excelerator, which is a real time excel; CityVision Cache, which is a data cache and calculations engine, Desktop, which is a real time market data terminal; CityVision API, which is a development, integration or build-out, and CityVision Symbol Mapper, which is a real-time data conversion that allows Market Data Managers to separate data integration from the data source.

name: DIALES GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Diales Group PLC, formerly Diales PLC, is a United Kingdom-based global specialist dispute avoidance and dispute resolution consultancy. It provides specialist support and expertise to clients in the construction and engineering industries. Its operating divisions include Europe & Americas, Middle East and Asia Pacific. It offers complete solutions throughout the project lifecycle, providing services in dispute avoidance and resolution, and supporting the legal profession in arbitration, litigation, and alternative dispute resolution. Its expert services include quantum, delay, project management, adjudicators, arbitrators, mediators and technical expertise. Its advisory services include commercial and contract, planning and programming, dispute resolution, structural design services, pre-contract, quantity surveying, building information modeling, and training. Its serves various sectors, including building, energy, infrastructure, marine, mining, oil and gas, and transportation.

name: SYSTEM1 GROUP PLC
businessSummary: System1 Group PLC is a United Kingdom-based marketing decision-making platform provider. The Company provides marketing and market research consultancy services. The Company predicts and improves marketing effectiveness. It provides research results, and insight and consultancy on those results that are required on arguably three marketing questions for its customers: Advertising effectiveness, Brand effectiveness and Innovation effectiveness. The Company’s products include Test Your Ad, Test Your Innovation, and Test Your Brand. The Company's subsidiaries include System1 Research Limited, System1 Research B.V., System1 Research, Inc., System1 Research Sarl, System1 Research GmbH, System1 Research Do Brazil Servicos de Marketing Ltda., System1 Research France Sarl, System1 Market Research Pte Ltd, System1 Research Pty Ltd., System1 Agency Limited, and System1 AdRatings Limited.

name: GATTACA PLC
businessSummary: Gattaca plc is a human capital resources business providing contract and permanent recruitment services in the private and public sectors across the United Kingdom, Europe and North America regions. Its segments include Mobility, Energy, Defense, Digital Technology, Infrastructure, Commercial & Professional, Gattaca Projects and International. It offers a range of recruitment solutions, such as workforce solutions, technical recruitment solutions, engineering and technology solutions, workforce insights, events, and resources, and others. It also provides a range of engineering and technology services to support clients’ needs, from engineering design services to analysis. It serves various markets, such as aerospace, automotive, defense, and banking and financial services. Gattaca Projects solves complex technical and operational challenges through tangible outcome-based services. The Company’s brands include Gattaca Solutions, Gattaca Projects, Matchtech, and Barclay Meade.

name: INCHCAPE PLC
businessSummary: Inchcape plc is a United Kingdom-based independent multi-brand global automotive distributor. The Company's segments include The Asia Pacific Accreditation Cooperation (APAC), and Europe & Africa Americas. Its APAC segments include exclusive distribution, sales and marketing activities of new vehicles and parts. Its Europe & Africa Americas segment includes sale of new and used vehicles together with logistics services where the group may also be the exclusive distributor, alongside associated aftersales activities of service, body shop repairs and parts sales.

name: MOTHERCARE PLC
businessSummary: Mothercare plc owns and operates Mothercare Global Brand Limited (MGB), which owns the Mothercare brand, a global brand for parents and young children. MGB designs, sources and supplies products across clothing and many other essential categories, including baby nursery, feedtime, bathtime and playtime, providing for the needs of parents and young children across the world. MGB is presented in stores and online through a network of global franchise partners who operate approximately 450 plus stores in 31 countries around the world. Its product categories include clothing and home, travel and toys. It provides collections for 0-10 years. Its clothing product categories include newborn, baby essentials, and nightwear. Its home, travel and toys categories the needs of new parents in the nursery, bedding, bathing, feeding, and travel, primarily for children under three. The Company manufactures primarily in India, Bangladesh and China.

name: SANDERSON DESIGN GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Sanderson Design Group PLC is a luxury interior furnishings company, which is engaged in the design, manufacture, and marketing of wallpapers, fabrics, and paints. It operates through three segments, namely Brands, Licensing, and Manufacturing. Its Brands segment includes around six brands: Sanderson, Morris & Co., Zoffany, Harlequin, Clarke & Clarke, and Scion, which offer wallpaper, fabrics, and paints. The Licensing segment involves the use of the Company’s designs on a wide range of products such as bedding, rugs, blinds, tableware and apparel through licensing arrangements. The Manufacturing segment includes the wallcovering and printed fabric manufacturing businesses operated by Anstey and Standfast & Barracks, respectively. It operates manufacturing facilities at Anstey Wallpaper factory in Loughborough and Standfast & Barracks fabric printing factory in Lancaster. Its subsidiaries include Sanderson Design Group Brands Limited, Anstey Wallpaper Company Limited, among others.

name: PEBBLE GROUP PLC
businessSummary: The Pebble Group plc is a United Kingdom-based holding company. The Company’s principal activity is the sale of digital commerce, products and related services to the promotional merchandise industry. The Company’s segments include Brand Addition, Facilisgroup, and Central operations. The Brand Addition segment is engaged in the sale of promotional products through services provided under framework contracts on an international basis. The Facilisgroup is engaged in provision of digital technology, consolidated buying power and community learning and networking events to small and medium-sized enterprises promotional product distributors in North America through subscription-based services. Its technology, branded Syncore, offers promotional product distributors tools and processes they need to efficiently run their business. Its subsidiaries include Project Amber Bidco Limited, H.I.G Milan UK Bidco Limited, among others.

name: TRAVIS PERKINS PLC
businessSummary: Travis Perkins plc is a United Kingdom-based distributor of building materials. The Company's businesses include Merchanting and Toolstation. Its Merchanting business brands include Travis Perkins, BSS, Keyline Civils Specialist and CCF. Travis Perkins is a general builder merchant, offering a destination for heavy side products complemented by light side convenience. Travis Perkins contains a comprehensive tool hire offer, managed services solutions and a kitchen design and supply offer, branded as Benchmarx. BSS offers customers a tailored tool hire service and includes TF Solutions, a specialist provider of air-conditioning products and heat pumps. Keyline Civils Specialist supports housebuilders, groundworkers and infrastructure contractors to build and redevelop facilities. CCF distributes insulation and interior building products. Its Toolstation business is a supplier of tools and building supplies to trade and do-it-yourself (DIY) customers via a multi-channel offering.

name: YU GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Yu Group PLC is a United Kingdom-based independent supplier of gas and electricity, meter asset owner, and installer of smart meters. The Company operates through three segments: Yu Retail, Yu Smart, and Metering. Yu Retail segment is engaged in the supply of electricity, gas and water to business customers in the United Kingdom. Yu Smart segment is engaged in the provision of engineering and related services to install and maintain smart and other meters, and electric vehicle (EV) charging solutions. Metering assets segment is engaged in the ownership and rental of smart metering assets. The Company serves small and medium-sized businesses, multi-site complex corporations, third party intermediaries, and other partners. Its wholly owned subsidiaries include Yu Energy Holding Limited, which is engaged in gas shipping services; Yu Energy Retail Limited, which provides the supply of energy to businesses, and Yu Water Limited, which is engaged in the supply of water to businesses.

name: S4 CAPITAL PLC
businessSummary: S4 Capital PLC is a United Kingdom-based digital advertising, marketing, and technology services company. The Company operates through two segments: Marketing Services and Technology Services. Its Marketing Services segment includes creative content, campaigns, and assets at a global scale for paid, social and earned media - from digital platforms and apps to brand, full-service campaign management analytics, creative production and ad serving, platform and systems integration and transition, training and education. Its Technology Services segment includes digital transformation services, which deliver advanced digital product design, engineering services and delivery services. The Company’s customers are primarily businesses across technology, fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) and media and entertainment. Monks.Flow is its Artificial Intelligence (AI) product solution that automates marketing workflows.

name: TOPPS TILES PLC
businessSummary: Topps Tiles Plc operates as a specialist supplier of tiles and associated products, targeting the United Kingdom domestic, commercial, and housebuilder markets and serving homeowners, trade customers, architects, designers and contractors from its approximately 297 stores. The Company is engaged in the sale and distribution of ceramic and porcelain tiles, natural stone, and related products. It operates various retail and distribution brands, including Topps Tiles, Pro Tiler Tools, CTD, Parkside, Fired Earth, and Tile Warehouse, among others. Its product portfolio includes luxury vinyl tiles, shower panels, outdoor tiles, laminate and engineered wood, splashbacks, XXL porcelain, and acoustic panels. Tile Warehouse is an online pure play brand focused on selling coverings products. Pro Tiler supplies fitters and smaller contractors buying consumable items and technical tools through its modern digital channels. Topps Tiles brand caters to traders and homeowner customers.

name: ULTIMATE PRODUCTS PLC
businessSummary: Ultimate Products PLC is a supplier of branded household products to global markets. The Company is the owner of a number of homeware brands, including the Salter houseware brand and Beldray (a laundry, floor care, heating and cooling brand). It sells to over 300 retailers across 38 countries and specializes in five product categories: small domestic appliances, houseware, laundry, audio, and heating and cooling. Its Laundry division offers time-saving products, which provide a lasting solution to maintaining a clean and tidy home. Its other brands include Progress (cookware and bakeware), Kleeneze (laundry and floorcare), Intempo (audio), ZFrame, and others. Its products are sold to a cross-section of both national and international multichannel retailers as well as smaller national retail chains, incorporating discount retailers, supermarkets, general retailers and online retailers. It operates in the United Kingdom, Germany, Rest of Europe, and Rest of the World.

name: REACT GROUP PLC
businessSummary: REACT Group plc is a United Kingdom-based support services provider to the facility management (FM) sector, operating across four key service propositions: LaddersFree, Fidelis Contract Services, REACT and 24hr Aquaflow Services. LaddersFree is engaged in commercial window cleaning businesses, delivering nationwide services. Fidelis Contract Services is a contract cleaning and soft facilities maintenance provider focused on long-term client partnerships. REACT, specializing in emergency and specialist cleaning solutions, offers both long-term framework agreements and rapid response services. 24hr Aquaflow Services is a commercial drainage and plumbing business serving clients across London and the Southeast of England. It serves various sectors, including education, emergency, facilities management, healthcare, highways, housing, industrial, justice and rail. The Company’s services include air duct cleaning, commercial window cleaning, crime scene decontaminations and deep cleaning.

name: EASYJET PLC
businessSummary: Easyjet PLC is a United Kingdom-based holding company engaged in providing flights and package holidays, principally in Europe. The Company operates through two segments: Airline business and Holidays business. The Airline business segment operates its route network. The Holidays business segment sells holiday packages. Its fleet includes A319, A320, A320 neo and A321 neo. The Company’s total fleet comprises approximately 355 aircraft, operating 1,207 routes across 38 countries and 164 airports. Its subsidiaries include easyJet Airline Company Limited, easyJet Sterling Limited, easyJet UK Limited, easyJet Europe Airline GmbH, easyJet Switzerland S.A., easyJet FinCo B.V., easyJet MT Limited, easyJet HQ Holdings Limited, easyJet HQ Limited, easyJet HQ Development Limited, easyJet Holidays Holdings Limited, and others. The easyJet Airline Company Limited and easyJet Switzerland S.A. subsidiaries are engaged in airline operations.

name: ROBERT WALTERS PLC
businessSummary: Robert Walters plc is a United Kingdom-based global talent solutions business. The Company’s services include Specialist professional recruitment, which is encompassing permanent and temporary recruitment, interim management and executive search; Recruitment outsourcing services enabling organizations to transfer all, or part of, their recruitment needs to the Company either through recruitment process outsourcing (RPO) or contingent workforce solutions (CWS), and Talent advisory service supporting the growth of organization’s through market intelligence, talent development, and future of work consultancy. The Company’s client base ranges from blue-chip corporates through to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), and start-ups. The Company's subsidiaries include Robert Walters Pty Limited, Resource Solutions Corporation Pty Limited, Robert Walters Business Consulting (Shanghai) Ltd Company, Walters People Chile Empresa de Servicios Transitorios SpA, and others.

name: VESUVIUS PLC
businessSummary: Vesuvius plc is engaged in molten metal flow engineering and technology. The Company’s segments include Steel and Foundry. The Steel Division includes Steel Flow Control, Steel Advanced Refractories, and Steel Sensors & Probes. Steel Flow Control unit supplies the global steel industry with consumable ceramic products, systems, robotics, and digital services. Steel Advanced Refractories supplies specialist refractory products designed to enable steel-making equipment to hold the molten metal. Steel Sensors & Probes supplies a range of products that enhance the control and monitoring of customers’ production processes. The Foundry Division operates under the Foseco brand, which offers a range of foundry consumables and equipment to meet the requirements of iron foundries, steel foundries, and non-ferrous foundries. Foundry Division’s six core product lines are feeding systems, coatings, metal treatment, filters, refractories, and crucibles. It also owns molten metal systems businesses.

name: HVIVO PLC
businessSummary: hVIVO plc is a United Kingdom-based specialist early-stage drug development contract research organization (CRO) and human challenge trials. The Company delivers end-to-end clinical development services to a diverse and expanding client base. It specializes in conducting human challenge trials across multiple infectious and respiratory indications, leveraging its quarantine facility. The Company also offers comprehensive virology and immunology laboratory services under the hLAB brand. The Company, through its subsidiary, operates an approximately 120-bed capacity across Mannheim and Kiel, providing early-phase clinical trial services, including first-in-human and proof-of-concept studies. It also offers Early Drug Development Consulting and Biometry services to the biopharma sector. The Company also provides industry-standard, temperature-controlled storage solutions for biological and clinical materials.

name: SHIRES INCOME PLC
businessSummary: Shires Income PLC is a United Kingdom-based closed-end investment company. The Company's investment objective is to provide shareholders with a high level of income, together with the potential for growth of both income and capital, from a diversified portfolio substantially invested in United Kingdom equities but also in preference shares, convertibles and other fixed-income securities. Its investment policy is to invest principally in the ordinary shares of the United Kingdom quoted companies, and in preference shares, convertibles and other fixed-income securities with above-average yields. The Company invests in various sectors, including basic materials, consumer discretionary, consumer staples, energy, financials, healthcare, industrials, real estate, technology, telecommunications, utilities and others. The Company's alternative investment fund manager is abrdn Fund Managers Limited.

name: GEAR4MUSIC (HOLDINGS) PLC
businessSummary: Gear4music (Holdings) plc is a United Kingdom-based online retailer of musical instruments and music equipment. The Company sells own-brand musical instruments and music equipment alongside premium third-party brands, including Yamaha, Roland, and Fender, to customers ranging from beginners to musical enthusiasts and professionals, in the United Kingdom, Europe and the Rest of the World. The Company is also developing its own bespoke e-commerce platform, with multilingual and multicurrency websites. It offers products, such as guitars and bass, keyboards, pianos, drum kits, flutes, lightweight instruments, woodwind, brass, strings, audio-visual products, and others. It operates approximately 21 websites in 15 languages and nine currencies. The Company retails over 63,000 stock-keeping-units across all musical instruments and categories. The Company’s subsidiaries include Gear4music Sweden AB, Gear4music GmbH, Gear4music Europe Limited, and others.

name: PHAROS ENERGY PLC
businessSummary: Pharos Energy PLC is an independent energy company. The Company has a portfolio of production, development and exploration assets in Vietnam and Egypt. It holds a 45% working interest in the El Fayum Concession in the Western Desert. The El Fayum Concession produces oil from 10 fields and is located 80 km southwest of Cairo. It also holds a 45% working interest share in the North Beni Suef (NBS) Concession in Egypt, which is located immediately south of the El Fayum Concession. It has assets in Vietnam, with production in two fields, including Te Giac Trang (TGT) & Ca Ngu Vang (CNV) and the potential for growth from two additional exploration blocks (125 & 126). TGT Field is located in Block 16-1, offshore Vietnam in the shallow water Cuu Long Basin, about 100 km from Vung Tau. The CNV Field is located in Block 9-2, offshore Vietnam, in the shallow water Cuu Long Basin. Blocks 125 & 126 are located in moderate to deep waters in the Phu Khanh Basin, northeast of the Cuu Long Basin.

name: CHURCHILL CHINA PLC
businessSummary: Churchill China plc is a United Kingdom-based manufacturer of performance ceramics. The Company’s principal business services hospitality market worldwide, providing tableware and other products to a number of sectors. Its brands include Ambience, Alchemy, Super Vitrified, Art de Cuisine, and Dudson. The Company’s product categories include plates, bowls, beverages, serveware, dip pots and side dishes, cutlery, accessories and cookware. It offers products for a range of sectors which include hotels, contract caterers, cafes, and restaurants. The Company operates in two segments: Ceramics and Materials. The Ceramics segment is engaged in the sale of ceramic tableware and complementary items. The Materials segment is engaged in the sale of materials for the production of ceramics, predominantly to the tableware industry. The Company’s subsidiaries include Churchill China (UK) Limited, Furlong Mills Ltd, Churchill China, Inc, Churchill Ceramica Iberia, S.L. and Churchill China RM S.R.L.

name: CROMA SECURITY SOLUTIONS GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Croma Security Solutions Group plc is a United Kingdom-based security solution provider. The Company operates through two segments: Croma Fire and Security, and Croma Locksmiths. The Croma Fire and Security segment is engaged in designing, supplying, installing, monitoring, and maintaining Intruder Alarms systems, closed-circuit television (CCTV), fire and life safety systems, perimeter detection systems, barriers, gates, bollards, and automatic doors. The Croma Locksmiths segment provides mechanical solutions via its 16 retail outlets as well as its team of onsite engineers. This allows the Company to supply, install, and maintain locks, padlocks, safes, ironmongery, Unplasticized polyvinyl chloride (UPVC) mechanisms, security shutters, grilles, and doors. The Company also offers emergency call out services. Its subsidiaries include CSS Total Security Limited, Croma Locksmiths & Security Solutions Limited, Safeguard (N/W) Limited, and others.

name: KIER GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Kier Group plc is an infrastructure services, construction, and property company. The Company is a provider of infrastructure services, construction, and property development. The Company’s segments include Infrastructure Services, Construction and Property. Infrastructure Services designs, builds and maintains infrastructure for the highways, rail, aviation and ports sectors. It delivers work for National Highways, Network Rail, Transport for London and HS2 as well as a number of local and combined authorities. It also delivers long-term contracts in maintenance and capital projects to the water, nuclear and energy sectors, and the protection of habitats and communities in natural environment and waterways. The Construction segment comprises regional buildings, strategic projects, and Kier Places. The Property segment invests and develops primarily mixed-use commercial development.

name: REACH PLC
businessSummary: Reach plc is a United Kingdom-based commercial news publisher. The Company is focused on providing content that attracts the audience of any commercial news publisher in the United Kingdom (UK) and Ireland. The Company is engaged in delivering the latest news, entertainment and sport to communities throughout the United Kingdom and Ireland and around the world. It connects with people on and offline, through 120 trusted brands, from national titles like the Mirror, Express, Daily Record and Daily Star, to local brands like MyLondon, BelfastLive and the Manchester Evening News, Liverpool Echo, Irish Star, OK! magazine, WalesOnline, MyLondon and Curiously. The Company has approximately 120 brands, including Websites and print products; 17 books published from Mirror Books, and 168 active podcasts.

name: AIREA PLC
businessSummary: Airea plc is a United Kingdom-based specialist flooring company, supplying both the United Kingdom and international markets. The Company's core brand, Burmatex, is the designer and manufacturer of commercial carpet tiles and planks. Burmatex is focused on the design and creation of sustainable flooring solutions to meet the needs of architects, specifiers, and contractors with a developing range to suit the education, leisure, commercial, hospitality and public sectors. The Company offers a product range spanning fiber bonded and tufted carpet in sheet and tile, as well as specialist barrier and entrance matting products. Its products include multilevel loop, loop pile, cut pile, structure bonded, fiber bonded and entrance matting, and carpet planks. Its multilevel loop products include rocklines, threads, standing stones, snowfall, balance collection, arctic and dapple. Its loop pile products include tivoli, infinity and go to. Its structure bonded products include lateral and code.

name: FISKE PLC
businessSummary: Fiske plc is a United Kingdom-based independent investment management and stockbroking company. The Company's principal activity is the provision of financial intermediation, which consists of private client and institutional stockbroking, and private client investment management. It offers services to individuals, professional advisers, and companies and trusts. It also operates Ocean Equity Fund. The Ocean Equity Fund does not have an objective linked to the oceans or marine biodiversity, but the Fund Manager may choose to invest in companies that derive their revenue from shipping and energy transition sectors. It offers three levels of investment service: discretionary investment management, advisory managed and execution only. Its discretionary investment management service is for people who wish to delegate decision-making on investment matters to a professional investment manager. It provides self-invested personal pensions (SIPPs) and small self-administered schemes (SSASs).

name: HALFORDS GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Halfords Group plc is a United Kingdom-based provider of motoring and cycling products and services. The Company operates through two segments: Retail and Autocentres. The operations of the Retail reporting segment comprise the retailing of automotive, leisure and cycling products and services through retail stores and online. The operations of the Autocentres reporting segment comprise vehicle servicing and repair performed from garages and vans. The Company has approximately 387 Halfords Retail and two Performance Cycling stores offering a wide range of motoring and cycling products and on demand services. It has over 273 direct to consumer vans and 495 commercial vans, bringing services direct to customers. Its product categories include motoring products, mainstream cycling products and performance cycling products. Its services include retail motoring, cycling, and auto centers.

name: ANGLING DIRECT PLC
businessSummary: Angling Direct PLC is a United Kingdom-based omni-channel specialist fishing tackle and equipment retailer. The principal activity of the Company is the sale of fishing tackles through its websites and stores. The Company provides customer service, expert advice and ensuring product lines, including a complete range of equipment. The Company has over 7.6 million visitors to its websites each year and completes approximately 41,000 transactions each week in its stores. The Company operates through three segments: UK Stores, UK Online and Europe. The Company’s products categories include bait and additives; bait accessories; bait boats; bait boxes; bait making equipment; barrows and trolleys; bedchairs; bite alarms; bivvies and shelters; bivvy accessories; buckets and riddles; Catapults; chairs; clothing; cooking equipment; fish care; files, fly fishing accessories; fly storage, gift cards; indicators; lighting; luggage; nets; tools; umbrellas, and others.

name: EBIQUITY PLC
businessSummary: Ebiquity plc is an independent media and marketing consultancy. The Company helps advertisers make smarter media investment decisions by providing data-driven insights, auditing, and advisory services. It provides analysis and solutions through four Service Lines: Media management, Media performance, Marketing effectiveness and Contract Compliance. Its media management service provides guidance to global brands, offering an understanding of their digital media performance to help them make informed decisions about their media investments. The Company's media performance service helps brand owners drive efficiency and effectiveness from their media spend, eliminating wastage and creating value. Its marketing effectiveness service provides a picture of the true levels of business performance by using a suite of complementary methods. The Company's contract compliance division, FirmDecisions, provides contract compliance services.

name: STAR ENERGY GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Star Energy Group plc is an onshore hydrocarbon producer in the United Kingdom. The Company is engaged in delivering indigenous crude oil and electricity to Britain’s energy market from its fields in the East Midlands and the Weald Basin in Southern England. It has approximately 28 fields with over 90 sites around the country, producing predominantly oil. The Company owns a 71% interest in a company which has three geothermal exploration licenses in Croatia, with the potential to develop power generation facilities that seek to supply renewable baseload power to local and regional electricity markets. Its pipeline of geothermal heat opportunities in the United Kingdom includes projects in partnership with Salisbury and Manchester University NHS Foundation Trusts to decarbonize their operations and provide a reliable long-term source of heat.

name: WORKS CO UK PLC
businessSummary: TheWorks.co.uk plc is a United Kingdom-based value retailer. The Company is a retailer of arts and crafts, stationery, toys, games and books. The Company's product categories include arts & crafts; stationery; toys & games; seasonal & events, and books. The book category comprises children's books, fiction books, and non-fiction books. Its arts and crafts comprise canvases, sketch books, artist paint, art sets, art paper, art pens & markers, art pencils & pastels, paint brushes, time well-spent ideas, wooden crafts, craft kits, paper crafts, craft embellishments, diamond painting, craft frames, and knitting & crochet kits. Its stationery selection includes pens and pencils, office supplies, notepads, stationery sets, office stationery, stationery collections, files and folders, and kids’ stationery. It also includes brands, such as The Works Essentials, Bic, Pukka Pad, Sharpie, Staedtler, Scribblicious, Harry Potter, and Hello Kitty and Friends. It operates in approximately 511 stores.

name: MISSION GROUP PLC
businessSummary: The Mission Group Plc is a United Kingdom-based company. The Company is a collective of agencies dedicated to helping clients. The Company’s segments include Consumer & Lifestyle, Health & Wellness, Property, Sports & Entertainment, Technology & Mobility, MISSION Advantage & Central, Business & Corporate, and Investments. The Company's agencies include Bray Leino, ALiVE, Bray Leino Events, IB, Influence Sports & Media, .krow, LIVITY, mongoose, Populate, RJW & partners, soul, SPARK, STORY, thinkbdw, SPEED, TURBINE, Mezzo Labs, and SOLARIS health. The Company operates through 28 different locations across the United Kingdom, from London to Leicester to Edinburgh and from Norwich to Devon. MISSION Hubs, its international network of affiliates and partner agencies, enables it to curate bespoke communications solutions to any client requirement, in any market, in any discipline and deliver Work That Counts.

name: SAVANNAH ENERGY PLC
businessSummary: Savannah Energy PLC is a United Kingdom-based independent energy company. The Company’s principal activities are the exploration, development and production of natural gas and crude oil and the development of other energy-related projects in Africa. It holds an 80% economic interest in the exploration, development and production of gas within the Uquo Field, the Uquo Gas Project. It also holds a 49% non-operated interest in the Stubb Creek oil & gas field (Stubb Creek Field). Stubb Creek Field is located in Akwa Ibom State, Nigeria, and is a producing oil field with considerable undeveloped, non-associated 2C gas resources. The Company’s Accugas midstream business focuses on the marketing, processing, distribution, and sale of gas to the Nigerian market. It owns and operates the Cameroon Export Transportation System, comprising the Cameroon export pipeline, the Kome Kribi 1 floating storage and offloading unit (FSO) and related infrastructure.

name: CURRYS PLC
businessSummary: Currys plc is a United Kingdom-based company. The Company is an omnichannel retailer of technology products and services, operating online and through over 708 stores in six countries. The Company’s segments include UK & Ireland and Nordics. UK & Ireland segment comprises the operations of Currys, iD Mobile, and business to business (B2B) operations. Nordics segment operates both franchise and own stores in Norway, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark with further franchise operations in Iceland, Greenland, and Faroe Islands. In Nordics, the Company trades under the Elkjop brand. Its operations include repair facilities in Newark, United Kingdom, a sourcing office in Hong Kong and an extensive distribution network for delivery to stores and homes. Its subsidiaries include Connected World Services Distributions Limited, Carphone Warehouse Europe Limited, CPW Technology Services Limited, Currys Retail Group Limited, DSG International Holdings Limited, and others.

name: KROMEK GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Kromek Group plc is a developer of radiation detection and bio-detection technology solutions for advanced imaging and chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear (CBRN) detection segments. Its advanced imaging segment comprises the medical, security, and industrial markets. The Company provides its original equipment manufacturer customers with detector components based on its core cadmium zinc telluride (CZT) platform, to enable the detection of diseases such as cancer and Alzheimer's, contamination in industrial manufacture and explosives in aviation settings. In CBRN detection, it provides nuclear radiation detection solutions to the global homeland defense and security market. Its compact, handheld, high-performance radiation detectors, based on advanced scintillation technology, are primarily used to protect critical infrastructure and urban environments from the threat of dirty bombs. The Company is also developing bio-security solutions in the CBRN detection segment.

name: NEXUS INFRASTRUCTURE PLC
businessSummary: Nexus Infrastructure plc is a United Kingdom-based provider of sustainable infrastructure. The Company provides a range of civil engineering and infrastructure services to the United Kingdom housebuilding sectors, with operations focused on the South-East of England and London. The services provided by the Company include earthworks, highways, substructures and basements, and installing sustainable drainage systems. It operates through two segments: Tamdown and Nexus Park. Tamdown's operations are focused on the southeast of England and London. Tamdown customers are United Kingdom housebuilders and affordable housing developers, including housing associations. Tamdown works with various quoted housebuilders. Tamdown also works alongside a number of housing associations that deliver mixed tenure developments and are focused on the affordable homes segment of the housing market.

name: CASTINGS PLC
businessSummary: Castings P.L.C. is a United Kingdom-based company, which is engaged in manufacturing iron castings and machining operations. Its segments include Foundry operations and Machining operations. It operates three iron foundries, such as Castings P.L.C. (Brownhills, West Midlands) and William Lee Limited (Dronfield, Derbyshire) and Castings Ductile Limited (Scunthorpe, North Lincolnshire) together with the CNC Speedwell Limited machining operation, which is also based in Brownhills. It produces Ductile iron, SG iron, Austempered ductile iron (ADI), SiMo, and Ni-resist castings over 7000 kilograms in weight. Its three Disamatic molding machines and three horizontal green sand molding machines provide a foundry capacity of over 70,000 tons per annum. Its machining operation is invested to support the capacity requirements of the foundry customer base. Its customer sector profile includes commercial vehicles, automotive, and others.

name: INGENTA PLC
businessSummary: Ingenta plc is a United Kingdom-based company that provides mission-critical software and services to the global publishing industry. The Company operates as one reporting segment with two core revenue categories: Ingenta Commercial and Ingenta Content. Ingenta Commercial provides a variety of modular publishing management systems for both print and digital products. The Company's core area of expertise is intellectual property management, including the associated contracts, rights and royalties. The Ingenta Content suite of products enables publishers of any size, discipline or technical proficiency to convert, store, deliver and monetize digital content on the Web. Its commercial suite of products includes ingenta content lifecycle manager (CLM), ingenta contracts rights and royalties (CRR), and ingenta order to Cash (O2C). The Ingenta CLM module helps publishers manage their intellectual property, contributors, product lifecycle and workflow.

name: FUTURA MEDICAL PLC
businessSummary: Futura Medical plc is a consumer healthcare company that specializes in the development and global commercialization of sexual health products. The Company is a developer of sexual health products, including the lead product, Eroxon, and two products in development, including WSD4000 and Eroxon Intense. Eroxon is a clear gel used for the treatment of erectile dysfunction (ED) available over the counter and without prescription and addresses significant unmet needs in the ED market. Eroxon Intense provides a potential range extension of the Eroxon product and acts as an additional treatment option for men who have ED. WSD4000 is a topical treatment designed for sexual dysfunction in women. The Company has distribution partners in place in a number of major consumer markets, including Haleon in the United States, and Cooper Consumer Health in Europe.

name: TT ELECTRONICS PLC
businessSummary: TT Electronics plc is a provider of design-led, electronics technologies for performance-critical applications. The Company provides design and manufacturing solutions for a range of diagnostic, surgical and direct patient care devices critical to the identification, treatment and prevention of disease. Its brands are AB Connectors, Aero Stanrew, BI Technologies, Ferranti, IRC Components, and Optek Technologies. Its Aero Stanrew brand specializes in the design and manufacture of ruggedized electromagnetic components and electronics systems for safety-critical applications in aerospace and defense. The Optek Technologies brand designs and manufactures optoelectronic solutions for sensing and illumination applications. The Company’s products and services include power conversion, medical device coils, sensors, microelectronics, industrial and medical grade power supplies, and others. Its geographic regions include Europe, North America and Asia.

name: ONE MEDIA IP GROUP PLC
businessSummary: One Media iP Group plc is a United Kingdom-based digital music rights acquirer, publisher and distributor with a diversified catalogue of over 400,000 music tracks. The Company specializes in purchasing and monetizing intellectual property rights. It adds value to its content by maximizing its availability in over 600 digital stores globally, including Apple Music, YouTube, Amazon and Spotify. The Company's music is also widely used for synchronization in film and television whilst its video content is primarily viewed on YouTube where the Company operates over 20 YouTube channels as a certified partner. Its catalogue includes different types of copyrights associated with high profile artists, including producer's royalties from certain recordings by Take That, Culture Club, Heatwave and Kid Creole. It also owns master rights (recordings) and writers' royalties (compositions) for Don Williams, Mago De Oz, Philip Wesley, as well as thousands of other income producing royalties.

name: AFENTRA PLC
businessSummary: Afentra plc is a United Kingdom-based upstream oil and gas company. It is focused on optimizing and expanding its portfolio of producing fields, near-field development assets and short-cycle exploration opportunities within its target markets of West Africa. It has a 30% non-operated interest in the producing Block 3/05 and a 21.33% non-operated interest in the adjacent development Block 3/05A in Offshore, Angola. It also holds a 40% non-operating interest in Block 23, a deepwater exploration license with a proven hydrocarbon potential and covers an approximately 5,000 square kilometers (km2) exploration and appraisal block located in the offshore section of the Kwanza basin. It also has 45% non-operated interests in KON19 and KON15. The Block is an unexplored frontier acreage position covering 22,840 km2, offering the opportunity to explore an undrilled onshore rift basin in Africa.

name: LOWLAND INVESTMENT COMPANY PLC
businessSummary: Lowland Investment Company plc is a United Kingdom-based investment trust company. The Company's objective is to give shareholders a higher-than-average return with growth of both capital and income over the medium to long-term by investing in a broad spread of predominantly UK companies. The Company invests in a combination of large, medium, and smaller companies listed in the United Kingdom. In normal circumstances, up to half the portfolio is invested in Financial Times Stock Exchange (FTSE) 100 companies and the remainder is divided between small and medium-sized companies. The Company invests in various sectors, such as basic materials, consumer discretionary, consumer staples, energy, financials, healthcare, industrials, real estate, technology, telecommunications, and utilities. Janus Henderson Fund Management UK Limited acts as the Company's alternate investment fund manager.

name: FDM GROUP (HOLDINGS) PLC
businessSummary: FDM Group (Holdings) plc is a United Kingdom-based global professional services provider focusing principally on information technology (IT). The Company’s principal business activities involve recruiting, training, and deploying its own permanent IT and business consultants to clients, either on site or remotely. The Company’s geographical segments include UK; North America; Europe, Middle East and Africa, excluding UK (EMEA); and Asia Pacific (APAC). Its business model is focused on coaching and deploying passionate, energetic and self-motivated consultants equipped with skills across five practices: software engineering; change and transformation; data and analytics; IT operations; and risk, regulation & compliance (RRC). The Company attracts, identifies, and develops high-performing talent at its FDM Skills Lab, helping businesses bridge the digital skills gap and build long-term internal capabilities. Its subsidiaries include Astra 5.0 Limited, FDM Group Limited, and others.

name: MAINTEL HOLDINGS PLC
businessSummary: Maintel Holdings Plc is a United Kingdom-based provider of cloud communications, security, and connectivity managed communications services. It provides managed communications services across three areas, namely Unified Communications and Collaboration, which focuses on the Unified Communications as a Service (UCaaS) market segment; Customer Experience, which focuses on Contact Centre as a Service (CCaaS) market segment, supporting customer acquisition, delight, and retention, and Security and Connectivity, which includes Software Defined Wide Area Networking (SD-WAN) and Security Service Edge (SSE) segments, providing secure access to cloud platforms, applications, and data. The Company integrates technology from its strategic global technology vendors and carrier partners with its own proprietary systems, including Maintel Infrastructure Platform, Maintel Application Platform, and Maintel Orchestration Platform. It provides services to public and private sector organizations.

name: STAFFLINE GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Staffline Group plc is a United Kingdom-based recruitment company. The Company is engaged in the provision of recruitment and outsourced human resource services. The Company provides a pure-play recruitment platform with market reach across the United Kingdom and Ireland. Its division includes Recruitment GB and Recruitment Ireland. The Recruitment GB business provides flexible blue-collar workers, supplying c.30,000 staff per day on average from around 400 sites, across a range of industries, including supermarkets, drinks, driving, food processing, logistics and manufacturing. Recruitment Ireland is an end-to-end solution provider operating across multiple industries, ten branch locations and ten onsite customer locations, supplying c.4,500 staff per day on average, and offering RPO, MSP, temporary and permanent solutions across public and private sectors throughout the island of Ireland.

name: DR MARTENS PLC
businessSummary: Dr. Martens plc is a United Kingdom-based company, which designs, develops, procures, markets, sells and distributes footwear, under the Dr. Martens brand. The Company’s segments include Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA); Americas; and Americas and Asia-Pacific (APAC). Its product segments include boots, shoes, sandals, and bags & other. Its boots offerings include the 1460 8-eye boot, 2976 Chelsea boot, Jadon, Bex and Sinclair. Its shoes offerings include 1461 3-eye shoe and the Adrian tassel loafer, as well as franchises/families such as Buzz and Lowell. Its sandals range includes Blaire and Gryphon silhouettes and also includes the mules range, led by the Zebzag. Its bag range is focused on key silhouettes of leather bags, such as the Kiev backpack, the heart-shaped bag and its weekender bag. This category also includes socks, laces and shoe care. The Company offers its products through direct-to-consumer channel via its ecommerce platforms and its stores, among others.

name: STV GROUP PLC
businessSummary: STV Group plc is a digital media company. The Company's principal activities include the production of content for the United Kingdom and international commissioners, the acquisition of content for viewers of its linear broadcast and video on demand player, and the sale of advertising airtime and space in these media. Its segment include Audience and Studios. The Audience segment operates public service broadcaster STV which owns the Channel 3 licenses across central and north Scotland and is free-to-air on all the main TV platforms in Scotland. It also operates free streaming service, STV Player, features a library of premium content, including the United Kingdom original and international drama boxsets, sport and factual entertainment. The Studios segment includes the production business, STV Studios, which is the production company engaged in creating content for a range of United Kingdom and international broadcast networks and streamers.

name: WYNNSTAY GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Wynnstay Group PLC is a United Kingdom-based agricultural supplies company, which is engaged in supplying arable and livestock farmers with a wide range of inputs and services. The Company helps livestock and arable farmers to produce food. Its segments include Feed and Grain, Fertilizer and Seed, and Depot Merchanting. Its Feed and Grain segment manufactures and supplies a wide range of feeds and animal nutrition products for a range of sectors, including dairy, beef, sheep, and poultry. It also sells a range of feed raw materials through both the Wynnstay and Glasson Grain brands. The Company offers grain and combinable crop marketing services through the GrainLink business. Its Fertilizer and Seed segment manufactures blended fertilizer and its arable operations supply a wide range of services and products to arable and grassland farmers. The Company’s Depot Merchanting segment operates a network of 51 depots catering mainly to the needs of farmers but also rural dwellers.

name: INVESTEC PLC
businessSummary: Investec plc is a United Kingdom-based company. The Company provides its clients with products and services in the corporate mid-market, bespoke solutions to high-net-worth clients and access to a wealth management offering through its strategic partnership with Rathbones. Its principal business divisions include Wealth & Investment; Private Banking; Corporate, Investment Banking and Other, and Group Investments. Its private client offering provides transactional banking, lending, private capital, savings, and foreign exchange. Its corporate and investment banking activities include lending, advisory, hedging, savings, equity placement, and risk management services for private companies, private equity, institutions, intermediaries, and governments. This division also includes central treasury and liability management channels. Its subsidiaries are Investec Bank plc and Rathbones Group plc.

name: SURGICAL INNOVATIONS GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Surgical Innovations Group Plc is a holding company that is involved in the design, manufacture, and sale of devices for use in minimally invasive surgery (SI Brand) along with its own label products through original equipment manufacturer (OEM) relationships including precision engineering markets. The Company’s segments include SI Brand, OEM, and Distribution. The SI Brand segment is engaged in the research, development, manufacture, and distribution of SI branded minimally invasive devices. The OEM segment includes research, development, manufacture, and distribution of minimally invasive devices for third party medical device companies through their own label or co-branding. It also includes research, development, manufacture, and sale of minimally invasive technology products for precision engineering applications. The Distribution segment is engaged in the distribution of specialist medical products sold by Elemental Healthcare Ltd.

name: RWS HOLDINGS PLC
businessSummary: RWS Holdings plc is a United Kingdom-based global Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions company. The Company’s technology, backed by 45+ patents, makes enterprise AI culturally fluent, contextually accurate and secure, ensuring every interaction reflects a brand's tone, context and customer values. Its segments include Generate, Transform, and Protect. The Generate segment provides content technology and TrainAI data platform businesses. The Transform segment provides a global localisation platform, integrating language technologies and specialised services. The Protect segment provides mission-critical Intellectual Property (IP) services business.

name: JAMES CROPPER PLC
businessSummary: James Cropper PLC is engaged in advanced materials and paper and packaging, centered around four market audiences: energy solutions, composite solutions, luxury packaging and creative papers. Its advanced materials incorporate pioneering nonwovens and electrochemical coatings for its customers globally, including components in fuel cells and hydrogen electrolysis. In paper and packaging, they range from luxury packaging and creative papers, including bespoke colors and textures in paper and molded fiber packaging designed. It offers composite solutions and energy solutions. Its products include Abrasion Resistance, Carrier, Corrosion Resistance, Catalysts, Cell Separators, Electrodes, GDL Substrate, and others. It serves various markets, including aerospace, automotive, batteries, consumer electronics, marine and others. Its portfolio of products is in use on commercial aircraft, delivering surface finish solutions, improved processing, light weighting efficiency solutions, and more.

name: HILTON FOOD GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Hilton Food Group plc is a United Kingdom-based specialist international food packing business supplying international food retailers in European countries, Australia and New Zealand. The Company operates in five categories including meat, seafood, easier meals, supply chain services, and vegan and vegetarian. Its vegan and vegetarian category is focused on plant-based products and deliver fresh and frozen products to its customers in retail, food service and branded with both private label and co-manufactured products for global brands. Its Foods Connected platform is a cloud-based solution that gives a 360-degree view over supply chains. Its seafood products range from smoked salmon, wet fish, shellfish, coated fish and fish cakes. Its easier meals engage in from straight-to-oven trays to ready meals, soups, sandwiches and wraps. Its supply chain services include software and automation solutions.

name: NAHL GROUP PLC
businessSummary: NAHL Group PLC is a United Kingdom-based company. The Company is engaged in consumer legal services and catastrophic injury markets, delivering products and services to consumers and businesses through its two divisions: Consumer Legal Services and Critical Care. Its Consumer Legal services division focuses on the Personal Injury and Residential Conveyancing sectors of the legal services market. The division provides outsourced marketing services to law firms through the National Accident Helpline brand and claims processing to individuals through National Accident Law (NAL), and its joint venture LLPs. In addition, it also provides property searches through Searches UK. It operates Critical Care business through Bush & Co (Bush), which provides vital services supporting individuals who have suffered severe and life changing injuries whilst they pursue a compensation claim. Its subsidiaries include Consumer Champion Group Limited, NAH Group Ltd, Rehabilitation Limited, and others.

name: PANTHEON INFRASTRUCTURE PLC
businessSummary: Pantheon Infrastructure Plc is a United Kingdom-based closed-ended investment company. The Company's primary investment objective is to seek to maximize long-term capital growth for its shareholders by investing in equity or equity-related investments in a diversified portfolio of infrastructure assets. Investments are not restricted to a single market but are made when the opportunity arises and on an international basis. The Company seeks to generate attractive risk adjusted total returns for shareholders over the longer term. These returns are made up of capital growth with a progressive dividend, through the acquisition of equity or equity related investments in a diversified portfolio of infrastructure assets with a primary focus on developed OECD markets. It invests in various sectors, such as digital infrastructure, power and utilities, renewables and energy efficiency, and transport and logistics. Pantheon Ventures (UK) LLP is the investment manager of the Company.

name: GATELEY (HOLDINGS) PLC
businessSummary: Gateley (Holdings) Plc is a professional services company. The Company is engaged in the provision of commercial legal services together with complementary professional consultancy services. Its segments include Corporate, Business Service, People, and Property. The Corporate segment includes banking, corporate, restructuring advisory, and taxation. The Business Service segment includes commercial, commercial dispute resolution, complex international litigation, and reputation, media, and privacy law. The People segment includes employment, pensions, and private clients. The Property segment includes real estate, residential development, construction, planning, and real estate dispute resolution. The Company’s subsidiaries include Gateley Plc, Entrust Pension Limited, Gateley Capitus Limited, Gateley Hamer Limited, International Investments Services Limited, Persona Associates Limited, T-Three Consulting Limited, Gateley Vinden Limited, Thomas Alexander Holdings Limited, and others.

name: J SMART & CO (CONTRACTORS) PLC
businessSummary: J. Smart & Co. (Contractors) PLC is a United Kingdom-based commercial, residential and industrial developer in Scotland. The Company's principal activities are building and civil engineering contracting, residential development for sale, the development of industrial and commercial property for lease and the provision of serviced office spaces. The main area of operations is the central belt of Scotland. The main construction activity undertaken by the Company is that of social housing for several housing associations and registered social landlords predominately in the Edinburgh area and construction of its own private housing for sale. It carries out commercial and industrial developments that are self-financed and are retained for lease in the Company's property portfolio, which totals more than approximately 90,000 square meters in the Central Belt. It has a number of joint venture projects where it sets up joint venture companies with its partners to deliver the projects.

name: MOUNTVIEW ESTATES P.L.C.
businessSummary: Mountview Estates P.L.C. is a United Kingdom-based property trading company.
